text.body:
<1.1>
|| atha śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe prathamaṃ māheśvarakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate|| ||śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ|| oṃnamo bhagavate vāsudevāya|| oṃnārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam|| devīṃ sarasvatī caiva tato jayamudīrayet|| 1.1 ||
<1.1.1>
||vyāsa uvāca|| yasyājñayā jagatsraṣṭāviriṃciḥ pālako hariḥ|| saṃhartā kālarudrākhyo namastasmai pinākine| 1.1 || tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam|| tatraiva naimiṣāraṇye saunakādyāstapodhanāḥ|| dīrghasatraṃ prakurvaṃtaḥ satriṇaḥ karmacetasaḥ|| 1.2 || teṣāṃ sadarśanautsukyādāgato hi mahā tapāḥ|| vyāsaśiṣyomahāprājño lomaśonāma nāmataḥ|| 1.3 || tatrāgataṃ te dadṛśurmunayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ|| uttasthuryugapatsarve sārghyahastāḥ samutsukāḥ|| 1.4 || dattvārghyapādyaṃ satkṛtya munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ|| taṃ papracchurmahābhāgāḥ śivadharmaṃ savistaram|| 1.5 || ||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| kathayasva mahāprājña devadevasya śūlinaḥ|| mahimānaṃ mahābhāga dhyānārcanasamanvitam|| 1.6 || saṃmārjane kiṃ phalaṃ syāttathā raṃgāvalīṣuca|| pradāne darpaṇasyātha tathā vai cāmarasya ca|| 1.7 || pradāne ca vitānasya tathā dhārāgṛhasya ca|| dīpadāne kiṃ phalaṃ syātpūjāyāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet|| 1.8 || kānikāni ca puṇyāni kathyatāṃ śivapūjane|| itihāsapurāṇāni vedādhyayanameva ca|| 1.9 || śivasyāgre prakurvaṃti kārayantyathavānarāḥ|| kiṃ phalaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ teṣāṃ kathyatāṃ vistareṇa hi|| 1.10 || śivākhyānaparoloke tvatto nānyo'sti vai mune|| 1.11 || iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām|| uvāca vyāsaśiṣyo'sau śivamāhātmyamuttamam|| 1.12 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu gīyate vai paraḥśivaḥ|| tasmācchivasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ ko'pi na pāryate|| 1.13 || śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma vyāhariiṣyaṃti ye janāḥ|| teṣāṃ svargaśca mokṣaśca bhaviṣyati na cānyathā|| 1.14 || udāro hi mahādevo devānāṃ patiriśvaraḥ|| yena sarvaṃ pradattaṃ hi tasmātsarva iti smṛtaḥ|| 1.15 || te dhanyāste mahātmāno ye bhajaṃti sadā śivam|| 1.16 || vinā sadāśivaṃ yohi saṃsāraṃ tartumicchati|| sa mūḍho hi mahāpāpaḥ śivadveṣī na saṃśayaḥ|| 1.17 || bhakṣitaṃ hi garaṃ yena dakṣayajño vināśitaḥ|| kālasya dahanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ rājñaḥ pramocanam|| 1.18 || ||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| yathā garaṃ bhakṣitaṃ ca yathā yajño vināśitaḥ|| dakṣasya ca tathā brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ|| 1.19 || ||sūta uvāca|| dākṣāyaṇī purā dattā śaṃkarāya mahātmane|| vacanādbrahmaṇo viprā dakṣeṇa parameṣṭhinaḥ|| 1.20 || ekadā hi sa dakṣo vai naimiṣāraṇyamāgataḥ|| yadṛcchāvaśamāpanna ṛṣibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ|| 1.21 || stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ|| tatra sthito mahādevo nābhyutthānābhivādane|| cakārāsya tataḥ kruddho dakṣo vacanabravīt|| 1.22 || sarvatra sarve hi surāsurā bhṛśaṃ namaṃti māṃvipravarāḥ samutsukāḥ|| kathaṃ hyasau durjanavanmahātmā bhūtādibhiḥ pretapiśācayuktaḥ|| śmaśānavāsī nirapatrapo hyayaṃ kathaṃ praṇāmaṃ na karoti me'dhunā|| 1.23 || pākhaṃḍino durjanāḥ pāpaśīlā vipraṃ dṛṣṭvā coddhatā unmadāśca|| vadhyāstyājyāḥ sadbhirevaṃvidhā hi tasmādenaṃ śāpituṃ codyato'smi|| 1.24 || ityevamuktvā sa mahātapāstadā ruṣānvito rudramidaṃ babhāṣe|| 1.25 || śrṛṇvaṃ tvamī vipratamā idānīṃ vaco hi me kartumihārhathaitat|| rudro hyayaṃ yajñabāhyo vṛto me varṇātīto varṇaparo yataśca|| 1.26 || naṃdī niśamya tadvākyaṃ śailādo hi ruṣānvitaḥ|| abravīttvarito dakṣaṃ śāpadaṃ taṃ mahāprabham|| 1.27 || ||nandyuvāca|| yajñabāhyo hi me svāmī maheśo'yaṃ kṛtaḥ katham|| yasya smaraṇamātreṇa yajñāśca saphalā hyamī|| 1.28 || yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca|| yasya nāmnā pavitrāṇi soyaṃ śapto'dhunā katham|| 1.29 || vṛthā te brahmacāpalyācchapto'yaṃ dakṣa durmate|| yenedaṃ pālitaṃ viśvaṃ sarveṇa ca mahātmanā|| śapto'yaṃ sa kathaṃ pāpa rudro'yaṃ brāhmaṇādhama|| 1.30 || evaṃ nirbhārtsitastena naṃdinā hi prajāpatiḥ|| naṃdinaṃ ca śaśāpātha dakṣo roṣasamanvitaḥ|| 1.31 || yūyaṃ sarve rudravarā vedabāhyāśca vai bhṛśam|| śaptāhi vedamārgaiśca tathā tyaktā maharṣibhiḥ|| 1.32 || pāṣaṃḍavādasaṃyuktāḥ śiṣṭa''cārabahiṣkṛtāḥ|| kapālinaḥ pānaratāstathā kālamukhā hyamī|| 1.33 || iti śaptāstadā tena dakṣeṇa śivakiṃkarāḥ|| tadā prakupito naṃdī dakṣaṃ śaptuṃ pracakrame|| 1.34 || śaptā vayaṃ tvayā vipra sādhavaḥ śivakiṃkarāḥ|| vṛthaiva brahmacāpalyādahaṃ śāpaṃ dadāmi te|| 1.35 || vedavādaratā yūyaṃ nānyadastītivādinaḥ|| kāmātmānaḥ svargaparā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ|| 1.36 || vaidikaṃ ca puraskṛtya brāhmaṇāḥ śūdrayājakāḥ|| daridriṇo bhaviṣyaṃti pratigraharatāḥ sadā|| 1.37 || dakṣa kecidbhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇā brahmarākṣasāḥ|| ||lomaśa uvāca|| viprāste śapitāstena naṃdinā kopinā bhṛśam|| 1.38 || athākarṇyeśvaro vākyaṃ naṃdinaḥ prahasanniva|| uvāca vākyaṃ madhuraṃ bodhayayuktaṃ sadāśivaḥ|| 1.39 || ||mahādeva uvāca|| kopaṃ nārhasi vai kartuṃ brāhmaṇānprati vai sadā|| brāhmaṇāguravo hyete vedavādaratāḥ sadā|| 1.40 || vedo maṃtramayaḥ mākṣāttathā sūktamayo bhṛśam|| sūkte pratiṣṭhito hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām|| 1.41 || tasmānnātmavido nindyā ātmaivāhaṃ na cetaraḥ|| ko'yaṃ kastvaṃ kva cāhaṃ vai kasmācchaptā hi vai dvijāḥ|| 1.42 || prapaṃcaracanāṃ hitvā buddho bhava mahāmate|| tattvajñānena nirvartya svasthaḥ krodhādivarjitaḥ|| 1.43 || evaṃ prabodhitastena śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā|| vivekaparamo bhūtvā śailādo hi mahātapāḥ|| śivena saha saṃgamya paramānaṃdasaṃplutaḥ|| 1.44 || dakṣopi hi ruṣā''vi ṣṭaṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ|| yayau sthānaṃ svakaṃ tatra praviveśa ruṣā'nvitaḥ|| 1.45 || śraddhāṃ vihāya paramāṃ śivapūjakānāṃ niṃdāparaḥ sa hi babhūva narādhamaśca|| sarvairmaharṣibhirupetya sa tatra śarvaṃ devaṃ nininda na babhūva kadāpi śāntaḥ|| 1.46 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe purāṇaprastāvadakṣavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || cha ||
<1.1.2>
||lomaśa uvāca|| ekadā tu tadā tena yajñaḥ prāraṃbhito mahān|| tatrāhūtāstadā sarve dīkṣitena tapasvinā|| 2.1 || ṛṣayo vividhāstatra vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ samāgatāḥ|| agastyaḥ kaśyapo'triśca vāmadevastathā bhṛguḥ|| 2.2 || dadhīco bhagavānvyāso bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ|| ete cānye ca bahavaḥ samājagmurmaharṣayaḥ|| 2.3 || tathā sarve suragaṇā lokapālastathā'pare vidyādharāśca gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnarāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| 2.4 || saptalokātsamānīto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| vaikuṃṭhācca tathā viṣṇuḥ samānīto maravaṃ prati|| 2.5 || devendro hi samānīta iṃdrāṇyā saha suprabhaḥ|| tathā caṃdro hi rohiṇyā varuṇaḥ priyayayā saha|| 2.6 || kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho mṛgā''rūḍho'tha mārutaḥ|| bastā''rūḍhaḥ pāvakaśca pretā''rūḍho'tha nirṛti|| 2.7 || ete sarve samāyātā yajñavāṭe dvijanmanaḥ|| te sarve satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa ca durātmanā|| 2.8 || bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahāṃti ca|| tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni kauśalyena mahātmanā|| 2.9 || teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathājoṣaṃ samāsthitāḥ|| 2.10 || varttamāne mahāyajñe tīrthe kanakhale tathā|| ṛtvijaśca kṛtāstena bhṛgvādyāśca tapodhanāḥ|| 2.11 || dīkṣāyuktastadā dakṣaḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ|| bhāryayā sahito vipraiḥ kṛtasvatyayano bhṛśam|| 2.12 || reje mahattvena tadā suhṛdbhiḥ paritaḥ sadā|| etasminnaṃtare tatra dadhīcirvākyamabravīt|| 2.13 || ||dadhīciruvāca|| ete sureśā ṛṣayo mahattarāḥ salokapālāśca samāgatāstava|| tathā'pi yajñastu na śobhate bhṛśaṃpinākinā tena mahātmanā vinā|| 2.14 || yenaiva sarvāṇyapi maṃgalāni jātāni śaṃsaṃti mahāvipaścitaḥ|| so'sau na dṛṣṭo'tra pumānpurāṇo vṛṣadhvajo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kapardī|| 2.15 || amaṃgalānyeva ca maṃgalāni bhavaṃti yenādhikṛtāni dakṣa|| triyaṃbakenātha sumaṃgalāni bhavaṃti sadyohyapamaṃgalāni|| 2.16 || tasmāttvayaiva kartavyamāhvānaṃ parameṣṭhinā|| tvaritaṃ caiva śakreṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā|| 2.17 || sarvaireva hi gaṃtavyaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ|| 2.18 || dākṣāyaṇyā sametaṃ tamānayadhvaṃ tvarānvitāḥ|| tena sarvaṃ pavitraṃ syācchaṃbhunā yoginā bhṛśam|| 2.19 || yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā samagraṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena samāneyo vṛṣadhvajaḥ|| 2.20 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasannāha duṣṭadhīḥ|| mūlaṃ viṣṇurhi devānāṃ yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ|| 2.21 || yasminvedāśca yajñāśca karmāṇivividhāni ca|| pratiṣṭhitāni sarvāṇi so'sau viṣṇurihāgataḥ|| 2.22 || satyalokātsamāyāto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| vedaiścopaniṣadbhiśca āgamairvividhaiḥ saha|| 2.23 || tathā suragaṇaiḥ sākamāgataḥ surarāṭ svayam|| tathā yūyaṃ samāyātā ṛṣayo vītakalmaṣāḥ|| 2.24 || yeye yajñocitāḥ śāṃtāstete sarve samāgatāḥ|| vedavedārthatattvajñāḥ sarve yūyaṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ|| 2.25 || atraiva ca kimasmākaṃ rudreṇāpi prayojanam.|| kanyā dattā mayā viprā brahmaṇā noditena hi|| 2.26 || akulīno hyasau viprā naṣṭo naṣṭapriyaḥ sadā|| bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ patireko duratyayaḥ|| 2.27 || ātmasaṃbhāvito mūḍhaḥstabdho maunī samatsaraḥ|| karmaṇyasminnayogyo'sau nānīto hi mayā'dhunā|| 2.28 || tasmāttvayā na vaktavyaṃ punarevaṃ vacodvija|| sarvairbhavadbhiḥ kartavyo yajño me saphalo mahān|| 2.29 || etacchrutvā vacastasya dadhīcirvākyamabravīt|| 2.30 || ||dadhīciruvāca|| sarveṣāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām|| anayo'yaṃ mahāñjāto vinā tena mahātmanā|| 2.31 || vināśo'pi mahānsadyohyatratyānāṃ bhaviṣyati|| evamuktvā dadhīco'sāveka eva vinirgataḥ|| 2.32 || yajñavāṭācca dakṣasya tvaritaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau|| munau vinirgate dakṣaḥ prahasannidamabravīt|| 2.33 || gataḥ śivapriyo vīro dadhīcirnāma nāmataḥ|| āviṣṭacittā maṃdāśca mithyāvādaratāḥ khalāḥ|| 2.34 || vedabāhya durācārāstyājyāste hyatra karmaṇi|| vedavādaratā yūyaṃ sarve viṣṇupurogamāḥ|| 2.35 || yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ viprāḥ kurvaṃtu hyacirādiva|| tadā te devayajanaṃ cakruḥ sarve saharṣayaḥ|| 2.36 || etasminnaṃtare tatra parvate gaṃdhamādane|| dhārāgṛhe vimānena sakhībhiḥ parivāritā|| 2.37 || dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī cakāra vividhāstadā|| krīḍā vimānamadhyastā kandukādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ|| 2.38 || krīḍāsaktā tadā devī dadarśātha mahāsatī|| yajñaṃ prayāṃtaṃ somaṃ ca rohiṇyā sahitaṃ prabhum|| 2.39 || kva gamiṣyati caṃdro'yaṃ vijaye pṛccha satvaram|| tayoktā vijayā devī taṃ papraccha yathocitam|| 2.40 || kathitaṃ tena tatsarvaṃ dakṣasyaiva makhādikam|| tacchrutvā tvaritā devī vijayā jātasaṃbhramā|| kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ śaśinā bhṛśam|| 2.41 || vimṛśya kāraṇaṃ devī kimāhvānaṃ karoti na|| dakṣaḥ pitā me mātā ca vismṛtā māṃ kuto'dhunā|| 2.42 || pṛcchāmi śaṃkaraṃ cādya kāraṇaṃ kṛtaniścayā|| sthāpayitvā sakhīstatra āgatā śaṃkaraṃ prati|| 2.43 || dadarśataṃ sabhāmadhye trilocanamavasthitam|| gaṇaiḥ parivṛtaṃ sarvaiścaṃḍamuṃḍādibhistadā|| 2.44 || bāṇo bhṛṃgistathā naṃdī śailādo hi mahātapāḥ|| mahākālo mahācaṃḍo mahāmuṃḍo mahāśirāḥ|| 2.45 || dhūmrākṣo dhūmraketuśca dhūmrapādastathaiva ca|| ete cānye ca bahavo gaṇā rudrānuvartinaḥ|| 2.46 || kecidbhayānakā raudrāḥ kabaṃdhāśca tathā pare|| vilocanāśca kecicca vakṣohīnāstathā pare|| 2.47 || evaṃbhūtāśca śataśaḥ sarve te kṛttivāsasaḥ|| jaṭākalāpasaṃbhūṣāḥ sarve rudrākṣabhūṣaṇāḥ|| 2.48 || jiteṃdriyā vītarāgāḥ sarve viṣayavairiṇaḥ|| ebhiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ|| dṛṣṭastayā upāviṣṭa āsane parāmādbhute|| 2.49 || ākṣiptacittā sahasā jagāma śivasaṃnidhim|| śivena sthāpitā svāṃke prītiyuktena vallabhā|| 2.50 || premṇoditā vacobhiḥ sā bahumānapuraḥsaram|| kimāgamanakāryaṃme vada śīghraṃ sumadhyame|| 2.51 || evamuktā tadā tena uvācāsitalocanā|| 2.52 || ||satyuvāca|| piturmama mahāyajñe kasmāttava na rocate|| gamanaṃ devadevaśa tatsarvaṃ kathaya prabho|| 2.53 || suhṛdāmeṣa vai dharmaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ saha saṃgatim|| kurvaṃti yanmahādeva suhṛdāṃ prītivardhinīm|| 2.54 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena anāhūto'pi gaccha bhoḥ|| yajñavāṭaṃ piturme'dya vacanānme sadāśiva|| 2.55 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā ba bhāṣe sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ|| tvayā bhadre na gaṃtavyaṃ dakṣasya yajanaṃ prati|| 2.56 || tasya ye māninaḥ sarve sasurāsukiṃnarāḥ|| te sreva yajanaṃ prāptāḥ pitustava na saṃśayaḥ|| 2.57 || anāhūtāśca ye subhru gacchaṃti paramandiram|| apamānaṃ prāpnuvanti maraṇādadhikaṃ tataḥ|| 2.58 || pareṣāṃ maṃdiraṃ prāpta iṃdropi laghutāṃ vrajet|| tasmāttvāyā na gaṃtavyaṃ dakṣasya yajanaṃ śubhe|| 2.59 || evamuktā satī tena maheśena mahātmanā|| uvāca roṣasaṃyuktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varā|| 2.60 || yajño hi satyaṃ loke tvaṃ sa tvaṃ devavareśvara|| anāhūto'si tenādya pitrā me dṛṣṭacāriṇā|| tatsarvaṃ jñātumicchāmi tasya bhāvaṃ durātmanaḥ|| 2.61 || tasmāccādyaiva gacchāmi yajñavāḍaṃ piturmmama|| anujñāṃ dehi me nātha devadeva jagatpate|| 2.62 || ityukto bhagavānrudrastayā devyā śivaḥ svayam|| vijñātākhiladṛgdraṣṭā bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ|| 2.63 || sa tāmuvāca deveśo maheśaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ|| gaccha devi tvarāyuktā vacanānmama suvrate|| 2.64 || etaṃ naṃdinamāruhya nānāvidhagaṇānvitā|| gaṇāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi jagmūraudrāḥ śivajñayā|| 2.65 || tairgaṇaiḥ saṃvṛtā devī jagāma pitṛmaṃdiram|| nirīkṣya tadbalaṃ sarvaṃ mahādevotivismitaḥ|| 2.66 || bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi tebhyo devyai paraṃtapaḥ|| preṣayāmāsa cāvyagro mahādevo'nu pṛṣṭhataḥ|| 2.67 || devyā gataṃ vai svapiturgṛhaṃ tadā vimṛśya sarvaṃ bhagavānmaheśaḥ|| dākṣāyaṇī pitravamānitā satī na yāsyatīti svapuraṃ punarjagau|| 2.68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe dakṣayajñaṃ prati satīdevyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2 ||
<1.1.3>
||lomaśa uvāca|| dākṣāyaṇī gatā tatra yatra yajño mahānabhūt|| tatpituḥ sadanaṃ gatvā nā nāścaryasamanvitam|| 3.1 || dvāri sthitā tadā devā avatīrya nijāsanāt|| naṃdino hi mahābhāgā devalokaṃ nirīkṣya ca|| 3.2 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhi vāṃdhavān|| abhivādyaiva pirataṃ mātaraṃ ca mudānvitā|| 3.3 || babhāṣe vacanaṃ devī prastāpasadṛśaṃ tadā|| anāhūtastvayā kasmācchaṃbhuḥ paramaśobhanaḥ|| 3.4 || yena pūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ samagraṃ sacarācaram|| yajño yajñavidāṃ śreṣṭho yajñāṃgo yajñadakṣiṇaḥ|| 3.5 || dravyaṃ maṃtrādikaṃ sarvaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yanmayam|| vinā tena kṛtaṃ sarvamapavitraṃ bhaviṣyati|| 3.6 || śaṃbhunā hi vinā tāta kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravartate|| ete kathaṃ samāyātā brahmaṇā sahitāḥ pitaḥ|| 3.7 || he bhṛgo tvaṃ na jānāsi he kaśyapa mahāmate|| atre viśiṣṭha ekastvaṃ śakra kiṃ kṛtamadyate|| 3.8 || he viṣṇo tvaṃ mahādevaṃ jānāsi parameśvaram|| brahmankiṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi mahādevasya vikramam|| 3.9 || purā paṃcamukho bhūtvā garvitosi sadāśivam|| kṛtaścaturmukhastena vismṛto'si tadadbhutam|| 3.10 || bhikṣāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena purā dāruvane vibhuḥ|| śaptoyaṃ bhikṣuko rudro bhavadbhiḥ sakhibhistadā|| 3.11 || śaptenāpi ca rudreṇa bhavadbhirvismṛtaṃ katham|| yasyāvayavamātreṇa pūritaṃ sacarācaram|| 3.12 || liṃgabhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ jātaṃ tatkṣaṇameva hi|| layānālliṃgamityāhuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ|| 3.13 || sarve devāśca saṃbhūtā yato devasya śūlinaḥ|| so'sau vedāṃtago devastvayā jñātuṃ na pāryate|| 3.14 || tasyā vacanamākarṇya dakṣaḥ kruddho'bravīdvacaḥ|| kiṃ tvayā bahunoktena kāryaṃ nāstīha sāṃpratam|| 3.15 || gaccha vā tiṣṭhavā bhadre kasmāttvaṃ hi samāgatā|| amaṃgalo hi bhartā te aśivosau sumadhyame|| 3.16 || akulīno vedabāhyo bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ|| tasmānnākārito bhadre yajñārthaṃ cārubhāṣiṇi|| 3.17 || mayā dattāsi suśroṇi pāpinā maṃdabuddhinā|| rudrāyāviditārthāya uddhatāya durātmane|| 3.18 || tasmātkāyaṃ parityajya svasthā bhava śucismite|| dakṣeṇoktā tadā putrī sā satī lokapūjitā|| 3.19 || niṃdāyuktaṃ svapitaraṃ vilokya ruṣitā bhṛśam|| ciṃtayaṃtī tadā devī kathaṃ yāsyāmi maṃdire|| 3.20 || śaṃkaraṃ draṣṭukāmāṃha kiṃ vakṣye tena pṛcchitā|| yo niṃdati mahādevaṃ niṃdyamānaṃ śrṛṇoti yaḥ|| tāvubhau narake yāto yāvaccandradivākarau|| 3.21 || tasmāttayakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam|| 3.22 || evaṃ mīmāṃsamānā sā śivarudretibhāṣiṇī|| apamānābhibhūtā sā praviveśa hutāśanam|| 3.23 || hāhākāreṇa mahatā vyāptamāsīddigaṃtaram|| sarve te maṃcamārūḍhāḥ śastrairvyāptā niraṃtarāḥ|| 3.24 || śastraiḥ svairjadhnurātmānaṃ svāni dehāni cicchiduḥ|| kecitkaratale gṛhya śirāṃsi svāni cotsukāḥ|| 3.25 || nīrājayaṃtastvaritā bhasmībhūtāśca jajñire|| evamūcustadā sarve jagarjjuratibhīṣaṇam|| 3.26 || śastraprāhāraiḥ svāṃgāni cicchiduścātibhīṣaṇāḥ|| te tathā vilayaṃ prāptā dākṣāyaṇyā samaṃ tadā|| 3.27 || gaṇāstatrāyūte dve ca tadadbhutamivābhavat|| te sarva ṛṣayo devā iṃdrādyāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ|| 3.28 || viśve'śvanau lokapālāstūṣṇīṃbūtāstadābhavan|| viṣṇuṃ vareṇyaṃ kecicca prārthayaṃtaḥ samaṃtataḥ|| 3.29 || evaṃ bhūtastadā yajño jātastasya durātmanaḥ|| dakṣasya brahmabaṃdhośca ṛṣayo bhayamāgatāḥ|| 3.30 || etasminnaṃtare viprā nāradena mahātmanā|| kathitaṃ sarvamevaitaddakṣasya ca viceṣṭitam|| 3.31 || tadākarṇyeśvaro vākyaṃ nāradasya mukhodgatam|| cukopa paramaṃ kruddha āsanādutpatanniva|| 3.32 || uddhṛtya ca jaṭāṃ rudro lokasaṃhārakārakaḥ|| āsphoṭayāmāsa ruṣā parvatasya śiropari|| 3.33 || tāḍanācca samudbhūto vīrabhadro mahāyaśāḥ|| tathā kālī samutpannā bhūtakoṭibhirāvṛtā|| 3.34 || kopānniḥśvasitenaiva rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ|| jātaṃ jvarāṇāṃ ca śataṃ sannipātāstrayodaśa|| 3.35 || vijñapto vīrabhadreṇa rudro raudraparākramaḥ|| kiṃ kāryaṃ bhavataḥ kāryaṃ śīghrameva vada prabho|| 3.36 || ityukto bhagavānrudraḥ preṣayāmāsa satvaram|| gaccha vīra mahā bāho dakṣayajñaṃ vināśaya|| 3.37 || śāsanaṃ śirasā dhṛtvā devadevasya śūlinaḥ|| kālikā''lihito vīraḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ|| vīrabhadro mahātejā yayau dakṣamakhaṃ prati|| 3.38 || tadānīmeva sahasā durnimittāni cābhavan|| rūkṣo vavau tadā vāyuḥ śarkarābhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ|| 3.39 || asṛgvarṣati devaśca timireṇā''vṛtā divaśaḥ|| ulkāpātāśca bahavaḥ petururvyāṃ sahasraśaḥ|| 3.40 || evaṃvidhānyariṣṭāni dadṛśurvibudhādayaḥ|| dakṣo'pi bhayamāpanno viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamāyayau|| 3.41 || rakṣarakṣa mahāviṣṇo tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ|| yajño'si tvaṃ suraśreṣṭha bhayānmāṃ parimocaya|| 3.42 || dakṣeṇa prārthya māno hi jagāda madhusūdanaḥ|| mayā rakṣā vidātavyā bhavato nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 3.43 || apūjyā yatra pūjyaṃte pūjanīyo na pūjyate|| trīṇī tatra pravartaṃte durbhikṣaṃ tvayā dharmamajānatāḥ|| īśvarāvajñayā sarvaṃ viphalaṃ ca bhaviṣyati|| 3.44 || apūjyā yatra pūjyaṃ te pūjanīyo na pūjyate|| trīṇī tatra pravartaṃte durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ bhayam|| 3.45 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena mānanīyo vṛṣadhvajaḥ|| amānitānmaheśāttvāṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam|| 3.46 || adhunaiva vayaṃ sarve prabhavo na bhavāmahe|| bhavato durnnayeneva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 3.47 || viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaściṃtāparo'bhavat|| vivirṇavadano bhūtvā tūṣṇīmāsīdbhuvi sthitaḥ|| 3.48 || vīrabhadro mahābāhū rudreṇaiva pracoditaḥ|| kālī kātyāyanīśānā cāmuṃḍā muṃḍamarddinī|| 3.49 || bhadrakālī tathā bhadrā tvaritā vaiṣṇavī tathā|| navadurgādisahito bhūtānāṃ ca gaṇo mahān|| 3.50 || śākinī ḍākinī caiva bhūtapramathaguhyakāḥ|| tathaiva yoginīcakraṃ catuḥ ṣaṣṭyā samanvitam|| 3.51 || nijanmuḥ sahasā tatra yajñavāṭaṃ mahāprabham|| vīrabhadrasametā sarve haraparākramāḥ|| daśabāhavastrinetrā jaṭilā rudrabhūṣaṇāḥ|| 3.52 || pārṣadāḥ śaṃkarasyaite sarve rudrasvarūpiṇaḥ|| paṃcavaktrā nīlakaṃṭhāḥ sarve te śastrapāṇayaḥ|| 3.53 || chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ sarve haraparākramāḥ|| daśabāhavastrinetrā jaṭilā rudrabhūṣaṇāḥ|| 3.54 || ardhacaṃdradharāḥ sarve sarve caiva mahaujasaḥ|| sarve te vṛṣabhārūḍhāḥ sarve te veṣabhūṣaṇāḥ|| 3.55 || sahasrabāhurbhujagādhipairvṛtastrilocano bhīmabalo bhayāvahaḥ|| ebhiḥ sametaśca tadā mahātmā sa vīrabhadro'bhijagāma yajñam|| 3.56 || yugyānāṃ ca sahasreṇa dvipramāṇena syaṃdanam|| siṃhānāṃ prayutenaiva vāhyamānaṃ ca tasya tat|| 3.57 || tathaiva daṃśitāḥ siṃhā bahavaḥ pārśvarakṣakāḥ|| śārdūlā makarā matsyā gajāścaiva sahasraśaḥ|| chatrāṇi vividhānyeva cāmarāṇi tathaiva ca|| 3.58 || mūrddhanidhriyamāṇāni sarvatogrāṇi sarvaśaḥ|| tato bherīmahānādāḥ śaṃkhāśca vividhasvanāḥ|| paṭahā gomukhāścaiva śrṛṃgāṇi vividhāni ca|| 3.59 || tato'vādyaṃta tānyeva ghanāni suṣirāṇi ca|| kalagānaparāḥ sarve sarve mṛdaṃgavādinaḥ|| 3.60 || anekalāsyasaṃyuktā vīrabhadrāgratobhavan|| raṇavāditranirghoṣairjagarjuramitaujasaḥ|| 3.61 || tena nādena mahatā nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam|| evaṃ sarve samāyātā gaṇā rudrapraṇoditāḥ|| 3.62 || yajñavāṭaṃ ca dakṣasya vināśārthaṃ prahāriṇaḥ|| rajasā cā''vṛtaṃ vyoma tamasā ca vṛtā diśaḥ|| 3.63 || saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī cacāla sādrikānanā|| te dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryyaṃ lokakṣayakaraṃ tadā|| 3.64 || uttasthuryugapatsarve devadaityaniśācarāḥ|| te vai dadṛśurāyāṃtīṃ rudrasenā bhayāvahām|| 3.65 || pṛthvīṃ kecitsamāyātā gagane kecidāgatāḥ|| diśaśca pradiśaścaiva samāvṛtya tathāpare|| 3.66 || anaṃtā hyakṣayāḥ sarve śūrā rudrasamā yudhi|| evaṃbhūtaṃ ca tatsainyaṃ rudraiśca parivāritam|| dṛṣṭvo curvismitāḥ sarve yāmo'dya śastrapāṇayaḥ|| 3.67 || iṃdro hi gajamārūḍho mṛgārūḍhaḥ sadāgatiḥ|| yamo mahiṣamārūḍho yamadaṃḍasamanvitaḥ|| 3.68 || kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍhaḥ pāśī makarameva ca|| agnirbastamārūḍho nirṛtiḥ pretameva ca|| 3.69 || tathānye surasaṃghāśca yakṣacāraṇaguhyakāḥ|| āruhya vāhanānyeva svānisvāni pratipinaḥ|| 3.70 || sveṣāmudyogamālokya dakṣaścāśrumukhastataḥ|| daṃḍavatpatito bhūmau sarvānevābhyabhāṣata|| 3.71 || yuṣmadbalenaiva mayā yajñaḥ prāraṃbhito mahān|| satkarmasiddhaye yūyaṃ pramāṇaṃ sumahāprabhāḥ|| 3.72 || viṣṇo tvaṃ karmaṇaḥ sākṣādyajñānāṃ paripālakaḥ|| dharmasya vedagarbhasya brahmaṇyastvaṃ ca mādhava|| 3.73 || tasmādrakṣā vidhātavyā yajñasyā'sya mahāprabho|| dakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca madhusūdanaḥ|| 3.74 || mayā rakṣā vidhātavyā dharmasya paripālane|| tatsatyaṃ tu tvayoktaṃ hi kiṃ tu tasya vyatikramaḥ|| 3.75 || yātastvadyaiva yajñasya yattvayoktaṃ sadāśivam|| naimiṣe'nimiṣakṣetre tadā kiṃ na smṛtaṃ tvayā|| 3.76 || yo'yaṃ rudro mahātejā yajñarūpaḥ sadāśivaḥ|| yajñabāhyaḥ kṛto mūḍha tacca durmmatritaṃ tava|| 3.77 || rudrakopācca ko hyatra samartho rakṣaṇe tava|| na paśyāmi ca taṃ vipra tvāṃ vai rakṣati durmmatim|| 3.78 || kiṃ karmma kimakarmmeti tanna paśyasi durmmate|| samarthaṃ kevalaṃ karmana bhaviṣyati sarvadā|| 3.79 || seśvaraṃ karma viddhyotatsamarthatvena jāyate|| na hyanyaḥ karmmaṇo dātā īśvareṇa vinā bhavet|| 3.80 || īśvarasya ca ye bhaktāḥ śāṃtāstadgatamānasāḥ|| karmmaṇo hi phalaṃ teṣāṃ prayacchati sadāśivaḥ|| 3.81 || kevalaṃ karma cāśritya nirīśvaraparā janāḥ|| nirayaṃ te ca gacchaṃti koṭiyajñaśatairapi|| 3.82 || punaḥ karmamayaiḥ pāśairbaddhā janmanijanmani|| nirayeṣu prapacyaṃte kevalaṃ karmmarūpiṇaḥ|| 3.83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe vīrabhadraprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3 ||
<1.1.4>
||lomaśa uvāca|| viṣṇunoktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā dakṣo vacanamabravīt|| vedānāmapramāṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ te madhusūdana|| 4.1 || vaidikaṃ karma cotsṛjya kathaṃ seśvaratāṃ vrajet|| taducyatāṃ mahāviṣṇo yena dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ|| 4.2 || dakṣeṇokto mahāviṣṇuruvāca parisāṃtvayan|| traigaṇyaviṣayā vedāḥ saṃbhavaṃti na cānyathā|| 4.3 || vedoditāni karmāṇi īśvareṇa vinā katham|| saphalāni bhaviṣyaṃti viphalānyeva tāni ca|| 4.4 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraaijā|| evaṃ bruvati govinda āgataḥ sainyasāgaraḥ|| vīrabhadreṇa sadṛśo dadṛśustaṃ tadā surāḥ|| 4.5 || iṃdropi prahasanviṣṇumātmavādarataṃ tadā|| vajrapāṇiḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ yoddhukāmo'bhavattadā|| 4.6 || bhṛguṇācāritaḥ śīghramuccāṭanapareṇa hi|| tadā gaṇāḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ yuyudhuste gaṇānvitāḥ|| 4.7 || śaratomaranāgacairjaghnuste ca parasparam|| neduḥśaṃkhāśca bahuśastasminraṇamahotsave|| 4.8 || tathā dundubhayo neduḥ paṭahā ḍiṃḍimādayaḥ|| tena śabdena mahatāślāghyamānāstadā surāḥ|| lokapālaiśca sahitā jaghnustāñchivakiṃkarān|| 4.9 || khaḍgaiścāpi hatāḥ kecidgadābhiśca vipothitāḥ|| devaiḥ parājitāḥ sarve gaṇāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ|| 4.10 || iṃdrādyaurlokapālaiśca gaṇāste ca parāṅgamukhāḥ|| kṛtāśca tatkṣaṇādeva bhṛgormaṃtrabalena hi|| 4.11 || uccāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ bhṛguṇā yajvinā tadā|| yajanārthaṃ ca devānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ dīkṣitasya ca|| 4.12 || tenaiva devā jayino jātāstatkṣaṇameva hi|| svānāṃ parājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro rupānvitaḥ|| 4.13 || bhūtānpretānpiśācāṃśca kṛtvā tāneva pṛṣṭhataḥ|| vṛṣabhasthānpuraskṛtya svayaṃ caiva mahābalaḥ|| tīkṣṇaṃ triśūlamādāya pātayāmāsa tānraṇe|| 4.14 || devānyakṣānpiśācāṃśca guhyakānrākṣasāṃ stathā|| śūlaghātaiśca te sarve gaṇā devānprajaghnire|| 4.15 || keciddvidhākṛtāḥ khaṅgairmudgaraiścāpi pothitāḥ|| paraśvadhaiḥ khaṃḍaśaśca kṛtāḥ kecidraṇājire|| 4.16 || śūlairbhinnāśca śataśaḥ kecicca śakalīkṛtāḥ|| evaṃ parājitāḥ sarve palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ|| 4.17 || parasparaṃ pariṣvajya gatāstepi triviṣṭapam|| kevalaṃ lokapālāśca iṃdrādyāstasthurutsukāḥ|| bṛhaspatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ kutosmākaṃ jayo bhavet|| 4.18 || bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ sureṃdraṃ tvaritastadā|| ||bṛhaspatiruvāca|| yaduktaṃ viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ tatsatyaṃ jātamadya vai|| 4.19 || asti cedīśvaraḥ kaścitphalarūpyasya karmmaṇaḥ|| kartāraṃ bhajate sopi na hyakartuḥ prabhurhisaḥ|| 4.20 || na maṃtrauṣadhayaḥ sarve nābhicārā na laukikāḥ|| na karmāṇi na vedāśca na mīmāṃsādvayaṃ tathā|| 4.21 || jñātumīśāḥ saṃbhavaṃti bhaktyājñeyastvananyayā|| śāṃtyā ca parayā tṛṣṭyā jñātavyo hi sadāśivaḥ|| 4.22 || tena sarvaṃ saṃbhavaṃti sukhaduḥjhakhātmakaṃ jagat|| paraṃtu saṃvadiṣyāmi kāryākāryavivakṣayā|| 4.23 || tvamiṃdra bāliśo bhūtvā lokapālaiḥ sahādya vai|| āgato bāliśo bhūtvā idānīṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi|| 4.24 || ete rudrasahāyāśca gaṇāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ|| kupitāśca mahābhāgā na tu śeṣaṃ prakurvate|| 4.25 || evaṃ bṛhaspatervākyaṃ śrutvā te'pi divaukasaḥ|| ciṃtāmāpedire sarve lokapālā maheśvarāḥ|| 4.26 || tato'bravīdvīrabhadro gaṇaiḥ parivṛto bhṛśam|| sarve yūyaṃ bāliśatvādavadānārthamāgatāḥ|| 4.27 || avadānāni dāsyāmi tṛptyarthaṃ bhavatāṃ tvaran|| evamuktvā śitairbāṇairjaghānātha ruṣānvitaḥ|| 4.28 || tairbāṇairnihatāḥ sarve jagmuste ca diśo daśa|| 4.29 || gateṣu lokapāleṣu vidruteṣu sureṣu ca|| yajñavāṭe samāyāto vīrabhadro gaṇānvataḥ|| 4.30 || tadā ta ṛṣayaḥ sarve sarvameveśvareśvaram|| vijñaptukāmāḥ sahasā ūcurevaṃ janārdanam|| 4.31 || rakṣa yajñaṃ hi dakṣasya yajñosi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| etacchrutvā tu vacanamṛṣīṇāṃ vai janārdanaḥ|| 4.32 || yoddhukāmaḥ sthito yuddhe viṣṇuradhyātmadīpakaḥ|| vīrabhadro mahābāhuḥ keśavaṃ vākyamabravīt|| 4.33 || atra tvayāgataṃ kasmādviṣṇo vettrā mahābalam|| dakṣasya pakṣamāśritya kathaṃ jeṣyasi tadvada|| 4.34 || dākṣāyaṇyā kṛtaṃ yacca na dṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ tvayānagha|| tvaṃ cāpi yajñe dakṣasya avadānārthamāgataḥ|| avadānaṃ prayacchāmi tava cāpi mahābhūja|| 4.35 || evamuktvā praṇamyādau viṣṇuṃ sadṛśarūpiṇam|| vīrabhadro'grato bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ vākyamathābravīt|| 4.36 || yathā śaṃbhustathā tvaṃ hi mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ|| tathāpi tvaṃ mahābāho yoddhukāmo'grataḥ stitaḥ|| neṣyāmyapunarāvṛttiṃ yadi tiṣṭhestvamātmanā|| 4.37 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vīrabhadrasya dhīmataḥ|| uvāca prahasandevo viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ|| 4.38 || ||viṣṇuruvāca|| rudratejaḥprasūtosi pavitro'si mahāmate|| anena prārthitaḥ pūrvaṃ yajñārthaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ|| 4.39 || ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīnastathā so'pi maheśvaraḥ|| tenaiva kāraṇenātra dakṣasya yajanaṃ prati|| 4.40 || āgato'haṃ vīrabhadra rudrakopasamudbhava|| ahaṃ nivārayāmi tvāṃ tvaṃ vā māṃ vinivāraya|| 4.41 || ityuktavati goviṃde prahasya sa mahābhujaḥ|| praśrayāvanato bhūtvā idamāha janārdanam|| 4.42 || yathā śivastathā tvaṃ hi yathā tvaṃ ca tathā śivaḥ|| sevakāśca vayaṃ sarve tava vā śaṃkarasya ca|| 4.43 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya so'cyutaḥ saṃprahasya ca|| idaṃ viṣṇurmahāvākyaṃ jagāda parameśvaraḥ|| 4.44 || yodhayasva mahābāho mayā sārdhamaśaṃkitaḥ|| tavāstraiḥ pūryamāṇo'haṃ gacchāmi bhavanaṃ svakam|| 4.45 || tathetyuktvā tu vīro'sau vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ|| gṛhītvā paramāstrāṇi siṃhanādairjagarja ha|| 4.46 || viṣṇuścāpi mahāghoṣaṃ śaṃkhanādaṃ cakāra saḥ|| tacchrutvā ye gatā devā raṇaṃ hitvā''yayuḥ punaḥ|| 4.47 || vyūhaṃ cakrustadā sarve lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ|| tadendreṇa hato naṃdīvajreṇa śataparvaṇā|| 4.48 || naṃdīnā ca hataḥ śakrastriśūlena stanāṃtare|| vāyunā ca hato bhṛṃgī bhṛṃgiṇā vāyurāhataḥ|| 4.49 || śūlena sitadhāreṇa saṃnaddho daṇḍadhāriṇā|| yamena saha saṃgrāmaṃ mahākālo balānvitaḥ|| 4.50 || kubereṇa ca saṃgamya kūṣmāṃḍānāṃ patiḥ svayam|| varuṇena samaṃ yuddhaṃ muṃḍaścaiva mahābalaḥ|| 4.51 || yuyudhe parayāśaktyā trailokyaṃ vismayanniva|| nairṛtena samāgamya caṃḍaścabalavattaraḥ|| 4.52 || yuyudhe paramāstreṇa nairṛtyaṃ ca viḍaṃbayan|| yoginīcakrasaṃyukto bhairavo nāyako mahān|| 4.53 || vidārya devānakhilānpapau śoṇitamadbutam|| kṣetrapālāstathā cānye bhūtapramathaguhyakāḥ|| 4.54 || sākinī ḍākinī raudrā navadurgāstathaiva ca|| yoginyo yātudānyaśca tathā kūṣmāṃḍakādayaḥ|| neduḥ papuḥ śoṇitaṃ ca bubhujuḥ piśitaṃ bahu|| 4.55 || bhakṣyamāṇaṃ tadā sainyaṃ vilokya surarāṭsvayam|| vihāya naṃdinaṃ paścādvīrabhadraṃ samākṣipat|| 4.56 || vīrabhadro vihāyaiva viṣṇuṃ devendramāsthitaḥ|| tayoryuddhamabhūddhoraṃ budhāṃgārakayoriva|| 4.57 || vīrabhadraṃ yadā śakro haṃtukāmastvarānvitaḥ|| tāvacchaṃkraṃ gajasthaṃ hi purayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ|| 4.58 || vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo durnivāryo mahābalaḥ|| tadedreṃṇāhataḥ śīghraṃ vajreṇa śataparvaṇā|| 4.59 || sagajaṃ ca savajraṃ ca vāsavaṃ grastumudyutaḥ|| hāhākāro mahā nāsīdbhūtānāṃ tatra paśyatām|| 4.60 || vīrabhadraṃ tatābhūtaṃ tathābhūtaṃ haṃtukāmaṃ puraṃdaram|| tavramāṇastadā viṣṇurvīrabhadrāgrataḥ sthitaḥ|| 4.61 || śakraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā yodhayāmāsa vai tadā|| vīrabhadrasya viṣṇośca yuddhaṃ paramabhūttadā|| 4.62 || śastrāstrairvividhākārairyodhayāmāsatustadā|| punarnaṃdinamālokya śakro yuddha viśāradaḥ|| 4.63 || dvaṃdvayuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ devānāṃ pramathaiḥ saha|| pramathā mathitā devaiḥ sarve te prādravanraṇāt|| 4.64 || gaṇānparāṅmukhāndṛṣṭvā sarve te vyādhayo bhṛśam|| rudrakopātsamudbhūtā devāścāpi pradudruvuḥ|| 4.65 || jvaraistu pīḍitāndevāndṛṣṭvā viṣṇurhasanniva|| jīvagrāheṇa jagrāha devāṃstāṃśca pṛthakpṛthak|| 4.66 || devāścinau tadāhūya vyādhīnhaṃtuṃ tadā bhṛtim|| dadau tābhyāṃ prayatnena gaṇayitvā subuddhimān|| 4.67 || jvarāṃśca sannipātāṃśca anye bhūtadruhastadā|| tānsarvānnigṛhītvātha aśvinau tau mudānvitau|| vijvarānatha devāṃśca kṛtvā mumudatuściram|| 4.68 || tairjitaṃ yoginīcakraṃ bhairavaṃ vyākulīkṛtam|| tīkṣṇāgraiḥ pātayāmāsuḥ śarairbhūtagaṇānapi|| 4.69 || surairvidrāvitaṃ sainyaṃ vilokya patitaṃ bhuvi|| vīrabhadro rupāviṣṭo viṣṇuṃ vacanamabravīt|| 4.70 || tvaṃ śūrosi mahābāho devānāṃ pālako hyasi|| yudhyasva māṃ prayatnena yadi te matirīdṛśī|| 4.71 || ityuktvā taṃ samāsādya viṣṇuṃ sarveśvareśvaram|| vavarṣa niśitairbāṇairvīrabhadro mahābalaḥ|| 4.72 || tadā cakreṇa bhagavānvīrabhadraṃ jaghāna saḥ|| āyāṃtaṃ cakramālokya grasitaṃ tatkṣaṇācca tat|| 4.73 || grasitaṃ cakramālokya viṣṇuḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ|| mukhaṃ tasya parāmṛjya viṣṇunodgilitaṃ punaḥ|| 4.74 || svacakramādāya mahānubhāvo divaṃ gato'tho bhuvanaikabhartā|| jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ kṛtī kṛtaṃ duṣprasahaṃ pareṣām|| 4.75 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe vīrabhadrādīnāṃ viṣṇvādibhiḥ saha yuddhavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4 || cha ||
<1.1.5>
||lomaśa uvāca|| viṣṇau gate tadā sarve devāśca ṛṣibhiḥ saha|| vinirjitā gaṇaiḥ sarve ye ca yajñopajīvinaḥ|| 5.1 || bhṛguṃ ca pātayāmāsa smaśrūṇāṃ luṃcanaṃ kṛtam|| dvijāṃścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo vikṛtavikriyān|| 5.2 || viḍaṃbitā svadhā tatra ṛṣayaśca viḍaṃbitāḥ|| vavṛṣuste purīṣeṇa vitānāgnau rupānvitāḥ|| 5.3 || anirvācyaṃ tadā cakrurgaṇāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ|| aṃtarvedyaṃtaragato dakṣo vai mahato bhayāt|| 5.4 || taṃ nilīnaṃ samājñāya ānināyaruṣānvitaḥ|| kapoleṣu gṛhītvā taṃ khaḍgenopahataṃ śiraḥ|| 5.5 || abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān|| skaṃdhaṃ padbhyāṃ samākramya kadhare'pīḍayattadā|| 5.6 || gaṃdharātpāṭyamānācca śiraśchinnaṃ durātmanaḥ|| dakṣasya ca tadā tena vīrabhadreṇa dhīmatā|| tacchiraḥ suhutaṃ kuṃḍe jvalixxxxxxx|| 5.7 || ye cānya ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro yakṣarākṣasāḥ|| gaṇairupadrutāḥ sarve palāyanaparā yayuḥ|| 5.8 || caṃdrādityagaṇāḥ sarve grahanakṣatratārakāḥ|| sarve vicalitā hyāsangaṇaistepi hyupadrutāḥ|| 5.9 || satyalokaṃ gato brahmā putraśokena pīḍitaḥ|| ciṃtayāmāsa cāvyagraḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ kāryamadya vai|| 5.10 || manasā dūyamānena śaṃna lebhe pitāmahaḥ|| jñātvā sarvaṃ prayatnena duṣkṛtaṃ tasya pāpinaḥ|| 5.11 || gamanāya matiṃ cakre kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati|| haṃsārūḍho mahātejāḥ sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaḥ|| 5.12 || praviṣṭaḥ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ sa dadarśa sadāśivam|| ekāṃtavāsinaṃ rudraṃ śailādena samanvitam|| 5.13 || kaparddinaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ vedāṃgānāṃ ca durgamam|| tathāvidhaṃ samālokya brahma kṣobhaparo'bhavat|| 5.14 || daṃḍavatpatito bhūmaukṣamāpayitumudyataḥ|| saṃspṛśaṃ statpadābjaṃ ca caturmukuṭakoṭibhiḥ|| stutiṃ kartuṃ samārebhe śivasya paramātmanaḥ|| 5.15 || ||brahmovāca|| namo rudrāya śāṃtāya brahmaṇe paramātmane|| tvaṃ hi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā dhātā tvaṃ prapitāmahaḥ|| 5.16 || namo rudrāya mahate nīlakaṃṭhāya vedhase|| viśvāya viśvabījāya jagadānaṃdahetave|| 5.17 || oṃkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarvāraṃbhapravartakaḥ|| yajñosi yajñakarmāsi yajñānāṃ ca pravartakaḥ|| 5.18 || sarveṣāṃ yajñakartṝṇāṃ tvameva pratipālakaḥ|| śaraṇyosi mahādeva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prabho|| rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva putraśokena pīḍitam|| 5.19 || ||mahādeva uvāca|| śrṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā mama vākyaṃ pitāmaha|| dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgoyaṃ na kṛtaśca mayā kvacit|| 5.20 || svīyena karmaṇā dakṣo hato brahmanna saṃśayaḥ|| 5.21 || pareṣāṃ kleśadaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tatkadācana|| parameṣṭhinpareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati|| 5.22 || evamuktvā tadā rudro brahmaṇā sahitaḥ suraiḥ|| yayau kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ prajāpateḥ|| 5.23 || rudrastadā dadarśāya vīrabhadreṇa yatkṛtam|| svāhā svadhā tathā pūṣā bhṛgurmatimatāṃ varaḥ|| 5.24 || tadānya ṛṣayaḥ sarve pitaraśca tathāvidhāḥ|| ye'nye ca bahavastatra yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ|| 5.25 || troṭitā luṃcitāścaiva mṛtāḥ kecidraṇājire|| 5.26 || śaṃbhuṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro gaṇaiḥ saha|| daṃḍapraṇāmasaṃyuktastasthāvagre sadāśivam|| 5.27 || dṛṣṭvā puraḥ sthitaṃ rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam|| upāca prahasanvākyaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ vīra nanvidam|| 5.28 || dakṣamānaya śīghraṃ bho yenedaṃ kṛtamīdṛśam|| yajñe vilakṣaṇaṃ tāta yasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam|| 5.29 || evamuktaḥ śaṃkareṇa vīrabhadrastvarānvitaḥ|| kabaṃdhamānayitvātha śaṃbhoragre tadākṣipat|| 5.30 || tadoktaḥ śaṃkareṇaiva vīrabhadro mahāmanāḥ|| śiraḥ kenā panītaṃ ca dakṣasyāsya durātmanaḥ|| 5.31 || dāsyāmi jīvanaṃ vīra kuṭilasyāpi cādhunā|| evamuktaḥ śaṃkareṇa vīrabhadro'bravītpunaḥ|| 5.32 || mayā śiro hutaṃ cāgnau tadānīmeva śaṃkara|| avaśiṣṭaṃ śiraḥśaṃbho paśośca vikṛtānanam|| 5.33 || iti jñātvā tato rudraḥ kabaṃdhopari cākṣipat|| śiraḥ paśośca vikṛtaṃ kūrcayuktaṃ bhayāvaham|| 5.34 || sa dakṣo jīvitaṃ lebhe prasādācchaṃkarasya ca|| sa dṛṣṭvāgre tadā rudraṃ dakṣo lajjāsamanvitaḥ|| tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram|| 5.35 || ||dakṣa uvāca|| namāmi devaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ namāmi deveśvaraṃ sanātanam|| namāmi devādhipamīśvaraṃ haraṃ namāmi śaṃbhuṃ jagadekabaṃdhum|| 5.36 || namāmi viśveśvaraviśvarūpaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma nijātmarūpam|| namāmi sarvaṃ nijabhāvabhāvaṃ varaṃ vareṇyaṃ nato'smi|| 5.37 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| dakṣeṇa saṃstuto rudro babhāṣe prahasanrahaḥ|| 5.38 || ||hara uvāca|| caturvidhā bhajaṃte māṃ janāḥ sukṛtinaḥ sadā|| ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca dvijasattama|| 5.39 || tasmānme jñāninaḥ sarve priyāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ|| vinā jñānena māṃ prāptuṃ yataṃte te hi bāliśaḥ|| 5.40 || kevalaṃ karmaṇā tvaṃ hi saṃsārāttartumicchasi|| 5.41 || na vedaiśca na dānaiśca na yajñaistapasā kvacit|| na śaknuvaṃti māṃ prāptuṃ mūḍhāḥ karmmavaśānarāḥ|| 5.42 || tasmājjñānaparo bhūtvā kuru karmma samāhitaḥ|| sukhaduḥkhasamo bhūtvā sukhī bhava niraṃtaram|| 5.43 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| upadiṣṭastadā tena śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā|| dakṣaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpāya yayo rudraḥ svaparvatam|| 5.44 || brahmaṇāpi tathā sarve bhṛgvādyāśca maharṣayaḥ|| āśvāsitā bodhitāśca jñāninaścābhavankṣaṇāt|| 5.45 || gataḥ pitāmaho brahmā tataśca sadanaṃ svakam|| 5.46 || dakṣopi ca svayaṃ vākyātparaṃ bodhamupāgataḥ śivadhyānaparo bhūtvā tapastepe mahāmanāḥ|| 5.47 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃkṣevyo bhagavāñchivaḥ|| 5.48 || saṃmārjanaṃ ca kurvaṃti narā ye ca śivāṃgaṇe|| te vai śivapuraṃ prāpya jagadvaṃdyā bhagsi ca|| 5.49 || ye śivasya prayacchati darppaṇaṃ sumahāprabham|| bhaviṣyaṃti śivasyāgre pārṣadatvena te narāḥ|| 5.50 || cāmarāṇi prayacchaṃti devadevasya śūlinaḥ|| cāmarairvījyapānāste bhaviṣyaṃti jagattraya|| 5.51 || dīpadānaṃ prayacchaṃti mahādevālaye narāḥ|| tejasvino bhaviṣyaṃti te trailokyapradīpakā|| 5.52 || dhūpaṃ ye vai prayacchanti śivāya paramātmane|| yaśasvino bhaviṣyaṃti uddharanti kuladvayam|| 5.53 || naivedyaṃ ye prayacchaṃti bhakayā hariharāgrataḥ|| sikthesikthe kratuphalaṃ prāpnuvaṃti hi te narāḥ|| 5.54 || bhagnaṃ śivālayaṃ ye ca prakurvaṃti narottamāḥ|| prāpnuvati phala te vai dviguṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 5.55 || nūtanaṃ ye prakṛrvaṃti iṣṭakairaśmanāpi vā|| svarge hi te pramodaṃte yāvattiṣṭhati nirmalam|| yaśo bhūmau dvijaśreṣṭhā kāryā vicāraṇā|| 5.56 || kārayaṃti ca ye viprāḥ prāsādaṃ bahubhūmikam|| śivasyātha mahāprājñāḥ prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ gatim|| 5.57 || śuddhaṃ dhavalitaṃ ye ca kurvanti haramaṃdiram|| svīyaṃ parakṛtaṃ cāpi te'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim|| 5.58 || vitānaṃ ye prayacchati narāḥ sukṛtinopi hi|| tārayati kulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śivalokaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ|| 5.59 || ye ca nādamayīṃ ghaṃṭāṃ nibadhnaṃti śivālaye|| tejasvinaḥ kīrtimaṃto bhaviṣyaṃti jagattraye|| 5.60 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ cānupaśyati|| āḍhyo vāpi daridro vā sukhaṃ duḥkhātpracucyate|| 5.61 || śraddhāvānbhajate yo vā śivāya paramātmane|| kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya śivena saha modate|| 5.62 || atraivodāharaṃtīma mitihāsaṃ purātanam|| aiṃdradyumneśca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ|| 5.63 || purā kṛtayuge hyasīdindraseno narādhipaḥ|| pratiṣṭhānādhipo vīro mṛgayārasikaḥ sadā|| 5.64 || abrahmaṇyaḥ sadā krūraḥ kevalāsutṛpaḥ sadā|| paraprāṇaurnijaprāṇānpuṣṇāti sa khalaḥ sadā|| 5.65 || parastrīlaṃ paṭo'tyaṃtaṃ paradravyeṣu lolupaḥ|| brāhmaṇā ghātitāstena surāpaśca niraṃtaram|| 5.66 || gurulatpagatotyarthaṃ sadā sauvarṇataskaraḥ|| tathābhūtānugāḥ sarve rājñastasya durātmanaḥ|| 5.67 || evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra sa durātmavān|| tataḥ kālena mahatā paṃcatvaṃ prāpa durmatiḥ|| 5.68 || tadā yāmyaiśca nīto'sāviṃdraseno durātmavān|| yamāntikamanuprāptastadā rājā sakalmaṣaḥ|| 5.69 || yamena dṛṣṭastatrāsāviṃdrasenogrataḥ sthitaḥ|| abhyutthānaparo bhūtvā nanāma śirasā śivam|| 5.70 || dūtānsaṃbhartsayāmāsa yamo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ|| pāśairbaddhaṃ caṃdrasenaṃ muktvā provāca dharmarāṭ|| 5.71 || gaccha puṇyatamām̐llokānbhuṃkṣva rājanyasattama|| yāvadiṃdraśca nāke'sti yāvatsūryo nabhastale|| 5.72 || paṃcabhūtāni yāvacca tāvattvaṃ ca sukhī bhava|| sukṛtī tvaṃ mahārāja śivabhakto'si nityadā|| 5.73 || yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā iṃdrasenobhyabhāṣata|| ahaṃ śivaṃ na jānāmi mṛgayārasiko hyaham|| 5.74 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yamo bhāṣyamabhāṣata|| āhara praharasveti uktaṃ cedaṃ sadā tvayā|| 5.75 || tena karmavipākena sadā pūtosi mānada|| tasmāttvaṃ gaccha kailāsaṃ parvataṃ śaṃkaraṃ prati|| 5.76 || evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇasya yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ|| āgatāḥ śivadvatāste vṛṣārūḍhā mahāprabhāḥ|| 5.77 || nīlakaṃṭhā daśabhujāḥ paṃcavaktrāstrilocanāḥ|| kaparddinaḥ kuṃḍalinaḥ śaśaṃkāṃkitamaulayaḥ|| 5.78 || tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya yamo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ|| pūjayāmāsa tānsarvānmaheṃdrapratimāṃstadā|| 5.79 || tvarīrenaiva te sarve ūcurvaivasvataṃ yamam|| atrāgato mahābhāga iṃdraseno'mitadyutiḥ|| nāmnāḥ pravarttako nityaṃ rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ|| 5.80 || śrutvā ca vacanaṃ teṣāṃ yamena ca puraskṛtaḥ|| iṃdraseno vimānasthaḥ preṣito hi śivālayam|| 5.81 || ānītoyaṃ tadā taiśca pārṣadapravarottamaiḥ|| śaṃbhunā hi tadā dṛṣṭa iṃdraseno'mitadyutiḥ|| 5.82 || abhyutthāyāgato rudraḥ pariṣvajya tadā nṛpam|| arddhāsanagataṃ kṛtvā iṃdrasenaṃ tato'bravīt|| 5.83 || kiṃ dātavyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha prayacchāmi tavepsitam|| iti śrutvā vacastasya maheśasya tadā nṛpaḥ|| ānaṃdāśrukaṇānmuṃcanpremṇā novāca kiṃcana|| 5.84 || tadā kṛto maheśena pārṣado hi mahātmanā|| caṃḍo nāmnāca vikhyātomuṇḍasya ca sakhā priyaḥ|| 5.85 || nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa rudrasya paramātmanaḥ|| siddhiṃ prāpto hi pāpiṣṭha idraseno narādhipaḥ|| 5.86 || rahehareti vai nāmnā śaṃbhoścakradharasya ca|| rakṣitā bahavo martyāḥ śivena paramātmanā|| 5.87 || maheśānnāparo devo dṛśyatebhuvanatraye|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ|| 5.88 || patraiḥpuṣpaiḥ phalairvāpi jalairvā vimalaiḥ sadā|| karavīraiḥ pūjyamānaḥ śaṃkaro varado bhavet|| 5.89 || karavīrāddaśaguṇamarkapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate|| vibhūtyādikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| 5.90 || śivasyāṃgaṇalagnā yā tasmāttāṃ dhārayetsadā|| tatastripuṃḍre yatpumyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ|| 5.91 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ|| stenaḥ ko'pi mahāpāpo ghātito rājadūtakaiḥ|| 5.92 || taṃ khādituṃ samāyātaḥ śvāśirasyuparisthitaḥ|| nakhāṃtarālasaṃlagnā rakṣā tasyaiva pāpinaḥ|| 5.93 || lalāṭe patitā tasya tripuṃḍrāṃkiṃtamudrayā|| caitanyena vinā tasya dehamātraikalagnayā|| 5.94 || kailāsaṃ taskaro nīto rudradūtaistatastadā|| vibhūtermahimānaṃ tu ko viśeṣiturmahati|| 5.95 || vibhūtvā maṃḍitāṃgānāṃ narāṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām|| mukhe paṃcākṣaro yeṣāṃ rudrāste nātra śaṃśayaḥ|| 5.96 || jaṭākalāpino ye ca ye rudrākṣavibhūṣaṇāḥ|| te vai manuṣyarūpeṇa rudrā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ|| 5.97 || tasmātsadāśivaḥ puṃbhiḥ pūjanīyo hi nityaśaḥ|| prātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyaṃ saṃdhyā viśiṣyate|| 5.98 || prātastu darśanācchaṃbhornaiśameno vyapohati|| madhyāhne darśanācchaṃbhoḥ saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛṇām|| pāpaṃ praṇāśamāyāti niśāyāṃ naiva gaṇyate|| 5.99 || śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma mahā pāpapraṇāśanam|| yeṣāṃ mukhodgataṃ nṝṇāṃ tairidaṃ dhāryate jagat|| 5.100 || śivāṃgaṇe tu yā bherī sthāpitā puṇyakarmabhiḥ|| tasyā nādena pūtā vai ye ca pāparatā janāḥ|| pāṣaṃḍino'pyasadvādāste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim|| 5.101 || paśoryasya ca saṃbaddhā carmaṇā ca śivālaye|| nṛbhiryā sthāpitā bherī mṛdaṃgamurajādi ca|| sa paśuḥ śivasānnidhyamāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥ|| 5.102 || tasmāttataṃ ca vitataṃ ghanaṃ suṣirameva ca|| cāmarāṇi mahārhāṇi maṃcakāḥ śayanāni ca|| 5.103 || gāthāśca itihāsāśca gāyanaṃ ca yathāvidhi|| bahurūpādikaṃ śaṃbhoḥ priyānyetāni kalpayet|| 5.104 || kalpayitvā ca gacchaṃti śivalokaṃ hi pāpinaḥ|| sudharmāṇo mahātmānaḥ śivapūjāviśāradāḥ|| 5.105 || gurormukhācca saṃprāptaśivapūjāratāśca ye|| śivarūpeṇa ye viśvaṃ paśyaṃti kṛtaniścayāḥ|| 5.106 || samyagbuddhyā samācārā varṇāśramayutā narāḥ|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśvayāḥ śūdrāścānye tathā narāḥ|| 5.107 || śvapaco'pi variṣṭhaḥ sa śaṃbhoḥ priyataro bhavet|| śaṃbhunādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| 5.108 || tasmātsarvaṃ śivamayaṃ jñātavyaṃ suviśeṣataḥ|| vedaiḥ purāṇaiḥ śāstraiśca tathaupanipadairapi|| 5.109 || āgamairvividhaiḥ śaṃbhurjñātavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ|| niṣkāmaiśca sakāmaiśca pūjanīyaḥ sadā śivaḥ|| 5.110 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| kathayāmi purāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam|| naṃdī nāma purā vaiśyo hyavaṃtīpuramāvasat|| 5.111 || śivadhyānaparo bhūtvā śivapūjāṃ cakāra saḥ|| nityaṃ tapovanasthaṃ hi liṃgamekaṃ samarcayat|| 5.112 || uṣasyuṣasi cotthāya pratyahaṃ śivavallabhaḥ|| naṃdīliṃgārccanarato babhūvātiśayena hi|| 5.113 || liṃgaṃ paṃcāmṛtenaiva yathoktenābhyaṣecayat|| vipraiḥ samāvṛto nityaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ|| 5.114 || yathāśāstreṇa vidhinā liṃgārcanaparo'bhavat|| snāpayitvā tataḥ puṣpairnānaścaryasamanvitaiḥ|| 5.115 || muktāphalairiṃdranīlairgomedaiśca niraṃtaram|| vaiḍūryaiścaiva nīlaiśca māṇikyaiśca tathārcayat|| 5.116 || evaṃ naṃdī mahābhāgo bahūnyabdāni cārccayat|| vijanasthaṃ tadā liṃgaṃ nānābhogasamanvitam|| 5.117 || ekadā mṛgayāsaktaḥ kirāto bhūtahiṃsakaḥ|| avivekaparo bhūtvā mṛgayārasikaḥ sadā|| 5.118 || pāpī pāpasamācāro vicarangirikaṃdare|| anekaśvāpadākīrṇe hanyamāna itastataḥ|| 5.119 || evaṃ vicaramāṇo'sau kirāto bhūtahiṃsakaḥ|| yadṛcchayāgatastatra yatra liṃgaṃ supūjitam|| 5.120 || udakaṃ vīkṣmāṇo'sau tṛṣayā pīḍito bhṛśam|| tato vane saraḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā toye samāviśat|| 5.121 || tīre saṃsthāpya duṣṭātmā tatsarvaṃ mṛgayādikam|| gaṃḍūṣotsarjanaṃ kṛtvā pītvā toyaṃ ca nirgataḥ|| 5.122 || śivālayaṃ dadarśāgre anekāścaryamaṃḍitam|| dṛṣṭaṃ supūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ nānāratnaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak|| 5.123 || tathā liṃgaṃ samālakṣya yadā pūjāṃ samāharat|| ratnāni sarvabhūtāni vidhūtāni itastataḥ|| 5.124 || snapanaṃ tasya liṃgasya kṛtaṃ gaṃḍūṣavārīṇā|| kareṇaikena pūjārthaṃ bilvapatrāṇi so'rpayat|| 5.125 || dvitīyena karem̐ṇaiva mṛgamāṃsaṃ samarpayat|| daṇḍapraṇāmasaṃyuktaḥ saṃkalpaṃ manasā'karot|| 5.126 || adyaprabhṛti pūjāṃ vai kariṣyāmi prayatnataḥ|| tvaṃ me svāmī ca bhaktohamadyaprabhṛti śaṃkara|| 5.127 || evaṃ naiyamiko bhūtvā kirāto gṛhamāgataḥ|| nandī dadarśa tatsarvaṃ kirātena itastataḥ|| 5.128 || ciṃtāyukto'bhavannaṃdī jātaṃ kiṃ chidramadya me|| kathitāni ca vighnāni śivapūjāratasya ca|| upasthitāni tānyeva mama bhāgyaviparyayāt|| 5.129 || evaṃ vimṛśya suciraṃ prakṣālya śivamaṃdiram|| yathāgatena mārgeṇa naṃdī svagṛhamāgataḥ|| 5.130 || tato naṃdinamāgatya purodhā gatamānasam|| abravodvacanaṃ taṃ tu kasmāttvaṃ gatamānasaḥ|| 5.131 || purohitaṃ prati tadā nandī vacanamabravīt|| 5.132 || adya dṛṣṭaṃ mayā vipra amedhyaṃ śivasaṃnidhau|| kenedaṃ kāritaṃ tatra na jānāmi kathaṃcana|| 5.133 || tataḥ purodhā vacanaṃ nandinaṃ cābravīttadā|| yena viskhalitaṃ tatra ratnādīnāṃ prapūjanam|| so'pi mūḍho na saṃdehaḥ kāryākāryeṣu maṃdadhīḥ|| 5.134 || tasmācciṃtā na kartavyā tvayā amurapi prabho|| prabhāte ca mayā sārddhaṃ gamyatāṃ tacchivālayam|| 5.135 || nirīkṣaṇārthaṃ duṣṭasya tatkāryaṃ vidadhāmyaham|| etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nandī tasya purodhasaḥ|| 5.136 || āsthitaḥ svagṛhe naktaṃ dūyamānena cetasā|| tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāhūya ca purodhasam|| 5.137 || gataḥ śivālayaṃ nandī samaṃ tena mahātmanā|| tato dṛṣṭaṃ pūrvadine kṛtaṃtena durātmanā|| 5.138 || samyakprapūjanaṃ kṛtvā nānāratnaparicchadam|| pañcopacārasaṃyuktaṃ caikādasyanvitaṃ tathā|| 5.139 || anekastutibhiḥ stutvā girīśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha|| tadā yāmadvayaṃ jātaṃ stūyamānasya naṃdinaḥ|| 5.140 || āyāto hi mahākālasthārūpo mahābalaḥ|| kālarūpo mahāraudro dhanuṣpāṇiḥ pratāpavān|| 5.141 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayavitrasto nandī sa vilalāpa ha|| purodhāścaiva sahasā bhayabhītastadābhavat|| 5.142 || kirātena kṛtaṃ tatra yathāpūrvamaviskhalam|| tāṃ pūjāṃ prapadāhatya bilvapatraṃ samarpayat|| 5.143 || snapanaṃ tasya kṛtvā ca tato gaṃḍūṣavāriṇā|| naivedyaṃ tatpalaṃ caiva kirātaḥ śivamarpayat|| 5.144 || daṇḍavatpatito bhūmāvutthāya svagṛhaṃ gataḥ|| taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa vai ciram|| 5.145 || purodhasā saha tadā naṃdīvyākulacetasā|| tena cākāritā viprā bahavo vedavādinaḥ|| 5.146 || nivedya teṣu tatsarvaṃ kirātena ca yatkṛtam|| kiṃ kāryamatha bho viprāḥ kathyatāṃ ca yathātatham|| 5.147 || saṃpradhārya tataḥ sarve militvā dharmaśāstrataḥ|| ūcuḥ sarve tadā viprā naṃdinaṃ cātiśaṃkinam|| 5.148 || idaṃ vighnaṃ samutpannaṃ durnivāryaṃ surairapi|| tasmādānaya liṃgaṃ tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vaiśyasatt|| 5.149 || tatheti matvāsau naṃdī śivasyotpāṭanaṃ tadā|| kṛtvā svagṛha mānīya pratiṣṭhāpya yatāvidhi|| 5.150 || suvarṇapīṭhikāṃ kṛtvā navaratnasuśobhitām|| upacārairanekaiśca pūjayāmāsa vai tadā|| 5.151 || athāpare dyurāyātaḥ kitarātaḥ śivamaṃdiram|| yāvadvilokyāmāsa liṃgamaiśaṃ na dṛṣṭavān|| 5.152 || maunaṃ vihāya sahasā hyākrośannidamabravīt|| he śaṃbho kva gatosi tvaṃ darśayātmānamadya vai|| 5.153 || na dṛṣṭosi mayā tvaṃ hi tyajāmyadya kalevaram|| he śaṃbho he jagannātha tripurāṃtakara prabho|| 5.154 || he rudra he mahādevadarśayātmānamātmanā|| 5.155 || evaṃ sākṣepamadhurairvākyaiḥ kṣiptaḥ sadāśivaḥ|| kirātena tato raṃgairvīrosau jaṭharaṃ svakam|| 5.156 || vibhedāśu tato bāhūnāsphoṭyaiva ruṣābravīt|| he śaṃbho darśayātmānaṃ kuto māṃ tyajya yāsyasi|| 5.157 || iti kṣitvā tatoṃtrāṇi māṃsamukṛttya sarvataḥ|| tasmingarte kareṇaiva kirātaḥ sahasākṣipat|| 5.158 || svasthaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā sasnau tatsarasi dhruvam|| tathaiva jalamānīya bilvapattraṃ tvarānvitaḥ|| 5.159 || pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ daṃḍavatpatito bhuvi|| 5.160 || dhyānasthitastatastatra kirātaḥ śivasaṃnidhau|| prādurbhūtastadā rudraḥ pramathaiḥ parivāritaḥ|| 5.161 || karpūragaurodyutimānkapardī caṃdraśekharaḥ|| taṃ gṛhītvā kare rudra uvāca parisāṃtvayan|| 5.162 || bhobho vīra mahāprājña madbhaktosi mahāmate|| varaṃ vṛṇīṣvātmahitaṃ yatte'bhilaṣitaṃ mahat|| 5.163 || evamuktaḥ sa rudreṇa mahākālo mudānvitaḥ|| papāta daṃḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ|| 5.164 || tato rudraṃ babhāpe sa varaṃ samprārthayāmyaham|| ahaṃ dāsosmi te rudra tvaṃ me svāmī na saṃśayaḥ|| 5.165 || etadbuddhātmano bhaktiṃ dehi janmanijanmani|| tvaṃ mātā ca pitā tvaṃ ca tvaṃ baṃdhuśca sakhā hi me|| 5.166 || tvaṃ guhustvaṃ mahāmaṃtro maṃtravedyo'si sarvadā|| tasmāttvadaparaṃ nānyattriṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana|| 5.167 || niṣkāmaṃ vākyamākarṇya kirātasya tadā bhavaḥ|| dadau pārṣadamukhyatvaṃ dvārapālatvameva ca|| 5.168 || tadā ḍamarunādena nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam|| bherībhāṃkāraśabdena śaṃkhānāṃ ninadena ca|| 5.169 || tadā duṃdubayo neduḥ paṭahāścasahasraśaḥ|| naṃdī taṃ nādamākarṇya vismayāttavarīto yayau|| 5.170 || tapovanaṃ yatra śivaḥ sthitaḥ pramathasaṃvṛtaḥ|| kirāto hi tathā dṛṣṭo naṃdinā ca tadā bhṛśam|| 5.171 || uvāca praśrito vākyaṃ sa naṃdī vismayānvitaḥ|| kirātaṃ stotukāma'sau parameṇa samādhinā|| 5.172 || ihānītastvayā śaṃbhustvaṃ bhaktosi paraṃtapa|| tvaṃ bhakto'hamiha prāpto māṃ nivedaya śaṃkare|| 5.173 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kirātastvarayānvitaḥ|| naṃdinaṃ ca kare gṛhya śaṃkaraṃ samupāgataḥ|| 5.174 || prahasya bhagavānrudraḥ kirātaṃ vākyamabravīt|| ko'yaṃ tvayā samānīto gaṇānāmiha sannidhau|| 5.175 || ||kirāta uvāca|| vijñapto'sau kirātena śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ|| tava bhaktaḥ sadā deva tava pūjārato hyasau|| 5.176 || pratyahaṃ ratnamāṇikyaiḥ puṣpaiścoccāvacairapi|| jīvitena dhanenāpi pūjito'si na saṃśayaḥ|| 5.177 || tasmājjānīhi manmitraṃ naṃdinaṃ bhaktavatsala|| 5.178 || ||mahādeva uvāca|| na jānāmi mahābhāga naṃdinaṃ vaiśyacarcitam|| tvaṃ me bhaktaḥ sakhā ceti mahākāla mahāmate|| 5.179 || upādhirahitā ca ye'pi caiva manasvinaḥ|| te'tīva me priyā bhaktāste viśiṣṭā narottamāḥ|| 5.180 || tava bhakto hyahaṃ tāta sa ca me priyakṛttaraḥ|| tāvubhau svīkṛtau tena pārṣadatvena śaṃbhunā|| 5.181 || tato vimānāni bahūni tatra samāgatānyeva mahāprabhāṇi|| kirātavaryeṇa sa vaiśyavarya uddhāritastena mahāprabheṇa|| 5.182 || kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prāptau vimānairvegavattaraiḥ|| sārūpyameva saṃprāptāvīśvareṇa mahātmanā|| 5.183 || nīrājitau girijayā śivena sahitau tadā|| uvācedaṃ tato devī prahasya gajagāminī|| 5.184 || yathā tvaṃ hi mahādeva tathā caitau na saṃśayaḥ|| svarūpeṇa ca gatyā ca hāsyabhāvaiḥ supūjitau|| 5.185 || mayā tvameka evāsīḥ sevito vai na saṃśayaḥ|| devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā kirāto vaiśya eva ca|| 5.186 || sadyaḥ parāṅmukhau bhūtvā śaṃkarasya ca paśyataḥ|| bhavāvastvanukaṃpyau ca bhavatā hi trilocana|| 5.187 || tava dvāri sthitau nityaṃ bhāvavaste namonamaḥ|| 5.188 || tayorbhāvaṃ sa bhagavānviditvā prahasanbhavaḥ|| uvāca parayā bhaktyā bhavatorastu vāṃchitam|| 5.189 || tadā prabhṛti tāvetau dvārapālau babhūvatuḥ|| śivadvāri sthitau viprā madhyāhne śivadarśinau|| 5.190 || eko naṃdī mahākālo dvāvetau śivavallabhau|| ūcatustau mudāyuktāveka eva sadāśivaḥ|| 5.191 || ekāṃguliṃ samuddhṛtya mahādevobhyabhāṣata|| tathā naṃdī uvācedamuddhṛtya svāṃgulidvayam|| 5.192 || evaṃ saṃjñānvitau dvāri tiṣṭhatastau mahātmanaḥ|| śaṃkarasya mahābhāgāḥ śrṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo hyamī|| 5.193 || śailādena purā proktaṃ śivadharmamanaṃtakam|| prāṇināṃ kṛpayā viprāḥ sarveṣāṃ duṣkṛtātmanām|| 5.194 || ye pāpino'pyadharmiṣṭhā aṃdhā mūkāśca paṃgavaḥ|| kulahīnā durātmānaḥ śvapacā api mānavāḥ|| 5.195 || yādṛśāstādṛśāścānye śivabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ|| te'pi gacchaṃti sāṃnidhyaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ|| 5.196 || liṃgaṃ sikatāmayaṃ ye pūjayaṃti vipaścitaḥ|| te rudralokaṃ gacchaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 5.197 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivabhaktimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5 || cha ||
<1.1.6>
||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| liṃge pratiṣṭhā ca kathaṃ śivaṃ hitvā pravartitā|| tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga paraṃ śuśruṣatāṃ hi naḥ|| 6.1 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| yadā dāruvane śaṃbhurbhikṣārthaṃ prācaratprabhuḥ|| 6.2 || digaṃbaro muktajaṭākalāpo vedāṃtavedyo bhuvanaikabhartā|| sa īśvaro brahmakalāpadhāro yogīśvarāṇāṃ paramaḥ paraśca|| 6.3 || aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahī yānmahānubhāvo bhuvanādhipo mahān|| sa īśvaro bhikṣurūpī mahātmā bhikṣāṭanaṃ dāruvane cakāra|| 6.4 || madhyāhna ṛṣayo viprāstīrthaṃ jagmuḥ svakāśramāt|| tadānīmeva sarvāstā ṛṣībhāryāḥ samāgatāḥ|| 6.5 || vilokayaṃtyaḥ śaṃbhuṃ tamācakhyuśca parasparam|| ko'sau bhikṣukarūpoyamāgato'pūrvadarśanaḥ|| 6.6 || asmai bhikṣāṃ prayacchāmo vayaṃ ca sakhibhiḥ saha|| tatheti gatvā sarvāstā gṛhebhya ānayanmudā|| 6.7 || bhikṣānnaṃ vividhaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ sopacāraṃ ca śaktitaḥ|| pradattaṃ bhikṣitaṃ tena devadevena śūlinā|| 6.8 || kācitpriyatamaṃ śaṃbhuṃ babhāṣe vismayānvitā|| kosi tvaṃ bhikṣuko bhūtvā āgatotra mahāmate|| 6.9 || ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ śuddhaṃ kimarthaṃ no niṣīdasi|| tayokto'pi tadā śaṃbhurbabhāṣe prahasanniva|| 6.10 || īśvarohaṃ sukeśāṃte pāvanaṃ prāptavānimam|| īśvarasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣibhāryā uvāca tam|| 6.11 || īśvaro'si mahābhāga kailāsapatireva ca|| ekākinaḥ kathaṃ deva bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ tava|| 6.12 || evamuktastayā śaṃbhuḥ punastāmabravīdvacaḥ|| dākṣāyaṇyā virahito vicarāmi digaṃbaraḥ|| 6.13 || bhikṣāṭanārthaṃ suśroṇi saṃkalparahitaḥ sadā|| tayā satyā vinā kiṃcitstrīmātraṃ mama bhāmini|| na rocate viśālākṣi satyaṃ prativadāmi te|| 6.14 || tasyoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca kamalekṣaṇā|| striyo hi sukhasaṃsparśāḥ puruṣasya na saṃśayaḥ|| 6.15 || tāsstriyo varjitāḥ śaṃbho tvādṛśena vipaścitā|| 6.16 || iti ca pramadāḥ sarvā militā yatra śaṃkaraḥ|| bhikṣāpātraṃ ca tacchaṃbhoḥ pūritaṃ ca mahāguṇaiḥ|| 6.17 || annaiścaturvidhaiḥ ṣaḍbhī rasaiśca paripūritam|| yadā saṃbhurgaṃtukāmaḥ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati|| tadā sarvā viprapatnyo hyangacchanmudānvitāḥ|| 6.18 || gṛhakāryaṃ parityajya cerustadgatamānasāḥ|| gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu patnīṣu ṛṣisattamāḥ|| 6.19 || yāvadāśramamabhyetya tāvacchūnyaṃ vyalokayan|| parasparamathocuste patnyaḥ sarvāḥ kuto gatāḥ|| 6.20 || na vidāmo'tha vai sarvāḥ kena naṣṭena cāhṛtāḥ|| evaṃ vimṛśyamānāste vicinvaṃtastatastataḥ|| 6.21 || samapaśyaṃstataḥ sarve śivasyānugatāśca tāḥ|| śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu saṃprāptā ṛṣayaste ruṣānvitāḥ|| 6.22 || śivasyāthāgrato bhūtvā ūcuḥ sarve tvarānvitāḥ|| kiṃ kṛtaṃ hi tvayā śaṃbho viraktena mahātmanā|| paradārāpaharttāsi tvamṛṣīṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 6.23 || evaṃ kṣiptaḥ śivo maunī gacchamāno'pi parvatam|| tadā sa ṛṣibhiḥ prāpto mahādevo'vyayastathā|| yasmātkalatrahartā tvaṃ tasmātṣaṃḍho bhava tvaram|| 6.24 || evaṃ śaptaḥ sa munibhirliṃgaṃ tasyāpatadbhuvi|| bhūmiprāptaṃ ca talliṃgaṃ vavṛdhe tarasā mahat|| 6.25 || āvṛtya sapta pātālānkṣaṇālliṃgamadordhvataḥ|| vyāpya pṛthvīṃ samagrāṃ ca aṃtarikṣaṃ samāvṛṇot|| 6.26 || svargāḥ samāvṛtāḥ sarve svargātītamathābhavat|| na mahī na ca dikcakraṃ na toyaṃ na ca pāvakaḥ|| 6.27 || na ca vāyurna vākāśaṃ nāhaṃkāro na vā mahat|| na cāvyaktaṃ na kālaśca na mahāprakṛtistathā|| 6.28 || nāsīddvavaitavibhāgaṃ ca sarvaṃ līnaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt|| yasmāllīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tasmim̐llige mahātmanaḥ|| 6.29 || layanālliṃgamityevaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ|| tathābhūtaṃ varddhamānaṃ dṛṣṭvā te'pi surarṣayaḥ|| 6.30 || brahmeṃdraviṣṇuvāyyagnilokapālāḥ sapannagāḥ|| vismayāviṣṭamanasaḥ parasparamathābruvan|| 6.31 || kimāyāmaṃ ca vistāraṃ kva cāṃtaḥ kva ca pīṭhikā|| iti ciṃtānvitā viṣṇumūcuḥ sarve surāstadā|| 6.32 || ||devā ūcuḥ|| asya mūlaṃ tvayā viṣṇo padmodbhava ca mastakam|| yuvābhyāṃ ca vilokyaṃ syātsthāne syātparipālakau|| 6.33 || śrutvā tu tau mahābhāgau vaikuṃṭhakamalodbhavau|| viṣṇurgato hi pātālaṃ brahmā sarvargaṃ jagāma ha|| 6.34 || svargaṃ gatastadā brahmā avalokanatatparaḥ|| nāpasyattatra liṃgasya mastakaṃ ca vicakṣamaḥ|| 6.35 || tathā gatena mārgeṇa pratyāvṛttyābjasaṃbhavaḥ|| merupṛṣṭhamanuprāptaḥ surabhyā lakṣitastataḥ|| 6.36 || sthitā yā ketakīcchāyāmuvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ|| tasyā vacanamākarṇya sarvalokapitāmahaḥ|| uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ chaloktyā surabhiṃ prati|| 6.37 || liṃgaṃ mahādbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yenavyāptaṃ jagattrayam|| darśanārthaṃ ca tasyāṃtaṃ devaiḥ saṃpreṣitosmayaham|| 6.38 || na dṛṣṭaṃ mastakaṃ tasya vyāpakasya mahātmanaḥ|| kiṃ vakṣye'haṃ ca devāgre ciṃtā me cāti vartate|| 6.39 || liṃgasya mastakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ devānāṃ ca mṛṣā vadeḥ|| te sarve yadi vakṣyaṃti iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ|| 6.40 || te saṃti sākṣimo devā asminnarthe vadatvaram|| arthe'sminbhava sākṣī tvaṃ ketakyā saha suvrate|| 6.41 || tadvacaḥ śirasā gṛhya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ|| ketakīsahitā tatra surabhī tadamānayat|| 6.42 || evaṃ samāgato brahma devāgre samuvāca ha|| 6.43 || ||brahmovāca|| liṃgasya mastakaṃ devā dṛṣṭavānahamadbhutam|| samīcīnaṃ cārtitaṃ ca ketakīdala saṃyutam|| 6.44 || viśālaṃ vimalaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ prasannataramadbhutam|| ramyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca darśanīyaṃ mahāprabham|| 6.45 || etādṛśaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ tadvinākvacit|| brahmaṇo hi vacaḥ śrutvā surā vismayamāyayuḥ|| 6.46 || evaṃ vismayapūrṇāste iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ|| tiṣṭhaṃti tāvatsarveśo viṣṇuradhyātmadīpakaḥ|| 6.47 || pātālādāgataḥ sadyaḥ sarveṣāmavadattvaram|| tasyāpyaṃto na dṛṣṭo me hyavalokanatatparaḥ|| 6.48 || vismayo me mahāñjātaḥ pātālātparataścaran|| atalaṃ sutalaṃ cāpi nitalaṃ ca rasātalam|| 6.49 || tathā gatastalaṃ caiva pātālaṃ ca tathātalam|| talātalāni tānyenaṃ śūnyavadyadvibhāvyate|| 6.50 || śūnyādapi ca śūnyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ sunirīkṣitam|| na mūlaṃ ca na madhyaṃ ca na cāṃto hyasya vidyate|| 6.51 || liṃgarūpī mahādevo yenedaṃ dhāryate jagat|| yasya prasādādutpannā yūyaṃ ca ṛṣayastathā|| 6.52 || śrutvā surāśca ṛṣayastasya vākyamapūjayan|| tadā viṣṇuruvācedaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prahasanniva|| 6.53 || dṛṣṭaṃ hi cettvayā brahmanmastakaṃ paramārthataḥ|| sākṣiṇaḥ ke tvayā tatra asminnarthe prakalpitāḥ|| 6.54 || ākarṇya vacanaṃ viṣṇorbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| uvāca tvaritenaiva ketakī surabhīti ca|| 6.55 || te devā mama sākṣitve jānīhi paramārthataḥ|| brahmaṇo hi vacaḥ śrutvā sarve devāstvarānvitāḥ|| 6.56 || āhvānaṃ cakrire tasyāḥ surabhyāśca tayā saha|| āgate tatkṣamādeva kāryārthaṃ brahmaṇastadā|| 6.57 || iṃdrādyaiśca tadā devairuktā ca surabhī tataḥ|| uvāca ketakīsārddhaṃ dṛṣṭo vai brahmaṇā surāḥ|| 6.58 || liṃgasya mastako devāḥ ketakīdalapūjitaḥ|| tadā nabhogatā vāṇī sarveṣāṃ śrṛṇvatāmabhūt|| 6.59 || surabhyā caiva yatproktaṃ ketakyā ca tathā surāḥ|| tanmṛṣoktaṃ ca jānīdhvaṃ na dṛṣṭo hyasya mastakaḥ|| 6.60 || tadā sarve'tha vibudhāḥ seṃdrā vai viṣṇunā saha|| śepuśca surabhīṃ roṣānmṛṣāvādanatatparām|| 6.61 || mukhenoktaṃ tvayādyaivamanṛtaṃ ca tathā śubhe|| apavitraṃ mukhaṃ te'stu sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtam|| 6.62 || sugaṃdhaketakī cāpi ayogyā tvaṃ śivārcane|| bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho anṛtā caiva bhāmini|| 6.63 || tadā nabho gatā vāṇī brahmaṇaṃ ca śaśāpa vai|| mṛṣoktaṃ ca tvayā maṃda kimarthaṃ bāliśena hi|| 6.64 || bhṛguṇā ṛṣibhiḥ sākaṃ tathaiva ca purodhasā|| tasmādyuyaṃ na pūjyāśca bhaveyuḥ kleśabhāginaḥ|| 6.65 || ṛṣayo'pi ca dharmiṣṭhāstattvavākyabahiṣkṛtāḥ|| vivādaniratā mūḍhā atattvajñāḥ samatsarāḥ|| 6.66 || yācakāścāvadānyāśca nityaṃ svajñānaghātakāḥ|| ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ stabdhāḥ parasparaviniṃdakāḥ|| 6.67 || evaṃ śaptāśca munayo brahmādyā devatāstathā|| śivena śaptāste sarve liṃgaṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ|| 6.68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śrīśivaliṅgamāhātmye brahmādiśāpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6 ||cha ||
<1.1.7>
||lomaśa uvāca|| tadā ca te surāḥ sarva ṛṣayopi bhayānvitāḥ|| īḍire liṃgamaiśaṃ ca brahmādyā jñānavihvalāḥ|| 7.1 || ||brahmovāca|| tvaṃ liṃgarūpī tu mahāprabhāvo vedāṃtavedyosi mahātmarūpi|| yenaiva sarve jagadātmamūlaṃ kṛtaṃ sadānaṃdapareṇa nityam|| 7.2 || tvaṃ sākṣī sarvalokānāṃ hartā tvaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ|| rakṣaṇosi mahādeva bhairavosi jagatpate|| 7.3 || tvayā liṃgasvarūpeṇa vyāptametajjagattrayam|| kṣudrāścaiva vayaṃ nātha māyāmohitacetasaḥ|| 7.4 || ahaṃ surā'surāḥ sarve yakṣagaṃdharvarākṣasāḥ|| pannagāśca piśācāśca tathā vidyādharā hyamī|| 7.5 || tvaṃhi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā tvaṃ hi devo jagatpatiḥ|| kartā tvaṃ bhuvanasyāsya tvaṃ hartā puruṣaḥ paraḥ|| 7.6 || trāhyasmākaṃ mahādeva devadeva namo'stu te|| evaṃ stuto hi vai dhātrā liṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ|| 7.7 || ṛṣayaḥ stotukāmāste maheśvaramakalmaṣam|| astuvangīrbiragryābhiḥ śrutigītābirādṛtāḥ|| 7.8 || ||ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| ajñānino vayaṃ kāmānna viṃdāmo'sya saṃsthitim|| tvaṃ hyātmā paramātmā ca prakṛtistvaṃ vibhāvinī|| 7.9 || tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva tvameva baṃdhuśca sakhā tvame|| tvamīśvaro vedavidekarūpo mahānubhāvaiḥ pariciṃtyamānaḥ|| 7.10 || tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāmeko jyotirivaidhasām|| sarvaṃ bhavati yasmāttvattasmātsarvo'si nityadā|| 7.11 || yasmācca saṃbhavatyetattasmācchaṃbhuriti prabhuḥ|| 7.12 || tvatpādapaṃkajaṃ prāptā vayaṃ sarve surādayaḥ|| ṛṣayo devagaṃdharvā vidyādharamahoragāḥ|| 7.13 || tasmācca kṛpayā śaṃbho pāhyasmāñjagataḥ pate|| 7.14 || ||mahādeva uvāca|| śrṛṇudhvaṃ tu vaco me'dya kriyatāṃ ca tvarānvitaiḥ|| viṣṇuṃ sarve prārthayaṃtu tvaritena tapodhanāḥ|| 7.15 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ|| viṣṇuṃ sarve namaskṛtya īḍire ca tadā surāḥ|| 7.16 || ||deva ūcuḥ|| vidyādharāḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayaśca sarve trātāstvayādya sakalājagadekabaṃdho|| tadvatkṛpākarajanānparipālayādya trailokyanātha jagadīśa jagannivāsa|| 7.17 || prahasya bhagavanviṣṇuruvācedaṃ vacastadā|| daityaiḥ prapīḍitā yūyaṃ rakṣitāśca purā mayā|| 7.18 || adyaiva bhayamutpannaṃ liṃgādasmācciraṃtanam|| na śakyate mayā trātumasmālliṃgabhayātsurāḥ|| 7.19 || acyutenaivamuktāste devā ściṃtānvitābhavan|| tadā nabhogatā vāṇī uvācāśvāsya vai surān|| 7.20 || etalliṃgaṃ saṃvṛṇuṣva pūjanāya janārdana|| piṃḍibhūtvā mahābāho rakṣasva sacarācaram|| tatheti matvā bagavānvīrabhadro'bhyapūjayat|| 7.21 || brahmādibhaḥ suragaṇaiḥ sahitaistadānīṃ saṃpūjitaḥ śivavidhānarato mahātmā|| sravīrabhadraḥ śaśiśekharo'sau śivapriyo rudrasamastrilokyām|| 7.22 || liṃgasyārcanayukto'sau vīrabhadro'bhavattadā|| tadrūpasyaiva liṃgasya yena sarvamidaṃ jagat|| 7.23 || udbhāti sthitimāpnoti tathā vilayameti ca|| talliṃgaṃ liṃgamityāhurlayanāttattvavittamāḥ|| 7.24 || brahmāṇḍāgolakairvyāptaṃ tathā rudrākṣabhūṣitam|| tathā liṃgaṃ mahajjātaṃ sarveṣāṃ duratikramam|| 7.25 || tadā sarve'tha vibudhā ṛṣo vai mahāprabhāḥ|| tuṣṭuvuśca mahāliṃgaṃ vedāvādaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak|| 7.26 || aṇoraṇīyāṃstvaṃ deva tathā tvaṃ mahato mahān|| tasmāttvayā vidhātavyaṃ sarvaiṣāṃ liṃgapūjanam|| 7.27 || tadānīmeva sarveṇa liṃgaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṛtam|| satye brahmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ vaikuṇṭhe ca sadāśivaḥ|| 7.28 || amarāvatyāṃ supratiṣṭhamamareśvarasaṃjñakam|| varuṇeśvaraṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ yāmyāṃ kāleśvaraṃ prabhum|| 7.29 || nairṛteśvaraṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ vāyavyāṃ pāvaneśvaram|| kedāraṃ mṛtyuloke ca tathaiva amaresvaram|| 7.30 || oṃkāraṃ narmadāyāṃ ca mahākālaṃ tathaiva ca|| kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ prayāge laliteśvaram|| 7.31 || triyambakaṃ brahmagirau kalau bhadreśvaraṃ tathā|| drākṣārāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame|| 7.32 || saurāṣṭre ca tathā liṃgaṃ someśvaramiti smṛtam|| tathā sarveśvaraṃ vindhye śrīśaile śikhareśvaram|| kāntyāmallālanāthaṃ ca siṃhanāthaṃ ca siṃgale|| 7.33 || virūpākṣaṃ tathā liṃgaṃ koṭiśaṅkarameva ca|| tripurāntakaṃ bhīmeśamamareśvarameva ca|| 7.34 || bhogeśvaraṃ ca pātāle hāṭakeśvarameva ca|| evamādīnyanekāni liṃgāni bhuvanatraye|| sthāpitāni tadā devairviśvopakṛtihetave|| 7.35 || liṃgeśaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ pūrṇamāsījjagattrayam|| tathā ca vīrabhadrāṃśāḥ pūjārthamamaraiḥ kṛtāḥ|| 7.36 tatra viṃśatisaṃskārāsteṣāmaṣṭādhikābhavan|| kathitāḥ śaṃkareṇaiva liṃgasyācanasūcakāḥ|| 7.37 || saṃti rudreṇa kathitāḥ śivadharmā sanātanāḥ|| vīrabhadro yathā rudrastathānye guravaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 7.38 || gurorjātāśca guravo vikhyātā bhuvanatraye|| liṃgasya mahimāna tu nandī jānāti tattvataḥ|| 7.39 || tathā skando hi bhagavānnye te nāmadhārakāḥ|| yathoktāḥ śivadharamā hi nandinā parikīrttitāḥ|| 7.40 || śailādena mahābhāgā vicitrā liṃgadhārakāḥ|| śavasyopari liṃgaṃ ca dhriyate ca purātanaiḥ|| 7.41 || liṃgena saha pañcatvaṃ liṃgena saha jīvitam|| ete dharmāḥ supratiṣṭhāḥ śailādena pratiṣṭhitāḥ|| 7.42 || dharmaḥ pāśupataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ skandena pratipālitaḥ|| 7.43 || śuddhā pañcākṣarī vidyā prāsādī tadanantaram|| ṣaḍakṣarī tathā vidyāgrāsā syaca dīpikā|| 7.44 || skandāttatsamanuprāptamagastyena mahātmanā|| paścādācāryabhedena hyāgamā bahavo'bhavan|| 7.45 || kiṃ tu vai bahunoktena śvi ityakṣaradvayam|| uccārayaṃti sa nityaṃ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 7.46 || satāṃ mārgaṃ puraskṛtya ye sarve te purāṃtakāḥ|| vīrā māheśvarājñeyāḥ pāpakṣayakarā nṛṇām|| 7.47 || prasaṃgenānupaṃkṣeṇa śradvayā ca yadṛcchayā|| śivabhaktiṃ prakurvanti ye vai te yāṃti sadgatim|| 7.48 || śrṛṇudhvaṃ kathayāmīha itihāsaṃ purātanam|| kṛtaṃ sivālayaṃ yacca pataṃgyā mārjana purā|| 7.49 || āgatā bhakṣaṇārthaṃ hi naivedyaṃ kena cārpitam|| mārjanaṃ rajastasyāḥ pakṣābhyāmabhavatpurā|| 7.50 || tena karmavipākena uttamaṃ svargamāgatā|| bhuktvā svargasukhaṃ cograṃ punaḥ saṃsāgmāgatā|| 7.51 || kāśigajasutā jātā sundarīnāma viśrutā|| pūrvābhyāsācca kalyāṇī babhūva paramā satī|| 7.52 || upasyupasi tanvaṃgī śivadvāraratā sadā|| saṃmārjanaṃ ca kurute bhaktyā paramayā yutā|| 7.53 || svayameva tadā devī sundarī rājakanyakā|| tathābhūtāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiruddālako'bravīt|| 7.54 || sukumārī satī bāle svayameva kathaṃ śubhe|| saṃmārjanaṃ ca kuruṣe kanyake tvaṃ śucismite|| 7.55 || dāsī dāsyaśca bahavaḥ saṃti devi tavāgrataḥ|| tavājñayā kariṣyaṃti sarvaṃ saṃmārjanādikam|| 7.56 || ṛṣestadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyedamuvāca ha|| 7.57 || śivasevāṃ prakurvāṇāḥ śivabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ|| ye narāścaiva nāryyaśca śivalokaṃ vrajaṃti vai|| 7.58 || saṃmārjanaṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ padbhyāṃ yānaṃ śivālaye|| tasmānmayā ca kriyate saṃmārjanamataṃdritam|| 7.59 || anyatkiñcinna jānāmi ekaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ vinā|| ṛṣistadvacanaṃ śrutvā manasā ca vimṛśya hi|| 7.60 || anayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ keyaṃ kasya prasādataḥ|| tadā jñānaṃ ca ṛṣiṇā tatsarvaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā|| vismayena samāviṣṭastūṣṇīṃbhūto'bhavattadā|| 7.61 || savismayo'bhūdatha tadviditvā uddālako jñānavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ|| śivaprabhāvaṃ manasā viciṃtya jñānātparaṃ bodhamavāpa śāṃtaḥ|| 7.62 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7 || cha ||
<1.1.8>
||lomaśa uvāca|| taskaro'pi purā brahmansarvadharmabāhiṣkṛtaḥ|| brahmaghno'sau surāpaśca suvarṇasya ca taskaraḥ|| 8.1 || laṃpaṭohi mahāpāpa uttamastrīṣu sarvadā|| dyūtakārī sadā maṃdaḥ kitavaiḥ saha saṃgataḥ|| 8.2 || ekadā krīḍatā tena hāritaṃ dyūtamadbhutam|| kitavairmardyamāno hi tadā novāca kiñcana|| 8.3 || pīḍito'pyabhavattūṣṇīṃ tairuktaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ|| dyūte tvayā ca taddravyaṃ hāritaṃ kiṃ prayacchasi|| 8.4 || no vā tatkathyatāṃ śīghraṃ yāthātathyena durmate|| yaddhāritaṃ prayacchāmi rātrāvityabravīcca saḥ|| 8.5 || tairmuktastena vākyena gatāste kitavādayaḥ|| tadā niśīthasamaye gato'sau śivamaṃdiram|| 8.6 || śirodhiruhya śambhośca ghaṇṭāmādātumudyataḥ|| tāvatkailāsaśikhare śaṃbhuḥ provāca kiṃkarān|| 8.7 || anena yatkṛtaṃ cādya sarveṣāmadhikaṃ bhuvi|| sarveṣāmeva bhaktānāṃ variṣṭho'yaṃ ca matpriyaḥ|| 8.8 || iti proktvāna yāmāsa vīrabhadrādibhirgaṇaiḥ|| te sarve tvaritā jagmuḥ kailāsācchivavallabhāt|| 8.9 || sarvairḍamarunādena nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam|| tāndṛṣṭvā sahasottīrya taskarosau durātmavān|| liṃgasya mastakātsadyaḥ palāyanaparo'bhavat|| 8.10 || palāyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadraḥ samāhvayat|| 8.11 || kasmādvibhepi re manda devadevo mahesvaraḥ|| prasannastava jātodya udāracarito hyasau|| 8.12 || ityuktvā taṃ vimāne ca kṛtvā kailāsamāyayau|| pārṣado hi kṛtastena taskaro hi mahātmanā|| 8.13 || tasmādbhāvyā śive bhaktiḥ sarveṣāmapi dehinām|| paśavo'pi hi pūjyāḥ syuḥ kiṃ punarmānavābhuvi|| 8.14 || ye tārkikāstarkaparāstatha mīmāṃsakāśca ye|| anyonyavādinaścānye cānye vātmavitarkakāḥ|| 8.15 || ekavākyaṃ na kurvaṃti śivārcanabahiṣkṛtāḥ|| tarko hi kriyate yaiśca tesarve kiṃ śivaṃ vinā|| 8.16 || tathā kiṃ bahunoktena sarve'pi sthirajaṃgamāḥ|| prāṇino'pi hi jāyaṃte kevalaṃ liṃgadhāriṇaḥ|| 8.17 || piṇḍīyuktaṃ yatā liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ ca yathā'bhavat|| tathā narā liṃgayuktāḥ piṇḍībhūtāstatā striyaḥ|| 8.18 || śivaśaktiyutaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| taṃ śivaṃ mauḍhyatastyaktvā mūḍhāścānyaṃ bhajaṃti ye|| 8.19 || dharmamātyaṃtikaṃ tucchaṃ naśvaraṃ kṣaṇabhaṃguram|| yo viṣṇuḥ sa śivo jñeyo yaḥ śivo viṣṇureva saḥ|| 8.20 || pīṭhikā viṣṇurūpaṃ syālliṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ|| tasmālliṃgārcanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarveṣāmapi vai dvijāḥ|| 8.21 || brahmā maṇimayaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayatyaniśaṃ śubham|| indro ratnamayaṃ liṃgaṃ candro muktāmayaṃ tathā|| 8.22 || bhānustāmramayaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayatyaniśaṃ śubham|| raukmaṃ liṃgaṃ kuberaśca pāśī cāraktameva ca|| 8.23 || yamo nīlamayaṃ liṃgaṃ rājataṃ nairṛtastathā|| kāśmīraṃ pavano liṃgamarcayatyaniśaṃ vibhoḥ|| 8.24 || evaṃ te liṃgitāḥ sarve lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ|| tathā sarve'pi pātāle gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnaraiḥ saha|| 8.25 || daityānāṃ vaiṣṇavāḥ kecitprahlādapramukhā dvijāḥ|| tathāhi rākṣasānāṃ ca vibhīṣaṇapurogamāḥ|| 8.26 || baliśca namuciścaiva hiraṇyakaśipustathā|| vṛṣaparvā vṛṣaścaiva saṃhrādo bāṇa eva ca|| 8.27 || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ śukrasya dhīmataḥ|| evaṃ śivārcanaratāḥ sarve te daityadānavāḥ|| 8.28 || rākṣasā eva te sarve śivapūjānvitāḥ sadā|| hetiḥ prahetiḥ saṃyātirvighasaḥ praghasastathā|| 8.29 || vidyujjihvastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro dhūmrākṣo bhīmavikramaḥ|| mālī caiva sumālī ca mālyavānatibhīṣamaḥ|| 8.30 || vidyutkaiśastaḍijjihvo rāvaṇaśca mahābalaḥ|| kuṃbhakarṇo durādharṣo vegadarśī pratāpavān|| 8.31 || ete hi rākṣasāḥ śreṣṭhā śivārcanaratāḥ sadā|| liṃgamabhyarcya ca sadā siddhiṃ prāptāḥ purā tu te|| 8.32 || rāvaṇena tapastaptaṃ sarveṣāmapi duḥkhaham|| tapodhipo mahādevastutoṣa ca tadā bhṛśam|| 8.33 || varānprāyacchata tadā sarveṣāmapi durlabhān|| jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ labdhaṃ tena sadāśivāt|| 8.34 || ajeyatvaṃ ca saṃgrāme dvaiguṇyaṃ śirasāmapi|| paṃcavaktro mahā devo daśavaktro'tha rāvaṇaḥ|| 8.35 || devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva nirjitya tapasā vibhuḥ|| maheśasya prasādācca sarveṣāmadhiko'bhavat|| 8.36 || rājā trikūṭādhipatirmaheśena kṛto mahān|| sarveṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca paramāsanamāstitaḥ|| 8.37 || tapasvināṃ parīkṣāyai yadṛṣīṇāṃ vihiṃsanam|| kṛtaṃ tena tadā viprā rāvaṇena tapasvinā|| 8.38 || ajeyo hi mahāñjāto rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ|| sṛṣṭyaṃtaraṃ kṛtaṃ yena prasādācchaṃkarasya ca|| 8.39 || lokapālā jitāstena pratāpena tapasvinā|| brahmāpi vijito yena tapasā parameṇa hi|| 8.40 || amṛtāṃśukaro bhūtvā jito yena śaśī dvijāḥ|| dāhakatvājjito vahnirīśaḥ kailāsatolanāt|| 8.41 || aiśvaryeṇa jitaścendro viṣṇuḥ sarvagatastathā|| liṃgārcanaprasādena trailokyaṃ ca vaśīkṛtam|| 8.42 || tadā sarve suragaṇā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ|| merupṛṣṭhaṃ samāsādya sumaṃtraṃ cakrire tadā|| 8.43 || pīḍitāḥ smo rāvaṇena tapasā duṣkareṇa vai|| gokarṇākhye girau devāḥ śrūyatāṃ paramādbhutam|| 8.44 || sākṣālliṃgārcanaṃ yena kṛtamasti mahātmanā|| jñānajñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ yadyatparamamadbhutam|| tatkṛtaṃ rāvaṇenaiva sarveṣāṃ duratikramam|| 8.45 || vairāgyaṃ paramāsthāya audāryaṃ ca tato'dhikam|| tenaiva mamatā tyaktā rāvaṇena mahātmanā|| 8.46 || saṃvatsarasahasrācca svaśiro hi mahābhujaḥ|| kṛttvā kareṇa liṃgasya pūjanārthaṃ samarpayat|| 8.47 || rāvaṇasya kabaṃdhaṃ ca tadagre ca samīpataḥ|| yogadhāraṇayā yuktaṃ parameṇa samādhinā|| 8.48 || liṃge layaṃ samādhāya kayāpi kalayā sthitam|| anyacchirovivṛścyaivaṃ tenāpi śivapūjanam|| kṛtaṃ naivānyamuninā tathā caivāpareṇahi|| 8.49 || evaṃ śirāṃsyeva bahūni tena samarpitānyeva śivārcanārthe|| bhūtvā kabaṃdho hi punaḥ punaśca śivo'sau varado babhūva|| 8.50 || mayā vināsurastatra piṃḍībhūtena vai purā|| varānvaraya paulastya yatheṣṭaṃ tāndadāmyaham|| 8.51 || rāvaṇena tadā coktaḥ śivaḥ paramamaṃgalaḥ|| yadi prasanno bhagavandeyo me vara uttamaḥ|| 8.52 || na kāmaye'nyaṃ ca varamāśraye tvatpadāṃbujam|| yathā tathā pradātavyaṃ yadyasti ca kṛpā mayi|| 8.53 || tadā sadāśivenokto rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ|| matprasādācca sarvaṃ tvaṃ prāpsyase manasepsitam|| 8.54 || evaṃ prāptaṃ śivātsarvaṃ rāvaṇena sureśvarāḥ|| tasmātsarvairbhavadbhiśca tapasā parameṇa hi|| 8.55 || vijetavyo rāvaṇoyamiti me manasi sthitam|| cyutasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ|| 8.56 || ciṃtāmāpedire sarve ciraṃ te viṣayānvitāḥ|| brahmāpi ceṃdriyagrastaḥ sutā ramitumudyataḥ|| 8.57 || iṃdro hi jārabhāvācca caṃdro hi gurutalpagaḥ|| yamaḥ kadaryabhāvācca caṃcalatvātsadāgatiḥ|| 8.58 || pāvakaḥ sarvabhakṣitvāttathānye devatāgaṇāḥ|| aśaktā rāvaṇaṃ jetuṃ tapasā ca vijṛṃbhitam|| 8.59 || śailādo hi mahātejā gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ purātanaḥ|| buddhi mānnītinipuṇo mahābalaparākramī|| 8.60 || śivapriyo rudrarūpī mahātmā hyuvāca sarvānatha ceṃdramukhyān|| kasmādyūyaṃ saṃbhramādāgatāśca etatsarvaṃ kathyatāṃ vistareṇa|| 8.61 || naṃdinā ca tadā sarve pṛṣṭāḥ procustvarānvitāḥ|| 8.62 || || devā ūcuḥ|| rāvaṇena vayaṃ sarve nirjitā munibhiḥ saha|| prasādayitumāyātāḥ śivaṃ lokeśvareśvaram|| 8.63 || prahasya bhagavānnaṃdī brahmāṇaṃ vai hyuvāca ha|| kva yūyaṃ kva śivaḥ śaṃbhustapasā parameṇa hi|| draṣṭavyo hṛdi madhyasthaḥ so'dya draṣṭuṃ na pāryate|| 8.64 || yāvadbhāvā hyanekāśca iṃdriyārthāstathaiva ca|| yāvacca mamatābhāvastāvadīśo hi durlabhaḥ|| 8.65 || jiteṃdriyāṇāṃ śāṃtānāṃ tanniṣṭhānāṃ mahātmanām|| sulabho liṃgarūpī syādbhavatāṃ hi sudurlabhaḥ|| 8.66 || tadā brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaśca vipaścitaḥ|| praṇamya naṃdinaṃ prāhuḥ kasmāttvaṃ vānarānanaḥ|| tatsarvaṃ kathayānyaṃ ca rāvaṇasya tapobalam|| 8.67 || ||naṃdīśvara uvāca|| kubero'dhikṛtastena śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā|| dhanānāmādipatye ca taṃ draṣṭuṃ rāvaṇo'tra vai|| 8.68 || āgacchattvarayā yuktaḥ samāruhya svavāhanam|| māṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravītkruddhaḥ kubero hyatra āgataḥ|| 8.69 || tvayā dṛṣṭo'tha vātrāsau kathyatāmavilaṃbitam|| kiṃ kāryaṃ dhanadenādya iti pṛṣṭo mayā hi saḥ|| 8.70 || tadovāca mahātejā rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ|| mayyaśraddhānvito bhūtvā viṣayātmā sudurmadaḥ|| 8.71 || śikṣāpayitumārabdho maivaṃ kāryamiti prabho|| yathāhaṃ ca śriyā yukta āḍhyo'haṃ balavānaham|| tathā tvaṃ bhava re mūḍha mā mūḍhatvamupārjaya|| 8.72 || ahaṃ mūḍhaḥ kṛtastena kubereṇa mahātmanā|| mayā nirākṛto roṣāttapastepe sa guhyakaḥ|| 8.73 || kuberaḥ sa hi naṃdinkimāgatastava maṃdiram|| dīyatāṃ ca kuberodya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| 8.74 || rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā hyavocaṃ tvarito'pyaham|| liṃgakosi mahābhāga tvamahaṃ ca tathāvidhaḥ|| 8.75 || ubhayoḥ samanāṃ jñātvā vṛthā jalpasi durmate|| yathoktaḥ sa tvavādīnmāṃ vadanārthe baloddhataḥ|| 8.76 || yathā bhavadbhiḥ pṛṣṭo'haṃ vadanārthe mahātmabhiḥ|| purāvṛttaṃ mayā proktaṃ śivārcanavidheḥ phalam|| śivena dattaṃ sālūpyaṃ na gṛhītaṃ mayā tadā|| 8.77 || yācitaṃ ca mayā śaṃbhorvadanaṃ vānarasya ca|| śivena kṛpayā dattaṃ mama kāruṇyaśālinā|| 8.78 || nirābhimānino ye ca nirdabhā niṣparigrahāḥ|| śaṃbhoḥ priyāste vijñeyā hyanye śivavabahiṣkṛtāḥ|| 8.79 || tathāvadanmayā sārddhaṃ rāvaṇastapaso balāt|| mayā ca yācitānyeva daśa vaktrāṇi dhīmatā|| 8.80 || upahāsakaraṃ vākyaṃ paulastyasya tadā surāḥ|| mayā tadā hi śapto'sau rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ|| 8.81 || īdṛśānyeva vaktrāṇi yeṣāṃ vai saṃbhavaṃti hi|| taiḥ sameto yadā ko'pi naravaryo mahātapāḥ|| māṃ puraskṛtya sahasā haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| 8.82 || evaṃ śapto mayā brahmanrāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ|| arcitaṃ kevalaṃ liṃgaṃ vinā tena mahātmanā|| 8.83 || pīṭhikārūpasaṃsthena vinā tena surottamāḥ|| viṣṇunā hi mahābhāgāstasmātsarvaṃ vidhāsyati|| 8.84 || devadevo mahādevo viṣṇurūpī maheśvaraḥ|| sarve yūyaṃ prārthayaṃtu viṣṇuṃ sarvaguhāśayam|| 8.85 || ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ purovartī bhavāmyataḥ|| te sarve naṃdino vākyaṃ śrutvā muditamānasāḥ|| vaikuṃṭhamāgatā gīrbhirviṣṇuṃ stotuṃ pracakrire|| 8.86 || || devā ūcuḥ|| namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ devadeva jagatpate|| tvadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| 8.87 || etalliṃgaṃ tvayā viṣṇo dhṛtaṃ vai piṇḍirūpiṇā|| mahāviṣṇusvarūpeṇa ghātitau madhukaiṭabhau|| 8.88 || tathā kamaṭharūpeṇa dhṛto vai maṃdarācalaḥ|| varāharūpamāsthāya hiraṇyākṣo hatastvayā|| 8.89 || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo hato nṛharirūpiṇā|| tvayā caiva balirbaddho daityo vāmanarūpiṇā|| 8.90 || bhṛgūṇāmanvaye bhūtvā kṛtavīryātmajo hataḥ|| itopyasmānmahāviṣṇo tathaiva paripālaya|| 8.91 || rāvamasya bhayādasmāttrātuṃ bhūyorhasi tvaram|| 8.92 || evaṃ saṃprārthito devairbhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ|| uvāca ca surānsarvānvāsudevo jaganmayaḥ|| 8.93 || he devāḥ śrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃ mahat|| śailādiṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve yūyaṃ tvarānvitāḥ|| avatārānprakurvantu vānarīṃ tanumāśritāḥ|| 8.94 || ahaṃ hi mānuṣo bhūtvā hyajñānena samāvṛtaḥ|| saṃbhaviṣyāmyayodhyāyaṃ gṛhe daśarathasya ca|| brahmavidyāsahāyosmi bhavatāṃ kāryasiddhaye|| 8.95 || janakasya gṛhe sākṣādbrahmavidyā janiṣyati|| bhakto hi rāvaṇaḥ sākṣācchivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ|| 8.96 || tapasā mahatā yukto brahmavidyāṃ yadecchati|| tadā susādhyo bhavati puruṣo dharmanirjitaḥ|| 8.97 || evaṃ saṃbhāṣya bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramamaṅgalaḥ|| vālī cendrāṃśasaṃbhūtaḥ sugrīvoṃ śumataḥ sutaḥ|| 8.98 || tathā brahmāṃśasaṃbhūto jāmbavānnṛkṣakuñjaraḥ|| śilādatanayo naṃdī śivasyānucaraḥ priyaḥ|| 8.99 || yo vai caikādaśo rudro hanūmānsa mahākapiḥ|| avatīrṇaḥ sahāyārthaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ|| 8.100 || maiṃdādayo'tha kapayaste sarve surasattamāḥ|| evaṃ sarve suragaṇā avateruryathā tatham|| 8.101 || tathaiva viṣṇurutpannaḥ kauśalyānaṃdavarddhanaḥ|| viśvasya ramaṇāccaiva rāma ityucyate budhaiḥ|| 8.102 || śeṣopi bhaktyā viṣṇośca tapasā'vātaradbhuvi|| 8.103 || dordaṇḍāvapi viṣṇośca avatīrṇau pratāpinau|| śatrughnabharatākhyau ca vikhyātau bhuvanatraye|| 8.104 || mithilādhipateḥ kanyā yā uktā brahmavādibhiḥ|| sā brahmavidyāvataratsurāṇāṃ kāryyasiddhaye|| sītā jātā lāṃgalasya iyaṃ bhūmivikarṣaṇāt|| 8.105 || tasmātsīteti vikhyātā vidyā sānvīkṣikī tadā|| mithilāyāṃ samutpannā maithitītyabhidhīyate|| 8.106 || janakasya kule jātā viśrutā janakātmajā|| khyātā vedavatī pūrvaṃ brahmavidyāghanāśinī|| 8.107 || sā dattā janakenaiva viṣṇave paramātmane|| 8.108 || tayātha vidyayā sārddhaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ|| ugre tapasi līno'sau viṣṇuḥ paramaduṣkaram|| 8.109 || rāvaṇaṃ jetukāmo vai rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ|| araṇyavāsamakaroddevānāṃ kāryasiddhaye|| 8.110 || śeṣāvatāro'pi mahāṃstapaḥ paramaduṣkaram|| tatāpa parayā śaktyā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye|| 8.111 || śatrughno bharataścaiva tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ|| 8.112 || tato'sau tapasā yuktaḥ sārddhaṃ tairdevatāgaṇaiḥ|| sagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rāmaḥ ṣaḍbhirmāsairajīhanat|| viṣṇunā ghātitaḥ śastraiḥ śivasārūpyamāptavān|| 8.113 || sagamaḥ sa punaḥ sadyo baṃdhubhiḥ saha suvratāḥ|| 8.114 || śivaprasādātsakalaṃ dvaitādvaitamavāpa ha|| dvaitādvaitavivekārthamṛpayopyatra mohitāḥ|| tatsarvaṃ prāpnuvaṃtīha śivārcanaratā narāḥ|| 8.115 || ye'rcayaṃti śivaṃ nityaṃ liṃgarūpiṇameva ca|| striyo vāpyatha vā śūdrāḥ śvapacā hyaṃtyavāsinaḥ|| taṃ śivaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyeva sarvaduḥkhopanāśanam|| 8.116 || paśavo'pi paraṃ yātāḥ kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥ|| 8.117 || ye dvijā brahmacaryeṇa tapaḥ paramamāsthitāḥ|| varṣairanekairyajñānāṃ te'pi svargaparā bhavan|| 8.118 || jyotiṣṭomo vājapeyo hyatirātrādayo hyamī|| yajñāḥ svargaṃ prayacchaṃti sattrīṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 8.119 || tatra svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣayakaraṃ mahat|| puṇyakṣaye'pi yajvāno martyalokaṃ pataṃti vai|| 8.120 || patitānāṃ ca saṃsāre daivādbuddhiḥ prajāyate|| guṇatrayamayī viprāstāsutāstviha yoniṣu|| 8.121 || yathā sattvaṃ saṃbhavati sattvayuktabhavaṃ narāḥ|| rājasāśca tathā jñeyāstā masāścaiva te dvijāḥ|| 8.122 || evaṃ saṃsāracakre'sminbhramitā bahavo janāḥ|| yadṛcchayā daivagatyā śivaṃ saṃsevate naraḥ|| 8.123 || śivadhyānaparāṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ yatacetasām|| māyānirasanaṃ sadyo bhaviṣyati na cānyathā|| 8.124 || māyānirasanātsadyo naśyatyeva guṇatrayam|| yadā guṇatrayātīto bhavatīti sa muktibhāk|| 8.125 || tasmālliṅgārcanaṃ bhāvyaṃ sarveṣāmapi dehinām|| liṅgarūpī śivo bhūtvā trāyate saṃcarācaram|| 8.126 || purā bhavadbhiḥ pṛṣṭo'haṃ liṅgarūpī kathaṃ śivaḥ|| tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ viprā yāthātathyena saṃprati|| 8.127 || kathaṃ garaṃ bhakṣitavāñchivo lokamaheśvaraḥ|| tatsarvaṃ śrūyatāṃ viprā yatāvatkathayāmi vaḥ|| 8.128 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhāsryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivaliṅgārcanamāhātmyakathane śrīrāmāvatārakathāvarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8 || cha ||
<1.1.9>
||lomaśa uvāca|| ekadā tu sabhāmadhya āsthito devarāṭ svayam|| lokapālaiḥ parivṛto devaiśca ṛṣibhistathā|| 9.1 || apsarogaṇasaṃvīto gaṃdharvaiśca puraskṛtaḥ|| upagīyamānavijayaḥ siddhavidyādharairapi|| 9.2 || tadā śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto devarājaguruḥ sudhīḥ|| āgato'sau mahābhāgo bṛhaspati rudāradhīḥ|| 9.3 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā devāḥ praṇemuḥ samupasthitāḥ|| iṃdropi dadṛśe tatra prāptaṃ vācaspatiṃ tadā|| 9.4 || novāca kiṃciddurmedhāvaco mānupuraḥsaram|| nāhvānaṃ nāsanaṃ tasya na visarjanameva ca|| 9.5 || śakraṃ pramattaṃ jñātvātha madādrājyasya durmatim|| tirodhānamanuprāpto bṛhaspatī ruṣānvitaḥ|| 9.6 || gate devagurau tasminvimanaskā'bhavansurāḥ|| yakṣā nāgāḥ sagaṃdharvā ṛṣayo'pi tathā dvijāḥ|| 9.7 || gāṃdharvasyā vasāne tu labdhasaṃjño hariḥ surān|| papraccha tvaritenavai kva gato hi mahātapāḥ|| 9.8 || tadaiva nāradenoktaḥ śakro devādhipastathā|| tvayā kṛtā hyavajñā ca gurornastyatra saṃśayaḥ|| 9.9 || guroravajñayā rājyaṃ gataṃ te balasūdana|| tasmātkṣamāpanīyo'sau sarvabhāvena hi tvayā|| 9.10 || etacchrutvā vacastasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ|| āsanātsahasotthāya taiḥ sarvaiḥ parivāritaḥ|| āgacchattvarayā śakro gurorgehamataṃdritaḥ|| 9.11 || pṛṣṭvā tārāṃ praṇamyādau kva gato hi mahātapāḥ|| na jānāmītyuvācedaṃ tārā śakraṃ nirīkṣatī|| 9.12 || tadā ciṃtānvito bhūtvā śakraḥ svagṛhamāvrajat|| etasminnaṃtare svarge hyaniṣṭāndbhutāni ca|| 9.13 || abhavansarvaduḥkhārthe śakrasya ca mahātmanaḥ|| pātālasthena balinā jñātaṃ śakrasya ceṣṭitam|| 9.14 || yayau daityaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pātālādamarāvatīm|| tadā yuddhamatīvāsīddevānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha|| 9.15 || devāḥ parājitā daityai rājyaṃ śakrasya tatkṣaṇāt|| saṃprāptaṃ sakalaṃ tasya mūḍhasya ca durātmanaḥ|| 9.16 || nītaṃ sarvaprayatnena pātālaṃ tvaritaṃ gatāḥ|| śukraprasādātte sarve tathā vijayino'bhavan|| 9.17 || śakro'pi niḥśriko jāto devaistyaktastato bhṛśam|| devī tirodhānagatā babhūva kamalekṣaṇā|| 9.18 || airāvato mahānāgastathaivoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ|| evamādīni ratnāni anekāni bahūnyapi|| nītāni sahasā daityairlobhādasādhuvṛttibhiḥ|| 9.19 || puṇyabhāṃji ca tānyeva patitāni ca sāgare|| tadā sa vismayāviṣṭo balirāha guruṃ prati|| 9.20 || devānnirjitya cāsmābhirānītāni bahūni ca|| ratnāni tu samudre'tha patitāni tadadbhutam|| 9.21 || balestadvacanaṃ śrutvā uśanā pratyuvāca tam|| aśvamedhaśatenaiva surarājyaṃ bhaviṣyati|| dīkṣitasya na saṃdehastasmādbhokta sa eva ca|| 9.22 || aśvamedhaṃ vinā kiṃcitsvargaṃ bhoktaṃ na pāryate|| 9.23 || gurorvacanamājñāya tūṣṇīṃbhūto balistataḥ|| babhūva devaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca yathocitamakārayat|| 9.24 || indropi śocyatāṃ prāpto jagāma
