dāridryaśaṃkayā|| prājñastu visṛjatyarthānamutra tasya śaṃkayā|| 2.63 || kiṃ dhanena kariṣyaṃti dehino bhaṃgurāśrayāḥ|| yadarthaṃ dhanamicchaṃti taccharīramaśāśvatam|| 2.64 || akṣaradvayamabhyastaṃ nāstināstīti yatpurā|| tadidaṃ dehidehiti viparītamupasthitam|| 2.65 || bodhayaṃti ca yāvaṃto dehīti kṛpaṇaṃ janāḥ|| avastheyamadānasya mā bhūdevaṃ bhavānapi|| 2.66 || dāturevopakārāya vadatyarthīti dehi me|| yasmāddātā prayātyūrdhvamadhastiṣṭhetpratigrahī|| 2.67 || daridrā vyādhitā mūrkhāḥ parapreṣyakarāḥ sadā|| adattadānājjāyaṃte duḥkhasyaiva hi bhājanāḥ|| 2.68 || dhanavaṃtamadātāraṃ daridraṃ vā'tapasvinam|| ubhāvaṃbhasi moktavyau kaṃṭhe baddhā mahāśilām|| 2.69 || śateṣu jāyate śūraḥ sahasreṣu ca paṃḍitaḥ|| vaktā śatasahasreṣu dātā jāyeta vā na vā|| 1.2.2.70 || gobhirvipraiśca vedaiśca satībhiḥ satyavādibhiḥ|| alubdhairdānaśīlaiśca saptabhirdhāryate mahī|| 2.71 || śibirauśīnaroṅgāni sutaṃ ca priyamaurasam|| brāhmaṇārthamupākṛtya nākapṛṣṭhabhito gataḥ|| 2.72 || pratarddanaḥ kāśipati pradāya nayene svake|| brāhmaṇāyātulāṃ kīrtimiha cāmutra cāśnute|| 2.73 || nimī rāṣṭraṃ ca vaideho jāmadagnyo vasuṃdharām|| brāhmaṇebhyo dadau cāpi gacaścorvī sapattanām|| 2.74 || avarṣati ca parjanye sarvabhūtanivāsakṛt|| vasiṣṭho jīvayāmāsa prajāpatiriva prajāḥ|| 2.75 || brahmadattaśca pāṃcālyo rājā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ|| nidhiṃ śaṃkhaṃ dvijāgryebhyo dattvā svargamavāptavān|| 2.76 || sahasrajicca rājarṣiḥ prāṇāniṣṭānmahāyaśāḥ|| brāhmaṇārthe parityajya gato lokānanuttamān|| 2.77 || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sthāṇordānena bhaktitaḥ|| rudralokaṃ gatā nityaṃ śāntātmāno jitendriyāḥ|| 2.78 || eṣāṃ pratiṣṭhitā kīrtiryāvatsthāsyati medinī|| iti saṃciṃtya sārārthī sthāṇudānaparo bhava|| 2.79 || so'pi moha parityajya tathā kātyāyano'bhavat|| 1.2.2.80 || ||nārada uvāca|| evaṃ suśravasā proktāṃ kathāmākarṇya padmabhūḥ|| harṣāśrusaṃyuto'tīva praśaśaṃsa muhurmuhuḥ|| 2.81 || sādhu te vyāhṛtaṃ vatsa evametanna cānyathā|| satyaṃ sārasvataḥ prāha satyā caivaṃ tathā śrutiḥ|| 2.82 || dānaṃ yajñānāṃ varūthaṃ dakṣiṇā loke dātāram̐sarvabhūtānyupajīvaṃti dānenārātīram̐pānudaṃta dānena dviṣaṃto mitrā bhavaṃti dāne sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tasmāddānaṃ paramaṃ vadaṃtīti|| 2.83 || saṃsārasāgare ghore dharmādharmormisaṃkule|| dānaṃ tatra niṣeveta tacca nauriva nirmitam|| 2.84 || iti saṃciṃtya ca mayā puṣkare sthāpitā dvijāḥ|| gaṅgāyamunayormadhye madhyadeśe dvijāḥ sṛte|| 2.85 || sthāpitāḥ śrīharibhyāṃ tu śrīgauryā vedavittamāḥ|| rudreṇa nāgarāścaiva pārvatyā śaktipūrbhavāḥ|| 2.86 || śrīmāle ca tathā lakṣmyā hyevamādisurottamaiḥ|| nānāgrahārāḥ saṃdattā lokoddharaṇakāṃkṣayā|| 2.87 || na hi dānaphale kāṃkṣā kācinna'sti surottamāḥ|| sādhusaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ hi dānaṃ naḥ parikīrtitam|| 2.88 || brāhmaṇāśca kṛtasthānā nānādharmopadeśanaiḥ|| samuddharaṃti varṇāṃstrīṃstataḥ pūjyatamā dvijāḥ|| 2.89 || dānaṃ caturvidhaṃ dānamutsargaḥ kalpitaṃ tathā|| saṃśrutaṃ ceti vividhaṃ tatkramātparikīrtitam|| 1.2.2.90 || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ vṛkṣavidyāsuraukasām|| maṭhaprapāgṛhakṣetradānamutsarga ityasau|| 2.91 || upajīvannimānyaśca puṇyaṃ ko'pi carennaraḥ|| ṣaṣṭhamaṃśaṃ sa labhate yāvadyo visṛjeddvijaḥ|| 2.92 || tadeṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ viprasaṃsthāpanaṃ param|| devasaṃsthāpanaṃ caiva dharmastanmūla eva yat|| 2.93 || devatāyatanaṃ yāvadyāvacca brāhmaṇagṛham|| tāvaddātuḥ pūrvajānāṃ puṇyāṃśaścopatiṣṭhati|| 2.94 || etatsvalpaṃ hi vāṇijyaṃ punarbahuphalapradam|| jīrṇoddhāre ca dviguṇametadeva prakīrtitam|| 2.95 || tasmādidaṃ tvahamapibravīmi surasattamāḥ|| nāsti dānasamaṃ kiṃcitsatyaṃ sārasvato jagau|| 2.96 || ||nārada uvāca|| iti sārasvataproktāṃ tathā padmabhuveritām|| sādhusādhvityamodaṃta surāścāhaṃ suvismitāḥ|| 2.97 || tataḥ sabhāvisargāṃte suramye merumūrdhani|| upaviśya śilāpṛṣṭhe ahametadaciṃtayam|| 2.98 || satyamāha viraṃcistu sa kimarthaṃ tu jīvati|| yenaikamapi taddhṛttaṃ naiva yena kṛtārthatā|| 2.99 || tadahaṃ dānapuṇyaṃ hi kariṣyāmi kathaṃ sphuṭam|| kaupīnadaṇḍātmadhano dhanaṃ svalpaṃ hi nāsti me|| 1.2.2.100 || anarhate yaddadāti na dadāti tathārhate|| arhānarhaparijñānāddānadharmo hi duṣkaraḥ|| 2.101 || deśekāle ca pātre ca śuddhena manasā tathā|| nyāyārjitaṃ ca yo dadyādyauvane sa tadaśnute|| 2.102 || tamovṛtastu yo dadyātkrodhāttathaiva ca|| bhuṃkte dāna phalaṃ taddhi garbhastho nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 2.103 || bālatve'pi ca so'śrāti yaddattaṃ dambhakāraṇāt|| dattamanyāyato vittaṃ vai cārthakāraṇam|| 2.104 || vṛddhatve hi samaśrāti naro vai nātra bhaviṣyati|| tasmāddeśe ca kāle ca supātre vidhinā naraḥ|| śubhārjitaṃ prayuñjīta śraddhayā śāṭhyavarjitaḥ|| 2.105 || tadetannirdhanatvācca kathaṃ nāma bhaviṣyati|| satyamāhuḥ purā vākyaṃ purāṇamunayo'malāḥ|| 2.106 || nādhanasyāstyayaṃ loko na paraśca kathaṃcana|| abhiśastaṃ prapaśyaṃti daridraṃ pārśvataḥ sthitam|| 2.107 || dāridryaṃ pātakaṃ loke kastacchaṃsitumarhati|| patitaḥ śocyate sarvairnirdhanaścāpi śocyate|| 2.108 || yaḥ kṛśāśvaḥ kṛśadhanaḥ kṛśabhṛtyaḥ kṛśātithiḥ|| sa vai proktaḥ kṛśonāma na śarīrakṛśaḥ kṛśaṛ 2.109 || arthavānduṣkulīno'pi loke pūjyatamo naraḥ|| śaśinastulyavaṃśo'pi nirdhanaḥ paribhūyate|| 1.2.2.110 || jñānavṛddhāstapovṛddhā ye ca vṛddhā bahuśrutāḥ|| te sarve dhanavṛddhasya dvāri tiṣṭhanti kiṃkarāḥ|| 2.111 || yadyapyayaṃ tribhuvane artho'smākaṃ parāgnahi|| tathāpyanyaprārthito hi tasyaiva phalado bhavet|| 2.112 || athavaitatpurā sarvaṃ ciṃtayiṣyāmi susphuṭam|| vilokayāmi pūrvaṃ tu kiṃcidyogyaṃ hi sthānakam|| 2.113 || sa ciṃtayitveti bahuprakāraṃ deśāṃśca grāmānnagarāṇi cāśramān|| bahūnahaṃ paryaṭannāptavānhi sthānaṃ hitaṃ sthāpaye yatra viprān|| 2.114 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe nāradārjunasaṃvāde dānapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma dvitīya'dhyāyaḥ|| 2 || cha ||
<1.2.3>
||sū uvāca|| evaṃ sthānāni puṇyāni yāniyānīha vai bhuvi|| nirīkṣaṃstatra tatrāhaṃ nārado vīrasattama|| 3.1 || vicaranmedinīṃ sarvāṃ prāpto'hamāśramaṃ bhṛgoḥ|| yatra revānadī puṇyā saptakalpasmarā varā|| 3.2 || mahāpuṇyā pavitrā ca sarvatīrthamayī śubhā|| punāni kīrtanenaiva darśanena viśeṣataḥ|| 3.3 || tatrāvagāhanātpārtha mucyate jaṃturaṃhasā|| yathā sā piṅgalā nāḍī dehamadhye vyavasthitā|| 3.4 || iyaṃ brahmāṃḍapiṇḍasya sthāne tasminprakīrtitā|| tatrāste śuklatīrthākhyaṃ revāyāṃ pāpanāśanam|| 3.5 || yatra vai snānamātreṇa brahmahatyā praṇaśyati|| tasyāpi sannidhau pārtha revāyā uttare taṭe|| 3.6 || nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ latāgulmopaśobhitam|| nānāpuṣpaphalo petaṃ kadalīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitam|| 3.7 || anekāśvāpadākīrṇaṃ vihagairanunāditam|| sugaṃdhapuṣpaśobhāḍhyaṃ mayūraravanāditam|| 3.8 || bhramaraiḥ sarvamutsṛjya nilīnaṃ rāvasaṃyutam|| yathā saṃsāramutsṛjya bhaktena harapādayoḥ|| 3.9 || kokilā madhuraiḥ svānairnādayaṃti tathā munīn|| yathā kathāmṛtākhyānairbrāhmaṇā bhavabhīrukān|| 1.2.3.10 || yatra vṛkṣā hlādayaṃti phalaiḥ puṣpaiśca patrakaiḥ|| chāyābhirapi kāṣṭhaiśca lokāniva haravratāḥ|| 3.11 || putraputreti vāśaṃte yatra putrapriyāḥ khagāḥ|| yathā śivapriyāḥ śaivā nityaṃ śivaśiveti ca|| 3.12 || evaṃvidhaṃ munestasya bhṛgorāśramamaṃḍalam|| vipraistraividyasaṃyuktaiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtam|| 3.13 || ṛgyajuḥ sāmanirghopairārūritadigantaram|| rudrabhaktena dhīreṇa yathaiva bhuvanatrayam|| 3.14 || tatrāhaṃ pārtha saṃprāpto yatrāste munisattamaḥ|| bhṛguḥ paramadharmātmātapasā dyotitaprabhaḥ|| 3.15 || āgacchaṃtaṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnaṃ ca muditaṃ tathā|| abhyutthaānaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvairviprairbhṛgupurogamaiḥ|| 3.16 || kṛtvā susvāgataṃ dattvā arghādyaṃ bhṛguṇā saha|| āsaneṣūpaviṣṭāste munīṃdrā grāhitā mayā|| 3.17 || viśrāṃtaṃ tu tato jñātvā bhṛgurmāmapyuvācaha|| kva gaṃtavyaṃ muniśreṣṭha kasmādiha samāgataḥ|| 3.18 || āgamanakāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ samācakṣva parisphuṭam|| tatastaṃ ciṃtayāviṣṭo bhṛguṃ pārthāhamabruvam|| 3.19 || śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi yadarthamahāmāgataḥ|| mayā paryaṭitā sarvā samudrāṃtā ca medinī|| 1.2.3.20 || dvijānāṃ bhūmidānārthaṃ mārgamāṇaḥ padepade|| nirdoṣāṃ ca pavitrāṃ ca tīrtheṣvapi samanvitām|| 3.21 || ramyāṃ manoramāṃ bhūmiṃ na paśyāmi kathaṃcana|| ||bhṛguruvāca|| viprāṇāṃ sthāpanārthāya mayāpi bhramatā purā|| 3.22 || pṛthvī sāgaraparyaṃtā dṛṣṭā sarvā tadānagha|| mahīnāma nadī puṇyā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā|| 3.23 || divyā manoramā saumyā mahāpāpapraṇāśinī|| nadīrūpeṇa tatraiva pṛthvī sā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 3.24 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāni nārada|| tāni sarvāṇi tatraiva nivasaṃti mahījale|| 3.25 || sā samudreṇa saṃprāptā puṇyatoyā mahānadī|| saṃjātastatra devarṣe mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| 3.26 || staṃbhākhyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ tu triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam|| tatra ye manujāḥ snānaṃ prakurvaṃti vipaścitaḥ|| 3.27 || sarvapāpavinirmuktā nopasarpaṃti vai yamam|| tatrādbhutaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ me purā snātuṃ gatena vai|| 3.28 || tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi mune śrṛṇu mahādbhutam|| yāvatsnātuṃ vrajāmyasminmahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 3.29 || tīre sthitaṃ prapaśyāmi munīṃdraṃ pāvakopamam|| prāṃśuṃ vṛddhaṃ cāsthiśeṣaṃ tapolakṣmyā vibhūṣitam|| 1.2.3.30 || bhujāvūrdhvau tataḥ kṛtvā prarudaṃtaṃ muhurmuhuḥ|| taṃ tathā duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhito'hamathābhavam|| 3.31 || satāṃ lakṣaṇametaddhi yaddṛṣṭvā duḥkhitaṃ janam|| śatasaṃkhya tasya bhavettathāhaṃ vilalāpa ha|| 3.32 || ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ mānuṣye sati durlabham|| tatastamupasaṃgamya paryapṛcchamahaṃ tadā|| 3.33 || kimarthaṃ rodiśi mune śoke kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tava|| suguhyamapi cedbūhi jijñāsā mahatī hi me|| 3.34 || munistato māmavadadbhṛgo nirbhāgyavānaham|| tena rodimi mā pṛccha durbhāgyaṃ cālapeddhi kaḥ|| 3.35 || tamahaṃ vismayāviṣṭaḥ punarevedamabruvam|| durlabhaṃ bhārate janma tatrāpi ca manuṣyatā|| 3.36 || manuṣyatve brāhmaṇatvaṃ munitvaṃ tatra durlabham|| tatrāpi ca tapaḥsiddhiḥ prāpyaitatpaṃcakaṃ param|| 3.37 || kimarthaṃ rodiṣi mune vismayo'tra mahānmama|| evaṃ saṃpṛcchate mahyametasminneva cāṃtare|| 3.38 || subhadronāma nāmnā ca munistatrābhyupāyayau|| sa hi meruṃ parityajya jñātvā tīrthasya sāratām|| 3.39 || kṛtāśramaḥ pūjayati sadā staṃbheśvaraṃ muniḥ|| so'pyevaṃ māmi vāpṛcchanmuniṃ rodanakāraṇam|| 1.2.3.40 || athāhācamya sa muniḥ śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ munī|| ahaṃ hi devaśarmākhyo muniḥ saṃyatavāṅmanāḥ|| 3.41 || nivasāmi kṛtasthāno gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame|| tatra darśetarpayāmi sadaiva ca pitṝnaham|| 3.42 || śrāddhāṃte te ca pratyakṣā hyāśiṣo me vadaṃti ca|| tataḥ kadācitpitaraḥ prahṛṣṭā māmathābravan|| 3.43 || vayaṃ sadātra cāyāmo devaśarmaṃstavāṃtike|| sthāne'smākaṃ kadācittvaṃ na cāyāsi kutaḥ sutaḥ|| 3.44 || sthānaṃ didṛkṣustaccāhaṃ na śakto'smi nivoditum|| tataḥ paramamityuktvā gatavānpitṛbhiḥ saha|| 3.45 || pitṝṇāṃ maṃdiraṃ puṇyaṃ bhaumalokasamāsthitam|| tatratatra sthitaścāhaṃ tejomaṇḍaladurdṛśān|| 3.46 || dṛṣṭvāgrataḥ pūjayāḍhyānapṛcchaṃ svānpitṝniti|| ke hyamī samupāyāṃti bhṛśaṃ tṛptā bhṛśārcitāḥ|| bhṛśaṃpramuditā naiva tathā yūyaṃ yathā hyamī|| 3.47 || ||pitara ūcuḥ|| bhadraṃ te pitaraḥ puṇyāḥ subhadrasya mahāmuneḥ|| tarpitāstena muninā mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 3.48 || sarvatīrthamayī yatra nilīnā hyudadhau mahī|| tatra darśe tarpayati subhadrastānamūnsuta|| 3.49 || ityākarṇya vacasteṣāṃ lajjito'haṃ bhṛśaṃtadā|| vismitaśca praṇamyaitānpitṝnsvaṃ sthānamāgataḥ|| 1.2.3.50 || yathā tathā ciṃtitaṃ ca tatra yāsyāmyahaṃ śphuṭam|| puṇyo yatrāpi vikhyāto mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| 3.51 || kṛtāśramaśca tatraiva tarpayiṣye nijānpitṝn|| darśedarśe yathā cāsau stutyanāmā subhadrakaḥ|| 3.52 || kiṃ tena nanu jātena kulāṃgāreṇa pāpinā|| yasmiñjīvatyavi nijāḥ pitaro'nyaspṛhākarāḥ|| 3.53 || iti saṃciṃtya mudito ruciṃ bhāryāmathābravum|| ruce tvayā samāyukto mahīsāgagarasaṃgamam|| 3.54 || gatvā sthāsyāmi tatraiva śīghraṃ tvaṃ sammukhībhava|| pativratāsi śuddhāsikulīnāsi yaśasvini|| tasmādetanmama śubhe kartumarhasi ciṃtitam|| 3.55 || ||ruciruvāca|| hatā tasya janirnābhūtkathaṃ pāpa durātmanā|| 3.56 || śmaśānastaṃbha yenāhaṃ dattā tubhyaṃ kṛtaṃtvāya|| iha kaṃdaphalāhārairyatkiṃ tena na pūryate|| 3.57 || netumicchasi māṃ tatra yatra kṣārodakaṃ sadā|| tvameva tatra saṃyāhi naṃdaṃtu tava pūrvajāḥ|| 3.58 || gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā vṛddha vasa vā kākavacciram|| tathā bruvantyāṃ tasyāṃ tu karṇāvasmi pidhāya ca|| 3.59 || vipulaṃ śiṣyamādiśya gṛha eko'tra āgataḥ|| so'haṃ snātvātra saṃtarpya pitṝñchraddhāparāyaṇaḥ|| 1.2.3.60 || ciṃtāṃ suvipulāṃ prāpto narake duṣkṛtī yathā|| yadi tiṣṭhāmi cātraiva ardhadehadharo hyaham|| 3.61 || naro hi gṛhiṇīhīno ardhadeha iti smṛtaḥ|| yathātmanā vinā dehe kāryaṃ kiṃcinna sidhyati|| 3.62 || anayorhi phalaṃ grāhyaṃ sāratā nātra kācana|| ardhadehī ca manujastvasaṃspṛśyaḥ satāṃmataḥ|| 3.63 || anayorhiphalaṃ grāhyaṃ sāratā nātra kācana|| ardhadehī ca manujastvasaṃspṛśyaḥ satāṃmataḥ|| 3.64 || auttānapādiraspṛśya uttamo hi suraiḥ kṛtaḥ|| atha cettatra saṃyāmi na mahīsāgarastataḥ|| 3.65 || yāmi vā tatkathaṃ pādau calato me kathaṃcana|| etasminme mano viddhaṃ khidyate'jñānasaṃkaṭe|| 3.66 || ato'hamatimuhyāmi bhṛśaṃ śocāmi rodimi|| itiśrutvā vacastasya bhṛśaṃ romāṃcapūritam|| 3.67 || sādhusādhvityathovāca taṃ subhadro'pyahaṃ tathā|| daṇḍavacca praṇamito mahīsāgarasaṅgamam|| 3.68 || cintayāvaśca manasi pratīkāraṃ munerubhau|| yo hi mānuṣyamāsādya jalabudbudabhaṃguram|| 3.69 || parārthāya bhavatyeṣa puruṣo'nye purīṣakāḥ|| tataḥ saṃciṃtya prāhedaṃ subhadro munisattamam|| 1.2.3.70 || mā mune parikhidyasva devaśarmansthiro bhava|| ahaṃ te nāśayiṣyāmi śokaṃ sūryastamo yathā|. 3.71 || gamiṣyāmyāśramaṃ tvaṃ ca nātrāpi parihāsyate|| śrṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ tubhyaṃ tarpayiṣye pitṝnaham|| 3.72 || ||devaśarmovāca|| evaṃ te vadamānasya āyurastu śataṃ samāḥ|| yadaśakyaṃ mahatkarma kartumicchasi matkṛte|| 3.73 || harṣasthāne viṣādaśca punarmāṃ bādhate śrṛṇu|| api vākyaṃ śubhaṃ santo na gṛhṇanti mudhā mune|| 3.74 || kathametanmahatkarma kārayāmi mudhāvada|| punaḥ kiṃcitpravakṣyāmi yathā me niṣkṛtirbhavet|| 3.75 || śāpito'si mayā prāṇairyathā vacmi tathā kuru|| ahaṃ sadā kariṣyāmi darśe coddiśyate pitṝn|| 3.76 || śrāddhaṃ gaṃgārṇave cātra matpitṝṇāṃ tvamācara|| ahaṃ caivāpi tapasaḥ saṃcitasyāpi janmanā|| caturbhāgaṃ pradāsyāmi evamevaitadācara|| 3.77 || ||subhadra uvāca|| yadyevaṃ tava saṃtoṣastvevamastu munīśvara|| sādhūnāṃ ca yathā harṣastathā kāryaṃ vijānatā|| 3.78 || ||bhṛguruvāca|| devaśarmā tato hṛṣṭo dattvā puṇyaṃ trivācikam|| caturthāśaṃ yayau dhāma svaṃ subhadro'pi ca sthitaḥ|| 3.79 || evaṃvidho nāradāsau mahī sāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| yamanusmarato mahyaṃ romāṃco'dyāpi vartate|| 1.2.3.80 || ||nārada uvāca|| iti śrutvā phālgunāhaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā|| mṛtomṛta ivā vocaṃ sādhusādhviti taṃbhṛgum|| 3.81 || yūyaṃ vayaṃ gamiṣyāmo mahītīraṃ suśobhanam|| āvāmīkṣāvahe sarvaṃ sthānakaṃ tadanuttamam|| 3.82 || mama caivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhṛguḥ saha mayayayau|| samastaṃ tu mahāpuṇyaṃ mahīkūlaṃ nirīkṣitam|| 3.83 || taddṛṣṭvā cātihṛṣṭohamāsaṃ romāṃcakaṃcukaḥ|| abravaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā|| 3.84 || tvatprasādātkariṣyāmi bhṛgo sthānamanuttamam|| svasthānaṃ gamyatāṃ brahmannataḥ kṛtyaṃ viciṃtaye|| 3.85 || evaṃ bhṛguṃ cāsmivisarjayitvā kallolakolāhalakautukītaṭe|| athopaviśyedamaciṃtayaṃ tadā kiṃ kṛtyamātmānamivaikayogī|| 3.86 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārīkākhaṃḍe nāradārjunasaṃvāde mahīsāgarasaṃgamatīrthamāhātmye tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3 || cha ||
<1.2.4>
|| nārada uvāca|| tatastvahaṃ ciṃtayāmi kathaṃ sthānamidaṃ bhavet|| mamāyattaṃ yato rājñāṃ bhūmireṣā sadā vaśe|| 4.1 || yattvahaṃ dharmavarṇāṇaṃ gatvā yāce ha medinīm|| arpayatyeva sa ca me yācito na punaḥ paraḥ|| 4.2 || tathā hi munibhiḥ proktaṃ dravyaṃ trividhamuttamam|| śuklaṃ madhyaṃ ca śabalamadhamaṃ gṛṣṇamucyate|| 4.3 || śruteḥ saṃpādanācchiṣyātprāptaṃ śuklaṃ ca knyayayā|| tathā kusīdavāṇijyakṛṣiyācitameva ca|| 4.4 || śabalaṃ procyate sadbhirdyūtacauryeṇa sāhasaiḥ|| vyājenopārjitaṃ yacca tatkṛṣṇaṃ samudāhṛtam|| 4.5 || śuklavittena yo dharmaṃ prakuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ|| tīrthaṃ pātraṃ samāsādya devatve tatsamaśnute|| 4.6 || rājasena ca bhāvena vittena śabalena ca|| pradadyāddānamarthibhyo mānuṣyatve tadaśnute|| 4.7 || tamovṛtastu yo dadyātkṛṣṇavittena mānavaḥ|| tiryaktve tatphalaṃ pretya samaśrāti narādhamaḥ|| 4.8 || tattu yācitadravyaṃ me rājasaṃ hi sphuṭaṃ bhavet|| atha brāhmaṇabhāvena nṛpaṃ yāce pratigraham|| 4.9 || tadapyaho cātikaṣṭa hetunā tena me matam|| ayaṃ pratigraho ghoro madhvāsvādo viṣopamaḥ|| 1.2.4.10 || pratīgraheṇa saṃyuktaṃ hyamīvamāviśoddvijam|| tasmādahaṃ nivṛttaśca pāpādasmātpratigrahāt|| 4.11 || tataḥ kenāpyupāyena dvayoranyatareṇa tu|| svāyattaṃ sthānaka kurma etatsañciṃtaye muhuḥ|| 4.12 || yathā kubhāryaḥ puruṣaścintāṃtaṃ na prapadyate|| tathaiva vimṛśaṃścāhaṃ ciṃtāṃtaṃ na labhāmyaṇu|| 4.13 || etasminnantare pārtha snātuṃ tatra samāgatāḥ|| bahavo munayaḥ puṇye mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 4.14 || ahaṃ tānabravaṃ sarvānkuto yūyaṃ samāgatāḥ|| te māmūcuḥ praṇamyātha saurāṣṭraviṣaye mune|| 4.15 || dharmavarmeti nṛpatiryo'sya deśasya bhūpatiḥ|| sa tu dānasya tattvārthī tepe varṣagaṇānbahūn|| 4.16 || tatastaṃ prāha khe vāṇī ślokamekaṃ nṛpa śrṛṇu|| dvihetu ṣadhiṣṭhānaṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ ca dvipākayuk|| 4.17 || catuḥprakāraṃ trividhaṃ trināśaṃ dānamucyate|| ityekaṃ ślokamābhāṣya khe vāṇī virarāma ha|| 4.18 || ślokasyārthaṃ nāvabhāṣe pṛcchamānāpi nārada|| tato rājā dharmavarmā paṭahenānvaghoṣayat|| 4.19 || yastu ślokasya caivāsya labdhasya tapasā mayā|| karoti samyagavyākhyānaṃ tasya caitaddadāmyaham|| 1.2.4.20 || gavāṃ ca sapta niyutaṃ suvarṇaṃ tāvadeva tu|| saptagrāmānprayacchāmi ślokavyākhyāṃ karoti yaḥ|| 4.21 || paṭaheneti nṛpateḥ śrutvā rājño vaco mahat|| ājagmurbahudeśīyā brāhmaṇāḥ koṭiśo mune|| 4.22 || punardurbodhavinyāsaḥ ślokastairviprapuṃgavaiḥ|| ākhyātuṃ śakyate naiva guḍo mūkairyathā mune|| 4.23 || vayaṃ ca tatra yātāḥ smo dhanalobhena nārada|| durbodhatvānnamaskṛtya ślokaṃ cātra samāgatāḥ|| 4.24 || durvyākhyeyastvayaṃ śloko dhanaṃ labhyaṃ na caiva naḥ|| tīrthayātrāṃ kathaṃ yāmītyevāciṃtyātra cāgatāḥ|| 4.25 || evaṃ phālguna teṣāṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā mahātmanām|| anīva saṃprahṛṣṭo'haṃ tānvisṛjyetyaciṃtayam|| 4.26 || aho prāpta upāyo me sthānaprāptau na saṃśayaḥ|| ślokaṃ vyākhyāya nṛpaterlapsye sthānaṃ dhanaṃ tathā|| 4.27 || vidyāmūlyena naivaṃ ca yācitaḥ syātpratigrahaḥ|| satyamāha purāṇārṣirvāsudevo jagadguruḥ|| 4.28 || dharmasya yasya śraddhā syānna ca sā naiva pūryate|| pāpasya yasya śraddhāsyānna ca sāpi na pūryate|| 4.29 || evaṃ viciṃtya vidvāṃsaḥ prakurvaṃti yatāruci|| satyametadvibhorvākyaṃ durlabho'pi yathā hi me|| 1.2.4.30 || manoratho'yaṃ saphalaḥ saṃbhūtoṃkuritaḥ sphuṭam|| enaṃ ca durvidaṃ ślokamahaṃ jānāmi susphuṭam|| 4.31 || amūrtaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pūrvameva khyāto hi me purā|| evaṃ harṣānvitaḥ pārtha saṃciṃtyā'haṃ tato muhuḥ|| 4.32 || praṇamya tīrthaṃ calito mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa tatohaṃ yātavānnṛpam|| 4.33 || idaṃ bhaṇitavānasmi ślokavyākhyāṃ nṛpa śrṛṇu|| yatte paṭahavikhyātaṃ dānaṃ ca praguṇīkuru|| 4.34 || evamukte nṛpaḥ prāha procurevaṃ hi koṭiśaḥ|| dvijottamāḥ punarnasyaṃ proktumartho hi śakyate|| 4.35 || ke dvihetū ṣaḍākhyātānyadhiṣṭhānāni kāni ca|| kāni caiva ṣaḍaṃgāni kau dvau pākau tathā smṛtau|| 4.36 || ke ca prakārāścatvāraḥ kiṃsvittattrividhaṃ dvija|| payo nāśāśca ke proktā dānasyaitatsphucaṃ vada|| 4.37 || sphuṭānpraśrānimānsapta yadi vakṣyasi brāhmaṇa|| tato gavāṃ saptaniyutaṃ suvarṇaṃ tāvadeva tu|| 4.38 || sapta grāmāṃśca dāsyāmi no cedyāsyasi svaṃgṛham|| ityuktvacanaṃ pārtha saurāṣṭrasvāminaṃ nṛpam|| 4.39 || dharmavarmāṇamastvevaṃ prāvocamavadhāraya|| ślokavyākhyāṃ sphuṭāṃ vakṣye dānahetū ca tau śrṛṇu|| 1.2.4.40 || alpatvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā bahutvaṃ vā dānasyābhyudayāvaham|| śraddhā śaktiśca dānānāṃ vṛddhyakṣayakarehi te|| 4.41 || tatra śraddhāviṣaye ślokā bhavanti|| kāyakleśaiśca bahubhirna caivārathasya rāśibhiḥ|| 4.42 || dharmaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā dharmo'dbhutaṃ tapaḥ|| śraddhā svargaśca mokṣaśca śraddhā sarvamidaṃ jagat|| 4.43 || sarvasvaṃ jīvitaṃ cāpi dadyādaśraddhayā yadi|| nāpnuyātsa phalaṃ kiṃcicchraddadhānastato bhavet|| 4.44 || śraddhayā sādhyate dharmo mahadbhirnārtharāśibhiḥ|| akiṃcanā hi munayaḥ śraddhāvaṃto divaṃ gatāḥ|| 4.45 || trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā|| sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śrṛṇu|| 4.46 || yajaṃte sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ|| pretānbhūtapiśācāṃśca yajaṃte tāmasā janāḥ|| 4.47 || tasmācchraddhāvatā pātre dattaṃ nyāyārjitaṃ hi yat|| tenaiva bhagavānrudraḥ svalpakenāpi tuṣyati|| 4.48 || śaktiviṣaye ca ślokā bhavaṃti|| kuṭuṃbabhuktavasanāddeyaṃ yadatiricyate|| madhvāsvādo viṣaṃ paścāddāturdharmo'nyathā bhavet|| 4.49 || śakte parajane dātā svajane duḥkhajīvini|| madhvāpānaviṣādaḥ sa dharmāṇāṃ pratirūpakaḥ|| 1.2.4.50 || bhṛtyānāmuparodhena yatkarotyaurdhvadaihikam|| tadbhavatyasukhodakaṃ jīvato'sya mṛtasya ca|| 4.51 || sāmānyaṃ yācitaṃ nyāsamādhirdārāśca darśanam|| anvāhitaṃ ca nikṣepaḥ sarvasvaṃ cānvaye sati|| 4.52 || āpatsvapi na deyāni navavastūni paṃḍitaiḥ|| yo dadāti sa mūḍhātmā prāyāścittīyate naraḥ|| 4.53 || iti te gaditau rājandvau hetū śrūyatāmataḥ|| adhiṣṭhānāni vakṣyāmi ṣaḍeva śrṛṇu tānyapi|| 4.54 || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vrīḍāharṣabhayāni ca|| adhiṣṭhānāni dānānāṃ ṣaḍetāni pracakṣate|| 4.55 || pātrebhyo dīyate nityamanapekṣya prayojanam|| kevalaṃ dharmabuddhyā yaddharmadānaṃ taducyate|| 4.56 || dhaninaṃ dhanalobhena lobhayitvārthamāharet|| tadarthadānamityāhuḥ kāmadānamataḥ śrṛṇu|| 4.57 || prayojana mapekṣyaiva prasaṃgādyatpradīyate|| anarheṣu sarāgeṇa kāmadānaṃ taducyate|| 4.58 || saṃsadi vrīḍayā''śrutya ārthibhyaḥ praaidadāti ca|| pratidīyate ca yaddānaṃ vrīḍādānamiti śrutam|| 4.59 || dṛṣṭvā priyāṇi śrutvā vā harṣavadyatpradīyate|| harṣadānamiti proktaṃ dānaṃ taddharmaciṃtakaiḥ|| 1.2.4.60 || ākrosānarthahiṃsānāṃ pratīkārāya yadbhavet|| dīyate'nupakartṛbhyo bhayadānaṃ taducyate|| 4.61 || proktāni ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānānyaṃgānyapi ca ṣaṭcchruṇu|| dātā pratigrahītā ca śuddhirdeyaṃ ca dharmayuk|| 4.62 || deśakālau ca dānānāmaṃgānyetāni ṣaḍviduḥ|| aparogī ca dharmātmā ditsuravyasanaḥ śuciḥ|| 4.63 || aniṃdyājīvakarmā ca ṣaḍbhirdātā praśasyate|| anṛjuścāśraddadhāno'śāṃtātmā dhṛṣṭabhīrukaḥ|| 4.64 || asatyasaṃdho nidrālurdātāyaṃ tāma so'dhamaḥ|| triśuklaḥ kṛśavṛttiśca ghṛṇāluḥ sakaleṃdriyaḥ|| 4.65 || vimukto yonidoṣebhyo brāhmaḥ pātramucyate|| saumukhyādabhisaṃprītirarthināṃ darśane sadā|| satkṛtiścānasūyā ca tadā śuddhiriti smṛtā|| 4.66 || aparābādhamakleśaṃ svayatnenārjitaṃ dhanam|| svalpaṃ vā vipulaṃ vāpi deyamityabhidhīyate|| 4.67 || tenāpi kila dharmeṇa uddiśya kila kiṃcana|| deyaṃ taddharmayugiti śūnye śūnyaṃ phalaṃ matam|| 4.68 || nyāyena durlabhaṃ dravyaṃ deśe kālepi vā punaḥ|| dānārhau deśakālau tau syātāṃ śreṣṭhau na cānyathā|| 4.69 || ṣaṃḍagānīti coktāni dvau ca pākāvataḥ śrṛṇu|| dvau pākau dānajau prāhuḥ paratrātha tvihocyate|| 1.2.4.70 || sadbhyo yaddīyate kiṃcittatparatropatiṣṭhati|| asatsu dīyate kiṃcittaddānamiha bhujyate|| 4.71 || dvau pākāviti nirdiṣṭau prakārāṃścaturaḥ śrṛṇu|| dhruvamāhustrikaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikamiti kramāt|| 4.72 || vaidiko dānamārgo'yaṃ caturdhā varṇyate dvijaiḥ|| prapārāmataḍāgādisarvakāmaphalaṃ dhruvam|| 4.73 || tadāhustrikāmityāhurdīyate yaddinedine|| apatyavijayaiśvaryastrībālārthaṃ pradīyate|| 4.74 || icchāsaṃsthaṃ ca yaddānaṃ kāmyamityabhidhīyate|| kālāpekṣaṃ kriyāpekṣaṃ guṇāpekṣamiti smṛtau|| 4.75 || tridhā naumittikaṃ proktaṃ sadā homavivarjitam|| iti proktāḥ prakārāste traividhyamabhidhīyate|| 4.76 || aṣṭottamāni catvāri madhyamāni vidhānataḥ|| kānīyasāni śeṣāṇi trividhatvamidaṃ viduḥ|| 4.77 || gṛhaprāsādavidyābhūgokūpaprāṇahāṭakam|| etānyuttamadānāni uttamadravyadānataḥ|| 4.78 || annārāmaṃ ca vāsāṃsi hayaprabhṛtivāhanam|| dānāni madhyamānīti madhyamadravyadānataḥ|| 4.79 || upānacchatrapātrādidadhimadhvāsanāni ca|| 1.2.4.80 || dīpakāṣṭhopalādīni caramaṃ bahuvārṣikam|| iti kānīyasānyāhurdānanāśatrayaṃ śrṛṇu|| 4.81 || yaddattvā tapyate paścādāsuraṃ taddhṛthā matam|| aśraddhayā yaddadāti rākṣasaṃ syādvṛthaiva tat|| 4.82 || yaccākruśya dadātyaṃga dattvā vākrośati dvijam|| paiśācaṃ tadvṛthā dānaṃdānanāśāstrayastvamī|| 4.83 || iti saptapadairbaddhaṃ dānamāhātmya muttamam|| śaktyā te kīrtitaṃ rājansādhu vā'sādhu vā vada|| 4.84 || ||dharmavarmovāca|| adya me śaphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ|| adya te kṛtakṛtyo'smi kṛtaḥ kṛtimatāṃ vara|| 4.85 || paṭhitvā sakalaṃ janma brahmacāri yathā vṛthā|| bahukleśātprāptabhāryaḥ sāvṛthā'priyavādinī|| 4.86 || kleśena kṛtvā kūpaṃ vā sa ca kṣārodako vṛthā|| bahukleśairjanma nītaṃ vinā dharmaṃ tathā vṛthā|| 4.87 || evaṃ me yadvṛthā nāma jātaṃ tatsaphalaṃ tvayā|| kṛtaṃ tasmānnamastubhyaṃ dvijebhyaśca namonamaḥ|| 4.88 || satyamāha purā viṣṇuḥ kumārānviṣṇusadbhani|| 4.89 || nāhaṃ tathādbhi yajamānahavirvitānaścayotadghṛtaplutamadanhutabhuṅmukhena|| yadbrāhmaṇasya mukhataścaratonughāsaṃ tuṣṭasya mayyavahitairnijakarmapākaiḥ|| 1.2.4.90 || tanmayā'śarmaṇā vāpi yadvipreṣvapriyaṃ kṛtam|| sarvasya prabhavo viprāstatkṣamatāṃ prasādaye|| 4.91 || tvaṃ ca kosi na sāmānyaḥ praṇamyāhaṃ prasādaye|| ātmānaṃ khyāpaya mune proktaścetyavravaṃ tadā|| 4.92 || ||nārada uvāca|| nārado'smi nṛpaśreṣṭha sthānakārthī samāgataḥ|| proktaṃ ca dehi me dravyaṃ bhūmiṃ ca sthānahetave|| 4.93 || yadyapīyaṃ devatānāṃ bhūmirdravyaṃ ca pārthiva|| tathāpi yasminyaḥ kāle rājā prārthyaḥ sa niścitam|| 4.94 || sahīśvarasyāvatāro bharttā dātā'bhayasya saḥ|| tathaiva tvāmahaṃ yāce dravyaśuddhipsayā|| pūrva mamālayaṃ dehi deyārthe prārthanāparaḥ|| 4.95 || ||rājovāca|| yadi tvaṃ nārado vipra rājyamastvakhilaṃ tava|| ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇānāṃ te dāsyaṃ kartā na saṃśayaḥ|| 4.96 || ||nārada uvāca|| yadyasmākaṃ bhavānbhaktastatte kāryaṃ ca no vacaḥ|| 4.97 || sarvaṃ yattaddehi me dravyamuktaṃ bhuvaṃ ca me saptagavyūtimātrām|| bhūyāttvattopyasya rakṣeti so'pi mene tvahaṃ ciṃtaye cārthaśeṣam|| 4.98 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumāri kākhaṇḍe nāradārjunasaṃvāde dānabhedapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4 || cha ||
<1.2.5>
|| nārada uvāca|| tato'haṃ dharmavarmāṇaṃ procya tiṣṭheddhanaṃ tvayi|| kṛtyakāle grahīṣyāmītyāgamaṃ raivataṃ girim|| 5.1 || āsaṃ pramuditaścāhaṃ paśyaṃstaṃ girisattamam|| āhvayānaṃ narānsādhūnbhūmerbhujamivocchritam|| 5.2 || yasminnānāvidhā vṛkṣāḥ prakāśaṃte samaṃtataḥ|| sādhuṃ gṛhapatiṃ prāpya putrabhāryādayo yathā|| 5.3 || muditā yatra saṃtṛptā vāśaṃte kokilādayaḥ|| sadgurorjñānasaṃpannā yathā śiṣyagaṇā bhuvi|| 5.4 || yatra taptvā tapo martyā yathepsitamavāpnuyuḥ|| śrīmahādevamāsādya bhakto yadvanmanoratham|| 5.5 || tasyāhaṃ ca gireḥ pārtha samāsādya mahāśilām|| śītasaurabhyamaṃdena prīṇīto'ciṃtayaṃ hṛdi|| 5.6 || tāvanmayā sthānamāptaṃ yadatīva sudurlabham|| idānīṃ brāhmaṇārthe'haṃ kurve tāvadupakramam|| 5.7 || brāhmaṇāśca vilokya me ye hi pātratamā matāḥ|| tathā hi cātra śrūyaṃte vacāṃsi śrutivādinām|| 5.8 || na jalottaraṇe śaktā yadvannauḥ karṇavarjitā|| tadvacchreṣṭho'pyanācāro vipro noddharaṇakṣamaḥ|| 5.9 || brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati|| tasmai havyaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate|| 1.2.5.10 || dānapātramatikramya yadapātre pradīyate|| taddattaṃ gāmatikramya gardabhasya gavāhnikam|| 5.11 || ūṣare vāpitaṃ bījaṃ bhinnabhāṃḍe ca goduham|| bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ mūrkhe dānamaśāśvatam|| 5.12 || vidhihīne tathā'pātre yo dadāti pratigraham|| na kevalaṃ hi tadyāti śeṣaṃ puṇyaṃ praṇaśyati|| 5.13 || bhūrāptā gaustathā bhogāḥ suvarṇaṃ dehameva ca|| aśvaścakṣustathā vāso ghṛtaṃ tejastilāḥ prajāḥ|| 5.14 || ghnaṃti tasmādavidvāṃstu bibhiyācca pratigrahāt|| svalpaka kenāpyavidvāṃstu paṃke gauriva sīdati|| 5.15 || tasmādye gūḍhatapaso gūḍhasvādhyāyasādhakāḥ|| svadāraniratāḥ śāṃtāsteṣu dattaṃ sadā'kṣayam|| 5.16 || deśe kāla upāyena dravyaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam|| pātre pradīyate yattatsakalaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam|| 5.17 || na vidyayā kevalayā tapasā vāpi pātratā|| yatra vṛttimime cobhe tadvi pātraṃ pracakṣate|| 5.18 || teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye ca vidyā mukhyo mahāguṇaḥ|| vidyāṃ vināṃdhavadviprāścakṣuṣmaṃto hi te matāḥ|| 5.19 || tasmāccakṣuṣmato vidvāndeśe deśe parīkṣayet|| praśrānye mama vakṣyaṃti tebhyo dāsyāmyahaṃ tataḥ|| 1.2.5.20 || iti saṃciṃtya manasā tasmāddeśātsamutthitaḥ|| āśrameṣu maharṣīṇāṃ vicarāmyasmi phālguna|| 5.21 || imāñchlokāngāyamānaḥ praśrarūpāñchṛṇuṣva tān|| mātṛkāṃ ko vijānāti katidhā kīdṛśākṣarām|| 5.22 || paṃcapaṃcādbhutaṃ gehaṃ ko vijānāti vā dvijaḥ|| bahurūpāṃ striyaṃ kartumekarūpāṃ ca vatti kaḥ|| 5.23 || ko vā citrakathābaṃdhaṃ vetti saṃsāragocaraḥ|| ko vārṇavamahāgrāhaṃ vetti vidyāparāyaṇaḥ|| 5.24 || ko vāṣṭavidhaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ vetti brāhmaṇasattamaḥ|| yugānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ vā ko mūladivasānvadet|| 5.25 || caturdaśamanūnāṃ vā mūlavāsaraṃ vetti kaḥ|| kasmiṃścaiva dine prāpa pūrvaṃ vā bhāskaro ratham|| 5.26 || udvejayati bhūtāni kṛṣṇāhirivavetti kaḥ|| ko vāsminghorasaṃsāre dakṣadakṣatamo bhavet|| 5.27 || paṃthānāvapi dvau kaścidvetti vakti ca brāhmaṇaḥ|| iti me dvādaśa praśrānye vidurbrāhmaṇottamāḥ|| 5.28 || te me pūjyatamāsteṣāmahāmārādhakaściram|| ityahaṃ gāyamāno vai bhramitaḥ sakalāṃ mahīm|| 5.29 || te cāhurduḥkhadāḥ khyātāḥ praśrāste kurmahe namaḥ|| ityahaṃ sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ viciṃtyālabdhabrāhmaṇaḥ|| 1.2.5.30 || himādriśikharāsīno bhūyaściṃtāmavāptavān|| sarve vilokitā viprāḥ kimataḥ kartumutsahe|| 5.31 || tato me ciṃtayānasya punarjātāmatistviyam|| adyāpi na gataścāhaṃ kalāpagrāmamuttamam|| 5.32 || yasminviprāḥ saṃvasaṃti mūrtānīva tapāṃsi ca|| caturāśītisāhasrāḥ śrutādhyayanaśālinaḥ|| 5.33 || sthāne tasmingamiṣyāmītyuktvāhaṃ calitastadā|| khecaro himamākramya paraṃ pāraṃ gatastataḥ|| 5.34 || adrākṣaṃ puṇyabhūmisthaṃ grāmaratnamahaṃ mahat|| śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamākulam|| 5.35 || yatra puṇyavatāṃ saṃti śataśaḥ pravarāśramāḥ|| sarveṣāmapi jīvānāṃ yatrānyonyaṃ na duṣṭatā|| 5.36 || yajñabhājāṃ munīnāṃ yadupakārakaraṃ sadā|| satāṃ dharmavatāṃ yadvadupakāro na śāmyati|| 5.37 || munīnāṃ yatra paramaṃ sthānaṃ cāpyavināśakṛt|| svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārahantakāro na naśyati|| 5.38 || yatra kṛtayugastārthaṃ bījaṃ pārthāvaśiṣyate|| sūryasya somavaṃśasya brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca|| 5.39 || sthānakaṃ tatsamāsādya praviṣṭo'haṃ dvijāśramān|| tatra te vividhānvādānvivadaṃte dvijottamāḥ|| 1.2.5.40 || parasparaṃ ciṃtayānā vedā mūrtidharā yathā|| tatra medhāvinaḥ kecidarthamanyaiḥ prapūritam|| 5.41 || vicikṣipurmahātmāno nabhogatamivāmiṣam|| tatrā haṃ karamudyamya prāvocaṃ pūryatāṃ dvijāḥ|| 5.42 || kākārāvaiḥ kimatairvo yadyasti jñānaśālitā|| vyākurudhvaṃ tataḥ praśrānmama durviṣahānbahūn|| 5.43 || ||brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ|| vada brāhmaṇa praśrānsvāñchrutvā''dhāsyāmahe vayam|| paramo hyeṣa no lābhaḥ prakṣānpṛcchati yadbhavān|| 5.44 || ahaṃ pūrvikayā te vai nyaṣedhaṃta parasparam|| ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamiti vīrā yathā raṇe|| 5.45 || tatastānbravaṃ praśrānahaṃ dvādaśa pūrvakān|| śrutvā te māmavo caṃta līlāyaṃto munīśvarāḥ|| 5.46 || kiṃ te dvija bālapraśnairamībhiḥ svalpakairapi|| asmākaṃ yannihīnaṃ tvaṃ manyase sa bravītvamūn|| 5.47 || tatoti vismitaścāhaṃ manyamānaḥ kṛtārthatām|| teṣāṃ nihīnaṃ saṃciṃtya prāvocaṃ prabravītvayam|| 5.48 || tataḥ sutanunāmā sa bālo'bālo'bhyuvāca mām|| mama maṃdāyate vāṇī praśnaiḥ svalpaistava dvija|| tathāpi vacmi māṃ yasmānnihīnaṃ manyate bhavān|| 5.49 || ||sutanuruvāca|| akṣarāstu dvipaṃ cāśanmātṛkāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 1.2.5.50 || oṃkāraḥ prathamastatra caturdaśa svarāstathā|| sparśāścaiva trayastriṃ śadanusvārastathaiva ca|| 5.51 || visarjjanīyaśca paro jihvāmūlīya eva ca|| upadhmānīya evāpi dvipaṃcāśadamī smṛtāḥ|| 5.52 || iti te kathitā saṃkhyā arthaṃ caiṣāṃ śrṛṇu dvija|| asminnarthe ceti hāsaṃ tava vakṣyāmi yaḥ purā|| 5.53 || mithilāyāṃ pravṛtto'bhūdbrāhmaṇasya niveśane|| mithilāyāṃ purā puryāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kauthumābhidhaḥ|| 5.54 || yena vidyāḥ prapaṭhitā vartaṃte bhuvi yā dvija|| ekatriṃśatsahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ sa kṛtādaraḥ|| 5.55 || kṣaṇamapyanavacchinnaṃ paṭhitvā gehavānabhūt|| tataḥ kenāpi kālena kauthumasyābhavatsutaḥ|| 5.56 || jaḍavadvarttamānaḥ sa mātṛkāṃ pratyapadyata|| paṭhitvā mātṛkāmanyannādhyeti sa kathaṃcana|| 5.57 || tataḥ pitā khinnarūpī jaḍaṃ taṃ samabhāṣata|| adhīṣva putrakādhīṣva tava dāsyāmi modakān|| 5.58 || athānyasmai pradāsyāmi karṇāvutpāṭayāmi te|| 5.59 || ||putra uvāca|| tāta kiṃ modakārthāya paṭhyate lobhahetave|| paṭhanaṃnāma yatpuṃsāṃ parāmārthaṃ hi tatsmṛtam|| 1.2.5.60 || ||kauthuma uvāca|| evaṃ te vadamānasya āyurbhavatu brahmaṇaḥ|| sādhvī buddhiriyaṃ te'stu kuto nādhyeṣyataḥ param|| 5.61 || ||putra uvāca|| tāta sarvaṃ parijñeyaṃ jñānamatraiva vai yataḥ|| tataḥ paraṃ kaṃṭhaśoṣaḥ kimarthaṃ kriyate vada|| 5.62 || ||pitovāca|| vicitraṃ bhāṣase bāla jñāto'trārthaśca kastvayā|| brūhi brūhi punarvatsa śrotumicchāmi te giram|| 5.63 || ||putra uvāca|| ekatriṃśatsahasrāṇi paṭhitvāpi tvayā pitaḥ|| nānātarkānbhrāṃtireva saṃdhitā manasisvake|| 5.64 || ayamayaṃ cāyamiti dharmo yo darśanoditaḥ|| teṣu vātāyate cetastava tannāśayāmi te|| 5.65 || upadeśaṃ paṭhasyeva naivārthajño'si tattvataḥ|| pāṭhamātrā hi ye viprā dvipadāḥ paśavo hi te|| 5.66 || tatte bravīmi tadvākyaṃ mohamārtaṃḍamadbhutam|| 5.67 || akāraḥ kathito brahmā ukāro viṣṇurucyate|| makāraśca smṛto rudrastrayaścaite guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 5.68 || ardhamātrā ca yā mūrdhni paramaḥ sa sadāśivaḥ|| evamoṃkāramāhātmyaṃ śrutireṣā sanātanī|| 5.69 || oṃkārasya ca māhātmyaṃ yāthātmyena na śakyate|| varṣāṇāmayutenāpi graṃthakoṭibhireva vā|| 1.2.5.70 || punaryatsārasarvasvaṃ proktaṃ tacchrūyatāṃ param|| aḥkārāṃtā akārādyā manavaste caturdaśa|| 5.71 || svāyaṃbhuvaśca svārocirauttamo raivatastathā|| tāmasaścākṣuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭhastathā vaivasvato'dhunā|| 5.72 || sāvarṇirbrahmasāvarṇī rudrasāvarṇireva ca|| dakṣasāvarṇirevāpi dharmasāvarṇireva ca|| 5.73 || raucyo bhautyastathā cāpi manavo'mī caturdaśa|| śvetaḥ pāṃḍustathā raktastāmraḥ pītaśca kāpilaḥ|| 5.74 || kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmastathā dhūmraḥ supiśaṃgaḥ piśaṃgakaḥ|| trivarṇaḥ śabalo varṇaiḥ karkaṃdhura iti kramāt|| 5.75 || vaivasvataḥ kṣakāraśca tāta kṛṣṇaḥ pradṛśyate|| kakārādya hakārāṃtāstrayastriṃśacca devatāḥ|| 5.76 || kakārādyāṣṭhakārāṃtā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ|| dhātā mitro'ryamā śakro varuṇāścāṃśureva ca|| 5.77 || bhago vivasvānpūṣā ca savitā daśamastathā|| ekādaśastathā tvaṣṭā viṣṇurdvādaśa ucyate|| 5.78 || jaghanyajaḥ sa sarveṣāmādityānāṃ guṇādhikaḥ|| ḍakārādyā bakārāṃtā rudrāścaikādaśaiva tu|| 5.79 || kapālī piṃgalo bhīmo virupākṣo vilohitaḥ|| ajakaḥ śāsanaḥ śāstā śaṃbhuścaṇḍo bhavastathā|| 1.2.5.80 || bhakārādyāḥ ṣakārāṃtā aṣṭau hi vasavo matāḥ|| dhruvo ghoraśca somaśca āpaścaiva nalo'nilaḥ|| 5.81 || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca aṣṭau te vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ|| sau haścetyaśvinau khyātau trayastriṃśadime smṛtāḥ|| 5.82 || anusvāro visargaśca jihvāmūlīya eva ca|| upadhmānīya ityete jarāyujāstathāṃḍajāḥ|| 5.83 || svedajāścodbhijāśceti tata jīvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| bhāvārthaḥ kathitaścāyaṃ tattvārthaṃ śrṛṇu sāṃpratam|| 5.84 || ye pumāṃsastvamūndevānsamāśritya kriyāparāḥ|| ardhamātrātmake nitye pade līnāsta eva hi|| 5.85 || caturṇāṃ jīvayonīnāṃ tadaiva parimucyate|| yadābhūnmanasā vācā karmaṇā ca yajetsurān|| 5.86 || yasmiñchāstre tvamī devā mānitā naiva pāpibhiḥ|| tacchāstraṃ hi na maṃtavyaṃ yadi brahmā svayaṃ vadet|| 5.87 || amī ca devāḥ sarvatra śraute mārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ|| pāṣaṇḍaśāstre sarvatra niṣiddhāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ|| 5.88 || tadamūnye vyatikramya tapo dānamatho japam|| prakurvaṃti durātmāno vepate marutaḥ pathi|| 5.89 || aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ paśyatāvijitātmanām|| paṭhaṃti mātṛkāṃ pāpā manyaṃte na surāniha|| 1.2.5.90 || ||sutanuruvāca|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā pitābhūdativismitaḥ|| papraccha ca bahūnpraśrānsopya vādīttathātathā|| 5.91 || mayāpi tava prokto'yaṃ mātṛkāpraśra uttamaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ śrṛṇu taṃ praśnaṃ paṃcapaṃcādbutaṃ gṛham|| 5.92 || paṃcabhūtāni pañcaiva karmajñāneṃdriyāṇi ca|| paṃca paṃcāpi viṣayā manobuddhyahameva ca|| 5.93 || prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva pañcaviṃśaḥ sadāśivaḥ|| pañcapañcabhiretataistu niṣpannaṃ gṛhamucyate|| 5.94 || dehametadidaṃ veda tattvato yātyasau śivam|| bahurūpāṃ striyaṃ prāhurbuddhiṃ vedāṃtavādinaḥ|| 5.95 || sā hi nānārthabhajanānnānārūpaṃ prapadyate|| dharmasyaikasya saṃyogādbahudhāpyekikaiva sā|| 5.96 || iti yo vede tattvārthaṃ nāsau narakamāpnuyāt|| munibhiryaśca na proktaṃ yanna manyeta daivatān|| 5.97 || vacanaṃ tadbudhāḥ prahurbaṃdhaṃ citrakathaṃ tviti|| yacca kāmānvitaṃ vākyaṃ paṃcamaṃ vāpyataḥ śruṇu|| 5.98 || eko lobho mahāngrāho lobhātpāpaṃ pravartate|| lobhātkrodhaḥ prabhavati lobhātkāmaḥ pravartate|| 5.99 || lobhānmohaśca māyā ca mānaḥ stambhaḥ pareṣsutā|| avidyā'prajñatā caiva sarvaṃ lobhātpravartate|| 1.2.5.100 || haraṇaṃ paravittānāṃ paradārābhimarśanam|| sāhasānāṃ ca sarveṣāmakāryāṇaāṃ kriyāstathā|| 5.101 || sa lobhaḥ saha mohena vijetavyo jitātmanā|| dambho drohaśca niṃdā ca paiśunyaṃ matsarastathā|| 5.102 || bhavantyetāni sarvāṇi lubdhānāmakṛtātmanām|| sumahāṃ tyapi sāstrāṇi dhārayaṃti bahuśrutāḥ|| 5.103 || chettāraḥ saṃśayānāṃ ca lobhagrastā vrajaṃtyadhaḥ|| lobhakrodhaprasaktāśca śiṣṭācārabahiṣkṛtāḥ|| 5.104 || antaḥkṣurā vāṅmadhurāḥ kūpāśdhannāstṛṇauriva|| kurvate ye bahūnmārgāṃstāṃstānhetubalanvitāḥ|| 5.105 || sarvamārgaṃ viluṃmapaṃti lobhājjātiṣu niṣṭhurāḥ|| dharmāvataṃsakāḥ kṣudrā muṣṇaṃti dhvajino jagat|| 5.106 || ete'tipāpino jñeyā nityaṃ lobhasamanvitāḥ|| janako yuvanāśvaśca vṛṣādarbhiḥ prasenajit|| 5.107 || lobhakṣayāddivaṃ prāptāstathaivānye janādhipāḥ|| tasmāttyajaṃti ye lobhaṃ te'tikrāmaṃti sāgaram|| 5.108 || saṃsārākhyamato'naye ye grāhagrastā na saṃśayaḥ|| atha brāhmaṇabhedāṃstvamaṣṭo viprāvadhāraya|| 5.109 || mātraśca brāhmaṇaścaiva śrotriyaśca tataḥ param|| anūcānastathā bhrūṇa ṛṣikalpa ṛṣirmuniḥ|| 1.2.5.110 || ete hyaṣṭau samuddiṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ prathamaṃ śrutau|| teṣāṃ paraḥ paraḥ śreṣṭho vidyāvṛttaviśeṣataḥ|| 5.111 || brāhmaṇānāṃ kule jāto jātimātro yadā bhavet|| anupetaḥ kriyāhīno mātra ityabhidhīyate|| 5.112 || ekoddeśyamatikramya vedasyācāravānṛjuḥ|| sa brāhmaṇa iti prokto nibhṛtaḥ satyavāgghṛṇī|| 5.113 || ekāṃ śākhāṃ sakalpāṃ ca ṣaḍbhiraṃgairadhītya ca|| ṣaṭkarmanirato vipraḥ śrotriyonāma dharmavit|| 5.114 || vedavedāṃgatattvajñaḥ śuddhātmā pāpavarjitaḥ|| śreṣṭhaḥ śrotriyavānprājñaḥ so'nūcāna iti smṛtaḥ|| 5.115 || anūcānaguṇopeto yajñasvādhyāyayaṃtritaḥ|| bhrūṇa ityucyate śiṣṭaiḥ śeṣabhojī jiteṃdriyaḥ|| 5.116 || vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ caiva sarvajñānamavāpya yaḥ|| āśramastho vaśī nityamṛṣikalpa iti smṛtaḥ|| 5.117 || ūrdhvaretā bhavatyagryo niyatāśī nasaṃśa yī|| śāpānugrahayoḥ śaktaḥ satyasaṃdho bhavedṛṣiḥ|| 5.118 || nivṛttaḥ sarvatattvajñaḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ|| dhyānasthāniṣkriyo dāṃtastulyamṛtkāṃcano muniḥ|| 5.119 || evamanvayavidyābhyāṃ vṛttena ca samucchritāḥ|| triśuklānāma vipreṃdrāḥ pūjyante savanādiṣu|| 1.2.5.120 || ityevaṃvidhavipratvamuktaṃ śrṛṇu yugādayaḥ|| navamī kārtike śuklā kṛtādiḥ parikīrtitā|| 5.121 || vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā yā śuklā tretādirucyate|| māghe pañcadaśīnāma dvāparādiḥ smṛtā budhaiḥ|| 5.122 || trayodaśī nabhasye ca kṛṣṇā sā hi kaleḥ smṛtā|| yugādayaḥ smṛtā hyetā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ|| 5.123 || etāścatasrastithayo yugādyā dattaṃ hutaṃ cākṣayamāśu vidyāt|| yugeyuge varṣaśatena dānaṃ yugādikāle divasena tatphalam|| 5.124 || yugādyāḥ kathitā hyetā manvādyāḥ śrṛṇu sāṃpratam|| aśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtike tathā|| 5.125 || tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca|| phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā|| 5.126 || āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī|| śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā|| 5.127 || kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jyeṣṭhe pañcadaśī sitā|| manvaṃtarādayaścaitā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ|| 5.128 || yasyāṃ tithau rathaṃ pūrvaṃ prāpa devo divākaraḥ|| sā tithiḥ kathitā viprairmāghe yā rathasaptamī|| 5.129 || tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ sarvamevākṣayaṃ matam|| sarvadāridryaśamanaṃ bhāskaraprītaye matam|| 1.2.5.130 || nityodvejakamāhuryaṃ budhāstaṃ śrṛṇu tattvataḥ|| yaśca yācaniko nityaṃ na sa svargasya bhājanam|| 5.131 || udvejayati bhūtāni yathā caurāstathaiva saḥ|| narakaṃ yāti pāpātmā nityodvegakarastvasau|| 5.132 || ihopapattirmama kena karmaṇā kva ca prayātavyamito mayeti|| vicārya caivaṃ pratikārakārī budhaiḥ sa cokto dvija dakṣadakṣaḥ|| 5.133 || māsairaṣṭabhirahnā ca pūrveṇa vayasāyuṣā|| tatkarma puruṣaḥ kuryādyenāṃte sukhamedhate|| 5.134 || arcirdhūmaśca mārgau dvāvāhurvedāṃtavādinaḥ|| arciṣā yāti mokṣaṃ ca dhūmenāvartate punaḥ|| 5.135 || yajñairāsādyate dhūmo naiṣkarmyeṇārcirāpyate|| etayoraparo mārgaḥ pākhaṃḍa iti kīrtyate|| 5.136 || yo devānmanyate naiva dharmāṃśca manusūcitān|| naitau sa yāti paṃthānau tattvārtho'yaṃ nirūpitaḥ|| 5.137 || ite te kīrtitāḥ praśrāḥ śaktyā brāhmaṇasattama|| sādhu vā'sādhu vā brūhī khyāpayātmānameva ca|| 5.138 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kalāpagrāmavāsisutanubrāhmaṇena nāradapraśnottarakathanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5 || cha ||
<1.2.6>
||śrīnārada uvāca|| iti śrutvā phālgunāhaṃ romāṃcapulakīkṛtaḥ|| svarūpaṃ prakaṭīkṛtya brāhmaṇānidamabravam|| 6.1 || aho dhanyaḥ pitāsmākaṃ yasya sṛṣṭasya pālakāḥ|| yuṣmadvidhā brāhmaṇeṃdrāḥ satyamāha purā hariḥ|| 6.2 || matto'pyanaṃtātparataḥ parasmātsamastabhūtādhipaterna kiṃcit|| teṣāṃ kimusyāditareṇa yeṣāṃ dvijeśvarāṇāṃ mama mārgavādinām|| 6.3 || tatsarvathādyā dhanyo'smi saṃprāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam|| yadbhavanto mayā dṛṣṭāḥ pāpopadravavarjitāḥ|| 6.4 || tataste sahasotthāya śātātapapurogamāḥ|| arghyapādyādisatkāraiḥ pūjayāmāsurmāṃ dvijāḥ|| 6.5 || proktavantaśca māṃ pārtha vacaḥ sādhujano citam|| dhanyā vayaṃ hi devarṣe tvamasmānyadihāgataḥ|| 6.6 || kuto vā''gamanaṃ tubhyaṃ gantavyaṃ vā kva sāṃpratam|| atrāpyāgamane kāryamucyatāṃ munisattama|| 6.7 || śrutvā prītikaraṃ vākyaṃ dvijānāmiti pāṃḍava|| pratyavocaṃ munīndrāṃstāñchrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ|| 6.8 || ahaṃ hi brahmaṇo vākyādviprāṇāṃ sthānakaṃ śubham|| dātukāmo mahātīrthe mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 6.9 || parīkṣanbrāhmaṇānatra prāpto yūyaṃ parīkṣitāḥ|| ahaṃ vaḥ sthāyiṣyāmi cānujānīta taddvijāḥ|| 1.2.6.10 || evamukto vilokyaiva dvijāñchātātapo'bravīt|| devānāmapi duṣprāpyaṃ satyaṃ nārada bhāratam|| 6.11 || kiṃ punaścāpi tatraiva mahī sāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| yatra snāto mahātīrthaphalaṃ sarvamupāśnute|| 6.12 || punareko mahāndoṣo bibhīmo nitarāṃ yataḥ|| tatra caurāḥ subahavo nirghṛṇāḥ priyasāhasāḥ|| 6.13 || svarśeṣu ṣoḍaśaṃ caikaviṃśaṃgṛhṇaṃti no dhanam|| dhanena tena hīnānāṃ kīdṛśaṃ janma no bhavet|| 6.14 || varaṃ bubhukṣayā vāso mā caurakaragā vayam|| ||arjuna uvāca|| adbhutaṃ varṇyate vipra ke hi caurāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 6.15 || kiṃ dhanaṃ ca haraṃtyete yebhyo bibhyati brāhmaṇāḥ|| ||nārada uvāca|| kāmakrodhādayaścaurāstapa eva dhanaṃ tathā|| 6.16 || tasyāpahābhītāste māmūcuriti brāhmaṇāḥ|| tānahaṃ prābravaṃ paścādvi jānīta dvijottamāḥ|| 6.17 || jāgratāṃ tu manuṣyāṇāṃ caurāḥ kurvaṃti kiṃ khalāḥ|| bhayabhītaścālasaśca tathā cāśucireva yaḥ|| 6.18 || tena kiṃ nāma saṃsādhyaṃ bhūmistaṃ grasate naram|| 6.19 || ||śātātapa uvāca|| vayaṃ caurabhayādbhītāste haraṃti dhanaṃ mahat|| kartuṃ tadā kathaṃ śakyamaṃgajāgaraṇaṃ tathā|| 1.2.6.20 || khalāścaurā gatāḥ kvāpi tato natvā''gatā vayam|| tasmāsarvaṃ saṃtyajāmo bhayabhītā vayaṃ mune|| 6.21 || pratigrahaśca vai ghoraḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃ'śaphaladastathā|| evaṃ bruvati tasmiṃśca hārītonāma cābravīt|| 6.22 || mūḍhabuddhyā hi ko nāma mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| tyajecca yatra mokṣaśca svargaśca karago'tha vā|| 6.23 || kalāpādiṣu grāmeṣu ko vaseta vicakṣaṇaḥ|| yadi vāsaḥ stambhatīrthe kṣaṇārdhamapi labhyate|| 6.24 || bhayaṃ ca caurajaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati tatra na|| kumāranāthaṃ manasi pālakaṃ kurvatāṃ dṛḍham|| 6.25 || sāhasaṃ ca vinā bhūtirna kathaṃcana prāpyate|| tasmānnārada tatrāhamā yāsye tava vākyataḥ|| 6.26 || ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi brāhmaṇā me parigrahe|| ṣaṭkarmaniratāḥ śuddhā lobhadambhavivarjitāḥ|| 6.27 || taiḥ sārdhamāgamiṣyāmi mamedaṃ matamuttamam|| ityukte vacane tāṃśca kṛtvāhaṃ daṃḍamūrdhani|| 6.28 || nivṛttaḥ sahasā pārtha khecaro'timudānvitaḥ|| śatayojanamātraṃ tu himamārgamatītya ca|| 6.29 || kedāraṃ samupāyāto yuktastairdvijasattamaiḥ|| ākāśena suśakyaśca bilenātha sa deśakaḥ|| 1.2.6.30 || atikrāṃtuṃ nānyathā ca tathā skaṃdaprasādataḥ|| 6.31 || ||arjuna uvāca|| kva kalāpaṃ ca dgrāmaṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ bilena ca|| kathaṃ skaṃdaprasādaḥ syādetanme brūhi nārada|| 6.32 || ||nārada uvāca|| kedārāddhimasaṃyuktaṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ smṛtam|| tadaṃte yojanaśataṃ vistṛtaṃ tatkalāpakam|| 6.33 || tadaṃte yojanaśataṃ vāsukārṇava mucyate|| śatayojanamātraḥ sa bhūmisvargastataḥ smṛtaḥ|| 6.34 || bilena ca yathā śakyaṃ gaṃtuṃ tatra śrṛṇuṣva tat|| nirannaṃ vai nirudakaṃ devamārādhayedguham|| 6.35 || dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi tato niṣpāpaṃ manyate yadā|| tadā guho'sya svapne gaccheti bhārata|| 6.36 || tato guhātpaścimato bilamasti bṛhattaram|| tatra praviśya gaṃtavyaṃ kramāṇāṃ śatasaptakam|| 6.37 || tatra mārakataṃ liṃgamasti sūryasamaprabham|| tadagre mṛttikā cāsti svarṇavarṇā sunirmalā|| 6.38 || namaskṛtya ca talliṃgaṃ gṛhītvā mṛttikāṃ ca tām|| āgaṃtavyaṃ staṃbhatīrthe samārādhya kumārakam|| 6.39 || kolaṃ vā kūpato grāhyaṃ bhūtāyāṃ niśi tajjalam|| tenodakena mṛttikayā kṛtvā netradvayāñjanam|| 1.2.6.40 || udvartanaṃ ca dehasya kadācitṣaṣṭime pade|| netrāṃjanaprabhāvācca bilaṃ paśyati śobhanam|| 6.41 || tanmadhyena tato yāti gātrodvarttaprabhāvataḥ|| kārīṣairnāma cātyugrairbhakṣyate naiva kīṭakaiḥ|| 6.42 || bilamadhye ca saṃpaśyansiddhānbhāskarasannibhān|| yātyevaṃ yātyasau pārtha kalāpaṃ grāmamuttamam|| 6.43 || tatra varṣasahasrāṇi catvāryāyuḥprakīrtitam|| phalānāṃ bhojanaṃ ca syātpunaḥ puṇyaṃ ca nārjjayet|| 6.44 || ityetatkathitaṃ tubhyamataścābhūcchṛṇuṣva tat|| tapaḥ sāmarthyataḥ sūkṣmāndaṇḍasyāgre nidhāya tān|| 6.45 || dvijānahaṃ samāyāto mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| 6.46 || tadottārya mayā muktāstīre puṇyajalāśaye|| tato mayā kṛtaṃ snānaṃ saha tairdvijasattamaiḥ|| 6.47 || niḥśeṣadoṣadāvāgnau mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtvā tarpaṇasatkriyāḥ|| 6.48 || japamānāḥ paraṃ japyaṃ niviṣṭāḥ saṃgame vayam|| bhāskaraṃ samavekṣaṃtaściṃtayaṃto hariṃ hṛdi|. 6.49 || tasmiṃścaivāṃtare pārtha devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ|| ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve lokapālāśca saṃgatāḥ|| 1.2.6.50 || devānāṃ yonayo hyaṣṭau gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| mahotsave tatastasmingītavāditra uttame|| 6.51 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ kartuṃ viprāṇāmudyatastvaham|| tasminkāle cāśrṛṇavamahamātithyavākyatām|| 6.52 || sāmadhvanisamāyuktāṃ tṛtīyasvaranāditām|| atīva manaso ramyāṃ śiva bhaktimivottamām|| 6.53 || viprairutthāya saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kastvaṃ vipra kva cāgataḥ|| kiṃ vā prārthayase brūhi yatte manasi rocate|| 6.54 || ||vipra uvāca|| muniḥ kapilanāmāhaṃ nāradāya nivedyatām|| āgataḥ prārthanāyaiva tacchrutvāhamathābravam|| 6.55 || dhanyohaṃ yadihāyātaḥ kapila tvaṃ mahāmune|| nāstyadeyaṃ tavāsmābhiḥ pātraṃ nāsti tavādhikam|| 6.56 || ||kapilā uvāca|| brahmaputra tvayā deyaṃ yadi me tvaṃ śrṛṇuṣva tat|| aṣṭau viprasahasrāmi mama dehīti nārada|| 6.57 || bhūmidānaṃ kariṣyāmi kalāpagrāmavāsinām|| brāhmaṇānāmahaṃ caiṣāṃ tadidaṃ kriyatāṃ vibho|| 6.58 || tato mayā pratijñātameva mastu mahāmune|| tvayāpi kriyatāṃ sthānaṃ kāpilaṃ kapilottamam|| 6.59 || śrāddhe vā prāptakāle vā hyatithirvimukhībhavet|| yasyāśramamupāyātasyasya sarvaṃ hi niṣphalam|| 1.2.6.60 || sa gacchedrauravām̐llokānyo'tithiṃ nābhipūjayet|| atithiḥ pūjito yena sa devairapi pūjyate|| 6.61 || dānairyajñaista tastasminbhojitaḥ kapilo muniḥ|| tato mahāmuniḥ śrīmānhārīto hvayitastadā|| 6.62 || pādaprakṣālanārthāya siddhadevasamāgame|| hārītaśca puraskṛtya vāmapādaṃ tadā sthitaḥ|| 6.63 || tato hāso mahāñjajñe siddhāpsaraḥ suparvaṇām|| viciṃtya bahudhā pṛthvīṃ sādhu sādhukṛtā dvijāḥ|| 6.64 || tato mamāpi manasi śokavego mahānabhūt|| satyāṃ caiva tathā mene gāthāṃ pūrvabudheritām|| 6.65 || sarveṣvapi ca kāryeṣu hetiśabdo vigarhitaḥ|| kurvatāmatikāryāṇi śilāpāto dhruvaṃ bhavet|| 6.66 || tatohamabraṃvaṃ viprānyūyaṃ mūrkhā bhaviṣyatha|| dhanadhānyālpasaṃyuktā dāridryakalilāvṛtāḥ|| 6.67 || evamukte prahasyaiva hārītaḥ prābravīdidam|| tavaiveyaṃ mune hāniryadasmāñchapate bhavān|| 6.68 || kaḥ śāpo dīyate tubhyaṃ śāpoyamayameva te|| tato vimṛśya bhūyo'habravaṃ kimahaṃdvija|| 6.69 || tathāvidhasya bhavato vāmapādapradānataḥ|| 1.2.6.70 || ||hārīta uvāca|| śrṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ dhīmañchūnyatā me yato bhavet|| 6.71 || iti ciṃtayataścitte hā duḥkho'yaṃ pratigrahaḥ|| pratigraheṇa viprāṇāṃ brāhayaṃ tejo hi śāmyati|| 6.72 || mahādānaṃ hi gṛhṇāno brāhmaṇaḥ svaṃ śubhaṃ hi yat|| dadāti dāturdātā ca aśubhaṃ yacchati svakam|| 6.73 || dātā pratigrahītā ca vacanaṃ hi parasparam|| manyate'dhaḥkaro yasya so'lpabuddhiḥ prahīyate|| 6.74 || iti ciṃtayato mahyaṃ śūnyatābhūddhi nārada|| nidrārtaśca bhayārtaśca kāmārtaḥ śokapīḍitaḥ|| 6.75 || hṛtasvaścānyacittaśca śūnyāhyete bhavaṃti ca|| tadeṣu matimānkopaṃ na kurvīta yadi tvayā|| 6.76 || kṛtaḥ kopastatastubhyamevaṃ hāniriyaṃ mune|| tatastāpānvitaścāhaṃ tānvi prānabravaṃ punaḥ|| 6.77 || dhiṅmāmastu ca durbuddhimavimṛśyārthakāriṇam|| kurvatāmavimṛśyaiva tatkimasti na yadbhavet|| 6.78 || sahasā na kriyāṃ kuryātpadametanmahāpadām|| vimṛśyakāriṇaṃ dhīraṃ vṛṇate sarvasaṃpadaḥ|| 6.79 || satyamāha mahābuddhiścirakārī purā hi saḥ|| purā hi brāhmaṇaḥ kaścitprakhyātoṃ girasāṃ kule|| 1.2.6.80 || cirakāri mahāprājño gautamasyābhavatsutaḥ|| cireṇa sarvakāryāṇi yo vimṛśya prapadyate|| 6.81 || cirakāryābhisaṃpateścirakārī tathocyate|| alasagrahaṇaṃ prāpto durmedhāvī tathocyate|| 6.82 || buddhilāghavayuktena janenādīrghadarśinā|| vyabhicāreṇa kasminsa vyatikamyā parānsutān|| 6.83 || pitroktaḥ kupitenātha jahīmāṃ jananīmiti|| sa tatheti cireṇoktaḥ svabhāvāccirakārakaḥ|| 6.84 || vimṛśya cirakāritvācciṃ tayāmāsa vai ciram|| piturājñāṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ na hanyāṃ mātaraṃ katham|| 6.85 || kathaṃ dharmacchalenāsminnimajjeyamasādhuvat|| piturājñā paro dharmo hyadharmo mātṛrakṣaṇam|| 6.86 || asvataṃtraṃ ca putratvaṃ kiṃ tu māṃ nātra pīḍayet|| striyaṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet|| 6.87 || pitaraṃ cāpyavajñāya kaḥ pratiṣṭhāmavāpnuyāt|| anavajñā pituryuktā yuktaṃ mātuśca rakṣaṇam|| 6.88 || kṣamāyogyāvubhāvetau nātivarteta vai katham|| pitā hyātmānamādhatte jāyāyāṃ jajñivāniti|| 6.89 || śīlacāritragotrasya dhāraṇārthaṃ kulasya ca|| so'hamātmā svayaṃ pitrā putratve parikalpitaḥ|| 1.2.6.90 || jātakarmaṇi yatprāha pitā yaccopakarmaṇi|| paryāptaḥ sa dṛḍhīkāraḥ piturgauravalipsayā|| 6.91 || śarīrādīni deyāni pitā tvekaḥ prayaccati|| tasmātpiturvacaḥ kāryaṃ na vicāryaṃ kathaṃcana|| 6.92 || pātakānyapi cūryaṃte piturvacanakāriṇaḥ|| pitā svargaḥ pitā dharmaḥ pitā paramakaṃ tapaḥ|| 6.93 || pitari prītimāpanne sarvāḥ prīṇaṃti devatāḥ|| āśiṣastā bhajaṃtyenaṃ puruṣaṃ prāha yāḥ pitā|| 6.94 || niṣkṛtiḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pitā yadabhinaṃdati|| mucyate baṃdhanātpuṣpaṃ phalaṃ vṛṃtātpramucyate|| 6.95 || kliśyannapi sutaḥ snehaṃ pitā snehaṃ na muṃcati|| etadviciṃtyataṃ tāvatputrasya pitṛgauravam|| 6.96 || pitā nālpataraṃ sthānaṃ ciṃtayiṣyāmi mātaram|| yo hyayaṃ mayi saṃghāto martyatve pāṃcabhautikaḥ|| 6.97 || asya me jananī hetuḥ pāvakasya yathāraṇiḥ|| mātā dehāraṇiḥ puṃsaḥ sarvasyārthasya nirvṛtiḥ|| 6.98 || mātṛlābhe sanāthatvamanāthatvaṃ viparyaye|| na sa śocati nāpyenaṃ sthāvaryamapi karṣati|| 6.99 || śriyā hīno'pi yo gehe aṃbeti pratipadyate|| putrapautrasamāpanno jananīṃ yaḥ samāśritaḥ|| 1.2.6.100 || api varṣaśatasyāṃte sa dvihāyanavaccaret|| samarthaṃ vā'samarthaṃ vā kṛśaṃ vāpyakṛśaṃ tathā|| 6.101 || rakṣayecca sutaṃ mātā nānyaḥ poṣyavidhānataḥ|| tadā sa vṛddho bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ|| 6.102 || tadā śunyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate|| nāsti mātṛsamā cchāyā nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ|| 6.103 || nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇaṃ nāsti mātṛsamā prapā|| kukṣisaṃdhāraṇāddhātrī jananājjananī tathā|| 6.104 || aṃgānāṃ vardhanādaṃbā vīrasūtve ca vīrasūḥ|| śiśoḥ śuśrūṣaṇācchvaśrūrmātā syānmānanāttathā|| 6.105 || devatānāṃ samāvāpamekatvaṃ pitaraṃ viduḥ martyānāṃ devatānāṃ ca pūgo nātyeti mātaram|| 6.106 || patitā guravastyājyā mātā ca na kathaṃcana|| garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ tena mātā garīyasī|| 6.107 || evaṃ sa kauśikītīre baliṃ rājānamīkṣatīm|| strīvṛttiṃ cirakālatvāddhantuṃ diṣṭaḥ svamātaram|| 6.108 || vimṛśya cirakālaṃ hi ciṃtāṃtaṃ nābhyapadyata|| etasminnaṃtare śakro rūpamāsthitaḥ|| 6.109 || gāyangākhāmupāyātaḥ pitustasyāśramāṃtike|| anṛnā hi striyaḥ sarvāḥ sūtrakāro yadabravīt|| 1.2.6.110 || atastābhyaḥ phalaṃ grāhyaṃ na syāddoṣekṣaṇaḥ sudhīḥ|| iti śrutvā tamānarca medhātithirudāradhīḥ|| 6.111 || duḥkhitaściṃtayanprāpto bhṛśamaśrūṇi vartayan|| aho'hamīrṣyayākṣipto magno'haṃ duḥkhasāgare|| 6.112 || hatvā nārīṃ ca sādhvīṃ ca ko nu māṃ tārayiṣyati|| satvareṇa mayājñaptaścirakārī hyudāradhīḥ|| 6.113 || yadyayaṃ cirakārī syātsa māṃ trāyeta pātakāt|| cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika|| 6.114 || yadadya cirakārī tvaṃ tato'si cirakārikaḥ|| trāhi māṃ mātaraṃ caiva tapo yaccārjitaṃ mayā|| 6.115 || ātmānaṃ pātake viṣṭaṃ śubhāhva cirakārika|| evaṃ sa duḥkhitaḥ prāpto gautamo'ciṃtayattadā|| 6.116 || cirakārikaṃ dadarśātha putraṃ māturupāṃtike|| cirakārī tu pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaduḥkhitaḥ|| 6.117 || śastraṃ tyaktvā sthito mūrdhnā prasādāyopacakrame|| medhātithiḥ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śirasā patitaṃ bhuvi|| 6.118 || patnīṃ caiva tu jīvaṃtīṃ parāmabhyagamanmudam|| hanyāditi na sā veda śastrapāṇau sthite sute|| 6.119 || buddhirāsītsutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pituścaraṇayornatam|| śastragrahaṇacāpalyaṃ saṃvṛṇoti bhayāditi|| 1.2.6.120 || tataḥ pitrā ciraṃ smṛtvā ciraṃ cāghrāya mūrdhani|| ciraṃ dorbhyāṃ pariṣvajya ciraṃjīvetyu dāhṛtaḥ|| 6.121 || ciraṃ mudānvitaḥ putraṃ medhātithirathābravīt|| cirakārika bhadraṃ te cirakārī bhavecciram|| 6.122 || cirāya yatkṛtaṃ saumya ciramasmin duḥkhitaḥ|| gāthāścāpyabravīdvidvāngautamo munisattamaḥ|| 6.123 || cireṇa maṃtraṃ saṃdhīyāccirema ca kṛtaṃ tyajet|| cireṇa vihataṃ mitraṃ ciraṃ dhāraṇamarhati|| 6.124 || roge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi|| apriye caiva kartavye cirakārī praśasyate|| 6.125 || baṃdhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ caiva bhṛtyānāṃ strījanasya ca|| avyakteṣvaparādheṣu cirakārī praśasyate|| 6.126 || ciraṃ dharmānniṣeveta kuryāccānveṣaṇaṃ ciram|| ciramanvāsya viduṣaściramiṣṭānupāsya ca|| 6.127 || ciraṃ vinīya cātmānaṃ ciraṃ yātyanavajñatām|| bruvataśca parasyāpi vākyaṃ dharmopasaṃhitam|| 6.128 || ciraṃ pṛcchecca śrṛṇuyācciraṃ na paribhūyate|| dharme śatrau śastrahaste pātre ca nikaṭasthite|| 6.129 || bhaye ca sādhupūjāyāṃ cirakārī na śasyate|| evamuktvā putrabhāryāsahitaḥ prāpya cāśramam|| 1.2.6.130 || tataściramupāsyātha divaṃ yātiściraṃ muniḥ|| vayaṃ tvevaṃ bruvanto'pi mohenaivaṃ pratāritāḥ|| 6.131 || kalau ca bhavatāṃ viprā macchāpo nipatiṣyati|| kecitsadā bhaviṣyaṃti viprāḥ sarvaguṇairyutāḥ|| 6.132 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā tato'haṃ dharmavarmaṇaḥ|| samīpe sākṣiṇo devānkṛtvā saṃkalpamācaram|| 6.133 || kāṃcanairarnopradānaiśca gṛhadānairdhanādibhiḥ|| bhāryābhūṣaṇavastraiśca kṛtārthā brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ|| 6.134 || tataḥ karaṃ samudyamya prāhendro devasaṃgame|| harāṃgaruddhavāmārddha yāvaddevī gireḥ sutā|| 6.135 || gaṇādhīśo vayaṃ yāvadyāvattribhuvanaṃ tvidam|| tāvannandyādide sthānaṃ nāradasthāpitaṃ surāḥ|| 6.136 || brahmaśāpo rudraśāpo viṣṇuśāpastathaiva ca|| dvijaśāpastathā bhūyādidaṃ sthānaṃ viluṃpataḥ|| 6.137 || tatastatheti taiḥ sarvairhṛṣṭaistatra tathoditam|| evaṃ mayā sthāpite sthānake'sminsaṃsthāpayāmāsa ca kāpilaṃ muniḥ|| sthāne ubhe devakṛte prasannāstato yayurdevatā devasadma|| 6.138 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe nārīyasthānapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || cha ||
<1.2.7>
|| arjuna uvāca|| mahīsāgaramāhātmyamadbhutaṃ kīrtitaṃ tvayā|| vismayaḥ paramo mahyaṃ praharṣaścopajāyate|| 7.1 || tadahaṃ vistarācchrotumidamicchāmi nārada|| kasya yajñe mahī glānā vahnitāpābhitā pitā|| 7.2 || ||nārada uvāca|| mahādākhyānamākhyāsye yathā jātā mahīnadī|| śrṛṇvannetāṃ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyamāpsyasi pāṃḍava|| 7.3 || purābhūdbhūpatirbhūmāvindradyumna iti śrutaḥ|| vadānyaṛ sarvadharmajño mānyo mānayitā prabhuḥ|| 7.4 || ucitajño vivekasya nivāso guṇasāgaraḥ|| na tadasti dharāpṛṣṭhe nagaraṃ grāmapattanam|| 7.5 || tadīyapūrtadharmasya cihnena na yadaṃkitam|| kanyādānāni bahudhā brāhmeṇa vidhinā vyadhāt|| 7.6 || bhūpā lo'sau dadau dānamāsahasrāddhanārthinām|| daśamīdivase rātrau gajapṛṣṭhena dundubhiḥ|| 7.7 || tāḍyate tatpure prātaḥ kāryamekādaśīvratam|| yajvanā tena bhūpena vicchinnaṃ somapāyinām|| 7.8 || svaraṇairāstṛtā darbhairdvyagulotsedhitā mahī|| gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā dhārā varṣato divi tārakāḥ|| 7.9 || śakyā gaṇayituṃ prājñaistadīyaṃ sukṛtaṃ na tu|| īdṛśaiḥ sukṛtaireṣa tenaiva vapuṣā nṛpaḥ|| 1.2.7.10 || dhāma prajāpateḥ prāpto vimānena kurūdvaha|| bubhuje sa tadā bhogāndurlabhānamarairapi|| 7.11 || atha kalpaśatasyāṃte vyatīte taṃ mahīpatim|| prāha prajāpatiḥ sevāvasarāyātamātmanaḥ|| 7.12 || ||brahmovāca|| iṃdradyumna drutaṃ gaccha dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ nṛpottama|| na stātavyaṃ madīyedya loke kṣaṇamapi tvayā|| 7.13 || ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| kasmādbrahmannito bhūmau māṃ preṣayasi samprati|| sati puṇye madīye tu bahule vada kāraṇam|| 7.14 || ||brahmovāca|| na puṇyaṃ kevalaṃ rājanguptaṃ svargasya sādhakam|| vinā niṣkalmaṣāṃ kīrti trilokītalavistṛtām|| 7.15 || tava kīrtisamucchedaḥ sāṃprataṃ vasudhātale|| saṃjātaścirakālena gatvā tāṃ kuru nūtanām|| 7.16 || yadi vāṃchā mahīpāla mama dhāmani saṃsthitau|| 7.17 || ||indradyumna uvāca|| madīyaṃ sukṛtaṃ brahmankathaṃ bhūmau bhavediti|| kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā naitanmama cetasi tiṣṭhati|| 7.18 || ||brahmovāca|| balavāneṣa bhūpāla kālaḥ kalayati svayam|| 7.19 || brahmāṃḍānyapi māṃ caiva gaṇanā kā bhavādṛśām|| tadetadeva manye'haṃ tava bhūpāla sāṃpratam|| 1.2.7.20 || yatkīrtimātmano vyaktiṃ nītvābhye hi punardivam|| śuśruvāniti vācaṃ sa brahmaṇaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ|| 7.21 || paśyatisma tathātmānaṃ mahītalamupāgatam|| kāṃpilyanagare bhūyaḥ papracchātmānamātmanā|| 7.22 || nagaraṃ sa tadā deśamaprākṣīditi vismitaḥ|| ||janā ūcuḥ|| na jānīmo vayaṃ bhūpamiṃdradyumnaṃ na tatpuram|| 7.23 || yattvaṃ pṛcchasi bho bhadra kañcitpṛccha cirāyuṣam|| ||indradyumna uvāca|| kaḥ saṃprati dharāpṛṣṭhe cirāyuḥ prathito janāḥ|| 7.24 || pṛthivījayarājyesminyatra prabūta mā ciram|| ||janā ūcuḥ|| śrūyate naimivāraṇye saptakalpasmaro muniḥ|| 7.25 || mārkaṃḍeya iti khyātastaṃ gatvā pṛccha saṃśayam|| tathopadiṣṭastairgatvā tatra taṃ munipuṃgavam|| 7.26 || niśamya praṇipatyāha nṛpaḥ svahṛdayasthitam|| ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| cirāyurbhagavānbhūmau viśrutaḥ sāṃprataṃ tataḥ|| 7.27 || pṛcchāmyahaṃ bhavānvetti iṃdradyumnaṃ nṛpaṃna vā|| 7.28 || ||śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca|| saptakalpāntare nābhūtkopīṃdradyumnasaṃjñitaḥ|| bhūpāla kimahaṃ vacmi tavānyatpṛccha saṃśayam|| 7.29 || sa nirāśastadākarṇya vaco bhūpognisādhane|| samudyogaṃ tadā cakre taṃ dṛṣṭvāha tadā muniḥ|| 1.2.7.30 || ||mārkaṃḍeya uvāca|| mā sāhasamidaṃ kārṣīrbhadra vācaṃ śrṛṇuṣva me|| eti jīvaṃtamānaṃdo naraṃ varṣaśatādapi|| 7.31 || tatkaromi pratīkāraṃ tava duḥkhopaśāṃtaye|| śrṛṇu bhadra mamāstīha bako mitraṃ ciraṃtanaḥ|| 7.32 || nāḍījaṃgha iti khyātaḥ sa tvā jñāsyatyasaṃśayam|| tasmādehi drutaṃ yāvadāvāṃ tatra vrajāvahe|| 7.33 || paropakāraikaphalaṃ jīvitaṃ hi mahātmanām|| yadi jñāsyatyasaṃdigdhamiṃdradyumnaṃ sa vakṣyati|| 7.34 || tau prasthitāviti tadā vipreṃdranṛpapuṃgavau|| himācalaṃ prati prītau nāḍījaṃghā layaṃ prati|| 7.35 || bako'tha mitraṃ svaṃ vīkṣya cirakālādupāgatam|| mārkaṃḍeyaṃ yayau prītyutkaṃṭhitaḥ sammukhaṃ dvijaiḥ|| 7.36 || kṛtasaṃvidabhūtpūrvaṃ kuśalasvāgatādinā|| papracchānaṃtaraṃ kāryaṃ vadāgamanakāraṇam|| 7.37 || mārkaṃḍeyotha taṃ prāha bakaṃ prastutamīpsitam|| iṃdradyumnaṃ bhavānvetti bhūpālaṃ pṛthivītale|| 7.38 || etasya mama mitrasya tena jñātena kāraṇam|| no vāyaṃ tyajati prāṇānpurā vahnipraveśanāt|| 7.39 || etasya prāṇarakṣārthaṃ brūhi jānāsi cennṛpam|| 1.2.7.40 || ||naḍījaṃgha uvāca|| caturdaśa smarāmyasmi kalpānvipreṃdra sāṃpratam|| āstāṃ taddarśanaṃ vārtāmapi vā na smarāmyaham|| 7.41 || iṃdradyumno mahīpālaḥ ko'pi nāsīnmahītale|| etāvanmātramevāhaṃ jānāmi dvijapuṃgava|| 7.42 || ||nārada uvāca|| tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭastasyāyuriti śuśruvān|| papraccha rājā ko heturdānasya tapaso'tha vā|| yadāyurīdṛśaṃ dīrghaṃ saṃjātamiti vismitaḥ|| 7.43 || ||nāḍījaṃgha uvāca|| ghṛtakaṃbalamāhātmyānmama devasya śūlinaḥ|| dīrghamāyuridaṃ vipra śāpādbakavapuḥ śrṛṇu|| 7.44 || purā janmanyahaṃ bālo brāhmaṇasyābhavaṃ bhuvi|| pārāśaryasagotrasya viśvarūpasya sanmuneḥ|| 7.45 || bālako baka ityevaṃ pratīto'tipriyaḥ pituḥ|| capalo'tīva bālatve nisargādeva bhadraka|| 7.46 || atha mārakataṃ liṃgaṃ devatāvasarātpituḥ|| cāpalyādvālabhāvāccāpahṛtya nihitaṃ mayā|| 7.47 || ghṛtasya kuṃbhe saṃkrāṃtau makarasyottarāyaṇe|| atha prātarvyatītāyāṃ niśi yāvatpitā mama|| 7.48 || nirmālyāpanayaṃ cakre tāvacchūnyaṃ śivālayam|| niśamya kāṃdiśīko māṃ papraccha madhurasvaram|| 7.49 || vatsa kva nu tvayā liṃgaṃ nūnaṃ vinihitaṃ vada|| dāsyāmi vāṃchitaṃ yatte bhakṣyamanyattavepsitam|| 1.2.7.50 || tato mayā bālabhāvādbhakṣyalubdhena tatpituḥ|| ghṛtakuṃbhāṃtarākṛṣya bhadraliṃgaṃ samarpitam|| 7.51 || atha kāle tu saṃprāpte pramīto'haṃ nṛpālaye|| jāto jātismārastāvadānartādhipateḥ sutaḥ|| 7.52 || ghaॉtakaṃbalamāhātmyānmakarasthe divākare|| api bālyādavajñānātsaṃyogādghṛtaliṃgayoḥ|| 7.53 || tataḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ prāgjanma smaratā mayā|| tataḥ prabhṛti liṃgāni ghṛtenācchādayāmyaham|| 7.54 || pitṛpaitāmahaṃ prāpya rājyaṃ śaktyanurūpataḥ|| tataḥ prasanno bhagavānpārvatīpatirāha mām|| 7.55 || pūrvajanmani tuṣṭo'haṃ ghṛtakaṃbalapūjayā|| prayacchāmyasmi ta rājyamadhunābhimataṃ vṛṇu|| 7.56 || tato mayā vṛtaḥ prādādgāṇapatyaṃ madīpsitam|| kailāse māṃ śivo nityaṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāha ceti ca|| 7.57 || tenaiva hi śarireṇa praṇataṃ purataḥ sthitam|| adyaprabhṛti saṃkrāṃtau makarasyāparopi yaḥ|| 7.58 || ghṛtena pūjāṃ kartāsau bhāvī mama gaṇaḥ sphuṭam|| ityuktvā māṃ śivo bhadra gaṇakoṭīśvaraṃ vyadhāt|| 7.59 || pratīpapālakaṃnāma saṃsthitaṃ śivaśāsanam|| tataḥ kāmādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ padaiścaṃkramaṇātmikām|| 1.2.7.60 || nisargacapalāṃ prāpya bhramarīmiva tāṃ śriyam|| naivālamabhavaṃ tasyā dhāraṇe daivayogataḥ|| 7.61 || vicacāra tadā mattaḥ kilāhaṃ vāraṇo yathā|| kṛtyākṛtyavicāreṇa vimukto'tīva garvitaḥ|| 7.62 || vidyāmabhijanaṃ lakṣmīṃ prāpya nīcanaro yathā|| āpadāṃ pātratāmeti siṃdhūnāmiva sāgaraḥ|| 7.63 || atha kāle vyatikrāṃte kiyanmātre yadṛcchayā|| vicarannagamaṃ śailaṃ himānīruddhakaṃdaram|| 7.64 || tapasyati munistatra gālavo bhāryayā saha|| sadaiva tīvratapasā kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ|| 7.65 || brāhmaṇasya hi dehoyaṃ naivaihikaphalapriyaḥ|| kṛcchrāya tapase ceha pretyānaṃtasukhāya ca|| 7.66 || tasya bhāryā'tirūpeṇa vijigye viśvavarṇinī|| tanvī śyāmā mṛgākṣī sā pīnonnatapayodharā|| 7.67 || haṃsagadgadasaṃbhāṣā mattamātaṃgagāminī|| vistīrṇajaghanā madhye kṣāmā dīrghaśiroruhā|| 7.68 || nimnanābirvidhātraiṣā nirmitā saṃdidṛkṣuṇā|| vikīrṇamiva sauṃdaryamekapātramiva sthitam|| 7.69 || tato'vinītastāṃ vīkṣya bhadra gālavavallabhām|| ahamāsaṃ śaravrātaistāḍitaḥ puṣpadhanvinā|| vivekino'pi munayastāvadeva vivekinaḥ|| 1.2.7.70 || yāvanna hariṇākṣīṇāmapāṃgavivarekṣitāḥ|| mayā vyavasitaṃ citte tadānīṃ tāṃ jihīrṣuṇā|| 7.71 || iti ceti hariṣyāmi tapasā rakṣitāṃ muneḥ|| asyāḥ kṛte yadi śapenmunistatra parābhavaḥ|| 7.72 || mama bhāvī bhavedeṣā bhāryā mṛtyurutāpi me|| tasmācchiṣyo bhavāmyasya śuśrūṣānirato muneḥ|| 7.73 || prāpyāṃtaraṃ hariṣyāmi nāsya yogyeyamaṃganā|| iti vyavasya vidyārthimūrtimāsthāya gālavam|| 7.74 || namaskṛtya vaco'vocamiti bhāvyarthanoditaḥ|| tathā matistathā mitraṃ vyavasāyastathā nṛṇām|| 7.75 || bhavedavaśyaṃ tadbhāvi yathā puṃbhiḥ purā kṛtam|| vivekavairāgyayuto bhagavaṃstvāsamupasthitaḥ|| 7.76 || śiṣyo'haṃ bhavatā pāṭhyaṃ karṇadhāraṃ mahāmunim|| apārapāradaṃ viṣṇuṃ vipramūrtimupāśritam|| 7.77 || namasye cetanaṃ brahmā pratyakṣaṃ gālavākhyayā|| avidyākṛṣṇasarpeṇa daṣṭaṃ tadviṣapīḍitam|| 7.78 || upadeśamahāmaṃtrairmāṃ jāṃgulika jīvaya|| mahāmohamahā vṛkṣo hṛdyāvāpasamutthitaḥ|| 7.79 || tvadvākyatīkṣṇadhāreṇa kuṭhāreṇa kṣayaṃ vrajet|| apavargapathavyāpī mūḍhasaṃsargasecanaḥ|| 1.2.7.80 || chidyatāṃ sūtradhāreṇa vidyāparaśunādhunā|| bhajāmi tava śiṣyo'haṃ varivasyāparaściram|| 7.81 || samiddarbhānmūlaphalaṃ dārūṇi jalameva ca|| āhariṣye'nugṛhṇīṣva vinītaṃ māmupasthitam|| 7.82 || itthaṃ purā bakābhikhyaṃ bakavṛttimupāśritam|| tadā''rjave kṛtamatiranujagrāha māṃ muniḥ|| 7.83 || tato'tīva vinīto'haṃ bhūtvā taṃ brāhmaṇīyutam|| viśvāsanāya sudṛḍhaṃ toṣayāmi dinedine|| 7.84 || sa ca jānanmuniḥ patnīṃ pātrabhūtāmaviśvasan|| strīcaritravidaṃke tāṃ vidhāya svapiti dvijaḥ|| 7.85 || athānyasmindine sābhūdbrāhmaṇyatha rajasvalā|| taddṛraśāyinī rātrau viśvāsānme tapasvinī|| 7.86 || idamantaramityaṃtārviciṃtyāhaṃ praharṣitaḥ|| malimlucākṛtirbhūtvā niśīthe tāmathāharam|| 7.87 || vilalāpa tadā bālā hriyamāṇā mayoccakaiḥ|| maivaṃ maivamiti jñātvā māṃ svareṇābravīnmunim|| 7.88 || bakavṛttirayaṃ duṣṭo dharmakaṃcukamāśritaḥ|| harate māṃ durācārastasmāttvaṃ trāhi gālava|| 7.89 || tava śiṣyaḥ purā bhūtvā kopveṣodya malimlucaḥ|| māṃ jihīrṣati tadrakṣa śaraṇya śaraṇaṃ bhava|| 1.2.7.90 || tadvākyasamakālaṃ sa prabuddho gālavo muniḥ|| tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti māmuktvā gatistambhaṃ vyadhānmama|| 7.91 || tataścitrākṛtikahaṃ stambhito muninā'bhavam|| vrīḍitaṃ praviśāmīva svāṃgāni kila lajjayā|| 7.92 || tataḥ prakupitaḥ pāha māmabhyetyātha gālavaḥ|| tadvajraduḥsahaṃ vākyaṃ yenāhamabhavaṃ bakaḥ|| 7.93 || ||gālava uvāca|| bakavṛttimupāśritya vaṃcito'ha yatastvayā|| tasmādbakastvaṃ bhavitā cirakālaṃ narādhama|| 7.94 || iti śapto'hamabhavaṃ muninā'dharmamāśritaḥ|| paradāropasevārthamanarthamimamāgataḥ|| 7.95 || na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃcana vidyate|| yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāro pasevanam|| 7.96 || tataḥ satī sā matsparśadvaṣitāṃgī tapasvinī|| mayā vimuktā snātvā māṃ tathaivānuśaśāpa ha|| 7.97 || evaṃ tābhyāmahaṃ śapto hyaśvatthaparṇavadbhayāt|| kaṃpamānaḥ praṇamyobhāvavocaṃ tatra dampatī|| 7.98 || gaṇo'hamīśvarasyaiva durvinītataro yuvām|| nirodhamevaṃ kurutaṃ bhagavaṃtāvanugraham|| 7.99 || vāci kṣuro nāvanītaṃ hṛdayaṃ hi dvijanmanām|| prakupyaṃti prasīdaṃti kṣaṇenāpi prasāditāḥ|| 1.2.7.100 || tvayi vipratipannasya tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama|| bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmirevāvalaṃbanam|| 7.101 || gaṇādhipatyamapi me jātaṃ paribhavāspadam|| vipadaṃtā hi jāyante durvinītasya sampadaḥ|| 7.102 || vidureṣyaddhiyā'pāyaṃ parato'nye vivekinaḥ|| naivobhayaṃ vidurnīcā vinā'nubhavamātmanaḥ|| 7.103 || durvīnītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryameva vā|| na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ sthāne yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ|| 7.104 || vidyāmado dhanamadastṛtīyo'bhijano madaḥ|| ete madā madāṃdhānāmeta eva satāṃ damāḥ|| 7.105 || nodarkaśālinī buddhiryeṣāmavijitātmanām|| taiḥ śriyaścapalā vācyaṃ nīyaṃte mādṛśairjanaiḥ|| 7.106 || tatprasīda muniśreṣṭha śāpāṃtaṃ me'dhunā kuru|| durvinīteṣvapi sadā kṣamācārā hi sādhavaḥ|| 7.107 || itthaṃ vacasi vijñapte vinītenāpi vai mayā|| prasādapravaṇo bhūtvā śāpāṃtaṃ me tadā vyadhāt|| 7.108 || ||gālava uvāca|| channakīrtisamuddhārasahāyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi|| yadendradyumnabhūpasya tadā mokṣamavāpsyasi|| 7.109 || ityahaṃ muniśāpena tadāprabhṛti parvate|| himācale bako bhūtvā kāśyapeyo vasāmi ca|| 1.2.7.110 || rājyaṃ cirāyuriti me ghṛtakambalasya jātismaratvamadhunāpi tathānu bhāvān|| śāpādbakatvamabhavanmunigālavasya tadbhadra sarvamuditaṃ bhavatādya pṛṣṭam|| 7.111 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe mahīprādurbhāve saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7 || cha ||
<1.2.8>
||nārada uvāca|| nāḍījaṃghabakenoktāṃ vācamākarṇyabhūpatiḥ|| mārkaṃḍeyena saṃyukto babhūvātīva duḥkhitaḥ|| 8.1 || taṃ niśamya munirbhūpaṃ duḥkhitaṃ sāśrulocanam|| samānavyasanaḥ prāha tadarthaṃ sa punarbakam|| 8.2 || vidhāyāśāṃ mahābhāga tvadaṃtikamupāgatau|| āvāṃ cirāyurjñātāṃśāvindradyumnamiti dvija|| 8.3 || niṣpannaṃ nāsya tatkāryaṃ prāṇāneṣa mumukṣati|| vahnipraveśena paraṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāgataḥ|| 8.4 || tanmāmupāgato'haṃ ca tvāṃ siddhaṃ nāsya vāṃchitam|| tadenamanuyāsyāmi maraṇena tvayā śape|| 8.5 || āśāṃ kṛtvābhyupāyātaṃ nirāśaṃ nekṣituṃ kṣamāḥ|| bhavaṃti sādhavastasmājjīvitānmaraṇaṃ varam|| 8.6 || prārthitaṃ cāmunā hṛtsthaṃ mayā cāsmai pratiśrutam|| tvāṃ mitraṃ tatparijñāne dhṛtvā hṛdi cirāyuṣam|| 8.7 || asaṃpādayato nārthaṃ pratijñātaṃ mamāyuṣā|| kaluṣeṇārthinā māśāpūrakeṇa sakhedhunā|| 8.8 || pratiśrutaṃ kṛtaṃ ślāghyā dāsatāṃtyajapakvaṇe|| hariścaṃdrasyeva nṛṇāṃ na ślāghyā satyasaṃdhatā|| 8.9 || mitrasnehasya paryāyastacca sāptapadaṃ smṛtam|| snehaḥ sa kīdṛśo mitre duḥkhito yo na dṛśyate|| 1.2.8.10 || tadavaśyamahaṃ sākamadhunā vahnisādhanam|| kariṣye kīrtivapuṣaḥ kṛte satyamidaṃ sakhe|| 8.11 || anujānīhi māmetaddarśanaṃ tava paścimam|| tvayā saha mahābhāga nāḍījaṃgha dvijottama|| 8.12 || ||nārada uvāca|| vajravadduḥsahāṃ vācaṃ mārkaṃḍeyasamīritām|| śuśruvānsa kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā pratītaḥ prāha tāvubhau|| 8.13 || ||nāḍījaṃgha uvāca|| yadyevaṃ tadidaṃ mitraṃ viśaṃtaṃ jvalane'dhunā|| nivāraya muniśreṣṭha matto'sti cirajīvitaḥ|| 8.14 || prākārakarṇanāmāsāvulūkaḥ śivaparvate|| sa jñāsyati mahīpālamiṃdradyumnaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 8.15 || tasmādahaṃ tvayā sārdhamamunā ca śivālayam|| vrajāmi taṃ śikhariṇaṃ mitrakāryaprasiddhaye|| 8.16 || ityeva muktvā te jagmustrayo'pi dvijapuṃgavāḥ|| kailāsaṃ dadṛśustatra tamulūkaṃ svanīḍagam|| 8.17 || kṛtasaṃvidasau tena bakaḥ svāgatapūjayā|| pṛṣṭaśca tāvubhau prāha tatsarvamabhivāṃchitam|| 8.18 || cirāyurasi jānīṣe yadīndradyumnabhūpatim|| tadbrūhi tena jñānena kāryaṃ jīvāmahe vayam|| 8.19 || iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa vimanā mitrakāryaprasādhanāt|| kauśikaḥ prāha jānāmi nendradyumnamahaṃ nṛpam|| 1.2.8.20 || aṣṭāviṃśatpramāṇā me kalpā jātasya bhūtale|| na dṛṣṭo na śruto vāsāviṃdradyumno nṛpaḥ kṣitau|| 8.21 || tacchrutvā vismito bhūpastasyāyuratimātrataḥ|| duḥkhito'pi tadā hetuṃ papracchāsau tadāyuṣaḥ|| 8.22 || evamāyuryadi tava kathaṃ prāptaṃ bravīhi tat|| ulūkatvaṃ kathamidaṃ jugupsitamatīva ca|| 8.23 || ||prākārakarṇa uvāca|| śrṛṇu bhadra yathā dīrghamāyurmeśivapūjanāt|| jugupsitamulūkatvaṃ śāpena ca mahāmuneḥ|| 8.24 || vasiṣṭhakulasaṃbhūtaḥ purāhamabhavaṃ dvijaḥ|| ghaṃṭa ityabhivikhyāto vārāṇasyāṃ śiverataḥ|| 8.25 || dharmaśravaṇaniṣṭhasya sādhūnāṃ saṃsadi svayam|| śrutvāsmi pūjayāmīśaṃ bilvapatrairakhaṃḍitaiḥ|| 8.26 || na mālatī na maṃdāraḥ śatapatraṃ na mallikā|| tathā priyāṇi śrīvṛkṣo yathā madanavidviṣaḥ|| 8.27 || akhaṃḍabilvapatreṇa ekena śivamūrdhani|| nihitena naraiḥ puṇyaṃ prāpyate lakṣapuṣpajam|| 8.28 || akhaṃḍitairbilvapatraiḥ śraddhayā svayamāhṛtaiḥ|| liṃgaprapūjanaṃ kṛtvā varṣalakṣaṃ vaseddivi|| 8.29 || sacchāstrebhya iti śrutvā pūjayāmyahamīśvaram|| trikālaṃ śraddhayā patraiḥ śrīvṛkṣasya tribhistribhiḥ|| 1.2.8.30 || tato varṣaśatasyāṃte tutoṣa śaśiśekharaḥ|| pratyakṣībhūya māmāha meghagaṃbhīrayā girā|| 8.31 || ||īśvara uvāca|| tuṣṭosmi tava vipreṃdrākhaṃḍabilvadalārcanāt|| vṛṇīṣvābhimataṃ yatte dāsyamyapi ca durlabham|| 8.32 || akhaṃḍabilvapatreṇa mahātuṣṭiḥ prajāyate|| ekanāpi yathānyeṣāṃ tathā na mama koṭibhiḥ|| 8.33 || ityukto'haṃ bhagavatā śaṃbhunā svamanaḥ sthitam|| vṛṇomi sma varaṃ deva kuru māmajarāmaram|| 8.34 || atha līlāvilāso māṃ tathetyuktvā'vicāritam|| yayāvadarśanaṃ prītimahaṃ ca mahatīṃ gataḥ|| 8.35 || kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānamajñāsipamahaṃ kṣitau|| etasminneva kāle tu bhṛguvaṃśyo'bhavaddvijaḥ|| 8.36 || avadātatrijanmāsavakṣaviccākṣarārthavit|| sudarśaneti prathitā priyā tasyābhavatsatī|| 8.37 || atīva muditā patyurmukhaṃ prekṣyāsya darśanāt|| tanayā devalasyaipā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi|| 8.38 || tasyāṃ tasmādabhūtkanyā nirviśeṣā nijāraṇeḥ|| nivṛttabālabhāvābhūtkumārī yauvanonmukhī|| 8.39 || nālaṃ babhūva tāṃ dātuṃ tanayāṃ guṇaśālinīm|| kasyāpi janakaḥ sā ca vayaḥsaṃdhau mayekṣitā|| 1.2.8.40 || praviśdyauvanābhogabhāvairatimanoharā|| nirvāsyamānairaparaistilataṃdulitākṛtiḥ|| 8.41 || krīḍamānā vayasyābhirlāvaṇyapratimeva sā|| vyaciṃtayamahaṃ vipra tāṃ nirīkṣya sumadhyamām|| 8.42 || ananyākṛtimanyo'sau vidhiryeneti nirmitā|| tataḥ sāttvikabhāvānāṃ tatkṣaṇādasmi gocaram|| 8.43 || prāpito līlayāhatya bāṇaiḥ kusumadhanvinā|| tato mayā skhaladvālaṃ pṛṣṭā kasyeti tatsakhī|| 8.44 || prāheti bhṛguvaṃśyasya kanyeyaṃ dvijajanmanaḥ|| anūḍhādyāpi kenāpi samāyātātra khelitum|| 8.45 || tataḥ kusumabāṇena śaravrātairbhṛśaṃ hataḥ|| pitaraṃ praṇato gatvā yayāce tāṃ bhṛgūdvaham|| 8.46 || sa ca māṃ sadṛśaṃ jñātvā śīlena ca kulena ca|| atīva cārthinaṃ mahyaṃ dadau vācā puraḥ kramāt|| 8.47 || tataḥ sā tanayā tasya bhārgavasyā śrṛṇoditi|| dattāsmi tasmai viprāya virūpāyeti jalpatām|| 8.48 || rorūyamāṇā jananīmāha paśya yathā kṛtam|| atīvānucitaṃ dattvā janakena tathā vare|| 8.49 || viṣamāloḍya pāsyāmi pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam|| varaṃ na tu virūpasyodvoḍhurbhāryā kathaṃcana|| 1.2.8.50 || tataḥ saṃbodhya jananī tāṃ sutāmāha bhārgavam|| na deyāsmai tvayā kanyā virūpāyeti cāgrahāt|| 8.51 || sa vallabhāvacaḥ śrutvā dharmaśāstrāṇyavekṣya ca|| dattāmapi haretpūrvāṃ śreyāṃścedvara āvrajet|| 8.52 || arvākchilākramaṇato niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade|| iti vyavasya pradadāvanyasmai tāṃ dvijaḥ sutām|| 8.53 || śvobhāvini vivāhe tu tacca sarvaṃ mayā śrutam|| tatotīva vilakṣyohaṃ vayasyānāṃ purastadā|| 8.54 || nāśakaṃ vadanaṃ bhadra tathā darśayituṃ nijam|| kāmārtotīva tāṃ suptāmarvāgniśi tadāharam|| 8.55 || nītvā durgatamaikāṃte'kārṣamaudvāhikaṃ vidhim|| gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena tato'kārṣaṃ hṛdīpsitam|| 8.56 || anicchaṃtīṃ tadā bālāṃ balātsuratasevanam|| athānupadamāgatya tatpitā prātareva mām|| 8.57 || niśvasya saṃvṛto viprāstāṃ vīkṣyodvāhitāṃ sutām|| śaśāpa kupito bhadra māṃ tadānīṃ sa bhārgavaḥ|| 8.58 || ||bhārgava uvāca|| niśācarasya dharmeṇa yattvayodvāhitā sutā|| tasmānniśācaraḥ pāpa bhava tvamavilaṃbitam|| 8.59 || iti śaptaḥ praṇmyainaṃ pādopagrahapūrvakam|| hāheti ca bruvangāḍhaṃ sāśrunetraṃ sagadgadam|| 1.2.8.60 || tatohamabravaṃ kasmādadoṣaṃ māṃ bhavāniti|| śapate bhavatā dattā mama vācā purā sutā|| 8.61 || sodvāhitā mayā kanyā dānaṃ sakṛditi smṛtiḥ|| sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti paṇḍitāḥ|| 8.62 || sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyaṃte trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt|| kiṃ ca pratiśrutārthasya nirvāhastatsatāṃ vratam|| 8.63 || bhavādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāṃ sādhūnāṃ tasya tyāgo vigarhitaḥ|| pratiśrutā tvayā labdhā tadā kālamiyaṃ mayā|| 8.64 || udvoḍhā cādhunā nāhamucitaḥ śāpabhājanam|| vṛthā śapanti mahyaṃ ca bhavaṃtastadvicāryatām|| 8.65 || yo dattvā kanyakāṃ vācā paścāddharati durmatiḥ|| sa yāti narakaṃ ceti dharmaśāstreṣu niścitam|| 8.66 || tadākarṇya vyavasyāsau tathyaṃ madvacanaṃ hṛdā|| paścāttāpasamopeto munirmāmityathābravīt|| 8.67 || na me syādanyathā vāṇī ulūkastvaṃ bhaviṣyati|| niśācaro hyulūko'pi procyate dvijasattama|| 8.68 || yadeṃdradyumnavijñāne sahāyastaṃva bhaviṣyasi|| tadā tvaṃ prakṛtiṃ vipra prāpsyasītyabravītsa mām|| 8.69 || tadvākyasamakālaṃ ca kauśikatvamidaṃ mama|| etāvaṃti dinānyāsīdaṣṭāviṃśaddinaṃ vidheḥ|| 1.2.8.70 || bilvīdalauriti purā śaśiśekharasya saṃpūjanena mama dīrghataraṃ kilāyuḥ|| saṃjātamatra ca jugupsitamasya śāpātkailāsarodhasi niśācararūpamāsīt|| 8.71 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīnadīprādurbhāve bilvadalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8 || cha ||
<1.2.9>
|| ulūka uvāca|| itidamuktamakhilaṃ pūrvajanmasamudbhavam|| svarūpamāyuṣo hetuḥ kauśikatvasya ceti me|| 9.1 || ityuktvā virate tasminpurūhūtasanāmani|| nāḍījaṃgho bako mitramāha taṃ duḥkhito vacaḥ|| 9.2 || ||nāḍījaṃgha uvāca|| yadarthaṃ vayamāyātāstanna siddhaṃ mahāmate|| kāryaṃ tanmaraṇaṃ nūnaṃ trayāṇāmapyupāgatam|| 9.3 || iṃdradyumnāparijñāne bhadrako'yaṃ mumūrṣati|| tasyānu mitraṃ mārkaṃḍastaṃ cānvahamapi sphuṭam|| 9.4 || mitrakārye vinirvṛtte mriyamāṇaṃ nirīkṣate|| yo mitraṃ jīvitaṃ tasya dhigasnigdhaṃ durātmanaḥ|| 9.5 || tadetāvanuyāsyāmi mriyamāṇāvahaṃ dvija|| āpṛcche tvāṃ namaskāra āśleṣaścāthapaścimaḥ|| 9.6 || pratijñātamaniṣpādya mitrasyābhyāgatasya ca|| kathaṃkāraṃ na lajjaṃte hatāśā jīvitepsavaḥ|| 9.7 || tasmādvahniṃ pravekṣyāmi sārdhamābhyāmasaṃśayam|| āpṛṣṭo'syadhunā snehānmama dehi jalāṃjalim|| 9.8 || ityuktavatyulūko'sau nāḍījaṃghe sagadgadam|| sāśrunetraṃ sthirībhūya prāha vācaṃ sudhāsamucam|| 9.9 || ||ulūka uvāca|| mayi jīvati mitre me bhavānmaraṇameti ca|| adyaprabhṛti kastarhi hṛdā mama labhiṣyati|| 1.2.9.10 || astyupāyo mahānatra gandhamādanaparvate|| mattaścirāyurmitrosti gṛdhraḥ prāṇasamaḥ suhṛt|| 9.11 || sa vijñāsyati vo'bhīṣṭamiṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim|| ityuktvā puratastasthāvulūkaḥ sa ca bhūpatiḥ|| 9.12 || mārkaṃḍeyo bakaścaiva prayayurgaṃdhamādanam|| tamāyāṃtamathālokya vayasyaṃ purataḥ sthitam|| 9.13 || svakulāyātprahṛṣṭo'sau gṛdhraḥ saṃmukhamāyayau|| kṛtasaṃvidasau pūrvaṃ svāgatāsanabhojanaiḥ|| 9.14 || ulūkaṃ gṛdhrarājaśca kāryaṃ papraccha taṃ tathā|| ma cācakhyāvayaṃ mitraṃ bako me'sya muniḥ kila|| 9.15 || munerapi tṛtīyo'yaṃ mitraṃ cārthoyamudyataḥ|| iṃdradyumnaparijñāne svayaṃ jīvati nānyathā|| 9.16 || vahniṃ pravekṣyate vyaktamayaṃ tadanu vai vayam|| mayā niṣiddho'yaṃ jñātvā tvāṃ ciraṃtanamātmanā|| 9.17 || taccejjānāsi taṃ brūhi caturṇāṃ dehi jīvitam|| saraṃ kṣyāpnuhi satkīrtiṃ kṣayaṃ cākhilapāpmanaḥ|| 9.18 || ||gṛdhra uvāca|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśadvyatītā me kalpā jātasya kauśika|| na dṛṣṭo na śruto'smābhiriṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ|| 9.19 || tacchrutvā vismayāviṣṭa iṃdradyumno'pi duḥkhitaḥ|| papracacha jīvite hetumatimātre vihaṃgamam|| 1.2.9.20 || ||gṛdhra uvāca|| śrṛṇu bhadrai purā jāto markaṭo'haṃ ca cāpalaḥ|| āsaṃ kadācidabhavadvasaṃto'tha ṛtuḥ kramāt|| 9.21 || tatrāgre devadevasya vanamadhye śivālaye|| bhavodbhavasya purato jagadyogeśvarābhidhe|| 9.22 || caturdaśīdine hastanakṣatre harṣaṇābhidhe|| yoge caitre site pakṣa āsīddamanakotsavaḥ|| 9.23 || atra sauvarṇyadolāyāṃ liṃga āropite janaiḥ|| niśāyāmadhirūhyā'haṃ dolāṃ tāṃ ca vyacālayam|| 9.24 || nisargājjaticāpalyāccirakālaṃ punaḥpunaḥ|| atha prabhāta āyātā janāḥ pūjākṛte kapim|| 9.25 || dolādhirūḍhamālokya lakuṭairmāṃ vyatāḍayan|| dolāsaṃsthita evāhaṃ pramītaḥ śivamaṃdire|| 9.26 || teṣāṃ prahāraiḥ sudṛḍhairbahubhirvajraduḥsahaiḥ|| śivāṃdolanamāhātmyājjāto'haṃ nṛpamaṃdire|| 9.27 || kāśīśvarasya tanayaḥ pratīto'smi kuśadhvajaḥ|| jāti smarastato rājye kramātprāpyāhamaiśvaram|| 9.28 || kārayāmi dharāpṛṣṭhe caitre damanakotsavam|| yatā yathā dolayati śivaṃ dolāsthitaṃ naraḥ|| 9.29 || tathā tathā'śubhaṃ yāti puṇyamāyāti bhadraka|| śivadīkṣāmupāgamyākhilasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaḥ|| 1.2.9.30 || śivācāryairvimukto'haṃ paśupāśaistadāgamāt|| nirvāhadīkṣāparyaṃtānsaṃskārānprāpya sarvataḥ|| 9.31 || ārādhayāmi deveśaṃ pratyakcittamumāpatim|| samastakleśavicchedakāraṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum|| 9.32 || cittavṛttinirodhena vairāgyābhyāsayogataḥ|| japannudgītamasyārthaṃ bhāvayannaṣṭamaṃ rasam|| 9.33 || tato māṃ praṇidhānenābhyāsena dṛḍhabhūminā|| antarāyānupahataṃ jñātvā tuṣṭo'bravīddharaḥ|| 9.34 || ||īśvara uvāca|| kuśadhvajāhaṃ tuṣṭodya varaṃ varaya vāṃchitam|| na hīdṛśamanuṣṭhānaṃ kasyāpyasti mahītale|| 9.35 || śrutvetyukto mayā śambhurbhūyāsaṃ te gaṃṇo hyaham|| anenaiva śarīreṇa tathetyevāha gāṃ prabhuḥ|| 9.36 || tataḥ kailāsamānīya vimānaṃ mama cādiśat|| sarvaratnamayaṃ divyaṃ divyāścaryasamāvṛtam|| 9.37 || vicarāmi pratīto'haṃ tadārūḍho yadṛcchayā|| atha kāle kiyanmātre vyatīte'traivaṃ parvate|| 9.38 || gavākṣādhiṣṭhito'paśyaṃ vasaṃte munikanyakām|| pravāti dakṣiṇe vāyau madanāgnipradīpitaḥ|| 9.39 || agniveśyasutāṃ bhadra vivastrāṃ jalamadhyagām|| udbhinnayauvanāṃ śyāmāṃ madhyakṣāmāṃ mṛgekṣaṇām|| 1.2.9.40 || vistīrṇajaghanābhogāṃ raṃbhoruṃ saṃhatastanīm|| tāmaṃkuritalāvaṇyāṃ jalasekā divāgrataḥ|| 9.41 || pronnidrapaṃkajamukhīṃ varṇanīyatamākṛtim|| yathāprajñānayāthātmyādvidvidbhirapi varṇinīm|| 9.42 || prodyatkaṭākṣavikṣepaiḥ śaravrātairiva smaraḥ|| svayaṃ tadaṃgamāsthāya tāḍayāmāsa māṃ dṛḍham|| 9.43 || vayasyāsaṃvṛcāmevaṃ khelamānāṃ yadṛcchayā|| avatīryāhamaharaṃ vimānānmadanāturaḥ|| 9.44 || sā gṛhītā mayā dīrghaṃ prakurvāṇā mahāsvanam|| tāteti ca vimānasthā rurodātīva bhadraka|| 9.45 || tato vayasyāstā dīnā munimāhuḥ pradhāvitāḥ|| vaimānikena kenāpi hriyate tava putrikā|| 9.46 || rudantīṃ bhagavannetāṃ trāhyuttiṣṭheti sarvataḥ|| tāsāṃ tadākarṇya vaco munirbhadrataponidhiḥ|| 9.47 || agniveśyo'bhyagāttasyā vyomanyupapadaṃ tvaran|| tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti māmuktvā saṃstabhya tapasā gatim|| 9.48 || tataḥ prakupitaḥ prāha munimāmati duḥsaham|| ||agniveśya uvāca|| yasmānmadīyā tanayā māṃsapeśīva te hṛtā|| 9.49 || gṛdhreṇevā'dhunā vyomni tasmādgadhro bhava drutam|| anicchaṃtī madīyeyaṃ sutā bālā tapasvinī|| 1.2.9.50 || tvayā hṛtādhunāsyaitatphalamāpnuhi durmate|| ityākarṇya bhayāviṣṭo lajjayādhomukho muneḥ|| 9.51 || pādau pragṛhya nyapataṃ rudannatitarāṃ tadā|| na mayeyaṃ parijñāya hṛtā nādyāpi dharṣitā|| 9.52 || prasādaṃ kuru te śāpaṃ vyāvartaya taponidhe|| praṇateṣu kṣamāvanto nisargeṇa tapodhanāḥ|| 9.53 || bhavaṃti saṃtastadgṛdhro mā bhaveyaṃ prasīda me|| iti prapannena mayā praṇato'sau mahāmuniḥ|| 9.54 || prasannaḥ prāha no mithyā mama vākyaṃ bhavetkvacit|| kiṃ tviṃdradyumnabhūpālaparijñāne sahāyatām|| 9.55 || yadā yāsyasi śāpasya tadā muktimavāpsyasi|| 9.56 || ityuktvā sa muniḥ prāyādgṛhītvā nijakanyakām|| akhaṇḍaśīlāṃ svāvāsamahaṃ gṛdhro'bhavaṃ tadā|| 9.57 || evaṃ tadā damanakotsava īśvarasya āṃdolanena nṛpaveśmani me'vatāraḥ|| śambhorgaṇatvamabhavacca tathāgniveśyaśāpena gṛdhra iha bhadra tavedamuktam|| 9.58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe mahīprādurbhāve damanakamāhātmyaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9 || cha ||
<1.2.10>
|| nārada uvāca|| gṛdhrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhavismayasaṃyutaḥ|| indradyumnastamā pṛcchaya maraṇāyopacakrame|| 10.1 || tatastamālokya tathā mumūrṣuṃ kauśikādibhiḥ|| sa saṃhitaṃ viciṃtyāha dīrghāyuṣamathātmanaḥ|| 10.2 || maivaṃ kārṣīḥ śruṇu giraṃ bhadraka tvaṃ ciraṃtanaḥ|| matto'pyasti sphuṭaṃ caiva jñāsyati tvadabhīpsitam|| 10.3 || mānase sarasi khyātaḥ kūrmomaṃtharakākhyayā|| tasya nāviditaṃ kiṃcidehi tatra vrajāmahe|| 10.4 || tataḥ pratītāste bhūpamunigṛdhrabakāstathā|| ulūkasahitā jagmuḥ sarve kūrmadidṛkṣavaḥ|| 10.5 || sarastīre sthitaḥ kūrmastānnirīkṣya vidūragān|| kāṃdiśīko viveśāsau jalaṃ śīghrataraṃ tadā|| 10.6 || kauśiko'tha tamāhedaṃ prahasya vacanaṃ svayam|| kasmātkūrma pranaṣṭodya vimukho'bhyāgateṣvapi|| 10.7 || agnirdvijānāṃ vipraśca varṇānāṃ ramaṇaḥ striyām|| guruḥ pitā ca putrāṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ|| 10.8 || vihāya tamimaṃ dharmamātithyavimukhaḥ katham|| gṛhṇāsi pāpaṃ sarveṣāṃ brūhi kūrmādhunottaram|| 10.9 || ||kūrma uvāca|| ciraṃtano hi jānāmi
