karttumātithyasatkriyām|| abhyāgateṣvapacitiṃ dharmaśāstreṣu niścitam|| 1.2.10.10 || sumahatkāraṇaṃ cātra śrūyatāṃ tadvadāmi vaḥ|| nāhaṃ parāṅmukho jāta etāvaṃti dinānyapi|| 10.11 || abhyāgatasya kasyāpi sarvasatkārasadvratī|| kiṃ tveṣa paṃcamo yo vo dṛśyate saralākṛtiḥ|| 10.12 || iṃdradyumno mahīpālo bibhomyasmādalaṃtarām|| amunā yajamānena raucakākhye purā pure|| 10.13 || yajñapāvakadagdhā me pṛṣṭhirnādyāpi nirvraṇā|| tanme bhayaṃ punarjātaṃ kimayaṃ punareva mām|| 10.14 || āsutīvalamādhāya bhuvi dhakṣyati saṃprati|| iti vākyāvasāne tu kūrmasya kurusattama|| 10.15 || papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ khādvimuktāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ|| sasvanurdevavādyāni kīrtyuddhāre mahīpateḥ|| 10.16 || vismitāste ca dadṛśurvimānaṃ purataḥ sthitam|| iṃdradyumnakṛte devadūtenādhiṣṭhitaṃ tadā|| 10.17 || ayātayāmāḥ pradadurāśiṣo'smai suradvijāḥ|| sādhuvādo divi mahānāsīttasya mahīpateḥ|| 10.18 || tato vimānamālaṃbya devadūtastamuccakaiḥ|| iṃdradyumnamuvācedaṃ śrṛṇvatāṃ nākavāsinām|| 10.19 || ||devadūta uvāca|| navīkṛtādhunā kīrtistava bhūpāla nirmalā|| trilokyāmapi tacchīghraṃ vimānamidamāruha|| 1.2.10.20 || gamyatāṃ brahmaṇo lokamākalpaṃ tapasorjitam|| preṣito'hamanenaiva tavānayanakāraṇāt|| 10.21 || yāvatkīrtirmanuṣyasya pṛthivyāṃ prathitā bhavet|| tāvāneva bhavetsvargī sati puṇye hyanaṃtake|| 10.22 || surālayasarovāpīkūpārāmādikalpanā|| etadarthaṃ hi pūrtākhyā dharmaśāstreṣu niścitā|| 10.23 || ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| amī mamaiva suhṛdo mārkaṃḍabakakauśikāḥ|| gṛdhrakūrmau prabhāvo'yamamīṣāṃ mama vṛddhaye|| 10.24 || taccedamī mayā sākaṃ brahmalokaṃ prayāṃtyuta|| puraḥsthitāstadāyāsye brahmalokaṃ ca nānyathā|| 10.25 || pareṣāmanapekṣyaiva kṛtapratikṛtaṃ hi yaḥ|| pravartate hitāyaiva sa suhṛtprocyate budhaiḥ|| 10.26 || svārthodyuktadhiyo ye syuranvarthāstepyasuṃdharāḥ|| maraṇaṃ prakṛtiścaiva jīvitaṃ vikṛtiryadā|| 10.27 || prāṇināṃ paramo lābhaḥ kevalaṃ prāṇisauhṛdam|| daridrā rāgiṇo'satyapratijñātā gurudruhaḥ|| 10.28 || mitrāvasāninaḥ pāpāḥ prāyo narakamaṃḍanāḥ|| parārthanaṣṭāstadamī paṃca saṃprati sādhavaḥ|| 10.29 || mama kīrtisamuddhāraḥ sa prabhāvo mahātmanām|| amīṣāṃ yadi te svargaṃ prayāsyanti mayā saha|| tadāhamapi yāsyāmi devadūtānyathā na hi|| 1.2.10.30 || ||devadūta uvāca|| ete haragaṇāḥ sarveśāpabhraṣṭāḥ kṣitiṃ gatāḥ|| 10.31 || śāpāṃte harapārśve tu yāsyaṃti pṛthivīpate|| vihāyemānato bhūpa tvamāgaccha mayā saha|| 10.32 || na caiṣāṃ rocate svargo hitvā devaṃ maheśvaram|| ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| yadyevaṃ gaccha taddūta nāyāsyehaṃ triviṣṭapam|| 10.33 || tathā tathā yati ṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi yathā gaṇaḥ|| aviśuddhikṣayādhikyadūṣaṇaireṣa niṃditaḥ|| 10.34 || svargaḥ sadānuśravikastasmādenaṃ na kāmaye|| tatrasthāsya punaḥ pāto bhayaṃ na vyeti mānasāt|| 10.35 || punaḥ pāto yataḥ puṃsastasmātsvargaṃ na kāmaye|| sati puṇye svayaṃ tena pātito nijalokataḥ|| 10.36 || caturmukhena vailakṣyaṃ gato'smi kathamemi tam|| itīdamuktvā dūtaṃ taṃ śrṛṇvato'syaiva vismayāt|| 10.37 || aprākṣīdbhūpatiḥ kūrmaṃ tadāyuḥkāraṇaṃ tadā|| idamāyuḥ kathaṃ jātaṃ kūrma dīrghatamaṃ tava|| 10.38 || suhṛnmitraṃ gurustvaṃ me yena kīrtirmamoddhṛtā|| 10.39 || ||kūrma uvāca|| śrṛṇu bhūpa kathāṃ divyāṃ śravaṇātpāpanāśinīm|| kathāṃ sumadhurāmetāṃ śivamāhātmyasaṃyutām|| 1.2.10.40 || śrṛṇvannimāmapi kathāṃ nṛpate manuṣyaḥ suśraddhayā bhavati pāpavimuktadehaḥ|| śaṃbhoḥ prasādamabhigamya yathāyurevamāsītprasādata iyaṃ mama kūrmatā ca|| 10.41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhastrāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10 || cha ||
<1.2.11>
||kūrma uvāca|| śāṃḍilya iti vikhyātaḥ purāhamabhavaṃ dvijaḥ|| bālabhāve mayā bhūpa krīḍamānena nirmitam|| 11.1 || purā prāvṛṣi pāṃśūtthaṃ śivāyatanamucchritam|| jalārdravālukāprāyaṃ prāṃśuprākāraśobhitam|| 11.2 || paṃcāyatanavinyāsamanoharataraṃ nṛpa|| vināyakaśivāsūryamadhusūdanamūrtimat|| 11.3 || pītamṛtsvarṇakalaśaṃ dhvajamālāvibhūṣitam|| kāṣṭhatoraṇavinyastaṃ dolakena vibhūṣitam|| 11.4 || dṛḍhaprāṃśusamudbhūtasopānaśreṇibhāsuram|| sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ vayasyaiḥ saṃvṛtena me|| 11.5 || tatra jāgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gṛtvātha viniveśitam|| bālyādupalarūpaṃ tadvarṣāvāriviśudvimat|| 11.6 || bakapuṣpaistathānyaiśca kedārotthaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ|| komalairaparaiḥ puṣpairvṛtivallīsamudbhavaiḥ|| 11.7 || kūṣmāṃḍaiścaiva varṇādyairunmattakusumāyutaiḥ|| maṃdārairbilvapatraiśca dūrvādyaiśca navāṃkuraiḥ|| 11.8 || pūjā viracitā ramyā śaṃbhoriti mayā nṛpa|| tatastāṃḍavamārabdhamanapekṣitasatkriyam|| 11.9 || śivasya purato bālyādgītaṃ ca svasvarjitam|| akārṣaṃ sakṛdevāhaṃ bālye śiśugaṇāvṛtaḥ|| 1.2.11.10 || tato mṛto'haṃ jātaśca vipro jātismaro nṛpa|| vaidiśe nagare'kārṣaṃ śivapūjāṃ viśeṣataḥ|| 11.11 || śivadīkṣāmupāgamyānugṛhītaḥ śivāgamaiḥ|| śivaprāsāda ādhāya liṃgaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ|| 11.12 || kalpakoṭiṃ vasetsvargeyaḥ karoti śivālayam|| yāvaṃti paramāṇūni śivasyāyatane nṛpa|| 11.13 || bhavaṃti tāvadvarṣāṇi karakaḥ śivasadmani|| iti paurāṇavākyāni smarañchailaṃ śivālayam|| 11.14 || akāriṣamahaṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmavidhānataḥ|| mṛnmayaṃ kāṣṭhaniṣpannaṃ pākveṣṭaṃ śailameva vā|| 11.15 || kṛtamāyatanaṃ dadyātkramāddaśaguṇaṃ phalam|| bhasmaśāyī triṣavaṇo bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ|| 11.16 || jaṭādharastapasyaṃśca śivārādhanatatparaḥ|| itthaṃ me kurvato jātaṃ punarbhūpa pramāpaṇam|| 11.17 || jāto jāti smarastatra kāritā tṛtīyehaṃ bhavāṃtare|| sārvabhaumo mahīpālaḥ pratiṣṭhāne purottame|| 11.18 || jayadatta iti khyātaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ|| tato mayā bahuvidhāḥ prāsādāḥ kāritā nṛpa|| 11.19 || tasminbhavāṃtare śaṃbhorārādhanapareṇa ca|| tato nirūpitā jātā bakapuṣpapurassarāḥ|| 1.2.11.20 || sauvarṇai rājatai ratnanirmitaiḥ kusumairnṛpa|| tathāvidhe'nnadānādi karomi nṛpasattama|| 11.21 || kevalaṃ śivaliṃgānāṃ pūjāṃ puṣpaiḥ karomyaham|| tato me bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ saṃtuṣṭo'tha varaṃ dadau|| 11.22 || ajarāmaratāṃ rājaṃstenaiva vapuṣāvṛtaḥ|| tatastathāvidhaṃ prāpyānanyasādhāraṇaṃ varam|| 11.23 || vicarāmi mahīmetāṃ madāṃdha iva vāraṇaḥ|| śivabhaktiṃ vihāyātha nṛpo'haṃ madanāturaḥ|| 11.24 || pradharṣayitumārabdhaḥ striyaḥ paraparigrahāḥ|| āyuṣastapasaḥ kīrtestejaso yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ|| 11.25 || vināśakāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ paradārapradharṣaṇam|| sakarṇaḥ śrutihīno'sau paśyannaṃdho vadañjaḍaḥ|| 11.26 || acetanaścetanāvānmūrkho vidvānapi sphuṭam|| tadā bhavati bhūpāla puruṣaḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ|| 11.27 || yadaiva hariṇākṣīṇāṃ gocaraṃ yāti cakṣuṣām|| mṛtasya niraye vāso jīvataśceśvarādbhayam|| 11.28 || evaṃ lokadvayaṃ haṃtrī paradārapradharṣaṇā|| jarāmaraṇahīnohamiti niścayamāsthitaḥ|| 11.29 || aihikāmuṣmikabhayaṃ vihāyāṃha tataḥ param|| pradharṣayitumārabdhastadā bhūpa parastriyaḥ|| 1.2.11.30 || atha māṃ saṃparijñāya maryādārahitaṃ yamaḥ|| varapradānādīśasya tadaṃtikasupāyayau|| vyajijñapanmadīyaṃ ca śaṃbhordharmavyatikramam|| 11.31 || ||yama uvāca|| nāhaṃ tavānubhāvena guptasyāsya vinigraham|| 11.32 || śakromi pāpino deva manniyoge'nyamādiśa|| jagadādhārūpā hi tvayeśoktāḥ pativratāḥ|| 11.33 || gāvo viprāḥ sanigamā alubdhā dānaśīlinaḥ|| satyaniṣṭhā iti svāmiṃsteṣāṃ mukhyatamā satī|| 11.34 || tāstena dharṣitā luptaṃ madīyaṃ dharmaśāsanam|| varadānapramattena tavaiva paribhūya mām|| 11.35 || jayadattena deveśa pratiṣṭhānādhivāsinā|| imāṃ dharmasya bhagavāngiramākarṇya kopitaḥ|| śaśāpa māṃ samānīya vepamānaṃ kṛtāṃjalim|| 11.36 || ||īśvara uvāca|| yasmādduṣṭasamācāra dharṣitāste pativratāḥ|| 11.37 || kāmārtena mayā śaptastasmātkūrmaḥ kṣaṇādbhava|| tataḥ praṇamya vijñaptaḥ śāpatāpaharo mayā|| 11.38 || prāha ṣaṣṭitame kalpe viśāpo bhavitā gaṇaḥ|| madīya iti saṃprocya jagāmādarśanaṃ śivaḥ|| 11.39 || ahaṃ kūrmastadā jāto daśayojanavistṛtaḥ|| samudrasalile nītastvayāhaṃ yajñasādhane|| 1.2.11.40 || purastādyāyajūkena smaraṃstacca bibhemi te|| dagdhastvayāhaṃ pṛṣṭhetra vraṇānyetāni paśya me|| 11.41 || cayanāni bahūnyatra kalpasūtravidhānataḥ|| pṛṣṭhopari kṛtānyāsanniṃdradyumna tadā tvayā|| 11.42 || bhūyaḥ saṃtāpitā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī pṛthivīpate|| susrāva sarvatīrthānāṃ sāraṃ sā'bhūnmahīnadī|| 11.43 || tasyāṃ ca snānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate|| tato naimittike kasminnapi pralaya āgataḥ|| 11.44 || plavamānamidaṃ rājanmānasaṃ śatayojanam|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśatpramāṇena kalpā mama purā nṛpa|| 11.45 || vyatītā iha catvāraḥ śeṣe mokṣastataḥ param|| evamāyuridaṃ dīrghamevaṃ śāpācca kūrmatā|| 11.46 || mamābhūdīśvarasyaiva satīdharmadruho nṛpa|| brūhi kiṃ kriyatāṃ śatrorapi te gṛhagāminaḥ|| 11.47 || mama pṛṣṭhiściraṃ bhūpa tvayā dagdhāgninā'purā|| ahaṃ jvalaṃtīmiva tāṃ paśyāmyadyāpi satriṇā|| 11.48 || idaṃ vimānamāyātaṃ tvayā kasmānnirākṛtam|| devadūtasamāyuktaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhogānnijārjitān|| 11.49 || ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| caturmukhena tenāhaṃ svargānnirvāsitaḥ svayam|| vilakṣyona prayāsyāmi pātādhikyādidūṣite|| 1.2.11.50 || tasmādvivekavairāgyamavidyāpāpanāśanam|| āliṃgyāhaṃ yatiṣyāmi prāpya bodhaṃ vimuktaye|| 11.51 || tanme gṛhagatasyādya yathātithyakaro bhavān|| tadādiśa yathā'pārapāradaḥ kopi me guruḥ|| 11.52 || ||kūrma uvāca|| lomaśonāma dīrghāyurmatto'pyasti mahāmuniḥ|| mayā kalāpagrāme sa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kvacinnṛpa|| 11.53 || ||iṃdradyumna uvāca|| tasmādāgaccha gacchāmastameva sahitāvayam|| prāhuḥ pūtatamāṃ tīrthādapi satsaṃgatiṃ budhāḥ|| 11.54 || itthaṃ niśamya nṛpatervacanaṃ tadānīṃ sarve'pi te ṣaḍatha taṃ munimukhyamāśu|| citte vidhāya muditāḥ prayayurdvijeṃdraṃ jijñāsavaḥ sucirajīvitahetumasya|| 11.55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve kūrmākhyānaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11 || cha ||
<1.2.12>
|| nārada uvāca|| atha te dadṛśuḥ pārtha saṃyamasthaṃ mahāmunim|| kūrmākhyānaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12.1 || jaṭāstriṣavaṇasnānakapilāḥ śirasā tadā|| dhārayantaṃ lomaśākhyamājyasiktamivānalam|| 12.2 || savyahaste tṛṇaughaṃ ca cchāyārthe viprasattamam|| dakṣiṇe cākṣamālāṃ ca bibhrataṃ maitramārgagam|| 12.3 || ahiṃsayanduruktādyaiḥ prāṇino bhūmicāriṇaḥ|| yaḥ siddhimeti japyena sa maitro munirucyate|| 12.4 || bakabhūpadvijolūkagṛdhrakūrmā vilokya ca|| nemuḥ kalāpagrāme taṃ ciraṃtanataponidhim|| 12.5 || svāgatāsanasatkāreṇāmunā te'ti satkṛtāḥ|| yathocitaṃ pratītāstamāhuḥ kāryaṃ hṛdi sthitam|| 12.6 || ||kūrma uvāca|| indradyumno'yamavanīpatiḥ satrijanāgraṇīḥ|| kīrtilopānnirasto'yaṃ vedhasā nākapṛṣṭhataḥ|| 12.7 || mārkaṃḍeyādibhiḥ prāpya kīrtyuddhāraṃca sattama|| nāyaṃ kāmayate svargaṃ punaḥpātādibhīṣaṇam|| 12.8 || bhavatānugṛhīto'yamihecchati mahodayam|| praṇodyastadayaṃ bhūpaḥ śiṣyaste bhagavanmayā|| tvatsakāśamihānīto brūhi sādhvasya vāṃchitam|| 12.9 || paropakaraṇaṃ nāma sādhūnāṃ vratamāhitam|| viśeṣataḥ praṇodyānāṃ śiṣyavṛttimupeyuṣām|| 1.2.12.10 || apraṇodyeṣu pāpeṣu sādhu proktamasaṃśayam|| vidveṣaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi kurute'nyatarasya ca|| 12.11 || apramattaḥ praṇodyeṣu munireṣa prayacchati|| tadeveti bhavānevaṃ dharmaṃ vetti kuto vayam|| 12.12 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| kūrma yuktamidaṃ sarvaṃ tvayābhihitamadya naḥ|| dharmaśāstropanataṃ tatsmāritāḥ sma purātanam|| 12.13 || brūhi rājansuviśrabdhaṃ sandehaṃ hṛdayasthitam|| kaste kimabravīccheṣaṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 12.14 || ||indradyumna uvāca|| bhagavanprathamaḥ praśrastāvadeva mamocyatām|| grīṣmakāle'pi madhyasthai ravau kiṃ na tavāśramaḥ|| 12.15 || kuṭīmātro'pi yacchāyā tṛṇaiḥ śirasi pāṇigaiḥ|| 12.16 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| martavyamastyavaśyaṃ ca kāya eṣa patiṣyati|| kasyārthe kriyate gehamanityabhavamadhyagaiḥ|| 12.17 || yasya mṛtyurbhavenmitraṃ pītaṃ vā'mṛtamuttamam|| tasyaitaducitaṃ vaktumidaṃ me śvo bhaviṣyati|| 12.18 || idaṃ yugasahasreṣu bhaviṣyamabhaviddinam|| tadapyadyatvamāpannaṃ kā kathāmaraṇāvadheḥ|| 12.19 || kāraṇānugataṃ kāryamidaṃ śukrādabhūdvapuḥ|| kathaṃ viśuddhimāyāti kṣālitāṃgāravadvada|| 1.2.12.20 || tadasyāpi kṛte pāpaṃ śatruṣaḍvarganirjitāḥ|| kathaṃkāraṃ na lajjante kurvāṇā nṛpasattama|| 12.21 || tadbrahmaṇa ihotpannaḥ sikatādvayasambhavaḥ|| nigamoktaṃ paṭhañchṛṇvannidaṃ jīviṣyate katham|| 12.22 || tathāpi vaiṣṇavī māyā mohayatyavivekinam|| hṛdayasthaṃ na jānaṃti hyapi mṛtyu śatāyuṣaḥ|| 12.23 || dantāścalāścalā lakṣmīryauvanaṃ jīvitaṃ nṛpa|| calācalamatīvedaṃ dānamevaṃ gṛhaṃ nṛṇām|| 12.24 || iti vijñāya saṃsārasāraṃ ca calācalam|| kasyārthe kriyate rājankuṭajādi parigrahaḥ|| 12.25 || ||indradyumna uvāca|| cirāyurbhagavāneva śrūyate bhuvanatraye|| tadarthamahamāyātastatkimevaṃ vacastava|| 12.26 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| pratikalpaṃ maccharīrādekaromaparikṣayaḥ|| jāyate sarvanāśe ca mama bhāvi pramāpaṇam|| 12.27 || paśya jānupradeśaṃ me dvyaṃgulaṃ romavarjitam|| jātaṃ vapustadbibhemi martavye sati kiṃ gṛhaiḥ|| 12.28 || ||nārada uvāca|| itthaṃ niśamya tadvākyaṃ sa prahasyātivismitaḥ|| bhūpālastasya papraccha kāraṇaṃ tādṛśāyuṣaḥ|| 12.29 || ||indradyumna uvāca|| pṛcchāmi tvāmahaṃ brahmanyadāyuridamīdṛśam|| tava dīrghaṃ prabhāvo'sau dānasya tapaso'thavā|| 1.2.12.30 || ||lomaśa uvāca|| śrṛṇu bhūpa pravakṣyāmi pūrvajanmasamudbhavām|| śivadharmayutāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm|| 12.31 || ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro daridro'tīvabhūtale|| bhramāmi vasudhāpṛṣṭhe hyaśanapīḍito bhṛśam|| 12.32 || tato mayā mahalliṃgaṃ jālimadhyagataṃ tadā|| madhyāhne'sya jalādhāro dṛṣṭaścaivā vidūrataḥ|| 12.33 || tataḥ praviśya tadvāri pītvā snātvā ca śāṃbhavam|| talliṃgaṃ snāpitaṃ pūjā vihitā kamalaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| 12.34 || atha kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭho'haṃ śrīkaṃṭhaṃ taṃ namasya ca|| punaḥ pracalito mārge pramīto nṛpasattama|| 12.35 || tato'haṃ brāhmaṇagṛhe jāto jātismaraḥ sutaḥ|| snāpanācchivaliṃgasya sakṛtkamalapūjanāt|| 12.36 || smaranvilasitaṃ mithyā satyābhāsamidaṃ jagat|| avidyāmayamityevaṃ jñātvā mūkatvamāsthitaḥ|| 12.37 || tena vipreṇa vārdhakye samārādhya maheśvaram|| prāpto'hamiti me nāma īśāna iti kalpitam|| 12.38 || tataḥ sa vipro vātsalyādagadānsubahūnmama|| cakāra vyapaneṣyāmi mūkatvamiti niścayaḥ|| 12.39 || maṃtravādānbahūnvaidyānupāyānaparānapi|| pitrostathā mahāmāyāsaṃbaddhamanasostathā|| 1.2.12.40 || nirīkṣya mūḍhatāṃ hāsyamāsīnmanasi me tadā|| tathā yauvanamāsādya niśi hitvā nijaṃ gṛham|| 12.41 || saṃpūjya kamalaiḥ śaṃbhuṃ tataḥ śayanamabhyagām|| tataḥ pramīte pitari mūḍhaityahamujjhitaḥ|| 12.42 || saṃbaṃdhibhiḥ pratīto'tha phalāhāramavasthitaḥ|| pratītaḥ pūjayāmīśamabjairbahuvidhaistathā|| 12.43 || atha varṣaśatasyāṃte varadaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ|| pratyakṣo yācito dehi jarāmaraṇasaṃkṣayam|| 12.44 || ||īśvara uvāca|| ajarāmaratā nāsti nāmarūpabhṛtoyataḥ|| mamāpi dehapātaḥ syādavadhiṃ kuru jīvite|| 12.45 || iti śaṃbhorvacaḥ śrutvā mayā vṛtimidaṃ tadā|| kalpāṃte romapāto'stu maraṇaṃ sarvasaṃkṣaye|| 12.46 || tatastava gaṇo bhūyāmiti me'bhīpsito varaḥ|| tathetyuktvā sa bhagavānharaścādarśanaṃ gataḥ|| 12.47 || ahaṃ tapasiniṣṭhaśca tataḥ prabhṛti cābhavam|| brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate śivapūjanāt|| 12.48 || bradhnābjairitarairvapi kamalairnātra saṃśayaḥ|| evaṃ kuru mahārāja tvamapyāpsyasi vāṃchitam|| 12.49 || harabhaktasya lokasya trilokyāṃ nāsti durlabham|| bahiḥpravṛttiṃ sagṛhya jñānakarmendriyādi ca|| 1.2.12.50 || layaḥ sadāśive nityamataryo go'yamucyate|| duṣkaratvādvahiryogaṃ śiva eva svayaṃ jagau|| 12.51 || paṃcabhiścārcanaṃ bhūtairviśiṣṭaphaladaṃ dhruvam|| kleśakarmavipākādyairāśayaiścāpya saṃyutam|| 12.52 || īśānamārādhya japanpraṇavaṃ muktipāpnuyāt|| sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā|| 12.53 || pāpopahatabuddhīnāṃ śive vārtāpi durlabhā|| durlabhaṃ bhārate janma durlabhaṃ śivapūjanam|| 12.54 || durlabhaṃ jāhnavīsnānaṃ śive bhaktiḥ sudurlabhā|| durlabhaṃ brāhmaṇe dānaṃ durlabhaṃ vahnipūjanam|| 12.55 || alpapuṇyaiśca duṣprāpaṃ puruṣottamapūjanam|| 12.56 || lakṣeṇa dhanuṣāṃ yogastadardhena hutāśanaḥ|| pātraṃ śatasahasreṇa revā rudraśca ṣaṣṭibhiḥ|| 12.57 || iti damuktamakhilaṃ mayā tava mahīpate|| yathāyurabhavaddīrghaṃ samārādhya maheśvaram|| 12.58 || na durlabhaṃ na duṣprāpaṃ na cāsādhyaṃ mahātmanām|| śivabhaktikṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ trilokyāmiti niścitam|| 12.59 || naṃdīśvarasya tenaiva vapuṣā śivapūjanāt|| siddhimālokya ko rājañchaṃkaraṃ na namasyati|| 1.2.12.60 || śvetasya ca mahīpasya śrīkaṃṭhaṃ ca namasyataḥ|| kālopi pralayaṃ yātaḥ kastamīśaṃ na pūjayet|| 12.61 || (16) yadicchayā viśvamidaṃ jāyate vyavatiṣṭhate|| tathā saṃlīyate cāṃte kastaṃ na śaraṇaṃ vrajet|| 12.62 || etadrahasyamidameva nṛṇāṃ pradhānaṃ kartavyamatra śivapūjanameva bhūpa|| yasyāṃtarāyapadavīmupayāṃti lokāḥ sadyoḥ naraḥ śivanataḥ śivameva satyam|| 12.63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīprādurbhāve lomaśavṛttānte śivapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12 || cha ||
<1.2.13>
||nārada uvāca|| iti tasya munīṃdrasya bhūpatiḥ śuśruvānvacaḥ|| prāha nāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ vihāya naraṃ kvacit|| 13.1 || liṃgamārādhayiṣye'dya sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām|| tvayaivānugṛhīto'dya yāṃtu sarve yathāgatam|| 13.2 || tadbhūpativacaḥ śrutvā bako gṛdhro'tha kacchapaḥ|| ulūkaśca tathaivocuḥ praṇatā lomaśaṃ munim|| 13.3 || sa ca sarvasuhṛdviprastathetyevāha tāṃstadā|| praṇodyānpraṇatānsarvānanujagrāha śiṣyavat|| 13.4 || śivadīkṣāvidhānena liṃgapūjāṃ samādiśat|| teṣāmanugrahaparo muniḥ pramatavatsalaḥ|| tīrthādapyadhikaṃ sthāne satāṃ sādhusamāgamaḥ|| 13.5 || pacelimaphalaḥ sadyo duraṃtakalupāpahaḥ|| apūrvaḥ ko'pi sadgoṣṭhīsahasrakiraṇodayaḥ|| 13.6 || ya ekāṃtatayātyaṃtamaṃtargatatamopahaḥ|| sādhugoṣṭhīsamudbhūtasukhāmṛtarasormayaḥ|| 13.7 || sarve varāḥ sudhākārāḥ śarkarāmadhuṣaḍrasāḥ|| tataste sādhusaṃsargaṃ saṃprāptāḥ śivaśāsanāt|| 13.8 || ārebhire kriyāyogaṃ mārkaṃḍanṛpapūrvakāḥ|| teṣāṃ tapasyatāmevaṃ samājagme kadācana|| tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgena lomaśālokanotsukaḥ|| 13.9 || mukhyā puruṣayātrā hi tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgataḥ|| sadbhiḥ samāśrito bhūpa bhūmibhāgastathocyate|| 1.2.13.10 || kṛtārhaṇātithyavidhiṃ viśrāṃtaṃ māṃ ca phālguna|| praṇamya te'tha papracchurnāḍījaṃghapuraḥ sarāḥ|| 13.11 || ||ta ucuḥ|| śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ brahmaṃścatvāro'pi svakarmaṇā|| tanmuktisādhanārthāya sthānaṃ kiṃcitsamādiśa|| 13.12 || iyaṃ hi niṣphalā bhūmiḥ śapalaṃ bhārataṃ mune|| 13.13 || tatrāpi kvacidekatra sarvatīrthaphalaṃ vada|| iti pṛṣṭastvahaṃ taiśca tānabravamidaṃ tadā|| 13.14 || saṃvartaṃ paripṛcchadhvaṃ sa vo vakṣyati tattvataḥ|| sarvatīrthaphalāvāptikārakaṃ bhūpradeśakam|| 13.15 || ||ta ucuḥ|| kutrāsau vidyate yogī nājñāsiṣma vayaṃ ca tam|| saṃvartadarśanānmuktiriti cāsmadanugrahaḥ|| 13.16 || yadi jānāsi taṃ brūhi suhṛtsaṃgo na niṣphalaḥ|| tato'hamabravaṃ tāṃśca vicāryedaṃ punaḥpunaḥ|| 13.17 || vārāṇasyāmasāvāste saṃvarto guptaliṃgabhṛt|| maladigdho vivasano bhikṣāśī kutapādanu|| 13.18 || karapātrakṛtāhāraḥ sarvathā niṣparigrahaḥ|| bhāvayanbrahma paramaṃ praṇavābhidhamīśvaram|| 13.19 || bhuktvā niryāti sāyāhne vanaṃ na jñāyate janaiḥ|| yogīśvaro'sau tadrūpāḥ santyanye liṃgadhāriṇaḥ|| 1.2.13.20 || vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ tasya jñāsyatha taṃ munim|| pratolyā rājamārge tu niśi bhūmau śavaṃ janaiḥ|| 13.21 || avijñātaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ stheyaṃ tadavidūrataḥ|| yastāṃ bhūmimupāgamya akasmādvinirvatate|| 13.22 || sa saṃvarto na cākrāmatyeṣa śalyamasaṃśayam|| praṣṭavyo'bhimataṃ cāsāvupāśritya vinītavat|| 13.23 || yadi pṛcchati kenāhamākhyāta iti māṃ tataḥ|| nivedya caitadvaktavyaṃ tvāmākhyāyāgnimāviśat|| 13.24 || tacchrutvā te tathā cakruḥ sarvepi vacanaṃ mama|| prāpya vārāṇasīṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃvartaṃ te tathā vyadhuḥ|| 13.25 || śavaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tairnyastaṃ saṃvarto vai nyavartata|| kṣutparīto'pi taṃ jñātvā yayustamanu śīghragam|| 13.26 || tiṣṭha brahmankṣaṇamiti jalpaṃto rājamārgagam|| yāti nirbhartsayatyeṣa nivartadhvamiti bruvan|| 13.27 || samayā māmare bho'dya nāgaṃtavyaṃ na vo hitam|| palāyanamasau kṛtvā gatvā dūrataraṃ saraḥ|| kupitaḥ prāha tānsarvānkenākhyāto'hamityuta|| 13.28 || nivedayata śīghraṃ me yathā bhasma karomi tam|| śāpāgninātha vā yuṣmānyadi satyaṃ na vakṣyatha|| 13.29 || atha prakaṃpitāḥ prāhurnāradeneti taṃ munim|| sa tānāha punaryātaḥ piśunaḥ kva nu saṃprati|| 1.2.13.30 || lokānāṃ yena sāpāgnau bhasmaśeṣaṃ karomi tam|| brahmabaṃdhumahaṃ prāhurbhītāste taṃ punarmunim|| 13.31 || ||ta ūcuḥ|| tvaṃ nivedya sa cāsmākaṃ praviṣṭo havyavāhanam|| tatkālameva vipreṃdra na vidmastatra kāraṇam|| 13.32 || ||saṃvarta uvāca|| ahamapyevamevāsya kartā tena svayaṃ kṛtam|| tadbrūta kāryaṃ naivātra ciraṃ sthāsyāmi vaḥ kṛte|| 13.33 || ||arjuna uvāca|| yadi nārada devarṣe praviṣṭo'si hutāśanam|| jīvitastatkathaṃ bhūya āścaryamiti me vada|| 13.34 || ||nārada uvāca|| na hutāśaḥ samudro vā vāyurvā vṛkṣaparvataḥ|| āyudhaṃ vā na me śaktā dehapātāya bhārata|| 13.35 || punaretatkṛtaṃ cāpi saṃvarto manyate yathā|| ahaṃ sanmānitaśceti vahniṃ prāpyāpyagāmaham|| 13.36 || yathā puṣpagṛhe kaścitpraviśatyaṃga phālguna|| tathāhamagniṃ saṃviśya yātavānuttaraṃ śrṛṇu|| 13.37 || saṃvartastānpunaḥ prāha mārkaṃḍeyamukhāniti|| viśalyaḥ paṃthāḥ kṣudhito'haṃ punaḥ purīm|| bhikṣārthaṃ paryaṭiṣyāmi praśraṃ prabrūta caiva me|| 13.38 || ||ta ūcuḥ|| śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpsyāmastavadanugrahāt|| pratīkāraṃ tadākhyāhi praṇatānāṃ mahāmune|| 13.39 || yatra tīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ|| tattīrthaṃ brūhi saṃvarta tiṣṭhāmo yatra vai vayam|| 1.2.13.40 || ||saṃvarta uvāca|| namaskṛtya kumārāya durgābhyaśca narottamāḥ|| tīrthaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| 13.41 || amunā rājasiṃhena iṃdradyumnena dhīmatā|| yajanāddvyaṃgulotsedhā kṛteyaṃ vasudhāyadā|| 13.42 || tadā saṃtāpyamānāyā bhuvaḥ kāṣṭhasya vai yathā|| susrāva yo jalaughaśca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ|| 13.43 || mahīnāma nadī ca pṛthivyāṃ yānikānicit|| tīrthāni teṣāṃ salilasaṃbhavaṃ tajjalaṃ viduḥ|| 13.44 || mahīnāma samutpannā deśe mālavakābhidhe|| dakṣiṇaṃ sāgaraṃ prāptā puṇyobhayataṭāśivā|| 13.45 || sarvatīrthamayī pūrvaṃ mahīnāma mahānadī|| kiṃ punaryaḥ samāyogastasyāśca saritāṃ pateḥ|| 13.46 || vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ gaṃgā revā sarasvatī|| 13.47 || tāpī payoṣṇī nirvidhyā candrabhāgā irāvatī|| kāverī śarayūścaiva gaṃḍakī naimiṣaṃ tathā|| 13.48 || gayā godāvarī caiva aruṇā varuṇā tathā|| etāḥ puṇyāḥ śataśonyā yāḥ kāścitsarito bhuvi|| 13.49 || sahasraviṃśatiścaiva ṣaṭśatāni tathaiva ca|| tāsāṃ sārasamudbhutaṃ mahītoyaṃ prakīrtitam|| 1.2.13.50 || pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snātvā yatphalamāpyate|| tanmahīsāgare proktaṃ kumārasya vaco yathā|| 13.51 || ekatra sarvatīrthānāṃ yadi saṃyogamicchatha|| tadgacchatha mahāpuṇyaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| 13.52 || ahaṃ cāpi ca tatraiva bahūnvarṣagaṇānpurā|| avasaṃ cāgataścātra nāradasya bhayāttathā|| 13.53 || sa hi tatra samīpasthaḥ piśunaśca viśeṣataḥ|| maruttaḥ kurute yatnaṃ tasmai brūyādidaṃ bhayam|| 13.54 || atra digvāsasāṃ madhye bahūnāṃ tatsamastvaham|| nivasāmyatipracchanno maruttādatibhītavat|| 13.55 || punaratrāpi māṃ nūnaṃ kathayiṣyati nāradaḥ|| tathāvidhā hi ceṣṭāsya piśunasya pradṛśyate|| 13.56 || bhavadbhiśca na cāpyatra vaktānāṃ kasyacitkvacit|| maruttaḥ kurute yatnaṃ bhūpālo yajñasiddhaye|| 13.57 || devācāryeṇa saṃtyakto bhrātrā me kāraṇāṃ tare|| guruputraṃ ca māṃ jñātvā yajñārtvijyasya kāraṇāt|| 13.58 || avidyāṃtargatairyajñakarmabhirna prayojanam|| mama hiṃsātmakairasti nigamoktairacetanaiḥ|| 13.59 || samitpuṣpakuśaprāyaiḥ sādhanairyadyacetanaiḥ|| kriyate tattathā bhāvi kāryaṃ kāraṇavannṛṇām|| 1.2.13.60 || tadyūyaṃ tatra gacchadhvaṃ śīghrameva nṛpānugāḥ|| asti vipraḥ svayaṃ brahmā yājñavalkyaśca tatra vai|| 13.61 || sa hi pūrvaṃ mitheḥ puryāṃ vasannāśramamuttamam|| āgacchamānaṃ nakulaṃ dṛṣṭvā gārgīṃ vaco'bravīt|| 13.62 || gārgi rakṣa payo bhadre nakulo'yamupeti ca|| payaḥ pātuṃ kṛtimatiṃ nakulaṃ taṃ nirākuru|| 13.63 || ityukto nakulaḥ kruddhaḥ sa hi kruddhaḥ purā'bhavat|| jamadagneḥ pūrvajaiśca śaptaḥ provāca taṃ munim|| 13.64 || aho vā dhigdhigityeva bhūyo dhigiti caiva hi|| nirlajjatā manuṣyāṇāṃ dṛśyate pāpakāriṇām|| 13.65 || kathaṃ te nāma pāpāni prakurvaṃti narādhamāḥ|| maraṇāṃtaritā yeṣāṃ narake tīvravedanā|| 13.66 || nimeṣo'pi na śakyeta jīvite yasya niścitam|| tanmātraparamāyuryaḥ pāpaṃ kuryātkathaṃ sa ca|| 13.67 || tvaṃ mune manyase cedaṃ kulīno'smīti buddhimān|| tataḥ kṣipasi māṃ mūḍha nakulo'yamiti smayan|| 13.68 || kimadhītaṃ yājñavalkya kā yogeśvaratā tava|| niraparādhaṃ kṣipasi dhigadhītaṃ hi tattava|| 13.69 || kasminvedaṃ smṛtau kasyāṃ proktametadbravīhi me|| paruṣairiti vākyairmāṃ nakuleti bravīṣi yat|| 1.2.13.70 || kimidaṃ naiva jānāsi yāvatyaḥ paruṣā giraḥ|| paraḥ saṃśrāvyate tāvacchaṃkavaḥ śrotrataḥ punarā|| 13.71 || kaṃṭhe yamānugāḥ pādaṃ kṛtvā tasya sudurmateḥ|| atīva rudato lohaśaṃkūnkṣepsyaṃti karṇayoḥ|| 13.72 || vāvadūkāśca dhvajino muṣṇaṃti kṛpaṇāñjanān|| svayaṃ hastasahasreṇa dharmasyaivaṃ bhavadvidhāḥ|| 13.73 || vajrasya digdhaśastrasya kālakūṭasya cāpyuta|| samena vacasā tulyaṃ mṛtyoriti mamābhavat|| 13.74 || karṇanāsikanārācānnirharaṃti śarīrataḥ|| vākchalyastu na nirhartuṃ śakyo hṛdiśayo hi saḥ|| 13.75 || yaṃtrapīḍaiḥ samākramya varameṣa hato naraḥ|| na tu taṃ paruṣairvākyairjighāṃseta kathaṃcana|| 13.76 || tvayā tvahaṃ yājñavalkya nityaṃ paṃḍitamāninā|| nakulosīti tīvreṇa vacasā tāḍitaḥ kutaḥ|| 13.77 || ||saṃvarta uvāca|| iti śrutvā vacastasya bhṛśaṃ vismitamānasaḥ|| yājñavalkyo'bravīdetatprabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ|| 13.78 || namo'dharmāya mahate na vidmo yasya vai bhavam|| paramāṇumapi vyaktaṃ kotra vidyāmadaḥ satām|| 13.79 viraṃciviṣṇuprasamukhāḥ someṃdrapramukhāstathā|| sarvajñāste'pi muhyati gaṇanāsmādṛśaṃ ca kā|| 1.2.13.80 || dharmajño'smīti yo mohādātmānaṃ pratipadyate|| sa vāyuṃ muṣṭinā baddhumīhate kṛpaṇo naraḥ|| 13.81 || kecidajñānato naṣṭāḥ kecijjñānamadādapi|| jñānaṃ prāpyāpi naṣṭāśca kecidālasyato'dhamāḥ|| 13.82 || vedasmṛtītihāseṣu purāṇeṣu prakalpitam|| catuḥpādaṃ tathā dharmaṃ nācaratyadhamaḥ paśuḥ|| 13.83 || sa purā śocate vyaktaṃ prāpya taccāṃtakaṃ gṛham|| tathāhi gṛhyakāreṇa śrutau proktamidaṃ vacaḥ|| 13.84 || nakulaṃ sakulaṃ brūyānna kaṃcinmarmaṇi spṛśet|| prapaṭhannapi caivāhamidaṃ sarvaṃ tathā śukaḥ|| 13.85 || ālasyenāpyanācārādvṛthākāryekamaṃga tat|| 13.86 || kevalaṃ pāṭha mātreṇa yaśca saṃtuṣyate naraḥ|| tathā paṃḍitamānī ca konyastasmātpaśurmataḥ|| 13.87 || na cchaṃdāṃsi vṛjināttārayaṃti māyāvinaṃ māyayā''vartamānam|| nīḍaṃ śakuṃtā iva jātapakṣāśchaṃdāsyenaṃ prajahatyaṃtakāle|| 13.88 || svārgāya baddhakakṣo yaḥ pāṭhamātreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ|| sa bālo māturaṃkastho grahītuṃ somamicchati|| 13.89 || tadbhavānsarvathā mahyamanayaṃ soḍhumarhasi|| sarvaḥ ko'pi vadatyevaṃ tanmayaivamudāhṛtam|| 1.2.13.90 || ||nakula uvāca|| vṛthedaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tubhyaṃ sarvalokena yatsamam|| ātmānaṃ manyase naitadvaktuṃ yogyaṃ mahātmanām|| 13.91 || vājivāraṇalohānāṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇavāsasām|| nārīpuruṣatoyānāmaṃtaraṃ mahadaṃtaram|| 13.92 || anye cetprākṛtā lokā bahupāpāni kurvate|| pradhānapuruṣeṇāpi kāryaṃ tatpṛṣṭhatonu kim|| 13.93 || sarvārthaṃ nirmitaṃ śāstraṃ manobuddhī tathaiva ca|| datte vidhātrā sarveṣāṃ tathāpi yadi pāpinaḥ|| 13.94 || tato vidhātuḥ ko doṣasta eva khalu durbhagāḥ|| brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa kiṃ bhāvyaṃ lokavadyataḥ|| 13.95 || yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ|| sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate|| 13.96 || tasmātsadā mahadbhiśca ātmārthaṃ ca parārthataḥ|| satāṃ dharmo na saṃtyājyo nyāyyaṃ tacchikṣaṇaṃ tava|| 13.97 || yasmāttvayā pīḍito'haṃ ghoreṇa vacasā mune|| tasmācchīghraṃ tvāṃ śapsyāmi śāpayogyo hi me mataḥ|| 13.98 || nakulo'sīti māmāha bhavāṃstasmātkulādhamaḥ|| śīghramutpatsyase mohāttvameva nakulo mune|| 13.99 || ||saṃvarta uvāca|| iti vācaṃ samākarṇya bhāvyarthakṛtaniścayaḥ|| yājñavalkyo marau deśe viprasyājāyatātmajaḥ|| 1.2.13.100 || durācārasya pāpasya nighṛṇasyātivādinaḥ|| duṣkulīnasya jāto'sau tadā jātismaraḥ sutaḥ|| 13.101 || so'tha jñānātsamālokya bhartṛyajña iti dvijaḥ|| guptakṣetraṃ samāpanno mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| 13.102 || tatra pāśupato bhūtvā śivārādhanatatparaḥ|| svāyaṃbhuvaṃ mahākālaṃ pūjayanvartate'dhunā|| 13.103 || yo hi nityaṃ mahākālaṃ śraddhayā pūjayetpumān|| sa dauṣkulīnadoṣebhyo mucyate'hiriva tvacaḥ|| 13.104 || yathāyathā śraddhayāsau talliṃgaṃ paripaśyati|| tathātathā vimucyeta doṣairjanmaśatodbhavaiḥ|| 13.105 || bhartṛyajñastu tatraiva liṃgasyārādhanātkramāt|| bījadoṣādvinirmuktastalliṃgamahimā tvasau|| 13.106 || babhruṃ ca nakulaṃ prāha vimukto duṣṭajanmataḥ|| yasmāttasmādidaṃ tīrthaṃ khyātaṃ vai babhru pāvanam|| 13.107 || tasmādvrajadhvaṃ tatraiva mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| paṃca tīrthāni sevanto muktimāpsyatha niścitam|| 13.108 || ityevamuktvā saṃvarto yayāvabhimataṃ dvijaḥ|| bhartṛyajñaṃ muniṃ prāpya te ca tatra sthitābhavan|| 13.109 || tatastānāha sa jñātvā gaṇāñjñānena śāṃbhavān|| mahadvo vimalaṃ puṇyaṃ guptakṣetre yadatra vai|| 1.2.13.110 || bhavanto'bhyāgatā yatra mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ piṃḍadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| 13.111 || akṣayaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ mahīsāgara saṃgame|| kṛtaṃ tathā'kṣayaṃ sarvaṃ snānadānakriyādikam|| 13.112 || yadātra stānakaṃ cakre devarṣirnāradaḥ purā|| tadā grahairvarā dattāḥ śaninā ca varastvasau|| 13.113 || śanaiścareṇa saṃyuktā tvamāvāsyā yadā bhavet|| śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta snānadānapuraḥ saram|| 13.114 || yadi śrāvaṇamāsasya śanaiścaradine śubhā|| kuhūrbhavati tasyāṃ tu saṃkrāṃtiṃ kurute raviḥ|| 13.115 || tasyāmeva tithau yogo vyatīpāto bhavedyadi|| puṣkaraṃnāma tatparva sūryaparvaśatādhikam|| 13.116 || sarvayogasamāvāpaḥ sathaṃcidapi labhyate|| tasmindine śaniṃ lohaṃ kāṃcanaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā|| 13.117 || mahīsāgarasaṃsarge pūjayīta yathāvidhi|| śanimaṃtraiḥ śaniṃ dhyātvā sūryamaṃtrairdivākaram|| 13.118 || arghyaṃ dadyādbhākarasya sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye|| prayāgādidhikaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ kṣetrātkurorapi|| 13.119 || piṃḍadānaṃ gayākṣetrādadhikaṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| idaṃ saṃprāpyate parva mahadbhiḥ puṇyarāśibhiḥ|| 1.2.13.120 || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate divi niścitam|| yathā gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ param|| 13.121 || tathā samadhikaḥ puṇyo mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| 13.122 || agniśca reto mṛḍayā ca dehe retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ|| evaṃ bruvañchraddhayā satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta mahīsamudram|| 13.123 || mukhaṃ ca yaḥ sarvanadīṣu puṇyaḥ pāthodhiraṃbā pravarā mahī ca|| samastatīrthākṛtiretayośca dadāmi cārghyaṃ praṇamāmi naumi|| 13.124 || tāmrā rasyāḥ payovāhāḥ pitṛprītipradāḥ śabhāḥ|| sasyamālā mahāsindhurdāturdātrī pṛthustutā|| indradyumnasya kanyā ca kṣitijanmā rāvatī|| 13.125 || mahīparṇā mahīśṛṃgā gaṃgā paścimavāhinī|| nadī rājanadī ceti nāmāṣṭāśamālikām|| 13.126 || snānakāle ca sarvatra śrāddhakāle paṭhennaraḥ|| pṛthunoktāni nāmāni yajñamūrtipadaṃ vrajet|| 13.127 || mahīdohe mahānaṃdasaṃdohe viśvamohini|| jātāsi saritāṃ rājñi pāpaṃ hara mahīdrave|| ||ityarghyamaṃtraḥ|| 13.128 || kaṃkaṇaṃ rajatasyāpi yo'tra nikṣipate naraḥ|| sa jāyate mahīpṛṣṭhe dhanadhānyayute kule|| 13.129 || mahīṃ ca sāgaraṃ caiva raupyakaṃkaṇa pūjayā|| pūjayāmi bhavenmā me dravyānāśo daridratā|| 1.2.13.130 || ||kaṃkaṇakṣepaṇam|| yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñaiśca yatphalam|| tatphalaṃ snānadānena mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 13.131 || vivāde ca samutpanne aparādhī ca yo mataḥ|| jalahastaḥ sadā vācyo mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 13.132 || saṃsnāpyāghoramaṃtreṇa sthāpya nābhipramāṇake|| jale karaṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ vācayeddrutam|| 13.133 || yadi dharmo'tra satyo'sti satyaścetsaṃgamastvasau|| satyāścetkratudraṣṭāraḥ satyaṃ syānme śubhāśubham|| 13.134 || evamuktvā karaṃ kṣipya dakṣiṇaṃ sakalaṃ tataḥ|| niḥsṛtaḥ pāpakārī cejjvareṇāpīḍyate kṣaṇāt|| 13.135 || saptāhāddṛśyate cāpi tāvannirdoṣavānmataḥ|| atra snātvā ca japtvā ca tapastaptvā tathaiva ca|| 13.136 || rudralokaṃ subahavo gatāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā|| somavāre viśeṣeṇa snātvā yotra subhaktitaḥ|| 13.137 || paṃca tīrthāni kurute mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ|| ityādyuktaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam|| 13.138 || bhartṛyajñaḥ śivasyo ca teṣāmārādhane kramam|| śivāgamoktamādiśya pūjāyogaṃ yathāvidhi|| 13.139 || śivabhaktisamudraikapūritaḥ prāha tānmuniḥ|| na śivātparamo devaḥ satyametacchivavratāḥ|| 1.2.13.140 || śivaṃ vihāya yo hyānyadasatkiṃcidupāsate|| karasthaṃ so'mṛtaṃ tyaktvā mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ pradhāvati|| 13.141 || śivaśaktimayaṃ hyetatpratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate jagat|| liṃgāṃkaṃ ca bhagāṃkaṃ ca nānyadevāṃkitaṃ kvacit|| 13.142 || yaśca taṃ pitaraṃ rudraṃ tyaktvā mātaramaṃ bikām|| vartate'sau svapitaraṃ tyaktodapitṛpiṃḍakaḥ|| yasya rudrasya māhātmyaṃ śatarūdrīyamuttamam|| 13.143 || śrṛṇudhvaṃ yadi pāpānāmicchadhvaṃ kṣālanaṃ param|| brahmā hāṭakaliṃgaṃ ca samārādhya kapardinaḥ|| 13.144 || jagatpradhānamiti ca nāma japtvā virājate|| kṛṣṇamūle kṛṣṇaliṃgaṃ nāma cārjitameva ca|| 13.145 || sanakādyaiśca talliṃgaṃ pūjyājayurjagadgatim|| darbhāṃkuramayaṃ sapta munayo viśvayonikam|| 13.146 || nāradastvaṃtarikṣe ca jadadbījamidaṃ gṛṇan|| vajramidro liṃgamevaṃ viśvātmānaṃ ca nāma ca|| 13.147 || sūryastāmraṃ tathā liṃgaṃ nāma viśvasṛjaṃ japan|| caṃdraśca mauktikaṃ liṃgaṃ japannāma jagatpatim|| 13.148 || iṃdranīlamayaṃ vahnirnāma viśveśvaraṃ japan|| puṣparāgaṃ guruliṃgaṃ viśvayoniṃ japanharam|| 13.149 || padmarāgamayaṃ śukro viśvakarmeti nāma ca|| hemaliṃgaṃ ca dhanado japannāmnā tatheśvaram|| 1.2.13.150 || raupyajaṃ viśvadevāśca nāmāpi jagatāṃpatim|| vāyavo rītijaṃ liṃgaṃ śaṃbhumityeva nāma ca|| 13.151 || kāśajaṃ vasavo liṃgaṃ svayaṃbhumiti nāma ca|| trilohaṃ mātaro liṃgaṃ nāma bhūteśameva ca|| 13.152 || lauhaṃ ca rakṣasāṃ nāma bhūtabhavyabhavodbhavam|| guhyakāḥ sīsajaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma yogaṃ japaṃti ca|| 13.153 || jaigīṣavyo brahmaraṃdhraṃ nāma yogeśvaraṃ japan|| nimirnayanayorliṃge japañśarveti nāma ca|| 13.154 || dhanvaṃtarirgomayaṃ ca sarvalokeśvareśvaram|| gaṃdharvā dārujaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvaśreṣṭheti nāma ca|| 13.155 || vaiḍūryaṃ rāghavo liṃgaṃ jagajjyeṣṭheti nāma ca|| bāṇo mārakataṃ liṃgaṃ vasiṣṭhamiti nāma ca|| 13.156 || varuṇaḥ sphāṭikaṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā ca parameśvaram|| nāgā vidrumaliṃgaṃ ca nāma lokatrayaṃkaram|| 13.157 || bhāratī tāraliṃgaṃ ca nāma lokatrayāśritam|| śaniśca saṃgamāvarte jagannātheti nāma ca|| 13.158 || śanideśe madhyarātrau mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| jātījaṃ rāvaṇo liṃgaṃ japannāma sudurjayam|| 13.159 || siddhāśca mānasaṃ nāma kāmamṛtyujarātigam|| uṃchajaṃ ca balirliṃgaṃ jñānātmetyasya nāma ca|| 1.2.13.160 || marīcipāḥ puṣpajaṃ ca jñānagamyeti nāma ca|| śakṛtāḥ śakṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ jñānajñeyeti nāma ca|| 13.161 || phenapāḥ phenajaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma cāpi sudurvidam|| kapilo vālukāliṃgaṃ varadaṃ ca japanharam|| 13.162 || sārasvato vācilaṃgaṃ nāma vāgīśvareti ca|| gaṇā mūrtimayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma rudreti cābruvan|| 13.163 || jāṃbūnadamayaṃ devāḥ śitikaṇṭheti nāma ca|| śaṃkhaliṃgaṃ budho nāma kaniṣṭhamiti saṃjapan|| 13.164 || aśvinau mṛnmayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā caiva suvedhasam|| vināyakaḥ piṣṭaliṃgaṃ nāmnā cāpi kapardinam|| 13.165 || nāvanītaṃ kujo liṃgaṃ nāma cāpi karālakam|| tārkṣya odanaliṃgaṃ ca haryakṣeti hi nāma ca|| 13.166 || gauḍaṃ kāmastathā liṃgaṃ ratidaṃ ceti nāma ca|| śacī lavaṇaliṃgaṃ tu babhrukeśeti nāma ca|| 13.167 || viśvakarmā ca prāsādaliṃgaṃ yāmyeti nāma ca|| vibhīṣaṇaśca pāṃsūtthaṃ suhṛttameti nāma ca|| vaṃśāṃkurotthaṃ sagaro nāma saṃgatameva ca|| 13.168 || rāhuśca rāmaṭhaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma gamyeti kīrtayan|| lepyaliṃgaṃ tathā lakṣmīrharinetreti nāma ca|| 13.169 || yoginaḥ sarvabhūtasthaṃ sthāṇurityeva nāma ca|| nānāvidhaṃ manuṣyāśca puruṣaṃnāma nāma ca|| 1.2.13.170 || tejomayaṃ ca ṛkṣāṇi bhagaṃ nāma ca bhāsvaram|| kiṃnarā dhātuliṃgaṃ ca sudīptamiti nāma ca|| 13.171 || devadeveti nāmāsti liṃgaṃ ca brahmarākṣasāḥ|| daṃtajaṃ vāraṇā liṃgaṃ nāma raṃhasameva ca|| 13.172 || saptalokamayaṃ sādhyā bahūrūpeti nāma ca|| dūrvākuramayaṃ liṃgamṛtavaḥ sarvanāma ca|| 13.173 || kaukumamapsaraso liṃgaṃ nāma śaṃbhoḥ priyeti ca|| siṃdūrajaṃ corvaśī ca nāma ca priyavāsanam|| 13.174 || brahmacāri gururliṃgaṃ nāma coṣṇīṣiṇaṃ viduḥ|| alaktakaṃ ca yoginyo nāma cāsya subabhrukam|| 13.175 || śrīkhaṃḍaṃ siddhayoginyaḥ sahasrākṣeti nāma ca|| ḍākinyo māṃsa liṃgaṃ ca nāma cāsya ca mīḍhuṣam|| 13.176 || apyannajaṃ ca manavo giriśeti ca nāma ca|| agastyo vrīhijaṃ vāpi suśāṃtamiti nāma ca|| 13.177 || yavajaṃ devalo liṃgaṃ patimityeva nāma ca|| valmīkajaṃ ca vālmīkiściravāsīti nāma ca|| 13.178 || pratardano bāṇaliṃgaṃ hiraṇyabhujanāma ca|| rājikaṃ ca tathā daityā nāma ugreti kīrtitam|| 13.179 || niṣpāvajaṃ dānavāśca liṃganāma ca dikpatim|| meghā nīramayaṃ liṃgaṃ parjanyapatināma ca|| 1.2.13.180 || rājamāṣamayaṃ yakṣā nāma bhūtapatiṃ smṛtam|| tilānnajaṃ ca pitaro nāma vṛṣapatistathā|| 13.181 || gautamo gorajamayaṃ nāma gopatireva ca|| vānaprasthāḥ phalamayaṃ nāma vṛkṣāvṛteti ca|| 13.182 || skaṃdaḥ pāṣāṇaliṃgaṃ ca nāma senānya eva ca|| nāgaścāśvataro dhānyaṃ madhyametyasya nāma ca|| 13.183 || puroḍāśamayaṃ yajvā sruvahasteti nāma ca|| yamaḥ kālāyasamayaṃ nāma prāha ca dhanvinam|| 13.184 || yavāṃkuraṃ jāmadagnyo bhargadaityeti nāma ca|| purūravāścāścānnamayaṃ bahurūpeti nāma ca|| 13.185 || māṃdhātā śarkarāliṃgaṃ nāma bāhuyugeti ca|| gāvaḥ payomayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma netrasahasrakam|| 13.186 || sādhyā bhartṛmayaṃ liṃgaṃ nāma viśvapatiḥ smṛtam|| nārāyaṇo naro mauṃjaṃ sahasraśiranāma ca|| 13.187 || tārkṣyaṃ pṛthustathā liṃgaṃ sahasracaraṇābhidham|| pakṣiṇo vyomaliṃgaṃ ca nāma sarvātmaketi ca|| 13.188 || pṛthivī meruliṃgaṃ ca dvitanuścāsya nāma ca|| bhasmaliṃgaṃ paśupatirnāma cāsya maheśvaraḥ|| 13.189 || ṛṣayo jñānaliṃgaṃ ca cirasthāneti nāma ca|| brāhmaṇā brahmaliṃgaṃ ca nāma jyeṣṭheti taṃ viduḥ|| 1.2.13.190 || gorocanamayaṃ śeṣo nāma paśupatiḥ smṛtam|| vāsukirviṣaliṃgaṃ ca nāma vai śaṃkareti ca|| 13.191 || takṣakaḥ kālakūṭākhyaṃ bahurūpeti nāma ca|| hālāhalaṃ ca karkoṭa ekākṣa iti nāma ca|| 13.192 || śrṛṃgī viṣamayaṃ padmo nāma dhūrjaṭireva ca|| putraḥ pitṛmayaṃ liṃgaṃ viśvarūpeti nāma ca|| 13.193 || pāradaṃ ca śivā devī nāma tryambaka eva ca|| matsyādyāḥ śāstraliṃgaṃ ca nāma cāpi vṛṣākapiḥ|| 13.194 || evaṃ kiṃ bahunoktena yadyatsattvaṃ vibhūtimat|| jagatyāmasti tajjātaṃ śivārādhanayogataḥ|| 13.195 || bhasmano yadi vṛkṣatvaṃ jñāyate nīrasevanāt|| śivabhaktivihīnasya tato'sya phalamucyate|| 13.196 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yadi prāptau bhavenmatiḥ|| tato haraḥ samārādhyastrijagatyāḥ prado mataḥ|| 13.197 || ya idaṃ śatarudrīyaṃ prātaḥprātaḥ paṭhiṣyati|| tasya prītaḥ śivo devaḥ pradāsyatyakhilānvarān|| 13.198 || nātaḥ paraṃ puṇyatamaṃ kiṃcidasti mahāphalam|| sarvavedarahasyaṃ ca sūryeṇoktamidaṃ mama|| 13.199 || vācā ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ manasā vāpyupārjitam|| pāpaṃ tannāśamāyāti kīrtite śatarudriye|| 1.2.13.200 || rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt|| bhayānmucyeta bhītaśca japedyaḥ śatarudriyam|| 13.201 || nāmnāṃ śatena yaḥ kumbhaiḥ puṣpaistāvadbhirīśvaram|| praṇāmānāṃ śatenāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ|| 13.202 || liṃgānāṃ śatametacca śatamārādhakāstathā|| nāmāni ca śataṃ sarvadoṣasaṃnāśakaṃ smṛtam|| 13.203 || viśeṣādeṣu liṃgeṣu yaḥ paṭhiṣyati paṃcasu|| paṃcabhirviṣayodbhūtaiḥ sa doṣaiḥ parimucyate|| 13.204 || ||nārada uvāca|| niśamyaivaṃ prārthyate'pi guptakṣetre mudānvitāḥ|| paṃcaliṃgānayarcayaṃtaḥ śivadhyānaparābhavan|| 13.205 || tato bahutithe kāle pratyakṣībhūya śaṃkaraḥ|| prāhatānmudito devasteṣāṃ bhaktiviśeṣataḥ|| 13.206 || ||śiva uvāca|| bakolūkagṛdhrakūrmā indradyumna ca pārthiva|| sārūpyāṃ muktimāpannā malloke nivasiṣyatha|| 13.207 || lomaśaścāpi mārkaṃḍo jīvanmuktau bhaviṣyataḥ|| ityukte devadevena liṃgaṃ sthāpitavānnṛpaḥ|| 13.208 || indradyumneśvaraṃ nāma mahākālākhyamityuta|| jñātvā tīrthaguṇānrājā kīrtimicchaṃściraṃtanīm|| 13.209 || triramyamatulaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpyedamuvāca ha|| yāvaccaṃdraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī|| 1.2.13.210 || indradyumneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ naṃdatācchāśvatīḥ samāḥ|| tatastatheti bhagavācchivaḥ procyābravītpunaḥ|| 13.211 || atra yo niyataṃ liṃgamaiṃdradyumnaṃ prapūjayet|| sa gaṇo jāyate nūnaṃ mama loke nivatsyati|| 13.212 || ityuktvā saha taiścaiva paṃcabhiḥ śaśiśekharaḥ|| rudralokama gāddevaste'pi jātā gaṇāḥ punaḥ|| 13.213 || evaṃ prabhāvo rājābhūdiṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ|| yajatā yena vīreṇa nirmiteyaṃ mahīnadī|| 13.214 || evaṃvidhaḥsa puṇyo'yaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| abhūttato'pi saṃkṣepāttava pārtha prakīrtitaḥ|| 13.215 || snātvātra saṃgame yaśca indradyumneśvaraṃ naraḥ|| pūjayettasya vāsaḥ syādyatreśaḥ pārvatīpatiḥ|| 13.216 || sarvabandhaharaṃ liṃgaṃ gāṇapatyapradaṃ tvidam|| yato bandhānvihāyaiva sthāpitaṃ tena phālalguna|| 13.217 || itīdamuktaṃ tava puṇyakāri māhātmyamasyottamasaṃgamasya|| māhātmyamatyadbutapuṇyamindradyumneśvarasyāpi ca puṇyakāri|| 13.218 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahīsāgarasaṃgamamāhātmyaśatarudriyaliṃgamāhātmyendradyumneśvaraliṃgamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13 || cha ||
<1.2.14>
||arjuna uvāca|| kumāranāthamāhātmyaṃ yattvayoktaṃ kathāṃtare|| tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa mahāmune|| 14.1 || ||nārada uvāca|| tārakaṃ vinihatyaiva vajrāṃgatanayaṃ prabhuḥ|| guhaḥ saṃsthāpayāmāsa liṃgametacca phālguna|| 14.2 || darśanācchravaṇāddhyānātpūjayā śrutivaṃdanaiḥ|| sarvapāpāpahaḥ pārtha kumāreśo na saṃśayaḥ|| 14.3 || ||arjuna uvāca|| atyāścaryamayī ramyā katheyaṃ pāpanāśinī|| vistareṇa ca me brūhi yāthātathyena nārada|| 14.4 || vajrāṃgaḥ kopyasau daityaḥ kiṃprabhāvaśca tārakaḥ|| kathaṃ sa nihataścaiva jātaścaiva kathaṃ guhaḥ|| 14.5 || kathaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kumāreśvarasaṃjñitam|| kiṃ phalaṃ cāsya liṃgasya brūhi tadvistarānmama|| 14.6 || ||nārada uvāca|| praṇipatya kumārāya senānye ceśvarāya ca|| śrṛṇu caikamanāḥ pārtha kumāracaritaṃ mahat|| 14.7 || mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putro dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ|| ṣaṣṭiṃ so'janayatkanyā vīriṇyāṃ nāma phālguna|| 14.8 || dado sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa|| saptaviṃśatiṃ somāya catasroriṣṭanemine|| 14.9 || bhūtāṃgiraḥ kṛśāśvebhyo dvedve caiva dadau prabhuḥ|| nāmadheyānyamūṣāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ ca me śrṛṇu|| 1.2.14.10 || yāsāṃ prasūtiprabhavā lokā āpūritāstrayaḥ|| bhānurlambā kakudbhūmirviśvā sādhyā marutvatī|| 14.11 || vasursuhūrtā saṃkalpā dharmapatnyaḥ sutāñchṛṇu|| bhānostu devaṛṣabha suto'bhavat|| 14.12 || vidyota āsīllaṃbāyāṃ tataśca stanayitnavaḥ|| kakudaḥ śakaṭaḥ putraḥ kīkaṭastanayo yataḥ|| 14.13 || bhuvo durgastathā svargo naṃdaścaiva tato'bhavat|| viśvedevāśca viśvāyā aprajāṃstānpracakṣate|| 14.14 || sādhyā dvādaśa sādhyāyā arthasiddhistu tatsutaḥ|| marutvānsujayaṃtaśca marutvatyā babhūvatuḥ|| 14.15 || naranārāyaṇau prāhuryau tau jñānavido janāḥ|| vasośca vasavaścāṣṭau muhūrtāyāṃ muhūrtakāḥ|| 14.16 || ye vai phalaṃ prayacchaṃti bhūtānāṃ svaṃ svakālajam|| saṃkalpāyāśca saṃkalpaḥ kāmaḥ saṃkalpajaḥ sutaḥ|| 14.17 || surūpāsūta tanayānrudrānekādaśaiva tu|| kapālī piṃgalo bhīmo virupākṣo vilohitaḥ|| 14.18 || ajakaḥ śāsanaḥ śāstā śaṃbhuścāṃtyo bhavastathā|| rudrasya pārṣadāścānye virūpāyāḥ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 14.19 || prajāpateraṃgirasaḥ svadhā patnī pitṝnatha|| jajñe sanī(cī?)tathā putramatharvāgirasaṃ prabhum|| 1.2.14.20 || kṛśāśvasya ca dve bhārye arciśca diṣaṇā tathā|| astragāmo yayoḥ putraḥ sasaṃhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 14.21 || pataṃgī yāminī tāmrā timiścāriṣṭaneminaḥ|| pataṃgyasūta patagānyāminī śalabhānatha|| 14.22 || tāmrāyāḥ śyenagṛdhrādyāstimeryādogaṇāstathā|| atha kaśyapapatnīnāṃ yatprasūdamidaṃ jagat|| 14.23 || śrṛṇu nāmāni lokānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ śaṃkarāṇi ca|| aditirditirdanuḥ siṃhī danāyuḥ surabhistathā|| 14.24 || ariṣṭā vinatā grāvā dayā krodhavaśā irā|| kadrurmuniśca te cobhe mātarastāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 14.25 || ādityāścāditeḥ putrā diterdaityāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| danośca dānavāḥ proktā rāhuḥ siṃhīsuto grahaḥ|| 14.26 || danāyuṣastathā jāto danāyuśca gaṇo balī|| gāvaśca surabherjātāriṣṭāputrā yugaṃdharāḥ|| 14.27 || vinatāsūta aruṇaṃ garuḍaṃ ca mahābalam|| grāvāyāḥ śvāpadāḥ putrā gaṇaḥ krodhavaśastathā|| 14.28 || jātaḥ krodhavaśāyāśca irāyā bhūruhāḥ smṛtāḥ|| kadrūsutāḥ smṛtā nāgā munerapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| 14.29 || tatra dvau tanayau yau ca ditestau viṣṇunā hatau|| hiraṇyakaśipurvīro hiraṇyākṣastathā'paraḥ|| 1.2.14.30 || tato nihataputrā sā ditirārādhya kaśyapam|| ayācata varaṃ devī putramanyaṃ mahābalam|| 14.31 || samare śakrahaṃtāraṃ sa tasyā adadātprabhuḥ|| niyame cāpi vartasva varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam|| 14.32 || ityuktā sā tathā cakre puṣkarasthā samāhitā|| vartaṃtyā niyame tasyāḥ sahasrākṣaḥ samāhitaḥ|| 14.33 || upāsāmācaradbhaktyā sā cainamanvamanyata|| daśavatsaraśeṣasya sahasrasya tadā ditiḥ|| 14.34 || uvāca śakraṃ suprītā bhaktyā śakrasya toṣitā|| ||ditiruvāca|| atrottīrṇavrataprāyāṃ viddhi devasattama|| 14.35 || bhaviṣyati tava bhrātā tena sārdhamimāṃ śriyam|| bhokṣyase tvaṃ yathānayāyaṃ trailokyaṃ hatakaṃṭakam|| 14.36 || ityuktvā nidrayāviṣṭā caraṇākrāṃtamūrdhajā|| divā suptā ditirdevī bhāvyarthabalanoditā|| 14.37 || tattu raṃdhramavekṣyaiva yogamūrtistadāviśat|| jaṭharasthaṃ ditergarbhaṃ cakre vajreṇa saptadhā|| 14.38 || ekaikaṃ ca punaḥ khaṇḍaṃ cakāra maghavā tataḥ|| saptadhā saptadhā kopādudbudhya ca tato ditiḥ|| 14.39 || na haṃtavyo na haṃtavya iti sā śakramabravīt|| vajreṇa kṛttyamānānāṃ buddhā sā rodanena ca|| 1.2.14.40 || tataḥ śakraśca mā rodīriti tāṃstānyathā'vadat|| nirgatya jaṭharāttasmāttataḥ prāṃjaliragrataḥ|| 14.41 || uvāca vākyaṃ cātrasto mātaraṃ riṣapūritām|| divāsvāpaṃ kṛthā mātaḥ pādākrāṃtaśiroruhā|| 14.42 || suptātha suciraṃ vāte dhinno garbho mayā tava|| kṛtā ekonapaṃcāśadbhāgā vajreṇa te sutāḥ|| 14.43 || satyaṃ bhavatu te vākyaṃ sārdhaṃ bhokṣyāmi taiḥ śriyam|| dāsyāmi teṣāṃ sthānāni divi yāvadahaṃ dite|| 14.44 || mā rodīriti me proktāḥ khyātāśca marutastviti|| ityuktā sā ca savrīḍā ditirjātā niruttarā|| 14.45 || sārdhaṃ tairgatavāniṃdro digaṃte vāyavaḥ smṛtāḥ|| tataḥ punaśca bhartāraṃ ditiḥ provāca duḥkhitā|| 14.46 || putraṃ me bhagavandehi śakrahaṃtāramūrjitam|| yo nāstraśastrairvadhyatvaṃ gacchettridivavāsinām|| 14.47 || na dadāsyuttaraṃ viddhi mṛtāmeva prajāpate|| ityuktaḥ sa tadovāca tāṃ patnīmatiduḥkhitām|| 14.48 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi taponiṣṭhā tu tapsyase|| vajrasāramayairaṃgairacchedyairāyasairdṛḍhaiḥ|| 14.49 || vajrāṃgonāma putraste bhavitā dharmavatsalaḥ|| sā tu labdhavarā devī jagāma tapase vanam|| 1.2.14.50 || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapo ghoraṃ samācarat|| tapasoṃ'te bhagavatī janayāmāsa durjayam|| 14.51 || putramapratikarmāṇamajeyaṃ vajraduśchidam|| sa jātāmātra evābhūtsarvaśā strārthapāragaḥ|| 14.52 || uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā mātaḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham|| tamuvāca tato hṛṣṭā ditirdaityādhipaṃ sutam|| 14.53 || bahavo me hatāḥ putrāḥ sahasrākṣeṇa putraka|| teṣaāmapacitiṃ kartumicche śakravadhādaham|| 14.54 || bāḍhamityeva saṃ procya jagāma tridivaṃ balī|| sasainyaṃ samare śakraṃ sa ca bāhvāyudho'jayat|| 14.55 || pādenākṛṣya deveṃdraṃ siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā|| māturaṃtikamāgacchadyācamānaṃ bhayāturam|| 14.56 || etasminnaṃtare brahmā kaśyapaśca mahātapāḥ|| āgatā tatra saṃtrastāvatho brahmā jagāda tam|| 14.57 || muṃcāmuṃ putra yācaṃtaṃ kimanena prayojanam|| avamāno vadhaḥ prokto vīrasaṃbhāvitasya ca|| 14.58 || asmadvākyena yo mukto jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ|| śatruṃ ye ghnaṃti samare na te vīrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 14.59 || kṛtvā mānapariglaniṃ ye muṃcaṃti varā hi te|| yatāmānyatamaṃ matvā tvayā māturvacaḥ kṛtam|| 1.2.14.60 || tathā piturvacaḥ kāryaṃ muṃcāmuṃ putra vāsavam|| etacchrutvā tu vajrāṃgaḥ praṇato vākyamabravīt|| 14.61 || na me kṛtyamanenāsti māturājñā kṛtā mayā|| tvaṃ surāsuranātho vai mama ca prapitāmahaḥ|| 14.62 || kariṣye tvadvaco deva eṣa muktaḥ śatakratuḥ|| na ca kāṃkṣe śakrabhuktāmimāṃ trailokyarājatām|| 14.63 || parabhuktā yathā nārī parabhuktāmivasrajam|| yacca tribhuvaneṣvasti sāraṃ tanmama kathyatām|| 14.64 || ||brahmovāca|| tapaso na paraṃ kiṃcittapo hi mahatāṃ dhanam|| tapasā prāpyate sarvaṃ tapoyogyo'si putraka|| 14.65 || ||vajrāṃga uvāca|| tapase me ratirdeva na vighnaṃ tatra me bhavet|| tvatprasādena bhagavannityuktvā virarāma saḥ|| 14.66 || ||brahmovāca|| krūrabhāvaṃ parityajya yadīcchasi tapaḥ suta|| anayā cittabuddhyā tattvayāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam|| 14.67 || ityuktvā padmajaḥ kanyāṃ sasarjjayatalocanām|| tāmasmai pradadau devaḥ patnyarthaṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ|| 14.68 || varāṃgīti ca nāmāsyāḥ kṛtavāṃśca pitāmahaḥ|| jagāma ca tato brahmā kaśyapena samaṃ divam|| 14.69 || vajrāṃgo'pi tayā sārdhaṃ jagāma tapase vanam|| ūrddhūbāhuḥ sa daityeṃdro'tiṣṭhadabdasahasrakam|| 1.2.14.70 || kālaṃ kamalapatrākṣaḥ śuddhabuddhirmahātapāḥ|| tāvānadhomukhaḥ kālaṃ tāvatpaṃcāgnisādhakaḥ|| 14.71 || nirāhāro ghoratapāstaporāśirajāyata|| tataḥ soṃ'tarjale cakre kālaṃ varṣasahasrakam|| 14.72 || jalāṃtarapraviṣṭasya tasya patnī mahāvratā|| tasyaiva tīre sarasastatparā maunamāśritā|| 14.73 || nirāhāraṃ patiṃ matvā tapastepe pativratā|| tasyāstapasi vartaṃtyā iṃdraścakre vibhīṣikām|| 14.74 || bhūtvā tu markaṭākārastasyāabhyāśamāgataḥ|| apavidhya dṛśaṃ tasyā mūtraviṣṭhe cakāra saḥ|| 14.75 || tathā vilolavasanāṃ vilolavadanāṃ tathā|| vilolakeśāṃ tāṃ cakre vidhitsustapasaḥ kṣatim|| 14.76 || tataśca meṣarūpeṇa kleśaṃ tasyāścakāra saḥ|| tato bhujaṃgarūpeṇa baddhā caraṇayordvayoḥ|| 14.77 || apākarṣata dūraṃ sa tasmāddevabhṛtastathā|| tapobālācca sā tasya na vadhyatvaṃ jagāma ha|| 14.78 || kṣamayā ca mahābhāgā krodhamaṇvapi nākarot|| tato gomāyurūpeṇa tamadūṣayadāśramam|| 14.79 || agnirūpeṇa tasyāśca sa dadāha mahāśramam|| cakarṣa vāyurūpeṇa mahogreṇa ca tāṃ śubhām|| evaṃ sihavṛkādyābhirbhīṣikābhiḥ punaḥpunaḥ|| 1.2.14.80 || virarāma yadā naiva vajrāṃgamahiṣī tadā|| śailasya duṣṭatāṃ matvā śāpaṃ dātuṃ vyavasyata|| 14.81 || tāṃ śāpābhimukhīṃ dṛṣṭvā śailaḥ puruṣāvigrahaḥ|| uvāca tāṃ varārohāṃ tvarayātha sulocanām|| 14.82 || ||śaila uvāca|| nāhaṃ mahāvrate duṣṭaḥ sevyo'haṃ sarvadehinām|| atikhedaṃ karotyeṣa tataḥ kruddhastu vṛtrahā|| 14.83 || etasminnaṃtare jātaḥ kālo varṣasahasrikaḥ|| tasminyāte sa bhagavānkāle kamalasaṃbhavaḥ|| 14.84 || tuṣṭaḥ provāca vajrāṃgaṃ tamāgamya jalāśaye|| 14.85 || ||brahmovāca|| dadāmi sarvakāmāṃste uttiṣṭha ditinandana|| evamuktastadotthāya daityeṃdrastapaso nidhiḥ|| uvāca prāṃjalirvākyaṃ sarvalokapitāmaham|| 14.86 || ||vajrāṃga uvāca|| āsuro me'stu mā bhāvaḥ śakrarājye ca mā ratiḥ|| tapodharmaratiścāstu vṛṇomyetatpitāmaha|| 14.87 || evamastviti taṃ brahmā prāha vismitamānasaḥ|| upekṣate ca śakraṃ sa bhāvyarthaṃ ko'tivartate|| 14.88 || ṛṣayo manujā devāḥ śivabrahmamukhā api|| bhāvyarthaṃ nāti vartaṃte velāmiva mahodadhiḥ|| 14.89 || iti ciṃtya viriṃco'pi tatraivāṃtaradhīyata|| vajrāṃgo'pi samāpte tu tapasi sthirasaṃyamaḥ|| 1.2.14.90 || āhāramicchansvāṃ bhāryāṃ na dadarśāśrame svake|| bhāryāhīno'phalaśceti sa saṃciṃtya itastataḥ|| 14.91 || vilokayansvakāṃ bhāryāṃ vidhitsuḥ karma naityakam|| vilokayandadarśātha ihāmutra sahayinīm|| 14.92 || rudantīṃ svāṃ priyāṃ dīnāṃ tarupracchāditānanām|| tāṃ vilokya tato daityaḥ provāca parisāṃtvayan|| 14.93 || ||vajrāṃga uvāca|| kena te'pakṛtaṃ bhīru vartaṃtyāstapasi svake|| kathaṃ rodiṣi vā bāle mayi jīvati bhartari|| kaṃ vā kāmaṃ prayacchāmi śīghraṃ prabrūhi bhāmini|| 14.94 || gṛheśvarīṃ sadguṇabhūṣitāṃ śubhāṃ paṃgvaṃdhayogena patiṃ sametām|| na lālayetpūrayennaiva kāmaṃ sa kiṃ pumānna pumānme matosti|| 14.95 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye vajrāṃgetihāsavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14 || cha ||
<1.2.15>
||varāṃgyuvāca|| nāśitāsmyapaviddhāsmi trāsitā pīḍitāsmi ca|| raudroṇa devanāthena naṣṭanāthena bhūriśaḥ|| 15.1 || duḥkhapāramapaśyaṃtī prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ vyavasthitā|| putraṃ me ghoraduḥkhasya tārakaṃ dehi cetkṛpā|| 15.2 || evamuktastu daityeṃdro duḥkhito'ciṃtayaddhṛdi|| āsureṣvapi bhāveṣu spṛhā yadyapi nāsti me|| 15.3 || tathāpi manye śāstraibhyastvanukaṃpyā priyeti yat|| sarvāśramānupādāya svāśrameṇa kalatravān|| 15.4 || vyasanārṇavamatyeti jalayānairivārṇavam|| yāmāśrityeṃdriyārātīndurjayānitarāśrayaiḥ|| 15.5 || gehino helayā jigyurdasyūndūrga patiryathā|| na ke'pi prabhavastāṃ cāpyanukartuṃ gṛheśvarīm|| 15.6 || athāyuṣā vā kārtsnyena dharme ditsuryathaiva ca|| yasyāṃ bhavati cātmaiva tato jāyā nigadyate|| 15.7 || bhartavyā eva yasmācca tasmādbhāryeti sā smṛtā|| sā eva gṛhamuktaṃ ca gṛhīṇī sā tataḥ smṛtā|| 15.8 || saṃsārakalmaṣāttrātrī kalatramiti sā tataḥ|| evaṃvidhāṃ priyāṃ ko vai nānukaṃpitumarhati|| 15.9 || trīṇi jyotīṃṣi puruṣa iti vai devalo'bravīt|| bhāryā karma ca vidyā ca saṃsādhyaṃ yatnatastrayam|| 1.2.15.10 || tadenāṃ pīḍitāṃ cedyaḥ patirbhūtvā na pālaye|| tato yāsye śāstravādānnarakāṃtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 15.11 || aha mapyenamiṃdraṃ vai śakto jetuṃ yathā'nṛṇām|| punaḥ kāmaṃ kariṣye'syā dāsye putraūṃ mahābalam|| 15.12 || iti saṃciṃtya vajrāṃgaḥ kopavyākulalocanaḥ|| pratikartuṃ maheṃdrāya tapo bhūyo vyavasyata|| 15.13 || jñātvā tu tasya saṃkalpaṃ brahmā krūrataraṃ punaḥ|| ājagāma tvarāyukto yatrā'sau ditinaṃdanaḥ|| 15.14 || uvācainaṃ sa bhagavānprabhurmadhurayā girā|| 15.15 || ||brahmovāca|| kimarthaṃ bhūya eva tvaṃ niyamaṃ krūramicchasi|| āhārābhimukho daitya tanme brūhi mahāvrataḥ|| 15.16 || yāvadabdasahasreṇa nirāhāreṇa vai phalam|| tyajatā prāptamāhāraṃ labdhaṃ te kṣaṇamātrataḥ|| 15.17 || tyāgo hyaprāptakāmānāṃ na tathā ca guruḥ smṛtaḥ|| yathā prāptaṃ parityajya kāmaṃ kamalalocana|| śrutvaitadbrahmaṇo vākyaṃ daityaḥ prāṃjalirabravīt|| 15.18 || ||daitya uvāca|| patnyarthe'haṃ kariṣyāmi tapo ghoraṃ pitāmaha|| putrārthamudyataścāhaṃ yaḥ syādgīrvāṇadarpahā|| 15.19 || etacchrutvā vaco devaḥ padmagarbhodbhavastadā|| uvāca daityarājānaṃ prasannaścaturānanaḥ|| 1.2.15.20 || ||brahmovāca|| alaṃ te tapasā vatsa mā kleśe vistare viśa|| putraste tārakonāma bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ|| 15.21 || devasīmaṃtinīkāmyadhammillakavimokṣaṇaḥ|| ityukto daityarājastu praṇamya prapitāmaham|| 15.22 || visṛjya gatvā mahiṣīṃ naṃdayā māsa tāṃ mudā|| tau daṃpatī kṛtārthau ca jagmatuścāśramaṃ tadā|| 15.23 || āhitaṃ ca tato garbhaṃ varāṃgī varavarṇinī|| pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dadhārodara eva hi|| 15.24 || tato varṣasahasrāṃte varāṃgī samasūyata|| jāyamāne tu daityeṃdre tasmim̐llokabhayaṃkare|| 15.25 || cacāla sakalā pṛthvī proddhūtāśca mahārṇavā|| celurdharādharāścāpi vavurvātā vibhīṣaṇāḥ|| 15.26 || jepurjapyaṃ munivarā vyādhaviddhā mṛgā iva|| jahuḥ kāṃtiṃ ca sūryādyā nīhārāśchāṃdayandiśaḥ|| 15.27 || jāte mahāsure tasminsarva eva mahāsurāḥ|| ājagmurharṣitāstatra tathā cāsurayoṣitaḥ|| 15.28 || jagurharṣasamāviṣṭā nanṛtuścāsurāṃganāḥ|| tato mahotsave jāte dānavānāṃ pṛthāsuta|| 15.29 || viṣaṇṇamanaso devāḥ samaheṃdrāstadābhavan|| jātāmātrastu daityeṃdrastārakaścaṃḍavikramaḥ|| 1.2.15.30 || abhiṣikto'suro daityaiḥ kuraṃgamahiṣādibhiḥ|| sarvāsuramahārājye yutaḥ sarvairmahāsuraiḥ|| 15.31 || sa tu prāptamahārājyastārakaḥ pāṃḍusattama|| uvāca dānavaśreṣṭhānyuktiyuktamidaṃ vacaḥ|| 15.32 || śrṛṇudhvamasurāḥ sarve vākyaṃ mama mahābalāḥ|| śrutvā vaḥ stheyasī buddhiḥ kriyatāṃ vacane mama|| 15.33 || asmākaṃ jātidharmeṇa virūḍhaṃ vairamakṣayam|| kariṣyāmyahaṃ tadvairaṃ teṣāṃ ca vijayāya ca|| 15.34 || kiṃ tu tattapasā sādhyaṃ manyehaṃ surasaṃgamam|| tasmādādau kariṣyāmi tapo ghoraṃ danoḥ sutāḥ|| 15.35 || tataḥ surānvijeṣyāmo bhokṣyāmo'tha jagattrayam|| yuktopāyo'hi puruṣaḥ sthiraśrīreva jāyate|| 15.36 || ayuktaścapalaḥ prāptāmapi rakṣitumakṣamaḥ|| tacchrutvā dānavāḥ sarve vākyaṃ tasyāsurasya tu|| 15.37 || sādhusādhvityathocuste vacanaṃ tasya vismitāḥ|| so'gacchatpāriyātrasya gireḥ kaṃdaramuttamam|| 15.38 || sarvartukusumākīrṇanānauṣadhividipitam|| nānādhāturasasrāvicitranānāgṛhāśrayam|| 15.39 || anekākārabahulaṃ pṛthakpakṣikulākulam|| nānāprasravaṇopetaṃ nānāvidhajalāśayam|| 1.2.15.40 || prāpya tatkaṃdaraṃ daityaścakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ|| vahanpāśupatīṃ dīkṣāṃ paṃca maṃtrāñjajāpa saḥ|| 15.41 || nirāhāraḥ paṃcatapā varṣāyutamabhūtkila|| tataḥ svadehādutkṛttya karṣaṃkarṣaṃ dinedine|| 15.42 || māṃsasyāgnau juhāvaiva tato nirmāṃsatāṃ gataḥ|| tato nirmāṃsadehaḥ sa taporāśirajāyata|| 15.43 || jajvaluḥ sarvabhūtāni tejasā tasya sarvataḥ|| udvignāśca surāḥ sarve tapasā tasya bhīṣitāḥ|| 15.44 || etasminnaṃtare brahmā paramaṃ toṣamāgataḥ|| tārakasya varaṃ dātuṃ jagāma śikharaṃ gireḥ|| 15.45 || prāpya taṃ śailarājānaṃ haṃsasyaṃdanamāsthitaḥ|| uvāca tārakaṃ devo girā madhurayā tadā|| 15.46 || ||brahmovāca|| uttiṣṭha putra tapaso nāstyasādhyaṃ tavādhunā|| varaṃ vṛṇīṣvābhimataṃ yatte manasi vartate|| 15.47 || ityuktastārako daityaḥ prāṃjaliḥ prāha taṃ vibhum|| 15.48 || ||tāraka uvāca|| vayaṃ prabho jātidharmāḥ kṛtavairāḥ sahamaraiḥ|| taiśca niḥśeṣitā daityāḥ kṛtāḥ krūrainṛśaṃ savat|| 15.49 || teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā bhaveyamiti me matiḥ|| avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāmastrāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām|| 1.2.15.50 || syāmahaṃ cāmaraiścaiṣa varo mama hṛdisthitaḥ|| etanme dehi deveśa nānyaṃ vai rocaye varam|| 15.51 || tamuvāca tato daityaṃ viraṃco'maranāyakaḥ|| na yujyate vinā mṛtyuṃ dehino dehadhāraṇam|| jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyuḥ satyametacchrutīritam|| 15.52 || iti saṃciṃtya varaya varaṃ yasmānna śaṃkase|| tataḥ saṃciṃtya daityeṃdraḥ śiśutaḥ saptavāsarāt|| 15.53 || ||tāraka uvāca|| vāsarāṇāṃ ca saptānāṃ varjayitvā tu bālakam|| devānāmapyavadhyo'haṃ bhūyāsaṃ tena yācitaḥ|| 15.54 || vavre mahāsuro mṛtyuṃ brahmāṇaṃ mānamohitaḥ|| brahmā proce tatastaṃ ca tatheti haravākyataḥ|| 15.55 || jagāma tridivaṃ devo daityo'pi svakamālayam|| uttīrṇaṃ tapasastaṃ ca daityaṃ daityeśvarāstadā|| 15.56 || parivavruḥ phalākīrṇaṃ vṛkṣaṃ śakunayo yathā|| tasminmahati rājyasthe tārake ditinaṃdane|| 15.57 || brahmaṇābhihi tasthāne mahārṇavataṭottare|| taravo jajñire pārtha tatra sarvartavaḥ śubhāḥ|| 15.58 || kāṃtirdyutirdhṛtirmedhā śrīrakhaṃḍā ca dānavam|| parivavrurguṇā kīrṇaṃ niśchidrāḥ sarva eva hi|| 15.59 || kālāgaruviliptāṃgaṃ mahāmukuṭamaṃḍitam|| rucirāṃgadasannaddhaṃ mahāsiṃhāsane sthitam|| 1.2.15.60 || nṛtyaṃtyapsarasaḥ śreṣṭhā gandharvā gāyayaṃti ca|| candrārkau dīpamārgeṣu vyajaneṣu ca mārutaḥ|| grahā agresarāstasya jīvādeśaprabhāṣiṇaḥ|| 15.61 || evaṃ svakādbāhubalātsa daityaḥ saṃprāpya rājyaṃ parimodamānaḥ|| kadācidābhāṣya jagāda maṃtriṇaḥ proddhṛttasarvāṃgabalena darpitaḥ|| 15.62 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikakhaṇḍe kumāreśamāhātmaye tārakāsurotpattivarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15 || cha ||
<1.2.16>
|| tāraka uvāca|| rājyena budbudābhena strībhirakṣaiśca pānakaiḥ|| mohito janma labdhvātra tyajate pauruṣaṃ naraḥ|| 16.1 || janma tasya vṛthā sarvamākalpāṃtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 16.2 || mātāpitṛbhyāṃ na karoti kāmānbandhūnaśokānna karoti yo vā|| kīrtiṃ hi vā nārjayate na mānaṃ naraḥ sa jāto'pi mṛto'tra loke|| 16.3 || tasmājjayāyāmarapuṃgavānāṃ trailokyalakṣmīharaṇāya śīghram|| saṃyojyatāṃ me rathamaṣṭacakraṃ balaṃ ca me durjayadaityacakram|| 16.4 || dhvajaṃ ca me kāṃcanapaṭṭabandhaṃ chatraṃ ca me mauktikajālabaddham|| adyāhamāsāṃ surakāminīnāṃ dhammīllakāṃścāgrathitānkariṣye|| 16.5 || yathā purā markaṭako jananyāstasyāśca satyena tu tārakaḥ syām|| 16.6 || ||nārada uvāca|| tārakasya vacaḥ śrutvā grasanonāma dānavaḥ|| senānīrdaityarājasya tathā cakre'vilaṃbitam|| 16.7 || āhatya bherīṃ gambhīrāṃ daityānāhūya satvaraḥ|| sajjaṃ cakre rathaṃ daityo daityarājasya dhīmataḥ|| 16.8 || garuḍānāṃ sahasreṇa garuḍopamitatviṣā|| te hi putrāḥ suparṇasya saṃsthitā merukandare|| 16.9 || vijitya daityarājena vāhanatve prakalpitāḥ|| aṣṭāṣṭacakraḥ sarathaścaturyojanavistṛtaḥ|| 1.2.16.10 || nānākrīḍāgṛhayuto gītavādyamanoharaḥ|| gaṃdharvanagarākāraḥ saṃyuktaḥ pratyadṛsyata|| 16.11 || ājagmustatra daityāśca daśā caṃḍaparākramāḥ|| koṭikoṭiparivārā anye ca bahavo raṇe|| 16.12 || teṣāmagresaro jambhaḥ kujambhonaṃtarastathā|| mahiṣaḥ kuñjaro meṣaḥ kālanemirnimistathā|| 16.13 || mathano jaṃbhakaḥ śumbho daityeṃdrā daśa nāyakāḥ|| daityeṃdrā girivarṣmāṇaḥ saṃti caṃḍaparākramāḥ|| 16.14 || nānāvidhapraharaṇā nānāśastrāstrapāragāḥ|| tārakasyābhavatketurbahūrūpo mahābhayaḥ|| 16.15 || kvacicca rākṣaso ghoraḥ piśācadhvāṃkṣagṛdhrakaḥ|| evaṃ bahuvidhākāraḥ sa ketuḥ pratyadṛśyata|| 16.16 || ketunā makareṇāpi senānīrgrasano babhau|| paiśācaṃ yatra vadanaṃ jaṃbhasyāsīdayasmayam|| 16.17 || kharo vidhutalāṃgūlaḥ kujambhasyābhavaddhaje|| mahiṣasya ca gomāyuḥ kāṃto haimastathāṃ babhau|| 16.18 || gṛdhro vai kuṃjarasyāsīnmeṣasyābhūcca rākṣasaḥ|| kālanemermahākālo nimerāsīnmahātimiḥ|| 16.19 || rākṣasī mathanasyāpi dhvāṃkṣo'bhūjjaṃbhakasya ca|| mahāvṛkaśca śumbhasya dhvajā evaṃvidhā babhuḥ|| 1.2.16.20 || anekākāravinyāsādanyeṣāṃ ca dhvajā bhavan|| śatena śīghravegānāṃ vyāghrāṇāṃ hemamālinām|| 16.21 || grasanasya ratho yukto mahāmegharavo babhau|| śatena cāpi siṃhānāṃ ratho jaṃbhasya yojitaḥ|| 16.22 || kujaṃbhasya ratho yuktaḥ piśācavadanaiḥ kharaiḥ|| tāvadbhirmahiṣasyoṣṭairgajasya ca hayairyutaḥ|| 16.23 || meṣasya dvīpibhirbhīmaiḥ kuñjaraiḥ kālaneminaḥ|| parvataṃ vai samārūḍho niścitya vidhṛtaṃ gajaiḥ|| 16.24 || caturdaṃṣṭrairgaṃdhavadbhiścarbhirmeghasannibhaiḥ|| śatahastāyate kṛṣṇe turaṃge hemabhūṣaṇe|| 16.25 || sitacāmarajālena śobhite puṣpadāmani|| mathanonāma daityendraḥ pāśahasto vyarājata|| 16.26 || kiṃkiṇīmālinaṃ coṣṭramārūḍho'bhūcca jaṃbhakaḥ|| kālamuṃcaṃ mahāmeghamārūḍhaḥ śumbhadānavaḥ|| 16.27 || anye ca dānavā vīrā nānāvāhanahetayaḥ|| pracaṇḍacitravarmāṇaḥ kuṇḍaloṣṇīṣabhūṣitāḥ|| 16.28 || nānāvidhottarāsaṃgā nānāmālyavibhūṣaṇāḥ|| nānāsugaṃdhagaṃdhāḍhyā nānābaṃdhiśatastutāḥ|| 16.29 || nānāvādyaparisyaṃdasāgresaramahārathāḥ|| nānāśauryakathāsaktāstasminsainye mahārathāḥ|| 1.2.16.30 || tadbalaṃ daityasiṃhasya bhīmarūpaṃ vyadṛśyata|| bhūmireṇusamāliṃgatturaṃgarathapattikam|| 16.31 || sa ca daityeśvaraḥ kruddhaḥ samārūḍho mahāratham|| daśabhiḥ śuśube daityairdaśabāhuriveśvaraḥ|| jagaddhaṃtuṃ pravṛtto vā pratasthe'sau surānprati|| 16.32 || etasminnaṃtare vāyurdevadūtaḥ surālayam|| dṛṣṭvā taddānava balaṃ jagāmeṃdrasya śaṃsitum|| 16.33 || sa gatvā tu sabhāṃ divyāṃ maheṃdrasya mahātmanaḥ|| śaśaṃsa madhye devānāmidaṃ kāryamupasthitam|| 16.34 || tacchrutvā devarājaḥ sa nimīlitavilocanaḥ|| bṛhaspatimuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ kāle mahāmatiḥ|| 16.35 || ||indra uvāca|| saṃprāpto'tivimardo'yaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha|| kāryaṃ kimatra tadbruhi nītyupāyopabṛṃhitam|| 16.36 || etacchrutvā ca vacanaṃ maheṃdrasya girāṃpatiḥ|| pratyuvāca mahābhāgo baॉhaspati rudāradhīḥ|| 16.37 || ||bṛhaspatiruvāca|| sāmapūrvaṃ smṛtā nītiścaturaṃgāmanīkinīm|| jigīṣatāṃ suraśreṣṭha sthitireṣā sanātanī|| 16.38 || sāma dānaṃ ca bhedaśca caturtho daṃḍa eva ca|| nītau kramātprayojyāśca deśakālaviśeṣataḥ|| 16.39 || tatra sāma prayoktavyamāryeṣu guṇavatsu ca|| dānaṃ lubdheṣu bhedaśca śaṃkitoṣvito niścayaḥ|| 1.2.16.40 || daṇḍaścāpi prayoktavyo nityakālaṃ durātmasu|| sāma daityeṣu naivāsti nirguṇatvāddurātmasu|. 16.41 || śriyā teṣāṃ ca kiṃ kāryaṃ samṛddhānāṃ tathāpi yat|| jātidharmeṇa cābhedyā vidhāturapi te matāḥ|| 16.42 || eko hyupāyo daṃḍo'tra bhavatāṃ yadi rocate|| durjanaḥ sujanatvāya kalpate na kadācana|| 16.43 || lālitaḥ pālito vāpi svasvabhāvaṃ na muṃcati|| evaṃ me manyate buddhirbhavaṃto yadvyavasyatām|| 16.44 || evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣa evamevetyuvāca ha|| kartavyatāṃ ca saṃciṃtya provācāmarasaṃsadi|| 16.45 || bahumānena me vācaṃ śrṛṇudhvaṃ nākavāsinaḥ|| 16.46 || bhavaṃto yajñabhoktāraḥ satāmiṣṭāśca sāttvikāḥ|| svesve pade sthitā nityaṃ jagataḥ pālane ratāḥ|| 16.47 || bhavatāṃ ca nimittena bādhaṃte dānaveśvarāḥ|| teṣāṃ samādi naivāsti daṃḍa eva vidhīyatām|| 16.48 || kriyatāṃ samare buddhiḥ sainyaṃ saṃyojyatāmiti|| āvādyaṃtāṃ ca śastrāṇi pūjyaṃ tāṃ śastradevatāḥ|| 16.49 || ityuktāḥ samanahyaṃta devānāṃ ye pradhānataḥ|| vājināmayutenājau hemapaṭṭapariṣkṛtāḥ|| 1.2.16.50 || vāhanāni vimānāni yojayaṃtu mamāmarāḥ|| yamaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ niryāta devatāḥ|| 16.51 || nānāścaryaguṇopetā durjayā devadānavaiḥ|| ratho mātalinā yukto maheṃdrasyāpyadṛśyata|| 16.52 || yamo mahiṣamāsthāya senāgre samavartata|| caṃḍakiṃkiṇivṛṃdena sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ|| 16.53 || kalpakālojjavālāpūritāṃbaragocaraḥ|| hutāśa uraṇārūḍhaḥ śaktihasto vyavasthitaḥ|| 16.54 || pavanoṃ'kuśapāṇistu vistāritamahājavaḥ|| mahāṛkṣaṃ samārūḍhaṃ senāgre samadṛśyata|| 16.55 || bhujagendraṃ samārūḍho jaleśo bhagavānsvayam|| mahāpāśadharo vīraḥ senāyāṃ samavartata|| 16.56 || narayukte rathe divye dhanādhyakṣo vyacīcarat|| mahāsiṃharavo yuddhe gadāhasto vyavasthitaḥ|| 16.57 || rākṣaseśo'tha nirṛtī rathe rakṣomukhairhayaiḥ|| dhanvī rakṣogaṇavṛto mahārāvo vyadṛśyata|| 16.58 || caṃdrādityāvaśvinau ca vasavaḥ sādhyadevatāḥ|| viśvedevāśca rudrāśca sannaddhāstasthurāhave|| 16.59 || hemapīṭhattarāsaṃgāścitravarmāyudhadhvajāḥ|| gaṃdharvāḥ pratyadṛśyanta kṛtvā viśvāvasuṃ mukhe|| 1.2.16.60 || tathā raktottarāsaṃgā nirmalāyovibhūṣaṇāḥ|| gṛdhradhvajā adṛśyaṃta rākṣasā raktamūrdhajāḥ|| 16.61 || tathā bhīmāśanikarāḥ kṛṣṇavastrā mahārathāḥ|| yakṣāstatra vyadṛśyaṃta maṇibhadrādikoṭiśaḥ|| 16.62 || tāmrolūkadhvajā raudrā dvīpicarmāṃbarāstathā|| piśācāstatra rājaṃte mahāvegapuraḥsarāḥ|| 16.63 || tathaiva śvetavasanāḥ sitapaṭṭapatākinaḥ|| mattebhavāhanaprāyāḥ kiṃnarāstasthurāhave|| 16.64 || muktājāla piraṣkāro haṃso hārasamaprabhaḥ|| keturjaladhināthasya saumyarūpo vyarājata|| 16.65 || paṃcarāgamahāratnaviṭaṃko dhanadasya ca|| dhvajaḥ samutthito bhāti yātukāma ivāṃbaram|| 16.66 || kārṣṇalohamayo dhvāṃkṣo yamasyābhūnmahādhvajaḥ|| rākṣaseśasya vadanaṃ pretasya dhvaja ābabhau|| 16.67 || hemasiṃhadhvajau devau candrārkavamitadyuti|| kuṃbhena citravarṇena keturāśvinayorabhūt|| 16.68 || mātaṃgo hemaracitaścitraratnapariṣkṛtaḥ|| dhvajaḥ śatakratorāsītsitacā marasaṃsthitaḥ|| 16.69 || anyeṣāṃ ca dhvajāstatra nānārūpā babhū raṇe|| sanāgayakṣagaṃdharvamahoraganiśācarā|| 1.2.16.70 || senā sā devarājasya durjayā pratyadṛśyata|| koṭayastāstrayastriṃśannānādevakāyinām|| 16.71 || haimācalābhe sitakarṇacāmare suvarṇapadmāmalasuṃdarasraji|| kṛtābhirāmojjvalakuṃkumāṃkure kapolalītāvivimuktarāve|| 16.72 || śritastadairāvaṇanāmakuṃjare mahābalaścitraviśeṣitāṃbaraḥ|| viśālavajrāṃgavitānabhūṣitaḥ prakīrṇakeyūrabhujāgramaṃḍalaḥ|| 16.73 || sahasradṛgbaṃdisahasrasaṃstutastriviṣṭape'śobhata pākaśāsanaḥ|| 16.74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārīkākhaṇḍe tārakāsuradevendrayuddhopakramavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16 ||
<1.2.17>
||nārada uvāca|| tatastayoḥ samāyogaḥ senayorubhayorabhūt|| yugāṃte samanuprāpte yathā kṣubdhasamudrayoḥ|| 17.1 || surāsurāṇāṃ saṃmarde tasminparamadāruṇe|| tumulaṃ sumahatkrāṃte senayorubhayorapi|| 17.2 || garjatāṃ devadaityānāṃ śaṃkhabherīraveṇa ca|| tūryāṇāṃ caiva nirghoṣairmātaṃgānāṃ ca bṛṃhitaiḥ|| 17.3 || heṣitairhayavṛṃdānāṃ rathanemisvanena ca|| ghoṣeṇa caiva tūryāṇāṃ yugāṃta iva cābhavat|| 17.4 || roṣeṇābiparītāṃgāstyaktajīvitacetasaḥ|| samasajjanta tenyonyaṃ prakrameṇātilohitāḥ|| 17.5 || rathā rathaiḥ samāsaktā gajāścāpi mahāgajaiḥ|| pattayaḥ pattibhiścaiva hayāścāpi mahāhayaiḥ|| 17.6 || tataḥ prāsāśanigadābhiṃḍipālaparaśvadhaiḥ|| śaktibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlairmudgaraiḥ kaṇayairguḍaiḥ|| 17.7 || cakraiśca śaktibhiścaiva tomarairaṃkuśairapi|| karṇinālīkanārācavatsadaṃtārddhacaṃdrakaiḥ|| 17.8 || bhallairvetasapatraiśca śukatuṃḍaiśca nirmalaiḥ|| vṛṣṭibhiścādbhutākārairgaganaṃ samapadyata|| 17.9 || saṃpracchādya diśaḥ sarvāstamomayamivābhavat|| prājñāyaṃta na te'nyonyaṃ tasmiṃstamasi saṃkule|| 1.2.17.10 || adṛśyabhūtāstamasi nyakṛṃtaṃta parasparam|| tato bhujairdhvajaiśchatraiḥ śirobhiśca sakuṃḍalaiḥ|| 17.11 || gajaisturaṃgaiḥ pādātaiḥ patadbhiḥ patitairapi|| ākāśaśiraso bhraṣṭaiḥ paṃkajairiva bhūścitā|| 17.12 || bhagnadaṃtā bhinnakuṃbhāśchinnadīrghamahākarāḥ|| gajāḥ śailanibhāḥ peturdharaṇyāṃ rudhirasravāḥ|| 17.13 || bhagnaiṣāśca rathāḥ peturbhagnākṣāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ|| pattayaḥ koṭiśaḥ petusturaṃgāśca sahasraśaḥ|| 17.14 || tataḥ śoṇitanadyaśca harṣadāḥ piśitāśinām|| vaitālānaṃdadāyinyo vyajāyaṃta sahasa3śaḥ|| 17.15 || tasmiṃstathāvidhe yuddhe senānīrgrasano'rihā|| bāṇavarṣeṇa mahatā devasainyamakaṃpayat|| 17.16 || tato grasanamālokya yamaḥ krodhavimūrchitaḥ|| vavarṣa śaravarṣeṇa viśeṣādagnivarcasā|| 17.17 || sa viddho bahubhirṣāṇairgrasano'tiparākramaḥ|| kṛtapratikṛtākāṃkṣī dhanurānamya bhairavam|| 17.18 || śaraiḥ sahasraiśca pañcalakṣaiścaiva vyatāḍayat|| grasanena vimuktāṃstāñcharānsopi nivārya ca|| 17.19 || bāṇavṛṣṭibhirugrābhiryamo grasanamardayat|| kṛtāṃtaśaravṛṣṭīnāṃ saṃtatīḥ pratisarpatīḥ|| ciccheda śaravarṣeṇa grasano dānaveśvaraḥ|| 1.2.17.20 || viphalāṃ tāṃ samālokya yamaḥ svaśarasaṃtatim|| 17.21 || prāhiṇonmudgaraṃ dīptaṃ grasanasya rathaṃ prati|| sa taṃ mudgaramāyāṃtamutpatya rathasattamāt|| 17.22 || jagrāha vāmahastena līlayā grasano'rihā|| tenaiva mudgareṇātha yamasya mahiṣaṃ ruṣā|| 17.23 || tāḍayāmāsa vegena sa papāta mahītale|| utpatyātha yamastasmānmahiṣānnipatiṣyataḥ|| 17.24 || prāsena tāḍayāmāsa grasanaṃ vadane dṛḍham|| sa tu prāptaprahāreṇa mūrchito nyapatadbhuvi|| 17.25 || grasanaṃ patita dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho bhīmaparākramaḥ|| yamasya bhiṃḍipālena prahāramakaroddhṛdi || 17.26 || yamastena prahāreṇa susrāva rudhiraṃ mukhāt|| atigāḍha prahārārttaḥ kṛtāṃtomūrchito'bhavat|| 17.27 || kṛtāṃtamarditaṃ dṛṣṭvā gadāpāṇirdhanādipaḥ|| vṛto yakṣāyutagaṇairjaṃbhaṃ pratyudyayau ruṣaā|| 17.28 || jaṃbho ruṣā tamāyāṃtaṃ dānavā nīkasaṃvṛtaḥ|| jagrāha vākyaṃ rājñastu yatā snigdhena bhāṣitam|| 17.29 || grasano labdhasaṃjño'tha yamasya prāhiṇodgadām|| maṇihemapariṣkārāṃ gurvī parighamardinīm|| 1.2.17.30 || tāmāpataṃtīṃ saṃprekṣya gadāṃ mahiṣavāhanaḥ|| gadāyāḥ pratighātārthaṃ jagajjvalanabhairavam|| 17.31 || daṃḍaṃ mumoca kopena jvālāmālāsamākulam|| sa gadāṃ viyati prāpya rarāsāṃbudharoddhatam|| 17.32 || saṃvaṭṭaścābhavattābhyāṃ śailābhyāmiva duḥsahaḥ|| tābhyāṃ niṣpeṣanirhrāda jaḍīkṛtadigaṃtaram|| 17.33 || jagadvyākulatāṃ yātaṃ pralayāgamaśaṃkayā|| kṣaṇātpraśāṃtanirhrādaṃ jvaladulkāsamācitam|| 17.34 || niṣpeṣaṇaṃ tayorbhīmama bhūdganagocaram|| nihatyātha gadāṃ daṇḍastato grasanamūrdhani|| 17.35 || papāta pauruṣaṃ hatvā yathā daivaṃ purārjitam|| satu tena prahāreṇa dṛṣṭvā satimirādiśaḥ|| 17.36 || papāta bhūmau niḥsaṃjño bhūmireṇuvibhūṣitaḥ|| tato hāhāravo ghoraḥ senayorubhayorabhūt|| 17.37 || tato mahūrtamātreṇa grasanaḥ prāpya cetanām|| apaśyatsvāṃ tanuṃ dhvastāṃ vilolābharaṇāṃbarām|| 17.38 || sa cāpi ciṃtayāmāsa kṛtapratikṛtakriyām|| dhigastu pauruṣaṃ mahyaṃ prabhoragresaraḥ katham|| 17.39 || mayyāśritāni sainyāni jite mayi jitāni ca|| asaṃbhāvitarūpo hi sajjano modate sukham|| 1.2.17.40 || saṃbhāvitastvaśaktaścettasya nāyaṃ paro'pi vā|| evaṃ saṃciṃtya vegena samuttasthau mahābalaḥ|| 17.41 || mudgaraṃ kāladaṇḍābhaṃ gṛhītvā girisaṃnibham|| grasano ghorasaṃkalpaḥ saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭacchadaḥ|| 17.42 || rathena tvarito'gacchadāsasādāṃtakaṃ raṇe|| samāsādya yamaṃ yuddhe grasano bhrāmya mudgaram|| 17.43 || vegena mahatā raudraṃ cikṣepa yamamūrdhani|| vilokya mudgaraṃ dīptaṃ yamaḥ saṃbhrāṃtalocanaḥ|| 17.44 || vaṃcayāmāsa durddharṣaṃ mudgaraṃ taṃ mahābalaḥ|| tasminnapasṛte dūraṃ caṃḍānāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām|| 17.45 || yāmyānāṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ ca ayutaṃ niṣpipeṣa ha|| tatastadayutaṃ dṛṣṭvā hataṃ kiṃkaravāhinī|| 17.46 || daśārbudamitā kruddhā grasanāyānvadhāvata|| grasanastu samālokya tāṃ kiṃkaramayāṃ śubhām|| 17.47 || mene yamasahasrāṇi tādṛgrūpabalā hi sā|| vigāhya grasanaṃ senā vavarṣa śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ|| 17.48 || kalpāṃtaghorasaṃkāśo babhūva sa mahāraṇaḥ|| kecicchailena bibhiduḥ kecidbāṇairajihyagaiḥ|| 17.49 || pipiṣurgadayā kecitkocinmudgaravṛṣṭibhiḥ|| kecitprāsaprahāraiśca tāḍayāmāsuruddhatāḥ|| 1.2.17.50 || apare kiṃkarāstasya lalaṃburbāhumaṃḍale|| śilābhirapare jaghnurdrumairanye mahocchrayaiḥ|| 17.51 || tasyāpare ca gātreṣu daśanāṃścanyapātayan|| apare muṣṭibhiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kiṃkarāstāḍayaṃti ca || 17.52 || evaṃ cābhidrutastaiḥ sa grasanaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ|| utsādya gātraṃ bhūpṛṣṭhe niṣpipeṣa sahasraśaḥ|| 17.53 || kāṃścidutthāya jaghne'sau muṣṭibhiḥ kiṃkarānraṇe|| kāṃścitpādaprahāreṇa dhāvannanyānacūrṇayat|| 17.54 || kṣaṇaikena sa tānninye yamalokāyabhārata|| sa ca kiṃkarayuddhena vavṛdhe'gnirivaidhasā|| 17.55 || tamālokya yamo'śrāṃtaṃ śrāṃtaṃstāṃśca hatānsvakān|| ājagāma samudyamya daṃḍaṃ mahiṣavāhanaḥ|| 17.56 || grasanastu tamāyāṃtamājaghne gadayorasi|| aciṃtayitvā tatkarma grasanasyāṃtako'rihā|| 17.57 || vyāghrāndaṃḍena saṃjaghne sa rathānnya patadbhuvi|| tataḥ kṣaṇena cotthāya saṃciṃtyātmānamuddhataḥ|| 17.58 || vāyuvegena sahasā yayau yamarathaṃ prati|| padātiḥ sa rathaṃ taṃ ca samāruhya yamaṃ tadā|| 17.59 || yodhayāmāsa bāhubhyāmākṛṣya balināṃ varaḥ|| yamo'pi śastrāṇyutsṛjca bāhuyuddhe pravartate|| 1.2.17.60 || grasanaṃ kaṭivastre tu yamaṃ gṛhya balotkaṭaḥ|| bhrāmayāmāsa vegena saṃbhramāviṣṭacetasam|| 17.61 || vimocyātha yamaḥ kaṣṭātkaṃṭhe'vaṣṭabhya cāsuram|| bāhubhyāṃ bhrāmayāmāsa so'pyātmānamamocayat|| 17.62 || tato jaghnaturanyonyaṃ muṣṭibhirnirdayau ca tau|| daityeṃdrasyātivīryatvātpariśrāṃtataro yamaḥ|| 17.63 || skaṃdhe nidhāya daityasya mukhaṃ viśrāṃtimaicchata|| tamā lakṣya tato daityaḥ śrāṃtamutpāṭya caujasā|| 17.64 || niṣpipeṣa mahīpṛṣṭhe vinighnanpārṣṇipāṇibhiḥ|| tato yamasya vadanātsusrāva rudhiraṃ bahu|| 17.65 || nirjīvamiti taṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ saṃtyajya dānavaḥ|| jayaṃ prāpyoddhataṃ nādaṃ muktvā saṃtrāsya devatāḥ|| 17.66 || svakaṃ sainyaṃ samāsādya tasthau giririvācalaḥ|| 17.67 || nādena tasya grasanasya saṃkhye mahāyudhaiścārditasarvagātrāḥ|| gate kṛthāṃte vasudhāṃ ca niṣprabhe cakaṃpire kāṃdiśikāḥ surāste|| 17.68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe tārakasainyadevasainyayormadhye yamagrasanayoryuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17 || cha ||
<1.2.18>
||nārada uvāca|| dhanādhipasya jaṃbhena sāyakairmarmabhedibhiḥ|| diśoparuddhāḥ kruddhena sainyaṃ cābhyarditaṃ bhṛśam|| 18.1 || taddṛṣṭvā karma daityasya dhanādhyakṣaḥ pratāpavān|| ākarṇākṛṣṭacāpastu jaṃbhamājau mahābalam|| 18.2 || hṛdi vivyādha bāṇānāṃ sahasreṇāgnivarcasām|| sa prahasya tato vīro bāṇānāmayutatrayam|| 18.3 || niyutaṃ ca tathā koṭimarbudaṃ cākṣipatkṣaṇāt|| tasya tallāghravaṃ dṛṣaṭvā kruddho gṛhya mahāgadām|| 18.4 || dhanādhyakṣaḥ pracikṣepa svargepsuḥ svadhanaṃ yathā|| muktāyāṃ vai nādo'bhūtpralaye yathā|| 18.5 || bhūtānāṃ bahudhā rāvā jajñire khe mahābhayāḥ|| vāyuśca sumahāñjajñe khamāyānmeghasaṃkulam|| 18.6 || sā hi vaiśravaṇasyāste trailokyābhyarcitā gadā|| āyāṃtīṃ tāṃ samālokya taḍitsaṃghātadurddaśām|| 18.7 || daityo gadāvighātārthaṃ śastravṛṣṭiṃ mumoca ha|| cakrāṇi kuṇapānprāsāñchataghnīḥ paṭṭiśāṃstathā|| 18.8 || parighānmuśalānvṛkṣāngirīṃścātulavikramaḥ|| kadarthīkṛtya śastrāṇi tāni sarvāṇi sā gadā|| 18.9 || kalpāṃtabhāskaro yadvannyapataddaityavakṣasi|| sa tayā gāḍhabhinnaḥ sansaphenarudhiraṃ vaman|| 1.2.18.10 || niḥpapāta rathājjaṃbho vasudhāṃ gatacetanaḥ|| jaṃbhaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kujaṃbho ghoraniścayaḥ|| 18.11 || dhanādhipasya saṃkruddho nādenāpūrayandiśaḥ|| cakre bāṇamayaṃ jālaṃ śakuṃtasyeva paṃjaram|| 18.12 || vicchidya bāṇajālaṃ ca māyājālamivotkaṭam|| mumoca bāṇānaparāṃstasya yakṣādhipo balī|| 18.13 || ciccheda līlayā tāṃśca daityaḥ krodhīva sadvacaḥ|| niṣphalāṃstāṃstato dṛṣṭvā bāṇānkruddho dhanādhipaḥ|| 18.14 || śaktiṃ jagrāha durdharṣāṃ śataghaṃṭāmahāsvanām|| preṣitā sā tadā śaktirdārayāmāsa taṃ hṛti|| 18.15 || yathālpabodhaṃ puruṣaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārasaṃbhavam|| tathāsya hṛdayaṃ bhittvā jagāma dharaṇītalam|| 18.16 || nimeṣātsobhisaṃstambhya dānavo dāruṇākṛtiḥ|| jagrāha paṭṭiśaṃ daityo girīṇāmapi bhedanam|| 18.17 || sa tena paṭṭisenājau dhanadasya stanāṃtaram|| vākyena tīkṣṇarūpeṇa marmākṣaravisarpiṇā|| 18.18 || nirbibhedābhijātasya hṛdayaṃ durjano yathā|| tena paṭṭiśa ghātena dhaneśaḥ| parimūrchitaḥ|| 18.19 || niṣasāda rathopasthe durvācā sujano yathā|| tathāgataṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhaneśaṃ vai mṛtaṃ yathā|| 1.2.18.20 || rākṣaso nirṛtirdevo niśācarabalānugaḥ|| abhidudrāva vegena kujaṃbhaṃ bhīmavikramam|| 18.21 || atha dṛṣṭvātidurdharṣaṃ kujaṃbho rākṣaseśvaram|| nodayāmāsa daityānsa rākṣaseśarathaṃ prati|| 18.22 || sa dṛṣṭvā noditāṃ senāṃ prabalāstrāṃ subhīṣaṇām|| rathādāplutya vegena nirṛtī rākṣaseśvaram|| 18.23 || khaḍgena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa carmapāṇiradhāvata|| praviśya dānavānīkaṃ gajaḥ padmasaro yathā|| 18.24 || loḍayāmāsa bahudhā viniṣkṛtya sahasraśaḥ|| ciccheda kāṃścicchataśo bibhedānyānvarāsinā|| 18.25 || saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhamukhaiḥ pṛthvīṃ daityānāṃ so'bhyapūrayat|| tato niḥśeṣitaprāyāṃ vilokya svāṃ camūṃ tadā|| 18.26 || muktvā dhanapatiṃ daityaḥ kujaṃbho nirṛtiṃ yayau|| labdhasaṃjñastu jaṃbho'pi dhanādhyakṣapadānugān|| 18.27 || jīvagrāhaṃ sa jagrāha baddhā pāśaiḥ sahasradhā|| mūrtimaṃti ca ratnani padmādīṃśca nidhīṃstathā|| 18.28 || vāhanāni ca divyāni vimānāni ca sarvaśaḥ|| dhaneśo labdhasaṃjñastu tāmavasthāṃ vilokya saḥ|| 18.29 || niḥśvasandīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca roṣāttāmravilocanaḥ|| dhyātvāstraṃ gāruḍaṃ divyaṃ bāṇaṃ saṃdhāya kārmuke|| 1.2.18.30 || mumoca dānavānīke taṃ bāṇaṃ śatrudāraṇam|| prathamaṃ kārmukaṃ tasya vahnijvālamadṛśyata|| 18.31 || niścerurvisphuliṃgānāṃ koṭayo dhanuṣastathā|| tato jvālākulaṃ vyoma cakre cāstraṃ samaṃtataḥ|| 18.32 || tadastraṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho bhīmaparākramaḥ|| saṃvartaṃ mumuce tena praśāṃtaṃ gāruḍaṃ tadā|| 18.33 || tatastaṃ dānavo dṛṣṭvā kuberaṃ roṣavihvalaḥ|| abhidudrāva vegena padātirdhanadaṃ nadan|| 18.34 || athābhimukhamāyāṃtaṃ daityaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanādhipaḥ|| babhūva saṃbhramāviṣṭaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ|| 18.35 || tataḥ palāyatastasya mukuṭo ratnamaṃḍitaḥ|| papāta bhūtale dīpto ravibiṃbamivāṃbarāt|| 18.36 || yakṣaṇāmabhijātānāṃ bhagnaṃ pravavṛte raṇāt|| martuṃ saṃgrāma śirasi yuktaṃ no bhūṣaṇāya tat|| 18.37 || iti vyavasya durdharṣā nānāśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ|| yuyutsavastathā yakṣā mukuṭaṃ parivārya te|| 18.38 || abhimāna dhanā vīrā dhanasya padānugāḥ|| tānamarṣācca saṃprekṣya dānavaścaṃḍapauruṣaḥ|| 18.39 || bhuśuṇḍīṃ bhīṣaṇākārāṃ gṛhītvā śailagauravām|| rakṣiṇo mukuṭasyātha niṣpipeṣa niśācarān|| 1.2.18.40 || tānpramathyātha niyutaṃ mukuṭaṃ taṃ svake rathe|| samāropyāmararipurjitvā dhanadamāhave|| 18.41 || dhanāni ca nidhīngṛhya svasainyena samāvṛtaḥ|| nādena mahatā devāndrāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ|| 18.42 || dhanado'pi dhanaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhīto muktamūrdhajaḥ|| padātirekaḥ santrastaḥ prāpyaivaṃ dīnavatsthitaḥ|| 18.43 || kujaṃbhenātha saṃsakto rajanīcaranaṃdanaḥ|| māyāmamoghāmāśritya tāmasīṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ|| 18.44 || mohayāmāsa daityendro jagatkṛtvā tamomayam|| tato viphalanetrāṇi dānavānāṃ balāni ca|| 18.45 || na śekuścalituṃ tatra padādapi padaṃ tadā|| tato nānāstravarṣeṇa dānavānāṃ mahācamūḥ|| 18.46 || jaghāna nirṛtirdevastamasā saṃvṛtā bhṛśam|| hanyamāneṣu daityeṣu kujaṃbhe mūḍhacetasi|| 18.47 || mahiṣo dānavendrastu kalpāṃtāṃ bhodasannibhaḥ|| astraṃ cakāra sāvitramulkāsaṃghātamaṃḍitam|| 18.48 || vijṛṃbhatyatha sāvitre paramāstre prātapini|| praṇāsamagamattīvraṃ tamo ghoramanaṃtaram|| 18.49 || tato'stravisphuliṃgāṃkaṃ tamaḥ śuklaṃ vyajāyata|| protphullāruṇapadmaughaṃ śaradīvāmalaṃ saraḥ|| 1.2.18.50 || tatastamasi saṃśāṃte daityendrāḥ prāptacakṣuṣaḥ|| cakruḥ krureṇa tamasā devānīkaṃ mahādbhutam|| 18.51 || athādāya dhanurghoramiṣuṃ cāśīviṣopamam|| kujaṃbho'dhāvata kṣipraṃ rakṣodevabalaṃ prati|| 18.52 || rākṣasendrastathāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣaṭvā taṃ sa padānugaḥ|| vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiḥ kālāśanisamasvanaiḥ|| 18.53 || nādānaṃ na ca sandhānaṃ na mokṣo vāsya lakṣyate|| cicchedograiḥ śaravrātaistāñcharānatilāghavāt|| 18.54 || dhvajaṃ śareṇa tīkṣṇena nicakartāmaradviṣaḥ|| sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena rathanīḍādapāharat|| 18.55 || kālakalpena bāṇena taṃ ca vakṣasyātāḍayat|| sa tu tena prahāreṇa cakampe pīḍito bhṛśam|| 19.56 || daityeṃdro rākṣasendreṇa kṣitikaṃpenago yathā|| sa suhūrtātsamāśvāsya matvā taṃ durjayaṃ raṇe|| 18.57 || padātirāsādya rathaṃ rakṣo vāmakareṇa ca|| keśeṣu nirṛtiṃ gṛhya jānunākramya ca sthitaḥ|| 18.58 || tataḥ khaḍgena ca śiraśchettumaicchadamarṣaṇaḥ|| tataḥ kalakalo jajñe devānāṃ sumahāṃstadā|| kujaṃbhasya vaśaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirṛtimāhave|| 18.59 || etasminnantare devo varuṇaḥ pāśabhṛddhṛtaḥ|| pāśena dānaveṃdrasya babandhāśu bhujadvayam|| 1.2.18.60 || tato baddhabhujaṃ daityaṃ viphalīkṛtapauruṣam|| tāḍayāmāsa gadayā dayāmutsṛjya pāśabhṛt|| 18.61 || sa tu tena prahāreṇa srotobhiḥ kṣatajaṃ sravan|| dadhāra kālameghasya rūpaṃ vidyullatābhṛtam|| 18.62 || tadavasthāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā kujaṃbhaṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ|| vyāvṛttavadanārāvo bhoktumaicchatsurāvubhau|| 18.63 || nirṛti varuṇaṃ caiva tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrotkaṭānanaḥ|| tāvabhiprāyamā lokya tasya daityasya dūṣitam|| 18.64 || tyaktvā rathāvubhau bhītau padātī pradrutau drutam|| jagmaturmahiṣādbhītau śaraṇaṃ pākaśāsanam|| 18.65 || kruddho'tha mahiṣo daityo varuṇaṃ samupādravat|| tamaṃtakamukhāsannamālokya himadīdhitiḥ|| 18.66 || cakre śastraṃ visṛṣṭaṃ hi himasaṃghātamulbaṇam|| vāyavyaṃ cāstra matulaṃ caṃdraścakre dvitīyakam|| 18.67 || vāyunā tena caṃḍaṃna saṃśuṣkeṇa himena ca|| mahāhimanipātena śastraiścaṃdrapraṇoditaiḥ|| 18.68 || gātrāṇyasurasainyānāmadahyaṃta samaṃtataḥ|| vyathitā dānavāḥ sarve sītacchāditapauruṣāḥ|| 18.69 || na śekuścaliṃtuṃ tatra nāstrāṇyādātumeva ca|| mahiṣo niṣprayatnaśca śītenākaṃpitānanaḥ|| 1.2.18.70 || aṃsamāliṃgya pāṇibhyāmupaviṣṭo hyadhomukhaḥ|| sarve te niṣpratīkārā daityāścaṃdramasā jitāḥ|| 18.71 || raṇecchāṃ dūratastyaktvā tasthuste jīvitārthinaḥ|| tatrābravītkālanemirdaityānkrodhavidīpitaḥ|| 18.72 || bhobhoḥ śrṛṃgāriṇaḥ krūrāḥ sarvaśastrāstrapāragāḥ|| ekaiko'pi jagatkṛsnaṃ śaktastulayituṃ bhujaiḥ|| 18.73 || ekaiko'pi kṣamo grastuṃ jagatsarvaṃ carācaram|| ekaikasyāpi paryāptā na sarve'pi divaukasaḥ|| 18.74 || kiṃ trastanayanāścaiva samare parinirjitāḥ|| na yuktametacchūrāṇāṃ viśeṣāddaityajanmanām|| 18.75 || rājñaśca tārakasyāpi darśayiṣyatha kiṃ mukham|| viratānāṃ raṇāccāsau kruddhaḥ prāṇānhariṣyati|| 18.76 || iti te procyamānāpi nocuḥ kiṃcinmahāsurāḥ|| śītena naṣṭaśrutayo bhraṣṭavākyāśca te tathā|| 18.77 || mūkāstathābhavandaityā mṛtakalpā mahāraṇe|| tāndṛṣṭvā naṣṭacetaskāndaityāñchītena pīḍitān|| 18.78 || matvā kālakṣamaṃ kāryaṃ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ|| āśritya mānavīṃ māyāṃ vitatya ca mahāvapuḥ|| 18.79 || pūrayāmāsa gaganaṃ vidiśa eva ca|| nirmame dānavendro'sau śarīrebhāskarāyutam|| 1.2.18.80 || diśaśca vidiśaścaiva pūrayāmāsa pāvakaiḥ|| tato jvālākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyamabhavatkṣaṇāt|| 18.81 || tena jvālāsamūhena himāṃ śuragamaddrutam|| tataḥ krameṇa vibhraṣṭaṃ śītadurdinamābabhau|| 18.82 || tadbalaṃ dānaveṃdrāṇāṃ māyayā kālaneminaḥ|| taddṛṣṭvā dānavānīkaṃ labdhasaṃjñaṃ divākaraḥ|| uvācāruṇamatyarthaṃ koparaktāṃtalocanaḥ|| 18.83 || ||divākara uvāca|| nayāruṇa rathaṃ śīghraṃ kālanemiratho yataḥ|| 18.84 || vimarde tatra viṣame bhavitā bhūtasaṃkṣayaḥ|| jita eṣaśaśāṃko'tha vayaṃ yadbalamāśritāḥ|| 18.85 || ityuktaścodayāmāsa rathaṃ garuḍapūrvajaḥ|| rathe sthito'pi tairaśvaiḥ sitacāmaradhāribhiḥ|| 18.86 || jagaddīpo'tha bhagavāñjagrāha vitataṃ dhanuḥ|| śaraugho vai pāṃḍuputra
