kṣipramāsīdviṣadyutiḥ|| 18.87 || śaṃbarāstreṇa saṃdhāya bāṇamekaṃ sasarja ha|| dvitīyaṃ cendrajālenāyojitaṃ pramumoca ha|| 18.88 || śaṃbarāstraṃ kṣaṇāccakre teṣāṃrūpaviparyayam|| devānāṃ dānavaṃ rūpaṃ dānavānāṃ ca daivikam|| 18.89 || matvā surānsvakāneva jaghne ghorāstralāghavāt|| kālanemī ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kṛtāṃta iva saṃkṣaye|| 1.2.18.90 || kāṃścitkhaḍgena tīkṣṇena kāṃścinnārācavṛṣṭibhiḥ|| kāṃścidgadābhirghorābhiḥ kāṃściddhoraiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ|| 18.91 || śirāṃsi keṣācidapātayadrathādbhujāṃstathā sārathīṃscogravegān|| kāṃścitpipeṣātharathasya vegātkāṃścittathātyadbhutamuṣṭipātaiḥ|| 18.92 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikā khaṇḍe tārakasainyadevasainyayoryuddhavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18 || cha ||
<1.2.19>
||nārada uvāca|| kālanemī ruṣāviṣṭasteṣāṃ rūpaṃ na buddhavān|| tato nimiṃ ca daityendraṃ matvā devaṃ mahājavaḥ|| 19.1 || keśeṣu gṛhya taṃ vīraṃ cakarṣa ca nanāda ca|| tato nimiruvācedaṃ kālanemiṃ mahābalam|| 19.2 || ahaṃ nimiḥ kālaneme sutaṃ matvā vadhasva mā|| bhavatā mohitenājau devānmatvāsurāḥ svakāḥ|| 19.3 || suraiḥ sudurjayāḥ koṭyo nihatādaśa viddhi tat|| sarvāstravāraṇaṃ muṃca brahmamastraṃ tvarānvitaḥ|| 19.4 || sa tena bodhito daityo muktvā taṃ saṃbhramākulaḥ|| bāṇaṃ brahmāstravihitaṃ mumoca tvarayānvitaḥ|| 19.5 || brahmāstraṃ tatprajajvāla tataḥ khe sumahādbhutam|| devānāṃ cābhavatsainyaṃ sarvameva bhayākulam|| 19.6 || śaṃbarāstraṃ tataḥ śāṃtaṃ brāhmapratihataṃ tadā|| tasminpratihate hyastre bhāskaraḥ prabhuḥ|| 19.7 || maheṃdrajālamāstāya cakre bhīṣaṇāṃ tanum|| visphūrjatkarasaṃghātasamākrāṃtajagattrayaḥ|| 19.8 || tatāpa dānavānīkaṃ galanmajjāṅghriśoṇitam|| cakṣūṃṣi dānavendrāṇāṃ cakārāṃdhāni sa prabhuḥ|| 19.9 || gajānāmagalanmedaḥ petuścāpi rathā bhuvi|| turaṃgamāḥ śvasaṃtaśca gharmārtā rathinopi ca|| 1.2.19.10 || itaścetaśca salilaṃ prārthayaṃtastṛṣāturāḥ|| giridroṇīśca pādāṃśca giriṇāṃ gahanāni ca|| 19.11 || teṣāṃ prārthayatāṃ śīghramanyonyaṃ ca visarpiṇām|| dāvāgnirajvalattīvro ghoro nardagdhapādapaḥ|| 19.12 || toyārthinaḥ puro dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ kallo lamālitam|| puraḥsthitamapi prāptuṃ na śekurupasāditum|| 19.13 || aprāpya salilaṃ bhūmāvabhyāśe drutameva te|| tatratatra vyadṛśyanta mṛtā daityeśvarābhuvi|| 19.14 || rathā gajāśca patitāsturaṃgāśca śramānvitāḥ|| sthitā vamaṃto dhāvaṃto galaddrutavasāsrajaḥ|| 19.15 || dānavānāṃ koṭikoṭi vyadṛśyatamṛtaṃ tadā|| evaṃ kṣayo jānavānāṃ tasminmahati vartite|| 19.16 || prakopodbhūtatāmrākṣaḥ kālanemī ruṣāturaḥ|| babhūva kālamedhābhaḥ sphuradromaśatahradaḥ|| 19.17 || gaṃbhīrāsphoṭanirhrādajagaddhṛdayakaṃpanaḥ|| pracchādya gaganaṃ sūryaprabhāṃ sarvāṃ vyanāśayat|| 19.18 || vavarṣa śītaṃ ca jalaṃ dānavendrabalaṃ prati|| daityāstāṃ vṛṣṭimāsādya samāśvastāstataḥ kramāt|| 19.19 || bījāṃkurā iva mlānāḥ prāpya vṛṣṭiṃ dharātale|| tataḥ sa megharūpeṇa kālanemirmahāsurāḥ|| 1.2.19.20 || śastravṛṣṭiṃ vavarṣogrāṃ devanīkeṣu durjayaḥ|| tayā vṛṣṭyā pīḍyamānā daityairanyaiśca devatāḥ|| 19.21 || gatiṃ kāṃcinna paśyanti gāvaḥ śītārditā iva|| parasparaṃ vyalīyaṃta gajeṣu turageṣu ca|| ratheṣu ca bhayatrastāstatratatra nililyire|| 19.22 || evaṃ te līyamānāśca nihatāḥ kālane minā|| dṛśyaṃte patitā devāḥ śastrabhinnaṃgasaṃdhayaḥ|| 19.23 || vibhinnā bhinnamūrdhānastathā bhinnorujānavaḥ|| viparyastaṃ rathāṃgaiśca patitaṃ dhvajaśaktibhiḥ|| 19.24 || turaṃgāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gajānāmayutāni ca|| raktena teṣāṃ ghoreṇa dustarā cābhavanmahī|| 19.25 || evamājau mahādaityaḥ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ|| jaghne muhurtamātreṇa gaṃdharvāṇāṃ daśāyutam|| 19.26 || yakṣāṇāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi kiṃnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca|| jaghne piśācamukhyānāṃ saptalakṣāṇi nirbhayaḥ|| 19.27 || itareṣāṃ na saṃkhyāsti surajātinikāyinām|| jaghne sa koṭiśaḥ kraddhaḥ kālanemirmadotkaṭaḥ|| 19.28 || evaṃ pratibhaye bhīme tadāmara mahākṣaye|| saṃkruddhāvaśvinau vīrau citrāstrakavacojjavalau|| 19.29 || jaghnatustau raṇe daityamekaikaṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ śaraiḥ|| nirbhidya te mahādaityaṃ sapuṃkhā viviśurmahīm|| 1.2.19.30 || tābhyāṃ bāṇaprahāraistu kiṃcitso'vāptacetanaḥ|| jagrāha cakraṃ lakṣāraṃ tailadhautaṃ raṇe'dhikam|| 19.31 || tena cakreṇa sośvibhyāṃ ciccheda rathakūbaram|| jagrāhātha dhanurdaityaḥ śarāṃścāśīviṣopamān|| 19.32 || vavarṣa bhiṣajormūrdhni saṃchādyākāśagocaram|| tāvapyastraiḥ smṛtaiḥ sarvāśchedaturdaityasāyakān|| 19.33 || tacca karama tayordṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ kopamāviśat|| jagrāha mudgaraṃ bhīma kāladaṃḍavibhīṣaṇam|| 19.34 || sa tadamudbhrāmya vegena cikṣepāsya rathaṃ prati|| taṃ tu mudgaramāyāṃtamālokyāṃbaragocare|| 19.35 || muktvā rathāvubhau vegādāplutau tarasāśvinau|| tau rathau sa tu niṣpiṣya mudgaro'calasaṃnibhaḥ|| 19.36 || dārayāmāsa dharaṇīṃ hemajālapariṣkṛtaḥ|| tasya karmātha taddṛṣṭvā bhiṣajau citrayodhinau|| 19.37 || vajrāstraṃ ca prakurvāṇau dānaveṃdramayudhyatām|| ghoravajraprahāraistu dānavaḥ sa parikṣataḥ|| 19.38 || ratho dhvajo dhanuścaiva chatraṃ ca kavacaṃ tathā|| kṣaṇena śatadhā bhūtaṃ sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ|| 19.39 || taddṛṣṭvā dukaraṃ karma so'śvibhyāṃ bhīmavikramaḥ|| nārāyaṇāstraṃ balavānmumoca raṇamūrdhani|| 1.2.19.40 || tataḥ śaśāma vajrāstraṃ kālanemistato ruṣā|| jīvagrāhaṃ grāhayitumaśvinau tau pracakrame|| 19.41 || tāvabhiprāyamālakṣya saṃtyajya samarāṃgaṇam|| padātī vepamānāṃgau pradrutau vāsavoyataḥ|| 19.42 || tayoranugato daityaḥ kālanemirnadanmuhuḥ|| prāpyeṃdrasya balaṃ krūro daityānīkapadānugaḥ|| 19.43 || sa kāla iva kalpāṃte yadā vāsavamādrutaḥ|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvabhūtāni viviśurvihvalāni tu|| 19.44 || hāhārāvaṃ prakurvāṇāstadā devāśca menire|| parājayaṃ maheṃdrasya sarvalokakṣayāvaham|| 19.45 || celuḥ śikhariṇo mukhyāḥ peturulkā nabhastalāt|| jagarjurjaladā dikṣu saṃbhūtaśca mahāravaḥ|| 19.46 || tāṃ bhūtāvikṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ seṃdrā bhayāvahāḥ|| manasā śaraṇaṃ jagmurvāsudevaṃ jagatpatim|| 19.47 || namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca|| jagaddhitāya kṛṣṇāya goviṃdāya namonamaḥ|| 19.48 || sa no rakṣatu goviṃdo bhayārtāste jaguḥ surāḥ|| surāṇāṃ ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā bhagavāngaruḍadhvajaḥ|| 19.49 || vibudhyaiva ca paryaṃkādyoganidrāṃ vihāya saḥ|| lakṣmīkarayugāṃbhojalālitāṃghrisaroruhaḥ|| 1.2.19.50 || śāradaṃbaranīrābjakāṃtidehacchaviḥ prabhuḥ|| kaustubhodbhāsihṛdayaḥ kāṃtakeyūrabhāskaraḥ|| 19.51 || vimṛśya surasaṃkṣobhaṃ vainateyamātāhvayat|| āhūte'visthitetasmingaruḍe duḥkhite bhṛśam|| 19.52 || divyanānāstratīkṣṇārcirāruhyāgātsurāhavam|| tatrāpaśyata deveṃdraṃ bhayabhītamabhidrutam|| 19.53 || dānaveṃdrairnavāṃbhodasacchāyaiḥ sarvathotkaṭaiḥ|| yathā hi puruṣaṃ ghorairabhāgyairarthakāṃkṣibhiḥ|| 19.54 || tattrāṇāyāvrajadviṣṇuḥ stūyamāno muhuḥ suraiḥ|| abhāgyebhyaḥ paritrātuṃ sukṛtaṃ nirmalaṃ yathā|| 19.55 || athāpaśyata daityeṃdro viyati dyutimaṃḍalam|| sphuraṃtamudayācchīghraṃ kāṃtaṃ sūryaśataṃ yathā|| 19.56 || prabhavaṃ jñātumicchaṃto dānavāstasya tejasaḥ|| garuḍaṃ tamathā paśyankalpāṃtānalabhairavam|| 19.57 || tatra sthitaṃ caturbāhuṃ hariṃ cānupamadyutim|| tamālokyāsureṃdrāstu harṣasaṃpūrṇamānasāḥ|| 19.58 || ayaṃ sa devaḥ sarveṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ keśavo'rihā|| asmiñjite jitāḥ sarvā devatā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 19.59 || enamāśritya lokeśā yajñabhāgabhujo'marāḥ|| ityuktvā te samāgamya sarva eva tatastataḥ|| 1.2.19.60 || taṃ jaghnurvividhaiḥ śastraiḥ parivārya samaṃtataḥ|| kālanemiprabhṛtayo daśa daityamahārathāḥ|| 19.61 || ṣaṣṭyā vivyādhabāṇānāṃ kālanemirjanārdanam|| nimiḥ śatena bāṇānāṃ mathano'śītibhiḥ śaraiḥ|| 19.62 || jaṃbhakaścaiva saptatyā śuṃbho daśabhireva ca|| śeṣā daitye śvarāḥ sava viṣṇumekaikaśaḥ śaraiḥ|| 19.63 || daśabhirdaśabhiḥ śalyairjaghnuḥ sagaruḍaṃ raṇe|| teṣāmamṛṣyattatkarma viṣṇurdānavasūdanaḥ|| 19.64 || ekaikaṃ dānavaṃ jaghne ṣaḍbhiḥ paḍbhirajihnagaiḥ|| ākarṇakṛṣṭairbhūyaśca kālanemistribhiḥ śaraiḥ|| 19.65 || viṣṇuṃ vivyādha hṛdaye roṣādraktavilocanaḥ|| tasyāśobhaṃta te bāṇā hṛdaye taptakāṃcanāḥ|| 19.66 || mayūkhā iva saṃdīptāḥ kaustubhasya sphurattviṣaḥ|| tairbāṇaiḥ kiṃcidāyasto harirjagrāha mudgaram|| 19.67 || sa tamudgrāhya vegena dānavāya mumoca vai|| dānavendrastamaprāptaṃ viyatyeva śataiḥ śaraiḥ|| 19.68 || ciccheda tilaśaḥ kruddho darśayanpāṇilāghavam|| tato viṣṇuḥ prakupitaḥ prāsaṃ jagrāha bhairavam|| 19.69 || tena daityasya hṛdayaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ|| kṣaṇena labdhasaṃjñastu kālanemirmahāsuraḥ|| 1.2.19.70 || śaktiṃ jagrāha tīkṣṇāgrāṃ hemaghaṃṭāṭṭahāsinīm|| tayā vāmaṃ bhujaṃ viṣṇorbibheda ditinaṃdanaḥ|| 19.71 || bhinnaṃ śaktyā bhujaṃ tasya srutaśoṇitamābabhau|| nīle balā hake vidyudvidyotaṃtī yathā muhuḥ|| 19.72 || tato viṣṇuḥ prakupito jagrāha vipulaṃ dhanuḥ|| saptadaśa ca nārācāṃstīkṣṇāgrānmarmabhedinaḥ|| 19.73 || daityasya hṛdayaṃ ṣaḍbhirvivyādha ca śaraistribhiḥ|| caturbhiḥ sārathiṃ cāsya dhvajaṃ caikena patriṇā|| 19.74 || dvābhyāṃ dhanurjyādhanuṣī bhujaṃ caikena patriṇā|| sa viddho hṛdaye gāḍhaṃ doṣairmūḍho yathā naraḥ|| 19.75 || srutaraktāruṇaḥ prāṃśuḥ pīḍācalitamānasaḥ|| cakaṃpe māruteneva coditaḥ kiṃśukadrumaḥ|| 19.76 || tataḥ kaṃpitamālakṣya gadāṃ jagrāha keśavaḥ|| tāṃ ca vegena cikṣepa kālanemivadhaṃ prati|| 19.77 || sā papāta śirasyugrā sahasā kālaneminaḥ|| saṃcūrṇitottamāṃ gastu niṣpiṣṭamukuṭosuraḥ|| 19.78 || srutaraktaugharaṃdhraśca srutadhāturivācalaḥ|| papāta sve rathe bhagno visaṃjñaḥ śiṣṭajīvanaḥ|| 19.79 || patitasya rathopasthe dānavasyācyuto'rihā|| smitapūrvamuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ cakrāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ|| 1.2.19.80 || gacchāsura vimukto'si sāṃprataṃ jīva nirvṛtaḥ|| tataḥ svalpena kālena ahameva tavāṃtakaḥ|| 19.81 || evaṃ vacastasya niśamya viṣṇoḥ sarveśvarasyātha rathaṃ nimeṣāt|| nināya dūraṃ kila kālanemino bhītastadā sārathirlokanāthāt|| 19.82 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe devāsurāsaṃgrāme kālanemikṛtayuddhasaṃmarde viṣṇunā saha kālanemiyuddhavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19 || cha ||
<1.2.20>
||nārada uvāca|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavāḥ sarve kruddhāḥ svaiḥsvairbalairvṛtāḥ|| saraghā iva mākṣikaṃ rurudhuḥ sarvatastataḥ|| 20.1 || parvatābhe gaje bhīme madasrāviṇi durdame|| sitacitrapatāke tu prabhinnakaraṭāmukhe|| 20.2 || svarṇavarṇāṃcite yadvannage dāvāgnisaṃvṛte|| āruhyajau nimirdaityo hariṃ pratyudyayau balī|| 20.3 || tasyāsandānavā raudrā gajasya parirakṣiṇaḥ|| saptaviṃśatikoṭyaśca kirīṭakavacojjavalāḥ|| 20.4 || aśvamāruhya śailābhaṃ harimādravat|| paṃcayojanapragrīvamuṣṭramāsthāya jaṃbhakaḥ|| 20.5 || śumbho meṣaṃ samāruhyāvrajaddvādaśayojanam|| apare dānavendrāśca yattā nānāstrāpāṇayaḥ|| 20.6 || ājagmuḥ samare kruddhā viṣṇumakliṣṭakāriṇam|| paragheṇa nimirdaityo mathano mudgareṇa ca|| 20.7 || śumbhaḥ śūlena tīkṣṇena prāsena grasanastathā|| cakreṇa krathanaḥ kruddho jaṃbhaḥ śaktyā mahāraṇe|| 20.8 || jaghnurnārāyaṇaṃ śeṣā viśikhairmarmabhedibhiḥ|| tānyastrāṇi prayuktāni viviśuḥ puruṣottamam|| 20.9 || upadeśā guroryadvatsacchiṣyaṃ bahudheritāḥ|| tataḥ kruddho harirgṛhya dhanurbāṇāṃśca puṣkalān|| 1.2.20.10 || mamarda daityasenāṃ taddharmamarthavaco yathā|| nimiṃ vivyādha viṃśatyā vāṇairanalavarcasaiḥ|| 20.11 || mathanaṃ daśabhiścaiva śumbhaṃ paṃcabhireva ca|| śatena mahiṣaṃ kruddho vivyādhorasi mādhavaḥ|| 20.12 || jaṃbhaṃ dvādaśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ sarvāṃścaikaika śo'ṣṭabhiḥ|| tasya tallāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ|| 20.13 || cakrurgāḍhataraṃ yatnamāvṛṇvānā hariṃ śaraiḥ|| cicchedātha dhanurjyāṃ ca nimirbhallena dānavaḥ|| 20.14 || hastāccāpaṃ ca saṃraṃbhācciccheda mahiṣāsuraḥ|| ṣīḍayāmāsā garuḍaṃ jaṃbho bāṇāyutaistribhiḥ|| 20.15 ||| bhujāvasya ca vivyādha śaṃbho bāṇāyutena vai|| tato vismitacittastu gadāṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ|| 20.16 || tāṃ prāhiṇotsa vegena mathanāya mahāhave|| tāmāprāptāṃ nimirbāṇairmuśalābhaiḥ sahasraśaḥ|| 20.17 || āhatya pātayāmāsa vinadankālameghavat|| tatoṃ'tarikṣe hāheti bhūtānāṃ jajñire kathāḥ|| 20.18 || naitadasti balaṃ vyaktaṃ yatrāśīryata sā gadā|| tāṃ hariḥ patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā asthāne prārthanāmiva|| 20.19 || jagrāha mudgaraṃ ghoraṃ divyaratnapariṣkṛtam|| taṃ mumocātivegena nimimuddiśya dānavam|| 1.2.20.20 || tamāyāṃtaṃ viyatyeva trayo daityā hyavārayan|| gadayā daṃbhadaityastu grasanaḥ paṭṭiśena tu|| 20.21 || śaktyā ca mahiṣo daityo vinadaṃto mahāraravam|| nirākṛtaṃ tamālokya durjanaiḥ sujanaṃ yathā|| 20.22 || jagrāha śaktimugrogrāṃ śataghaṃṭāmahāsvanām|| jaṃbhāya tāṃ samuddiśya prāhiṇodbhīṣaṇeraṇe|| 20.23 || tāmāyāntīmathālokya jaṃbho'nyasya rathāttvarāt|| āplutya līlayā gṛhṇankāminīṃ kāmuko yathā|| 20.24 || tayaiva garuḍaṃ mūrdhni jaghne sa prahasanbalī|| tato bhūyo rathaṃ prāpya ghanurgṛhyabhyayojayat|| 20.25 || vicetāścābhavadyuddhe garuḍaḥ śaktipīḍitaḥ|| tataḥ prahasya taṃ viṣṇuḥ sādhusādhviti bhārata|| 20.26 || karasparśena kṛtavānvimohaṃ vinatātmajam|| samāśvāsya ca taṃ vāgbhiḥ śaktiṃ dṛṣṭvā ca niṣphalām|| 20.27 || kubhāryasya yathā puṃsaḥ sarvaṃsyācciṃtitaṃ vṛthā|| dṛṭhasāramahāmaurvīmanyāṃ saṃyojayattataḥ|| 20.28 || kṛtvā ca talanirghoṣaṃ raudramastraṃ mumoca saḥ|| tato'stratejasā sarvamākāśaṃ naiva dṛśyate|| 20.29 || bhūmirdiśaśca vidiśo bāmajālamayā bubhuḥ|| dṛṣṭvā tadastramāhātmyaṃ senānīrgrasano'suraḥ|| 1.2.20.30 || brāhmamastraṃ cakārāśu sarvāstravinivāraṇam|| tena tatpraśamaṃ yātaṃ raudrāstraṃ lokabhīṣaṇam|| 20.31 || astre pratihate tasminviṣṇurdānavasūdanaḥ|| kāladaṃḍāstramakarotsarvalokabhayaṃkaram|| 20.32 || saṃdhīyamānestre tasminmārutaḥ paruṣo vavau|| cakaṃpe ca mahī devī bhinnāścāṃbudhayo'bhavan|| 20.33 || tadastramugraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dānavā yuddhadurmadāḥ|| cakrurastrāṇi divyāni nānārūpāṇi saṃyuge|| 20.34 || nārāyaṇāṃstraṃ grasanastu cakre tvāṣṭraṃ nimiścāstravaraṃ mumoca|| aiṣīkamastraṃ ca cakāra jaṃbho yuddhasya daṇḍāstra nivāraṇāya|| 20.35 || yāvacca saṃdhānavaśaṃ prayāṃti nārāyaṇādīni nivāraṇāya|| tāvatkṣaṇenaiva jaghāna koṭīṃdaityeśvarāṇāṃ kila kāladaṃḍaḥ|| 20.36 || anaṃtaraṃ śāṃtabhayaṃ tadastraṃ daityāstrayogena ca kāladaṇḍam|| śāṃtaṃ tadālokya hariḥ svamastraṃ kopena kālānalatulyamūrtiḥ|| 20.37 || jagrāha cakraṃ tapanā yutaprabhamugrāramātmānamiva dvitīyam|| cikṣepa senāpataye jvalaṃtaṃ caturbhūjaḥ saṃyati saṃpragṛhya|| 20.38 || tadāvrajaccakramatho vilokya sarvātmanā daityavarāḥ svavīryāt|| nāśaknunvārayituṃ pracaṃḍaṃ daivaṃ yathā pūrvamivopapannam|| 20.39 || tadapratarkyaṃ navahetitulyaṃ cakraṃ papāta grasanasya kaṇṭhe|| tadraktadhārā ruṇaghoranābhi jagāma bhūyopi karaṃ murāreḥ|| 1.2.20.40 || cakrāhataḥ saṃyati dānavaśca papāta bhūmau pramamāra cāpi|| daityāśca śeṣā bhṛśaśaukamāpuḥ krodhaṃ ca kecitpipiṣurbhujāṃśca|| 20.41 || tato vinihate daitye grasane balanāyake|| nirmaryādamayudhyaṃta hariṇā saha dānavāḥ|| 20.42 || paṭṭiśairmuśalaiḥ prāsaigni dābhiḥ kaṇapairapi|| tīkṣṇānanaiśca nārācaiścakraiḥ śaktibhireva ca|| 20.43 || tadastrajālaṃ tairmuktaṃ labdhalakṣo janārdanaḥ|| ekaikaṃ śatadhā cakre bāṇairagni śikhopamaiḥ|| 20.44 || jaghāna teṣāṃ saṃkruddhaḥ koṭikoṭiṃ janārdanaḥ|| tataste sahasā bhūtvā nyapatankeśavopari|| 20.45 || garuḍaṃ jagṛhuḥ kecitpādayoḥ śataśo'surāḥ|| lalaṃbire ca pakṣābhyāṃ mukhe cānye lalaṃbire|| 20.46 || keśavasyāpi dhanuṣi bhujayoḥ śīrṣa eva ca|| lalaṃbire mahādaityā ninadaṃto muhurmuhuḥ|| 20.47 || tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā siddhacāraṇavārtikāḥ|| hāheti mumucurnādasaṃbare cāstuvanharim|| 20.48 || tato harirvinirdhūya pātayāmāsa tānbhuvi|| yathā prabuddhaḥ puruṣo doṣānsaṃsārasaṃbhavān|| 20.49 || vikośaṃ ca tataḥ naṃdakaṃ khaḍgamuttamam|| carma cāpyamalaṃ viṣṇuḥ padātistānadhāvata|| 1.2.20.50 || tato muhūrtamātreṇa padmāni daśa keśavaḥ|| cakartta mārge bahubhirvicarandaityasattamān|| 20.51 || tato nimiprabhṛtayo vinadyāsurasattamāḥ|| adhāvaṃta maheṣvāsāḥ keśavaṃ pādacāriṇam|| 20.52 || garutmāṃścābhyayāttūrṇamāruroha ca taṃ hariḥ|| uvāca ca garutmaṃtaṃ tasmiṃśca tumule raṇe|| 20.53 ||9 aśrāṃto yadi tārkṣyāsi mathanaṃ prati tadvraja|| śrāṃtaścecca muhūrtaṃ tvaṃ raṇādapasṛto bhava|| 20.54 || ||tārkṣya uvāca|| na me śramo'sti lokeśa kiṃcitsaṃsmarataśca me|| yanme sutānvāhanatve kalpayāmāsa tārakaḥ|| 20.55 || iti bravanraṇe daityaṃ mathanaṃ prati so'gamat|| daityastavabhimukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhacakragadādharam|| 20.56 || jaghāna bhiṃḍipālena śitadhāreṇa vakṣasi|| taṃ prahāramaciṃtyaiva viṣṇustasminmahāhave|| 20.57 || jaghāna paṃcabhirbāṇairgirīṃdrasyāpi bhedakaiḥ|| ākarṇakṛṣṭairdaśabhiḥ punarviddhaḥ stanāṃtare|| 20.58 || vicetano muhūrtātsa saṃstabhya mathanaḥ punaḥ|| gṛhītvā parighaṃ mūrdhni janārdanamatāḍayat|| 20.59 || viṣṇustena prahāreṇa kiṃcidāghūrṇito'bhavat|| tataḥ kopavivṛttākṣo gadāṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ|| 1.2.20.60 || tayā saṃtāḍayāmāsa mathanaṃ hṛdaye dṛḍham|| sa papāta tathā bhūmau cūrṇitāṃgo mamāra ca|| 20.61 || tasminnipatite bhūmau mathane mathite bhṛśam|| avasādaṃ yuyurdaityāḥ sarve te yuddhamaṇḍale|| 20.62 || tatasteṣu viṣaṇṇeṣu dānaveṣvatimāniṣu|| cukopa raktanayano mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ|| 20.63 || pratyudyayau hariṃ raudraḥ svabāhubalamāśritaḥ|| rīkṣṇadhāreṇa śūlena mahiṣo harimardayan|| 20.64 || śaktyā ca garuḍaṃ vīro hṛdaye'bhyahanaddṛḍham|| tato vivṛtya vadanaṃ mahāmalaguhānibham|| 20.65 || grastumaicchadraṇe daityaḥ sagarutmaṃtamacyutam|| athācyuto'pi vijñāya dānavasya cikīrṣitam|| 20.66 || vadanaṃ pūrayāmāsa divyaistrairmahābalaḥ|| sa tairbāṇairabhihato mahiṣo'calasaṃnibhaḥ|| 20.67 || parivartitakāyārdhaḥ papātātha mamāra ca|| mahiṣaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvayitvā punarhariḥ|| 20.68 || mahiṣaṃ prāha mattastvaṃ vadhaṃ nārhasi dānava|| yoṣidvadhyaḥ puroktastvaṃ sākṣātkamalayoninā|| 20.69 || uttiṣṭha gaccha manmukto drutamasmānmahāraṇāt|| ityukto hariṇā tasmāddeśādapagato'suraḥ|| 1.2.20.70 || tasminparāṅmukhe daitye mahiṣe śuṃbhadānavaḥ|| saṃdaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭāṭopo bhṛkuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ|| 20.71 || nirmadhya pāṇinā pāṇiṃ dhanurādāya bhairavam|| sajjīkṛtya mahāghorānmumoca śataśaḥ śarān|| 20.72 || sa citrayodhī dṛḍhamuṣṭipātastataśva viṣṇuṃ ca daityaḥ|| bāṇairjvaladvahniśikhānikāśaiḥ kṣiptairasaṃkhyaiḥ pratighāhīnaiḥ|| 20.73 || viṣṇuśca daityeṃdraśarārdito bhṛśaṃ bhuśuṃḍimādāya kṛtāṃtatulyām|| tayā mukhaṃ cāsya pipeṣa saṃkhye śuṃbhasya jatruṃ ca dharādharābham|| 20.74 || tatastribhiḥ śaṃbhubhujaṃ dviṣaṣṭyā sūtasya śīrṣaṃ daśakṣiśca ketum|| viṣṇurvikṛṣṭaiḥ śravaṇāvasānaṃ daityasya bāṇairjvalanārkavarṇaiḥ|| 20.75 || sa taiśca viddho vyathito babhūva daityeśvaro visrutaśoṇitāktaḥ|| tato'sya kiṃciccalitasya dhairyāduvāca śaṃkhāṃbujasārṅgapāṇiḥ|| 20.76 || yoṣitsuvadhyo'si raṇaṃ vibhuṃca śuṃbhā'śubha svalpatarairahobhiḥ|| mattorhasi tvaṃ na vṛthaiva mūḍha tato'payātaḥ sa ca śaṃbhadānavaḥ|| 20.77 || jambho'tha tadviṣṇumukhānniśamya jagarja coccaiḥ kṛtasiṃhanādaḥ|| provāca vākyaṃ ca salīlamājau mahāṭṭahāsena jagadvikaṃpya|| 20.78 || kimebhiste jalāvāsa daityairhīnaparākramaiḥ|| māmāsādaya yuddhe'sminyadi te pauruṣaṃ kvacit|| 20.79 || yatte pūrvaṃ hatā daityā hiraṇyākṣamukhāḥ kila|| jaṃbhastadābhavannaiva paśya māmadya saṃsthitam|| 1.2.20.80 || paśya tālapratī kāśau bhujāvetau hare mama|| vakṣo vā vajrakaṭhinaṃ mayi prahara tatsukham|| 20.81 || ityuktaḥ keśavastena sṛkkiṇī saṃlihanruṣā|| mumoca parighaṃghoraṃ virīṇāmapi dāraṇam|| 20.82 || tatastasyāpyanupadaṃ kālāyasamayaṃ dṛḍham|| mumoca mudgaraṃ viṣṇurdvitīyaṃ parvataṃ yathā|| 20.83 || tadāyudhadvayaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaṃbho nyasya rathe dhanuḥ|| āplutya parighaṃ gṛhya garuḍaṃ tena jaghnivān|| 20.84 || dvitīyaṃ mudgaraṃ cānu gṛhītvā vinadanraṇe|| sarvaprāṇena goviṃdaṃ tena mūrdhni jaghāna saḥ|| 20.85 || tābhyāṃ cātiprahārābhyāmubhau garuḍakeśavau|| mohāviṣṭau vicetaskau mṛtakalpāvivāsatām|| 20.86 || tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā jagarjurdaityasattamāḥ|| naitānharṣamadoddhūtānidaṃ sehe jagattadā|| 20.87 || siṃhanādaistalonnāhairdhanurnādaiśca bāṇajaiḥ|| jaṃbhaṃ te harṣayāmāsurvāsāṃsyādudhuvuśca te|| 20.88 || śaṃkhāṃśca pūrayāmāsuścikṣipurdevatā bhṛśam|| 20.89 || saṃjñāmavāpyātha mahāraṇe hariḥ savainateyaḥ parirabhya jaṃbham|| parāṅmukhaḥ saṃyugādapradhṛṣyātpalāyanaṃ vegaparaścakāra|| 1.2.20.90 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe daityaiḥ saha viṣṇoryuddhavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 20 || cha ||
<1.2.21>
||nārada uvāca|| tamālokya palāyaṃtaṃ vidhvastadhvajakārmukam|| daityāṃśca muditāniṃdraḥ kartavyaṃ nādhyagacchata|| 21.1 || athāyānnikaṭaṃ viṣṇoḥ sureśastvarayānvitaḥ|| uvāca cainaṃ madhuramutsāhaparibṛṃhitam|| 21.2 || kimebhiḥ krīḍase deva dānavairduṣṭamānasaiḥ|| durjanairlabdharaṃdhrasya puruṣasya kutaḥ kriyāḥ|| 21.3 || śaktenopekṣito nīco manyate balamātmanaḥ|| tasmānna nīcaṃ matimānuṣekṣeta kathaṃcana|| 21.4 || athāgresarasaṃpattyā rathino jayamāyayuḥ|| kaste sakhābhavatpūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣavadhe vibho|| 21.5 || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo vīryaśālī madoddhataḥ|| prāpya tvāṃ tṛmavannaṣṭastatra ko'gresarastava|| 21.6 || pūrvaṃ pratibalā daityā madhukaiṭabhasannibhāḥ|| niviṣṭāstvāṃ tu saṃprāpya śalabhā iva pāvakam|| 21.7 || yugeyuge ca daityānāṃ tvatto nāśo'bhavaddhare|| tathaivādyeha bhītānāṃ tvaṃ hi viṣṇo surāśrayaḥ|| 21.8 || evaṃ saṃnodito viṣṇurvyavardhata mahābhujaḥ|| balena tejasā ṛddhyā sarvabhūtāśrayo'rihā|| 21.9 || athovāca sahasrākṣaṃ keśavaḥ prahasanniva|| evametadyathā prāha bhavānasmadgataṃ vacaḥ|| 1.2.21.10 || trailokyadānavānsarvāndagdhuṃ śaktaḥ kṣaṇādaham|| durjastārakaḥ kiṃ tu muktvā saptadinaṃ śiśum|| 21.11 || mahiṣaścaiva śuṃbhaśca ubhau vadhyau ca yoṣitā|| jaṃbho durvāsasā śaptaḥ śakravadhyo bhavāniti|| tasmāttvaṃ divyavīryeṇa jahi jaṃbhaṃ madotkaṭam|| 21.12 || avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāmṛte sa tu dānavaḥ|| 21.13 || mayā gupto raṇe jaṃbho jagatkaṃṭakamuddhara|| tadvaikuṃṭhavacaḥ śrutvā sahasrākṣomarārihā|| 21.14 || samādiśatsurādhyakṣānsainyasya racanāṃ prati|| tataścābhyarthito devairviṣṇuḥ sainyamakalpayat|| 21.15 || yatsāraṃ sarvalokasya vīryasya tapaso'pi ca|| tadaikādaśa rudrāṃśca cakārāgresarānhariḥ|| 21.16 || vyālīḍhāṃgā mahādevā balino nīlakaṃdharāḥ|| caṃdrakhaṃḍatripuṃḍrāśca piṃgākṣāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ|| 21.17 || piṃgottuṃgajaṭājūṭāḥ siṃhacarmāvasāyinaḥ|| bhasmoddhūlitagātrāśca bhujamaṃḍalabhairavāḥ|| 21.18 || kapālīśādayo rudrā vidrāvitamahā'surāḥ|| kapālī piṃgalo bhīmo virupākṣo vilohitaḥ|| 21.19 || ajakaḥ śāsanaḥ śāstā śaṃbhuścaṃdro bhavastathā|| eta ekādaśanaṃtabalā rudrāḥ prabhāvinaḥ|| 1.2.21.20 || apālayaṃta tridaśānvigarjaṃta ivāṃbudāḥ|| himācalābhe mahati kāṃcanāṃburuhasrahi|| 21.21 || pracaṃcalamahāhemaghaṃṭāsaṃhatimaṃḍite|| airāvate caturdaṃte mattamātaṃga āsthitaḥ|| 21.22 || mahāmadajalasrāve kāmarūpe śatakratuḥ|| tasthau himagireḥ śrṛṃge bhānumāniva dīptimān|| tasyārakṣatpadaṃ savyaṃ māruto'mitavikramaḥ|| 21.23 || jugopāparamagniśca jvālāpūritadiṅmukhaḥ|| pṛṣṭharakṣo'bhava dviṣṇuḥ samareśaḥ śatakratoḥ|| 21.24 || ādityā vasavo viśve marutaścāśvināvapi|| gaṃdharvā rākṣasā yakṣāḥ sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ|| 21.25 || koṭiśaḥkoṭiśaḥ gṛtvā vṛṃdaṃ cihnopalakṣitam|| viśrāvayaṃtaḥ svāṃ kīrtiṃ baṃdivṛndaiḥ puraḥ saraiḥ|| 21.26 || celurdaityavadhe dṛptā nānāvarṇāyudhadhvajāḥ|| 21.27 || śatakratoramaranikāyapālitā patākinī yānaninādanāditā|| sitonnatadhvajapaṭakoṭimaṃḍitā babhūva sā ditisutokavardhinī|| 21.28 || āyāṃtīṃ tāṃ vilokyātha surasenāṃ gajāsuraḥ|| gajarūpī mahāṃścaiva saṃhārāṃbhodhivikramaḥ|| 21.29 || paraśvadhāyudho daityo daśanauṣṭhakasaṃpuṭaḥ|| mamarda caraṇe devāṃścikṣepānyānkareṇa ca|| 1.2.21.30 || parānparaśunā jaghne daityeṃdro raudravikramaḥ|| tasyaivaṃ nighnataḥ kruddhā devagandharvakiṃnarāḥ|| 21.31 || mumucuḥ saṃhatāḥ sarve citraśastrāstrasaṃhatim|| paraśvadhāṃśca cakrāṇi bhiṇḍipālānsamudgarān|| 21.32 || kuntānprāsāñcharāṃstīkṣṇānmudgarāṃścāpi duḥsahān|| tānsarvānsograsaddaityo yūthapaḥ kavalāniva|| 21.33 || kopasphuritadaṃṣṭrāgraḥ karasphoṭena nādayan|| surānnaghnaṃścarārājau duṣprekṣyaḥ so'tha dānavaḥ|| 21.34 || yasminyasminnipatati sura vṛṃde gajāsuraḥ|| tasmistīsminmahāśabdo hāhākāro vyajāyata|| 21.35 || atha vidravamānaṃ tablaṃ prekṣva samaṃtataḥ|| rudrāḥ parasparaṃ procurahaṃkārotthitārciṣaḥ|| 21.36 || bhobho gṛhṇata daityeṃdraṃ bhiṃdatainaṃ mahābalāḥ|| karṣatainaṃ śitaiḥ śūlairbhañjatainaṃ hi marmasu|| 21.37 || kapālī vākyamākarṇya śūlaṃ sitaśitaṃmukhe|| saṃmārjya vāmahastena saṃraṃbhādvivṛtekṣaṇaḥ|| 21.38 || protphullāruṇanīlābjasaṃhatiḥ sarvato diśaḥ|| athāgādbhukuṭīvakro daityeṃdrābhimukho raṇe|| 21.39 || dṛḍhena muṣṭibandhena śūlaṃ viṣṛbhya nirmalaḥ|| jaghāna kumbhadeśe tu kapālī gajadānavam|| 1.2.21.40 || tato daśāpi te rudrā nirmalāyomayai raṇe|| jaghnuḥ śūlaistu daityeṃdraṃ śailavarṣmāṇamāhave|| 21.41 || susrāva śoṇitaṃ paścātsarvasrotassu tasya vai|| śūlaraktena rudrasya śuśubhe gajadānavaḥ|| 21.42 || protphullāmalanīlābjaṃ śaradīvāmalaṃ saraḥ|| bhasmaśubhratanucchāyai rudra rhaṃsairivāvṛtam|| 21.43 || kruddhaṃ kapālinaṃ daityaḥ pracalatkarṇapallavaḥ|| bhavaṃ ca dantairbibhide nābhideśe jagāsuraḥ|| 21.44 || dṛṣṭvānuraktaṃ rudrābhyāṃ navarudrāstato drutam|| vivyadhurviśikhaiḥ śūlaiḥ śarīramamaradviṣaḥ|| 21.45 || tataḥ kapālinaṃ tyaktvā bhavaṃ cāsurapuṃgavaḥ|| vegena kupito daityo nava rudrānupādravat|| mamarda caraṇāghātairdantaiścāpi kareṇa ca|| 21.46 || tato'sau śūlayuddhena śramamāsādito yadā|| tadā kapālī jagrāha karamasyāmaradviṣaḥ|| 21.47 || bhrāmayāmāsa cātīva vegena ca gajāsuram|| dṛṣṭvāśramāturaṃ daityaṃ kiṃciccyāvitajīvitam|| 21.48 || nirutsāhaṃ raṇe tasmingatayuddhotsavo'bhavat|| tato bhramata evāsya carma utkṛttya bhairavam|| 21.49 || sravatsarvāṃgara ktaughaṃ cakārāṃbaramātmanaḥ|| tuṣṭuvustaṃ tadā devā bahudhā bahubhiḥ stavaiḥ|| 1.2.21.50 || ūcuścainaṃ cayo hanyātsa mriyeta tatastvasau|| dṛṣṭvā kapālino rūpaṃ gajacarmāṃbarāvṛtam|| 21.51 || vitresurdudruvurjaghnurnipetuśca sahasraśaḥ|| evaṃ vilulite tasmindānavendre mahābale|| 21.52 || gajaṃ mattamathāruhya śatadundubhināditam|| nimirabhyapatattūrṇaṃ surasainyāni loḍayan|| 21.53 || yāṃyāṃ nimigajo yāti diśaṃ tāṃtāṃ savāhanāḥ|| dudruvuścukruśurdevā bhayenākaṃpitā muhuḥ|| 21.54 || gandhena suramātaṃgā dudruvustasya hastinaḥ|| palāyiteṣu sainyeṣu surāṇāṃ pākaśāsanaḥ|| 21.55 || tasthau dikpālakaiḥ sārdhamaṣṭabhiḥ keśavena ca|| saṃprāptastasya mātaṃgo yāvacchakragajaṃ prati|| 21.56 || tāvacchakragajo bhīto muktvā nādaṃ subhairavam|| dhriyamāṇo'pi yatnena cakora iva tiṣṭhati|| 21.57 || palāyati gaje tasminnārūḍhaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ|| viparītamukhaṃ yuddhaṃ dānavendreṇa so'karot|| 21.58 || śatakra tustu śūlena nimiṃ vakṣasyatāḍayat|| gadayā daṃtinaṃ tasya galladeśehanadbhṛśam|| 21.59 || taṃ prahāraciṃtyaiva nimirnirbhayapauruṣaḥ|| airāvataṃ kaṭīdeśe mudgareṇābhyatāḍayat|| 1.2.21.60 || sa hato mudgareṇātha śakrakuñjara āhave|| jagāma paścātpadbhyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ bhūdharākṛtiḥ|| 21.61 || lāghavātkṣipramutthāya tato'maramahāgajaḥ|| raṇādapasasarpātha bhīṣito nimihastinā|| 21.62 || tato vāyurvavau rūkṣo bahuśarkarapāṃśulaḥ|| sammukho nimimātaṃgo'kaṃpano'calakaṃpanaḥ|| srutarakto babhau śailo ghanadhātuhrado yatā|| 21.63 || dhaneśo'pi gadāṃ gurvī tasya dānavahastinaḥ|| mumoca vegānnyapatatsā gadā tasya mūrdhani|| 21.64 || gajo gadānipātena sa tena parimūrchitaḥ|| daṃtairbhitvā dharāṃ vegātpapātācalasannibhaḥ|| 21.65 || patite ca gaje tasminsiṃhanādo mahānabhūt|| sarvataḥ surasainyānāṃ gajabṛṃhitabṛṃhitaḥ|| 21.66 || heṣāraveṇa cāśvānāṃ rāṇāsphoṭaiśca dhanvinām|| gajaṃ taṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā nimiṃ cāpi parāṅmukham|| 21.67 || surāṇāṃ siṃhanādaṃ ca sannāditadigaṃtaram|| jaṃbho jajvāla kopena saṃdīpta iva pāvakaḥ|| 21.68 || tataḥ sa koparaktākṣo dhnuṣyāropya sāyakam|| tiṣṭheti cābravīttāraṃ sārathiṃ cāpyanaṃdayat|| 21.69 || tamāyāṃtamabhiprekṣya dhanuṣyāhitasā yakam|| śatakraturadīnātmā dṛḍhamādatta kārmukam|| 1.2.21.70 || bāṇaṃ ca tailadhautāgramardhacaṃdramajihmagam|| 21.71 || tenāsyaṭa saśaraṃ cāpaṃ ciccheda balavṛtrahā|| apāsya taddhanuśchinnaṃ jaṃbho dānavanaṃdanaḥ|| 21.72 || anyatkārmukādāya vegavadbhārasādhanam|| śarāṃścāśīviṣākārāṃstailadhautājihmagān|| 21.73 || śakraṃ vivyādha daśabhirjatrudeśe ca patribiḥ|| hṛdaye ca tribhiścaiva dvābhyāṃ ca skandhayordvayoḥ|| 21.74 || śakropi dānavendrāya bāṇajālama bhīrayan|| aprāptāndānavendrastu śarāśchakrabhujeritān|| 21.75 || ciccheda śatadhā''kāśe śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ|| tataśca śarajālena devendro dānaveśvaram|| 21.76 || ācchādayata yatnena varṣāsviva ghanairnabhaḥ|| daityo'pi bāṇajālena vivyādha sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ|| 21.77 || yathā vāyurghanāṭopaṃ yadavāryaṃ diśāṃ mukhe|| śakro'tha krodhasaṃraṃbhānna viśeṣayate yadā|| 21.78 || dānavendraṃ tadā cakre gaṃdharvāstraṃ mahādbhutam|| tato'sya tejasā vyāptamabhūdganagocaram|| 21.79 || gandharvanagaraiścāpi nānāprākāratoraṇaiḥ|| muṃcadbhiradbhutākārairastravṛṣṭiṃ samaṃtataḥ|| 1.2.21.80 || tayāstravṛṣṭyā daityānāṃ hanyamānā mahācamūḥ|| jaṃbhaṃ śaraṇamāgacchattrāhitrāhīti bhārata|| 21.81 || tato jaṃbho mahāvīryo vinadya prahasanmuhuḥ|| smaransādhusamācāraṃ daityānāmabhayaṃ dadau|| 21.82 || tato'straṃ mauśalaṃnāma mumoca sumahābhayam|| athogramusalaiḥ sarvamabhavatpūritaṃ jagat|| 21.83 || taiśca bhagnāni sarvāṇi gaṃdharvanagarāṇi ca|| athograika prahāreṇa rathamaśvaṃ gajaṃ suram|| 21.84 || cūrṇayāmāsa tatkṣipraṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ|| tataḥ surādhipaḥ sakrastvāṣṭramastramudairayat|| 21.85 || saṃdhyamāne tataścāstre niśceruḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ|| tato yaṃtramayā vidyāḥ prādurāsansahasraśaḥ|| 21.86 || tairyaṃtrairabhavadyuddhamaṃtarikṣaṃ vitārakam|| tairyaṃtrairmauśalaṃ bhagnaṃ hanyaṃte cāsurāstadā|| 21.87 || śailāstraṃ mumuce jaṃbho yaṃtrasaṃghātacūrṇanam|| vyāmapramāṇairupalaistato varṣaḥ pravartata|| 21.88 || tvāṣṭroṇa nirmitānyāśu yāni yaṃtrāṇi bhārata|| tenopala nipātena gatāni tilaśastataḥ|| 21.89 || tataḥ śirassu devānāṃ śilāḥ peturmahājavāḥ|| dārayaṃtyaśca vasudhāṃ caturaṃgabalaṃ ca tat|| 1.2.21.90 || tato vajrāstramakarotsasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ|| śilāmahārṣaṃvyaśīryata samaṃtataḥ|| 21.91 || tataḥ praśāṃtaiḥ śailāstrairjaṃbho bhūdharasannibhaḥ|| aiṣīkamastramakaroccūrṇitānyaparākramaḥ|| 21.92 || aiṣīkeṇāgamannāśaṃ vajrāstraṃ giridāraṇam|| vijṛṃbhatyatha caiṣīke paramāstre'tidāruṇe|| 21.93 || jajvalurdevasainyāni sasyaṃdanagajāni ca|| dahyamāneṣva nīkeṣu tejasāstrasya sarvataḥ|| 21.94 || āgneyamastramakarodbalahā pākaśāsanaḥ|| tenāstreṇa ca tannāśamaiṣīkamagamattadā|| 21.95 || tasminpratihate cāstre pāvakāstraṃ vyajṛṃbhata|| jajvāla senā jaṃbhasya rathaḥ sārathireva ca|| 21.96 || taḥ pratihatāstro'sau daityeṃdraḥ pratibhānavān|| vāruṇāstraṃ mumocāthaśamanaṃ pāvakārciṣām|| 21.97 || tato jaladharairvyoma sphuradvidyullatākulaiḥ|| gaṃbhīrākṣasamādhāraiścābhyapūryata modinī|| 21.98 || karīṃdrakaratulyābhirdhārābhiḥ pūritaṃ jagat|| śāṃtamāgneyamastraṃ ca vilokyeṃdraścakāra ha|| 21.99 || vāyavyamastramatulaṃ tena meghā yayuḥ kṣayam|| vāyavyāstrabalenātha nirdhūte meghamaṃḍale|| 1.2.21.100 || babhūvānāvilaṃ vyoma nīlotpaladalaprabham|| vāyunā cātirūpeṇa kaṃpitāścaiva dānavāḥ|| 21.101 || na śekustatra te sthātuṃ raṇe'pi balino'pi ye|| jabhastato'bhavacchaulo daśayojanavistṛtaḥ|| 21.102 || mārutapratighātārthaṃ dānavānāṃ balādhipaḥ|| nānāścaryasamāyukto nānādrumalatāvṛtaḥ|| 21.103 || tataḥ praśamite vāyau daityeṃdra parvatākṛtau|| mahāśaniṃ vajramayīṃ mumocāśu śatakratuḥ|| 21.104 || tayāśanyā patitayā daityasyāca larūpiṇaḥ|| kaṃdarāṇi vyaśīryaṃtaṃ samaṃtānnirjharāṇi ca|| 21.105 || tataḥ sā dānaveṃdrasya śailamāyā nyavartata|| nivṛttaśailamāyo'tha dānaveṃdro madotkaṭaḥ|| 21.106 || babhūva kuṃjaro bhīmo mahāśailamayākṛtiḥ|| mamarda ca surānīkaṃ daṃtaiścābhyahanatsurān|| 21.107 || babhaṃja pṛṣṭhataḥ kāṃścitkareṇākṛṣya dānavaḥ|| tataḥ kṣapayatastasya surasainyāni vṛtrahā|| 21.108 || astraṃ trailokyadurdharṣaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ mumoca ha|| tataḥ siṃhasasrāṇi niścerurmaṃtratejasā|| 21.109 || hṛṣṭadaṃṣṭrāṭṭahāsāni krakacābhanakhāni ca|| tairvipāṭitagātro'sau gajamāyāṃ vyapohayat|| 1.2.21.110 || tataścāśīviṣo ghoro'bhavatphaṇasamākulaḥ|| viṣaniḥśvāsanirdagdhasurasainyamahārathaḥ|| 21.111 || tato'straṃ gāruḍaṃ cakre śakraḥ saṃpraharanraॅṇe|| tatastasmādgarutmaṃtaḥ sahasrāṇi viniryayuḥ|| 21.112 || tairgarutmadbhirāsādya jaṃbhaṃ bhujagarūpiṇam|| kṛtastu saṃḍhaśo daityaḥ sāsya māyā vyanaśyata|| 21.113 || māyāyāma ca pranaṣṭāyāṃ tato jaṃbho mahāsuraḥ|| cakāra rūpamatulaṃ caṃdrādityapadānugam|| 21.114 || vivṛttanayano grastumiyeṣa surapuṃgavān|| tato'sya praviśadvaktra samahārathakuṃjarā|| 21.115 || surasenā'bhavadbhīmaṃ pātālottālatālukam|| sainyeṣu grasyamāneṣu dānavena balīyasā|| 21.116 || śakro dīnatvamāpannaḥ śrāṃtavāhanavāhanaḥ|| kartavyatāṃ nādhyagacchatprovācedaṃ janārdanam|| 21.117 || kimanaṃtaramevāsti kartavyaṃ no viśeṣataḥ|| tadādiśa ghaṭāmo'sya dānavasya yuyutsataḥ|| 21.118 || tato hariruvācedaṃ vajrāyudhamudāradhīḥ|| na sāṃprataṃ raṇaṃ tyājyaṃ śatrukātarabhairavam|| 21.119 || mā gaccha mohaṃ mā gaccha kṣipramastraṃ smara prabho|| nārāyaṇāstraṃ prayataḥ śrutveti mumuce sa ca|| 1.2.21.120 || etasminnaṃtare daityo vivṛtāsyo'grasatkṣaṇāt|| trīṇitrīṇi ca lakṣāṇi kiṃnaroragarakṣasām|| 21.121 || tato nārāyaṇāstraṃ ca nipapātāsya vakṣasi|| mahāstrabhinnahṛdayaḥ susrāva rudhiraṃ ca saḥ|| 21.122 || tataḥ svatejasā rūpaṃ tasya daityasya nāśitaṃm|| tataścāṃ tardadhe daityaḥ kṛtvā hāsaṃ mahotkaṭam|| 21.123 || gaganasthaḥ sa daityendraḥ śastrāśanimatīṃdriyaḥ|| mumoca surasainyānāṃ sahārakaraṇīṃ parām|| 21.124 || tathā paraśvadhāṃścakravajrabāṇānsamudgarān|| kuṃtānkhaḍgānbhiṃḍipālānayomukhaguḍāṃstathā|| 21.125 || vavarṣa dānavo roṣādavadhyānakṣayānapi|| tairastrairdānavonmuktairdevānīkeṣu bhīṣaṇaiḥ|| 21.126 || bāhubhirdharaṇī pūrṇā śirobhiśca sakuṃḍalaiḥ|| ūrubhirgajahastābhaiḥ karīṃdraiścācalopamaiḥ|| 21.127 || bhagneṣā daṃḍacakrākṣai rathaibhiḥ saha|| duḥsaṃcārābhavatpṛthvī māṃsaśoṇitakardamā|| 21.128 || rudhiraughahradāvartā gajadehaśiloccayā|| kabaṃdhanṛtyabahulā mahā surapravāhinī|| 21.129 || śrṛgālagṛdhradhvāṃkṣāṇāṃ paramānaṃdakāriṇī|| piśācajātibhiḥ kīrṇaṃ pītvā''miṣaṃ saśoṇitam|| 1.2.21.130 || asaṃbhramābhirbhāryābhiḥ saha nṛtyadbhiruddhatā|| kācitpatnī prakupitā gajakuṃbhāṃtamauktikaiḥ|| 21.131 || piśāco yatra cāśvānāṃ khurānekatra cākarot|| karṇapūreṣu modaṃte paśyaṃtyanyāḥ saroṣataḥ|| 21.132 || prasādayaṃti bahudhā mahākarṇārthakovidāḥ|| kecidvadanti bho devā bho daityāḥ prārthayāmahe|| 21.133 || ākalpamevaṃ yoddhavyamasmākaṃ tṛptihetave|| kecidūcurayaṃ daityo devoyamatimāṃsalaḥ|| 21.134 || mriyate yadi saṃgrāme dhāturdadbho'payācitam|| kecidyudhyatsu vīreṣu sṛkkiṇī saṃlihaṃti ca|| 21.135 || etena payasā vidmo durjanaḥ sujano yathā|| kecidraktanadīnāṃ ca tīreṣvāstikyabuddhayaḥ|| 21.136 || pitṝndevāṃstarpayaṃti śoṇitaiścāmiṣaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| kecidāmiṣarāśisthā dṛṣṭvānyasya karāmiṣam|| 21.137 || dehidehīti vāśāṃto dhaninaḥ kṛpaṇā yathā|| kecitsvayaṃ pratṛptāśca dṛṣṭvā vai khādataḥ parān|| 21.138 || saroṣamoṣṭhau nirbhujya paśyaṃtyevātyasūyayā|| kecitsvamudaraṃ kruddhā niṃdaṃti tāḍayaṃti ca|| 21.139 || sarvabhakṣamabhīpsaṃtastṛptāḥ paradhanaṃ yathā|| kecidāhuradya eva ślāghyā sṛṣṭistu vedhasaḥ|| 1.2.21.140 || suprabhātaṃ sunakṣatraṃ pūrvamāsīddhṛthaiva tat|| evaṃ bahuvidhālāpe palādānāṃ tatastataḥ|| 21.141 || adṛśyaḥ samare jaṃbho devāñṭhastrairacūrṇayat|| tataḥ śakrodhaneśaśca varuṇaḥ pavano'nalaḥ|| 21.142 || yamo'tha nirṛtiścāpi divyāstrāṇi mahābalāḥ|| ākāśe mumucuḥ sarve dānavāyābhisaṃdhya tu|| 21.143 || vyarthatāṃ jagmurastrāṇi devānāṃ dānavaṃ prati|| yathātikrūracittānāmārye kṛtyaśatānyapi|| 21.144 || gatiṃ na vividuścāpi śrāṃtā daityāśca devatāḥ|| daityāstrabhinnasarvāṃgā gāvaḥ śītārditā iva|| 21.145 || parasparaṃ vyalīyaṃta hāhākiṃbhāvivādinaḥ|| tāmavasthāṃ harirdṛṣṭvā devāñchakramuvācaha|| 21.146 || aghoramaṃtraṃ smara devarāja astraṃ hi yatpāśupataprabhāvam|| rudreṇa tuṣṭena tava pradattamavyāhataṃ vīravarābhighāti|| 21.147 || evaṃ sa śakro haribodhitastadā praṇamya devaṃ vṛṣaketumīśvaram|| samādade bāṇamamitraghātanaṃ saṃpūjitaṃ daivaraṇe'rddhacaṃdram|| 21.148 || dhanuṣyajayye viniyojya buddhimānnyayojayattatra aghoramaṃtram|| 21.149 || tato vadhāyāśu mumoca tasya vā ākṛṣya karṇāṃtamakuṃṭhadīdhitim|| athāsuraḥ prekṣya mahāstramāpatadvisṛjya māyāṃ sahasā vyavasthitaḥ|| 1.2.21.150 || pravepamānena mukhena yujyatācalena gātreṇa ca saṃbhramākulaḥ|| tatastu tasyāstravarābhimaṃtritaḥ śarordhacaṃdraḥ prasabhaṃ mahāraṇe|| 21.151 || puraṃdarasyeṣvasanapramukto madhyārkaviṃvaṃ vapuṣā viḍaṃbayan|| 21.152 || kirīṭakūṭasphurakāṃtisaṃkulaṃ sugaṃdhinānākusumādhivāsitam|| prakīrṇadhūmajvalanābhamūrdhajaṃ nyapātayajjaṃbhiśiraḥ sakuṃḍalam|| 21.153 || tasminniṃdrahate jaṃbhe praśaśaṃsuḥ surā bahu|| vāsudevo'pi bhagavānsādhu sādhviti cābravīt|| 21.154 || tato jaṃbhaṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavendrāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ|| sarve te bhagnasaṃkalpā dudruvustārakaṃ prati|| 21.155 || tāṃśca trastānsamālokya śrutvā sa caturo hatān|| sārathiṃ prerayāmāsa yāhīṃdraṃ laghu saṃgare|| 21.156 || tathetyuktvā sa ca prāyāttārake rathamāsthite|| sāvalepaṃ ca sakrodhaṃ sagarvaṃ saparākramam|| 21.157 || sāviṣkāraṃ sadhikkāraṃ prayāto dānaveśvaraḥ|| sa yuktaṃ rathamāsthāya sahasreṇa garutmatām|| 21.158 || sarvāyudhapariṣkāraṃ sarvāstraparirakṣitam|| trailokyaṛddhisaṃpannaṃ kalpāṃtāṃtakanāditam|| 21.159 || sainyena mahatā yukto nādayanvidiśo diśaḥ|| sahasrākṣaśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā vāhanadaṃtinam|| 1.2.21.160 || rathaṃ mātalinā yuktaṃ taptahemapariṣkṛtam|| caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ siddhasaṃghapariṣkṛtam|| 21.161 || gaṃdharvakiṃnarodgītamapsaronṛtyasaṃkulam|| 21.162 || sarvāyudhamahābādhaṃ mahāratnasamācitam|| adhyatiṣṭhattaṃ rathaṃ ca parivārya samaṃtataḥ|| 21.163 || dāṃśitā lokapālāśca tasathuḥ sagaruḍadhvajāḥ|| tataścacāla vasudhā vavau rūkṣo marudgaṇaiḥ|| 21.164 || celuśca sāgarāḥ sapta tathā'naśyadraveḥ prabhā|| tato jajvalurastrāṇi tato'kaṃpaṃta vāhanāḥ|| 21.165 || tataḥ samastamudvṛttaṃ tatodṛsyata tārakaḥ|| ekatastārako daityaḥ surasaṃghāstathaikataḥ|| 21.166 || lokāvasāda mekatra lokoddharaṇamekataḥ|| carācarāṇi bhūtāni bhayavismayavaṃti ca|| 21.167 || praśaśaṃsuḥ surāḥ pārtha tadā tasminsamāgame|| 21.168 || astrāṇi tejāṃsi dhanāni yodhā yaśo balaṃ vīraparākramāśca|| sattvaujasānyaṃga babhūvureṣāṃ devāsurāṇāṃ tapasaḥ paraṃ tu naḥ|| 21.169 || athābhimukhamāyāṃtaṃ devā vinatarpavabhiḥ|| bāṇairanalakalpāgrārvivyadhustārakaṃ prati|| 1.2.21.170 || sa tānaciṃtya daityeṃdro devabāṇakṣatānhṛdi|| bāṇairvyoma diśaḥ pṛthvīṃ pūrayāmāsa dānavaḥ|| 21.171 || nārāyaṇaṃ ca saptatyā navatyā ca hutāśanam|| daśabhirmārutaṃ mūrdhni yamaṃ daśabhireva ca|| 21.172 || dhanadaṃ caiva saptyā varuṇaṃ ca tathāṣṭabhiḥ|| viṃśatyā nirṛtiṃ daityaḥ punaścāṣṭabhireva ca|| 21.173 || vivyādha punarekaikaṃ daśabhirmarmabhedibhiḥ|| tathā ca mātaliṃ daityo vivyādha tribhirāśugaiḥ|| 21.174 || garuḍaṃ daśabhiścaiva mahiṣaṃ navabhistathā|| punardairtyo'tha devānāṃ tilaśo nataparvabhiḥ|| 21.175 || cakāra varmajālāni ciccheda ca dhanūṃṣi ca|| tato vikavacā devā vidhanuṣkāḥ prapīḍitāḥ|| 21.176 || cāpānyanyāni saṃgṛhya yāvanmuṃcaṃti sāyakān|| tāvadbāṇaṃ samādhāya kālānalasamaprabham|| 21.177 || tāḍayāmāsa śakraṃ sa hṛdi sopi mumocaha|| tatoṃ'tarikṣamālokya dṛṣṭvā sūryaśatākṛtī|| 21.178 || tārkṣyaviṣṇū samājaghne śarābhyāṃ tāvamuhyatām|| pretanāthasya vahneśca varuṇasya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ|| 21.179 || nirṛteścākarotkāryaṃ bhītabītaṃ vimohayan|| nirucchvāsaṃ samāhṛtya cakre bāṇaiḥ samīraṇam|| 1.2.21.180 || tataḥ prāpya hariḥ saṃjñāṃ protsāhya ca diśāṃ patīn|| bāṇena sāratheḥ kāyācchiro'hārṣītsakuṇḍalam|| 21.181 || dhūmaketorjvalātkruddhastasya cchittvā nyapātayat|| daityarājakirīṭayaṃ ca ciccheda vāsavastataḥ|| 21.182 || dhaneśaśca dhanuḥ kruddho bibhedabahudhā śaraiḥ|| vāyuścakre ca tilaśo rathaṃ vā kṣoṇikūbaram|| 21.183 || nirṛtistilaśo varṇa cakre bāṇaistato raṇe|| kṛtvaitadatulaṃ karmatiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābruvan|| 21.184 || lihaṃtaḥ sṛkkiṇīṃ devā vāsudevādayastadā|| dṛṣṭvā tatkarma devānāṃ tārako'tulavikramaḥ|| 21.185 || mumoca mudgaraṃ bhīmaṃ sahasrākṣāya saṃgare|| dṛṣṭvā mudgaramāyāṃtamanivāryaṃ raṇājire|| 21.186 || rathādāplutya dharaṇīmagamatpākaśāsanaḥ|| mudgaro'pi rathopasthe papāta paruṣasvanaḥ|| 21.187 || sa rathaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa na mamāra ca mātaliḥ|| gṛhītvā paṭṭiśaṃ daityo jadhānorasi keśavam|| 21.188 || skandhe garutmataḥ so'pi niṣasāda vicetanaḥ|| khaḍgena rākṣasendraṃ ca bhittvā bhūmāvapātayat|| 21.189 || yamaṃ ca pātayāmāsa bhūmau daityo mukhe hatam|| vahniṃ ca bhiṃḍipālena cakre hatvā vicetanam|| 1.2.21.190 || vāyuṃ padā tadākṣipya pātayāmāsa bhūtale|| dhaneśaṃ taddhanuṣkoṭyā kuṭṭayāmāsa kopanaḥ|| 21.191 || tato devanikāyānāmekaikaṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ|| teṣāmeva jaghānāsau śastrairbālānyathā guruḥ|| 21.192 || labdhasaṃjñastato viṣṇuścakraṃ jagrāha durdharam|| rānaveṃdravasāmedorudhireṇābhiraṃjitam|| 21.193 || mumoca dānaveṃdrasya dṛḍhaṃ vakṣasi keśavaḥ|| papāta cakraṃ daityasya patitaṃ bhāskaradyuti|| 21.194 || vyaśīryatātha kāye'sya nīlotpalamivāśmani|| tato vajraṃ mahendro'pi pramumocārcitaṃ ciram|| 21.195 || tasmiñjayāśā śakrasya dānavendrāya saṃyuge|| tārakasya ca saṃprāpya śarīraṃ śauryaśālinaḥ|| 21.196 || viśīryata vikīrṇārciḥ śatadhā khaṇḍaśo gatam|| tato vāyuradīnātmā vegena mahatā nadan|| 21.197 || jvalitajvalanābhāsamaṃkuśaṃ pramumoca ha|| viśīrṇaṃ tasya taccāṃge dṛṣṭvā vāyurmahāruṣā|| 21.198 || tataḥ śailendramutpāṭya puṣpitadrumakaṃdaram|| cikṣepa dānavendrāya daśayojanavistṛtam|| 21.199 || mahīdharaṃ tamāyāṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ daityapuṃgavaḥ|| jagrāha vāmahastena bālaḥ kandukalīlayā|| 1.2.21.200 || tatastenaiva cāhatya pātayāmāsa cāṃtakam|| daṇḍaṃ tataḥ samudyamya kṛtāṃtaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ|| 21.201 || daityendramūrdhni cikṣepa bhrāmya vegena durjayam|| so'surasyāpatanmūrdhni daityastaṃ jagṛhe smayan|| 21.202 || kalpāṃtalokadahano jvalano roṣasaṃjvalan|| śaktiṃ cikṣepadurdharṣāṃ dānavendrāya saṃyuge|| 21.203 || tataḥ śirīṣamāleva sāsya vakṣasyarājata|| tataḥ khaḍgaṃ samākṛṣya kośādākāśanirmalam|| 21.204 || dyuti bhāsitatrailokyaṃ lokapālo'pi nirṛtiḥ|| cikṣepa dānavendrāya tasya mūrdhni papāta ha|| 21.205 || patitaścāgamatkhaḍgaḥ sa śīghraṃ śatakhaṇḍatām|| jaleśaśca tataḥ kruddho mahābhairavarūpiṇam|| 21.206 || mumoca pāśaṃ daityendrabhujabandhābilāṣukaḥ|| sa daityabhujamāsādya pāśaḥ sadyo vyapadyata|| 21.207 || sphuṭitaḥ krakacakrūradaśanālirahīśvaraḥ|| tato'śvinau sacaṃdrārkau sādhyāśca vasavaśca ye|| 21.208 || yakṣarākṣasaganadharvāḥ sarpāścāstraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ|| jaghnurdaityeśvaraṃ sarve bhūyaśaste mahābalāḥ|| 21.209 || na cāstrāṇyasyāsajjanta gātre vajrācalopame|| tato devanavaplutya tārako dānavādipaḥ|| 1.2.21.210 || jaghāna koṭiśaḥ kruddho muṣṭipārṣṇibhireva ca|| tathāvidhaṃ tasya vīryamālokya bhagavānhariḥ|| 21.211 || palāyadhvamaho devā vadannantarhito'bhavat|| śakrādayastato devāḥ palāyanakṛtādarāḥ|| 21.212 || kālanemimukhairdaityeruparuddhā madotkaṭaiḥ|| muṣṭibhiḥ pādaghātaiśca keśaṣvākṛṣya tairmudā|| 21.213 || tāritāḥ śuṣkasaritaṃ devamārgāśca daṃśitāḥ|| bahudhā cāpyakṛṣyaṃta lokapālā mahāsuraiḥ|| 21.214 || tato ninādaḥ saṃjajñe daityānāṃ balaśālinām|| kampayanpṛthivīṃ dyāṃ ca pātālāni ca bhārata|| 21.215 || jayeti muditā daityāstuṣṭuvustārakaṃ tadā|| śaṃkhāṃśca pūrayāmāsuḥ kundendusadṛśaprabhān|| 21.216 || dhanurbāṇaravāṃścogrānkarāghātāṃśca cakrire|| bhṛśaṃ harṣānvitā daityā neduśca nanṛturmuhuḥ|| 21.217 || tato devānpuraskṛtya paśupālaḥ paśūniva|| daityendro rathamāsthāya jagāma sahito'suraiḥ|| 21.218 || mahīsāgarakūlasthaṃ tārakaḥ sa puraṃ balī|| yojanadvādaśāyāmaṃ tāmraprākāraśobhitam|| 21.219 || prāsādarbahubhiḥ kīrṇaṃ divyāścaryopaśobhitam|| yatra śabdāstrayo naiva jīryaṃte cāniśaṃpure|| 1.2.21.220 || gītaghoṣaśca vyāghoṣo bhujyaṃtāṃ viṣayāstviti|| tatpraviśya puraṃ rājā jagāma svakamālayam|| 21.221 || mahotsavena mahatā putrastrīpratinaṃditaḥ|| tatra divyāṃ sabhāṃ rājā prāpya siṃhāsanasthitaḥ|| 21.222 || stūyamāno ditisutairapsarobhirvinoditaḥ|| divyāsanasthairdaityeṃdrairvṛtaḥ siṃhairiva prabhuḥ|| 21.223 || etasminnaṃtare kāci ddivyastrī tatpure'bhavat|| vismitastairvṛto daityaiḥ provācedaṃ smayanniva|| 21.224 || rūpeṇānupamā pārtha nānābharaṇabhūṣitā|| tāṃ dṛṣṭavā tārako rājā bhṛśaṃ vai vismito'bhavat|| 21.225 || kāsi devī mama brūhi kiṃ mayā rūpasuṃdari|| tvatsamāṃ yoṣitaṃ naiva dṛṣṭavaṃtaḥ purā vayam|| 21.226 || ||stryuvāca|| ahaṃ trailokyalakṣmīti viddhi māṃ daityasattama|| arjitā tapasā cāsmi tvayā vīryeṇa vā vibho|| 21.227 || vīryavaṃtaṃ tvanalasaṃ tapasvinamakātaram|| dātāraṃ cāpi bhoktāraṃ yuktyā sevāmi taṃ naram|| 21.228 || bhīruṃ nirviṇṇmatyarthaṃ sādhvīpīḍākaraṃ naram|| sarvātiśaṃkinaṃ sadyastyajāmi ditinaṃdana|| 21.229 || maheṃdraṇa ca mātā te yadā sā vyapamānitā|| tadaiva tyaktaprāyo'sāvidānīṃ tava saṃvaśe|| 1.2.21.230 || tārakaśca tataḥ prāha paramaṃ ceti tāṃ tadā|| sā cāviveśa taṃ devī trijagatpūjitā ramā|| 21.231 || tato daityādhipaṃ nāryo dānavānāṃ vibhūṣitāḥ|| vīrakāṃsyamupādāya vardhayāṃcakrire mudā|| 21.232 || devāśca dvāri tiṣṭhaṃti baddhā daityairbhṛśāturāḥ|| upahasyamānā nārībhirdaityairanyaiśca nāgaraiḥ|| 21.233 || etasminnaṃtare viṣṇurdaityarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ|| upahāsakamadhyastho gāthe dve prāha buddhimān|| 21.234 || idamalpataraṃnāma yadamīṣāṃ ca dṛśyate|| mātṛkrodhaṃ smaranrājā kiṃkiṃ yanna kariṣyati|| 21.235 || balīyāṃsaṃ samāsādya na namedyo na cāsti saḥ|| markavacchvetabākīyairupāyaiḥ sthīyatāṃ surāḥ|| 21.236 || upahāsamukhenāmī upadeśaṃ harermukhāt|| samākarṇya tato devā markkarūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ|| 21.237 || nṛtyaṃtaste ca bahudhā daityāścāsurayoṣitaḥ|| bhṛśaṃ ca nodayāmāsurmudā bhojyāni te daduḥ|| 21.238 || viṣṇurdaityapratīhāraṃ tataḥ provāca buddhimān|| vinodāya mahārājño markānetānprakīrtaya|| 21.239 || pratīhārastato hṛṣṭaḥ sabhāmadhye viveśa saḥ|| jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā baddhā ca karasaṃpuṭam|| 1.2.21.240 || uvācānāvilaṃ vākyamalpākṣaraparisphuṭam|| daityeṃdra markavṛṃdāni dvāri tiṣṭhaṃti te prabho|| 21.241 || bhṛśaṃ vinodakāriṇi spṛhā ceddraṣṭumarhasi|| tanniśamyābravīdrājā kiṃ ciraṃ kriyate tvayā|| 21.242 || kṣattā ceti vacaḥ śrutvā kālanemiṃ tadābravīt|| markānetānmahārājo draṣṭumicchati śīghrataḥ|| 21.243 || rakṣapāla sahaibhistvaṃ rājānamanukūlaya|| kālanemirupādāya markānyāto nṛpaṃ tataḥ|| 21.244 || markamadhye viṣṇumarko yātastyaktvā ca daityatām|| tatastārakadaityasya purato nanṛturbhṛśam|| 21.245 || markā daityakarottālairharṣanādavinoditaiḥ|| tato'timudito rājā teṣāṃ nṛtyena so'bravīt|| 21.246 || abhayaṃ vo markadevāstuṣṭo yacchāmyahaṃ tvidam|| madgṛhe sthīyatāmeva na ca kāryaṃ bhayaṃ hṛdi|| 21.247 || iti śrutvā viṣṇumarkaḥ pranṛtyanni damabravīt|| rājanvijñātumicchāmastava gehāvadhiṃ vayam|| 21.248 || evamukte prahasyāha tārako daityasattamaḥ|| tribhūmikaṃ hi me gehamidaṃ yadbhuvanatrayam|| 21.249 || harimarkastataḥ prāha yadyevaṃ svaṃ vacaḥ smara|| trailokye vicaraṃtvete markā rājansunirbhayāḥ|| 1.2.21.250 || aśvamedhaśatasyāpi satyaṃ rājanviśiṣyate|| dharmamenaṃ smaransatyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru daityapa|| 21.251 || tataḥ suvismito daityaḥ prāhedaṃ vacanaṃ tadā|| markaṭāho prabuddho'si satyaṃ brūhi ca ko bhavān|| 21.252 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca|| ahaṃ nārāyaṇonāma yadi śrotramupāgataḥ|| devānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya markarūpamupāśritaḥ|| 21.253 || taccenmānyatamo dharmastava tadvacanaṃ svakam|| paripālaya te gehaṃ vicaraṃtu surāstvamī|| 21.254 || avalopaśca rājeṃdra na kartavyastvayā hṛdī|| vīro'hamiti saṃcintya paśyatā kālajaṃ balam|| 21.255 || paryāyairhanyamānānāmabhihaṃtā na vidyate|| mauḍhyametattu yaddveṣṭā kartāhamiti manyate|| 21.256 || ṛṣīṃśca devāṃśca mahāsurāṃśca traividyavṛddhāṃśca vane munīṃśca|| kaṃ vāpado nopanamaṃti kāle kālasya vīryaṃ na tu karturetat|| 21.257 || na maṃtrabalavīryeṇa prajñayā pauruṣeṇa vā|| alabhyaṃ labhyate kāle kāle suptopi viṃdati|| 21.258 || na mātṛpitṛśuśrūṣā na ca daivatapūjanam|| nānyo guṇasamācāraḥ puraṣasya sukhāvahaḥ|| 21.259 || na vidyā na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na vāṃdhavāḥ|| śaknuvaṃti paritrātuṃ naraṃ kālena pīḍitam|| 1.2.21.260 || nāgāmigamanārthaṃ hi pratighātaśatairapi|| śaknuvaṃti prativyoḍhumṛte kālabalaṃ narāḥ|| 21.261 || dehavatpuṇyakarmāṇi jīvavatkāla ucyate|| dvayoḥ samāgame daitya kāryāṇāṃ siddhiriṣyate|| 21.262 || aho daitya tvadviśiṣṭā daityānāṃ koṭayaḥ purā|| śālmalestūlavatkṣiptāḥ kālavātena durdaśāḥ|| 21.263 || idaṃ tu labdhvā tvaṃ sthānamātmānaṃ bahu manyase|| sarvabhūtabhavaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇamiva śāśvatam|| 21.264 || na cedamacalaṃ sthānamanaṃtaṃ cāpi kasyacit|| tvaṃ tu bāliśayā buddhyā mamedamiti manyase|| 21.265 || aviśvāsye viśvasiṣi manyase cā'dhruvaṃ dhruvam|| mamedamiti mohāttvaṃ trilokīśriyamīpsasi|| 21.266 || neyaṃ tava na cāsmākaṃ na cānyeṣāṃ sthirā matā|| atikramya bahūnyāṃstvayi tāvadiyaṃ sthitā|| 21.267 || kaṃcitkālamiyaṃ sthitvā tvayi tāraka caṃcalā|| puṃścalīvāticapalā punaranyaṃ gamiṣyati|| 21.268 || saratnauṣadisaṃpannaṃ sasaritparvatākaram|| tānidānīṃ na paśyāmi yairbhuktaṃ bhuvanatrayam|| 21.269 || hiraṇyakaśipurvīro hiraṇyākṣaśca durjayaḥ|| prahrādo namucirvīro vipracittirvirocanaḥ|| 1.2.21.270 || kīrtiḥ śūraśca vīraśca vātāpirilvalastathā|| aśvagrīvaḥ śaṃbaraśca pulomā madhukaiṭabhau|| 21.271 || viśvajitpramukhāścānye dānaveṃdrā mahābalāḥ|| kālena nihatāḥ sarve kālo hi balavattaraḥ|| 21.272 || sarvairvarṣāyutaṃ taptaṃ na tvameko mahātapāḥ|| sarve satyavrataparāḥ sarve cāsanbahuśrutāḥ|| 21.273 || sarve yathārhadātāraḥ sarve dākṣāyaṇīsutāḥ|| jvalaṃtaḥ prajayaṃtaśca kālena pratisaṃhatāḥ|| 21.274 || muṃcecchāṃ kāmabhogeṣu muṃcemaṃ śrībhavaṃ madam|| etadaiśvaryanāśe tvāṃ śokaḥ saṃpīḍayiṣyati|| 21.275 || śokakāle śuco mātvaṃ harṣakāle ca mā hṛṣaḥ|| atītānāgate hi tvā pratyutpannena vartaya|| 21.276 || iṃdraṃ cedāgataḥ kālaḥ sadā yukta mataṃdritam|| kṣamasva na cirāddaitya tvāmapyupagamiṣyati|| 21.277 || ko hi sthātumalaṃ loke mama kruddhasya saṃyuge|| kālastu balavānprāptastena tiṣṭhāmi tāraka|| 21.278 || tvameva vetsi māṃ daitya yohaṃ yādṛkparākramaḥ|| kalpekalpe mahādaityāḥ koṭiśo'rbudaśohatāḥ|| 21.279 || yeṣāṃ tvaṃ koṭibhāge'pi paripūrṇo na tāraka|| kalpekalpe sṛjāmīdaṃ brahmādi sakalaṃ jagat|| 1.2.21.280 || icchansaṃjīvayāmyetadanicchannāśaye kṣaṇāt|| na hi tvāṃ notsahe haṃtuṃ sarvadaityasamāyutam|| 21.281 || aṃgulyagreṇa daityeṃdra punardharmaṃ nalopaye|| yadyahaṃ pravaro bhūtvā dharmaṃ brahmavarātmakam|| 21.282 || lopayāmi tataḥ kaṃ ca dharmo'yaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet|| ahaṃ karteti mā maṃsthāḥ kartāyastu sadā prabhuḥ|| 21.283 || so'yaṃ kālaḥ pacedviśvaṃ vṛkṣe phalamivāgatam|| yaireva karmabhiḥ saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ tairevakarmabhiḥ|| 21.284 || prāpnoti puruṣo daitya paśya kālasya citratām|| sarvaṃ kālavaśādeva bodvavyaṃ dhīryuternaraiḥ|| 21.285 || svakarmaparipākasya phaladaṃ vai vidurbudhāḥ|| tasmātkarma śubhaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyātpuṇyātmakaṃ ca yat|| 21.286 || puṇyena tatra sokhyaṃ syāddṛḥkhaṃ pāpena niścitam|| iti saṃciṃtya daityeṃdra svaṃ vacaḥ paripālaya|| maduktaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ yadi maṃtumihārhasi|| 21.287 || ||tāraka uvāca|| māmatra saṃsthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālanemimukhairyutam|| 21.288 || kasyeha na vyathedburmṛtyorapi jivāṃsataḥ|| sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī|| 21.289 || bravīṣi yadyattvaṃ vākyaṃ tatathaiva na saṃśayaḥ|| ko hi viśvāsamartheṣu śarīre vā śarīrabhṛt|| 1.2.21.290 || kartumutsahate loke dṛṣṭvā saṃprasthitaṃ jagat|| ahamapyevamevainaṃ lokaṃ jānāmyaśāśvatam|| 21.291 || kālāgnāvāhitaṃ ghore guhye satatagatvare|| idamadya kariṣyāmi śvaḥkartāsmītivādinaḥ|| 21.292 || kālo harati saṃprāpte nadīvega ivonmukhān|| idānīṃ tāvadevāsau mayā dṛṣṭo na vismṛtaḥ|| 21.293 || kālena hriyamāṇānāṃ pralāpaḥ śrūyate nṛṇām|| īrṣyābhimānalobheṣu kāmakro dhabhayeṣu ca|| 21.294 || spṛhāmohātivādeṣu lokaḥ sakto na budhyate|| guruṃ vāpyaguruṃ vāpi kṛtyākṛtyaṃ ca keśava|| 21.295 || jānāmi tvāmahaṃ viṣṇo sarvabhūtavaraṃ prabhum|| kiṃ kurmaḥ svasvabhāvena balinā tvāṃ na manmahe|| 21.296 || kecidbhajaṃti tvāṃ bhaktyā vaireṇa helayā pare|| sarvenukaṃpyāste tubhyamatarātmāsi dehinām|| 21.297 || purāṇaḥ śāśvato dharmaḥ sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ samaḥ|| māmālaṃbya mayā muktā yāṃtu sarve divaukasaḥ|| 21.298 || punarmarkasvarūpeṇa bhrāṃtavyaṃ bhuvanatrayam|| spṛhāpi yajñabhāgānāṃ na kāryā samayastvayam|| 21.299 || evamukte tārakeṇa devā harṣaṃ prapedire|| mucyate hṛtalomāpi meṣo lābho hi saunikāt|| 1.2.21.300 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca|| daityeṃdra bhava tattvajño vidyājñānataponvitaḥ|| kālaṃ paśyasi suvyaktaṃ pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā|| 21.301 || kālacāritratattvajña śivabhakta mahāmate|| vajrāṃgasuta dhanyo'si spṛhaṇīyo'si dhīmatām|| 21.302 || yāvatte tapaso vīryaṃ tāvadbhuṃkṣvajagattrayam|| etena samayenaite cariṣyaṃti surā jagat|| 21.303 || ityuktvā markayūthena vṛto nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ|| sthānādasmādapākramya meruṃ prati yayau tadā|| 21.304 || tato meruṃ samāgamya provāca vacanaṃ hariḥ|| bhavaṃto yāṃtu brahmaṇaṃ sa dhāsyati ca vo hitam|| 21.305 || apramattaiḥ sadā bhāvyaṃ pālyaśca samayastathā|| ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇustatraivāṃtaradhīyata|| 21.306 || praṇataḥ saṃstuto devairbrahmāṇaṃ ca surā yayuḥ|| 21.307 || divyottamaistatra gatairabhiṣṭuto vidīptatejā bhuvanatraye'pi|| vajrāṃgaputro'pi mumoda vīraḥ śivaprasādena maharddhimāpya|| 21.308 || svayamindro nimirvahniḥ kālanemiryamo'pi ca|| stambhaśca nirṛtisthāne mahiṣo varuṇāstathā|| 21.309 || meṣo vātādhikāri ca kujaṃbho dhanado'bhavat|| anyeṣāṃ cādhikārāṃśca daityānāṃ tārako dadau|| 1.2.21.310 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe devāsurasaṃgrāme tārakavijayavarṇananāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 21 || cha ||
<1.2.22>
||nārada uvāca|| evaṃ viprakṛtā devā maheṃdrasahitāstadā|| yayuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dāma markarūpamupāśritāḥ|| 22.1 || tataśca vismito brahmā prāha tānsurapuṃgavān|| svarūpeṇeha tiṣṭhadhvaṃ nātra vastārakādbhayam|| 22.2 || tato devāḥ svarūpasthāḥ pramlānavadanāṃbujāḥ|| tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve pitaraṃ putrakā yathā|| 22.3 || namo jagatprasūtyai te hetave pālakāya ca|| saṃhartre ca namastubhyaṃ tisro'vasthāstava prabho|| 22.4 || tvamapaḥ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭvā tāsu vīryamavāsṛjaḥ|| tadaṇḍamabhavaddhaimaṃ yasmillokāścarācarāḥ|| 22.5 || vedeṣvāhurvirāḍrūpaṃ tvāmekarūpamīdṛśam|| pātālaṃ pādamūlaṃ ca pārṣṇipāde rasātalam|| 22.6 || mahātalaṃ cāsya gulphau jaṃghe cāpi talātalam|| sutalaṃ jānunī cāsya ūrū ca vitalātale|| 22.7 || mahītalaṃ ca jaghanaṃ nābhiścāsya nabhastalam|| jyotiḥ padamuraḥ sthānaṃ svarloko bāhurucyate|| 22.8 || grīvā mahaścavadanaṃ janalokaḥ prakīrtyate|| lalāṭaṃ ca tapolokaḥ śīrṣa satyamudāhṛtam|| 22.9 || candrasūryau ca nayane diśaḥ śrotre nāsikāśvinau|| ātmānaṃ brahmaraṃdhrasthamāhustvāṃ vedavādinaḥ|| 1.2.22.10 || evaṃ ye te virāḍrūpaṃ saṃsmaraṃta upāsate|| janmabandhavinirmuktā yāṃti tvāṃ paramaṃ padam|| 22.11 || evaṃ sthūlaṃ prāṇimadhyaṃ ca śūkṣmaṃ bhāvebhāve bhāvitaṃ tvāṃ gṛṇaṃti|| sarvatrasthaṃ tvāmataḥ prāhurvedāstasmai tubhyaṃ padamja idvidhema|| 22.12 || evaṃ stuto viraṃcistu kṛpayābhipariplutaḥ|| jānannapi tadā prāha teṣāmāśvāsahetave|| 22.13 || sarve bhavanto duḥkhārtāḥ parimlānamukhāṃbujāḥ|| bhraṣṭāyudāstathā'kasmādbhraṣṭā bharaṇavāsasaḥ|| 22.14 || mamaivayaṃ kṛtirdevā bhavatāṃ yadvaḍambanā|| yadvairājaśarīre me bhavanto bāhusaṃjñakāḥ|| 22.15 || yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ dhārmikaṃ corjitaṃ mahat|| tatrāsīdbāhunāśo me bāhusthāne ca te mama|| 22.16 || tannūnaṃ mama bhagnau ca bāhū tena durātmanā|| yena copahṛtaṃ devāstanmamākhyātu marhatha|| 22.17 || ||devā ūcuḥ|| yo'sau vajrāṃgatanayastvayā dattavaraḥ prabho|| bhṛśaṃ viprakṛtāstena tattvaṃ jānāsi tattvataḥ|| 22.18 || yattanmahīsamudrasya taṭaṃ śārvikatīrthakam|| tadākramya kṛtaṃ tena marubhūmisamaṃ prabhoḥ|| 22.19 || ṛddhayaḥ sarvadevānāṃ gṛhītāstena sarvataḥ|| mahābhūtasvarūpeṇa sa eva ca jagatpatiḥ|| 1.2.22.20 || caṃdrasūryau grahāstārā yaccānyaddevapakṣataḥ|| tacca sarvaṃ nirākṛtya sthāpito daityapakṣakaḥ|| 22.21 || vayaṃ ca vidhṛtā stena bahūpahasitāstathā|| prasādānmuktāśca kathaṃcidiva kaṣṭataḥ|| 22.22 || tadvayaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ pīḍitāḥ kṣuttṛṣārditāḥ|| dharmarakṣā karāśceti saṃciṃtya trātumarhasi|| 22.23 || ityuktaḥ svātmabhūrdevaḥ surairdaityaviceṣṭitam|| surānuvāca bhagavānataḥ saṃciṃtya tattvataḥ|| 22.24 || avadhyastārako daityaḥ sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ|| yasya vadhyaśca nādyāpi sa jāto bhagavānpunaḥ|| 22.25 || mayā ca varadānena cchandayitvā nivāritaḥ|| 22.26 || tapasā sa hidīpto'bhūttrailokyadahanātmakaḥ|| sa ca vavre vadhaṃ daityaḥ śiśataḥ saptavāsarāt|| 22.27 || sa ca saptadino bālaḥ śaṃkarādyo bhaviṣyati|| tārakasya ca vīrasya vadhakartā bhaviṣyati|| 22.28 || satīnāmā tu yā devī vinaṣṭā dakṣahelayā|| sā bhaviṣyati kalyāṇī himācalaśarīrajā|| 22.29 || śaṃkarasya ca tasyāśca yatnaḥ kāryaḥ samāgame|| ahamapyasya kāryasya śeṣaṃ kartā na saṃśayaḥ|| 1.2.22.30 || ityuktāstridaśāstena sākṣātkalayoninā|| jagmurmeruṃ praṇamyeśaṃ markarūpeṇa saṃvṛtāḥ|| 22.31 || tato gateṣu deveṣu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| niśāṃ sasmāra bhagavānsvāṃ tanuṃ pūrvasaṃbhavām|| 22.32 || tato bhagavatī rātrirupatasthe pitāmaham|| tāṃ vivikte samālokya tathovāca vibhāvarīm|| 22.33 || vibhāvari mahākāryaṃ vibudhānāmupasthitam|| tatkartavyaṃ tvayā devi śrṛṇu kāryasya niścayam|| 22.34 || tārakonāma daityeṃdraḥ suraketuranirjjitaḥ|| tasyābhāvāya bhagavāñjanayiṣyati yaṃ śivaḥ|| 22.35 || sutaḥ sa bhavitā tasya tārakasyāṃtakārakaḥ|| ahaṃ tvādau yadā jātastadāpaśyaṃ puraḥsthitam|| 22.36 || ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ vyāpya viśvamavasthitam|| dṛṣṭvā tamabruvaṃ devaṃ bhajasveti ca bhaktitaḥ|| 22.37 || tato nārī pṛthagjātā puruṣaśca tathā pṛthak|| tasyāścaivāṃśajāḥ sarvāḥ striyastribhuvane smṛtāḥ|| 22.38 || ekādaśa ca rudrāśca puruṣāstasya cāṃśajāḥ|| tāṃ nārīmahāmālokya putraṃ dakṣamathā bravam|| 22.39 || bhajasva putrīṃ jagatī mamāpi ca tavāpi ca|| puṃduḥkhanakāttrātrī putrī te bhāvinī tviyam|| 1.2.22.40 || evamukto mayā dakṣaḥ putrītve pari kalpitām|| rudrāya dattavānbhaktyā nāma dattvā satīti yat|| 22.41 || tataḥ kāle cam̐ kasmiṃścidavamene ca tāṃ pitā|| mumūrṣuḥ pāpasaṃkalpo durātmā kulakajjalaḥ|| 22.42 || ye rudraṃ naiva manyaṃte te sphuṭaṃ kulakajjalāḥ|| piśācāste durātmāno bhavaṃti brahmarākṣasāḥ|| 22.43 || avamānena tasyāpi yathā devī jahau tanum|| yathā yajñaḥ sa ca dhvasto bhavena viditaṃ hi te'|| 22.44 || adhunā himaśailasya bhavitrī duhitā ca sā|| maheśvaraṃ patiṃ sā ca punaḥ prāpsyati niścitam|| 22.45 || tadidaṃ ca tvayā kāryaṃ menāgarbhe praviśya ca|| tasyāśchaviṃ kuru kṛṣṇāṃ yathā kālī bhavettu sā|| 22.46 || yadā rudropahasitā tapastapsyati sā mahat|| samāptaniyamā devī yadā cogrā bhaviṣyati|| 22.47 || svayameva yadā rūpaṃ sugauraṃ pratipatsyate|| viraheṇa haraścāsyā matvā śūnyaṃ jagattrayam|| 22.48 || tasyaiva himaśailasya kaṃdare siddhasevite|| pratīkṣamāṇastāṃ devīmugraṃ saṃtapsyate tapaḥ|| 22.49 || tayoḥ sutaptatapasorbhavitā yo mahānsutaḥ|| bhaviṣyati sa daityasya tārakasya nivārakaḥ|| 1.2.22.50 || tapaso hi vinā nāsti siddhiḥ kutrāpi śobhane|| sarvāsāṃ karmasiddhīnāṃ mūlaṃ hi tapa ucyate|| 22.51 || tvayāpi dānavo devi dehanirgatayā tadā|| caṃḍamuṃḍapurogāśca haṃtavyā lokadurjayāḥ|| 22.52 || yasmāccaṃḍaṃ ca muṃḍaṃ ca tvaṃ devi nihaniṣyasi|| cāmuṃḍeti tato loke khyātā devi bhaviṣyasi|| 22.53 || tatastvāṃ varade devī lokaḥ saṃpūjayiṣyati|| bhederbahuvidhākāraiḥ sarvagāṃ kāmasādhanīm|| 22.54 || oṃkāravaktrāṃ gāyatrīṃ tvāmarcaṃti dvijottamāḥ|| ūrjitāṃ baladāṃ pāpi rājānaḥ sumahābalāḥ|| 22.55 || vaiśyāśca bhūtimityeva śivāṃ śūdrāstathā śubhe|| kṣāṃtirmunīnāmakṣobhyā dayā niyamināmapi|| 22.56 || tvaṃ mahopāya sandohā nītirnayavisarpiṇām|| paristhitistvamarthānāṃ tvamaho prāṇikā matā|| 22.57 || tvaṃ yuktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvadehinām|| ratistvaṃ raticittānāṃ prītistvaṃ hṛdyadarśinām|| 22.58 || tvaṃ kāṃtiḥ śubharūpāṇāṃ tvaṃ śāṃti śubhakarmiṇām|| tvaṃ bhrāṃtirmūḍhacittānāṃ tvaṃ phalaṃ kratuyājinām|| 22.59 || jaladhīnāṃ mahāvelā tvaṃ ca līlā vilāsinām|| saṃbhūtistvaṃ padārthānāṃ sthitistvaṃ lokapālinī|| 1.2.22.60 || tvaṃ kālarātrirniḥśeṣa bhuvanāvalināśinī|| priyakaṃṭhagrahānandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī|| 22.61 || prasīda praṇatānasmānsaumyadṛṣṭyā vilokaya|| 22.62 || iti stuvaṃto ye devi pūjayiṣyaṃti tvāṃ śubhe|| te sarvakāmānāpsyaṃti niyatā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 22.63 || ityuktā tu niśādevī tathetyuktvā kṛtāñjaliḥ|| jagāma tvaritā pūrvaṃ gṛhaṃ himagirermahat|| 22.64 || tatrā''sīnāṃ mahāharmye ratnabhittisamāśraye|| dadarśa menāmāpāṃḍucchavivaktrasaroruhām|| 22.65 || kiṃcicchayāmamukhodagrastanabhāgāvanāmitām|| mahauṣadhigaṇabaddhamaṃtrarājaniṣevitām|| 22.66 || tataḥ kiṃcitpramilite menānetrāṃbujadvaye|| āviveśamukhaṃ rātrirbrahmaṇo vacanāttadā|| 22.67 || janmadāyā jaganmātuḥ krameṇa jaṭharāṃtaram|| araṃjayacchaviṃ devyā guhamāturvibhāvarī|| 22.68 || tato jaganmaṃ galadā menā himagireḥ priyā|| brāhme muhūrte subhage prāsūyata śubhānanām|| 22.69 || tasyāṃ tu jāyamānāyāṃ jaṃtavaḥ sthāṇujaṃgamāḥ|| abhavansukhinaḥ sarve sarvalokanivāsinaḥ|| 1.2.22.70 || abhavatkrūrasattvānāṃ cetaḥ śāṃtaṃ ca dehinām|| jyotiṣāmapi tejastvamabhavatsutarāṃ tadā|| 22.71 || vanāśritāścauṣadhayaḥ svādavaṃti phalāni ca|| gaṃdhavaṃti ca mālyāni vimalaṃ ca nabho'bhavat|| 22.72 || mārutaśca sukhasparśo diśaśca sumanoharāḥ|| vismṛtā ni ca śāstrāṇi prādurbhāvaṃ prapedire|| 22.73 || prabhāvastīrthamukhyānāṃ tadā puṇyatamo'bhavat|| satye dharme cādhyayane yajñe dāne tapasyapi|| 22.74 || sarveṣāmabhavacchraddhā janmakāle guhāraṇeḥ|| aṃtarikṣemarāścāpi praharṣotphullalocanāḥ|| 22.75 || haribrahmamaheṃdrārkavāyuvahnipurogamāḥ|| puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pramumucustasminmenāgṛhe śubhe|| 22.76 || meruprabhṛtayaścāpi mūrtimaṃto mahānagāḥ|| tasminmahotsave prāptā vīrakāṃsyopaśobhitāḥ|| 22.77 || sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva samājagmuśca sarvaśaḥ|| 22.78 || himaśailo'bhavalloke tadā sarvaiścarācaraiḥ|| sevyaścāpyabhigamyaśca pūjanīyaśca bhārata|| 22.79 || anubhūyotsavaṃ te ca jagmuḥ svānālayāṃstadā|| 1.2.22.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe kumāreśa māhātmye pārvatījanmavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 22 || cha ||
<1.2.23>
||nārada uvāca|| tataśca śailajā devī cikrīḍa subhagā tadā|| devagaṃdharvakanyābhirnagakiṃnarasaṃbhavāḥ|| munīnāṃ cāpi yāḥ kanyāstābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca śobhanā|| 23.1 || kadācidatha merustho vāsavaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| sasmārā māṃ yayau cāhaṃ saṃsmṛto vāsavaṃ tadā|| 23.2 || māṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sahasrākṣaḥ samutthāyātiharṣitaḥ|| pūjayāmāsa tāṃ pūjāṃ pratigṛhyāhamabruvam|| 23.3 || mahāsura mahonmādakālānala divaspate|| kuśalaṃ vidyate kaccicca naṃdasi|| 23.4 || pṛṣṭastvevaṃ mayā śakraḥ provāca vacanaṃ smayan|| kuśalasyāṃkurastāvatsaṃbhūto bhuvanatraye|| 23.5 || tatphalodayasaṃpattau tadbhavānsaṃsmṛto mune|| vetsi sarvamataṃ tvaṃ vai tathāpi parinodakaḥ|| 23.6 || nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ yāti nivedyārthaṃ suhṛjjane|| 23.7 || tadbhavāñchailajāṃ devīṃ śailaṃdraṃ śailavallabhām|| haraṃ saṃbhāvaya varaṃ yannānyaṃ rocayaṃti te|| 23.8 || tatastadvākyamākarṇya gato'haṃ śailasattamam|| oṣadhiprasthanilayaṃ sākṣādiva divaspatim|| 23.9 || tatra haime svayaṃ tena mahābhaktyā nivedite|| mahāsane pūjitohamupaviṣṭo mahāsukham|| 1.2.23.10 || gṛhītārghyaṃ tato māṃ ca papraccha ślakṣṇayā girā|| kuśalaṃ tapasaḥ śailaḥ śanaiḥ phullānanāṃbujaḥ|| 23.11 || ahamapyasya tatprocya pratyavocaṃ girīśvaram|| tvayā śaileṃdra pūrvāṃ vāpyaparāṃ ca diśaṃ tathā|| 23.12 || avagāhya sthitavatā kriyate prāṇipālanā|| aho dhanyosi vipreṃdrāḥ sāhāyyena tavācala|| 23.13 || tapojapavratasnānauḥ sādhyaṃtyātmanaḥ param|| yajñāṃgasādhanaiḥ kāṃścitkaṃdādiphaladānataḥ|| 23.14 || tvaṃ samuddharasi viprānkimataḥ procyate tava|| anye'pi jīva bahudhātvāmupāśritya bhūdhara|| 23.15 || muditāḥ prativartaṃte gṛhasthamiva prāṇinaḥ|| śītamātapavarṣāṃśca kleśānnānāvidhānsahan|| 23.16 || upākaroṣi jaṃtūnāmevaṃrūpā hi sādhavaḥ|| kimataḥ procyate tubhyaṃ dhanyastvaṃ pṛthivīdhara|| 23.17 || kaṃdaraṃ yasya cādhyāste svayaṃ tava maheśvaraḥ|| ityuktavati vākyaṃ ca yathārthaṃ mayiphālguna|| 23.18 || himaśailasya mahiṣī menā āgāddidṛkṣayā|| anuyātā duhitrā ca svalpāśca paricārikāḥ|| 23.19 || lajjayānatasarvāṃgī praviveśa sado mahat|| tato māṃ śailamahiṣī vavaṃde praṇipatya sā|| 1.2.23.20 || vastranirgūḍhavadanā pāṇipadmakṛtāṃjaliḥ|| tāmahaṃ satyarūpābhirāśīrbhiḥ samavardhayam|| 23.21 || pativratā śubhācārā subagā vīrasūḥ śubhe|| sadā vīravatī cāpi bhava vaṃśonnatiprada|| 23.22 || tato'haṃ vismitākṣīṃ ca himavadgiriputrikām|| mṛduvāṇyā pratyavocamehi bāle mamāṃtikam|| 23.23 || tato devī jaganmātā bālabāvaṃ svakaṃ mayi|| darśayaṃtī svapitaraṃ kaṃṭhe gṛhyāṃkamāvi śat|| 23.24 || uvāca vācaṃ tāṃ maṃdaṃ muniṃ vaṃdaya putrike|| muneḥ prasādato'vaśyaṃ patimāpsyasi saṃmatam|| 23.25 || ityuktā sā tato bālā vastrāṃtapi hitānanā|| kiṃcitsahuṃkṛtotkaṃpaṃ procya novāca kiṃcana|| 23.26 || tato vismitacittohamupacāravidāṃvaraḥ|| pratyavocaṃ punardevīmehi dāsyāmi te śubhe|| 23.27 || ratnakrīḍanakaṃ ramyaṃ stāpitaṃ suciraṃ mayā|| ityuktā sā tadotthāya pituraṃkātsavegataḥ|| 23.28 || vaṃdamānā ca me pādau mayā nītāṃka mātmanaḥ|| manyatā tāṃ jagatpūjyāmuktaṃ bāle tavocitam|| 23.29 || na tatpaśyāmi yattubhyaṃ dadmyāśīḥ kā tavocitā|| ityukte mātṛvātsalyācchailendra mahiṣī tadā|| 1.2.23.30 || nodayāmāsa māṃ maṃdamānaśīḥśaṃkitā tadā|| bhagavanvetsi sarvaṃ tvamatītānāgataṃ prabho|| 23.31 || tadahaṃ jñātumicchāmi kīdṛśo'syāḥ patirbhavet|| śrutveti sasmitamukhaḥ prāvocaṃ narmavallabhaḥ|| 23.32 || na jāto'syāḥ patirbhadre vartate ca kulakṣaṇaḥ|| nagno'tinirdhanaḥ krodhīvṛtaḥ krūraiśca sarvadā|| 23.33 || śrutveti saṃbhramāviṣṭo dhvastavīryo himācalaḥ|| māṃ tadā pratyuvācedaṃ sāśrukaṇṭho mahāgiriḥ|| 23.34 || aho vicitraḥ saṃ sāro durvedyo mahatāmapi|| pravarastvapi śaktyā yo nareṣu na kṛpāyate|| 23.35 || yatnena mahatā tāvatpuṇyairbahuvidhairapi|| sādhayatyātmano loko mānuṣya matidurlabham|| 23.36 || adhruvaṃ taddhravatve ca kathaṃcitparikalpyate|| tatrāpi durlabhānāma samānavratacāriṇī|| 23.37 || sādhvī mahākulotpannā bhāryāyā syātpativratā|| tatrāpi durlabhaṃ yacca tayā dharmaniṣevaṇam|| 23.38 || saha vedapurāṇoktaṃ jagattrayahitāvaham|| etatsudurlabhaṃ yacca tasyāṃ caiva prajāyate|| 23.39 || tadapatyamapatyārthaṃ saṃsāre kila nārada|| eteṣāṃ durlabhānāṃ hi kiṃcitprāpnoti puṇyavān|| 1.2.23.40 || sarvametadavāpnoti sa kopi yadivā na vā|| kiṃcitkenāpi hi nyūnaṃ saṃsāraḥ kurute naram|| 23.41 || atha saṃsāriko doṣaḥ svakṛtaṃ yatra bhujyate|| gārhasthyaṃ ca praśaṃsaṃti vedāḥ sarve'pi nārada|| 23.42 || neti kecittatra punaḥ kathaṃ te yadi no gṛhī|| ato dhātrā ca śāstreṣu sutalābhaḥ praśaṃsitaḥ|| 23.43 || punaścasṛṣṭivṛddhyarthaṃ narakatrāṇanāya ca|| tatra strīṇāṃ samutpattiṃ vinā sṛṣṭirna jāyate|| 23.44 || sā ca jātiprakṛtyaiva kṛpaṇā dainyabhāginī|| tāsāmupari māvajñā bhavediti ca vedhasā|| śāstreṣūktamasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametanmahātphalam|| 23.45 || daśaputrasamā kanyā daśaputrānpravarddhayan|| yatphalaṃ labhate martyastallabhyaṃ kanyayaikayā|| 23.46 || tasmātkanyā pituḥ śocyā sadā duḥkhavivardhinī|| 23.47 || yāpi syātpūrṇasarvārthā patiputradhanānvitā|| tvayoktaṃ ca kṛte hyasyāstadvākyaṃ mama śokadam|| 23.48 || kena doṣeṇa me putrī na yogyā āśiṣāmatā|| na jāto'syāḥ patiḥ kasmādvartate vā kulakṣaṇaḥ|| 23.49 || nirdhanaśca mune kasmātsarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ kutaḥ|| iti durghaṭavākyaṃ te mano mohayatīva me|| 1.2.23.50 || iti taṃ putravātsalyātsabhāryaṃ śokasaṃplutam|| ahamāśvāsayaṃ vāgbhiḥ satyābhiḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| 23.51 || mā śucaḥ śailarāja tvaṃ harṣasthāne'tipuṇyabhāk|| śrṛṇu tadvacanaṃ mahyaṃ yanmayoktaṃ ca hyarthavat|| 23.52 || jaganmātā tviyaṃ bālā putrī te sarvasiddhidā|| purā bhave'bhavadbhāryā satīnāmnā bhavasya yā|| 23.53 || tadasyāḥ kimahaṃ dadmi raverdīpamivālpakaḥ|| saṃciṃtyeti mahādevyā nāśiṣaṃ dattavānaham|| 23.54 || na jāto'bhavadbhāryā patiśceti vartate ca bhavo hi saḥ|| na sa jāto mahādevo bhūtabhavyabhavodbhavaḥ|| 23.55 || śaraṇyaḥ śāśvataḥ śāstā śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ|| 23.56 || sarve devā yatpadamāmanaṃti vedaiśca sarvairapi yo na labhyaḥ|| brahmādiviśvaṃ nanu yasya śaila bālasya vā krīḍanakaṃ vadaṃti|| 23.57 || sa cāmaṃgalyaśīlo'pi maṃgalāṃ yatano haraḥ|| nirdhanaḥ sarvadaścāsau veda svaṃ svayameva saḥ|| 23.58 || sa ca devo'calaḥ sthāṇurmahādevo'jaro haraḥ|| bhaviṣyati patiḥ so'syāstatkimarthaṃ tu śocasi|| 23.59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśamāhātmye himavadāśvāsanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23 || cha ||
<1.2.24>
||nārada uvāca|| evaṃ śrutvā sabhāryaḥ sa pramodaplutamānasaḥ|| praṇamya māmiti prāha yadyevaṃ puṇyavānaham|| 24.1 || punaḥ kiṃcitpravakṣyāmi putryā me dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ|| uttānaḥ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ tacchrotumicchāmi nārada|| 24.2 || iti pṛṣṭo'smi śailena prāvocaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadā|| sarvadaiva karo hyasyāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prati|| 24.3 || abhayasya pradātā'sāvuttānastu karastataḥ|| eṣā bhāryā jagadbharturvṛṣāṃkasya mahīdhara|| 24.4 || jananī sarvalokasya bhāvinī bhūtabhāvinī|| tadyathā śīghramevaiṣā yogaṃ yātu pinākinā|| 24.5 || tvayā vidheyaṃ vidhivattathā śailendrasattama|| astyatra sumahatakāryaṃ devānāṃ himabhūdhara|| 24.6 || iti procya tamāpṛcchya prāvocaṃ vāsavāya tat|| mama bhūyastu kartavyaṃ tanmayā kṛtameva hi|| 24.7 || kiṃ tu paṃcaśaraḥ preryaḥ kāryaśeṣe'tra vāsava|| ityādiśya gataścāhaṃ tārakaṃ prati phālguna|| 24.8 || kalipriyatvāttasyainamarthaṃ kathayituṃ sphuṭam|| himādrirapi me vākyapreritaḥ pārvatīṃ prati|| 24.9 || bhavasyārādhanāṃ kartuṃ sasakhīmādiśattadā|| sā taṃ paricacāreśaṃ tasyā dṛṣṭvā suśīlatām|| 1.2.24.10 || puṣpatoyaphalādyāni niyuktā pārvatī vyadhāt|| mahendropi ca madvākyātsmaraṃ sasmāra bhārata|| 24.11 || sa ca tatsmaraṇaṃ jñātvā vasaṃtaratisaṃyutaḥ|| cūtāṃkurāstraḥṛ sahasā prādurāsīnmanobhavaḥ|| 24.12 || tamāha ca vaco dhīmānsmaranniva ca taṃ spṛśan|| upadeśena bahunā kiṃ tvāṃ prati ratipriya|| 24.13 || citte vasasi tena tvaṃ vetsi bhūtamanogatam|| tathāpi tvāṃ vadiṣyāmi svakāryaparatāṃ smaran|| 24.14 || mamaikaṃ sumahatkāryaṃ kartumarhasi manmatha|| maheśvaraṃ kṛpānāthaṃ satībhāryāviyojitam|| 24.15 || saṃyojaya punardevyā himādrigṛhajātayā|| devī devaśca tuṣṭau te kariṣyata ihepsitam|| 24.16 || ||madana uvāca|| alīkametaddevendra sa hi devasya poratiḥ|| nānyāsādayitavyāni tejāṃsi munarabravīt|| 24.17 || vedānteṣu ca māṃ viprā garhasaṃyati punaḥpunaḥ|| mahāśano mahāpāpmā kāmo'yama nalo gahān|| 24.18 || āvṛtaṃ jñānametena jñānināṃ nityavairiṇā|| tasmādayaṃ sadā tyājyaḥ kāma'hiriva sattamaiḥ|| 24.19 || evaṃ śīlasya me kasmātpratuṣyati maheśvaraḥ|| madyapasyeva pāpasya vāsudevo jagadguraḥ|| 1.2.24.20 || ||iṃdra uvāca|| maivaṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāṃ vinākaḥ pumānbhuvi|| dharmamarthaṃ tathā kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ vā prāptumīśvaraḥ|| 24.21 || yatkiṃcitsādhyate loke mūlaṃ tasya ca kāmanā|| kathaṃ kāmaṃ viniṃdati tasmātte mokṣasādhakāḥ|| 24.22 || satyaṃ cāpi śrutervākyaṃ tava rūpaṃ tridhāgatam|| tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ caiva sāttvikaṃ cāpi manmatha|| 24.23 || amuktitaḥ kāmanayā rūpaṃ tattāmasaṃ tava|| sukhabuddhyā spṛhā yā ca rūpaṃ tadrājasaṃ tava|| 24.24 || kevalaṃ yāvadarthārthaṃ tadrūpaṃ sāttvikaṃ tava|| tatte rūpatrayamidaṃ brūhi nopāsate hi ke|| 24.25 || tvaṃ sākṣātparamaḥ pūjyaḥ kuru kāryamidaṃ hi naḥ|| atha vā pīḍitāndṛṣṭvā sāmānyānapi paṃḍitāḥ|| svaprāṇairapi trāyāṃti parametanmahāphalam|| 24.26 || iti saṃciṃtya kāryaṃ tvaṃ sarvathā kuru tatsphuṭam|| 24.27 || ityā karṇya tathetyuktvā vasaṃtaratisaṃyutaḥ|| pikādisainyasaṃpanno himādriṃ prayayau smaraḥ|| 24.28 || tatrāpaśyata śaṃbhoḥ sa puṇyamāśramamaṃḍalam|| nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ śāṃtasattvasamākulam|| 24.29 || tatrāpaśyattrinetrasya vīrakaṃnāma dvārapam|| yathā sākṣānmaheśānaṃ gaṇaāṃścāyutaśo'sya ca|| 1.2.24.30 || dadarśa ca maheśānaṃ nāsāgrakṛtalocanam|| devadārudrumacchāyāvedikā madhyamāśritam|| samākāyaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ samādhisthaṃ maheśvaram|| 24.31 || nistaraṃgaṃ vinirgṛhya sthitamiṃdriyagocarān|| ātmānamātmanā devaṃ praviṣṭaṃ tapaso nidhim|| 24.32 || taṃ tathāvidhamālokya soṃtarbhedāya yatnavān|| bhramaradhvanivyājena viveśa madano manaḥ|| 24.33 || etasminnaṃtare devo vikāsitavilocanaḥ|| sasmāra nagarājasya tanayāṃ raktamānasaḥ|| 24.34 || niveditā vīrakeṇa viveśa ca gireḥ sutā|| tasminkāle mahābhāgā sadā yadvadupaiti sā|| 24.35 || tatastasyāṃ manaḥ svīyamanuraktamavekṣya ca|| nigṛhya līlayā devaḥ svakaṃ pṛṣṭhamavaikṣata|| tāvadāpūrṇadhanuṣamapaśyata ratipriyam|| 24.36 || tannāśakṛpayā devo nānāsthāneṣu so'gamat|| tāvatpasyati pṛṣṭhastamākṛṣya dhanuṣaḥ śaram|| 24.37 || sa nadīḥ parvatāścaiva āśramānsarasīstathā|| paribhramanmahādevaḥ pṛṣṭhasthaṃ tamavaikṣata|| 24.38 || jagattrayaṃ paribhramya punarāgātsvamāśramam|| pṛṣṭhasthameva taṃ vīkṣya niḥśvāsaṃ mumuce haraḥ|| 24.39 || tatastṛtīyanetrotthavahninā nākavāsinām|| krośatāṃ gamitaḥ kāmo bhasmatvaṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| 1.2.24.40 || sasa tu taṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā haranetrodbhavo'nalaḥ|| vyajṛṃbhata jagaddagdhuṃ jvālāpūritadiṅmukhaḥ|| 24.41 || tato bhavo jagaddhetorvyabhajajjātavedasam|| sāhaṃkāre jane caṃdre sumanassu ca gītake|| 24.42 || bhṛṃgeṣu kokilāsyeṣu vihāreṣu smarānalam|| tatprāptau snehasaṃyuktaṃ kāmināṃ hṛdayaṃ kila|| 24.43 || jvālayatyaniśaṃ so'gnirduścikitsyo'sukhāvahaḥ|| vilokya haraniḥśvāsajvālābhasmīkṛtaṃ smaram|| 24.44 || vilalāpa ratirddīnā madhunā baṃdhunā saha|| vilapaṃtī subahuśo madhunā parisāṃtvitā|| 24.45 || ratyāḥ pralāpamākarṇya devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ|| kṛpayā parayā prāha kāmapatnīṃ nirīkṣya ca|| 24.46 || amūrto'pi hyayaṃ bhadre kāryaṃ sarvaṃ patistava|| ratikāle dhruvaṃ bāle kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| 24.47 || yadā viṣṇuśca bhavitā vasudevātmajo vibhuḥ|| tadai tasya suto yaḥ syātsapatiste bhaviṣyati|| 24.48 || sā praṇamya tato rudramiti proktā ratistataḥ|| jagāma svecchayā gatyā vasaṃtādibhiranvitā|| 24.49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kāmadahanonāma caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 24 || cha ||
<1.2.25>
||arjuna uvāca|| devarṣe varṇyate ceyaṃ kathā pīyūṣasodarā|| punaretanmune brūhi yadā vetti maheśvaraḥ|| 25.1 || bhagavānsvāṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ vadhārthaṃ cāpi tārakam|| satyāśca virahāttapyandadāha kimasau smaram|| 25.2 || tvayaivoktaṃ sa virahātsatyāstapyati vai tapaḥ|| himādrimāsthito devastasyāḥ saṃgamavāṃchayā|| 25.3 || ||nārada uvāca|| satyametatpurā pārtha bhavasyedaṃ manīṣitam|| ataptatapasā yogo na kartavyo mayā'nayā|| 25.4 || tapo vinā śuddhadeho na kathaṃcana jāyate|| asuddhadehena samaṃ saṃyogo naiva daihikaḥ|| 25.5 || mahatkarmāṇi yānīha teṣāṃ mūlaṃ sadā tapaḥ|| nātaptatapasāṃ siddhirmahatkarmāṇi yāṃti vai|| 25.6 || etasmātkāraṇāddevo darpitaṃ taṃ dadāha tu|| tato dagdhe smare cāpi pārvatīmapi vrītitām|| 25.7 || vihāya sagaṇo devaḥ kailāsaṃ samapadyata|| devī ca paramodvignā praskhalaṃtī padepade|| 25.8 || jīvitaṃ svaṃ viniṃdaṃtī babhrāmetastataścasā|| himādrirapi sve śrṛṃge rudatīṃ pṛṣṭavānratim|| 25.9 || kāsi kasyāsi kalyāṇi kimarthaṃ cāpi rodiṣi|| pṛṣṭā sā ca ratiḥ sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat|| 1.2.25.10 || nivedite tathā ratyā śailaḥ saṃbhrāṃtamānasaḥ|| prāpya svāṃ tanayāṃ pāṇāvādāyāgātsvakaṃ puram|| 25.11 || sā tatra pitarau prāha sakhīnāṃ vadanena ca|| durbhagena śarīreṇa kimanena hi kāraṇam|| 25.12 || dehavāsaṃ parityakṣye prāpsye vābhimataṃ patim|| asādhyaṃ cāpyabhīṣṭaṃ ca kathaṃ prāpyaṃ tapo vinā|| 25.13 || niyamairvividhaistasmācchoṣayiṣye kalevaram|| anujānīta māṃ tatra yadi vaḥ karuṇā mayi|| 25.14 || śrutveti vacanaṃ mātā pitā ca prāha tāṃ śubhām|| u meti capale putri na kṣamaṃ tāvakaṃ vapuḥ|| 25.15 || soḍhuṃ kleśātmarūpasya tapasaḥ saumyadarśane|| bhāvīnyapyani vāryāṇi vastūni ca sadaiva tu|| 25.16 || bhāvinorthā bhavaṃtyeva narasyānicchatopi hi|| tasmānna tapasā te'sti bāle kiṃcitprayojanam|| 25.17 || ||śrīdevyuvāca|| yadidaṃ bhavato vākyaṃ na samyagiti me matiḥ|| kevalaṃ na hi daivena prāptumartho hi śakyate|| 25.18 || tkiṃciddaivāddhaṭhātkiṃcitkiṃcideva svabhāvataḥ|| puruṣaḥ phalamāpnoti caturthaṃ nātra kāraṇam|| 25.19 || brahmaṇā cāpi brahmatvaṃ prāptaṃ kilatapobalāt|| anyairapi ca yallabdhaṃ tannasaṃkhyātumutsahe|| 1.2.25.20 || adhruveṇa śarīreṇa yadyabhīṣṭaṃ na sādhyate|| paścātsa śocyate maṃdaḥ patite'smiñcharīrake|| 25.21 || yasya dehasya dharmo'yaṃ kvacijjāyetkvacinmriyet|| kvacidgarbhagataṃ naśyejjātamātraṃ kvacittathā|| 25.22 || bālye ca yauvane cāpi vārdhakyepi vinaśyati|| tena caṃcaladehena ko'rthaḥ svārtho na cedbhavet|| 25.23 || ityuktvā svasakhīyuktā pitṛbhyāṃ sāśru vīkṣitā|| śrṛṃgaṃ himavataḥ puṇyaṃ nānāścaryaṃ jagāma sā|| 25.24 || tatrāṃ barāṇi saṃtyajya bhūṣaṇāni ca śailajā|| saṃvītā valkalairdivyaistapo'tapyata saṃyatā|| 25.25 || īśvaraṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya praṇavābhyasanādṛtā|| munīnāmapya bhūnmānyā tadānīṃ pārtha pārvatī|| 25.26 || trisnātā pāṭalāpatrabhakṣakābhūcchataṃ samāḥ|| śaṃta ca bilvapatreṇa śīrṇona kṛtabhojanā|| 25.27 || jalabhakṣā śataṃ cābhūcchataṃ vai vāyubhojanā|| tato niyamamādāya pādāṃguṣṭhasthitābhavat|| 25.28 || nirāhārā tatastāpaṃ prāpustattapaso janāḥ|| tato jagatsamālokya tadīyatapasorjitam|| 25.29 || harastatrāyayau sākṣādbrahmacārivapurddharaḥ|| vasāno valkalaṃ divyaṃ rauravājinasaṃvṛtaḥ|| 1.2.25.30 || sulakṣaṇāṣāḍhadharaḥ sadvṛttaḥ prati bhānavān|| tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsustatsakhyo bahumānataḥ|| 25.31 || vaktumicchuḥ śailaputrīṃ sakhībhiriti coditaḥ|| brahmanniyaṃ mahābhāgā gṛhītaniyamā śubhā|| 25.32 || muhūrtapaṃcamātreṇa niyamo'syāḥ samāpyate|| tatpratīkṣasva taṃ kālaṃ paścādasmatsakhīsamam|| 25.33 || nānāvidā dharmavārtāḥ prakariṣyasi brāhmaṇa|| ityuktvā vijayādyāstā devīcaritavarṇanaiḥ|| 25.34 || aśrumukhyo dvijasyāgre ninyuḥ kālaṃ ca taṃ tadā|| tataḥ kāle kiṃcidūne brahmacārī mahāmatiḥ|| 25.35 || vilokanamiṣeṇāgādāśramopasthitaṃ hradam|| nipapāta ca tatrāsau cukrośātitarāṃ tataḥ|| 25.36 || ahamatra nimajjāmi ko'pi māmuddhareta bhoḥ|| iti tāreṇa krośaṃtaṃ śrutvā taṃ vijayādikāḥ|| 25.37 || ājagmustvarayā yuktā dadustasmai karaṃ ca tāḥ|| sa cukrośa tato gāḍhaṃ dūredūre punaḥpunaḥ|| 25.38 || nāhaṃ spṛśāmyasaṃsiddhāṃ mriye vā nānṛtaṃ tvidam|| tataḥ samāptaniyamā pārvatī svayamāyayau|| 25.39 || savyaṃ karaṃ dadāvasya taṃ cāsau nābhyanandata|| bhadre yacchuci naiva syādyaccaivāvajñayā kṛtam|| 1.2.25.40 || sadoṣeṇa kṛtaṃ yacca tadādadyānna karhicit|| savyaṃ cāśuci te hastaṃ nāvalaṃbāmi karhicit|| 25.41 || ityuktā pārvatī prāha nāhaṃ dattaṃ ca dakṣiṇam|| dadāmi kasyacidvipra devadevāya kalpitam|| 25.42 || dakṣiṇaṃ me karaṃ devo grahītā bhava eva ca|| śīryate cogratapasā satyametanmayoditam|| 25.43 || ||vipra uvāca|| yadyevamavalepaste gamanaṃ kena vāryate|| yathā tava pratijñeyaṃ mamāpīyaṃ tathācalā|| 25.44 || rudrasyāpi vayaṃ mānyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ te tapo vada|| viṣamasthaṃ yatra vipraṃ mriyamāṇamupekṣasi|| 25.45 || avajā nāsi viprāṃstvaṃ tacchīghraṃ vraja darśanāt|| yadi vā manyase pūjyāṃstato'bhyuddhara nānyathā|| 25.46 || tato vicārya bahudhā iti ceti ca sā śubhā|| viprasyoddharaṇaṃ sarvadharmebhyo'manyatādhikam|| 25.47 || tataḥ sā dakṣiṇaṃ dattvā karaṃ taṃ projjahāra ca|| naraṃ nārī proddharati sajjantaṃ bhavavāridhau|| etatsandarśanārthāya tathā cakre bhavodbhavaḥ|| 25.48 || proddhṛtya ca tataḥ snātvā baddhva yogāsanaṃ sthitā|| 25.49 || brahmacārī tataḥ prāha prahasankimidaṃ śubhe|| kartukāmāsi tanvaṃgi dṛḍhayogāsanasthitā|| 1.2.25.50 || devī prāha jvālayiṣye śarīraṃ yogavahninā|| mahādevakṛtamatirucchiṣṭāhaṃ yato'bhavam|| 25.51 || brahmacārī tataḥ prāha kāścidbrāhmaṇakāmyayā|| kṛtvā vārtāstataḥ svīyamabhīṣṭaṃ kuru pārvati|| 25.52 || nopahanyāṃ kadācidvi sādhubhirviprakāmanā|| dharmamenaṃ manyase cenmuhūrtaṃ brūhi pārvati|| 25.53 || devī prāha brūhi vipra muhūrtaṃ saṃsthitā tvaham|| tataḥ svayaṃ vratī prāha devīṃ tāṃ svasakhīyutām|| 25.54 || kimarthamiti rambhoru nave vayasi duścaram|| tapastvayā samārabdhaṃ nānurūpaṃ vibhāti me|| 25.55 || durlabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ girirājagṛhe'dhunā|| bhogāṃśca durlabhāndevi tyaktvā kiṃ kliśyate vapuḥ|| 25.56 || atīva dūye vīkṣya tvāṃ sukumāratarākṛtim|| atyugratapasā kliṣṭā padminīva himarditā|| 25.57 || idaṃ cānyattva śubhe śiraso rogadaṃ mama|| yaddehaṃ tyaktukāmā tvaṃ prabuddhā nāsi bālike|| 25.58 || vāmaḥ kāmo manuṣyeṣu satyametadvaco yataḥ|| spṛhaṇīyāsi sarveṣāmevaṃ pīḍayase vapuḥ|| 25.59 || avijñātānvayo nagnaḥ śūlī bhūtagaṇādhipaḥ|| śmaśānanilayo bhasmoddhūlano vṛṣavāhanaḥ|| 1.2.25.60 || gajājino dvijihvādyalaṃkṛtāṃgo jaṭādharaḥ|| virūpākṣaḥ kathaṃkāraṃ nirguṇaḥ syāttavocitaḥ|| 25.61 || guṇā ye kulaśīlādya varāṇāmuditā budhaiḥ|| teṣāmeko'pi naivāsti tasmiṃstannocitaḥ sa te|| 25.62 || śocanīyatamā pūrvamāsītpārvati kaumudī|| tvaṃ saṃvṛttā dvitīyāsi tasyāstatsaṃgamāśayā|| 25.63 || tapodhanāḥ sarvasamā vayaṃ yadyapi pārvati|| dunotyeva tavāraṃbhaḥ śūlāyāṃ yūpasatkriyā|| 25.64 || vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ vāsaḥ śmaśāne pāṇisaṃgrahaḥ|| savyālapāṇinā kṣaumagajatvagbaṃdhanaḥ katham|| 25.65 || janahāsyakaraṃ sarvaṃ tvayārabdhamasāṃpratam|| strībhāvādbhūtisaṃparkkaḥ kathaṃ cābhimatastava|| 25.66 || nivartaya manastasmādasmātsarvavirodhinaḥ|| mṛgākṣi madanārātermarkaṭākṣasya prārthanāt|| 25.67 || viruddhavādinaṃ caivaṃ brahmacāriṇamīśvaram|| niśamya kupitā devī prāha vācā sagadgadam|| 25.68 || mā mā brāhmaṇa bhāṣiṣṭhā viruddhamiti śaṃkare|| mahattamo yāti pumāndevadevasya niṃdayā|| 25.69 || na samyagabhijānāsi tasya devasya ceṣṭitam|| śrṛṇu brāhmaṇa tvaṃ pāpādyathāsmātparimucyase|| 1.2.25.70 || sa ādiḥ sarvajagatāṃ kosya vedānvayaṃ tataḥ|| sarvaṃ jagadyasya rūpaṃ digvāsāḥ kīrtyate tataḥ|| 25.71 || guṇatrayamayaṃ śūlaṃ śūlī yasmādbibhārte saḥ|| abaddhāḥ sarvato muktā bhūtā eva ca tatpatiḥ|| 25.72 || śmaśānaṃ cāpi saṃsārastadvāsī kṛpayārthinām|| bhūtayaḥ kathitā bhūtistāṃ bibharti sa bhūtibhṛt|| 25.73 || vṛṣo dharma iti proktastamārūḍhastato vṛṣī|| sarpāśca doṣāḥ krodhādyāstānbibharti jaganmayaḥ|| 25.74 || nānāvidhāḥ karmayogā jaṭārūpā bibharti saḥ|| vedatrayī trinetrāṇi tripuraṃ triguṇaṃ vapuḥ|| 25.75 || bhasmīkaroti taddevastripuradhnastataḥ smṛtaḥ|| evaṃvidha mahādevaṃ vidurye sūkṣmadarśinaḥ|| 25.76 || kathaṃkāraṃ hi te nāma bhajaṃte naiva taṃ haram|| atha vā bhītasaṃsārāḥ sarve vipra yato janāḥ|| 25.77 || vimṛśya kurvate sarvaṃ vimṛśyaitanmayā kṛtam|| śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāstu tvamapyenaṃ prapūjaya|| 25.78 || iti bruvaṃtyāṃ tasyāṃ tu kiṃcitprasphuritādharam|| vijñāya tāṃ sakhīmāha kimapyeṣa vivakṣukaḥ|| 25.79 || vāryatāmiti vipro'yaṃ mahaddūṣaṇabāṣakaḥ|| na kevalaṃ pāpabhāgī śrotā vai syānna saṃśayaḥ|| 1.2.25.80 || atha vā kiṃ ca naḥ kāryaṃ vādena saha brāhmaṇaiḥ|| karṇau pidhāya yāsyāmo yathā yaḥ syāttatāstu saḥ|| 25.81 || ityuktvotthāya gacchaṃtyāṃ pidhāya śravaṇāvubhau|| svarūpaṃ samupāśritya jagṛhe vasanaṃ haraḥ|| 25.82 || tato nirīkṣya taṃ devaṃ saṃbhrāṃtā parameśvarī|| praṇipatya maheśānaṃ tuṣṭāvāvanatā umā|| 25.83 || prāha tāṃ ca mahādevo dāso'smi tava śobhane|| tapodravyeṇa krītaśca
