samādiśa yathepsitam|| 25.84 || ||devyuvāca|| manasastvaṃ prabhuḥ śaṃbho dattaṃ tacca mayā tava|| vapuṣaḥ pitarāvīśau tau sammānayitumarhasi|| 25.85 || ||mahādeva uvāca|| pitrā hi te parijñātaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ rūpaśālinīm|| bālāṃ svayaṃvaraṃ putrī mahaṃ dāsyāmi nānyathā|| 25.86 || tattasya sarvamevāstu vacanaṃ tvaṃ himācalam|| svayaṃvarārthaṃ suśroṇi preraya tvāṃ vṛṇe tataḥ|| 25.87 || ityuktvā tāṃ mahādevaḥ śuciḥ śuciṣado vibhuḥ|| jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ svapuraṃ prayayau ca sā|| 25.88 || dṛṣṭvā devīṃ tadā hṛṣṭo menayā sahito'calaḥ|| 25.89 || āliṃgyāghrāya papraccha sarvaṃ sā ca nyavedayat|| duhiturdevadevena ājñaptaṃ tu himācalaḥ|| 1.2.25.90 || svayaṃvaraṃ pramuditaḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat|| aśvino dvādaśādityā gandharvaruḍoragāḥ|| 25.91 || yakṣāḥ siddhāstathā sādhyā daityāḥ kiṃpuruṣā nagāḥ|| samudrādyāśca ye kecittrailokyapravarāsca ye|| 25.92 || trayastriṃśatsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśacchatāni ca|| trayastriṃśacca ye devāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ|| 25.93 || jagmurgirīndraputryāstu svayaṃvaramanuttamam|| āmaṃtritastathā viṣṇurmerumāha hasanniva|| 25.94 || tātāsmākaṃ ca sā devī mero gaccha namāmi tām|| atha śailasutā devī haimamāruhya śobhanam|| 25.95 || vimānaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam|| apsarobhiḥ pranṛtyadbhiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā|| 25.96 || gaṃdharvasaṃghairvividhaiḥ kiṃnaraiśca suśobhanaiḥ|| baṃdibhiḥ stūyamānā ca vīrakāṃsyadharā sthitā|| 25.97 || sitātapatraratnāṃśumiśritaṃ cāvahattadā|| śālinī nāma pārvatyāḥ saṃdhyāpūrṇedumaṃḍalā|| 25.98 || cāmarāsaktahastābhirdivyastrībhiśca saṃvṛtā|| mālāṃ pragṛhya sā tasthau suradrumasamudbhavām|| 25.99 || evaṃ tasyāṃ sthitāyāṃ tu sthite lokatraye tadā|| śiśurbhūtvā mahādevaḥ krīḍārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ|| 1.2.25.100 || utsaṃgatalasaṃgupto babhūva bhagavānbhavaḥ|| jayeti yatpadaṃ khyātaṃ tasya satyārthamīśvaram|| 25.101 || atha dṛṣṭvā śiśuṃ devāstasya utsaṃgavartinaḥ|| koyamatreti saṃmaṃtrya cukruśurbhṛśaroṣitāḥ|| 25.102 || vajramāhārayattasya bāhumudyamya vṛtrahā|| sa bāhurudyatastasya tathaiva samatiṣṭhata|| 25.103 || staṃbhitaḥ śiśurūpeṇa devadevena līlayā|| vajraṃ kṣeptuṃ na śaknoti bāhuṃ cālayituṃ tadā|| 25.104 || vahniḥ śaktiṃ tadā kṣeptuṃ na śaśāka tathotthitaḥ|| yamo'pi daṃḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca nirṛtistaṃ śiśuṃ prati|| 25.105 || pāśaṃ ca varuṇo rājā dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samīraṇaḥ|| somo guḍaṃ dhaneśaśca gadāṃ sumahatīṃ dṛḍhām|| 25.106 || nānāyudhāni cādityā musalaṃ vasavastathā|| mahāghorāṇi śastrāṇi tārakādyāśca dānavāḥ|| 25.107 || staṃbhitā devadevena tathānye bhuvaneṣu ye|| pūṣā daṃtāndaśandaṃrbālamaikṣata mohitaḥ|| 25.108 || tasyāpi daśanāḥ peturdṛṣṭamātrasya śaṃbhunā|| bhagaśca netre vikṛte cakāra sphuṭite ca te|| 25.109 || balaṃ tejaśca yogāṃśca sarveṣāṃ jagṛhe prabhuḥ|| atha teṣu sthiteṣveva manyumatsu sureṣvapi|| 1.2.25.110 || brahmā dhyānamupāśritya bubodha haraceṣṭitam|| so'bhigamya mahādevaṃ tuṣṭāva prayato vidhiḥ|| 25.111 || paurāṇaiḥ sāmasaṃgītairvedikairguhyanāmabhiḥ|| namastubhyaṃ mahādeva mahādevyai namonamaḥ|| 25.112 || prasādāttava buddhyādirjagadetatpravartate|| mūḍhāśca devatāḥ sarvā nainaṃ budhyata śaṃkaram|| 25.113 || mahādevamihāyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam|| gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ yadi jīvitumicchata|| 25.114 || tataḥ saṃbhrama saṃpannāstuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ surāḥ|| namonamo mahādeva pāhipāhi jagatpate|| 25.115 || durācārānbhavānasmānātmadrohaparāyaṇān|| aho paśyata no mauḍhyaṃ jānaṃtastava bhāvinīm|| 25.116 || bhāryāmumāṃ mahādevīṃ tathāpyatra samāgatāḥ|| yuktametadyadasmākaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhyeta cāsuraiḥ|| 25.117 || yeṣāmevaṃvidhābuddhirasmābhiḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvidam|| atha vā no na doṣo'sti paśavo hi vayaṃ yataḥ|| 25.118 || tvayaiva patinā sarve preritāḥ kurmahe vibho|| īśvaraḥ sarva bhūtānāṃ patistvaṃ parameśvaraḥ|| 25.119 || bhrāmayasyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ yantrārūḍhaṃ svamāyayā|| yena vibhrāmitā mūḍhāḥ samāyātāḥ svayaṃvaram|| 1.2.25.120 || tasmai paśunāṃ pataye namastubhyaṃ prasīda naḥ|| atha teṣāṃ prasanna'bhūddevadevāstriyaṃbakaḥ|| 25.121 || yathāpūrvaṃ cakāraitānsaṃstavādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ|| tārakapramukhā daityāḥ saṃkruddhāstatra procire|| 25.122 || koyamaṃga mahādevo na manyāmo vayaṃ ca tam|| tataḥ prahasya bālo'sau huṃkāraṃ līlayā vyadhāt|| 25.123 || huṃkāreṇaiva te daityāḥ svameva nagaraṃ gatāḥ|| vismṛtaṃ sakalaṃ teṣāṃ svayaṃvaramukhaṃ ca tat|| 25.124 || mahādevaprabhāvena daityānāṃ ghorakarmaṇām|| evaṃ yasya prabhāvo hi devadaityeṣu phālguna|| 25.125 || kathamīśvaravākyārthastasmādanyatra mucyate|| asaṃśayaṃ vimuḍhāste paścāttāpaḥ purā mahān|| 25.126 || īśvaraṃ bhuvanasyāsya ye bhajaṃte na tryaṃbakam|| tataḥ saṃstūyamānaḥ sa suraiḥ padmabhuvādibhiḥ|| 25.127 || vapuścakāra deveśastryaṃbakaḥ paramādbhutam|| tejasā tasya devāste seṃdracaṃdradivākarāḥ|| 25.128 || sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāśca vasurviśve ca devatāḥ|| sayamāśca sarudrāśca cakṣuraprārthayanprabhum|| 25.129 || tebhyaḥ paratamaṃ cakṣuḥ svavapurdraṣṭumuttamam|| dadāvambāpatiḥ śarvo bhavānyāścālasya ca|| 1.2.25.130 || labdhvā rudraprasādena divyaṃ cakṣuranuttamam|| sabrahyakāstadā devāstamapaśyanmaheśvaram|| 25.131 || tato jaguśca munayaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca khecarāḥ|| mumucuśca tadā nedurdevaduṃdubhayo bhṛśam|| 25.132 || jagugadharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ|| mumudurgaṇapāḥ sarve mumodāṃbā ca pārvatī|| 25.133 || brahmādyā menire pūrṇāṃ bhavānīṃ ca girīśvaram|| tasya devī tato hṛṣṭā samakṣaṃ tridivaukasām|| 25.134 || pādayoḥ sthāpayāmāsa mālāṃ divyāṃ sugaṃdhinīm|| sādusādhviti saṃprocya tayā taṃ tatra carcitam|| 25.135 || saha devyā namaścakruḥ śirobhirbhūtalāśritaiḥ|| sarve sabrahmakā devā jayeti ca mudā jaguḥ|| 25.136 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye śrīmahādevavaivāhikotsāvarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 25 || cha ||
<1.2.26>
||nārada uvāca|| atha brahmā mahādevamabhivādya kṛtāṃjaliḥ|| udvāhaḥ kriyatāṃ deva ityuvāca maheśvaram|| 26.1 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prāhedaṃ bhagavānharaḥ|| parādhīnā vayaṃ brahmanhimādrestava cāpi yat|| 26.2 || yadyuktaṃ kriyatāṃ taddhi vayaṃ yuṣmadvaśe'dhunā|| tato brahmā svayaṃ divyaṃ puraṃ ratnamayaṃ śubham|| 26.3 || udvāhārthaṃ maheśasya tatkṣaṇātsamakalpayat|| śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ prāsādaśataśobhitam|| 26.4 || puretasminmahādevaḥ svayameva vyatiṣṭhata|| tataḥ saptamunīndevaściṃtitābyāgatānpuraḥ|| 26.5 || prāhiṇodaṃbikāyāśca sthirapatrārthamīśvaraḥ|| sāruṃdhatīkāste tatra hlādayaṃto himācalam|| 26.6 || sabhāryāmīśvaraguṇaiḥ sthirapatrāṇi cādadhuḥ|| tataḥ saṃpūjitāstena punarāgamya te'calāt|| 26.7 || nyavedayaṃsryaṃbakāya sa ca tānabhyanaṃdata|| udvāhārthaṃ tato devo viśvaṃ sarvaṃ nyamaṃtrayat|| 26.8 || samāgataṃ ca tatsava vinā daityairdurātmabhiḥ|| sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yacca viśvaṃ viṣṇupurogamam|| 26.9 || sabrahyakaṃ purārātermahimānamavardhayat|| tatastaṃ vidhirāhedaṃ gandhamādanaparvate|| 1.2.26.10 || pure sthitaṃ vivāhasya deva kālaḥ pravartate|| tatastasya jaṭājūṭe caṃdrakhaṃḍaṃ pitāmahaḥ|| 26.11 || babaṃdha praṇayodāravisphāritavilocanaḥ|| kaparddaṃ śobhanaṃ viṣṇuḥ svaya cakre'sya harṣataḥ|| 26.12 || kapālamālāṃ vipulāṃ cāmuṇḍā mūrdhnyabaṃdhata|| uvāca cāpi giriśaṃ putraṃ janaya śaṃkara|| 26.13 || yo daityeṃdrakulaṃ hatvā māṃ raktaistarpayiṣyati|| sūryo jvalacchikhāraktaṃ bhābāsitajagattrayam|| 26.14 || babaṃdha devadevasyaca svayameva pramodataḥ|| śeṣavāsukimukhyāśca jvalaṃtastejasā śubhāḥ|| 26.15 || ātmānaṃ bhūṣaṇasthāne svayaṃ te cakrurīśvare || vāyavaśca tatastīkṣṇaśrṛṃgaṃ himagiriprabham|| 26.16 || vṛṣaṃ vibhūṣayāmāsurnānāratnopapattibhiḥ|| śakro gajajinaṃ gṛhya svayamagre vyavasthitaḥ|| 26.17 || vinā bhasma samādhāya kapāle rajataprabham|| manujāsthimayīṃ mālāṃ pretanāthaśca vandanam|| 26.18 || vahnistejomayaṃ divyamajinaṃ pradadau sthitaḥ|| evaṃ vibhūṣitaḥ sarvairbhṛtyairīśo babhau bhṛśam|| 26.19 || tato himādreḥ puruṣā vīrakaṃ procire vacaḥ|| mā bhūtkālātyayaḥ śīghraṃ bhavasyaitannivedyatām|| 1.2.26.20 || tato devaṃ praṇamyāha vīrakaḥ karasaṃpuṭī|| tvarayaṃti maheśānaṃ himādreḥ puruṣāstvamī|| 26.21 || iti śrutvā vaco devaḥ śīghramityeva cābravīt|| sapta vāridhayastasya cakrurdarpaṇadarśanam|| 26.22 || tatraikṣata mahādevaḥ svarūpaṃ sa jaganmayam|| tato baddhāṃjalirdhīmānsthāṇuṃ provāca keśavaḥ|| 26.23 || devadeva mahādeva tripurāṃtaka śaṃkara|| śobhase'nena rūpeṇa jagadānaṃdadāyinā|| 26.24 || maheśvara yathā sākṣādaparastvaṃ maheśvaraḥ|| tataḥ smayanmahādevo jayeti bhuvane śrutaḥ|| 26.25 || karamālaṃbya viṣṇośca vṛṣabhaṃ ruruheśanaiḥ|| tataśca vasavo devāḥ śūlaṃ tasya nyavedayan|| 26.26 || dhanado nidibhiryuktaḥ samīpasthastato'bhavat|| sa śūlapāṇirviśvātmā saṃcacāla tato haraḥ|| 26.27 || devaduṃdubhinādaiśca puṣpāsāraiśca gītakaiḥ|| nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca jayeti ca mahāsvanaiḥ|| 26.28 || savyadakṣiṇasaṃsthānau brahmaviṣṇūtu jagmatuḥ|| haṃsaṃ ca garuḍaṃ caiva samāruhya mahāprabhau|| 26.29 || athāditirditiḥ sā ca danuḥ kadrūḥ suparṇajā|| paulomī surasā caiva siṃhikā surabhirmuniḥ|| 1.2.26.30 || siddhirmāyā kṣamā durgā devī svāhā svadhā sudhā|| sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī lakṣmīḥ sā dakṣiṇā dyutiḥ|| 26.31 || spṛhāmatirdhṛtirbuddhirmaṃthirṛddhiḥ sarasvatī|| rākā kuhūḥ sinīvālī devī bhānumatī tathā|| 26.32 || dharaṇī dhāraṇī velā rājñī cāpi ca rohiṇī|| ityetāścānyadevānāṃ mātaraḥ patnayastathā|| 26.33 || udvāhaṃ devadevasya jagmuḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ|| uragā garuḍā yakṣā gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnarā narāḥ|| 26.34 || sāgarā girayo meghā māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā|| vedā maṃtrāstathā yajñāḥ śrautā dharmāśca sarvaśaḥ|| 26.35 || huṃkārāḥ praṇavāścaiva itihāsāḥ sahasraśaḥ|| koṭiśaśca tathā devā maheṃdrādyāḥ savāhanāḥ|| 26.36 || anujagmurmahādevaṃ koṭiśo'rbudaśaśca hi|| gaṇāśca pṛṣṭhato jagmuḥ śaṃkhavarṇāśca koṭiśaḥ|| 26.37 || daśabhiḥ kekarākhyāśca vidyuto'ṣṭābhireva ca|| catuḥṣaṣṭyā viśākhāśca navabhiḥ pāriyātrikāḥ|| 26.38 || ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāṃtakaḥ śrīmāṃstathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ|| jvālākeśo dvādaśabhiḥ koṭibhiḥ saṃvṛto yayau|| 26.39 || saptabhiḥ samadaḥ śrīmānduṃdubhoṣṭhābhireva ca|| paṃcabhiśca kapālīśaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃhrādakaḥ śubhaḥ|| 1.2.26.40 || koṭikoṭibhirevaikaḥ kuṃḍakaḥ kuṃbhakastathā|| viṣṭaṃbho'ṣṭābhireveha gaṇapaḥ sarvasattamaḥ|| 26.41 || pippalaśca sahasreṇa sannādaśca tathā balī|| āveśanastathāṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiścaṃdratāpanaḥ|| 26.42 || mahākeśaḥ sahasreṇa naṃdirdvādaśabhistathā|| nagaḥ kālaḥ karālaśca mahākālaḥ śatena ca|| 26.43 || agnikaḥ śatakoṭyā vai koṭyāgnimukha eva ca|| ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca koṭyā caiva dhanāvahaḥ|| 26.44 || sannāgaśca śatenaiva kumudaḥ koṭibhistribhiḥ|| amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā sumaṃtrakaḥ|| 26.45 || kākapādastatā ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā saṃtānako gaṇaḥ|| mahābalaśca navabhirmadhupiṃgaśca piṃgalaḥ|| 26.46 || nīlo navatyā saptatyā caturvaktraśca pūrvapāt|| vīrabhadraścaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā karaṇo bālakastathā|| 26.47 || paṃcākṣaḥ śatamanyuśca meghamanyuśca viṃśatiḥ|| kāṣṭhakoṭiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukośo vṛṣabhastathā|| 26.48 || viśvarūpastālaketuḥ paṃcāśacca sitānanaḥ|| īśāno vṛddhadevaśca dīptātmā mṛtyuhā tathā|| 26.49 || viṣādo yamahā caiva gaṇo bhṛṃgariṭistathā|| aśanī hāsakaścaiva catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahasrapāt|| 1.2.26.50 || ete cānye ca gaṇapā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ|| sarve sahasrahastāśca jaṭāmukuṭadhārīṇaḥ|| 26.51 || caṃdralekhāvataṃsāśca nīlakaṃṭhāstrilocanāḥ|| hārakuṃḍalakeyūramukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtāḥ|| 26.52 || aṇimādiguṇairyuktāḥ śaktāḥ śāpaprasādayoḥ|| sūryakoṭipratīkāśāstatrājagmurgaṇeśvarāḥ|| 26.53 || pātālāṃbarabhūmisthāḥ sarvalokanivāsinaḥ|| tuṃbururnārado hāhā hūhūścaiva tu sāmagāḥ|| 26.54 || taṃtrīmādāya vādyāṃścā'vādayañchaṃkarotsave|| ṛṣayaḥ kṛtsnaśaścaiva vedagītāṃstapodhanāḥ|| 26.55 || puṇyānvaivāhikānmaṃtrāñjeṣuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ|| evaṃ pratasthegiriśo vījyamānaśca gaṃgayā|| 26.56 || tathā yamunayā cāpāṃpatinā dhṛtacchatrayā|| strībhirnānāvidhālāpailājābhiścānumoditaḥ|| 26.57 || mahotsavena deveśo giristhānaṃ viveśa saḥ|| prabhāsatsvarṇakalaśaṃ toraṇānāṃ śatairyutam|| 26.58 || vaiḍūryabaddhabhūmisthaṃ ratnajaiśca gṛhairyutam|| tatpraviśya stūyamāno dvāramabhyāsasāda ha|| 26.59 || tato himācalastatra dṛśyate vyākulākulaḥ|| ādiśadātmabhṛtyānāṃ mahādeva upasthite|| 1.2.26.60 || tato brahmāṇamacalo gurutve prārthayattadā|| kṛtyānāṃ sarvabhāreṣu vāsudevaṃ ca buddhimān|| 26.61 || pratyāha ca vivāha'sminkumārībhrātaraṃ vinā|| bhaviṣyati kathaṃ viṣṇo lājahomādikarmasu|| 26.62 || suto hi mama mainākaḥ sa praviṣṭo'rṇave sthitaḥ|| iti ciṃtāviṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ viṣṇurāhamahāmatiḥ|| 26.63 || atra ciṃtā na kartavyā girirāja kathaṃcana|| ahaṃ bhrātā jaganmāturetade vaṃ ca nānyathā|| 26.64 || tataḥ pramuditaḥ śailaḥ pārvatīṃ ca svalaṃkṛtām|| sakhībhiḥ koṭisaṃkhyābhirvṛtāṃ praveśayatsadaḥ|| 26.65 || tato nīlamayastaṃbhaṃ jvalatkāṃcanakuṭṭimam|| muktājālapariṣkāraṃ jvalitau ṣadhidīpitam|| 26.66 || ratnāsanasahasrāḍhyaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam|| vivāhamaṃḍapaṃ śarvo viveśānucarāvṛtaḥ|| 26.67 || tataḥ śailaḥ sapatnīkaḥ pādau prakṣālya harṣitaḥ|| bhavasya tena toyena siṣice svaṃ jagattathā|| 26.68 || pādyamācamanaṃ dattvā madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tathā|| pradānasya prayogaṃ ca saṃciṃtayaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ|| 26.69 || dauhitrīṃ kavyavāhānāṃ dadmi putrīṃ svakāmaham|| ityuktvā tasthivāñchailo na jānāti harasya saḥ|| 1.2.26.70 || tataḥ sarvānapṛcchatsa kulaṃ ko'pi na veda tat|| tato viṣṇuridaṃ prāha pṛchyaṃte'nye kimarthataḥ|| 26.71 || ajñātakulatāṃ tasya pṛchyatāmayameva ca|| ahireva aheḥ pādānvetti nānyo himācala|| 26.72 || svagotraṃ yadi na brūte na deyā bhaginī mama|| tato hāsastadā jajñe sarveṣāṃ sumahāsvanaḥ|| 26.73 || nivṛttaśca kṣaṇādbhūyaḥ kiṃ vakṣyati harastviti|| tato vimṛśya bahudhā kiṃcidbhītānano yatā|| 26.74 || lajjājaḍaḥ smitaṃ cakre tataḥ pārtha sa vai haraḥ|| tato viśiṣṭā bruvati śīghraṃ kālo'tivartate|| 26.75 || hariḥ prāha maheśānaṃ bibhyadāvedmayahaṃ tava|| mātāmahaṃ ca pitaraṃ prayogaṃ śrṛṇu bhūdhara|| 26.76 || ātmaputrāya te śaṃbho ātmadauhitrakāya te|| ityukte viṣṇunā sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ|| 26.77 || devo'pyudāharedvuddhiṃ sarvebhyo'pyadhikāṃ varām|| tataḥ śailastathā coktvā dattvā devīṃ ca sodakam|| 26.78 || ātmānaṃ cāpi devāya pradadau sodakaṃ nagaḥ|| tataḥ sarve tuṣṭuvustaṃ vivāhaṃ vismayānvitāḥ|| 26.79 || dātā mahībhṛtāṃ nātho hotā devaścaturmukhaḥ|| varaḥ paśupatiḥ sākṣātkanyā viśvaraṇistathā|| 1.2.26.80 || tataḥ stuvatsu muniṣu puṣpavarṣe mahatyapi|| nadatsu devatūryeṣu karaṃ jagrāha tryambakaḥ|| 26.81 || devo devīṃ samālokya salajjāṃ himaśailajām|| na tṛpyati na cāhlādatsā ca devāṃ vṛṣadhvajam|| 26.82 || tatra brahmādimunayo devīmadbhutarūpiṇīm|| paśyaṃtaḥ śaraṇaṃ jagmurmanasā parameśvaram|| 26.83 || mā muhyāma pārvatīṃ ca yathā nāradaparvatau|| tatastathaiva taccakre sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ vacaḥ|| 26.84 || tato devaiśca munibhiḥ saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ|| praviveśa śubhāṃ vedīṃ mūrtimajjvalanāśritām|| 26.85 || vedhāḥ śrutīritairmaṃ trairmūrtimadbhirupasthitaiḥ|| mūrtamagniṃ juhāva triḥ parikramya ca taṃ haraḥ|| 26.86 || lājāhoma umābhrātā prāha taṃ sasmitaṃ hariḥ|| bahavo militāḥ saṃti lokāḥ saṃmarda īśvara|| 26.87 || sāvadhānena rakṣyāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tvayā hara|| tato haraśca taṃ prāha svajane mā'tigopaya|| 26.88 || kiṃcitprārthaya dāsyāmi prāha viṣṇustato varam|| tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā me'stu sa ca taddurlabhaṃ dadau|| 26.89 || dadatuḥ sṛṣṭisaṃrakṣāṃ brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāmubhau|| agnaye yajñabhāgāṃśca prītau harajanārdanau|| 1.2.26.90 || bhṛgvādīnāṃ tato dattvā śrutirakṣaṇadakṣiṇām|| tato gītaiśca nṛtyaiśca bhojanaiśca yathepsitaiḥ|| 26.91 || mahotsavairanekaiśca vismayaṃ samapadyata|| visṛjya lokaṃ taṃ sarvaṃ kimicchādānakairbhavaḥ|| 26.92 || sarasvatyā ca pitarau devyāścā''śvāsya duḥkhitau|| āmaṃtrya himaśaileṃdraṃ brahmaṇaṃ ca sakeśavam|| 26.93 || jagāma maṃdaragiriṃ giriṇā yānugorcitaḥ|| 26.94 || tato gate bhagavati nīlalohite sahomayā girimamalaṃ hi bhūdharaḥ|| sabāṃdhavo ruditi hi kasya no mano visaṃṣṭham̐laṃ jagati hi kanyakāpituḥ|| 26.95 || imaṃ vivāhaṃ girirājaputryāḥ śrṛṇoti cādhyeti ca yo naraḥ śuciḥ|| viśeṣataścāpi vivāhamaṃgale sa maṃgalaṃ vṛddhimavāpnute ciram|| 26.96 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāma ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumāreśamāhātmye haragaurīvivāhavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍiṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 26 || cha ||
<1.2.27>
||nārada uvāca|| tato nirupamaṃ divyaṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ śubham|| īśānanirmitaṃ sākṣātsaha devyāviśadgṛham|| 27.1 || tatrāsau maṃdaragirau saha devyā bhagākṣahā|| prāsāde tatra codyāne reme saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ|| 27.2 || etasminnaṃtare devāstārakeṇātipīḍitāḥ|| protsāhitena cātyarthaṃ mayā kalicikīrṣuṇā|| 27.3 || āsādya te bhavaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭuburbahudhā stavaiḥ|| etasminnaṃtare devī prodvartayata gātrakam|| 27.4 || udvartanamalenātha naraṃ cakre gajānanam|| devānāṃ saṃstavaiḥ puṇyaiḥ kṛpayābhipariplutā|| 27.5 || putretyuvāca taṃ devī tataḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasā|| etasminnaṃtare śarvastatrāgatya vaco'bravīt|| 27.6 || putrastavāyaṃ girije śrṛṇu yādṛgbhaviṣyati|| vikrameṇa ca vīryeṇa kṛpayā sadṛśo mayā|| 27.7 || yathāhaṃ tādṛśaścāsau putraste bhavitā guṇaiḥ|| ye ca pāpā durācārā vedāndharmaṃ dviṣaṃti ca|| 27.8 || teṣāmāmaraṇāṃtāni vighnānyeṣa kariṣyati|| ye ca māṃ naiva manyaṃte viṣṇuṃ vāpi jagadgurum|| 27.9 || vighnitā vighnarājena te yāsyaṃti mahattamaḥ|| teṣāṃ gṛheṣu kalahaḥ sadā naivopasāmyati|| 1.2.27.10 || putrasya tava vighnena samūlaṃ tasya naśyati|| yeṣāṃ na pūjyāḥ pūjyaṃte krodhāsatyaparāśca ye|| 27.11 || raudrasāhasikā ye ca teṣāṃ vighnaṃ kariṣyati|| śrutidharmāñjñātidharmānpālayaṃti gurūṃśca ye|| 27.12 || kṛpālavo gatakrodhāsteṣāṃ vighnaṃ hariṣyati|| sarve dharmāśca karmāṇi tathā nānāvidhāni ca|| 27.13 || savighnāni bhivaṣyaṃti pūjayāsya vinā śubhe|| evaṃ śrutvā umā prāha evamastviti śaṃkaram|| 27.14 || tato bṛhattanuḥ so'bhūttejasā dyotayandiśaḥ|| tato gaṇaiḥ samaṃ śarvaḥ surāṇāṃ pradadau ca tam|| yāvattāra kahaṃtā vo bhavettāvadayaṃ prabhuḥ|| 27.15 || tato vighnapatirdevaiḥ saṃstutaḥ pramatārtihā|| cakāra teṣāṃ kṛtyāni vighnāni ditijanmanām|| 27.16 || pārvatī ca punardevī putratve parikalpya ca|| aśokasyāṃkuraṃ vārbhiravarddhayata svādṛtaiḥ|| 27.17 || saptarṣīnatha cāhūya saṃskāramaṃgalaṃ taroḥ|| kārayāmāsa tanvaṃgī tatastāṃ munayo'bruvan|| 27.18 || tvayaiva darśite mārge maryādāṃ kartumarhasi|| kiṃ phalaṃ bhavitā devi kalpitaistaruputrakaiḥ|| 27.19 || ||devyuvāca|| yo vai nirudake grāme kūpaṃ kārayate budhaḥ|| yāvattoyaṃ bhavetkūpe tāvatsvarge sa modate|| 1.2.27.20 || daśakūpasamāvāpī daśavāpī samaṃ saraḥ|| daśasaraḥsamā kanyā daśakanyāsamaḥ kratuḥ|| 27.21 || daśakratusamaḥ putro daśaputrasamo drumaḥ|| 27.22 || eṣaiva mama maryādā niyatā lokabhāvinī|| jīrṇoddhāre kṛte vāpi phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ matam|| 27.23 || ||iti gaṇeśotpattiḥ|| tataḥ kadācidbhagavānumayā saha maṃdare|| maṃdire harṣajanane kaladhautamaye śubhe|| 27.24 || prakīrṇakusumāmodamahālikulakūjite|| kiṃnarodgītasaṃgīta pratiśabditamadhyake|| 27.25 || krīḍāmayūrairhasaiśca śrutaiścaivābhinādite|| mauktikairvividha ratnairvinirmitagavākṣake|| 27.26 || tatra puṇyakathābhiśca krīḍato rubhayostayoḥ|| prādurabhūnmahāñchabdaḥ pūritāṃbaragocaraḥ|| 27.27 || taṃ śrutvā kautukāddevī kimetaditi śaṃkaram|| paryapṛcchacchubhatanūrharaṃ vismayapūrvakam|| 27.28 || tāmāha devīṃ giriśo dṛṣṭapūrvāstu te tvayā|| ete gaṇā me krīḍaṃti śaile'smiṃstvatpriyāḥ śubhe|| 27.29 || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa kleśena kṣetrasādhanaiḥ|| yairahaṃ toṣitaḥ pṛthvyāṃ ta ete manujottamāḥ|| 1.2.27.30 || matsamīpamanuprāptā mama lokaṃ varānane|| carācarasya jagataḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāraṇakṣamāḥ|| 27.31 || vinaitānnaiva me prītirnaibhirvirahito rame|| ete ahamahaṃ caite tānetānpasya pārvati|| 27.32 || ityuktā vismitā devī dadṛśe tāngavākṣake|| sthitā padmapalāśākṣī mahādevena bhāṣitā|| 27.33 || kecitkṛśā hrasvadīrghāḥ kecitsthūlamahodarāḥ|| vyāghrebhameṣājamukhā nānāprāṇimahāmukhāḥ|| 27.34 || vyāghracarmaparīdhānā nagnā jvālāmukhāḥ pare|| gokarṇā gajakarṇāśca bahupādamukhekṣaṇāḥ|| 27.35 || vicitravāhanāścaiva nānāyudhadharāstathā|| gītavāditratattvajñāḥ sattvagītarasapriyāḥ|| 27.36 || tāndṛṣṭvā pārvatī prāha katisaṃkhyābhidhāstvamī|| 27.37 || ||śrīśaṃkara uvāca|| asaṃkhye yāstvamī devī asaṃkhyeyābhidhāstathā|| jagadāpūritaṃ sarvametairbhīmairmahābalaiḥ|| 27.38 || siddhakṣetreṣu rathyāsu jīrṇodyāneṣu veśmasu|| dānavānāṃ śarīreṣu bāleṣūnmattakeṣu ca|| 27.39 || ete viśati muditā nānāhāravihāriṇaḥ|| ūṣmapāḥ phenapāścaiva dhūmrapā madhupāyinaḥ|| madāhārāḥ sarvabhakṣyāstathānye cāpyabhojanāḥ|| 1.2.27.40 || gītanṛtyopahārāśca nānāvādyaravapriyāḥ|| anaṃtatvādamīṣāṃ ca vaktuṃ śakyā na vai guṇāḥ|| 27.41 || ||śrīdevyuvāca|| manaḥśilena kalkena ya eṣa cchuritānanaḥ|| tejasā bhāskarākāro rūpeṇa sadṛśastava|| 27.42 || ākarṇyākarṇya te deva gaṇairgītānmahāguṇān|| muhurnṛtyati hāsyaṃ ca vidadhāti muhurmuhuḥ|| 27.43 || sadāśivaśivetyevaṃ vihvalo vakti yo muhuḥ|| dhanyo'mīdṛśī yasya bhaktistvayi maheśvare|| 27.44 || enaṃ vijñātumicchāmi kiṃnāmāsau gaṇastava|| ||śrīśaṃkara uvāca|| sa eṣa vīraka devī sadā medrisute priyaḥ|| 27.45 || nānāścaryaguṇādhāraḥ pratīhāro matoṃ'bike|| ||devyuvāca|| īdṛśasya sutasyāpi mamo'kaṃṭhā purāṃtaka|| 27.46 || kadāhamīdṛśaṃ putraṃ lapsyāmyānaṃdadāyakam|| ||śarva uvāca|| eṣa eva sutastestu yāvadīdṛkparo bhavet|| 27.47 || ityuktā vijayāṃ prāha śīghramānaya vīrakam|| vijayā ca tato gatvā vīrakaṃ vākyamabravīt|| 27.48 || ehi vīraka te devī girijā toṣitā śubhā|| tvamamāhvayati sā devī bhavasyānumate svayam|| 27.49 || ityuktaḥ saṃbhramayuto mukhaṃ saṃmārjya pāṇinā|| devyāḥ samīpamāgacchajjayayā'nugataḥ śanaiḥ|| 1.2.27.50 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā girijā prāha girāmadhuravarṇayā|| ehyehi putra dattastvaṃ bhavena mama putrakaḥ|| 27.51 || ityukto daṃḍavaddevīṃ praṇamyāvasthitaḥ puraḥ|| mātā tatastamāliṃgya kṛtvotsaṃge ca vīrakam|| 27.52 || cucuṃba ca kapole taṃ gātrāṇi ca pramārjayat|| bhūṣayāmāsa divyaistaṃ svayaṃ nānāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ|| 27.53 || evaṃ saṃkalpya taṃ putraṃ lālayitvā umāciram|| uvāca putra krīḍeti gaccha sārdhaṃ gaṇairiti|| 27.54 || tataścikrīḍa madhye sa gaṇānāṃ pārvatīsutaḥ|| muhurmuhuḥ svamanasi stuvanbhaktiṃ sa śāṃkarīm|| 27.55 || praṇamya sarvabhūtāni prārthayāmyasmi duṣkaram|| bhaktyā bhajadhvamīśānaṃ yasyā bhakteridaṃ phalam|| 27.56 || krīḍituṃ vīrake yāte tato devī ca pārvatī|| nānākathābhiscikrīḍa punareva jaṭābhṛtā|| 27.57 || tato girisutākaṇṭhe kṣiptabāhurmaheśvaraḥ|| tapasastu viśeṣārthaṃ narma devīṃ kilābravīt|| 27.58 || sa hi gauratanuḥ śarvo viśeṣācchaśiśobhitaḥ|| raṃjitā ca vibhāvaryā devī nīlotpalacchaviḥ|| 27.59 || ||śarva uvāca|| śarīre mama tanvaṃgī site bhāsyasitadyutiḥ|| bhujaṃgīvāsitā śubhre saṃśliṣṭā candane tarau|| 1.2.27.60 || caṃdrajyotsnābhisaṃpṛktā tāmasī rajanī yathā|| rajanī vā site pakṣe dṛṣṭidoṣaṃ dadāsi me|| 27.61 || ityuktā girijā tena kaṇṭhaṃ śarvādvimucya sā|| uvāca koparaktākṣī bhṛkuṭīvikṛtānanā|| 27.62 || svakṛtena janaḥ sarvo janena paribhūyate|| avaśyamarthī prāpnoti khaṇḍanāṃ śaśikhaṃḍabhṛt|| 27.63 || tapobhirdīptacaritairyattvāṃ prārthitavatyaham|| tasya me niyamasyaivamavamānaḥ padepade|| 27.64 || naivāhaṃ kuṭilā śarva viṣamā na ca dhūrjaṭe|| svadoṣaistvaṃ gataḥ kṣāṃtiṃ tathā doṣākaraśriyaḥ|| 27.65 || nāhaṃ muṣṇāmi nayane netrahaṃtā bhavānbhava|| bhagastatte vijānāti tathaivedaṃ jagattrayamā|| 27.66 || mūrdhni śūlaṃ janayase svairdoṣairmāmadikṣipan|| yattvaṃ māmāha kṛṣṇeti mahākālo'si viśrutaḥ|| 27.67 || yāsyāmyahaṃ parityaktumātmānaṃ tapasā girim|| jīvaṃtyā nāsti me kṛtyaṃ dhūrtena paribhūtayā|| 27.68 || niśamya tasyā vacanaṃ kopatīkṣṇākṣaraṃ bhavaḥ|| uvācātha ca saṃbhrāṃto durjñeyacarito haraḥ|| 27.69 || na tattvajñāsi girije nāhaṃ niṃdāparastava|| cāṭūktibuddhyā kṛtavāṃsta vāhaṃ narmakīrtanam|| 1.2.27.70 || vikalpaḥ svacchacitteti girijaiṣā mama priyā|| prāyeṇa bhūtiliptānāmanyathā ciṃtitā hṛdi|| 27.71 || asmādṛśānāṃ kṛṣṇāṃgi pravartaṃte'nyathā giraḥ|| yadyevaṃ kupitā bhīru na te vakṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ|| 27.72 || narmavādī bhaviṣyāmi jahi kopaṃ sucismite|| śirasā praṇataste'haṃ racitaste mayāñjaliḥ|| 27.73 || dīnenāpyapamānena niṃditā nami vikriyām|| varamasmi vinamro'pi na tvaṃ devi guṇānvitā|| 27.74 || ityanekaiścāṭuvākyaiḥ sūktairdevena bodhitā|| kopaṃ tīvraṃ na tatyāja satī marmaṇi ghaṭṭitā|| 27.75 || avaṣṭabdhāvatha kṣiptvā pādau śaṃkarapāṇinā|| viparyastālakā vegādgantumaicchata śailajā|| 27.76 || tasyāṃ vrajantyāṃ kopena punarāha purāṃtakaḥ|| satyaṃ sarvairavayavaiḥ suteti sadṛśī pituḥ|| 27.77 || himācalasya śrṛṃgaistairmeghamālākulairmanaḥ|| tathā duravāgāhyo'sau hṛdayebhyastavāśayaḥ|| 27.78 || kāṭhinyaṃ kaṣṭamasmiṃste vanebhyo bahudhā gatam|| kuṭilatvaṃ nadībhyaste duḥsevyatvaṃ himādapi|| 27.79 || saṃkrāṃtaṃ sarvamevaitattava devī himācalāt|| ityuktā sā punaḥ prāha giriśaṃ sailajā tadā|| 1.2.27.80 || kopakaṃpitadhūmrāsyā prasphuraddaśanacchadā|| mā śarvātmopamānena niṃda tvaṃ guṇino janān|| 27.81 || tavāpi duṣṭasaṃparkātsaṃkrāṃtaṃ sarvamevahi|| vyālebhyo'nekajihvatvaṃ bhasmanaḥ snehavandhyatā|| 27.82 || hṛtkāluṣyaṃ śaśāṃkātte durbodhatvaṃ vṛṣādapi|| athavā bahunoktena alaṃ vācā śrameṇa me|| 27.83 || śmaśānavāsa āsīstvaṃ nagnatvānna tava trapā|| nirghṛṇatvaṃ kapālitvādevaṃ kaḥ śaknuyāttavaṃ|| 27.84 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśī tisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye pārvatīprakopavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 27 || cha ||
<1.2.28>
||nārada uvāca|| vrajaṃtī girijā'paśyatsakhīṃ māturmahāprabhām|| kusumāmodinīṃnāma tasya śailasya devatām|| 28.1 || sāpi dṛṣṭvā girisutāṃ snehaviklavamānasā|| kvapunargacchasītyuccairāliṃgyovāca devatā|| 28.2 || sā cāsyai sarvamācakhyau śaṃkarātkopakāraṇam|| punaścovāca girijā devatāṃ mātṛsaṃmatām|| 28.3 || nityaṃ śailādhirājasya devatā tvamaniṃdite|| sarvaṃ ca sannidhānaṃ ca mayi cātīva vatsalā|| 28.4 || tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yadvidheyaṃ tavādhunā|| athānya strīpraveśe tu samīpe tu pinākinaḥ|| 28.5 || tvayākhyeyaṃ mama śube yuktaṃ paścātkaromyaham|| tathetyukte tayā devyā yayau devī giriṃ prati|| 28.6 || ramye tatra mahāśṛṃge nānāścaryopaśobhite|| vibhūṣaṇādi sanyasya vṛkṣavalkaladhāriṇī|| 28.7 || tapastepe girisutā putreṇa paripālitā|| grīṣme paṃcāgnisaṃtaptā varṣāsu ca jaloṣitā|| 28.8 || yathā na kācitpraviśedyoṣidatra harāṃtike|| dṛṣṭvā parāṃ striyaṃ cātra vadethā mama putraka|| 28.9 || śīghrameva kariṣyāmi tato yuktamanaṃtaram|| evamastviti tāṃ devīṃ vīrakaḥ prāha sāṃpratam|| 1.2.28.10 || māturājñā suto hlāda plāvitāṃgo gatajvaraḥ|| jagāma tryakṣaṃ saṃdraṣṭuṃ praṇipatya ca mātaram|| 28.11 || gajavaktraṃ tataḥ prāha praṇamya samavasthitam|| sāśrukaṃṭhaṃ prayācaṃtaṃ naya māmapi pārvati|| 28.12 || gajavaktraṃ hi tvāṃ bāla māmivopahasiṣyati|| tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ yā gatirme tavāpi sā|| 28.13 || parābhavāddhi dhūrtānāṃ maraṇaṃ sādhu putraka|| evamuktvā samādāya himādriṃ prati sā yayau|| 28.14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye pārvatyastaporthaṃ gamanavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 28 || cha ||
<1.2.29>
||nārada uvāca|| vrajaṃtī girijā'paśyatsakhīṃ māturmahāprabhām|| kusumāmodinīṃnāma tasya śailasya devatām|| 29.1 || sāpi dṛṣṭvā girisutāṃ snehaviklavamānasā|| kvapunargacchasītyuccairāliṃgyovāca devatā|| 29.2 || sā cāsyai sarvamācakhyau śaṃkarātkopakāraṇam|| punaścovāca girijā devatāṃ mātṛsaṃmatām|| 29.3 || nityaṃ śailādhirājasya devatā tvamaniṃdite|| sarvaṃ ca sannidhānaṃ ca mayi cātīva vatsalā|| 29.4 || tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yadvidheyaṃ tavādhunā|| athānya strīpraveśe tu samīpe tu pinākinaḥ|| 29.5 || tvayākhyeyaṃ mama śubhe yuktaṃ paścātkaromyaham|| tathetyukte tayā devyā yayau devī giriṃ prati|| 29.6 || ramye tatra mahāśṛṃge nānāścaryopaśobhite|| vibhūṣaṇādi saṃnyasya vṛkṣavalkaladhāriṇī|| 29.7 || tapastepe girisutā putreṇa paripālitā|| grīṣme paṃcāgnisaṃtaptā varṣāsu ca jaloṣitā|| 29.8 || sthaṃḍilasthā ca hemaṃte nirāhārā tatāpa sā|| etasminnaṃtare daityo hyaṃdhakasya suto balī|| 29.9 || jñātvā gatāṃ girisutāṃ piturvairamanusmaran|| āḍirnāma bakabhrātā rahasyāṃtaraprekṣakaḥ|| 1.2.29.10 || jite kilāṃdhake daitye giriśenāmaradviṣi|| āḍiścakāra vipulaṃ tapo harajigīṣayā|| 29.11 || tamāgatyābravīdbrahmā tapasā paritoṣitaḥ|| brūhi kiṃ vāsuraśreṣṭha tapasā prāptumicchasi|| 29.12 || brahmāṇamāha daityastu nirmṛtyutvamahaṃ vṛṇe|| ||brahmovāca|| na kaścicca vinā mṛtyuṃ jaṃturāsura vidyate|| 29.13 || yatastato'pi daityeṃdra mṛtyuḥ prāpyaḥ śarīriṇā|| ityuktastaṃ tathetyāha tuṣṭaḥ kamalasaṃbhavam|| 29.14 || rūpasya parivarto me yadā syātpadmasaṃbhava|| tadā mṛtyurmama bhavedanyathā tvamaro hyaham|| 29.15 || ityuktastaṃ tathetyāha tuṣṭaḥ kamalasaṃbhavaḥ|| ityukto'maratāṃ mene daityarājyasthito'suraḥ|| 29.16 || ājagāma sa ca sthānaṃ tadā tripuraghātinaḥ|| āgato dadṛśe taṃ ca vīrakaṃ dvāryavasthitam|| 29.17 || taṃ cāsau vaṃcayitvā ca āḍiḥ sarpaśarīrabhṛt|| avārito vīrakeṇa praviveśa harāṃtikam|| 29.18 || bhujaṃgarūpaṃ saṃtyajya babhūvātha mahāsuraḥ|| umārūpī chalayituṃ giriśaṃ mūḍhacetanaḥ|| 29.19 || kṛtvomāyāstato rūpamapratarkyamanoharam|| sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvābhijñānasaṃvṛtam|| 1.2.29.20 || cakre bhagāṃtare daityo daṃtānvajropamāndṛḍhān|| tīkṣṇāgrānbuddhimohena giriśaṃ haṃtumudyataḥ|| 29.21 || kṛtvomārūpamevaṃ sa sthito daityo harāṃtike|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā giriśastuṣuṭaḥ samāliṃgya mahāsuram|| 29.22 || manyamāno girisutāṃ sarvai ravayavāṃtaraiḥ|| apṛcchatsādhu te bhāvo giriputrī hyakṛtrimā|| 29.23 || yā tvaṃ madaśayaṃ jñātvā prāpteha varavarṇini|| tvayā virahitaḥ śūnyaṃ manyosminbhuvanatraye|| 29.24 || prāptā prasannā yā tvaṃ māṃ yuktamevaṃvidhaṃ tvayi|| ityukte gūhayaṃśceṣṭāmumārūpyasuro'bravīt|| 29.25 || yātāsmi tapasaścartuṃ kālīvākyāttavātulam|| ratiśca tatra me nābhūttataḥ prāptā tavāṃtikam|| 29.26 || ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ śaṃkāṃ kiṃcitprāpyavadhārayat|| kupitā mayi tanvaṃgī pratyakṣā ca dṛḍhavratā|| 29.27 || aprāptakāmā saṃprāptā kimetatsaṃśayo mama|| rahasīti viciṃtyātha abhijñānādvicārayan|| 29.28 || nāpaśyadvāmapārśve tu tasyāṃkaṃ padmalakṣaṇam|| lomnāmāvartacaritaṃ tato devaḥ pinākadhṛk|| 29.29 || buddhā tāṃ dānavīṃ māyāṃ kiṃcitprahasitānanaḥ|| meḍhre raudrāstramādhāya cakre daityamanoratham|| 1.2.29.30 || sa rudanbhairavājrāvānavasādaṃ gato'suraḥ|| abudhyadvīrako naitadasureṃdraniṣūdanam|| 29.31 || hate ca mārutenāśugāminā nagadevatā|| aparicchinnatattvārthā śailaputryāṃ nyavedayat|| 29.32 || śrutvā vāyumukhāddevī krodharaktātilocanā|| apasyadvīrakaṃ putraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā|| 29.33 || mātaraṃ māṃ parityajya yasmāttvaṃ snehavihvalām|| vihitāvasaraḥ strīṇāṃ śaṃkarasya rahovidhau|| 29.34 || tasmātte paruṣā rūkṣā jaḍā hṛdaya varjitā|| gaṇeśākṣarasadṛśā śilā mātā bhaviṣyati|| 29.35 || evamutsṛṣṭaśāpāyā giriputryāstvanaṃtaram|| nirjagāma mukhātkrodhaḥ siṃharūpī mahābalaḥ|| 29.36 || paścāttāpaṃ samaśritya tayā devyā visarjitaḥ|| sa tu siṃhaḥ karālāsyo mahākesarakaṃdharaḥ|| 29.37 || proddhūtabalalāṃgūladaṃṣṭrotkaṭa guhāmukhaḥ|| vyāvṛtāsyo lalajjihvaḥ kṣāmakukṣiścikhādiṣuḥ|| 29.38 || tasyāsye vartituṃ devī vyavasyata satī tadā|| jñātvā manogataṃ tasyā bhagavāṃścaturānanaḥ|| 29.39 || ājagāmāśramapaṃda saṃpadāmāśrayaṃ tataḥ|| āgamyovāca tāṃ brahmā girijāṃ mṛṣṭayā girā|| 1.2.29.40 || kiṃ devī prāptukāmāsi kimalabhyaṃ dadāmi te|| tacchrutvovāca girijā gurugauravagarbhitam|| 29.41 || tapasā duṣkareṇāptaḥ patitve śaṃkaro mayā|| sa māṃ śyāmalavarṇeti bahuśaḥ proktavānbhavaḥ|| 29.42 || syāmahaṃ kāṃcanākārā vāllabhyena ca saṃyutā|| bharturbhūtapateraṃge hyekato nirviśaṃkitā|| 29.43 || tasyāstadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā provāca jalajāsanaḥ|| evaṃ bhavatu bhūyastvaṃ bharturdehārdhadhāriṇī|| 29.44 || tatastasyāḥ śarīrāttu strī sunīlāṃbujatviṣā|| nirgatā sābhavadbhīmā ghaṃṭāhastā trilocanā|| 29.45 || nānābharaṇapūrṇāṃgī pītakauśeyavāsinī|| tāmabravīttato brahmā devīṃ nīlāṃbujatviṣam|| 29.46 || asmādbhūdharajā radehasaṃparkāttvaṃ mamājñayā|| saṃprāptā kṛtakṛtyatvamekānaṃśā purākṛtiḥ|| 29.47 || ya eṣa siṃhaḥ prodbhūto devyāḥ krodhādvarānane|| sa testu vāhano devī ketau cāstu mahābalaḥ|| 29.48 || gaccha viṃdhyācale tatra surakāryaṃ kariṣyati|| atra śuṃbhaniśuṃbhau ca hatvā tārakasainyapau|| 29.49 || pāṃcālonāma yakṣo'yaṃ yakṣalakṣapadānugaḥ|| dattaste kiṃkaro devī mahāmāyāśatairyutaḥ|| 1.2.29.50 || ityuktā kauśikī devī tatetyāha pitāmaham|| nirgatāyāṃ ca kauśikyāṃ jātā svairāśritā guṇaiḥ|| 29.51 || sarvaiḥ pūrvabhavopāttaistadā svayamupastitaiḥ|| umāpi prāptasaṃkalpā paścāttāpaparāyaṇā|| 29.52 || muhuḥ svaṃ pariniṃdaṃtī jagāma giriśāṃtikam|| saṃprayāṃtīṃ ca tāṃ dvārī apavārya samāhitaḥ|| 29.53 || rurodha vīrako devīṃ hemavetralatādharaḥ|| tāmuvāca ca kopena tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva yāsi ca|| 29.54 || prayojanaṃ na te'stīha gaccha yāvanna bhartsyase|| devyā rūpadharo daityo devaṃ vaṃcayituṃ tviha|| 29.55 || praviṣṭo na ca dṛṣṭo'sau sa ca devena ghātitaḥ|| ghātite cāhamākṣipto nīlakaṇṭhena dhīmatā|| 29.56 || kāpi strī nāpi moktavyā tvayā putreti sādaram|| tasmāttvamatra dvāristhā varṣapūgānyanekaśaḥ|| 29.57 || bhaviṣyasi na cāpyatra praveśaṃ lapsyase vraja|| ekā me praviśedatra mātā yā snehavatsalā|| 29.58 || nagādhirājatanayā pārvatī rudravallabhā|| ityuktā tu tato devī ciṃtayāmāsa cetasā|| 29.59 || na sā nārī tu daityo'sau vāyornaivāvabāsata|| vṛthaiva vīrakaḥ śapto mayā krodhaparītayā|| 1.2.29.60 || akāryaṃ kriyate mūḍhaiḥ prāyaḥ krodhasamanvitaiḥ|| krodhena naśyate kīrtiḥ krodho haṃti sthirāṃ śriyam|| 29.61 || aparicchinnasarvārthā putraṃ śāpitavatyaham|| viparītārthaboddhṝṇāṃ sulabhā vipado yataḥ|| 29.62 || saṃciṃtyaivamuvācedaṃ vīrakaṃ prati śailajā|| adho lajjāvikāreṇa vadanenāṃbujatviṣā|| 29.63 || ahaṃ vīraka te mātā mā te'stu manaso bhramaḥ|| śaṃkarasyāsmi dayitā sutā tu himabhūbhṛtaḥ|| 29.64 || mama gātrasthitibhrāṃtyā mā śaṃkāṃ putra bhāvaya|| tuṣṭena gauratā dattā mameyaṃ padmayoninā|| 29.65 || mayā śapto'syavidite vṛttāṃte daityanirmite|| jñātvā nārīpraveśaṃ tu śaṃkare rahasi stite|| 29.66 || na nivartayituṃ śakyaḥ śāpaḥ kiṃ tu bravīmi te|| mānuṣyāṃ tu śilāyāṃ tvaṃ śilādātsaṃbhaviṣyasi|| 29.67 || puṇye cāpyarbudāraṇye svargamokṣaprade nṛṇām|| acaleśvaraliṃgaṃ tu vartate yatra vīraka|| 29.68 || vārāṇasyāṃ viśvanāthasamaṃ tatphaladaṃ nṛṇām|| prabhāsasya ca yātrābhirdaśabhiryatphalaṃ nṛṇām|| 29.69 || tadekayātrayā proktamarbudasya mahāgireḥ|| yatra taptvā tapo martyā dehadhātūnvihāya ca|| 1.2.29.70 || saṃsārī na punarbhūyānmaheśvaravaco yathā|| arbudo yadi labhyeta sevituṃ janmaduḥkhitaiḥ|| 29.71 || vārāṇasīṃ ca kedāraṃ kiṃ smaraṃti vṛthaiva te|| tatrārādhya bhavaṃ devaṃ bhavānnandīti nāmabhṛt|| 29.72 || śīghrameṣyasi cātraiva pratīhāratvamāpsyasi|| evamukte hṛṣṭaromā vīrakaḥ praṇipatya tām|| 29.73 || saṃstūya vividhairvākyairmātaraṃ samabhāṣata|| dhanyo'haṃ devi yo lapsye mānuṣyamatidurlabham|| 29.74 || śāpo'nugraharūpo'yaṃ viśeṣādarbudācale|| samīpe yasya puṇyo'sti mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| 29.75 || ūdhaḥ pṛthivyā deśo'yaṃ yo gireścārṇavāṃtare|| tatra gatvā mahatpuṇyamavāpya bhavabhaktitaḥ|| 29.76 || punareṣyāmi bho mātarityuktvābhūcchilāsutaḥ|| devī ca praviveśātha bhavanaṃ śaśimaulinaḥ|| 29.77 || ||ityārbudākhyānam|| tato dṛṣṭvā ca tāṃ prāha dhignārya iti tryaṃbakaḥ|| 29.78 || sā ca praṇmya taṃ prāha satyametanna mithyayā|| jaḍaḥ prakṛtibhāgoyaṃ nāryaścārhaṃti nindanām|| 29.79 || puruṣāṇāṃ prasādena mucyaṃte bhavasāgarāt|| tataḥ prahṛṣṭastāmāha haro yogyā'dhunā śubhe|| 1.2.29.80 || putraṃ dāsyāmi yena tvaṃ khyātimāpsyasi śobhane|| tato rema hi devyā sa nānāścaryālayo haraḥ|| 29.81 || tato varṣasahasreṣu devāstvaritamānasāḥ|| jvalanaṃ nodayāmāsurjñātuṃ śaṃkaraceṣṭitam|| 29.82 || dvāri sthitaṃ pratihāraṃ vaṃcayitvā ca pāvakaḥ|| pārāvatasya rūpeṇa praviveśa harāṃtikam|| 29.83 || dadṛśe taṃ ca deveśo vinatāṃ prekṣya pārvatīm|| tatastāṃ jvalanaṃ prāha naitadyogyaṃ tvayā kṛtam|| 29.84 || yadidaṃ bhukṣutaṃ sthānānmama tejo hyanuttamam|| gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sudurbuddhe no vā dhakṣyāmi tvāṃ ruṣā|| 29.85 || bhītastato'sau jagrāha sarvadevamukhaṃ ca saḥ|| tena te vahnisahitā vihvalāśca surāḥ kṛtāḥ|| 29.86 || vipāṭya jaṭharāṇyeṣāṃ vīryaṃ māheśvaraṃ tataḥ|| niṣkrāṃtaṃ tatsaro jātaṃ pāradaṃ śatayojanam|| 29.87 || vahniśca vyākulībhūto gaṃgāyāṃ mumuce sakṛt|| dahyamānā ca sā devī taraṃgairvahirutsṛjat|| 29.88 || jātastribhuvanakyātastena ca śvetaparvataḥ|| etasminnaṃtare vahnirāhūtaśca himālaye|| 29.89 || saptarṣibhirvahnihomaṃ kurvadbhirmaṃtravīryataḥ|| āgatya tatra jagrāha vahnirbhāgaṃ ca taṃ hutam|| 1.2.29.90 || gate'hnyatvasmiṃśca tatrasthaḥ patnī steṣāmapaśyata|| suvarṇakadalīstaṃbhanibhāstāścaṃdralekhayā|| 29.91 || paśyamānaḥ praphullākṣo vahniḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ|| sa bhūyaściṃtayāmāsa na nyāyyaṃ kṣubhito'smi yat|| 29.92 || sādhvīḥ patnīrdvijeṃdrāṇāmakāmāḥ kāmayāmyaham|| pāpametatkarma cograṃ naśyāmi tṛmavatsphuṭam|| 29.93 || kṛtvaitannaśyate kīrtiryāvadācaṃdratārakam|| evaṃ saṃciṃtya bahudhā gatvā caiva vanāṃtaram|| 29.94 || saṃyantuṃ nābhavacchakta upāyairbahubhirmanaḥ|| tataḥ sa kāmasaṃtapto mūrchitaḥ samapadyata|| 29.95 || tataḥ svāhā ca bhāryāsya bubudhe tadviceṣṭitam|| jñātvā ca ciṃtayāmāsa prahṛṣṭā manasi svayam|| 29.96 || svāṃ bhāryāmatha māṃ tyaktvā bahuvāsādavajñayā|| bhāryāḥ kāmayate nūnaṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām|| 29.97 || tadāsāṃ rūpamāśritya ramiṣye tena cāpyaham|| tatastvaṃgiraso bhāryā śivānāmeti śobhanā|| 29.98 || tasyā rūpaṃ samādhāya pāvakaṃ prāpya sābravīt|| māmagne kāmasaṃtaptāṃ tvaṃ kāmayitumarhasi|| 29.99 || na cetkariṣyase deva mṛtāṃ māmupadhāraya|| ahamaṃgiraso bhāryā śivānāma hutāśana|| 1.2.29.100 || sarvābhiḥ sahitā prāptā tāśca yāsyaṃtyanukramāt|| asmākaṃ tvaṃ priyo nityaṃ tvaccittāśca vayaṃ tathā|| 29.101 || tataḥ sa kāmasaṃtaptaḥ saṃbabhūva tayā saha|| prīte prītā ca sā devī nirjagāma vanāṃtarāt|| 29.102 || ciṃtayaṃtī mamedaṃ cedrūpaṃ drakṣyaṃti kānane|| te brāhmaṇīnāmanṛtaṃ doṣaṃ vakṣyaṃti pāvakāt|| 29.103 || tasmādetadrakṣamāṇā garuḍī saṃbhavāmyaham|| suparṇā sā tato bhūtvā dadṛśe śvetaparvatam|| 29.104 || śarastaṃbaiḥ susaṃpṛktaṃ rakṣobhiśca piśācakaiḥ|| sā tatra sahasā gatvā śailapūṣṭhaṃ sudurgamam|| 29.105 || prākṣipatkāṃcane kuṃḍe śukraṃ taddhāraṇe'kṣamā|| śiṣṭānāmapi devīnāṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām|| 29.106 || patnīsarūpatāṃ kṛtvā kāmayāmāsa pāvakam|| divyaṃ rūpamarūṃdhatyāḥ kartuṃ na śakitaṃ tayā|| 29.107 || tasyāstapaḥprabhāveṇa bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇena ca|| ṣaṭkṛtvastattu nikṣiptamagniretaḥ kurudvaha|| 29.108 || kuṃḍe'smiṃścaitrabahule pratipadyeva svāhayā|| tataśca pāvako duḥkhācchuśoca ca mumoha ca|| 29.109 || āḥ pāpaṃ kṛtamityeva dehanyāse'karonmatim|| tatastaṃ khecarī vāṇī prāha mā maraṇaṃ kuru|| 1.2.29.110 || bhāvyametacca bhāvyarthātko hi pāvaka mucyate|| bhāvyarthenāpi yatte ca paradāropa sevanam|| 29.111 || kṛtaṃ taccetasā tena tvāmajīrṇaṃ pravekṣyati|| śvetaketormahāyajñe ghṛtadhārābhitarpitam|| 29.112 || śokaṃ ca tyaja naitāstāḥ svāhai veyaṃ tava priyā|| śvetaparvatakuṃḍasthaṃ putraṃ tvaṃ draṣṭumarhasi|| tato vahnistatra gatvā dadṛśe tanayaṃ prabhum|| 29.113 || ||arjuna uvāca|| kasmātsvāhā karodrūpaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ tāsāṃ mahāmune|| 29.114 || yattā bhartṛparāḥ sādhvyastapasvinyognisaṃnibhāḥ|| na bibheti ca kiṃ tābhyaḥ ṣaḍbhyaḥ svāhā'parādhinī|| bhartṛbhaktyā jagaddagdhuṃ yataḥ śaktāśca tā mune|| 29.115 || ||nārada uvāca|| satyametatkuruśreṣṭha śrṛṇu taccāpi kāraṇam|| yena tāsāṃ kṛtaṃ rūpaṃ na vā śāpaṃ daduśca tāḥ|| 29.116 || yatra tadvahninā kṣiptaṃ rudratejaḥ sakṛtpurā|| gaṃgāyāṃ tatra sasnustāḥ ṣaṭatnyo'jñanābhāvataḥ|| 29.117 || tatastā vihvalībhūtāstejasā tena mohitāḥ|| lajjayā ca svabhartṝṇāṃ gaṃgātīrasthitā rahaḥ|| 29.118 || etadaṃtamālokya cikīrṣaṃtī manīṣitam|| svāhā śarīramāviśyatāsāṃ tejo jahāra tat|| 29.119 || cikrīḍa vahnijāyāpi yathā te kathitaṃ mayā|| 1.2.29.120 || upakāramimaṃ tābhiḥ smaraṃtībhiśca bhārata|| na śaptā sā yataḥ śāpo na deyaścopakāriṇi|| 29.121 || tataḥ saptarṣayo jñātvā jñānenāsucitāṃ gatāḥ|| tatyajuḥ ṣaṭ tadā patnīrvinā devīmaruṃdhatīm|| 29.122 || viśvāmitrastu bhagavānkumāraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ|| stavaṃ divyaṃ saṃpracakre mahāsenasya cāpi saḥ|| 29.123 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ śrṛṇu tvaṃ tāni phālguna|| japena yeṣāṃ pāpāni yāṃti jñānamavāpnuyāt|| 29.124 || tvaṃ brahmavādī tvaṃ brahmā brāhmaṇavatsalaḥ|| brahmaṇyo brahmadevaśca brahmado brahmasaṃgrahaḥ|| 29.125 || tvaṃ paraṃ paramaṃ tejo maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam|| aprameyaguṇaścaiva maṃtrāṇāṃ maṃtrago bhavān|| 29.126 || tvaṃ sāvitrīmayo deva sarvatraivāparājitaḥ|| maṃtra śarvātmako devaḥ ṣaḍakṣaravatāṃ varaḥ|| 29.127 || mālī maulī patākī ca jaṭī muṃḍī śikhaṃḍyapi|| kuṇḍalī lāṃgalī bālaḥ kumāraḥ pravaro varaḥ|| 29.128 || gavāṃputraḥ surārighnaḥ saṃbhavo bhavabhāvanaḥ|| pinākī śatruhā śveto gūḍhaḥ skandaḥ karāgraṇīḥ|| 29.129 || dvādaśo bhūrbhuvo bhāvī bhuvaḥ putro namaskṛtaḥ|| nāgarājaḥ sudharmātmā nākapṛṣṭhaḥ sanātanaḥ|| 1.2.29.130 || tvaṃ bhartā sarvabhūtātmā tvaṃ trātā tvaṃ sukhāvahaḥ|| śaradakṣaḥ śikhī jetā ṣaḍvaktro bhayanāśanaḥ|| 29.131 || hemagarbho mahāgarbho jayaśca vijayeśvaraḥ|| tvaṃ kartā tvaṃ vidhātā ca nityo nityārimardanaḥ|| 29.132 || mahāseno mahāteja vīrasenaśca bhūpatiḥ|| siddhāsanaḥ surādhyakṣo bhīmaseno nirāmayaḥ|| 29.133 || śauriryadurmahātejā vīryavānsatyavikramaḥ|| tejogarbho'suraripuḥ suramūrtiḥ surorjjitaḥ|| 29.134 || kṛtajño varadaḥ satyaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sādhuvatsalaḥ|| suvrataḥ sūryasaṃkāśo vahnigarbhaḥ kaṇo bhuvaḥ|| 29.135 || pippalī śīghrago raudrī gāṃgeyo ripudāraṇaḥ|| kārttikeyaḥ prabhuḥ kṣaṃtā nīladaṃṣṭro mahāmanāḥ|| 29.136 || nigraho nigrahāṇāṃ ca netā tvaṃ suranaṃdanaḥ|| pragrahaḥ paramānaṃdaḥ krodhaghnastāra ucchritaḥ|| 29.137 || kukkuṭī bahulī divyaḥ kāmado bhūrivardhanaḥ|| amogho'mṛtado hyagniḥ śatrughnaḥ sarvamodanaḥ|| 29.138 || avyayo hyamaraḥ śrīmānunnato hyagnisaṃbhavaḥ|| piśācarājaḥ sūryābhaḥ śivātmā śivanaṃdanaḥ|| 29.139 || apārapāro durjñeyaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ|| agrāhyaḥ kāraṇaṃ kartā parameṣṭhī paraṃ padam|| 1.2.29.140 || aciṃtyaḥ sarvabhūtātmā sarvātmā tvaṃ sanātanaḥ|| evaṃ sa sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃstutaḥ parameśvaraḥ|| 29.141 || nāmnāmaṣṭaśatenāyaṃ viśvāmitramaharṣiṇā|| prasannamūrtirāhedaṃ munīṃdraṃ vriyatāmiti|| 29.142 || mama tvayā dvijaśreṣṭha stutireṣā nirūpitā|| bhaviṣyati mano'bhīṣṭaprāptaye prāṇināṃ bhuvi|| 29.143 || vivardhate kule lakṣmīstasya yaḥ prapaṭhedimam|| na rākṣasāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtāni na cāpadaḥ|| 29.144 || vighnakārīṇi tadgehe yatraiva saṃstuvaṃti mām|| duḥsvapnaṃ ca na paśyetsa baddho mucyate baṃdhanāt|| 29.145 || stavasyāsya prabhāveṇa divyabhāvaḥ pumānbhavet|| tvaṃ ca māṃ śrutisaṃskāraiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃskartumarhasi|| 29.146 || saṃskārarahitaṃ janma yataśca paśuvatsmṛtam|| tvaṃ ca madvaradānena brahmarṣiśca bhaviṣyasi|| 29.147 || tato munistasya cakre jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ|| paurohityaṃ tathā bheje skaṃdasyaivājñayā prabhuḥ|| 29.148 || tatastaṃ vahnirabhyāgāddadarśa ca sutaṃ guham|| ṣaṭchīrṣaṃ dviguṇaśrotraṃ dvādaśākṣibhujakramam|| 29.149 || ekagrīvaṃ caikakāyaṃ kumāraṃ sa vyalokayat|| kalilaṃ prathame cāhni dvitīye vyaktitāṃ gatam|| 1.2.29.150 || dṛtīyāyāṃ śiśurjātaścaturthyāṃ pūrṇa evaca|| paṃcamyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ so'bhūtpāvakaṃ cāpyapaśyata|| 29.151 || tatastaṃ pāvakaḥ pārtha āliliṃga cucuṃba ca|| putreti coktvā tasmai sa śaktyastrama dadātsvayam|| 29.152 || sa ca śaktiṃ samādāya namaskṛtya ca pāvakam|| śvetaśrṛṃgaṃ samārūḍho mukhaiḥ paśyandiśo daśa|| 29.153 || vyanadadbhairavaṃ nādaṃ trāsa yansāsuraṃ jagat|| tataḥ śvetagireḥ śrṛṃgaṃ rakṣaḥ padmadaśāvṛtam|| 29.154 || bibheda tarasā śaktyā śatayojanavistṛtam|| tadekena prahāreṇa khaṃḍaśaḥ patitaṃ bhuvi|| 29.155 || cūrṇīkṛtā rākṣasāste satataṃ dharmaśatravaḥ|| tataḥ pravyathitā bhūmirvyaśīryata samaṃtataḥ|| 29.156 || bhītāśca parvatāḥ sarve cukruśuḥ pralayādyathā|| bhūtāni tatra subhṛśaṃ trāhitrāhīti cojjaguḥ|| 29.157 || evaṃ śrutvā tato devā vāsavaṃ saha te'bruvan|| yenaikena prahāreṇa trailokyaṃ vyākulī kṛtam|| 29.158 || sa saṃkruddhaḥ kṣaṇādviśvaṃ saṃhariṣyati vāsava|| vayaṃ ca pālanārthāya sṛṣṭā devena vedhasā|| 29.159 || tacca trāṇaṃ sadā kāryaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi|| asmākaṃ paśyatāmevaṃ yadi saṃkṣobhyate jagat|| 1.2.29.160 || dhiktato janma vīrāṇāṃ ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ kṣaṇāt|| tadasmābhiḥ sahainaṃ tvaṃ kṣatumarhasi vāsava|| 29.161 || evamuktastathetyuktvā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tamabhyayāt|| vidhitsustasya vīryaṃ sa śakrastūrṇataraṃ tadā|| 29.162 || ugraṃ tacca mahāvegaṃ devānīkaṃ durāsadam|| nardamānaṃ guhaṛ prekṣya nanāda jaladhiryathā|| 29.163 || tasya nādena mahatā samuddhūtodadhiprabham|| babhrāma tatratatraiva deva sainyamacetanam|| 29.164 || jighāṃsūnupasaṃprāptāndevāndṛṣṭvā sa pāvakiḥ|| visasarjja mukhāttatra pravṛddhāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ|| 29.165 || adahaddevasainyāni ceṣṭa mānāni bhūtale|| te pradīptaśirodehāḥ pradīptāyudhavāhanāḥ|| 29.166 || pracyutāḥ sahasā bhāṃti divastārāgaṇā iva|| dahyamānāḥ prapannāste śaraṇaṃ pāvakātmajam|| 29.167 || devā vajradharaṃ procustyaja vajraṃ śatakrato|| ukto devaistadā śakraḥ skaṃde vajravāsṛjat|| 29.168 || tadvisṛṣṭaṃ jaghānāśu pārśva skaṃdasya dakṣiṇam|| bibheda ca kuruśreṣṭha tadā tasya mahātmanaḥ|| 29.169 || vajraprahārātskaṃdasya saṃjātaḥ puruṣo'paraḥ|| yuvā kāṃcanasannāhaḥ śaktidhṛgdivya kuṃḍalaḥ|| 1.2.29.170 || śākha ityabhivikhyātaḥ sopi vyanadadadbhutam|| tataśceṃdraḥ punaḥ kruddho hṛdi skaṃdaṃ vyadārayat|| 29.171 || tatrāpi tādṛśo jajñe naigameya iti śrutaḥ|| tato vinadya skaṃdādyāścatvārastaṃ tadābhyayuḥ|| 29.172 || tadeṃdro vajramutsṛjya prāṃjaliḥ śaraṇaṃ yayau|| tasyābhayaṃ dadau skaṃdaḥ sahasainyasya sattamaḥ|| 29.173 || tataḥ prahṛṣṭāstrabhidaśā vāditrāṇyabhyavādayan|| vajraprahārātkanyāśca jajñire'sya mahābalāḥ|| 29.174 || yā haraṃ ti śiśūñjātāngarbhasthāṃścaiva dāruṇāḥ|| kākī ca hilimā caiva rudrā ca vṛṣabhā tathā|| 29.175 || āyā palālā mitrā ca saptaitāḥ śiśumātaraḥ|| etāsāṃvīryasaṃpannaḥ śiśuścābhūtsudāruṇaḥ|| 29.176 || skaṃdaprasādajaḥ putro lohitākṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ|| eṣa vīrāṣṭakaḥ proktaḥ skaṃdamātṛgaṇo'dbhutaḥ|| 29.177 || pūjanīyaḥ sadā bhaktyā sarvāpasmāraśāṃtidaḥ|| upātiṣṭhattataḥ skaṃdaṃ hiraṇyakavacasrajam|| 29.178 || lohitāṃbarasaṃvītaṃ trailokyasyāpi suprabham|| yuvānaṃ śrīḥ svayaṃ bheje taṃ praṇamya śarīriṇī|| 29.179 || śriyā juṣṭaṃ ca taṃ prāhuḥ sarve devāḥ praṇamya vai|| hiraṇyavarṇṇa bhadraṃ te lokānāṃ śaṃkaro bhava|| 1.2.29.180 || bhavāniṃdro'stu no nātha trailokyasya hitāya vai|| 29.181 || ||skaṃda uvāca|| kimiṃdraḥ sarvalokānāṃ karotīha surottamāḥ|| kathaṃ devagaṇāṃścaiva pāti nityaṃ sureśvaraḥ|| 29.182 || ||devā ūcuḥ|| iṃdro diśati bhūtānāṃ balaṃ tejaḥ prajāḥ sukham|| prajñāṃ prayacchati tathā sarvāndāyānsureśvaraḥ|| 29.183 || durvṛttānāṃ sa harati vṛttasthānāṃ prayacchati|| anuśāsti ca bhūtāni kāryeṣu balavattaraḥ|| 29.184 || asūrye ca bhavetsūryastathā'caṃdre ca caṃdramāḥ|| bhavatyagniśca vāyuśca pṛthivyāṃ jīvakāraṇam|| 29.185 || etadiṃdreṇa kartavyamiṃdro hi vipulaṃ balam|| tvaṃ ceṃdro bhava no vīra tārakaṃ jahi te namaḥ|| 29.186 || ||iṃdra uvāca|| tvaṃ bhaveṃdro mahābāho sarveṣāṃ naḥ sukhāvahaḥ|| praṇamya prārthaye skaṃda tārakaṃ jahi rakṣa naḥ|| 29.187 || ||skaṃda uvāca|| śādhi tvameva trailokyaṃ bhavāniṃdrostu sarvadā|| kariṣye ceṃdrakarmāṇi na mameṃdratvamīpsitam|| 29.188 || tvameva rājā bhadraṃ te trailokyasya mamaiva ca|| karomi kiṃ ca te śakraśāsanaṃ brūhi tanmama|| 29.189 || ||iṃdra uvāca|| yadi satyamidaṃ vākyaṃ niścayādbhāṣitaṃ tvayā|| abhiṣicchasva devānāṃ saināpatye mahābala|| ahamiṃdro bhaviṣyāmi tava vākyādyaśo'stu te|| 1.2.29.190 || ||skaṃda uvāca|| dānavānāṃ vināśāya devānāmarthasiddhaye|| gobrāhmaṇasya cārthāya evamastu vacastava|| 29.191 || ityukte sumahānādaḥ surāṇāmabhyajāyata|| bhūtānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ trailokyāṃkapakārakaḥ|| 29.192 || jayeti tuṣṭuvuścainaṃ vāditrāṇyabhyavādayan|| nanṛstaṣṭuvuścaivaṃ karāghātāṃśca cakrire|| 29.193 || tena śabdena mahatā vismitā naganaṃdinī|| śaṃkaraṃ prāha ko deva nādo'yamativartate|| 29.194 || ||rudra uvāca|| adya nunaṃ prahṛṣṭānāṃ surāṇāṃ vividhā giraḥ|| śrūyaṃte ca tathā devī yathā jātaḥ sutastava|| 29.195 || gavāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca divaukasām|| mārjayiṣyati cāśrūṇi putraste puṇyavatyapi|| 29.196 || evaṃ vadati sā devī draṣṭuṃ tamutsukā'bhavat|| śaṃkaraśca mahātejāḥ putrasnehādhiko yataḥ|| 29.197 || vṛṣabhaṃ tata āruhya devyā saha samutsukaḥ|| sagaṇo bhava āgacchatputra darśanalālasaḥ|| 29.198 || tato brahmā mahāsenaṃ prajāpatirathābravīt|| abhigaccha mahādevaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ prabho|| 29.199 || anayorvīryasaṃyogāttavotpattistu prāthamī|| evamastviti cāpyuktvā mahāseno maheśvaram|| 1.2.29.200 || apūjayadameyātmā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tām|| tatastamāliṃgya sutaṃ ciraṃ saṃyojya cāśiṣaḥ|| 29.201 || ciraṃ jahṛṣatuścobhau pārvatīparameśvarau|| siddhasārasya tattvaṃ ca dadau tuṣṭo'sya śaṃkaraḥ|| 29.202 || devī prakṛtimokṣaṃ ca tuṣṭā harṣapariplutā|| etasminneva kāle tu ṣaḍdevyastaṃ samāgaman|| 29.203 || ṛṣibhistāḥ parityaktāstaṃ putreti jagustadā|| pārvatī ca tataḥ prāha mama putro na vastvayam|| 29.204 || svāhā mameti ca prāha pāvakaśca mameti ca|| rudro mameti ca prāha mama devanadīti ca|| 29.205 || cakruste kalahaṃ ghoraṃ vivadaṃtaḥ parasparam|| putrasneho hi balavānpārtha kiṃkiṃ na kārayet|| 29.206 || tatastānprahasannāha vivādo yujyate na ca|| sarveṣāṃ vo guhaḥ putro matto vai vriyatāṃ varaḥ|| 29.207 || tataḥ prāhuśca ṣaḍdevyaḥ svargo no hyakṣayo bhavet|| tatheti tā gṛhaḥ prāha śakrastatrāṃtare'bravīt|| 29.208 || rohiṇyāścānujā skaṃda spardhamānābhijitkhalā|| itchaṃtī jyeṣṭhatāṃ devī pṛthatkvaṃ ca taporatā|| 29.209 || tataḥ prabhṛti mūḍho'smi tatsthāne sthāpayaprabho|| tatastatheti ca prokte kṛttikāstā divaṃ gatāḥ|| 1.2.29.210 || nakṣatraṃ saptaśīrṣābhaṃ bhāti tadvahnidaivatam|| athainamabravītsvāhā priyā nāhaṃ mahārciṣaḥ|| tadagneḥ priyatāṃ dehi sahavāsaṃ sadaiva ca|| 29.211 || ||skaṃda uvāca|| havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yatkiṃciddvijā hoṣyaṃti pāvake|| 29.212 || tatte nāmnā pradāsyaṃti vāsaḥ sārdhaṃ bhavettava|| pāvakaḥ prārthayāmāsa yajñabhāgānpunaḥ sutān|| 29.213 || sa cāpyāhādyaprabhṛti yajñabhāgānavāpnuhi|| itare prārthayāmāsuḥ khyāto nastvaṃ suto bhava|| 29.214 || evameveti tānāha skaṃdastaddhi sudurlabham|| tatastaṃ yoginaḥ sarve saṃbhūya sanakādayaḥ|| abhyaṣiṃcangirau tasminyogināmādipatyake|| 29.215 || yogīśvaramiti prāhustatastaṃ yoginastathā|| jahṛpurdevatāścaiva nānāvādyanyavādayan|| 29.216 || abhiṣiktena tenāsau śuśubhe śvetaparvataḥ|| ādityenevāṃśumatā suramya udayācalaḥ|| 29.217 || tato devāḥ sagandharvā nṛtyaṃtyapsarasastathā|| hṛṣṭānāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śrūyate ninado mahān|| 29.218 || evaṃ sendraṃ jagatsarvaṃ śvetaparvatasaṃsthitam|| prahṛṣṭaṃ prekṣya taṃ skandaṃ na ca tṛpyati darśanāt|| 29.219 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye skandakumārasya sarvadevasainādhipatyabhiṣekotsavavarmanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 29 || cha ||
<1.2.30>
||nārada uvāca|| tataḥ skandaḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ śvetaparvata mastakāt|| uttīrya tārakaṃ hantuṃ dakṣiṇāṃ sa diśaṃ yayau|| 30.1 || tataḥ sarasvatītīre yāni bhūtāni nārada|| grahāścopagrahāścaiva vetālāḥ śākinī gaṇāḥ|| 30.2 || unmādā ye hyapasmārāḥ palādāśca piśācakāḥ|| devaisteṣāmādhipatye so'bhyaṣicyata pāvakiḥ|| 30.3 || yathā te naiva maryādāṃ saṃtyajaṃti durāśayāḥ|| etaistasmātsamākrāṃtaḥ śaraṇyaṃ pāvakiṃ vrajet|| 30.4 || aprakīrṇendriyaṃ dāṃtaṃ śuciṃ nityamataṃdritam|| āstikaṃ skandabhaktaṃ ca varjayaṃti grahādikāḥ|| 30.5 || maheśvaraṃ ca ye bhaktā bhaktā nārāyaṇaṃ ca ye|| teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa naśyaṃte te vidūrataḥ|| 30.6 || tataḥ sarvaiḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ mahītīraṃ yayau guhaḥ|| tatra devaiḥ prakathitaṃ mahīmāhātmyamuttamam|| 30.7 || śrṛṇvanvisiṣmiye skandaḥ praṇanāma ca tāṃ nadīm|| tato mahīdakṣiṇatastīramāśritya dhiṣṭhitam|| 30.8 || praṇamya śakrapramukhā guhaṃ vacanamabruvan|| abhiṣiktaṃ vinā skanda senāpatimakalmaṣam|| 30.9 || na śarma labhate senā tasmāttvamabhiṣecaya|| mahīsāgarasaṃbhūtaiḥ puṇyaiścāpi śivairjalaiḥ|| 30.10 || abhiṣekṣyāmahe tvāṃ ca tatra no draṣṭumarhasi|| yathā hastipade sarvapadāṃtarbhāva iṣyate|| 30.11 || sarvatīrthāntarasthānaṃ tathārṇavamahījale|| sarvabhūtamayo yadvatryaṃbakaḥ parikīrtyate|| 30.12 || sarvatīrthamayastadvanmahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ|| ardhanārīśvaraṃ rūpaṃ yathā rudrasya sarvadam|| 30.13 || tathā mahīsamudrasya snānaṃ sarvaphalapradam|| yenātra pitaraḥ skanda tarpitā bhaktibhāvataḥ|| 30.14 || tena sarveṣu tīrtheṣu tarpitā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| na caitaddhṛdi maṃtavyaṃ kṣārametajjalaṃ hi yat|| 30.15 || yathā hi kaṭutiktādi gavā grastaṃ hi kṣīradam|| evametattvidaṃ toyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛpti dāyakam|| 30.16 || evaṃ bruvatsu deveṣu kapilo'pi munirjagau|| satyametadumāputra sarvatīrthamayī mahī|| 30.17 || kardamo yastvahamapi jñātvā tīrthamahā guṇān|| sarvāṃ bhuvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā hyaśramamāstitaḥ|| 30.18 || tato maheśvaraḥ prāha satyametatsuroditam|| brahmādyāstaṃ tathā prāhuratra bhūyo'pyatho guruḥ|| 30.19 || atrābhiṣekaṃ te vīra kariṣyāmaḥ samādiśa|| tataḥ suvismitastatra snātvā skando mahāmanāḥ|| 30.20 || abhiṣiñcantu māṃ devā iti tānabravīdvacaḥ|| tato'bhiṣekasaṃbhārānsarvānsaṃbhṛtya śāstrataḥ|| 30.21 || juhuvurmaṃtrapūte'gnau catvāro mukhyaṛtvijaḥ|| brahmā ca kapilo jīvo viśvāmitraścaturthakaḥ|| 30.22 || anye ca śataśastatra munayo vedapāragāḥ|| tatrādbhutaṃ mahādevo darśayāmāsa bhārata|| 30.23 || yadagnikuṇḍamadhyastho liṃgamūrtirvyadṛśyata|| ahamevāgnimadhyastho havirgṛhṇāmi nityaśaḥ|| 30.24 || etatsaṃdarśanārthāya liṃgamūrtirabhūdvibhuḥ|| talliṃgamatulaṃ devā namaścakrurmudānvitāḥ|| 30.25 || sarvapāpāpahaṃ pārtha sarvakāmaphalapradam|| tatra homāvasāne ca datte himavatā śubhe|| 30.26 || divyaratnānvite skando niṣaṇṇaḥ paramāsane|| sarvamaṃgalasaṃbhārairvidhimaṃtrapuraskṛtam|| 30.27 || abhyaṣiṃcaṃstato devāḥ kumāraṃ śaṃkarātmajam|| iṃdro viṣṇurmahāvīryo brahmarudrau ca phālguna|| 30.28 || ādityādya grahāḥ sarve tathobhāvanilānalau|| ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāścaivāśvināvubhau|| 30.29 || viśvedevāśca maruto gaṃdharvāpsarasastathā|| devabrahmarṣayaścaiva vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ|| 30.30 || vidyādharā yogasiddhāḥ pulastyapulahādayaḥ|| pitaraḥ kaśyapo'triśca marīcirbhṛguraṃgirāḥ|| 30.31 || dakṣo'tha manavo ye ca jyotīṃṣi ṛtavastathā|| mūrtimatyaśca sarito mahīprabhṛtikāstathā|| 30.32 || lavaṇādyāḥ samudrāśca prabhāsādyāśca tīrthakāḥ|| pṛthivī dyaurdiśaścaiva pādapāḥ pārvatāstathā|| 30.33 || ādityādyā mātaraśca kurvaṃtyo guhamaṃgalam|| vāsukipramukhā nāgāsthathobhau garuḍāruṇau|| 30.34 || varuṇo dhanadaścaiva yamaḥ sānucarastathā|| rākṣaso nirṛtiścaiva bhūtāni ca palāśanāḥ|| 30.35 || dharmo bṛhaspatiścaiva kapilo gādhinaṃdanaḥ|| bahulatvācca ye noktā vividhā devatāgaṇāḥ|| 30.36 || te ca sarve mahīkūle hyabhyaṣiṃcanmudā guham|| tato mahāsvanāmugrāṃ devadaityādidarpahām|| 30.37 || dadau paśupatistasmai sarvabhūtamahācamūm|| viṣṇurdadau vaijayaṃtīṃ mālāṃ balavivardhinīm|| 30.38 || umā dadau cārajasī vāsasī sūryasaprabhā|| gaṃgā kamaṃḍaluṃ divyamamṛtodbhavamuttamam|| 30.39 || mahī mahānadī tasya cākṣamālāṃ sasāgarā|| dadau mudā kumārāya daṃḍaṃ caiva bṛhaspatiḥ|| 30.40 || garuḍo dayitaṃ putraṃ mayūraṃ citrabarhiṇam|| aruṇastāmracūḍaṃ ca pradadau caraṇāyudham|| 30.41 || chāgaṃ ca varuṇo rājā balavīryasamanvitam|| kṛṣṇājinaṃ tathā brahmā brahmaṇyāya dadau jayam|| 30.42 || caturo'nucarāṃścaiva mahāvīryānbalotkaṭān|| naṃdisenaṃ lohitākṣaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ ca mānasān|| 30.43 || caturthaṃ cāpyatibalaṃ khyātaṃ kusumamālinam|| tataḥ sthāṇurdadau devo mahāpāriṣadaṃ kratum|| 30.44 || sa hi devāsure yuddhe daityānāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām|| jaghāna dorbhyāṃ saṃkruddhaḥ prayutāni caturdaśa|| 30.45 || yamaḥ prādādanucarau yamakālopamau tadā|| unmāthaṃ ca pramāthaṃ ca mahāvīryau mahādyutī|| 30.46 || subhrājau bhāskarasyaiva yau sadā cānuyāyinau|| tau sūryaḥ kārtikeyāya dadau pārtha mudānvitaḥ|| 30.47 || kailāsaśrṛṅgasaṃkāśau śvetamālyānulepanau|| somo'pyanucarau prādānmaṇiṃ sumaṇimeva ca|| 30.48 || jvālajihvaṃ jyotiṣaṃ ca dadāvagnirmahābalau|| parighaṃ ca balaṃ caiva bhīmaṃ ca sumahābalam|| 30.49 || skaṃdāya trīnanucarāndadau viṣṇururukramaḥ|| utkrośaṃ paṃcajaṃ caiva vajradaṇḍadharāvubhau|| 30.50 || dadau maheśaputrāya vāsavaḥ paravīrahā|| tau hi śatrūnmahendrasya jaghnatuḥ samare bahūn|| 30.51 || vardhanaṃ baṃdhanaṃ caiva āyurvedaviśāradau|| skandāya dadatuḥ prītāvaśvinau bharatarṣabha|| 30.52 || balaṃ cātibalaṃ caiva mahāvaktrau mahābalau|| pradadau kārtikeyāya vāyuścānucarāvubhau|| 30.53 || ghasaṃ cātighasaṃ vīrau varuṇaśca dadau prabhuḥ|| suvarcasaṃ mahātmānaṃ tathaivāpyativarcasam|| 30.54 || himavānpradadau pārtha sākṣāddauhitrakāya vai|| kāṃcanaṃ ca dadau merurmeghamālinameva ca|| 30.55 || ucchritaṃ cātiśṛṃgaṃ ca mahāpāṣāṇayodhinau|| svāheyāya dadau prītaḥ sa viṃdhyaḥ pārṣadau śubhau|| 30.56 || saṃgrahaṃ vigrahaṃ caiva samudro'pi gadhādharau|| pradadau pārṣadau virau mahīnadyā samanvitaḥ|| 30.57 || unmādaṃ puṣpadaṃtaṃ ca śaṃkukarṇaṃ tathaiva ca|| pradadāvagniputrāya pārvatī śubhadarśanā|| 30.58 || jayaṃ mahājayaṃ caiva nāgau jvalanasūnave|| pradadurbalināṃ śreṣṭhau suparṇaḥ pārṣadāvubhau|| 30.59 || evaṃ sādhyāśca rudrāśca vasavaḥ pitarastathā|| sarve jagati ye mukhyā daduḥ skaṃdāya pārṣadān|| 30.60 || nānāvīryānmahāvīryānnānāyudhavibhūṣaṇān|| bahulatvānna śakyaṃte saṃkhyātuṃ te ca phālguna|| 30.61 || mātaśca dadustasmai tadā mātṛgaṇānprabho|| yābhirvyāptāstrayo lokāḥ kalyāṇībhiścarācarāḥ|| 30.62 || prabhāvatī viśālākṣī gopālā gonasā tathā|| apsujātā bṛhaddaṃḍī kālikā bahuputrakā|| 30.63 || bhayaṃkarī ca cakrāṃgī tīrthanemiśca mādhavī|| gītapriyā alātākṣī caṭulā śalabhāmukhī|| 30.64 || vidyujjihvā rudrakālī śatolūkhalamekhalā|| śataghaṃṭākiṃkiṇikā cakrākṣī catvarālayā|| 30.65 || pūtanā rodanā tvāmā koṭarā meghavāhinī|| ūrdhvaveṇīdharā caiva jarāyurjarjarānanā|| 30.66 || khaṭakheṭī dahadahā tathā dhamadhamā jayā|| bahuveṇī bahuśīrā bahupādā bahustanī|| 30.67 || śatolūkamukhī kṛṣṇā karṇaprāvaraṇā tathā|| śūnyālayā dhānyavāsā paśudā dhānyadā sadā|| 30.68 || etāścānyāśca bahvyaśca mātaro bharatarṣabha|| bahulatvādahaṃ tāsāṃ na saṃkhyātumihotsahe|| 30.69 || vṛkṣacatvaravāsinyaścatuṣpathaniveśanāḥ|| guhāsmaśānavāsinyaḥ śailaprasravaṇālayāḥ|| 30.70 || nānābharaṇaveṣāstā nānāmūrtidharāstathā|| nānābhāṣāyudhadharāḥ parivavrustadā guham|| 30.71 || tataḥ sa śuśubhe śrīmānguho guha ivāparaḥ|| saināpatye cābhiṣikto devairnānāmunīśvaraiḥ|| 30.72 || tataḥ praṇamya sarvāṃstā nekaikatvena pāvakiḥ|| vriyatāṃ vara ityāha bhavabrahmapurogamān|| 30.73 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kārtikeyasya senānītve'bhiṣekavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 30 || cha ||
<1.2.31>
||nārada uvāca|| te cainaṃ yojya cāśīrbhirayācaṃta varaṃ guham|| eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yatpāpaṃ tārakaṃ jahi|| 31.1 || evamastviti tānuktvā yogoyoga iti bruvan|| tārakārimahātejā mayūraṃ cādhyarohata|| 31.2 || śaktihasto vinadyātha guho devāṃstadābravīt|| yadyadya tārakaṃ pāpaṃ nāhaṃ hanmi surottamāḥ|| 31.3 || gobrāhmaṇāvamantṝṇāṃ tato yāmi gatiṃ sphuṭam|| evaṃ tena pratijñāte śabdo'tisumahānabhūt|| 31.4 || yogoyoga iti prāhurājñayā śarajanmanaḥ|| arajo vāsasī rakte vasānaḥ pārvatīsutaḥ|| 31.5 || athāgre sarvadevānāṃ sthito vīro yayau mudā|| tasya keturalaṃ bhāti caraṇāyudhaśobhitaḥ|| 31.6 || caraṇābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ girīñchakto yo vidārayituṃ raṇe|| yā ceṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ prabhā śāṃtirbalaṃ yathā|| 31.7 || tanmayā guhaśaktiḥ sā bhṛśaṃ haste vyarocata|| yaddārḍhyaṃ sarvalokeṣu tanmayaṃ kavacaṃ tathā|| 31.8 || yotsyamānasya vīrasya deheprādurabhūtsvayam|| dharmaḥ satyamasaṃmohastejaḥ kāṃtatvamakṣatiḥ|| 31.9 || balamojaḥ kṛpā cava baddhā karayugaṃ tathā|| ādeśakārīṇyagre'sya svayaṃ tasthurmahātmanaḥ|| 31.10 || tamagre cāpi gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhatonuyayau haraḥ|| rathenādityavarṇena pārvatyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ|| 31.11 || nirmitena hareṇaiva svayamīśena līlayā|| sahasraṃ tasya siṃhānāṃ tasminyuktaṃ rathottame|| 31.12 || abhīṣūnpuruṣavyāghra brahmā ca jagṛhe svayam|| te pibaṃta ivākāśaṃ trāsayaṃtaścarācaram|| 31.13 || siṃhā rathasya gacchaṃto nadaṃtaścārukesarāḥ|| tasminrathe paśupatiḥ sthito bhātyumayā saha|| 31.14 || vidyutā meḍitaḥ sūryaḥ seṃdracāpaghano yathā|| agratastasya bhagavāndhaneśo guhyakaiḥ saha|| 31.15 || āsthāya ruciraṃ yāti puṣpakaṃ naravāhanaḥ|| airāvaṇaṃ samāstāya śakraścāpi suraiḥ saha|| 31.16 || pṛṣṭhatonuyayau yāṃtaṃ varadaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam|| tasya dakṣiṇato devā marutaścitrayodhinaḥ|| 31.17 || gacchaṃti vasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiśca saha saṃgatāḥ|| yamaśca mṛtyunā sārdhaṃ sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ|| 31.18 || ghorairvyādhiśataiścāpi savyato yāti kopitaḥ|| yamasya pṛṣṭhataścāpi ghorastriśikharaḥ sitaḥ|| 31.19 || vijayonāma rudrasya yāti śūlaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ|| tamugrapāśo bhagavanvaruṇaḥ salileśvaraḥ|| 31.20 || parivārya śataiyāti yādobhirvividhairvṛtaḥ|| pṛṣṭhato vijayasyāpi yāti rudrasya paṭṭiśaḥ|| 31.21 || gadāmuśalaśaktyādyairvarapraharaṇairvṛtaḥ|| paṭṭiśaṃ cānvagātpārtha astraṃ pāśupataṃ mahat|| 31.22 || bahuśīrṣaṃ mahāghoramekapādaṃ bahūdaram|| kamaṃḍaluścāsya paścānmaharṣigaṇasevitaḥ|| 31.23 || tasya dakṣiṇato bhāti daṇḍo gacchañchriyā vṛtaḥ|| bhṛgvaṃgirobhiḥ sahito devairapya bhipūjitaḥ|| 31.24 || rākṣasāścānyadevāśca gandharvā bhujagāstathā|| nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca munayo'psarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| 31.25 || nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva jaṃgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā|| mātaraśca mahādevamanujagmuḥ kṣudhānvitāḥ|| 31.26 || sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhataścāsīttārkṣyastho buddhimānhariḥ|| pālayanpṛtanāṃ sarvāṃ svaparīvārasaṃvṛtaḥ|| 31.27 || evaṃ sainyasamopeta uttaraṃ taṭamāgataḥ|| tāmraprākāramāśritya tasthau tryaṃbakanaṃdanaḥ|| 31.28 || sa tārakapurasyāpi paśyanṛddhi manuttamām|| visiṣmiye mahāsenaḥ praśaśaṃsa tapo'sya ca|| 31.29 || sthitaḥ paśyansa śuśubhe mayūrastho guhastadā|| chatreṇa dhriyamāṇena svayaṃ somasamastviṣā|| 31.30 || vījyamānaścāmarābhyāṃ vāyvagribhyāṃ mahādyutiḥ|| mātṛbhiśca surairdattaiḥ svairgaṇairapi saṃvṛtaḥ|| 31.31 || tataḥ praṇamya taṃ śakro deva madhye vaco'bravīt|| paśyapaśya mahāsena daityānāṃ balaśālinām|| 31.32 || ye tvāṃ kālaṃ na jānaṃti martyā gṛharatā iva|| eteṣāṃ ca gṛhe dūto yastvāṃ śaṃsatu tārakam|| 31.33 || vīrāṇāmucitaṃ tvetatkīrtidaṃ ca mahājane|| anujñayā tataḥ skandabhaktaṃ śakro dhanaṃjaya|| 31.34 || māmādiśyāsurendrāya prāhiṇoddautyayogyakam|| ahaṃ svayaṃ gantukāmaḥ śakreṇāpi ca preṣitaḥ|| 31.35 || prāsāde strīsahasrāṇāṃ prāvocaṃ madhyato'pyaham|| asurādhamadurbuddhe śakrastvāmāha tacchṛṇu|| 31.36 || yajjagaddalanādāptaṃ kilbiṣaṃ dānava tvayā|| tasyāhaṃ nāśakaste'dya puruṣaścedbhaviṣyasi|| 31.37 || śīghraṃ niḥsara pāpiṣṭha niḥsariṣyasi cenna hi|| kṣaṇāttava puraṃ kṣepsye pāvitryāyaiva sāgare|| 31.38 || iti śrutvā rūkṣavācaṃ kruddhaḥ strīgaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ|| muṣṭimudyamyamā'dhāvadbhītaścāhaṃ palāyitaḥ|| 31.39 || vyākulastatra vṛttāṃtaṃ kumārāya nyavedayam|| mayi cāpyāgate daityaściṃtayāmāsa cetasi|| 31.40 || nālabdha saṃśrayaḥ śakro vaktumetadihārhati|| nimittāni ca ghorāṇi saṃtrāsaṃ janayaṃti me|| 31.41 || evaṃ viciṃtya cotthāya gavākṣaṃ sodhyarohata|| sahasrabhaumikāvāsaśrṛṅgavātāyanasthitaḥ|| 31.42 || apaśyaddevasainyaṃ sa divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca saṃvṛtam|| ratairgajairhayaiścāpi nāditāśca diśo daśa|| 31.43 || vimānaiścādbhutākāraiḥ kiṃnarodgītanāditaiḥ|| dundubhibhirgoviṣāṇaistālaiḥ śaṃkhaiśca nāditaiḥ|| 31.44 || akṣobhyāmiva tāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā so'ciṃtayattadā|| ete mayā jitāḥ pūrvaṃ kasmādbhūyaḥ samāgatāḥ|| 31.45 || iti ciṃtāparo daityaḥ śuśrāva kaṭukākṣaram|| devabaṃdibhirudvuṣṭaṃ ghoraṃ hṛdayadāraṇam|| 31.46 || jayātu laśaktidīdhitipiṃjararucāruṇamaṃḍalabhujodbhāsitadevasainya puravanakumudakānanavikāsaneṃdo kumāranātha jaya ditikulamahodadhivaḍavānala madhuraravamayūraravāsuramukuṭakūṭakuṭṭitacaraṇanakhāṃkura mahāsena tārakavaṃśaśuṣkatṛmadāvānala yogīśvarayaॉ yogijanahṛdayagaganavitataciṃtāsaṃtānasaṃtamasanodanakharakiraṇakalpanakhanikaravirājitacaraṇakamala skanda jaya bāla saptavāsara bhuvanāvaliśokasaṃdahana|| 31.47 || namo namastestu manoramāya namostu te sādhubhayāpahāya|| namostu te bālakṛtācalāya namonamo nāśaya devaśatrūn|| 31.48 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kumārasya tārakāsunaranagaraṃ prati gamanavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 31 || cha ||
<1.2.32>
||nārada uvāca|| śrutvaitaṃ saṃstavaṃ daityaḥ saṃghuṣṭaṃ devabaṃdibhiḥ|| sasmāra brahmaṇo vākyaṃ vadhaṃ bālādupasthitam|| 32.1 || śrutvā sa klinnasarvāṃgo dvāḥsthaṃ rājā vaco'bravīt|| amātyāndraṣṭumicchāmi śīghramānaya mā ciram|| 32.2 || tataste rājavacanātkālanemi mukhāgatāḥ|| prāha tāṃstārako daityaḥ kimidaṃ vo viceṣṭitam|| 32.3 || yaiḥ śatrusaṃbhavā vārtā kāpi na śrīvitastvaham|| madirākāmamattānāṃ maṃtritvaṃ vo na yujyate|| hitaṃ mantrayate rājñastena maṃtrī nigadyate|| 32.4 || ||amātyā ūcuḥ|| ko jānāti surāndīnāndaityānāmiti no matiḥ|| 32.5 || mā viṣīda mahārāja vayaṃ jeṣyāmahe surān|| bālādapi bhayaṃ kiṃ vā lajjāyai ciṃtitaṃ tvidam|| 32.6 || sarvametatsusādhyaṃ ca bherī saṃtāḍyatāṃ dṛḍham|| tato daityendravacanātsaṃnāhajananī tadā|| 32.7 || bhṛśaṃ saṃtāḍitā bherī kaṃpayāmāsa sā jagat|| smaraṇāddaityarājasya parvatebhyo mahāsurāḥ|| 32.8 || nimnagābhyaḥ samudrebhyaḥ pātālebhyoṃ'barādapi|| sahasā samanuprāptā yugāṃtānalasaprabhāḥ|| 32.9 || koṭikoṭisahasraistu parārdhairdaśabhiḥ śataiḥ|| senāpatiḥ kālanemiḥ śīghraṃ devānupāyayau|| 32.10 || caturyojanavistīrṇe nānāścaryasamanvite|| rathe sthito manāgdīnastārakaḥ samadṛśyata|| 32.11 || etasminnaṃtare pārtha kruddhaiḥ skandasya pārṣadaiḥ|| prākāraḥ pātitaḥ sarvo bhagnānyupavanāni ca|| 32.12 || tataścacāla vasudhā devī savanakānanā|| jajvāla khaṃ sanakṣatraṃ pramūḍhaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhṛśam|| 32.13 || tamobhūtaṃ jagaccasīdgṛdhrairvyāptaṃ nabho'bhavat|| tato nānāpraharaṇaṃ pralayāṃbudasannibham|| 32.14 || kālanemimukhaṃ pārtha adṛśyata mahadbalam|| taddhi ghoramasaṃkhyeyaṃ jagarja vividhā giraḥ|| 32.15 || abhyadravadraṇe devānbhagavaṃtaṃ ca śaṃkaram|| vinadadbhistato daityaindevānīkaṃ mahāyudhaiḥ|| 32.16 || parvataiśca śataghnībhirāyasaiḥ paridhairapi|| kṣaṇena drāvitaṃ sarvaṃ vimukhaṃ cāpyadṛśyata|| 32.17 || asurairvadhyamāne tu pāvakairiva kānanam|| apataddāvabhūmiṣṭha mahādrumavanaṃ yathā|| 32.18 || te bhinnāsthiśi rodehāḥ prādravaṃta divaukasaḥ|| na nāthamadhyagacchaṃta vadhyamānā mahāsuraiḥ|| 32.19 || atha tadvidrutaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvāḥ puraṃdaraḥ|| āśvāsayannuvācedaṃ balavaddānavārditam|| 32.20 || bhayaṃ tyajata bhadraṃ vaḥ śurāḥ śastrāṇi gṛhṇata|| kurudhvaṃ vikrame buddhi mā ca kācidvyathāstu vaḥ|| 32.31 || eṣa kālānalaprakhyo mayūraṃ samupasthitaḥ|| rakṣitā vo mahāsenaḥ kathaṃ bhītistathāpi vaḥ|| 32.22 || śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā samāśvastā divokasaḥ|| dānavānpratyayudhyaṃta śakraṃ kṛtvā vyapāśrayam|| 32.23 || kālanemirmahendreṇa saṃyuge samayujyata|| sahasrākṣauhiṇīyukto jaṃbhakaḥ śaṃkareṇa ca|| 32.24 || kujaṃbho viṣṇunā caiva tāvatya kṣauhiṇīvṛtaḥ|| anye ca tridaśāḥ sava marutaśca mahābalāḥ|| 32.25 || pratyayudhyaṃtaṃ daityeṃdreḥ sādhyāśca vasubhiḥ saha|| tato bahuvidhaṃ yuddhaṃ kālanemirvidhāyaca|| 32.26 || utsṛjya sahasā pārtha airāvaṇaśiraḥsthitaḥ|| sa tu pādaprahāreṇa muṣṭinā caiva taṃ gajam|| 32.27 || śakraṃ ca caghne vinadanpetatustāvubhau bhuvi|| tataḥ śakraṃ samādāya kālanemirvicetasam|| 32.28 || rathamāśritya bhūyopi tārakābhimukho yayau|| atha kruddhaṃ tadā devaiḥ sahasā cāṃtakādibhiḥ|| 32.29 || hriyate hriyate rājā trātā ko'pi na vidyate|| etasminnaṃtare śarvaṃ pinākadhanuṣaścyutaiḥ|| 32.30 || bāṇaiḥ sasainyaṃ kṛtvā ca jaṃbhakaṃ gṛdhramodanam|| kālanemiṃ samāgamya rathastho vākyamabravīt|| 32.31 || kimetena mahendreṇa mayā yudhyasva dānava|| vīraṃmanya sudurbuddhe tato jñāsyasi vīratām|| 32.32 || ||kānemiruvāca|| nagnena saha ko yudhyeddhatenāpi ca yena vā|| śaṃsatsu daityavīrāṇāmupahāsaḥ prajāyate|| 32.33 || ātmanastu samaṃ kiṃcidvilokya sudurmate|| tadākarṇya ca sāvajñaṃ vacaḥ śarvo visiṣmiye|| 32.34 || tataḥ kumāraḥ sahasā mayūrastho'bhyadhāvata|| kujaṃbhaṃ sānugaṃ hatvā vāsudevopyadhāvata|| 32.35 || tato hariḥ skaṃdamāha kimetena tava prabho|| daityādhamena pāpena muhūrtaṃ paśya me balam|| 32.36 || evamuktvā nivāryainaṃ keśavo garuḍasthitaḥ|| śārṅgakodaṃḍanirmuktairbāṇairdaityamavākirat|| 32.37 || sa tairbāṇaistāḍyamāno vajrairiva mahāsuraḥ|| vimucya vāsavaṃ kruddho bāṇāṃstānvyadhamaccharaiḥ|| 32.38 || yānyānbāṇānharirdivyānastrāṇi ca mumoca ha|| nivārayati daityastānprahasam̐llīlayaiva ca|| 32.39 || tataḥ kaumodakīṃ gṛhya kṣiprakārī janārdanaḥ|| mumoca sainyanāthāya sārathiṃ ca vyacūrṇayat|| 32.40 || tato rathādavaplutya vivṛtya vadanaṃ mahat|| garuḍaṃ caṃcunādāya sa viṣṇuṃ kṣiptavānmukhe|| 32.41 || tato'bhūtsarvadevānāṃ vimoho jagatāmapi|| cacāla vasudhā celuḥ parvatāḥ sapta cārṇavāḥ|| 32.42 || kālanemirnaścaiva prānṛtyata mahāraṇe|| asaṃmūḍhastato viṣṇustvarākāla upasthite|| 32.43 || kukṣiṃ vidārya cakreṇa bhāskaro'bhādivoditaḥ|| bahirbhūto hariścainaṃ mahoyitvā svanindayā|| 32.44 || pātālasya talaṃ ninye tatra śiśye sa kāṣṭhavat|| tataścakreṇa daityānāṃ nihatā daśakoṭyaḥ|| 32.45 || pramoditāstathā devā vimohāstatkṣaṇādbabhuḥ|| tataḥśarvastamāliṃgya sādhusādhu janārdana|| 32.46 || tvayā yadvihitaṃ karma tatkartānyo na vidyate|| mahiṣādyāḥ sudurjeyā devyā ye vinipatitāḥ|| 32.47 || teṣāmatibalo hyeṣa tvayā viṣṇo vinirjitaḥ|| tārakāmayasaṃgrāme vadhyastesau janārdana|| 32.48 || kaṃsarūpaḥ punaste'yaṃ haṃtavyo'ṣṭamajanmani|| evaṃ praśaṃsamānāste vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum|| 32.49 || śastrajālairlabdhasaṃjñāndaityasainyānanāśayat|| tāni daityaśarīrāṇi jarjarāṇi mahāyudhaiḥ|| 32.50 || apatanbhūtale pārtha cchinnābhrāṇīva sarvaśaḥ|| tatastaddānavaṃ sainyaṃ hatanāthamabhūttadā|| 32.51 || devaiḥ skaṃdānugaiścaiva kṛtaṃ śastraiḥ parāṅmukham|| atho kruṣṭaṃ tadā hṛṣṭaiḥ sarvairdevairmudāyutaiḥ|| 32.52 || saṃhatāni ca sarvāṇi tadā tūryāṇyavādayan|| atha bhagnaṃ balaṃ prekṣya hatavīraṃ mahāraṇe|| 32.53 || devānāṃ ca mahāmodaṃ tārakaḥ prāha sārathim|| sārathe paśya sainyāni drāvyamāṇāni me suraiḥ|| 32.54 || yesmābhistṛṇavaddṛṣṭāḥ paśya kālasya citratām|| tanme vāhaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ rathamenaṃ surānprati|| 32.55 || paśyaṃtu me balaṃ bāhvordravaṃtu ca surādhamāḥ|| bruvannevaṃ sārathiṃ sa vidhunvansumahaddhanuḥ|| 32.56 || krodha raktekṣaṇo rājā devasainyaṃ samāviśat|| āgacchamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā hariḥ skaṃdamathābravīt|| 32.57 || kumāra paśya daityeṃdraṃ kālaṃ yadvadyugātyaye|| ayaṃ sa yena tapasā ghoreṇārādhitaḥ śivaḥ|| 32.58 || ayaṃ sa yena śakrādyāḥ kṛtā markāḥ samārbudam|| ayaṃ sa sarvaśastraigairyo'smābhirna jito raṇe|| 32.59 || nāvajñayā pradraṣṭavyastārako'yaṃ mahāsuraḥ|| saptamaṃ hi dinaṃ te'dya madhyāhno'yaṃ ca vartate|| 32.60 || arvāgastamanādenaṃ jahi vadhyo'nyathā nahi|| evamuktvā sa śakrādīṃstvaritaḥ keśavo'bravīt|| 32.61 || āyāsayata daityeṃdraṃ sukhavadhyo yathā bhavet|| tataste viṣṇuvacanādvinadanto divaukasaḥ|| 32.62 || tamāsādya śaravrātairmuditāḥ samavākiran|| prahasanniva devāṃstāndrāvayāmāsa tārakaḥ|| 32.63 || yathā nāstikadurvṛtto nānāśāstropadeśakān|| soḍhuṃ śaktā na te vīraṃ mahati syaṃdane sthitam|| 32.64 || mahāpasmārasaṃkrāṃtaṃ yathaivāpriyavādinam|| vidhūya sakalāndevānkṣaṇamātreṇa tārakaḥ|| 32.65 || ājagāma kumārāya vidhuvansa mahādhanuḥ|| āgacchamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā skaṃdaḥ pratyudyayau tataḥ|| 32.66 || tasyārakṣadbhavaḥ pārśvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ caiva taṃ hariḥ|| pṛṣṭhe ca pārṣadāstasya koṭiśo'rbadaśastathā|| 32.67 || tatastau sumahāyuddhe saṃsaktau devadaityayauḥ|| dharmādharmāvivodagrau jagadāścaryakārakau|| 32.68 || tataḥ kumāramāsādya līlayā tārako'bravīt|| aho bālātibālastvaṃ yattvaṃ gīrvāṇavākyataḥ|| 32.69 || āsādayasi māṃ yuddhe pataṃga iva pāvakam|| vadhena tava ko lābho mama mukto'si bālaka|| 32.70 || piṣa kṣīraṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ kaṃdukaṃ krīḍa līlayā|| evamuktaḥ prahasyāha tārakaṃ yogināṃ guruḥ|| 32.71 || śiśutvaṃ māvamaṃsthā me śiśuḥ kaṣṭo bhujaṃgamaḥ|| duṣprekṣyo bhāskaro bālo duḥsparśo'lpo'pi pāvakaḥ|| 32.72 || alpākṣaro na maṃtraḥ kiṃ sasphuro daitya dṛśyate|| evamuktvā daityamuktaṃ gṛhītvā kaṃdukaṃ ca tam|| 32.73 || tasmiñchaktyastramādāya daityāya pramumoca ha|| tasya tena prahārema rathaścūrṇikṛto'bhavat|| 32.74 || caturyojanamātro yo nānāścaryasamanvitaḥ|| garuḍasya sutā ye ca śīryamāṇe rathottame|| 32.75 || muktāḥ kathaṃcidutpatya sāgarāṃtaramāviśan|| tataḥ kruddhastārakaśca mudgaraṃ kṣiptavānguhe|| 32.76 || viṃdhyādrimiva taṃ skaṃdo gṛhītvā taṃ vyatāḍayat|| sthire tasyorasi vyūḍhe mudgaraḥ śatadhā'gamat|| 32.77 || mene ca durjayaṃ daityastadā ṣaḍvadanaṃ raṇe|| ciṃtayāmāsa buddhyā ca prāptaṃ tadbrahmaṇo vacaḥ|| 32.78 || taṃ bhītamiva cālakṣya daityavīrāśca koṭiśaḥ|| nadaṃto'timahāsenaṃ nānāśastrairavākiran|| 32.79 || kruddhasteṣu tataḥ skaṃdaḥ śaktiṃ ghorāmathādade|| abhyasyamāne śaktyastre skaṃdanāmitatejasā|| 32.80 || ulkājālaṃ mahāghoraṃ papāta vasudhātale|| cālyamānā tathā śaktiḥ sughorā bhavasūnunā|| 32.81 || tataḥ koṭyo viniṣpetuḥ śaktīnāṃ bhartarṣabha|| sa śaktyastreṇa balavānkarasthenāhanatprabhuḥ|| 32.82 || aṣṭau padmāni daitvānāṃ daśakoṭiśatāni ca|| tathā niyutasāhasraṃ vāhanaṃ koṭireva ca|| 32.83 || hraṃdodaraṃ ca daityeṃdraṃ nikharvairdaśabhirvṛtam|| tatrākurvansutumulaṃ nādaṃ vadhyeṣu śatruṣu|| 32.84 || kumārānucarāḥ pārtha pūrayaṃto diśo daśa|| śaktyastrasyārciḥ saṃbhūtaśaktibhiḥ ke'pi sūditāḥ|| 32.85 || patākayāvadhūtāśca hatāḥ kecitsahasraśaḥ|| keciddhaṃṭāravatrastāśchinnabhinnahṛdo'patan|| 32.86 || kecinmayūrapakṣābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca sūditāḥ|| koṭiśastāmracūḍena vidāryaiva ca bhakṣitāḥ|| 32.87 || pārṣadairmātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ padmaśo nihatāḥ pare|| evaṃ nihanyamāneṣu dānaveṣu guhādibhiḥ|| 32.88 || abhāgyairiva lokeṣu tārakaḥ skaṃdamāyayau|| jagrāha ca gadāṃ divyāṃ lakṣaghaṃṭādurāsadām|| 32.89 || tayā mayūramājaghne mayūro vimukho'bhavat|| dṛṣṭvā parāṅmukhaṃ lokeṣu vāsudevo'bravīttvaran|| 32.90 || devasenāpate śīghraṃ śaktiṃ muṃca mahāsure|| pratijñāmātmanaḥ pāhi laṃbate ravimaṃḍalam|| 32.91 || ||skaṃda uvāca|| tvayaiva rudrabhakto'yaṃ janārdana mameritam|| vadhārthaṃ rudrabhaktasya bāhuḥ śaktiṃ muṃcati|| 32.92 || nārudraḥ pūjayedrudraṃ bhaktarūpasya yo haraḥ|| rudrarūpamamuṃ hatvā kīdṛśaṃ janmano bhavet|| 32.93 || tiraskṛtā vipralabdhāḥ śaptāḥ kṣiptāḥ prapīḍitāḥ|| rudrabhaktāḥ kulaṃ sarvaṃ nirdahaṃti hatāḥ kimu|| 32.94 || eṣa ceddhaṃti tadbhadraṃ hanyatāmeṣa māṃ raṇe|| rudrabhakte punarviṣṇo nāhaṃ śastramupādade|| 32.95 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca|| naitattavocitaṃ skaṃda rudrabhakto yathā śrṛṇu|| dve tanū girijābharturvedajñā munayo viduḥ|| 32.96 || ekā jīvātmikā tatra pratyakṣā ca tathāparā|| drogdhā bhūteṣu bhaktaśca rudrabhakto na sa smṛtaḥ|| 32.97 || bhakto rudro kṛpāvāṃśca jaṃtuṣveva haravrataḥ|| tadenaṃ bhūtamartyeṣu drogdhāraṃ tvaṃ pinākinaḥ|| 32.98 || jahi naivātra paśyāmi doṣaṃ kaṃcana te prabho|| śrutveti vācaṃ goviṃdātsatyārthāmapi bhārata|| 32.99 || haṃtuṃ na kurute buddhiṃ rudrabhakta iti smaran|| tārakastu tataḥ kruddho yayau vegena keśavam|| 32.100 || prāha caivaṃ sudurbuddhe hanmi tvāṃ paśya me balam|| devānāṃ cāpi dharmāṇāṃ mūlaṃ matimatāṃ tathā|| hatvā tvāmadya sarvāṃstāṃśchetsye paśyādya me balam|| 32.101 || ||viṣṇuruvāca|| daityeṃdra tava cāsmābhiḥ kimaho śrṛṇu satyatām|| 32.102 || rathe ya eṣa śarvo'yaṃ hate'sminsakalaṃ hatam|| śrutveti tārakaḥ kruddhastūrṇaṃ rudrarathaṃ yayau|| 32.103 || abhisṛtya sa jagrāha rudrasya rathakūbaram|| yadā sa kūbaraṃ kruddhastārakaḥ sahasā'grahīt|| 32.104 || resatū rodasī tūrṇaṃ mumuhuśca maharṣayaḥ|| vyanadaṃśca mahākāyā daityā jaladharopamāḥ|| 32.105 || āsīcca niścitaṃ teṣāṃ jitamasmābhirityuta|| tāra kasyāpyabhiprāyaṃ bhagavānvīkṣya śaṃkaraḥ|| 32.106 || umayā saha saṃtyaktvā rathaṃ vṛṣabhamāvahat|| omityatha japanbrahmā ākāśaṃ sahasāśritaḥ|| 32.107 || tatastaṃ śatasiṃhaṃ ca rathaṃ rudreṇa nirmitam|| utkṣipya pṛthvyāmāsphoṭya cūrṇayāmāsa tārakaḥ|| 32.108 || śūlapāśupatādīni sahasopasthitāni ca|| vārayāmāsa giriśo bhavaḥ sādhya iti bruvan|| 32.109 || tataḥ svavaṃcitaṃ jñātvā rudreṇātmānamīrṣyayā|| vinadansahasā'dhāvadvṛṣabhasthaṃ maheśvaram|| 32.110 || tato janārdano'dhāvaccakramudyamya vegataḥ|| vajramiṃdrastathodyamya daṃḍaṃ cāpi yamo nadan|| 32.111 || gadāṃ dhaneśvaraḥ kruddhaḥ pāśaṃ ca varuṇo nadan vāyurmahāṃkuśaṃ ghoraṃ śaktiṃ vahnirmahāprabhām|| 32.112 || nirṛtirniśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rudrāḥ śūlāni kopitāḥ|| dhanūṃṣi sādhyā devāśca parighānvasavastathā|| 32.113 || viśvedevāśca musalaṃ caṃdrārkau svaprabhāmapi|| oṣadhīścāśvinau devau nāgāśca jvalitaṃ viṣam|| 32.114 || himādri pramukhāścāpi samudyamya mahīdharān|| bhṛśamunnadato devāndhāvato vīkṣya tārakaḥ|| 32.115 || nivṛttaḥ sahasā pārtha mahāgaja ivonnadan|| sa vajramuṣṭi nāhatya bhuje śakramapātayat|| 32.116 || daṃḍaṃ yamādupādāya mūrdhnyāhatya nyapātayat|| urasāhatya sagadaṃ dhanadaṃ bhuvyapātayat|| 32.117 || varuṇātpāśamādāya tena baddhā nyapātayat|| mahāṃkuśena vāyuṃ ca ciraṃ mūrdhni jaghāna saḥ|| 32.118 || phūlkārairuddhataṃ vahniṃ śamayāmāsa tārakaḥ|| nirṛtiṃkhaḍgamādāya hatvā tena nyapātayat|| 32.119 || śūlaireva tathā rudrāḥ sādhyāśca dhanuṣārditāḥ|| parighaireva vasavo muśalaireva viśvakāḥ|| 32.120 || reṇunācchādya caṃdrārkau valmīkasthāvivekṣitau|| mahogrāścauṣadhīstālairaśvibhyāṃ so'bhyavartayat|| 32.121 || saviṣāśca kṛtā nāgā nirviṣāḥ pādakuṭṭanaiḥ|| parvatāḥ parvataireva nirucchvāsā bhṛśaṃ kṛtāḥ|| 32.122 || evaṃ taddevasainyaṃ ca hāhābhūtamacetanam|| kṛtvā muhūrtādādhāvaccakrapāṇiṃ tamunnadan|| 32.123 || tataścāṃtardadhe sadyaḥ prahasanniva keśavaḥ|| kuyogina iva svāmī sadā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ|| 32.124 || apaśyaṃstārako viṣṇuṃ punarvṛṣabhavā hanam|| ādhāvatkupito daityo muṣṭimudyamya vegataḥ|| 32.125 || acirāṃśurivālakṣyo lakṣyotha bhagavānhariḥ|| ābabhāṣe tato devānbāhumudyamyacoccakaiḥ|| 32.126 || palāyadhvamaho devāḥ śaktiścedvaḥ palāyitum|| vimūḍhā hi vayaṃ sarve ye bālavacasāgatāḥ|| 32.127 || kiṃ na śrutaḥ purā gītaḥ ślokaḥ svāyaṃbhuvena yaḥ|| yathā bāleṣu nikṣiptāḥ strīṣu ṣaṃḍitakeṣu ca|| apasmārīṣu caivāpi sarve te saṃśayaṃ gatāḥ|| 32.128 || pratyakṣaṃ tadidaṃ sarvamādhunā cātra dṛsyate|| 32.129 || ajñāsiṣma puraivaitadrudrabhaktaṃ na haṃtyasau|| yatpratijñāṃ nākariṣyanna syānnaḥ kadanaṃ mahat|| 32.130 || athaiṣa yadi daityeṃdraṃ na nihaṃti kubuddhimān|| mā bhayaṃ vo mahābhāgā nihaniṣyāmi vo ripūn|| 32.131 || adya me vipulaṃ bāhvorbalaṃ paśyata daityādhamaṃ nāśayāmi muṣṭinaikena paśyata 32.132 || mayā hi dakṣiṇo bāhurdattaśca bhavatāṃ sadā|| ripūnvā nihaniṣyāmi satyaṃ tatparipālaye|| 32.133 || yeṃ'bare ye ca pātāle bhuvi ye ca mahāsurāḥ|| kṣaṇāttānnāsayiṣyāmi mahāvāto ghanāniva|| 32.134 || evamuktā jagannātho muṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam|| nirāyudhastārkṣyapṛṣṭhādavaplutyābhyadhāvata|| 32.135 || tasmindhāvati goviṃde cacāla bhuvanatrayam|| vimūrchitamabhūdviśvaṃ devā bhītiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ|| 32.136 || dhāvataścāpi kalpāṃtaṃ rudrakalpasya tasya yāḥ|| mukhātsamudyajurjvālāstābiḥ kharvaśataṃ hatam|| 32.137 || tatoṃ'tarikṣe vācaśca procuḥ siddhāḥ svayaṃ tadā|| jahi kopaṃ vāsudeva tvayi kruddhe kva vai jagat|| 32.138 || anādṛtyeva tadvākyaṃ bruvannānyatkaromyaham|| āhvayaṃśca mahādaityaṃ kruddho hariradhāvata|| 32.139 || uvāca vācaṃ sādhūṃśca yatnātpālayatāṃ phalam|| duṣṭānvinighnatāṃ caiva tatphalaṃ mama jāyatām|| 32.140 || athāpaśyanmahāseno rudraṃ yāṃtaṃ ca tārakam|| tārakaṃ cānvadhāvantaṃ purāmapuruṣaṃ harim|| 32.141 || jagacca kṣubdhamatyarthaṃ svāṃ pratijñāṃ purā kṛtām|| paścimāṃ pratilaṃbaṃtaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāpi lohitam|| 32.142 || ākāśavāṇīṃ śrṛṇvaṃśca kiṃ skanda tvaṃ viṣīdasī|| paścāttāpo yadi bhavetkṛtvā brahmavadhaṃ tvayi|| 32.143 || sthāpayerligamīśasya mokṣo hatyāśatairapi|| āviveśa mahākrodhaṃ didhakṣuriva medinīm|| 32.144 || athotplutya mayūrātsa prahasanniva keśavam|| bāhubhyāmapyupādāya provāca bhavanaṃdanaḥ|| 32.145 || jānāmi tvāmahaṃ viṣṇo mahābuddhiparākramam|| bhūtabhavyaviṣyāṃśca daityānhaṃsyapi hūṃkṛtaiḥ|| 32.146 || tvameva haṃtā daityānāṃ devānāṃ paripālakaḥ|| dharmasaṃsthāpakaśca tvameva te racitoṃ'jaliḥ|| 32.147 || kṣaṇārdhaṃ paśya me vīryaṃ bhāskaro lohitāyate|| evaṃ praṇamya skandena vāsudevaḥ prasāditaḥ|| 32.148 || viroṣo'bhūttamāliṃgya vacanaṃ keśavo'bravīt|| sanāthastvadya dharmo'yaṃ surāścaiva tvayā guha|| 32.149 || smarātmānaṃ yadarthaṃ tvamutpanno'si maheśvarāt|| sādhūnāṃ pālanārthāya duṣṭasaṃharaṇāya ca|| suraviprakṛte janma jīvitaṃ ca mahātmanām|| 32.150 || rudrasya devyā gaṃgāyāḥ kṛttikānāṃ ca tejasā|| svāhāvahneśca jātastvaṃ tattejaḥ saphalīkuru|| sādhūnāṃ ca kṛte yasya dhanaṃ vīryaṃ ca saṃpadaḥ|| 32.151 || saphalaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ nānyathā rudranaṃdana|| 32.152 || adya dharmaśca devāśca gāvaḥ sādhyāśca brāhmaṇāḥ|| naṃdaṃtu tava vīryeṇa pradarśaya nijaṃ balam|| 32.153 || ||skanda uvāca|| yā gatiḥ śivatyāgena tvattyāgena ca keśava|| tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyāṃ kṣipraṃ hanmi cenna hi tārakam|| 32.154 || yā gatiḥ śrutityāgena sādhvī bhāryātipīḍanāt|| sādhūnāṃ ca parityāgādvṛthā jīvitasādhanāt|| niṣṭhurasya gatiryā ca tāṃ gatiṃ yāmi keśava|| 32.155 || ityukte sumahānnādaḥ saṃprajajñe divaukasām|| praśaśaṃsurguhaṃ kecitkecinnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum|| 32.156 || tatastārkṣaayaṃ samārudya haristasminmahāraṇe|| tāmracūḍaṃ mahāsena stārakaṃ cāpyadhāvatām|| 32.157 || lohitāṃbarasaṃvīto lohitasragvibhūṣaṇaḥ|| lohitākṣo mahābāhurhiraṇyakavacaḥ prabhuḥ|| 32.158 || bhujena tolayañchaktiṃ sarvabhūtāni kampayan|| prāpya taṃ tārakaṃ prāha mahāseno hasanniva|| 32.159 || tiṣṭhatiṣṭha sudurbuddhe jīvitaṃ te mayi sthitam|| suhṛṣṭaḥ kriyatāṃ loko durlabhaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ|| 32.160 || yatte suniṣṭhuratvaṃ ca dharme deveṣu goṣu ca|| tasya te praharāmyadya smara śastraṃ suśikṣitam|| 32.161 || evamukte guhenātha nivṛttasyāsya bhārata|| tārakasya śirodeśātkāpi nārī viniryayau|| 32.162 || tejasā bhāsayaṃtī tamadha ūrdhvaṃ diśo daśa|| dṛṣṭvā nārīṃ guhaḥ prāha kāsi kasmācca nirgatā|| 32.163 || ||nāryuvāca|| ahaṃ śaktirguhākhyātā bhūtaleṣu sadā sthitā|| anena daityarājena mahatā tapasārjjitā|| 32.164 || sureṣu sarveṣu vasāmi cāhaṃ vipreṣu śāstrārtharateṣu cāham|| sādhvīṣu nārīṣu tathā vasāmi vinā guṇānnāsmi vasāmi kutracit|| 32.165 || tadasya puṇyasaṃghasya saṃprāptodyāvadhirguha|| tadenaṃ tyajya yāsyāmi jahyenaṃ viśvahetave|| 32.166 || tasyāṃ tato nirgatāyāṃ daityaśīrṣaṃ vyakampayat|| kaṃpitaṃ cāsya taddehaṃ gatavīryo'bhavatkṣaṇāt|| 32.167 || etasminnaṃtare śaktiṃ so'kṣipadgirijātmajaḥ|| ulkājvālā vimuñcaṃtīmatisūryāgnisaprabhām|| 32.168 || kalpāṃbhodhisamunnādāṃ didhakṣaṃtīṃ jagadyathā|| tārakasyāṃtakālāya abhāgyasya daśāmiva|| 32.169 || dāraṇīṃ parvatānāṃ ca sarvasattvabalādhikām|| utkṣipya tāṃ vinadyoccairamuñcatkupito guhaḥ|| 32.170 ||
