dharmaścedbalavām̐lloke dharmo jayati cetsadā|| tena satyena daityoyaṃ pralayaṃ yātvitīrayan|| 32.171 || sā kumārabhujotsṛṣṭā durnivāryā durāsadā|| vibheda hṛdayaṃ cāsya bhittvā ca dharaṇiṃ gatā|| 32.172 || niḥsṛtya jalakallolapūrvikā skaṃdamāyayau|| sa ca saṃtāḍitaḥ śaktyā vibhinnahṛdayosuraḥ|| nādayanvasudhāṃ sarvāṃ papātāyomukho mṛtaḥ|| 32.173 || evaṃ pratāpya trailokyaṃ nirjitya bahuśaḥ surān|| mahāraṇe kumāreṇa nihataḥ pārtha tārakaḥ|| 32.174 || etasminnihate daitye praharṣaṃ viśvamāyayau|| 32.175 || vavurvātāstathā puṇyāḥ suprabhobhūddivākaraḥ|| jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtā digjanitasvanāḥ|| 32.176 || tataḥ punaḥ skaṃdamāha prahṛṣṭaḥ keśavo'rihā|| skaṃdaskaṃda mahābāho bāṇonāma balātmajaḥ|| 32.177 || krauṃcaparvatamādāya devasaṃghānprabādhate|| so'dhunā te bhayādvīra palāyitvā nagaṃ gataḥ|| jahi taṃ pāpasaṃkalpaṃ krauṃcasthaṃ śaktivegataḥ|| 32.178 || tataḥ krauṃcaṃ mahātejā nānāvyālavināditam|| śaktyā bibheda bahubhirvṛkṣairjīvaiśca saṃkulam|| 32.179 || tatra vyālasahasrāṇi daityakoṭyayutaṃ tathā|| dadāha bāṇāṃ ca giraṃ bhittvā śaktirmahāravā|| 32.180 || adyāpi chidraṃ tatpārtha krauṃcasya parivartate|| 32.181 || yena haṃsāśca krauṃcāśca mānasāya prayāṃti ca|| hatvā bāṇaṃ mahāśaktiḥ punaḥ skaṃdaṃ samāgatā|| pratyāyāti manaḥ sādhorāhṛtaṃ prahitaṃ tathā|| 32.182 || tato harīṃdrapramukhāḥ pratuṣṭuvurnanṛtuśca raṃbhāpramukhā varāṃganāḥ|| vādyāni sarvāṇi ca vādayaṃtastaṃ sādhusādhvityamarā jagurbhuśam|| 32.183 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māhesvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaramāhātmye kumārakṛtatārakavadhavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 32 || cha ||
<1.2.33>
||nārada uvāca|| tatastaṃ girivarṣmāṇaṃ patitaṃ vasudhopari|| āliṃgitamiva pṛthvyā guṇinyā guṇinaṃ yathā|| 33.1 || dṛṣṭvā devā vismitāste jayaṃ jagustathā muhuḥ|| kecitsamīpamāgaṃtuṃ bibhyati tridivaukasaḥ|| 33.2 || utthāya tārako daityaḥ kadā cinno nihaṃti cet|| taṃ tathā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudhāmaṇḍale guhaḥ|| 33.3 || āsīddīnamanāḥ pārtha śuśoca ca mahāmatiḥ|| stavanaṃ cāpi devānāṃ vārayitvā vaco'bravīt|| 33.4 || śocyaṃ pātakinaṃ māṃ ca saṃstuvadhvaṃ kathaṃ surāḥ|| paṃcānāmapi yo bhartā prākṛto'sau na kīrtyate|| 33.5 || sa tu rudrāṃśajaḥ proktastasya druhyanna rudram̐vat|| svāyaṃbhuvena gītaśca ślokaḥ saṃśrūyate tathā|| 33.6 || vīraṃ hi puruṣaṃ hatvā gosahasreṇa mucyate|| yathākathaṃcitpuruṣo na haṃtavyastato budhaiḥ|| 33.7 || pāpaśīlasya hanane doṣo yadyapi nāsti ca|| tathāpi rudrabhakto'yaṃ saṃsmaranniti śocimi|| 33.8 || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi prāyāścittaṃ ca kiṃcana|| prāyaścittairapaityeno yatopi mahadarjitam|| 33.9 || iti saṃśocatastasya śivaputrasya dhīmataḥ|| vāsudevo guruḥ puṃsāṃ devamadhye vaco'bravīt|| 33.10 || śrutiḥ smṛtiścetihāsāḥ purāṇaṃ ca śivātmaja|| pramāṇaṃ cettato duṣṭavadhe doṣo na vidyate|| 33.11 || svaprāṇānyaḥ paraprāṇaiḥ prapuṣṇātyaghṛṇaḥ pumān|| tadvadhastasya hi śreyo yaddoṣādyātyadhaḥ pumān|| 33.12 || annāde bhrūṇahā mārṣṭi patyau bhāryā pacāriṇī|| gurau śiṣyaśca yājyaśca steno rājani kilbiṣam|| 33.13 || pāpinaṃ puruṣaṃ yo hi samartho na nihaṃti ca|| tasya tāvaṃti pāpāni tadardhaṃ so'pyavāśrute|| 33.14 || pāpino yadi vadhyaṃte naiva pālanasaṃsthitaiḥ|| tato'yamakṣamo lokaḥ kaṃ yāti śaraṇaṃ guha|| 33.15 || kathaṃ yajñāśca vedāśca vartate viśvadhārakāḥ|| tasmāttvayā puṇyamāptaṃ na ca pāpaṃ kathaṃcana|| 33.16 || atha cedrudrabhakteṣu bahumānastava prabho|| tatra te kīrtayiṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ mahottamam|| 33.17 || ājanmasaṃbhavaiḥ pāpaiḥ pumānyena vimucyate|| ākalpāṃta ca vā yena rudraloke pramodate|| 33.18 || kṛte pāpe'nutāpo vai yasya skanda prajāyate|| rudrārādhanato'nyacca prāyaśtittaṃ paraṃ na hi|| 33.19 || na yasyālamapi brahmāmahimānaṃ vivarṇitum|| śrutiśca bhītā yaṃ vakti kiṃ tasmātparamaṃ bhavet|| 33.20 || akāṃḍe yacca brahmāṃḍakṣayodyuktaṃ halāhalam|| kaṇṭhe dadhāra śrīkaṇṭhaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet|| 33.21 || duḥkhatāṃḍavadīno'bhūdaṇḍasaṃkīrṇamānasaḥ|| māramāraśca yo devaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet|| 33.22 || viyadvyāpī surasaritpravāho vipruṣākṛtiḥ|| babhūva yasya śirasi kastasmātparamo bhavet|| 33.23 || yajñādikāśca ye dharmā vinā yasyārcanaṃ vṛthā|| dakṣo'tra satyadṛṣṭāṃtaḥ kastasmātparamo bhavet|| 33.24 || kṣoṇī ratho vidhiryaṃtā śaro'haṃ mandaro dhanuḥ|| rathāṃge cāpi caṃdrārkau yuddhe yasya ca traipure|| 33.25 || ārādhanaṃ tasya kecidyogamārgeṇa kurvate|| duḥkhasādhyaṃ hi tatteṣāṃ nityaṃ śūnyapāsatām|| 33.26 || tasmāttasyārcayelliṃgaṃ bhuktimuktī ya icchati|| sṛṣṭyādau liṃgarūpī sa vivādo mama brahmaṇaḥ|| 33.27 || abhūdyasya paricchede nālamāvāṃ babhūviva|| carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ yato līnaṃ sadātra ca|| 33.28 || tasmālliṃgamiti proktaṃ devai rudrasya dhīmataḥ|| toyena snāpayelliṃgaṃ śraddhayā śucinā ca yaḥ|| 33.29 || brahmāditṛṇaparyaṃtaṃ tenedaṃ tarpitaṃ jagat|| paṃcāmṛtena talliṃgaṃ snāpayedyaśca buddhimān|| 33.30 || tarpitaṃ tena viśvaṃ syātsudhayā pitṛbhiḥ samam|| puṣpairabhyarcayelliṃgaṃ yathākālodbhavaiścayaḥ|| 33.31 || tena saṃpūjitaṃ viśvaṃ sakalaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| naivedyaṃ tatra yo dadyālliṃgasyāgre vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 33.32 || bhojitaṃ tena viśvaṃ syālliṃgasyaivaṃ phalaṃ mahat|| kimatra bahunoktena svalpaṃ vā yadi va bahu|| 33.33 || liṃgasya kriyate yacca tatsarvaṃ viśvaprītidam|| tacca ligaṃ sthāpayedyaḥ śucau deśe subhaktitaḥ|| 33.34 || sa sarvapāpanirmukto rudraloke pramodate|| yannityaṃ yajato yajñaiḥ phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ|| 33.35 || tacca sthāpayato liṃgaṃ śivasya śubhalakṣaṇam|| yathāgniḥ sarvadevānāṃ mukhaṃ skanda prakīrtyate|| 33.36 || tathaiva sarvajagatāṃ mukhaṃ liṃgaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| prāraṃbhānmucyate pāpaiḥ sarvajanmakṛtairapi|| 33.37 || atītaṃ ca tathāgāmi kulānāṃ tārayecchatam|| mṛnmayaṃ kāṣṭhaniṣpannaṃ pakveṣṭaṃ śailameva ca|| 33.38 || kṛtamāyatanaṃ dadyātkramācchataguṇaṃ phalam|| kalaśaṃ tatra cāropya ekaviṃśatkulairyutaḥ|| 33.39 || ākalpāṃtaṃ rudraloke modate rudravatsukhī|| evaṃvidhaphalaṃ liṃgamato bhūyo'pyadho na hi|| 33.40 || tasmādatra mahāsena liṃgaṃ sthāpitumarhasi|| yaduktametadaślīlaṃ yadi kiṃcana cātra cet|| 33.41 || tadbravītu mahā sena svayaṃ sākṣī maheśvaraḥ|| evaṃ vadati goviṃde sādhuvādo mahānabhūt|| 33.42 || mahādevo hyathāliṃgya skandaṃ vacanabravīt|| yadbhavānmama bhakteṣu prakaroti kṛpāṃ parām|| 33.43 || tenāpi paramā prītirmama jātā tavopari|| kiṃ tu yadbhagavānāha vāsudevo jagadguruḥ|| 33.44 || tattthā nānyathā kiṃcidatra proktaṃ hi viṣṇunā|| yo hyahaṃ sa harirjñeyo yo hariḥ so'hamityutā|| 33.45 || nāvayoraṃtaraṃ kiṃciddīpayoriva suvrata|| enaṃ dveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭiyonvetyenaṃ sa mā'nugaḥ|| 33.46 || iti skanda vijānāti sa madbhaktonyathā na hi|| 33.47 || ||skanda uvāca|| evamevāsmi jānāmi tvāṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca śaṃkara|| 33.48 || yacca liṃgakṛte prāha harirmāṃ dharmavatsalaḥ|| khe vāṇī tārakavadhe evameva purāha mām|| 33.49 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi sarvapāpā pahaṃ tataḥ|| ekaṃ yatra pratijñā me gṛhītāsya vadhāya ca|| 33.50 || dvitīyaṃ yatra niḥsattvasatyaktaḥ śaktyā'suro'bhavat|| tṛtīyaṃ yatra nihato hatyā pāpopaśāṃtidam|| 33.51 || ityuktvā viśvakarmāṇamāhūya prāha pāvakiḥ|| trīṇi liṃgāni śuddhāni śīghraṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi|| 33.52 || vacanādbāhuleyasya nirmame devavarddhakiḥ|| trīṇi liṃgāni śuddhāni nyavedayata tāni ca|| 33.53 || tato brahmādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca|| pūrvaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa paścimāyāmadūrataḥ|| 33.54 || pratijñeśvaramityeva liṃgaṃ paramaśobhanam|| aṣṭamyāṃ bahule cātra caitre snātvā upoṣya ca|| 33.55 || pūjāṃ ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā mucyetpāruṣyapāpataḥ|| ityāha skaṃdaprītyarthaṃ svayaṃ tatra maheśvaraḥ|| 33.56 || tato dvitīyaṃ liṃgaṃ tu vahnikoṇāśritaṃ tathā|| sthāpayāmāsa saraso yatra śaktirviniryayau|| 33.57 || kapāleśvaramityeva liṃgaṃ pāpāpahaṃ śubham|| śaktiṃ ca tāmabhiṣṭūya sthāpayāmāsa tatra ca|| 33.58 || kapāleśvarasāṃnidhyaṃ devīṃ kāpālikeśvarīm|| tatra cottaradigbhāge śakticchidraṃ pracakṣate|| 33.59 || pātālagaṃgā yatrāstiṃ sarvapāpaharā śivā|| tatra snātvā dadau skaṃdaḥ kṛpayābhipariplutaḥ|| 33.60 || tadā toyaṃ tārakāya sahitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ|| 33.61 || kāśyapeyāya vajrāṃgatanayāya mahātmane|| rudrabhaktāya satilamakṣayyodakamastviti|| 33.62 || tato maheśvaraḥ prītaḥ prāha skaṃdasya śrṛṇvataḥ|| caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe madhau caivātra yo naraḥ|| snātvopoṣya samabhyarcya kapāleśvaramīśvarīm|| 33.63 || tejovadhasamudbhūtapātakena sa mucyate|| 33.64 || asyāmeva tithau somaḥ śivayogaśca taitilam|| ṣaḍyogaḥ śakticchidreyo dinaṃ rudraṃ japanniśi|| snātvātra saśarīro vai rudralokaṃ vrajīṣyati|| 33.65 || kapāleśasya sāṃnidhye śakticchidraṃ hi kīrtyate|| tasya tulyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ naiva vidyate|| 33.66 || iti śrutvā rudravākyaṃ skaṃdaḥ prīto'bhavadbhṛśam|| devāśca muditāḥ sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ|| 33.67 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumārasthāpitajñeśvaraśakticcidreśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo.dhyāyaḥ|| 33 || cha ||
<1.2.34>
||nārada uvāca|| tatastṛtīyaliṃgasya cikīrṣu sthāpanaṃ guham|| brahmā prāhāsya prītyarthaṃ svayamanyaṃ prakurmahe|| 34.1 || yadyapyetacchubhaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitam|| tathāpyanyatkariṣye'haṃ sarvaśreṣṭhatamaṃ hi yat|| 34.2 || tato brahmā sarvadoṣavimuktaṃ nirmame svayam|| dṛṣṭikāṃtaṃ manaḥkāṃtaṃ phalakāṃtaṃ suliṃgakam|| 34.3 || tatra skaṃdasya prītyarthaṃ sarvadevairninirmitam|| saraḥ suramyaṃ tīrthāni tatra te nidadhustathā|| 34.4 || gaṃgādikāni tīrthāni yāni procurdivaukasaḥ|| idaṃ yāvatsarastāvatsarvairatra samuṣyatām|| 34.5 || evamastviti tānyūcuḥ prītyarthaṃ śarajanmanaḥ|| tato brahmā svayaṃ tatra raudrairmaṃtrairhutāśanam|| gādhiputrādibhirvipraistarpayāmāsa saṃyutaḥ|| 34.6 || tato vaiśākhamāsasya caturddaśyāṃ śubhe dine|| pratiṣṭhāṃ cakrire liṃge ciraṃ vipramukā dvijāḥ|| 34.7 || jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ|| tataḥ skaṃdaḥ prītiyuktaḥ snātvā sarasi śobhane|| 34.8 || sarvatīrthodakaiḥ snāpya talliṃgaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ|| vividhaiḥ pūjayāmāsa puṣpairmaṃtraiśca paṃcabhiḥ|| 34.9 || pūjākāle svayaṃ tatra liṃgamadhyesthito haraḥ|| jaṃgamā jaṃgamaiḥ sārdhaṃ svayaṃ jagrāha pūjanam|| 34.10 || tatastaṃ pūjayanprāha skaṃdo bhaktipariplutaḥ|| kena kenopahāreṇa tvayi dattena kiṃ phalam|| 34.11 || ||śrīmahādeva uvāca|| mama yaḥ sthāpayelliṃgaṃ śubhaṃ sadma ca kārayet|| malloke vasate'sau ca vāvaccaṃdradivākarau|| 34.12 || mama sadma sudhāśubhraṃ yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ karoti yaḥ|| tāvaṃtyeva ca janmāni yaśasāsau virājate|| 34.13 || dhvajabhūto dhvajaṃ dattvā vipāpaḥ syātpatākayā|| vidhāya citravinyāsa gaṃdharvaiḥ saha modate|| 34.14 || rajaḥsaṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā naro rogaiḥ pramucyate|| prāpnoti dehaṃ hārdaṃ ca surasadmānulepanāt|| 34.15 || puṣpakṣīrādi bhirdattaistilābho'kṣatadarbhakaiḥ|| śaṃbhoḥ śirasi dattvārghya divi varṣāyutaṃ vaset|| 34.16 || ghṛtena hatapāpaḥ syānmadhunā subhago bhavet|| virogo dadhidugdhābhyāṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsnāpya jāyate|| 34.17 || pānīyadadhidugdhādyaiḥ kramāddaśaguṇaṃ phalam|| māsaṃ saṃsnāpya vai bhaktyā piṣṭādyaiśca virūkṣayet|| 34.18 || kapilāpaṃcagavyena surasiṃdhujalena vā|| māṃ ca saṃsnāpya cābhyacca mallokamadhigacchati|| 34.19 || kuśodakādgaṃdhajalaṃ tasmāttīrthodakaṃ varam|| tīrthebhyaśca jalaṃ darśe mahīsāgarasaṃbhavam|| 34.20 || kapilāṃ dattvā yadāpnoti tatphalaṃ kalaśe pṛthak|| mṛttāmraraupyasauvarṇaiḥ kramācchataguṇaṃ phalam|| 34.21 || śrīkhaṃḍāgarukāśmīraśaśinaḥ kramaśo'dhikāḥ|| māṃ ca taiśca samālabhya syācchrīmānsubhagaḥ sukhī|| 34.22 || praśasto guglulo dhūpastasmāccaṃdro'garurvaraḥ|| dhūpānetānnaro dattvā sukhaṃ svargamavāpnuyāt|| 34.23 || dīpadaḥ kīrtimāpnoti cakṣuruttamameva ca|| naivedyasya pradānena naro mṛṣṭāśano bhavet|| 34.24 || puṣpeṇa hemakarṇasya prabaddhena dvisaṃguṇam|| phalamāpnoti puruṣaḥ satyasaṃdhaśca jāyate|| 34.25 || akhaṃḍairbilvapatraiśca puṣpairvā vividhairapi|| liṃgaṃ prapūraṇaṃ kṛtvā lakṣmekaṃ vaseddivi|| 34.26 || yastu puṣpagṛhaṃ kuryānnaraḥ śuddhāśayo bhavet|| puṣpakeṇa vimānena divi saṃkrīḍate ciram|| 34.27 || bhūṣaṇāṃbaradānena naro bhavati bhogabhāk|| saccāmarapradānena jāyate pārthivo naraḥ|| 34.28 || ramyaṃ vitānaṃ yo dadyācchatrubhirnābhūyate|| gītaṃ vādyaṃ pranṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā śuddho vrajetsa mām|| 34.29 || śaṃkhaghaṃṭāpradānena vidvānbhavati śabdavān|| vidhāya rathayātrāṃ ca ciraṃ śokaiḥ pramucyate|| 34.30 || namaskāraṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvā jāyenmahākule|| vācayaṃścāgrataḥ śāstraṃ mama jñānī prajāyate|| 34.31 || vimucyate manomohairbhaktyā stutvā ca māṃ naraḥ|| godānaphalamāpnoti nirmālyaspheṭanānmama|| 34.32 || ārārtikaṃ bhrāmayitvā artihīnaḥ prajāyate|| kṛtvā śītalikāṃ tāpairmucyate doṣa saṃbhavaiḥ|| 34.33 || natvā dattvātha śaktyā ca dānaṃ liṃgasya saṃnidhau|| phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ prāpya iha cāmutra modate|| 34.34 || praṇāmātpaṃcadaśa ca snānādviṃśatiṃ pūjayā|| śataṃ yathāproktavidheraparādhānahaṃ kṣame|| 34.35 || etatsarvaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ kumārātra bhaviṣyati|| ye māṃ prapūjayiṣyaṃti kumāreśvara saṃsthitam|| 34.36 || vārāṇasyāṃ yathā vatsa viśvanātho'smi saṃsthitaḥ|| 34.37 || guptakṣetre tathā sthāsye kumāreśvaramadhyataḥ|| 34.38 || śrutveti vacanaṃ rudrāddevānāṃ śrṛṇvatāṃ guhaḥ|| vismitaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ tuṣṭāva girijāpatim|| 34.39 || namaḥ śivāyāstu nirāmayāya namaḥ śivāyāstu manomayāya|| namaḥ śivāyāstu surārcitāya tubhyaṃ sadā bhaktakṛpāparāya|| 34.40 || namo bhavāyāstu bhavodbhavāya namostu te dhvastamanobhavāya|| namo'stu te gūḍhamahāvratāya namo'stu māyagahanāśrayāya|| 34.41 || namostu śarvāya namaḥ śivāya namostu siddhāya purātanāya|| namostu kālāya namaḥ kalāya namo'stu te kālakalātigāya|| 34.42 || namo nisargātmakabhūtikāya namo'stvameyokṣamaharddhikāya|| namaḥ śaraṇyāya namo'guṇāya namo'stu te bhīmaguṇānugāya || 34.43 || namo'stu nānābhuvanādhikartre namo'stu bhaktābhimatapradātre|| namo'stu karmaprasāvāya dhātre namaḥ sadā te bhagavansukartre|| 34.44 || anaṃtarūpāya sadaiva tubhyamasahyakopāya sadaiva tubhyam|| ameyamānāya namostu tubhyaṃ vṛṣeṃdrayānāya namo'stu tubhyam|| 34.45 || namaḥ prasiddhāya mahauṣadhāya namo'stu te vyādhigaṇāpahāya|| carācarāyātha vicāradāya kumāranāthāya namaḥ śivāya|| 34.46 || mameśa bhūteśa maheśvarosi kāmeśa vāgīśa baleśa dhīśa|| krodheśa moheśa parāpareśa namostu mokṣeśa guhaśayeśa|| 34.47 || iti saṃstūya varadaṃ śūlapāṇimumāpatim|| praṇipatya umāputro namonama uvāca ha|| 34.48 || evaṃ bhaktiparākrāṃtamātmayogyaṃ stavaṃ śivaḥ|| abhinandya ciraṃ kālamidaṃ vacanamabravīt|| 34.49 || tvayā duḥkhaṃ na saṃciṃtyaṃ mama bhaktavadhātmakam|| karmaṇānena ślāghyo'si munīnāmapi putraka|| 34.50 || ye ca sāyaṃ tathā prātastvatkṛtena stavena mām|| stoṣyaṃti parayā bhaktyā śruṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam|| 34.51 || na vyādhirna ca dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam|| bhuktvā bhogāndurlabhāṃśca mama yāsyaṃti sadma te|| 34.52 || tathānyānapi dāsyāmi varānparamadurlabhān|| bhaktyā tavātituṣṭo'haṃ prītyarthaṃ tava putraka|| 34.53 || mahīsā garakūle tu ye māṃ stoṣyaṃti pūjayā|| teṣāṃ datakṣayaṃ sarvaṃ vaiśākhyāṃ dānapūjanam|| 34.54 || sarasyatra ca ye snānaṃ prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ|| sarvatīrthaphalā vāptirvaiśākhyāṃ prabhaviṣyati|| 34.55 || kumāreśaṃ tu māṃ bhaktyā mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| snātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ tasya jātismṛtirbhavet|| 34.56 || jātismṛtiriyaṃ putra yasyāṃ jātau prajāyate|| smarate'syāḥ prakartavyaṃ śreyorūpaṃ sudurlabham|| 34.57 || yasminkāle hyanāvṛṣṭirjāyate kṛttikāsuta|| snāpayedvidhivanmāṃ ca kalaśairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| 34.58 || ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ ca sapta vā|| snāpayedgaṃdhatoyena kuṃkumena vilepayet|| 34.59 || karavīrai raktapuṣpairjapāpuṣpaistathaiva ca|| arcayetpuṣpamālābhiḥ paridhāyāruṇavāsasī|| 34.60 || bhojayedbrahṇāṃścaiva tāpasāñchaṃsivavratān|| lakṣahomaṃ prakurvīta śivahomaṃ grahādikam|| 34.61 || bhūmidānaṃ tataḥ kuryāttatto dadyādgavāhnikam|| āghoṣayecchivāṃ śāṃtiṃ rudrajāpyaṃ hi kārayet|| 34.62 || anenaiva vidhānena kṛtena tu dvijottamaiḥ|| āgarbhitāstadā meghā varṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 34.63 || vividhaiḥ pūryate dhānyaḥ śādvalaiśca vasundharā|| ārogyaṃ hi bhaveccaiva jane gopakule tathā|| 34.64 || dharmayukto bhavedrājā paracakrairna pīḍyate|| gṛtena snāpayenmāṃ ca arkakrāṃtau naro'tra yaḥ|| 34.65 || kanyādāna phalaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā|| kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevaṃ tathā paṃcāmṛtena yaḥ|| 34.66 || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ tasyopajāyate|| kumāreśvaratīrtheyaḥ prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti hi|| 34.67 || rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam|| ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ|| 34.68 || paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ saṃkrāṃtau vaidhṛte tathā|| kumāreśaṃ naraḥ snātvā mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 34.69 || bhaktyā yobhyarcayenmāṃ ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śrṛṇu|| yanmahītalatīrtheṣu snāne syāttu mahatphalam||34.70 || yaccarciteṣu liṃgeṣu sarveṣu syātphalaṃ ca tat|| ārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dhanalābhaṃ sukhaṃsutam|| 34.71 || niścitaṃ labhate martyaḥ kumāreśvarasevayā|| brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā yastiṣṭhedatra tāpasaḥ|| 34.72 || paraṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ prāpya yāti layaṃ mayi|| pāpātmanāṃ ca martyānāṃ sadyo'smi phaladarśakaḥ|| 34.73 || divyenāṣṭavidhenātra kośaḥ sādhāraṇo'tra ca|| aghorādyaiḥ paṃcamaṃtraiḥ snāpya liṃgaṃ mahojjavalam|| 34.74 || aghoreṇaiva tattoyaṃ dadyāddivyasya kāraṇe|| pibedetadudīryā prasṛtitrayameva ca|| 34.75 || yadi dharmastathā satyamīśvaro'tra jagattraye|| kośapānātphalaṃ sadyo drakṣyāmyasmi śubhā śubham|| 34.76 || yāsye ceti kulaṃ hanyādgamane ca kuṭumbakam|| darśane ca śubhaṃ pāne hanyāddehaṃ ca mithyayā|| 34.77 || tribhirdinaistribhiḥ pakṣaistribhirmāsaistribhiḥ samaiḥ|| atyugrapuṇyapāpānāṃ mānena phalamaśnute|| 34.78 || ete varāmayā liṃge dattātraṃ sthāpite tvayā|| tava prītyabhivṛddhyarthaṃ brūhi bhūyo'pyumātmaja|| 34.79 || ||skanda uvāca|| kṛtakṛtyo varairdattaistvayā caitairmaheśvara|| namonamo namastestu nātra tyājyaṃ tvayā vibho|| 34.80 || evaṃ praṇamya devaṃ sa mātaraṃ praṇato'bravīt|| tvayāpi mātarnaivātra tyājyaṃ mama priyepsayā|| 34.81 || tvāmapyatra sthāpayiṣye varadā bhava parvati|| 34.82 || ||śrīdevyuvāca|| yatra śarvaḥ svabhāvena tatra tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ suta|| 34.83 || tava bhaktyā viśeṣeṇa sthāsye strīṇāṃ varapradā|| yuddheṣu tavakarmāṇi rudrabhakteṣu te kṛpām|| 34.84 || paśyaṃti putriṇāṃ mukhyā prīṇitā ca bhṛśaṃ tvayā|| garbhakleśaḥ striyo manye sāphalyaṃ bhajate tadā|| 34.85 || suto yadā rudrabhaktaḥ sānaṃdaṃ sadbhirīryate|| bhava tasmātpriyārthāya tiṣṭhāmyatra ṣaḍānana|| 34.86 || strībhirārādhitā dāsye saubhāgyaṃ supatiṃ sutān|| caitre cāpi tṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā śītena vāriṇā|| 34.87 || arcayiṣyaṃti māṃ yāśca puṣpairdhūpairvilepanaiḥ|| dāsyāmi cāṣṭasaubhāgyaṃ yā nārī bhaktitatparā|| 34.88 || pitarau śvaśurau putrānpatiṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadaḥ|| kuṃkumaṃ puṣpaśrīkhaṃḍaṃ tāṃbūlāṃjanamikṣavaḥ|| 34.89 || saptamaṃ lavaṇaṃ proktamaṣṭamaṃ ca sujīrakam|| tolayettulayā vāpi sāṃghriśca tulitā bhavet|| 34.90 || suvarmenātha saugandhyadravyaiḥ śubhaphalairapi|| bhuṃkte vā lavaṇaṃ paścānnāsau vai vidhavā bhavet|| 34.91 || māghe vā kārtike vāpi caitre snātvārcayet mām|| daurbhāgyaduḥkhadāridryairna sā saṃyogamāpnuyāt|| 34.92 || śrutveti girijāvācaṃ sānaṃdaḥ pārvatīsutaḥ|| sthāpayitvā girisutāṃ kapardinamathābravīt|| 34.93 || puṣpairdhūpairmodakaiśca pūrvamabhyarcya tvāṃ prabho|| pujayaṃti kumāreśaṃ teṣāṃ vighnaharo bhava|| 34.94 || ||kapardyuvāca|| bhrātastvayā sthāpite'smim̐lliṃge bhaktāśca ye narāḥ|| na teṣāṃ mama vighnāni mama vāganugāminī|| 34.95 || evamukte vighnarājñā pratīte'sthāpayacca tam|| tasmādasau sadābhyarcyaścaturthyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ|| 34.96 || evaṃ sthāpya kumāreśaṃ labdhvā caitānvarāñchivāt|| manasā kṛtakṛtyaṃ cātmānaṃ mene ṣaḍānanaḥ|| 34.97 || tasthāvaṃśena tatraiva kumāreśvarasaṃnidhau|| atra sthitaṃ kumāraṃ ye paśyanti svāmiyātrimaḥ|| 34.98 || saphalā svāmiyātrā ca teṣāṃ bhavati bhārata|| kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa kārtikeyaṃ samarcayet|| 34.99 || yatphalaṃ svāmiyātrāyāṃ tatphalaṃ samāvāpnuyāt|| evaṃvidhamidaṃ pārtha mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| 34.100 || nimittīkṛtya cātmānaṃ sādhvarthe liṃgamarcitam|| rogābhibhūto rogairvā nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam|| 34.101 || japtvā śucirbrahmacārī māsaṃ mucyeta pātakāt|| etadārādhya saṃjātā rajirāmādayaḥ purā|| 34.102 || śatasaṃkhyābalaṃ rājyaṃ rudraloka ca bhejire|| jāmadagnyastvidaṃ liṃgamārādhya ca samāyutam|| 34.103 || lebhe kuṭhāramujjahne yenārjunabhujānyudhi|| agrato devadevasya jñātvā tīrthe mahāguṇān|| 34.104 || rāmeśvaramiti khyātaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam|| tacca yo'bhyarcayedbhaktyā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati|| 34.105 || prītaḥ syāttasya rāmaśca kumāreśaśca phālguna|| iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ kumāreśasya varṇanam|| 34.106 || kumāreśasya māhātmyaṃ kīrtayedyastadagrataḥ|| ye ca śrṛṇvaṃtyanudinaṃ rudraloke vasaṃti te|| 34.107 || asya liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ śrāddhakāle tu yaḥ paṭhet|| pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 34.108 || asya liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ gurviṇīṃ śrāvayedyadi|| guṇavāñjāyate putraḥ kanyā cāpi pativratā|| 34.109 || etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dharmyaṃ cāhlādakārakam|| paṭhatāṃ cāpi sarvābhīṣṭaphala pradam|| 34.110 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumāreśasthāpanapūrvakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 34 || cha ||
<1.2.35>
||nārada uvāca|| kumāreṇa sthāpito'tra kumāreśastataḥ surāḥ|| praṇamya guhamūcuśca prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭāḥ|| 35.1 || kiṃcidvijñāpayaṣyāmo vayaṃ tvāṃ śrṛṇu tattvataḥ|| pūrvaprasiddha ācāraḥ procyate jayināmayam|| 35.2 || jayaṃti ye raṇe śatrūṃstaiḥ kāryaḥ staṃbhacihnakaḥ|| tasmāttava jayoddyotanimittaṃ staṃmamuttamam|| 35.3 || nakṣipāma vayaṃ yāvattmanujñātumarhasi|| viśvakarmakṛtaṃ yacca tṛtīyaṃ liṃgamuttamam|| 35.4 || tasya staṃbhāgratasataṃ ca saṃsthāpaya śivātmaja|| evamukte suraiḥ skandastatetyāha mahāmanāḥ|| 35.5 || tato hṛṣṭāḥ suragaṇāḥ śakrādyāḥ staṃbhamuttamam|| jāṃbūnadamayaṃ śubhraṃ raṇabhūmau vinikṣipuḥ|| 35.6 || paritaḥ sthaṃḍilaṃ dikṣu sarvaratnamayaṃ tu te|| tatra hṛṣṭāścāpsaraso nanṛturdaśadhā śubhāḥ|| 35.7 || mātaro maṃgalānyasya jaguḥ skandasya naṃditāḥ|| iṃdrādyā nanṛtustatra svayaṃ viṣṇuśca vādakaḥ|| 35.8 || petuḥ khātpuṣpavarṣāṇi devavādyāni sasvanuḥ|| evaṃ staṃbhaṃ samāropya jayākhyaṃ viśvanaṃdakaḥ|| 35.9 || stambheśvarastato devaḥ sthāpitastryakṣasūnunā|| viriṃcipramukhairdevairjātānandaiḥ samaṃ tadā|| 35.10 || hariharādityuktaistaiḥ sendrairmunigaṇairapi|| tasyaiva paścime bhāge śaktyagreṇa mahātmanā|| 35.11 || guhena nirmitaḥ kūpo gaṃgā tatra talodbhavā|| māghasya ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ pitṛtarpaṇam|| 35.12 || kūpe snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā bhaktyā yaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| gayāśrāddhena yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ labhate sphuṭam|| 35.13 || staṃbheśvaraṃ tato devaṃ gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet|| vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya modate rudrasadmāni|| 35.14 || paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā ca yo'bhyarcceṃtstaṃbheśvaramakalmaṣaḥ|| 35.15 || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti tṛptā yacchaṃti cāśiṣaḥ|| sa bhittvā sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate|| 35.16 || ityāha bhagavānrudraḥ skandasya prītaye purā|| evameva caturthaṃ ca sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam|| 35.17 || praṇemurdevatāḥ sarve sādhusādhviti te jaguḥ|| 35.18 || iti skāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe staṃbheśvaramāhātmyavarṇana nāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 35 || cha ||
<1.2.36>
||nārada uvāca|| evaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣitau tāni liṃgāni harasūnunā|| haribrahmeṃdrapramukhā devāḥ procuḥ parasparam|| 36.1 || aho dhanyaḥ kumāro'yaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| yena catvārī liṃgāni stāpitāni sudurlabhe|| 36.2 || vayamapyatra śuddhyarthaṃ toṣārthaṃ skandarudrayoḥ|| sādhvarthe cātmalābhāya kurmo liṃgaparaṃparām|| 36.3 || athavā koṭiśo devā munayo naiva saṃkhyayā|| sarve cetsthāpayiṣyaṃti liṃgānyatra mahītaṭe|| 36.4 || pūjā teṣāṃ kataṃ bhāvi bahutvāccātra paṭhyate|| yasya rāṣṭre rudraliṃgaṃ pūjyate naiva śaktitaḥ|| 36.5 || tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ durbhikṣavyādhitaskaraiḥ|| saṃbhūya sthāpayiṣyāmo liṃgamekaṃ tataḥ śubham|| 36.6 || iti kṛtvā matiṃ sarve prāpyānujñāṃ maheśvarāt|| praharṣitā suhaścaiva haribrahmamukhāḥ surāḥ|| 36.7 || bhūmibhāgaṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya vijane liṃgamuttamam|| sthāpayāmāsuratha te svayaṃ brahmavinirmitam|| 36.8 || siddhārthaiḥ stāpitaṃ yasmā ddevairbrahmādibhiḥ svayam|| siddheśvaramiti prāha nāma liṃgasya vai guhaḥ|| 36.9 || sarvairdevaistatra liṃge khānitaṃ sara uttamam|| sarvatīrthodakaiḥ śubhraiḥ pūritaṃ ca mahātmabhiḥ|| 36.10 || etasminnaṃtare pārtha pātālāccheṣanaṃdanaḥ|| kumudonāma āgatya prāha śeṣāhipannagān|| 36.11 || asmiṃstārakayuddhe tu pralaṃbonāma dānavaḥ|| palāyitvā skaṃdabhītyā pāpaḥ pātālamāviśat|| 36.12 || sa vo vasūni putrāṃśca bhāryāḥ kanyā gṛhāṇi ca|| vidhvaṃsayati nāgeṃdrāḥ śīghraṃ dhāvatadhāvata|| 36.13 || śeṣātmajasya tadvākyaṃ kumadasya niśamyate|| autsukyamāpurnāgeṃdrā yāmayāmeti vādinaḥ|| 36.14 || tānnivārya tataḥ skaṃdaḥ kruddhaḥ śaktimathādade|| pātālāya mumocātha procya daityo nihanyatām|| 36.15 || tataḥ skaṃdabhujotsṛṣṭā bhuvaṃ nirbhidya vegataḥ|| praviṣṭā sahasā śaktiryathā daivaṃ naraṃ prati|| 36.16 || sā taṃ hatvā pralaṃbaṃ ca koṭibhirdaśabhirvṛtam|| naṃdayitvā gatā nāgāñjalakallopūrvikā|| 36.17 || yāṃtyā śaktyā tayā pārtha yatkṛtaṃ vivaraṃ bhuvi|| pātālagaṃgātoyena pūritaṃ pāpahāriṇā|| 36.18 || tasya nāma dadau skaṃdaḥ siddhakūpa iti smṛtaḥ|| kṛṣmāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāmupavāsī naraḥ svayam|| 36.19 || snātvā kūpe'rcayedīśaṃ siddheśvaramananyadhīḥ|| prabhūtabhavasaṃbhūtapāpaṃ tasya vilīyate|| 36.20 || siddhakuṃḍe ca yaḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| sarvakalmaṣanirmukto bhaktiyogyo bhavebhave|| 36.21 || vṛścāpyakṣayastasya tuṣṭo rudro varaṃ dadau|| prayāga vaṭatulyo'yametatsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ|| 36.22 || atrāgatya mahābhāgaḥ kṣāddhaṃ kuryātsubhaktitaḥ|| pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ tacca sarveṣāṃ piṃḍapātanam|| 36.23 || tato brahmādayo devāḥ skaṃdena sahitāstadā|| siddhāṃbikāṃ mahāśaktiṃ prārthayāmāsurīśvarīm|| 36.24 || tvayāviṣṭo hi bhagavānmatsyarūpī janārdanaḥ|| jagaduddhāraṇārthāya cakre karmāmyanekaśaḥ|| 36.25 || iti tāṃ prārthayāmāsuratra tyājyaṃ na te śubhe|| atra sthitāḥ sarva ime kṣetrapālā mahābalāḥ|| 36.26 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ balipuṣpaiśca tvāṃ śubhe|| ye pūjayaṃti te pālyāḥ sarvāpatsu ca yā sadā|| 36.27 || evamuktā siddhamātā tatheti pratyapadyata|| sthāpayāmāsuratha tāṃ liṃgāduttarabhāgataḥ|| 36.28 || tataḥ kṣetrapatīndevāścatuḥṣaṣṭiṃ maheśvaram|| siddheyaṃ nāma kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ nidadhuḥ svayam|| 36.29 || tvāṃ ca ye pūjayiṣyaṃti kāryārabheṣu sarvadā|| varṣe varṣe rājamāṣabalinā ca viśeṣataḥ|| 36.30 || tānasau pālayettuṣṭaḥ pitā lokāniva svakān siddhikṛto devāstatra siddhivināyakam|| 36.31 || kaparditanayaṃ prārthya sthāpayācakrire mudā|| taṃ ca ye pūjayaṃtyatra kāryāraṃbheṣu sarvadā|| 36.32 || teṣāṃ siddhiṃ dadātyeṣa prabalo vighnarāḍbhavaḥ|| yadyatra pūjayedyastu satataṃ siddhasaptakam|| 36.33 || paśyedvā smarate vāpi sarvadoṣairvimucyate|| siddheśvaraḥ siddhavaṭaśca sākṣātsiddhāṃbikā siddhavināyakaśca|| siddheyakṣetrādhipatiśca siddhasarastathā siddhakūpaśca sapta|| 36.34 || atra tuṣṭo dadau rudraḥ surāṇāṃ durlabhānvarān|| vaiśākhamāsasyāṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ siddhakūpake|| 36.35 || snātvā piṃḍānvaṭe kṛtvā pūjayanmāṃ ca siddhabhāk|| sadā yo'bhyarcayenmāṃ ca brahmacārī jiteṃdriyaḥ|| 36.36 || aṣṭāviṣṭakarā nityaṃ bhaveyustasya siddhayaḥ|| maṃtrajāpyaṃ baliṃ homamatra yaḥ kurute naraḥ|| 36.37 || ekacittaḥ śucirbhūtvā so'bhūṣṭāṃ siddhimāpnuyāt|| samāhitamanāścātha siddheśaṃ yastu paśyati|| 36.38 || tasya siddhirbhavatyeva vighnairyadi na hanyate|| siddhāṃbikā mahādevī hyatra saṃnihitāsti yā|| 36.39 || siddhidā sādhakeṃdrāṇāṃ mahāvidyāṃ japaṃti ye|| dhīrebhyo brahmacāribhyaḥ satyacittebhya eva ca|| 36.40 || maṃtrajāpyāddadātyeṣā sarvasiddhīryathopsitāḥ|| pātālasya bilaṃ caitadguhaśaktyā kṛtaṃ mahat|| 36.41 || siddhāṃ bikāprasādena vighnakṣetrapayormama|| pratyakṣaṃ bhavitā yatra nānāścaryāṇi bhūriśaḥ|| 36.42 || atra siddhiṃ prayāsyaṃti koṭiśaḥ puruṣāḥ surāḥ|| vidyādharatvaṃ devatvaṃ gaṃdharvatvaṃ ca nāgatā|| 36.43 || yakṣatvaṃ cāmaratvaṃ ca prāpsyaṃtyatra ca sādhakāḥ|| atra vai vijayonāma sthaṃḍilasya prabhāvataḥ|| 36.44 || siddhāṃbikāṃ samārādhya siddhimāpsyati durlabhām|| yo māṃ drakṣyati cātrasthaṃ yaśca māṃ pūjayiṣyati|| vādapracārato vāpi puṇyāvāptirbhaviṣyati|| 36.45 || ||nārada uvāca|| tryaṃbakeṇa vareṣvevaṃ datteṣvapi surottamāḥ|| 36.46 || prahṛṣṭāḥ samapadyaṃta gāthāṃ cemāṃ jagustadā|| tena yajñairjapaiḥstotraistapo bhistoṣitā vayam|| 36.47 || sarve devāḥ siddhiliṃgaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayiṣyati|| sarvakāmaphalāvāptirityevaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt|| 36.48 || ityuktvā te jayaṃ prāptāḥ skaṃdena sahitāḥ surāḥ|| kārāyyaṃ ramyaprāsādānramyaistārakasaṃbhavaiḥ|| 36.49 || caturvargaphalāvāptiṃ dattvā kṣetrasya saṃyayuḥ|| kecitskaṃdaṃ praśaṃsaṃtastīrthamanye hariṃ pare|| 36.50 || kecilliṃgāni paṃcāpi yuddhaṃ keciddivaṃ yayuḥ|| tatoṃ'tarikṣe cāliṃgya mahāsenaṃ haro'bravīt|| 36.51 || saptame mārutaskaṃdhe va sa nityaṃ priyātmaja|| kāryeṣvahaṃ tvayā putra saṃpraṣṭavyaḥ sadaiva hi|| 36.52 || darśanānmama bhaktyā ca śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi|| staṃbhatīrthe ca vatsye'haṃ na vimokṣyāmi karhicit|| 36.53 || ityuktvā visasarjainaṃ pariṣvajya maheśvaraḥ|| brahmaviṣṇumukhāṃścaiva bhaktyā tairabhinaṃditaḥ|| 36.54 || visarjitāḥ surājagmuḥ svānisvānyālayāni ca|| śarvo jagāma kailāsaṃ skaṃdhaṃ vai saptamaṃ guhaḥ|| 36.55 || ityetatkathitaṃ pārtha liṃgapaṃcakasaṃbhavam|| yaḥ paṭhetskaṃdasaṃbaddhāṃ kathāṃ martyo mahāmatiḥ|| 36.56 || śrṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi sa bhavetkīrtimānnaraḥ|| bahvāyuḥ subhagaḥ śrīmānkāṃtimāñchubhadarśanaḥ|| 36.57 || bhūtebhyo nirbhayaścāpi sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ|| śucirbhūtvā pumānyaśca kumāreśvarasannidhau|| 36.58 || śrṛṇuyātskaṃdacaritaṃ mahādhanapatirbhavet|| bālānāṃ vyādhiduṣṭānāṃ rājadvāropasevinām|| 36.59 || idaṃ tatparamaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvadoṣaharaṃ sadā|| tanukṣaye ca sāyujyaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya vrajennaraḥ|| 36.60 || varamenaṃ dadurdevāḥ skaṃdasyātha gatā divam|| 36.61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe paṃcaliṃgopākhyānasamāptivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 36 || cha ||
<1.2.37>
||śrīnārada uvāca|| barbarītīrthamāhātmyamatho vakṣyāmi te'rjuna|| yathā barbarikā jātā śataśrṛṃgā nṛpātmajā|| 37.1 || kumāriketi vikhyātā tasyā nāmnā prakathyate|| idaṃ kaumārikākhaṃḍaṃ caturvargaphalapradam|| 37.2 || yayā kṛtā pṛthivyāṃ ca nānāgrāmādikalpanā|| idaṃ bharatakhaṃḍaṃ ca yayā samyakprakalpitam|| 37.3 || ||dhanaṃjaya uvāca|| mahadetanmamāścaryaṃ śrotavyaṃ paramaṃ mune|| kumārīcaritaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi mahyaṃ savistaram|| 37.4 || kathaṃ viśvamidaṃ jātaṃ karmajātiprakalpitam|| kathaṃ vā bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ śuśrūṣeya sadā mama|| 37.5 || ||nārada uvāca|| avyakto'sminnirāloke pradhānapuruṣāvubhau|| ajau samāgatāvekau kevalaṃ śrṛṇumo vayam|| 37.6 || tataḥ svabhāvakālābhyāṃ svarūpābhyāṃ samīritam|| īkṣaṇenaiva prakṛtermahattattvamajāyata|| 37.7 || mahattattvādvikurvāṇādahaṃtattvaṃ vyajāyata|| tridhā tanmunibhiḥ proktaṃ sattvarāsatāmasam|| 37.8 || tāmasātpaṃca jātāni tanmātrāṇi vudurbudhāḥ|| tanmātrebhyaśca bhūtāni veśeṣāḥ paṃca tadbhavāḥ|| 37.9 || sāttvikāccāpyahaṃkārādvidvi karmedriyāṇi ca|| ekādaśaṃ manaścaiva rājasaṃ ca dvayorviduḥ|| 37.10 || caturviśatitattvāni jātānīti purā viduḥ|| sadāśivena vai puṃsā tāni dṛṣṭāni bhārata|| 37.11 || budbudākāratāṃ jagmuraṃḍaṃ jātaṃ tataḥ śubham|| śakatoṭipramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍamidamucyate|| 37.12 || ātmāsya kathito brahmā vyabhajatsa tridhā tvidam|| ūrdhvaṃ tatra sthitā devā madhye caiva ca mānavāḥ|| 37.13 || nāgā daityāśca pātāle tridhaitatparikalpitam|| aikaikaṃ saptadhābhūya tatastena prakalpitam|| 37.14 || pātālāni ca dvīpāni svarlokāḥ saptasapta ca|| sapta dvīpāni vakṣyāmi śrṛṇu teṣāṃ prakalpanām|| 37.15 || lakṣayojanavistāraṃ jaṃbūdvīpaṃ prakīrtyate|| sūryabiṃbasamākāraṃ tāvatkṣārārṇavāvṛtam|| 37.16 || śākadvīpaṃ dviguṇato jaṃbūdvīpāttataḥ param|| tāvatā kṣīratoyena samudreṇa parīvṛtam|| 37.17 || surātoyena daityānāṃ mohakāryarṇavena hi|| puṣkaraṃ tu tato dvīpaṃ dviguṇaṃ tāvatā vṛtam|| 37.18 || kuśadvīpaṃ dviguṇatastatastatparataḥ smṛtam|| dadhitoyena paritastāvadarṇavasaṃvṛtam|| 37.19 || tataḥ paraṃ krauñcasaṃjñaṃ dviguṇaṃ hi ghṛtābdhinā|| tataḥ śālmalidvīpaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ tāvataiva ca|| 37.20 || ikṣusārasvarūpeṇa samudreṇa parivṛtam|| gomedaṃ tasya parito dviguṇaṃ tāvatā vṛtam|| 37.21 || svādutoyena ramyeṇa samudreṇa samaṃtataḥ|| evaṃ koṭidvayaṃ pārtha lakṣapaṃcāśatatrayam|| 37.22 || paṃcāśacca sahasrāṇi saptadvīpāḥ sasāgarāḥ|| daśottarāṇi paṃcaiva aṃgulānāṃ śatāni ca|| 37.23 || apāṃ vṛddhikṣayo dṛṣṭaḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ|| tato hemamayī bhūmirdaśakoṭyaḥ kurūdvaha|| 37.24 || devānāṃ krīḍanasthānaṃ lokālokastataḥ param|| parvato valayākāro yojanāyutavistṛtaḥ|| 37.25 || asya bāhye tamo ghoraṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ jīvavarjitam|| paṃcatriṃśatsmṛtāḥ koṭyo lakṣāṇyekonaviṃśatiḥ|| 37.26 || catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ ca phālguna|| saptasāgaramānastu garbhodastadanaṃtaram|| 37.27 || koṭiyojanavistāraḥ kaṭāhaṛ saṃvyavasthitaḥ|| brahmaṇoṃ'ḍaṃ kaṭāhena saṃyuktaṃ merumadhyataḥ|| 37.28 || paṃcāśatkoṭayo jñeyā daśadikṣu samaṃtataḥ|| jaṃbudvīpasya madhye tu merunāmāsti parvataḥ|| 37.29 || sa lakṣayojano jñeyo hyadhaścordhvaṃ pramāṇataḥ|| ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi yojanānāmadhaḥ sthitaḥ|| 37.30 || ucchrayaścaturāśītirdvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ|| tribhiḥ śṛṃgaiḥ samāyuktaḥ śarāvākṛtimastakaḥ|| 37.31 || madhyaśṛṃge brahmavāsa aiśānyāṃ tryaṃbakasya ca|| nairṛtye vāsudevasya hemaśṛṃgaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ|| 37.32 || ratnajaṃ śaṃkarasyāpi rājataṃ keśavasya ca|| merudikṣu catasṛṣu viṣkaṃbhā girayaḥ smṛtāḥ|| 37.33 || pūrveṇa maṃdaro nāmadakṣiṇe gaṃdhamādanaḥ|| vipulaḥ paścimo jñeyaḥ supārśvastu tathottare|| 37.34 || kadaṃbo maṃdare jñeyojaṃburvai gaṃdhamādane|| aśvattho vipule caiva supārśveca vaṭomataḥ|| 37.35 || ekādaśaśatāyāmāścatvāro giriketavaḥ|| eteṣāṃ saṃti catvāri vanāni jayamūrdhasu|| 37.36 || pūrvaṃ caitrarathaṃ nāmadakṣiṇe gaṃdhamādanam|| vaibhrājaṃpaścime jñeyamudakcitrarathaṃ vanam|| 37.37 || sarāṃsi cāpi catvāri caturdikṣu nibodha me|| prācye'ruṇodasaṃjñaṃ tu mānasaṃ dakṣiṇe saraḥ|| 37.38 || pratyakchīto dakaṃnāma uttare ca mahāhradaḥ|| viṣkaṃbhagirayo hyeta ucchritāḥ paṃcaviṃśatiḥ|| 37.39 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sahasraṃ piṃḍataḥ smṛtam|| anye ca saṃti bahuśastatra vai kesarācalāḥ|| 37.40 || merordakṣiṇataścaiva trayo maryādaparvatāḥ|| niṣadho hemakūṭaśca himavāniti te trayaḥ|| 37.41 || lakṣayojanadīrghāśca vistīrṇā dvisahasrakam|| trayaścottarato merornīlaḥ śveto'tha śṛṅgavān|| 37.42 || mālyavānpūrvato merorgaṃdhākhyaḥ paścime tathā|| ityete girayaḥ proktā jaṃbudvīpe samaṃtataḥ|| 37.43 || gaṃdhamādanasaṃsthāyā mahāgajapramāṇataḥ|| phalāni jaṃbavāstannāmnā jaṃbūdvīpamiti smṛtam|| 37.44 || āsītsvāyaṃbhuvonāma manurādyaḥ prajāpatiḥ|| āsītstrī śatarūpā tāmuduvoḍha prajāpatiḥ|| priyavratottānapādau tasyā''stāṃ tanayāvubhau|| 37.45 || dhruvaścottānapādasya putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ|| bhaktyā sa viṣṇumārādhya sthānaṃ caivākṣayaṃ gataḥ|| 37.46 || priyavratasya rājarṣerutpannā daśa sūnavaḥ|| trayaḥ pravrajitāstatra paraṃbrahma samāśritāḥ|| 37.47 || sapta saptasu dvīpeṣu tena putrāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ|| jaṃbūdvīpādhipo jyeṣṭha āgnīdhra iti viśrutaḥ|| 37.48 || tasyāsannava sutāḥ pārtha navavarṣeśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ|| teṣāṃ nāmnā ca te varṣāstiṣṭhaṃtyadyāpi cāṃkitāḥ|| 37.49 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava pratyekaśaḥ smṛtāḥ|| meroścaturdaśaṃ khaṃḍaṃ gaṃdhamālyavatordvayoḥ|| 37.50 || aṃtare hemabhūmiṣṭhamilāvṛtamihocyate|| mālyavatsāgarāṃtasya bhadrāśvamiti procyate|| 37.51 || gaṃdhavatsāgarāṃtasya ketumālamiti smṛtam|| 37.52 || śṛṅgavajjaladheraṃtaḥ kurukhaṃḍamiti smṛtam|| śṛṅgavacchvetamadhye ca khaṇḍaṃ proktaṃ hiraṇmayam|| 37.53 || sunīlaśvetayormadhye khaṃḍamāhuśca ramyakam|| niṣadho hemakūṭaśca harikhaṃḍaṃ tadaṃtarā|| 37.54 || himavaddhimakūṭāṃtaḥ khaṇḍaṃ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam|| himādrijaladherantarnābhi khaṇḍamiti smṛtam|| 37.55 || nābhikhaṇḍaṃ ca kuravo dve varṣe dhanupākṛtī|| himavāṃśca giriśrṛṃgī jyāsthāne parikīrtitau|| 37.56 || nābheḥ putraśca ṛṣabha ṛṣabhādbarato'bhavat|| tasya nāmnā tvidaṃ varṣaṃ bhārataṃ ceti kīrtyate|| 37.57 || atra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasya ca upārjanam|| anyatra bhogabhūmiśca sarvatra kurunaṃdana|| 37.58 || śākadvīpe ca śāko'sti yojanānāṃ sahasrakaḥ|| tasya nāmnā ca tadvarṣaṃ śākadvīpamiti smṛtam|| 37.59 || tasya ca priyavrata evādhipatirnāmnā medhātithiriti|| 37.60 || tasya purojavamanojavavepamānadhūmrānīkacitrarephabahurūpaviśvacārasaṃjñāni putranāmāni sapta varṣāṇi|| 37.61 || śākadvīpe ca varṣa ṛtavratasatyavratānuvratanāmāno vāyyavātkamaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ japaṃti|| 37.62 || aṃtaḥ praviśya bhūtāni yo vibhajyātmaketubhiḥ|| aṃtaryāmīśvaraḥ sākṣātpātu no yadvaśe jagat|| 37.63 || ||iti japaḥ|| kuśadvīpe kuśastaṃbo yojanānāṃ sahasrakaḥ|| taccihnacihnitaṃ tasmātkuśadvīpaṃ tataḥ smṛtam|| 37.64 || taddvīpapatiśca praiyavrato hiraṇyaromā tatputravasuvasudānadṛḍhakavinābhiguptasatyavratavāmadevanāmāṃkitāni sapta varṣāṇi|| varṇāśca kuliśakovidābhiyuktakulakasaṃjñā jātavedasaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ stuvaṃti|| 37.65 || parasya brahṇaḥ sākṣājjātavedāsi havyavāṭ|| devānāṃ puruṣāṃgānāṃ yajñena puruṣaṃ yajaḥ|| 37.66 || ||iti stutiḥ|| krauṃcadvīpe krauṃcanāmā parvato yojanāyataḥ|| yo'sau guhena nirbhinnastaccihnaṃ krauṃcadvīpakam|| 37.67 || tatra ca praiyavrato ghṛtapṛṣṭināmā tatputrāmamadhuruhameghapṛṣṭhasvadāmaṛtāśvalohitārṇavavanaspatiitisaptaputranāmāṃkitāni sapta varṣāṇi|| 37.68 || varṇāśca guruṛṣabhadraviṇadevakasaṃjñāḥ|| 37.69 || āpomayaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ stuvaṃti|| 37.70 || āpaḥ puruṣavīryāśca punaṃtīrbhūrbhūvaḥsvaśca|| taiḥ punaramīvaghnāḥsaṃspṛśetātmanā bhuvaḥ|| 37.71 || ||iti japaḥ|| śālmalernāma vṛkṣasya tatravāsaḥ sahasraṃ yojanānāṃ taccihnaṃ śālmalidvipamucyate|| 37.72 || tasyādhipatiḥ praiyavrato yajñabāhustatputrasurocanasaumanasyaramaṇakadevabarhipāribhadrāpyāyanābhijñānanāmāni saptavarṣāṇi|| 37.73 || varṇāśca śrutadharavīryavasuṃdharaiṣaṃdharasaṃjñā bhagavaṃtaṃ somaṃ yajaṃti|| 37.74 || svayoniḥ pitṛdevebhyo vibhajañchuklakṛṣṇayoḥ|| adhaḥ prajānāṃ sarvāsāṃ rājā naḥ somostu|| 37.75 || iti japaḥ gomedanāmā plakṣosti suramyo yasya cchāyayā|| modovṛddhiṃ gataṃ laulyādgomedaṃ dvīpamucyate|| 37.76 || tatra praiyavrata idhmajihvaḥ patistatputrasivasuramyasubhadra śāṃtyaśaptamṛtābhayanāmāṃkitāni sapta varṣāṇi|| 37.77 || varṇāśca haṃsapataṃgordhvāṃcanasatyāṃgasaṃjñāścatvāro bhagavaṃtaṃ sūryaṃ yajaṃte|| 37.78 || praśrasya viṣṇurūpaṃyattatrotthasya brahmaṇo'mṛtasya ca|| mṛtyośca sūryamātmānaṃ dhīmahi|| 37.79 || ||iti japaḥ|| svarṇapatrāṇi niyutaṃ yojanānāṃ sahasrakam|| puṣkaraṃ jvaladā bhāti taccihnaṃ dvīpapuṣkaram|| 37.80 || tasyādhipatiḥ praiyavrato vītahotranāmā tatputrau ramaṇakaghātakau|| 37.81 || tannāmacihnataṃ khaṃḍadvayam|| 37.82 || tayoraṃtarālemānasācalo nāma valayākāraḥ parvato yasminbhramati bhagavānbhāskara iti|| 37.83 || tatra varṇāśca na saṃti kevalaṃ samānāste brahma dhyāyaṃti|| 37.84 || yadyatkarmamayaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaliṃgaṃ janorcayan|| bhedenaikāṃtamadvaitaṃ tasmai bhagavate namaḥ|| 37.85 || ||iti japaḥ|| naiṣu krodho na mātsaryaṃ puṇyapāpārjanena ca|| ayutaṃ dviguṇaṃ cāpi kramādāyuḥ prakīrtitam|| 37.86 || japaṃtaḥ kāminīyuktā viharaṃtyamarā iva|| atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi ūrdhvalokasya saṃsthitim|| 37.87 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumārikākhyāne bhūsaṃsthitivarṇanaṃnāma spatatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 37 || cha ||
<1.2.38>
||nārada uvāca|| bhūmeryojanalakṣe ca kauravya ravimaṃḍalam|| yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava|| 38.1 || īṣādaṃḍastataivāsya dviguṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| sārdhakoṭistathā sapta niyutāni vivasvataḥ|| 38.2 || yojanānāṃ tu tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam|| trinābhi tacca paṃcāraṃ ṣaṇnemi parikīrtitam|| 38.3 || catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dvitīyo'kṣo'pi vistṛtaḥ|| paṃca cānyāni sārddhāni syandanasya tu pāṃḍava|| 38.4 || akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇaṃ tadyugārddhayoḥ|| hrasvo'kṣastadyugārddhaṃ ca dhruvādhāraṃ rathasya vai|| 38.5 || dvitīyo'kṣastathā savye cakraṃ tanmānase sthitam|| hayāśca sapta cchāṃdāṃsi teṣāṃ nāmāni me śrṛṇu|| 38.6 || gāyatrī ca bṛhatyuṣṇigjagatī triṣṭuveva ca|| anuṣṭuppaṃktirityuktāśchaṃdāṃsi harayo raveḥ|| 38.7 || naivāstamanamarkasya nodayaḥ sarvadā sataḥ|| udayāstamanākyaṃ hi darśanādarśanaṃ raveḥ|| 38.8 || śakradīnāṃ pure tiṣṭhanspṛśatyeṣa puratrayam|| vikīrṇo'to vikarṇasthastrikoṇārdhapure tathā|| 38.9 || ayanasyottarasyādau makaraṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ|| tataḥ kumbhaṃ ca mīnaṃ ca rāśo rāśyaṃtaraṃ tathā|| 38.10 || triṣveteṣvatha bhukteṣu tato vaiṣuvatīṃ gatim|| prayāti savitā kurvannahorātraṃ ca tatsamam|| 38.11 || tato rātriḥ kṣayaṃ yāti vardhate tu dinaṃ dinam|| tataśca mithunasyāṃte parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāgataḥ|| 38.12 || rāśiṃ karkaṭakaṃ prāpya kurute dakṣiṇāyāṃnam|| kulālacakraparyaṃto yathā śīghraṃ nivartate|| 38.13 || dakṣiṇāyakrame sūryastathā śīghraṃ nivartate|| ativegitayā kālaṃ vāyumārgabalāccaran|| 38.14 || tasmātprakṛṣṭāṃ bhūmiṃ sa kālenālpena gacchati|| kulālacakramadhyastho yatā maṃdaṃ prasarpati|| 38.15 || tathodagayane sūryaḥ sarpate maṃdavikramaḥ|| tasmāddīrgheṇa kālena bhūmimalpaṃ nigacchati|| 38.16 || saṃdhyākāle ca maṃdehāḥ sūryamicchaṃti khāditum|| prajāpatikṛtaḥ śāpasteṣāṃ phālguna rakṣasām|| 38.17 || akṣayatvaṃ śarīrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ ca dinedine|| tataḥ sūryasya tairyuddhaṃ bhavatyatyaṃtadāruṇam|| 38.18 || tato gāyatripūtaṃ yaddvijāstoyaṃ kṣipaṃti ca|| tena dahyaṃti te pāpāḥ saṃdhyopāsanataḥ sadā|| 38.19 || ye saṃdhyāṃ nāpyupāsaṃte kṛtaghnā yāṃti rauravam|| pratimāsaṃ pṛthaksūrya ṛṣigandharvarākṣasaiḥ|| 38.20 || apsarogrāmaṇīsarpairatho yāti ca saptabhiḥ|| dhātāryamā mitravaruṇau vivasvānindra eva ca|| 38.21 || pūṣā ca savitā so'tha bhagastvaṣṭā ca kīrtitaḥ|| viṣṇuścaitrādimāseṣu ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ|| 38.22 || tato divākarasthānānmaṃḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ stitam|| lakṣamātreṇa tasyāpi tricakroratha ucyate|| 38.23 || kuṃdābhā daśa caivāśvā vāmadakṣiṇato yutāḥ|| pūrṇe śatasahasre ca yojanānāṃ niśākarāt|| 38.24 || nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamupariṣṭātprakāśate|| caturdaśa cārbudānyapyaśītiḥ saritāṃpatiḥ|| 38.25 || viṃśatiśca tathā koṭyo nakṣatrāṇāṃ prakīrtitāḥ|| dve lakṣe cottare tasmādbudho nakṣatramaṇḍalāt|| 38.26 || vāyvagnidravyasaṃbhūto rathaścaṃdrasutasya ca|| piśaṃgaistura--- soṣṭābhirvāyavegibhiḥ|| 38.27 || dvilakṣaścottare tasmādbudhāccāpyuśanā smṛtaḥ|| śukrasyāpi rathoṣṭābhiryukto'bhūtsaṃbhavairhayaiḥ|| 38.28 || lakṣadvayena bhaumasya smṛto devapurohitaḥ|| aṣṭābhiḥ pāṃḍurairaśvairyukto'sya kāṃcanorathaḥ|| 38.29 || saurirbṛhaspateścordhvaṃ dvilakṣe samupasthitaḥ|| ākāśasaṃbhavairaśvairaṣṭābhiḥ śabalai rathaḥ|| 38.30 || svarbhānosturagāścāṣṭau bhṛṃgābhā dhūsarāratham|| vahaṃti ca sakṛdyuktā ādityādhaḥsthitāstathā|| 38.31 || saurerlakṣaṃ smṛtaṃ cordhvaṃ tataḥ saptarṣimaṇḍalam|| ṛṣibhyaścāpi lakṣeṇa dhruvaścordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ|| 38.32 || meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ|| dhruvo'pi śiṃśumārasya pucchādhāre vyavasthitaḥ|| 38.33 || yamāhurvāsudevasya rūpamātmānamavyayam|| vāyupāśairdhruve baddhaṃ sarvametacca phālguna|| 38.34 || navayojanasāhasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ savituḥ smṛtam|| dviguṇaṃ sūryavistārānmaṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam|| 38.35 || tulyastayostu svarbhānurbhūtvādhastātprasarpati|| uddhṛtya pṛthivīcchāyāṃ nirmalāṃ maṇḍalākṛtiḥ|| 38.36 || candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavaśca vidhīyate|| bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo'tha bṛhaspatiḥ|| 38.37 || bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurī budhastathā|| śatāni paṃca catvāritrīṇi dve caikayojanam|| 38.38 || yojanārdhapramāṇāni bhāni hrasvaṃ na vidyate|| bhūmilokaśca bhūrlokaḥ pādagamyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 38.39 || bhūmisūryāṃtaraṃ tacca bhuvarlokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| dhruvasūryāṃtaraṃ tacca niyutāni caturdaśa|| 38.40 || svarlokaḥ so'pi gadito lokasaṃsthānaciṃtakaiḥ|| dhruvādūrdhvaṃ tathā koṭacirmaharlokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 38.41 || dve koṭyau ca jano yatra nivasaṃti catuḥsanāḥ|| caturbhiścāpi koṭībhistapolokastataḥ smaॉtaḥ|| 38.42 || vairājā yatra te devāḥ sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ|| ṣaḍguṇena tapolokātsatyaloko virājate|| 38.43 || apunarmarakā yatra brahmaloko hi sa smṛtaḥ|| aṣṭādasa tathā koṭyo lakṣāṇyaśītipaṃca ca|| 38.44 || śubhaṃ nirupamaṃ sthānaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ saṃprakāśate|| bhūrbhūvaḥsvariti proktaṃ trailokyaṃ kṛtakaṃ tvidam|| 38.45 || janastapastathā satyamiti cākṛtakaṃ trayam|| kṛtakākṛtayormadhye marharloka iti smṛtaḥ|| 38.46 || śūnyo bhavati kalpāṃte yotyaṃtaṃ na vinaśyati|| ete sapta samākhyātā lokāḥ puṇyairupārjitāḥ|| 38.47 || yajñairdānairjapairhomaistīrthairvratasamuccayaiḥ|| vedādiproktairanyaiśca sādhyām̐llokānimānviduḥ|| 38.48 || tataścāṃḍasya śiraso dhārā nīramayī śivā|| sarvalokānsamāplāvya gaṃgā merāvupāgatā|| 38.49 || tato mahītalaṃ sarvaṃ pātālaṃ praviveśa sā|| aṃḍamūrdhni sthitā devī satataṃ dvāravāsinī|| 38.50 || devīnāṃ koṭikoṭībhiḥ saṃvṛtā piṃgalena ca|| tatra sthitā sadā rakṣāṃ kurute'ṇḍasya sā śubhā|| 38.51 || nihaṃti duṣṭasaṃghātānmahābalaparākramā|| vāyuskaṃdhāni saptāpiśrṛṇuyadvatsthitānyapi|| 38.52 || pṛthivīṃ samabhikramya saṃsthito meghamaṃḍale|| pravahonāma yo meghānpravahatyatiśaktimān|| 38.53 || dhūmajāśvoṣmajā meghāḥ sāmudraiyana pūritāḥ|| toyairbhavaṃti nīlāṃgā varṣiṣṭhāścaiva bhārata|| 38.54 || dvitīyaścāvaho nāma nibaddhaḥ sūryamaṃḍale|| tena baddhaṃ dhruveṇedaṃ bhrāmyate sūryamaṃḍalam|| 38.55 || tṛtīyaścodvaho nāma caṃdraskaṃdhe pratiṣṭhitaḥ|| baddhaṃ dhruveṇa yenedaṃ bhrāmyate caṃdramaṃḍalam|| 38.56 || caturthaḥ saṃvaho nāma sthito nakṣatramaṇḍale|| vātaraśmibhirābaddhaṃ dhruveṇa saha bhrāmyate|| 38.57 || graheṣu paṃcamaḥ so'pi vivaho nāma mārutaḥ|| grahacakramidaṃ yena bhrāmyate dhruvasaṃdhitam|| 38.58 || ṣaṣṭhaḥ parivaho nāma sthitaḥ saptarṣimaṃḍale|| bhramaṃti dhruvasaṃbaddhā yena saptarṣayo divi|| 38.59 || saptamaśca dhruve baddho vāyurnāmnā parāvahaḥ|| yena saṃsthāpitaṃ dhrauvyaṃ cakraṃ cānyāni bhārata|| 38.60 || yaṃ samāsādya vegena diśāmaṃtaṃ prapedire|| dakṣasya daśa putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi prajāpateḥ|| 38.61 || evamete diteḥ putrāḥ saptasapta vyavasthitāḥ|| anāramaṃtaḥ saṃvāṃti sarvagāḥ sarvadhāriṇaḥ|| 38.62 || dhruvādūrdhvamasūryaṃ cāpyanakṣatramatārakam|| svatejasā svaśaktyā cādhiṣṭhitāste hi nityadā|| 38.63 || ityūrdhvaṃ te samākhyāṃtaṃ pātālānyatha me śrṛṇu|| 38.64 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhāsryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe kumārikākyāne lokavyavasthitivarmanaṃnāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 38 || cha ||
<1.2.39>
||nārada uvāca|| sahasrasaptatyucchrāye pātālāni parasparam|| atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva nitalaṃ ca rasātalam|| 39.1 || talātalaṃ ca sutalaṃ pātālaṃ cāpi saptamam|| kṛṣṇaśuklāruṇāḥ pītāḥ śarkarāśailakāṃcanāḥ|| 39.2 || bhūmayo yatra kauravya varaprāsādaśobhitāḥ|| teṣu dānavadaiteyanāgāścaiva sahasrasaḥ|| 39.3 || svarlokādapi ramyāṇi dṛṣṭāni bahuśo mayā|| āhlādakāriṇo nānāmaṇyo yatra pannagaḥ|| 39.4 || daityadānavakanyābhirmahārūpābhiranvite|| pātāle kasya na prītirvimuktasyāpi jāyate|| 39.5 || yatra noṣṇaṃ na vā śītaṃ na varṣaṃ duḥkhameva ca|| bhakṣyabhojyamahābhogakālo yatrāpi jāyate|| 39.6 || pātāle saptame cāsti liṃgaṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram|| brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ pārtha sahasrayojanocchritam|| 39.7 || hāṭakasya tu liṃgasya prāsādo yojanāyutaḥ|| sarvaratnamayo divyo nānāścayavibhūṣitaḥ|| 39.8 || taccāryaṃti talliṃgaṃ nānānāgendrasattamāḥ|| tadadhastājjalaṃ bhūri tasyādho narakāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 39.9 || pāpino yeṣu pātyaṃte tāñchṛṇuṣva mahāmate|| koṭayaḥ paṃcapaṃcāśadrājānaścaikaviṃśati|| 39.10 || rauravaḥ śūkaro rodhastālo viśasanastathā|| mahājvālastaptakumbho lavaṇotha vimohakaḥ|| 39.11 || rudhirāṃdho vaitaraṇī kṛmiśaḥ kṛmibhojanaḥ|| asipatravanaṃ kṛṣṇo lālābhakṣyaśca dārumaḥ|| 39.12 || tathā pūyavahaḥ pāpo vahnijvālo'pyadhaḥśirāḥ|| saṃdaṃśaḥ kṛṣṇasūtraśca tamaścāvīcirevaca|| 39.13 || śvabhojano visūciścāpyavīciśca tathā'paraḥ|| kūṭasākṣī rauravaṃ ca rodhaṃ goviprarodhakaḥ|| 39.14 || surāpaḥ sūkaraṃ yāti tālaṃ mithyāma nuṣyahā|| gurutalpī taptakumbhaṃ taptalohaṃ ca bhaktahā|| 39.15 || gurūṇāmavamaṃtā yaco mahājvāle nipātyate|| lavaṇaṃ śāstrahaṃtā ca nirmaryādo vimohake|| 39.16 || kṛmibhakṣye devadveṣṭā kṛmiśe tu duriṣṭakṛt|| pitṛdevātpūrvamaśrallām̐lābhakṣye prayāti ca|| 39.17 || mithyājīvavirodhī viśasane kūṭaśastrakṛt|| adhomukhe hyasadgrāhī ekāśī pūyavāhake|| 39.18 || mārjjārakukkuṭaśvānapakṣipoṣṭā prayāti ca|| badhirāṃdhagṛhakṣetratṛṇadhānyādijvālakaḥ|| 39.19 || nakṣatraraṃgajīvī ca yāti vaitaraṇīṃ naraḥ|| dhanayauvanamatto yo dhanahā kṛṣṇameti saḥ|| 39.20 || asipatravanaṃ yāti vṛkṣacchedī vṛthaiva yat|| kuhakājīvinaḥ sarve vahnijvāle pataṃti te|| 39.21 || parastrīṃ ca parānnaṃ ca gacchansaṃdaṃśameti ca|| divāsvapnaparā ye vratalopaparāśca ye|| 39.22 || śarīramadamattāśca yāṃti caite śvabhojanam|| śivaṃ hariṃ na manyaṃte yāṃtyavīcinameva ca|| 39.23 || ityevamādibhiḥ pāpairaśāstraughasya sevanaiḥ|| pataṃtyeva mahāghoranarakeṣu sahasraśaḥ|| 39.24 || tasmādya icchedetebhyo vimokṣaṃ buddhimānnaraḥ|| śrutimārgeṇa tenārcyau devau hariharāvubhau|| 39.25 || narakāṇāmadhobhāge sthitaḥ kālāgnisaṃjñakaḥ|| tadadho haṭṭakaścaiva anaṃtastadadhaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 39.26 || yasyaitatsakalaṃ viśvaṃ mūrdhāgre sarṣapāyate|| ityanaṃtaprabhāvātsa hyanaṃta iti kīrtyate|| 39.27 || diśāṃ gajāstatra padmakumudāṃjanavāmanāḥ|| tadadhoṃ'ḍakaṭāhaśca ekavīrāsti tatra ca|| 39.28 || caturlakṣasahasrāṇi navatiśca śatāni ca|| etanaiva pramāṇena udakaṃ ca tataḥ smṛtam|| 39.29 || tadadho narakāḥ koṭyo dvikoṭyo'gnistato mahān|| catvāriṃśatsahasraiśca tadadhastama ucyate|| 39.30 || catvāriṃśccakoṭyastu catasraśca tataḥ parāḥ|| ekonanavatirlakṣāḥ sahasrāśītireva ca|| 39.31 || tadadhoṃ'ḍakaṭāhotha koṭimātrastathāparaḥ|| devī yuktā kapālīśā daṃḍahastena cāpi sā|| 39.32 || devīnāṃ koṭikoṭībhiḥ saṃvṛtā tatra pālinī|| saṃkarṣaṇasya niḥśvāsaprerito dāhako'nalaḥ|| 39.33 || kālāgniṃ prerayatyeva kalpāṃte dahyate jagat|| evaṃvidhamadhaḥsūtraṃ nirmitaṃ cātra bhārata|| 39.34 || madhyasūtre kaṭāhe ca pālakāṃstāñchṛṇuṣva me|| vasudhāmā sthitaḥ pūrve śaṃkhapālaśca dakṣiṇe|| 39.35 || takṣakeśaḥ sthitaḥ paścāduttare ketumāniti|| harasiddhiḥ suparṇākṣī bhāskarā yoganaṃdinī|| 39.36 || koṭikoṭī yutā devī devīnāṃ pālayatyadaḥ|| evametanmahāścaryaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ sthāpitaṃ ca yaiḥ|| 39.37 || namāmi tānahaṃ nityaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān|| viṣṇuloko rudraloko bahiścāsmātprakīrtyate|| 39.38 || taṃ ca varṇayituṃ brahmā śakto naivāsmadādayaḥ|| vimuktā yatra saṃyāṃti nityaṃ hariharavratāḥ|| 39.39 || brahmāṃḍaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ hyetatkaṭāhena samaṃtataḥ|| kapitthasya yathā bījaṃ kaṭāhena susaṃvṛtam|| 39.40 || daśottareṇa payasā vṛtaṃ taccāpi tejasā|| tejaśca vāyunā vāyurnabha sāhaṃtayā ca tat|| 39.41 || ahaṃkāraśca mahatā taṃ cāpi prakṛtiḥ parā|| daśottarāṇi sarvāṇi ṣaḍāhuḥ saptamaṃ ca tat|| 39.42 || prākṛtaṃ caraṇaṃ pārtha tadanaṃtaṃ prakīrtitam|| aṃḍānāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca|| 39.43 || īdṛśānāṃ tathā cātra koṭikoṭiśatāni ca|| sarvāṇyevaṃvidhānyeva yādṛśaṃ kīrtitaṃtvidam|| 39.44 || yasyaivaṃ vaibhavaṃ pārtha taṃ namāmī sadāśivam|| aho maṃdaḥ sa pāpātmā ko vā tasmādacetanaḥ|| 39.45 || ya evaṃvidhasaṃmohatārakaṃ na śivaṃ bhajet|| atha te kīrthayiṣyāmi kālamānaṃ nibodha tat|| 39.46 || kāṣṭhā nimeṣā daśa paṃca cāhustriṃśacca kāṣṭhā gaṇayetkalā hi|| triṃśatkalāścāpi bhavenmuhurttaṃ tattriṃśatā rātryahanī ubhe ca|| 39.47 || divase paṃca kālāḥ syustrimuhūrtāḥ śrṛṇuṣva tān|| prātastataḥ saṃgavaśca madhyāhnaścāparāhṇakaḥ|| 39.48 || sāyāhnaḥ paṃcamaścāpi muhūrtā daśa paṃca ca|| ahorātrāḥ paṃcadaśa pakṣa ityabhidhīyate|| 39.49 || māsaḥ pakṣadvayenokto dvau māsau cārkajāvṛtuḥ|| ṛtutrayaṃ cāpyayanaṃ dveyane varṣamucyate|| 39.50 || caturbhedaṃ māsamāhuḥ paṃcabhedaṃ ca vatsaram|| saṃvatsarastu prathamo dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ|| 39.51 || idvatsarastṛtīyo'sau caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ|| paṃcamaśca yugonāma gaṇanāniścayo hi saḥ|| 39.52 || māsena ca manuṣyāṇāmahorātraṃ ca paitṛkam|| kṛṣṇapakṣastvahaḥ proktaḥ śuklapakṣaśca śarvarī|| 39.53 || mānuṣeṇa ca varṣeṇa daiviko divasaḥ smṛtaḥ|| ahastatro dagayanaṃ rātriḥ syāddakṣiṇāyanam|| 39.54 || varṣeṇa caiva devānāṃ mataḥ saptarṣivāsaraḥ|| saptarṣīṇāṃ ca varṣeṇa dhrauvaśca divasaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 39.55 || manuṣyāṇāṃ ca varṣāṇi lakṣāsaptadaśaiva tu|| aṣṭāviṃśatisahasrāṇi kṛtaṃ tretāyugaṃ tataḥ|| 39.56 || lakṣadvādaśasāhasraṣaṇnavatyadhikāḥ parāḥ|| aṣṭau lakṣāścatuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ca dvāparaḥ|| 39.57 || caturlakṣaṃ tu dvātriṃśatsahasrāṇi kaliḥ smṛtaḥ|| caturbhiretairdevānāṃ yugāmityabhidhīyate|| 39.58 || āyurmanoryugānāṃ ca sādhikā hyekasaptatiḥ|| caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca kālena brahmaṇo dinam|| 39.59 || yugānāṃ ca sahasreṇa sa ca kalpaḥ śrṛṇuṣva tān|| bhavodbhavastapabhavya ṛturvahnirvarāhakaḥ|| 39.60 || sāvitra āsikaścāpi gāṃdhāraḥ kuśikastathā|| ṛṣabhaśca tathā khaḍgo gāṃdhārīyaśca madhyamaḥ|| 39.61 || vairājaśca niṣādaśca meghavāhanapaṃcamau|| citrako jñāna ākūtirmono daṃśaśca bṛṃhakaḥ|| 39.62 || śveto lohitaraktau ca pītavāsāḥ śivaḥ prabhuḥ|| sarvarūpaśca māso'yamevaṃ varṣaśatāvadhiḥ|| 39.63 || pūrvārdhamaparārdhaṃ ca brahmamānamidaṃ smṛtam|| viṣṇośca śaṃkarasyāpi nāhaṃ śaktaśca varṇane|| 39.64 || kvāhamalpamatiḥ pārtha kvāparau haritryaṃbakau|| devikenaiva mānena pātāleṣvapi gaṇyate|| 39.65 || iti te sūcitaṃ buddhyā śrṛṇu tatprākṛtaṃ punaḥ|| 39.66 || iti vaidhātravyavasthitiḥ|| ||śrīnārada uvāca|| ṛṣabhonāma yannāmnā nānāpāṣaṃḍa kalpanāḥ|| kalau pārtha bhaviṣyaṃti lokānāṃ mohanātmikāḥ|| 39.67 || tasya putrastu bharataḥ śataśṛṅgastu tatsutaḥ|| tasya putrāṣṭakaṃ jātaṃ tathaikāca kumārikā|| 39.68 || iṃdradvīpaḥ kaseruśca tāmradvīpo gabhastimān|| nāgaḥ saumyaśca gāṃdharvo varuṇaśca kumārikā|| 39.69 || vadanaṃ cāpi kanyāyāḥ pārtha barkarikākṛti|| śrṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ mahāścaryasamanvitam|| 39.70 || mahīsāgaraparyaṃtaṃ vṛkṣarājivirājite|| jālīgulmalatākīrṇe staṃbhatīrthasya saṃnidhau|| 39.71 || ajāsamajato madhyātkācidekā ca barkarī|| bhrāṃtā satī samāyātā pradeśe tatra duścare|| 39.72 || itastato bhramaṃti sā jālimadhye samaṃtataḥ|| nirgaṃtuṃ naiva śaknoti kṣutpipāsārditā śubhā|| 39.73 || vilagnā jālimadhye tu tataḥ paṃcatvamāgatā|| kālena kiyatā tasya truṭitvā śiraso hyadhaḥ|| 39.74 || papāta śanidarśe ca mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| sarvatīrthamaye tatra sarvapāpapramocane|| 39.75 || śirastu tadavasthaṃ hi samagraṃ tatra saṃsthitam|| jāligulmāvalagnaṃ ca tasyā naivāpatajjale|| 39.76 || śeṣakāyaprapātena mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| tattīrthasya prabhāvena barkarīsā kurūdvaha|| 39.77 || śataśṛṅgasya vai rājñaḥ siṃhaleṣvabhavatsutā|| mukhaṃ barkarikātulyaṃ vyaktaṃ tasyā vyajāyata|| 39.78 || divyanārī śubhākārā śeṣakāye babhau śubhā|| pūrvaṃ tasyāpyaputrasya rājñaḥ putraśatopamā|| 39.79 || putrī jātā pramodena svajanānaṃdavardhinī|| tatastasyā vilokyātha mukhaṃ varkarikākṛti|| 39.80 || vismayaṃ samanuprāptāḥ sarve te rājapūruṣāḥ|| viṣādaṃ paramāpanno rājā sāṃtaḥpurastadā|| 39.81 || khinnāḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvāstādṛgrūpavilokanāt|| tatkimityetadāścaryamūcuḥ paurāḥ suvismitāḥ|| 39.82 || tataḥ sā yauvanaṃ prāptā sākṣāddevasutopamā|| svamukhaṃ darpaṇe vīkṣyasmṛtaḥ pūrvo bhavastayā|| 39.83 || tattīrthasya prabhāveṇa mātṛpitrorniveditam|| viṣādo naiva kartavyo madarthe tāta niścitam|| 39.84 || mā śokaṃ kuru me mātaḥ pūrvajanmārjitaṃ phalam|| tataḥ pūrvaṃ svavṛttāṃtamuktvā sā ca kumārikā|| 39.85 || pūrvajanmodbhavaḥ kāyasyasyā yatrāpatattathā|| gamanāya tamuddeśaṃ vijñaptau pitarau tayā|| 39.86 || ahaṃ tāta gamiṣyāmi mahīsāgarasaṃgamam|| bhavāmi tatra saṃprāptā yathā kuru tathā nṛpa|| 39.87 || tataḥ pitrā pratijñātaṃ śataśrṛṃgeṇa tattathā|| tasyāḥ saṃvāhanaṃ cakre rājā potaiḥ saratnakaiḥ|| 39.88 || staṃbhatīrthaṃ tataḥ sā'pi prāpya potāryasaṃyutā|| bhūridānaṃ tataścakre dānaṃ sarvasvalakṣaṇam|| 39.89 || jāligulmāṃtare'nviṣya tato dṛṣṭaṃ nijaṃ śiraḥ|| asthicarmāvaśeṣaṃ ca tadādāya prayatnataḥ|| 39.90 || dagdhvā saṃgamasāṃnidhye kṣiptānyasthīni saṃgame|| tatastīrthaprabhāveṇa mukhaṃ jātaṃ śaśiprabham|| 39.91 || na tādṛgdevakanyānāṃ na tādṛṅanāgayoṣitām|| na tādṛṅamartyanārīṇāṃ tasyā yādṛṅamukhaṃ mukham|| 39.92 || surāsuranarāḥ sarve tasyā rūpeṇa mohitāḥ|| bahudhā prārthayaṃtyenāṃ na sā varamabhīpsati|| 39.93 || kaṣṭaṃ tayā mudā tatra prārabdhaṃ duścaraṃ tapaḥ|| tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe devadevo maheśvaraḥ|| 39.94 || pratyakṣatāṃ gatastasyai varado'smīti cābravīt|| tatastaṃ pūjayitvā ca kumārī vākyamabravīt|| 39.95 || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama|| sāṃnidhyaṃ kriyatāmatra sarvakālaṃ hi śaṃkara|| 39.96 || evamastviti śarveṇa prokte hṛṣṭā kumārikā|| yatra dagdhaṃ śirastasyā barkaryāḥ kurusattama|| 39.97 || barkareśaḥ śivastatra tayā saṃsthāpitastadā|| manmukhānmahādāścaryaṃ śrutvedaṃ ca talātalāt|| 39.98 || svastikonāma nāgeṃdraḥ kumārīṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ|| śirasā gacchatā tena yatrotkṣiptā ca bhūrabhūt|| 39.99 || īśāne barkareśasya kūpo'bhūtsvastikābhidhaḥ|| pūrito gaṃgayā pārtha sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ|| 39.100 || dṛṣṭvā ca sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ śivastuṣṭo varaṃ dadau|| yeṣāṃ mṛtaśarīrāṇāmatra dāhaḥ prajāyate|| 39.101 || kṣipyaṃtebdhau tathā sthīni teṣāṃ syādakṣayā gatiḥ|| te svarge suciraṃ kālaṃ vasitvātra samāgatāḥ|| 39.102 || rājānaḥ sarvasaṃpūrṇāḥ sapratāpā bhavaṃti te|| barkareśaṃ ca yo bhaktyā saṃpūjayati mānavaḥ|| 39.103 || snātvārṇavamahītoye tasya syānmanasepsitam|| kārtike ca caturddeśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ|| 39.104 || kūpe snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā saṃtarpya ca pitṝnnijān|| pūjayedbarkareśaṃ yaḥ sarpapāpaiḥ sa mucyate|| 39.105 || evaṃ labdhvā varānsarvānsā punaḥ siṃhalaṃ yayau|| śataśrṛṅgāya pitre ca vṛttāṃtaṃ svaṃ nyavedayat|| 39.106 || tacchrutvā vismito rājā lokāḥ sarve ca phālguna|| praśaśaṃsurmahītīrthamājagmuśca kṛtādarāḥ|| 39.107 || snātvā dattvā ca dānāni vividhāni ca te tataḥ|| siṃhalaṃ ca yayurbhūyastīrthamāhātmyaharṣitāḥ|| 39.108 || anicchaṃtyāṃ kumāryāṃ ca varaṃ dravyaṃ ca pārthivaḥ|| tathānyadapi prītyāsau yaddadau nṛpatiḥ śrṛṇu|| 39.109 || idaṃ bhāratakhaṃḍaṃ ca navadhaiva vibhajya saḥ|| dadāvaṣṭau svaputrāṇāṃ kumāryai navamaṃ tathā|| 39.110 || teṣāṃ vibhedānvakṣyāmi parvatairupaśobhitān|| putranāmāni varṣāṇi parvatāṃśca śrṛṇuṣva me|| 39.111 || mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ|| viṃdhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ|| 39.112 || mahendraparataścaiva indradvīpo nigadyate|| pāriyātrasya caivārvākkhaṇḍaṃ kaumārikaṃ smṛtam|| 39.113 || sahasramekamekaṃ ca sarvakhaṇḍānyamūni ca|| nadīnāṃ saṃbhavaṃ cāpi saṃkṣepācchṛṇu phālguna|| 39.114 || vedasmṛtimukhā nadyaḥ pāriyātrodbhavā matāḥ|| narmadāsarasādyāśca nadyo viṃdhyādvinirgatāḥ|| 39.115 || śatadrūcandrabhāgādyā ṛkṣaparvatasaṃbhavāḥ|| ṛṣikulyākumāryādyāḥ śuktimatpādasaṃbhavāḥ|| 39.116 || tāpī payoṣṇī nirvidhyā kāverī ca mahīnadī|| kṛṣṇā veṇī bhīmarathī sahyapādodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 39.117 || kṛtamālātāmraparṇīpramukhā malayodbhavāḥ|| trisāmaṛṣyakulyādyā mahendraprabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 39.118 || evaṃ vibhajya putrebhyaḥ kumāryai ca mahīpatiḥ|| śataśṛṃgo giraṃ gatvā udīcyāṃ taptavāṃstapaḥ|| 39.119 || tatra taptvā tapo ghoraṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ|| śataśrṛṃgo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ śataśrṛṃge nagottame|| 39.120 || yatra jāto'si kauteya pāṃḍostvaṃ sodaraiḥ saha|| kumārī ca mahābhāgā staṃbhatīrthasthitā satī|| 39.121 || khaṃḍodbhavena dravyeṇa tepe dānāni yacchatī|| tataḥ kenāpi kālena bhrātṛbhyo'ṣṭabhya eva ca|| 39.122 || mahāvīryabalotsāhā jātā nava navātmajāḥ|| te sametya samāgamya kumārīṃ procire tataḥ|| 39.123 || kuladevī tvamasmākaṃ prasādaṃ kuru naḥ śubhe|| aṣṭau khaṇḍāni cāsmākaṃ vibhajya svayameva ca|| dehī dvāsaptatīnāṃ no vibhedaḥ syādyathā na naḥ|| 39.124 || ityuktā sarvadharmajñā vijñāne brahmaṇā samā|| dvāsaptativibhedaiḥ sā nava khaṃḍānyacīkarat|| 39.125 || teṣāṃ nāmāni grāmāṃśca pattanāni ca phālguna|| velākūlāni saṃkhyāṃ ca vakṣyāmi tava tattvataḥ|| 39.126 || koṭiścatasro grāmāṇāṃ nīvṛdāsīcca maṃḍale|| sārdhakoṭidvayagrāmairdeśo bālāka jacyate|| 39.127 || sapādakoṭirgrāmāṇāṃ purasāhaṇake viduḥ|| lakṣāścatvāra evāpi grāmāṇāmaṃdhake smṛtāḥ|| 39.128 || eko lakṣaśca nepāle grāmāṇāṃ parikīrtitaḥ|| ṣaṭtrīṃśallakṣamānaṃ tu kānyakubje prakīrtitam|| 39.129 || dvāsaptatistathā lakṣā grāmā gājaṇake smṛtāḥ|| aṣṭādaśa tathā lakṣā grāmāṇāṃ gauḍadeśake|| 39.130 || kāmarūpe ca grāmāṇāṃ navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| ḍāhale vedasaṃjñe tu grāmāṇāṃ navalakṣakam|| 39.131 || navaiva lakṣā grāmāṇāṃ kāṃtipure prakīrtitāḥ|| navalakṣāstathā caiva mācipure prakīrtitāḥ|| 39.132 || oḍḍiyāṇe tathā deśe navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| jālaṃdhare tathā deśe navalakṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 39.133 || lohapūre tathā deśe lakṣāḥ proktā navaiva ca|| grāmāṇāṃ saptalakṣaṃ ca pāṃbīpure prakīrtitam|| 39.134 || grāmāṇāṃ saptalakṣaṃ ca raṭarāje prakīrtitam|| harīāle ca grāmāṇāṃ lakṣapaṃcakasaṃmitam|| 39.135 || sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ draḍasya viṣaye tathā|| sārdhalakṣatrayaṃ proktaṃ tathāvaṃbhaṇavāhake|| 39.136 || ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ grāmaṇāṃ nīlapūrake|| tathāmalaviṣaye pārtha grāmamāṇāmekalakṣakam|| 39.137 || nareṃdunāmadeśe tu lakṣamekaṃ sapādakam|| atilāṃgaladeśe ca lakṣaḥ proktaḥ sapādakaḥ|| 39.138 || lakṣāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ navatī dve ca mālave|| sayaṃbhare tathā deśe lakṣaḥ proktaḥ sapādakaḥ|| 39.139 || mevāḍe ca tathā prokto lakṣaścaikaḥsapādakaḥ|| aśītiśca sahasrāṇi vāguriḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| 39.140 || grāmasaptatisāhasro gurjarātraḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| tathā saptatisāhasraḥ pāṃḍarviṣaya eva ca|| 39.141 || jahāhutisahasrāṇi dvācatvāriṃśadeva ca|| aṣṭaṣāṣṭasahasrāṇi proktaṃ kāśmīramaṃḍalam|| 39.142 || ṣaṣṭitriṃśatsahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ kauṃkaṇe viduḥ|| caturdaśaśataṃ dve ca viṃśatīlaghukauṃkaṇam|| 39.143 || siṃdhuḥ sahasradaśake grāmāṇāṃ parikīrtitaḥ|| 39.144 || caturdaśaśate dve ca viṃśatiḥ kacchamaṃḍalam|| paṃcapaṃcāśatsahasraṃ grāmāḥ saurāṣṭramucyate|| 39.145 || ekaviṃśatisahasro lāḍadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| atisiṃdhuśca grāmāṇāṃ daśasahasra ucyate|| tathā cāśvamukhaṃ pārtha daśasāhasramucyate|| 39.146 || sahasradaśakaṃ cāpi ekapādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 39.147 || tathaiva daśasāhasro deśaḥ sūryamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ|| ekabāhustathā deśo daśasāhasramucyate|| 39.148 || sahasradaśakaṃ caiva saṃjāyuriti deśakaḥ|| śivanāmā tathā deśaḥ sahasradaśakaḥ smṛtaḥ|| sahasrāṇi daśa khyātaṃ tathā kālahayaṃjayaḥ|| 39.149 || liṃgodbhavastathā deśaḥ sahasrāṇi daśaiva ca|| bhadraśca devabhadraśca pratyekaṃ daśakau smṛtau|| 39.150 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi smṛtau caṭavirāṭakau|| ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi yamakoṭiḥ prakīrtitā|| 39.151 || aṣṭādaśa tathā koṭyo rāmako deśa ucyate|| tomaraścāpi karṇāṭo yugalaśca trayastvime|| 39.152 || sapādalakṣagrāmāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ parikīrtitaḥ|| paṃcalakṣāśca grāmāṇāṃ strīrājyaṃ parikīrtitam|| 39.153 || pulastyaviṣayaścāpi daśalakṣaka ucyate|| pratyekaṃ lakṣadaśakau deśau kāṃbojakośalau|| 39.154 || grāmāṇāṃ ca caturlakṣo bālhikaḥ parikīrtyate|| ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi laṃkādeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 39.155 || catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi kurudeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| sārdhalakṣastathā proktaḥ kirātavijayo jayaḥ|| 39.156 || paṃca prāhustathā lakṣānvidarbhāyāṃ ca grāmakān|| caturdaśasahasrāṇi vardhamānaṃ prakīrtitam|| 39.157 || sahasradaśakaṃ cāpi siṃhaladvīpamucyate|| ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ pāṃḍudeśakaḥ|| 39.158 || lakṣaikaṃ ca tathā proktaṃ grāmāṇāṃ tu bhayāṇakam|| ṣaṭṣaṣṭiṃ ca sahasrāṇi deśo māgadha ucyate|| 39.159 || ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tathā grāmāṇāṃ pāṃgudeśakaḥ|| triṃśatsāhasra uktaśca grāmāṇāṃ ca vareṃdukaḥ|| 39.160 || paṃcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ mūlasthānaṃ prakīrtitam|| catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi grāmāṇāṃ yāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 39.161 || catvāryeva sahasrāṇi pakṣabāhurudīryate|| dvāsaptatiramī deśāḥ grāmasaṃkhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 39.162 || evaṃ bharatakhaṃḍe'sminṣaṇṇavatyeva koṭayaḥ|| dvāsaptatistathā lakṣāḥ pattanānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ|| 39.163 || ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi velākūlāni bhārata|| evaṃ vibhajya khaṃḍāni bhrātṛvyāṇāṃ dadau nava|| 39.164 || ātmīyamapi sā devī anicchuṣvapi teṣu ca|| yato mānyeti bhaginī prati krudhyaṃti bhrātaraḥ|| 39.165 || bhrātṝnprati bhaginī ca vicāryaiva dadau śubhā|| tatkṛtvā sānumānyaitānstaṃbhatīrthamupāgatā|| 39.166 || tadā teṣu ca deśeṣu caturvargasya sādhanam|| sarveṣāṃ pravaraṃ proktaṃ kumārīśvarameva ca|| 39.167 || tatrāpi guptakṣetraṃ ca vedaitatsā kumārikā|| guptakṣetre kumāreśaṃ pūjayaṃti mahāvratā|| 39.168 || tasthau snāyaṃtī ṣaṭsu caivāpi saṃgame|| tataḥ kālaprakarṣāc prāsāde skaṃdanirmite|| 39.169 || jīrṇe navyaṃ svarṇamayaṃ prāsādaṃ sāpyakārayat|| tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasyā bhaktyātitoṣitaḥ|| 39.170 || kumāraliṃgādutthāya pratyakṣastāmavocata|| bhadre tavāhaṃ bhaktyā ca vijñānena ca toṣitaḥ|| 39.171 || jīrṇaḥ punaruddhṛto'yaṃ prāsādastena toṣitaḥ|| tava nāmnā ca vikhyāto bhaviṣyāmi kumārike|| 39.172 || kartā cāpi tathoddhartā dvau vai samaphalau smṛtau|| kumāreśaḥ kumārīśa iti vakṣyaṃti māṃ tataḥ|| 39.173 || barkareśe ca ye datta varā dattāḥ sadaiva te|| tavāpi prāptaḥ kālaśca samīpe varavarṇini|| 39.174 || abhartṛkāyā nāryāśca na svargo mokṣa eva ca|| yathaiva vṛddhakanyāyāḥ sarasvatyāstaṭe śubhe|| 39.175 || tasmāttvamatra tīrthe ca mahākālamiti smṛtam|| siddhiṃ gataṃ vṛṇu bhadre patitve varavarṇini|| 39.176 || tataḥ sā rudravākyena varayāmāsa taṃ patim|| rudralokaṃ yayau cāpi mahākālasanvitā|| 39.177 || tatra tāṃ pārvatī prāha samāliṃgya praharṣitā|| yasmāttvayā citravacca likhitā pṛthivī śubhe|| 39.178 || citralekhetināmnā tvaṃ tasmādbhava sakhī mama|| tataḥ sakhī samabhavaccitralekheti sā śubhā|| 39.179 || yayāniruddhaḥ kathita uṣāyāḥ patiruttamaḥ|| yoginīnāṃ variṣṭhā yā mahākālasya vallabhā|| 39.180 || apsusā vārṣikaṃ biṃduṃ pūrṇe varṣaśate papau|| tapaścaraṃtī tasmātsā procyate cāpsarā divi|| 39.181 || evaṃvidhā kumārī sā liṃgametaddhi phālguna|| sthāpayāmāsa śivadaṃ barkareśvarasaṃjñitam|| 39.182 || tasmādatra nṛṇāṃ dāhaścāsthikṣepaśca bhārata|| prayāgādadhikau proktau maheśasya vaco yathā|| 39.183 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe barkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 39 || cha ||
<1.2.40>
||arjuna uvāca|| mahākālastvasau kaśca kathaṃ siddhimupāgataḥ|| asmiṃstīrthe muniśreṣṭha mahadāścarya matra me|| 40.1 || sarvametatsamākhyāhi śraddadhānāya pṛcchate|| 40.2 || ||nārada uvāca|| namaskṛtya mahākālaṃ varadaṃ sthāṇumavyayam|| śaktitaścaritaṃ tasya vakṣye pāṃḍukulodvaha|| 40.3 || vārāṇasyāṃ puri purā babhūva japatāṃ varaḥ|| rudrajāpī mahābhāgo māṃṭirnāma mahāyaśāḥ|| 40.4 || tasyāputrasya putrārthe rudrānsaṃjapataḥ kila|| gataṃ varṣaśataṃ tuṣṭastatastaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ|| 40.5 || māṃṭe tava suto dhīmānmatprabhāvaparākramaḥ|| vaṃśasya tava sarvasya samuddhartā bhaviṣyati|| 40.6 || iti śrutvā rudravaco māṃṭirharṣaṃ paraṃ gataḥ|| tataḥ kāle kiyanmātre patnī māṃṭermahātmanaḥ|| 40.7 || dadhāra garbhaṃ caṭikā tapomūrtidharā yathā|| tasya garbhasya varṣāṇi catvāri kila saṃyayuḥ|| 40.8 || na punarmāturudaraṃtyaktvā nirgacchate bahiḥ|| tato māṃṭirupāmaṃtrya sāmabhistamavocata|| 40.9 || vatsa sāmānyaputro'pi pitroḥ sukhakaraḥ sadā|| śuddhāyāṃ mātarī bhavomattaḥ kiṃ pīḍayasyalam|| 40.10 || vatsa mānuṣyavāsasya spṛhā tubhyaṃ kathaṃ na hi|| yatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasyāpi ca saṃtatiḥ|| 40.11 || kadāmanuṣyā jāyema pūjā yatra mahāphalā|| pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca nānādharmāśca yatra hi|| 40.12 || iti bhūtāni śocaṃti nānāyonigatānyapi|| tattvaṃ mānuṣyamatulaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ divaukasām|| anādṛtya kathaṃ brūhi sthitaścodara eva ca|| 40.13 || ||garbha uvāca|| tāta jānāmyahaṃ sarvametatparama durlabham|| kiṃ tu bibhemi cātimātraṃ kālamārgasya nityaśaḥ|| 40.14 || dvau mārgau kila vedeṣu proktau kālo'rcireva ca|| arciṣā mokṣamāyāṃti kālamārgeṇa karmaṇi|| 40.15 || svarge vā narake vāpi kālamārgagato hyayam|| na śarma labhate kvāpi vyādhaviddhamṛgo yathā|| 40.16 || tasyaiva hetoḥ prayatetkovido yanna duḥkhavit|| kālena ghorarupeṇa gaṃbhīreṇa samāhitaḥ|| 40.17 || taccenmama manastāta nānādoṣairna mohyate|| tato'haṃ durlabhaṃ janma mānuṣyaṃ śīghramāpnuyām|| 40.18 || tatastasya pitā pārtha kāṃdiśīko maheśvaram|| jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ trāhitrāhi maheśvara|| 40.19 || tvāṃ vinā ko'paro deva putrasyābhīṣṭado'sti me|| tvayaiva dattastvaṃ cāmuṃ janma prāpaya me sutam|| 40.20 || tatastasyātibhaktyāsau prāha tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ|| vibhūtīḥ svādharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryameva ca|| 40.21 || viparītaśca śīghraṃ bho māṃṭiputraḥ prabodhyatām|| tatastā dyotayaṃtyaśca vibhūtyo garbhamūciṃre|| 40.22 || mahāmate māṃḍiputra na dhāryaṃ te bhayaṃ hṛdi|| catvārastvāṃ hi dharmādyā manastyakṣyāmahe na te|| 40.23 || tato'parāstvadharmādyāḥ procurnaiva tathā vayam|| bhaviṣyāmo manastubhyamasmattava bhayaṃ na hi|| 40.24 || ityukte sa vibhūtībhiḥ śīghrameva kumārakaḥ|| niḥsasāra bahirjātaścakaṃpetiruroda ca|| 40.25 || tato vibhūtayaḥ prāhurmāṃṭe tava sutastvasau|| adyāpi kālamārgasya bhītaḥ kampati roditi|| 40.26 || kālabhītiriti khyātastasmādeṣa bhaviṣyati|| iti dattvā varaṃ tāśca mahādevāṃtikaṃ yayuḥ|| 40.27 || so'pi bālaḥ pravavṛdhe śuklapakṣa ivoḍupaḥ|| saṃskṛtaḥ sa ca saṃskārairdhīmānpaśupativratī|| 40.28 || paṃcamaṃtrāñjapañchuddhastīrthayātrāparo'bhavat|| rudrakṣetreṣu sasnau sa japanmantrāṃśca bhārata|| 40.29 || kālabhītiguptakṣetraguṇāñchrutvābhyupāyayau|| snātvā tato mahītoye japtvā mantrāṃśca koṭiśaḥ|| 40.30 || nivṛtto nātidūretha bilvavṛkṣaṃ dadarśa saḥ|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ tasya cādhastallakṣamekaṃ jajāpa saḥ|| 40.31 || japatastasya viprasya iṃdriyāṇi layaṃ yayuḥ|| kevalaṃ paramānaṃdasvarūpo'sāvabhūtkṣaṇāt|| 40.32 || tasyānaṃdasya naupamyaṃ svargādīnāṃ bhavetkvacit|| gaṃgodakasyeva mānaṃ kevalaṃ so'pyasāvapi|| 40.33 || tatra līno muhurtena punaścābhūdyathā purā|| tato visiṣmiye pārtha kālabhītiruvāca ha|| 40.34 || nāyaṃ mama mahānando vārāṇasyāṃ na namiṣe|| na prabhāse na kedāre na cāpyamarakaṇṭake|| 40.35 || śrīparvate na cānyatra yādṛśodyapravarttate|| nirvikārāṇi svacchāni gaṃgāṃbāṃsīvakhāni me|| 40.36 || bhūteṣu paramā prītistrijagaddyotate sphuṭam|| dharmamekaṃ paraṃ mahyaṃ cetaścāpyavagacchati|| 40.37 || aho sthānaprabhāvo'yaṃ sphuṭaṃ cāpyatra procyate|| nirdoṣaṃ yacchuci stāna sarvopadravavarjitam|| 40.38 || tatra sthitasya dharmārthastadvadbhūyātsahasradhā|| tadasmācca prabhāvāddhi jānāmītaḥ svacetasi|| 40.39 || viśiṣṭaṃ kāśimukhyebhyastīrthebhyaḥ sthānakaṃ tvidam|| tasmādatraiva saṃsthohaṃ tapastapsyāmi puṣkalam|| 40.40 || idaṃ cedaṃ tīrthamiti sadā yastṛṣitaścaret|| na sa siddhimavāpnoti kleśenaiva mriyeta saḥ|| 40.41 || iti saṃciṃtya bilvasya vṛkṣasyādho vyavasthitaḥ|| jajāpa mantrānrudrasya aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa dhiṣṭhitaḥ|| 40.42 || gṛhītvā niyamaṃ toyabiṃduṃ varṣaśate'gnivat|| tato varṣaśate yāte japatastasya bhārata|| 40.43 || kaścitto yabhṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ gṛhītvā nara āvrajat|| sataṃ praṇamya prāhedaṃ kālabhītiṃ praharṣataḥ|| 40.44 || adya te niyamaḥ pūrṇastoyametanmahāmate|| gṛhāṇa saphalaṃ mahyaṃ śramaṃ kartumihārhasi|| 40.45 || ||kālabhītiruvāca|| ko bhavānvarṇato brūhi kimācāraśca tattvataḥ|| janmācārau viditvā te grahīṣyāmyanyathā na hi|| 40.46 || ||nara uvāca|| na jāne pitarau svīyau naṣṭau vā sarvathā na hi|| evamevāpi paśyāmi sarvadā'haṃ sa eva ca|| 40.47 || ācāraiścāpi dharmaiśca na kāryaṃ mama kiṃcana|| tasmādvakṣyāmi nāpyetanna cāpyasmi samācare|| 40.48 || ||kālabhītiruvāca|| yadyevaṃ nodakaṃ tubhyaṃ grahīṣyāmyasmi karhicit|| śrṛṇuṣvātra vaco yanme gururāha śrutīritam|| 40.49 || na jñāyate kulaṃ yasya bījaśuddhiṃ vinā tataḥ|| tasya khādanpibanvāpi sādhuḥ sīdati tatkṣaṇāt|| 40.50 || yaśca rudraṃ na jānāti rudrabhaktaśca yo nahi|| annodakaṃ tasya bhuñjanpātakī syānna saṃśayaḥ|| 40.51 || ajñātvā yaḥ śivaṃ bhukte kathyate so'tra brahmahā|| mārṣṭi ca brahmahānnāde tasmāttasya na bhakṣayet|| 40.52 || gaṃgodakumbhaḥ syādyadvattanmadhye madya biṃdunā|| aśivajñasya yo bhuṃkte śivajño'pi tathaiva saḥ|| 40.53 || hīnavarṇaśca yaḥ syāddhi śivabhakto'pi naiva saḥ|| pratigṛhyau guṇau tasmādvilokyau dvau pratigrahe|| 40.54 || ||nara uvāca|| etena tava vākyena hāsyaṃ saṃjāyate mama|| aho mugdho'si mithyā tvamapasmārī jaḍo'pi ca|| 40.55 || sadā sarveṣu bhūteṣu śivo vasati nityaśaḥ|| sādhvasādhu tato vākyaṃ naiva nindā śivasya sā|| 40.56 || ātmanaśca parasyāpi yaḥ karotyaṃtaro haram|| tasya bhinnadṛśo mṛtyurvidadhe bhayamulbaṇam|| 40.57 || athavā kā hi pānīye bhavedaśucitā vada|| mṛttikodbhavakumbho'yaṃ pāvakenāpi pācitaḥ|| 40.58 || pūrṇaśca payasā kasminneṣāmasucitā kutaḥ|| 40.59 || atha cenmama saṃsargādaśucitvaṃ ca mīyate|| tadasyāṃ saṃsthitaḥ pṛthvyāmahaṃtvaṃ ca kuto vada|| 40.60 || kutaḥ pṛthivyāṃ carasi khe tvaṃ naiva carasyuta|| evaṃ vicāryamāṇe te bhāṣitaṃ mugdhavadbhavet|| 40.61 || ||kālabhītiruvāca|| sarvabhūteṣu cedevaṃ śiva eveti cocyate|| nāstikāṃ mṛttikā kasmādbhakṣayaṃti nabhasyake|| 40.62 || śuddhyarthaṃ tena viśvasya sthāpitā saṃsthitiryathā|| phalena pālitā sā ca nānyathā tāṃ śrṛṇuṣva ca|| 40.63 || sasarjeti purā dhātā rūpātmakamidaṃ jagat|| tacca nāmaprapañcena baddhaṃ dāmnā ca gauryathā|| 40.64 || sa ca nāmaprapañcastu caturddhā bhidyate kila|| dhvanirvarṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityāspadacatuṣṭayam|| 40.65 || tatra dhvanirnādamayo varṇāścākārapūrvakāḥ|| padaṃ `śā vami' ti proktaṃ vākyaṃ ceti śivaṃ' bhajet|| 40.66 || taccāpi vākyaṃ trividhaṃ bhavediti śrutermatam|| prabhusammatamekaṃ ca suhṛtsaṃmatameva ca|| 40.67 || kāṃtāsaṃmatamevāpi vākyaṃ hi trividhaṃ viduḥ|| prabhuḥ svāmī yathā bhṛtyamādiśatyetadācara|| 40.68 || tathā śrutismṛtī cobhe prāhatuḥ prabhusaṃmatam|| itihāsapurāṇādi suhṛtsaṃmatamucyate|| 40.69 || suhṛdvatpratibodhyainaṃ pravartayati tattvataḥ|| kāvyālāpādikaṃ yacca kāṃtāsaṃmatamucyate|| 40.70 || prabhuvākyaṃ smṛtaṃ yacca sabāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ śuci|| suhṛdvākyaṃ tathā śaucaṃ pālayetsvargakāṃkṣayā|| 40.71 || tadetatpālanīyaṃ syādbhūmijānāṃ śrutirvadet|| tvayā nāstikyavākyena cedetadabhidhīyate|| 40.72 || etena śrutiśāstrāṇi purāṇaṃ ca vṛtaiva kim|| agre saptarṣipūrvā ye brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā bhavan|| 40.73 || mugdhāḥ sarve'bhavandakṣā ye hi vedaṃ gatā hyanu|| tathā vedāṃtavacanaṃ sattvasthā hyūrdhvagāminaḥ|| 40.74 || tiṣṭhaṃti rājasā madhye hyadho gacchaṃti tāmasāḥ|| sattvāhāraiḥ sattvavṛttyā svargagāmī bhavettataḥ|| 40.75 || na caitadapya sūyāmo yadbhūteṣu śivo na hi|| astyeva sarvabhūteṣu śrṛṇvatrāpyupamānakam|| 40.76 || yathā suvarṇajātāni bhūṣaṇāni bahūni ca|| kānicicchraddharūpāṇi hīnarūpāṇi kānicit|| 40.77 || svarṇaṃ sarveṣu cāstyeva tathaiva sa sadāśivaḥ|| hīnarūpaṃ śodhitaṃ sacchuddhimeti na caikatām|| 40.78 || tathedaṃ śodhitaṃ dehaṃ śuddhaṃ divi vrajetsphuṭam|| tasmātsarvātmanā hīnānna grāhyaṃ bata dhīmatā|| 40.79 || cedidaṃ śodhayeddehaṃ naiva grāhyaṃ samaṃtataḥ|| sarvato yaḥ prati grāhī nihārāhārayorna ca|| 40.80 || śuciḥ syādalpadivasātpāṣāṇo'sau bhavetsphuṭam|| tasmātsarvātmanā naiva grahīṣyehaṃ jalaṃ sphuṭam|| 40.81 || sādhuvāpyathavā'sādhu pramāṇaṃ naḥ śrutiḥ parā|| evamukte sa ca naraḥ prahasandakṣiṇena ca|| 40.82 || aṃguṣṭhena likhanbhūmiṃ cakre gartaṃ mahottamam|| tatra cikṣepa tattoyaṃ tena gartaḥ sma pūritaḥ|| 40.83 || atyaricyata toyaṃ ca cakre pādena saṃlikhan|| cakre saraḥ pūritaṃ cāpyatiriktajalena tat|| 40.84 || tadadbhutaṃ mahaddṛṣṭvā naiva vipro visiṣmiye|| yato bahuvidhaṃ citraṃ bhavedbhūtādyupāsiṣu|| 40.85 || taccitreṇa na jahyācca śrutimārgaṃ sanātanam|| 40.86 || ||nara uvāca|| atimūrkhosi vipratvaṃ prajñāvādāṃśca bhāṣase|| kiṃ na śrutastvayā ślokaḥ purāvidbhirudīritaḥ|| kūponyasya ghaṭo'nyasya rajjuranyasya bhārata|| 40.87 || pāyaṃtyanye pibaṃtyanye sarve te samabhāginaḥ|| tajjalaṃ mama kasmāttvaṃ dharmajño na pibasyasi|| 40.88 || ||nārada uvāca|| tato vimamṛśe śloko bahudhā samabhāginām|| aniścayādvicāryāsau ghaṭādyaiḥ samabhāgitā|| 40.89 || bahupotadravyakṣepaḥ sarvaiḥ sā samabhāgitā|| evaṃ kartuḥ phalaiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃ syācca punaḥpunaḥ|| 40.90 || yaḥ śuciśca śivaṃ dhyāyanprāsādakūpakartari|| jalapratigrahābhāvātpibato'sya samaṃ phalam|| 40.91 || iti niścitya provāca kālabhītirnaraṃ ca tam|| satyametkiṃ tu kuṃbhapayasā gartapūraṇe|| 40.92 || dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣato mādṛkkathaṃ pibati bho vada|| sādhu vāpyathavā'sādhu na pibeyaṃ kathaṃcana|| 40.93 || evaṃ viniścayaṃ dṛṣṭvāsya sthiraṃ kurunaṃdana|| puruṣo'sau prahasyaiva kṣaṇādaṃtardadhe tataḥ|| 40.94 || kālabhītiśca paramaṃ vismayaṃ samupāgataḥ|| vṛttāṃtaḥ koyamityeva ciṃtayāmāsa bhūyasā|| 40.95 || tataściṃtayatastasya bilvādhastātsuśobhanam|| ucchritaṃ sumahāliṃgaṃ pṛthivyā dyotayaddiśaḥ|| 40.96 || prādurbhāve tatastasya mahāliṃgasya bhārata|| nanarta khepsarovṛṃdaṃ gadharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ|| 40.97 || pārijātamayīṃ puṣpavṛṣṭimiṃdro mumoca ha|| jayeti devā munayastuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ|| 40.98 || tasminmahati kauravya vartamāne mahotsave|| kālabhītiḥ pramuditaḥ praṇamya stotramairayat|| 40.99 || pāpasya kālaṃ bhavapaṃkakālaṃ kalākalaṃ kālamārgasya kālam|| devaṃ mahākālamahaṃ prapadye śrīkālakaṃṭhaṃ bhavakālarūpam|| 40.100 || īśānavaktraṃ praṇamāmi tvāhaṃ stauti śrutiḥ sarvavidyeśvarastvam|| bhūteśvarastvaṃ prapitāmahastvaṃ tasmai namastestu maheśvarāya|| 40.101 || yaṃ stauti vedastamahaṃ prapadye tatpuruṣasaṃjñaṃ śaraṇaṃ dvitīyam|| tvāṃ vidmahe tac nastvaṃ pradehi śrīrudra deveśa namonamaste|| 40.102 || aghoravaktraṃ tritayaṃ prapadye atharvajuṣṭaṃ tava rūpakāṇi|| aghoraghorāṇi ca ghoraghorāṇyahaṃ sadānaumi bhūtāni tubhyam|| 40.103 || caturthavaktraṃ ca sadā prapadye sadyobhijātāya namonamaste|| bhavebhavenādibhavo bhavasva bhavodbhavo māṃ śiva tatratatra|| 40.104 || namostu te vāmadevāya jyeṣṭharudrāya kālāya kalāvikāriṇe|| balaṃkarāyāpi balapramāthine bhūtāni haṃtre ca manonmanāya|| 40.105 || triyaṃbakaṃ tvāṃ ca yajāmahe vayaṃ supuṇyagaṃdhaiḥ śivapuṣṭivardhanam|| urvārukaṃ pakvamivograbaṃdhanādrakṣasva māṃ tryaṃbaka mṛtyumārgāt|| 40.106 || ṣaḍakṣaraṃ maṃtravaraṃ taveśa japaṃti ye munayo vītarāgāḥ|| teṣāṃ prasanno'si japāmahetaṃ tvoṃkārapūrvaṃ ca namaḥ śivāya|| 40.107 || evaṃ stuto mahādevo liṃgānniḥsṛtya bhārata|| trijagaddyotayanmabhāsā pratyakṣaḥ prāha ca dvijam|| 40.108 || yattvayātra mahātīrthe bhṛśamārādhito dvija|| tenāti tuṣṭaste vatsa neśaḥ kālaḥ kathaṃcana|| 40.109 || ahaṃ ca nararūpī yo dṛṣṭvā te dharmasaṃsthitim|| dhanyastaddharmamārgo'yaṃ pālyate yadbhavadvidhaiḥ|| 40.110 || sarvatīrthodakairgarataḥ pūrito me sarastathā|| jalametanmahāpuṇyaṃ tvadarthaṃ me samāhṛtam|| 40.111 || saptamaṃtrarahasyaṃ ca yatkṛtaṃ stavanaṃ mama|| anena paṭhyamānena saptamaṃtraphalaṃ bhavet|| 40.112 || abhīṣṭaṃ ca varaṃ matto vṛṇīṣva manasepsitam|| tvayātitoṣito hyasminādeyaṃ vidyate tava|| 40.113 || ||kālabhītiruvāca|| dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yattvaṃ tuṣṭo'si śaṃkara|| tvattoṣātsaphalā dharmāḥ śramāyaivānyatāmatāḥ|| 40.114 || yadi tuṣṭo'si sāṃnidyaṃ liṃge'tra kriyatāṃ sadā|| akṣayaṃ tatkṛtaṃ cāstu yalliṃge kriyate'tra ca|| 40.115 || japato yatphalaṃ devapaṃcamaṃtrāyutena ca|| tatphalaṃ jāyatāṃ naṇāmasya liṃgasya darśane|| 40.116 || kālamārgādahaṃ yasmānmocito'haṃ maheśvara|| mahākālamiti khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ tasmādbhavatvidam|| 40.117 || asmiṃśca kūpe yo martyaḥ snātvā tarpayate pitṝn|| sarvatīrthaphalaṃ cāstu pitṝṇāmakṣayā gatiḥ|| 40.118 || iti tasyavacaḥ śrutvā prītastaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt|| svāyaṃbhuvaṃ yatra liṃgaṃ tatra nityaṃ vasāmyaham|| 40.119 || svayaṃbhubāṇaratnotthadātupāṣāṇalohajam|| liṃgaṃ krameṇa phaladamaṃtyātpūrvaṃ daśottaram|| 40.120 || ākāśe tārakāliṃgaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram|| svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dhārapṛṣṭhe tadetattritayaṃ samam|| 40.121 || viśeṣātprārthitaṃ yacca tacca bhaviṣyati|| atra puṣpaṃ phalaṃ pūjā naivedyaṃ stavanakriyā|| 40.122 || dānaṃ vānyaśca yatkiṃcidakṣayaṃ tadbhaviṣyati|| māghāsitacaturdaśyāṃ śivayoge ca putraka|| 40.123 || liṃgācca pūrvataḥ kūpesnātvā yastarpayetpitṝn|| sarvatīrthaphalāvāptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā gatiḥ|| 40.124 || tasyāṃ rātrau mahākālaṃ yāmeyāme prapūjayet|| yaḥ kṣipetsarvaliṃgeṣu sa jāgaraphalaṃ labhet|| 40.125 || jiteṃdriyaśca yo nityaṃ māṃ liṃgetra prapūjayet|| bhuktimuktī na dūrasthe tasya nityaṃ dvijottama|| 40.126 || māghe caturdaśyaṣṭamyāṃ somavāre ca parvaṇi|| snātvā sarasi yo'bhyarcya liṃgametacchivaṃ vrajet|| 40.127 || dānaṃ tapo rudrajāpaḥ sarvamakṣayameva ca|| tvaṃ ca nandī dvitīyo me pratīhāro bhaviṣyasi|| 40.128 || kālamārgajayādvatsa mahākālā bhidhaściram|| karaṃdhamo'tra rājarṣiracirādāgamiṣyati|| 40.129 || tasya procya bhavāndharmāṃstato mallokamāvraja|| ityuktvā bhagavānrudro liṃgamadhye nyalīyata|| 40.130 || mahākālo'pi muditastatra tepe mahattapaḥ|| 40.131 || ||iti mahākālaprādurbhāvaḥ|| ||nārada uvāca|| atha kenāpi kālena pārtha rājā karaṃdhamaḥ|| viśeṣamicchurdharmeṣu śrutvā tīrthamahāguṇān|| 40.132 || mahākālacaritraṃ ca tatraiva samupāyayau|| mahīsāgara toye'sau snātvā liṃgānyathārcayat|| 40.133 || mahākālamanuprāpya paramāṃ prītimāgataḥ|| sa paśyansumahāliṃgaṃ nātṛpyata janesvaraḥ|| 40.134 || yathā daridraḥ kṛpaṇo nidhikumbhamavāpya ca|| saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mene mahākālaṃ nirīkṣya saḥ|| 40.135 || paṃcamaṃtrāyutajapaphalaṃ yasyeha darśanāt|| tataḥ saparyayākṣyarcya mahatyāsau praṇamya ca|| 40.136 || śrutvā ca liṃgapravaraṃ mahākālamupāsadat|| tato rudravacaḥ smṛtvā mahākālaḥ smayanniva|| 40.137 || pratyudgamya nṛpaṃ pūjāmarghaṃ ca pratyapādayat|| tataḥ kuśalapraśrādi kṛtvā śāṃtamukhaṃ nṛpaḥ|| 40.138 || mahākālamupāmaṃtrya kathāṃte vākyamabravīt|| bhagavansaṃśayo mahyaṃ sadā'yaṃ parivartate|| 40.139 || yadidaṃ tarpaṇaṃnāma pitṝṇāṃ kriyate nṛbhiḥ|| jalamadhye jalaṃ yāti kathaṃ tṛpyaṃti pūrvajāḥ|| 40.140 || evaṃ piṃḍādipūjā ca sarvamatraiva dṛśyate|| kathamevaṃ sma manyāmaḥ pitrādyairupabhujyate|| 40.141 || na caitadasti yatteṣāṃ nopatiṣṭhati kiṃcana|| svapne yathākramya naraṃ dṛśyaṃte yācakāśca te|| 40.142 || devānāṃ cāpi dṛśyaṃte pratyakṣāḥ pratyayāḥ sadā|| tatkathaṃ pratigṛhṇanti mano me'tra pramuhyati|| 40.143 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| yonirevaṃvidā teṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca divaukasām|| dūroktaṃ dūrapūjā ca dūrastutirathāpi yat|| 40.144 || bhavyaṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ jānaṃti yāṃti ca|| paṃcatanmātrarūpaṃ ca manobuddhirahaṃjaḍāḥ|| 40.145 || navatattavamayaṃ dehaṃ daśamaḥ puruṣo mataḥ|| tasmādgaṃdhena tṛpyaṃti rasatattvena te tathā|| 40.146 || śabdatattvena tuṣyaṃti sparśatattvaṃ ca gṛhṇate|| śuci dṛṣṭvā ta tuṣyaṃti nātra rājanbhavenmṛṣā|| 40.147 || yatā tṛṇaṃ paśūnāṃ ca narāṇāmannamucyate|| evaṃ daivatayonīnāmannasārasya bhojanam|| 40.148 || śaktayaḥ sarvabhāvānāmaciṃtyā jñānagocarāḥ|| tasmāttattvaṃ pragṛhṇanti śeṣamatraivadṛśyate|| 40.149 || ||karaṃdhama uvāca|| pitṛbhyo dīyate śrāddhaṃ svakarmavaśagāśca te|| svargasthā narakasthā vā kathaṃ tairupabhujyate|| 40.150 || atha svarge'tha nareka sthitāḥ karmābhiyaṃtritāḥ|| śaknuvaṃti varānetāndātuṃ te ceśvarāḥ katham|| 40.151 || āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukāni ca|| prayacchantu tathā rājyaṃ prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ|| 40.152 ||
