||mahākāla uvāca|| satyametatasvakarmasthāḥ pitaro yannṛpottama|| kiṃ tu devāsurāṇāṃ ca yakṣādīnāmamūrtakāḥ|| 40.153 || mūrtāścaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ pitaraḥ saptadhā smṛtāḥ|| te hi sarve prayacchaṃti dātuṃ sarvaṃ yatopsitam|| 40.154 || ekatriṃśadgaṇā yeṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ prabalā nṛpa|| kṛtaṃ ca tadidaṃ śrāddhaṃ tarpayettānparānpitṝn|| 40.155 || te tṛptāstarpayantyasya pūrvajānyatra saṃsthitān|| evaṃ svānāṃ copatiṣṭhecchrāddhaṃ yacchaṃti te varān|| 40.156 || ||rājovāca|| bhūtādibhyo yathā vipra nāmnā voddiśya dīyate|| surādīnāṃ kathaṃ caiva saṃkṣepeṇa na dīyate|| 40.157 || idaṃ pitṛbhyo devebhyo dvijebhyaḥ pāvakāya ca|| evaṃ kasmādvistarāḥ syurmanaḥ kāyādikaṣṭadāḥ|| 40.158 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| ucitā pratipattiśca kāryā sarveṣu nityaśaḥ|| pratipattiṃ cocitāṃ te vinā gṛhṇanti naiva ca|| 40.159 || yathā śvā gṛhadvārasthobaliṃ gṛhṇāti kiṃ tathā|| pradhānapuruṣo rājangṛhṇāti ca śunā samaḥ|| 40.160 || evaṃ te bhūtavaddevā na hi gṛhṇanti karhicit|| śuci kāmaṃ juṣaṃte na haviraśraddadhānataḥ|| 40.161 || vinā maṃtraiśca yaddattaṃ na tadgṛhṇanti te'malāḥ|| śrutirapyatra prāhedaṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ viṣaye nṛpa|| 40.162 || "maṃtrā daivatā yadyadvidvānmantravatkaroti devatābhireva tatkaroti yaddadāni devatabhireva taddadāti yatpratigṛhṇāti devatābhireva tatpratigṛhṇāti tasmānnāmantravatpratigṛhṇīyāt nāmantravatpratipadyate" iti|| 40.163 || tasmānmaṃtraiḥ sadā deyaṃ paurāṇairvaidikairapi|| anyathā te na gṛhṇanti bhūtānāmupatiṣṭhati|| 40.164 || ||rājovāca|| darbhāṃstilānakṣatāṃśca toyaṃ caitaiḥ susaṃyutam|| kasmātpradīyate dānaṃ jñātumicchāmi kāraṇam|| 40.165 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| purā kila pradattāni bhūmerdānāni bhūriśaḥ|| pratyagṛhṇanta daityāśca praviśyābhyaṃtaraṃ balāt|| 40.166 || tato devāśca pitaraḥ pratyūcuḥ padmasaṃbhavam|| 40.167 || svāminnaḥ paśyatāmeva sarvaṃ daityaiḥ pragṛhyate|| vidhehi rakṣāṃ teṣāṃ tvaṃ na naṣṭaḥ smo yathā vayam|| 40.168 || tato vimṛśyaiva vidhī rakṣo pāyamacīkarat|| tilairyuktaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca devānāmakṣataiḥ saha|| 40.169 || toyaṃ darbhāṃśca sarvatra evaṃ gṛhṇanti nāsurāḥ|| etānvinā pradattaṃ yatphalaṃ daityaiḥ pragṛhyate|| 40.170 || niḥśvasya pitaro devā yāṃti dātuḥ phalaṃ na hi|| tasmādyugeṣu sarveṣu dānameva pradīyate|| 40.171 || ||karaṃdhama uvāca|| caturyugavyavasthānaṃ śrotumicchami tattvataḥ|| mahatīyaṃ vivitsā me sadaiva parivartate|| 40.172 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ viddhitatastretāyugaṃ smṛtam|| dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti catvāraśca samāsataḥ|| 40.173 || sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā dvāparaṃ ca rajastamaḥ|| kalistamastu vijñeyaṃ yugavṛttaṃ yugeṣu ca|| 40.174 || dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛkayuge tretāyāṃ yajña ucyate|| vṛttaṃ ca dvāpare satyaṃ dānameva kalau yuge|| 40.175 || kṛte tu mānasī sṛṣṭirvṛttiḥ sākṣādrasollasā|| tejomayyaḥ prajāstṛptāḥ sadānaṃdāśca bhoginaḥ|| 40.176 || adhamottamo na tāsāṃ tā nirviśeṣāḥ prajāḥ śubhāḥ|| tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasminkṛte yuge|| 40.177 || na cāprītirna ca dvaṃdvo na dveṣo nāpi ca klamaḥ|| parvatodadhivāsinyo hyanukrośapriyāstu tāḥ|| 40.178 || varṇāśramavyavasthā ca tadāsīnna hi saṃkaraḥ|| ekamanyaṃ na dhyāyaṃti paramaṃ te sadā śivam|| 40.179 || caturthe ca tataḥ pāde naṣṭa sā'bhūdrasollasā|| prādurāsaṃstatastāsāṃ vṛkṣāśvagṛhasaṃjñitāḥ|| 40.180 || vastrāṇi ca prasūyaṃte phalānyābharaṇāni ca|| teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gaṃdhavarṇarasānvitam|| 40.181 || sumākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu|| tena tā vartayaṃti sma kṛtasyāṃte prajāstadā|| 40.182 || hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstathā vṛddhāḥ prajā vai vigatajvarāḥ|| tataḥ kālena kenāpi tāsāṃ vṛddhe raseṃdriye|| 40.183 || yugabhāvāttathā dhyāne svalpībhūte śivasya ca|| vṛkṣāṃstānparyagṛhṇaṃta madhu vā mākṣikaṃ balāt|| 40.184 || tāsāṃ tenopacāreṇa lobhadoṣakṛtena vai|| pranaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacitkvacit|| 40.185 || tasyāṃ cāpyalpaśiṣṭāyāṃ dvaṃdvānyabhyutthitāni vai|| śītātapairmanoduḥkhaistatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam|| 40.186 || cakrurāvaraṇārthaṃ hi ketanāni tatastataḥ|| tataḥ pradurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ|| 40.187 || vṛṣṭyā babhūvurauṣadhyo grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa|| akṛṣṭapacyānūptāstoyabhūmisamāgamāt|| 40.188 || ṛtu puṣpaphalaiścaiva vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire|| taiśca vṛttirabhūttāsāṃ dhānyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā|| 40.189 || tataḥ punarabhūttāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvataḥ|| kālavīryeṇa vā gṛhya nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān|| 40.190 || vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahyāśu yathābalam|| viparyayeṇa cauṣadhyaḥ pranaṣṭāśca caturdaśa|| 40.191 || natvā dharāṃ praviṣṭāstā oṣadhyaḥ pīḍitāḥ prajāḥ|| dudoha gāṃ pṛthurvainyaḥ sarvabhūtahitāya vai|| 40.192 || tadāprabhṛti cauṣadhyaḥ phālakṛṣṭāḥ prajāstataḥ|| vārttayā vartayaṃti sma pālyamānāśca kṣatriyaiḥ|| 40.193 || varṇāśramapratiṣṭhā ca yajñastretāsu cocyate|| sadāśivadhyānamayaṃ tyaktvā mokṣamacetanāḥ|| 40.194 || puṣpitāṃ vācamāśritya rāgātsvargamasādhayan|| dvāpare ca pravartaṃte matibhedāstato nṛṇām|| 40.195 || manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasidhyati|| lobho'dhṛtiḥ śivaṃ tyaktvā dharmāṇāṃ saṃkarastathā|| 40.196 || varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsāḥ pravartaṃte ca dvāpare|| tadā vyāsaiścaturddhā ca vyasyate dvāparāttataḥ|| 40.197 || eko vedaścatuṣpādaiḥ kriyate dvijahetave|| itihāsapurāṇāni bhidyaṃte lokagauravāt|| 40.198 || brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā|| tathānyannāradīya ca mārkaṃḍeyaṃ ca saptamama|| 40.199 || āgneyamaṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ navamaṃ smṛtam|| daśamaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṃgamekādaśaṃ tathā|| 40.200 || vārāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ caiva skāṃdaṃ caiva trayodaśam|| caturdaśaṃ vāmanaṃ ca kaurmaṃ paṃcadaśaṃ smṛtam|| 40.201 || mātsyaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ proktaṃ gāruḍaṃ ca tataḥ param|| ataḥ paraṃ tu brahmāṃḍamevañcāṣṭādaśāni hi|| 40.202 || asminvārāhakalpe ca vyāsānākarṇayasva ca|| ṛtuḥ satyo bhārgavaśca aṃgirāḥ savitā tathā|| 40.203 || mṛtyuḥ śatakraturdhīmānvasiṣṭho bhavitā'dhunā|| sārasvatastridhāmā ca vedavittrivṛto muniḥ|| 40.204 || śatatejāḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurnārāyaṇa iti smṛtaḥ|| karakaścāruṇirdhīmāstathā deva ṛtaṃjayaḥ|| 40.205 || kṛtaṃjayo bharadvājo gautamaḥ kavisattamaḥ|| vājaśravā muniścaiva tathā yuṣmāyaṇo muniḥ|| 40.206 || tṛṇabiṃdustathā ṛkṣaḥ śaktiḥ pārāśarastathā|| jātūkarṇyo'tha viṣṇuśca svayaṃdvaipāyano muniḥ|| 40.207 || aśvatthāmamukhāścaite bhaviṣyāḥ sūcitāstava|| dharmaśāstrāṇi lokārthaṃ bhidyaṃte cāpi dvāpare|| 40.208 || manvatriviṣṇuhāritayājñavalkyośanoṃgirāḥ|| yamāpastaṃbasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī|| 40.209 || parāśaravyāsaśaṃkhalikhitā dakṣagautamau|| śātātapo vasiṣṭhaśca dharmaśāstraprayojakāḥ|| 40.210 || tato dvāparasaṃdhyāyāṃ pravartati kalau yuge|| naśyamāne śaivayoge jāyaṃte yoganaṃdanāḥ|| 40.211 || ādye śvetakalaurudraḥ sutārastāraṇastathā|| suhotraḥ kaṃkaṇaścaiva lokākhyaśca mahāmuniḥ|| 40.212 || jaigīṣavyaśca bhāvyo vai bhagavāndadhivāhanaḥ|| ṛṣabhaśca munirdharmaugraścātriḥ sabālakaḥ|| 40.213 || gautamau vedaśīrṇaśca gokarṇaśca śikhaṃḍibhṛt|| gṛhāvāsī jaṭāmālī aṭṭahāsaśca dāruṇaḥ|| 40.214 || lāṃgalī saṃyamī śūlī ḍiṃḍī juṇḍīśvaraḥ svayam|| sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca lakulīśaśca pārthiva|| 40.215 || kāyāvarohaṇo bhāvītyādyā yogeśvarāḥ kramāt|| ete saṃkṣipta vakṣyaṃti śivadharmaṃ kalau yuge|| 40.216 || evaṃ kaliyuge rājañchāstrasaṃkṣepa ucyate|| śrṛṇu tiṣyapravṛttiṃ ca harṣodvegakarīṃ kila|| 40.217 || tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām|| sādhayaṃti narāstatra tamasā vyākuleṃdriyāḥ|| 40.218 || kalau pramāthako rāgaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca|| anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ|| 40.219 || na pramāṇaṃ śruterasti nṛṇāṃ cādharmasevanāt|| adhārmikāstvanācārā mahākopālpatejasaḥ|| 40.220 || anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhā nārīprāyāśca duṣprajāḥ|| duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ|| 40.221 || viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ|| utsīdaṃti kṣatraviśo vardhaṃte śūdraviprakāḥ|| 40.222 || śūdrā vipraiḥ sahāsaṃte śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ|| śūdrāśca brāhmaṇācārāḥ śūdrācārāśca brāhmaṇāḥ|| 40.223 || rājavṛttyāṃ sthitāścaurāścaurācārāśca pārthivāḥ|| ekapatnyo na śiṣyaṃti vardhayaṃtyabhisārikāḥ|| 40.224 || tadā hyalpaphalā bhūmiḥ kvaciccāpi mahāphalā|| arakṣitāro hartāro rājānaḥ pāpanirbhayāḥ|| 40.225 || akṣatriyāstu rājāno viprāḥ śūdroṣajīvinaḥ|| śūdrā vivādinaḥ sarve brāhmaṇairabhinaṃditāḥ|| 40.226 || āsanasthāndvijāndṛṣṭvā calaṃtyatyalapabuddhayaḥ|| āsye nidhāya vai hastaṃ karṇe śūdrāsya ca dvijāḥ|| 40.227 || nīcasyāpi tadā vākyaṃ vakṣyaṃti vinayena tam|| uccāsanasthāñchūdrāṃśca dvijānāṃ paśyatāmapi|| 40.228 || jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā paśya kālabalaṃ nṛpa|| puṣpaiḥ śubhasitaiścaiva tathānyairmaṃḍanairdvijāḥ|| 40.229 || śūdrānabhyarcayaṃtyalpaśrutabhāgyabalānvitāḥ|| pāṣaṃḍināṃ ca gṛhṇaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ kupratigraham|| 40.230 || yena te rauravaṃ yāṃti sudustāraṃ dvijādhamāḥ|| tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijāstathā|| 40.231 || yatayaśca bhaviṣyaṃti bahavaḥ koṭiśaḥ kalau|| puruṣālpabahustrīko nṛṇāṃ cāpatyasaṃbhavaḥ|| 40.232 || niṃdaṃti vedavākyāni vedārthāṃśca kalau yuge|| śūdraiḥ svayaṃ nirmitaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ śāstrameva tat|| 40.233 || śvāpadaprabalatvaṃ ca gavāṃ cāpi parikṣayaḥ|| kasyaciddānaprabhṛtidharmasyāsti na śuddhatā|| 40.234 || sādhūnāṃ bahavo nāśāḥ pārthivāścāpyarakṣiṇaḥ|| aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ|| 40.235 || pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge|| strīpradhānāni gehāni kucailāstāśca karkaśāḥ|| 40.236 || bahubhakṣyāvaliptāśca kṛtyā iva bhavaṃti ca|| sarve vaṇigjanāścāpi citravarṣī ca vāsavaḥ|| 40.237 || kuśīlacaryāpāṣaṃḍairvṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ|| bahuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparī|| 40.238 || aśaṃkaścaiva pāpeṣu tadā loko bhaviṣyati|| hartāraḥ pararatnānāṃ paradārapradharṣakāḥ|| 40.239 || ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣāśca prajāyaṃte yugakṣaye|| tathā dvādaśavarṣāśca prasavaṃti striyastadā|| 40.240 || caurāścaurasya hartāro harturharttā tathāparaḥ|| jñānakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate|| 40.241 || kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyaṃti mānavān|| varṇāśramāṇāṃ ye cānye pāṣaṃḍāḥ paripaṃthinaḥ|| 40.242 || te tadā prodbhaviṣyaṃti teṣaāṃ vṛddhiśca pārthiva|| duḥkhaṃ putrakalatrādyaṃ dehotsādaḥ sarogatā|| 40.243 || adharmābhiniveśatvāttamaso jāyate kalau|| kalerdoṣanidheścaiva śrṛṇuṣvaivaṃ mahāguṇam|| 40.244 || tadālpenaiva kāle na siddhiṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ|| triyugīnā vadaṃtyevaṃ dhanyā dharmaṃ caraṃti ye|| 40.245 || śrutismṛtipurāṇoktaṃ kalau śraddhāparāyaṇāḥ|| tretāyāṃ vārṣiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 40.246 || yathā kleśaṃ caranprājñastadahnā prāpyate kalau|| yugatrayeṇa tāvaṃtaḥ siddhiṃ gacchaṃti pārthivaḥ|| 40.247 || yāvaṃtaḥ siddhimāyāṃti kalau hariharavratāḥ|| aṣṭāviṃśe kalau yacca bhāvi tattvaṃ nibodha me|| 40.248 || triṣu varṣasahasreṣu kaleryāteṣu pārthivaḥ|| triśateṣu daśanyūneṣvasyāṃ bhuvi bhaviṣyati|| 40.249 || śūdrakonāma vīrāṇāmadhipaḥ siddhimatra saḥ|| carcitāyāṃ samārādhya lapsyate bhūbharāpahaḥ|| 40.250 || tatastriṣu sahasreṣu daśādhikaśatatraye|| bhaviṣyaṃ naṃdarājyaṃ ca cāṇakyo yānhaniṣyati|| 40.251 || śuklatīrthe sarvapāpanirmuktiṃ yo'bhilapsyati|| tatastriṣu sahasreṣu viṃśatyā cādhikeṣu ca|| 40.252 || bhaviṣyaṃ vikramādityarājyaṃ so'tha pralapsyate|| sidadhiprasādāddurgāṇāṃ dīnānyo hyuddhariṣyati|| 40.253 || tataḥ śatasahasreṣu śatenāpyadhikeṣu ca|| śakonāma bhaviṣyaśca yo'tidāridryahārakaḥ|| 40.254 || tatastriṣu sahasreṣu ṣaṭśatairadhikeṣu ca|| māgadhe hemasadanādaṃjanyāṃ prabhaviṣyati|| 40.255 || viṣṇoraṃśo dharmapātā budhaḥ sākṣātsvayaṃ prabhuḥ|| tasya karmāṇi bhūriṇi bhaviṣyaṃti mahātmanaḥ|| 40.256 || jyotirbidumukhānugrānsa haniṣyati koṭiśaḥ|| catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ sa varṣāṇi bhuktvā dvīpāni sapta ca|| 40.257 || bhaktebhyaḥ svayaśo muktvā divaṃ paścādgamiṣyati|| sarveṣāṃ cāvatārāṇaāṃ guṇaiḥ samadhiko yataḥ|| 40.258 || tato vakṣyaṃti taṃ bhaktyā sarvapāpaharaṃ budham|| caturṣu ca sahasreṣu śateṣvapi caturṣu ca|| 40.259 || sādhikeṣu mahānrājā pramitiḥ prabhaviṣyati|| gotreṣu vai caṃdramaso bahusenāpatirbalī|| 40.260 || mlecchānsa koṭiśo hatvā pāṣaṃḍāni ca sarvaśaḥ|| vaidikaṃ kevalaṃ śuddhaṃ saddharmaṃ vartayiṣyati|| 40.261 || gaṃgāyamunayormadhye niṣṭhāṃ yāsyati pārthivaḥ|| tataḥ prajāśca kālena kenāpi bhṛśapīḍitāḥ|| 40.262 || ghoraṃ vā dharmamāśritya śāṭhyena ca bhavaṃti tāḥ|| apragrahāstatastā vai lobhāviṣṭāśca vṛṃdaśaḥ|| 40.263 || upahiṃsaṃti cānyonyaṃ vyākulāḥ śramapīḍitāḥ|| naṣṭe śraute tathā smārte parasparahatāstadā|| 40.264 || nirmaryādā niṣkaruṇā nissnehā nirapatrapāḥ|| gṛhadārāṇi saṃtyajya hrasvakāḥ paṃṭaviṃśatiḥ|| 40.265 || hāhābhūtāścariṣyaṃti viṣādavyākuleṃdriyāḥ|| anāvṛṣṭihatāścaiva vārtāmutsṛjya duḥkhitāḥ|| 40.266 || pratyaṃtāṃstā niṣevaṃti hitvā janapadānsvakān|| saritsāgarakūlāṃśca sevaṃte parvatāṃstathā|| 40.267 || māṃsairmūlaphalaiscaiva vartayaṃti suduḥkhitāḥ|| cīrapatrājinadharā niṣkriyā niṣparigrahāḥ|| 40.268 || dharmasya vāsamātraṃ ca śālvo mleccho haniṣyati|| uttamādhamamadhyatvaṃ sarvamucchidya ghorakṛt|| 40.269 || tatastasya vadhārthāya viṣṇuḥ sākṣājjagatpatiḥ|| śaṃbhale viṣṇuyaśaso bhūtvā putro nṛpottama|| 40.270 || dvijottamaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śālvaṃ taṃ saṃhariṣyati|| koṭiśo'rbudaśaḥ pāpānnihatya ca nikharvaśaḥ|| 40.271 || pālayiṣyati taṃ dharmaṃ yo dharmaḥ śrutipūrvakaḥ|| 40.272 || kṛtvā potaṃ dharmarūpaṃ sādhūnāṃ parameśvaraḥ|| gamiṣyati paraṃ lokaṃ kṛtvā karmāmi bhūriśaḥ|| 40.273 || tataḥ kṛtayugaṃ bhūyaḥ pravartiṣyati pārthiva|| ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ cānyaṃ tadanyebhyo viśiṣyate|| 40.274 || aṣṭāviṃśakaliścaiva śeṣaḥ prāvarta anyataḥ|| tataḥ kṛte sūryavaṃśaḥ pravatsyati|| 40.275 || marurājācca devāpeḥ śrutadevācca brāhmaṇāḥ|| iti cāturyugī rājanvyavasthā parivartate|| caturyuge ca te dhanyā ye bhajaṃti harācyutau|| 40.276 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahākālakarandhamasaṃvāde caturyugavyavasthāvarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 40 || cha ||
<1.2.41>
||karadhama uvāca|| kecicchivaṃ samāśritya viṣṇumāśritya vedhasam|| varṇayaṃti pare mokṣaṃ tvaṃ tu kasmāttu manyase|| 41.1 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| apāravaibhavā devāstrayo'pyete nararṣabha|| yogīṃdrāṇāmapi tvatra ceto muhyati kiṃ mama|| 41.2 || purā kilaivaṃ munayo naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ|| saṃdihyāṃtaḥ śreṣṭhatāyāṃ brahmalokamupāgaman|| 41.3 || tasminkṣaṇe viriṃco'pi ślokaṃ prahvo'bravītkila|| anaṃtāya namastasmai yasyāṃto nopalabhyate|| 41.4 || maheśāya ca bhakte dvau kṛpāyetāṃ sadā mayi|| tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ ca taṃ matvā kṣīrodaṃ munayo yayuḥ|| 41.5 || tatra yogeśvaraḥ ślokaṃ prabudhyannamumabravīt|| brahmāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu paramaṃ brahmarūpiṇam|| 41.6 || sadāśivaṃ ca vaṃde tau bhavetāṃ maṃgalāya me|| tataste vismitā viprā apasṛtya yayuḥ punaḥ|| 41.7 || kailāse dadṛśuḥ sthāṇuṃ vadaṃtaṃ girijāṃ prati|| ekādaśyāṃ pranṛtyāni jāgare viṣṇusadmani|| 41.8 || sadā tapasyāṃ carāmi prītyarthaṃ harivedhasoḥ|| śrutveti cāpasṛtyaiva khinnāste munayo'bruvan|| 41.9 || yadvā devā na saṃyāṃti pāraṃ ye ca parasparam|| tatsṛṣṭasṛṣṭasṛṣṭeṣu gaṇanā kā'smadādiṣu|| 41.10 || uttamādhamamadhyatvamamīṣāṃ varṇayaṃti ye|| asatyavādinaḥ pāpāste yāṃti nirayaṃ dhruvam|| 41.11 || evaṃ te niściyāmāsurnaimiṣeyā stapasvinaḥ|| satyametacca rājeṃdra mamāpīdaṃ mataṃ sphuṭam|| 41.12 || jāpakānāṃ sahasrāṇi vaiṣmavānāṃ tathaiva ca|| śaivānāṃ ca vidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ sthāṇuṃ cāpyanvamūmucan|| 41.13 || tasmādyasya manorāgo yasmindeve bhavetsphuṭam|| sa taṃ bhajedvipāpaḥ syānmamedaṃ matamuttamam|| 41.14 || ||karaṃdhama uvāca|| kāni pāpāni vipreṃdra yaistu saṃmūḍhacetasaḥ|| na vedeṣu na dharmeṣu ratimāpadyate manaḥ|| 41.15 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| adharmabhedā vijñeyāścittavṛttiprabhedataḥ|| sthūlāḥ sūkṣmā asūkṣmāśca koṭibhedairanekaśaḥ|| 41.16 || tatra ye pāpanicayāḥ sthūlā narakahetavaḥ|| te samāsena kathyaṃte manovākkāyasādhanāḥ|| 41.17 || parastrīdravyasaṃkalpaścetasāniṣṭaciṃtanam|| akāryābhiniveśaśca caturddhā karma mānasam|| 41.18 || anibaddhapralāpitvamasatyaṃ cāpriyaṃ ca yat|| parāpavādapaiśunyaṃ caturdhā karma vācikam|| 41.19 || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ hiṃsā mithyā kāmasya sevanam|| parasvānāmupādānaṃ caturdhā karma kāyikam|| 41.20 || ityetaddvādaśavidhaṃ karma proktaṃ trisaṃbhavam|| asya bhedānpunarvakṣye yeṣāṃ phalamanaṃtakam|| 41.21 || ye dviṣaṃti mahādevaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam|| sumahātpātakopetāste yāṃti narakāgniṣu|| 41.22 || mahāṃti pātakānyāhurniraṃtaraphalāni ṣaṭ|| nābhinaṃdaṃti ye dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraṃ na stuvaṃti ye|| 41.23 || yatheṣṭaceṣṭā niḥśaṃkāḥ saṃtiṣṭhaṃti ramaṃti ca|| upacāravinirmuktāḥ śivasya gurusaṃnidhau|| 41.24 || śivācāraṃ na manyaṃte śivabhaktāndviṣaṃti ṣaṭ|| gurumārttamaśaktaṃ vā videśaprasthitaṃ tathā|| 41.25 || aribhiḥ paribhūtaṃ vā yastyajati sa pāpakṛt|| tadbhāryāputramitreṣu yaścāvajñāṃ karoti vā|| 41.26 || ityetatpātakaṃ jñeyaṃ guruniṃdāsamaṃ mahat|| brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ|| 41.27 || mahāpātakinastvete tatsaṃsargī ca paṃcamaḥ|| krodhāddveṣādbhayāllobhādbrāhmaṇasya vadaṃti ye|| 41.28 || marmāṃtikaṃ mahādoṣaṃ brahmaghnaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ|| brāhmaṇaṃ yaḥ samāhūya yācamānamakiṃcanam|| 41.29 || paścānnāstīti yo brūyātsa ca vai brahmahā smṛtaḥ|| yaśca vidyābhimānena nistejayati saddvijam|| 41.30 || udāsīnaḥ sabhāmadhye brahmahā sa prakīrtitaḥ|| mithyāguṇaiḥ svamātmānaṃ nayatyutkarṣatāṃ balāt|| 41.31 || viruddhaṃ gurubhiḥ sārdhaṃ brahmaghnaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ|| kṣuttṛṣṇātaptadehānāṃ dvijānāṃ bhoktumicchatām|| 41.32 || yaḥ samācarate vighnaṃ tamāhurbrahmagātakam|| piśunaḥ sarvalokānāṃ chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ|| 41.33 || udvegajananaḥ krūraḥ sa ca vai brahmahā smṛtaḥ|| gavāṃ tṛṣābhibhūtānāṃ jalārthamupasarpatām|| 41.34 || yaḥ samācarate vighnaṃ tamāhurbrahmaghātakam|| paradoṣaṃ parijñāya nṛpakarṇe japeta yaḥ|| 41.35 || pāpīyānpiśunaḥ krūrastamāhurbrahmaghātakam|| nyāyenopārjitaṃ vipraistaddravyaharaṇaṃ ca yat|| 41.36 || chadmanā vā balādvāpi brahmahatyāsamaṃ matam|| adhītya yaśca śāstrāṇi parityajati mūḍhadhīḥ|| 41.37 || surāpānasamaṃ jñeyaṃ jīvanāyaiva vā paṭhet|| agnihotraparityāgaḥ paṃcayajñopakarmaṇām|| 41.38 || mātṛpitṛparityāgaḥ kūṭasākṣī suhṛdvadhaḥ|| abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ vanyajaṃtūnāṃ kāmyayā vadhaḥ|| 41.39 || grāmaṃ vanaṃ gavāvāsaṃ yaśca krodhena dīpayet|| iti ghorāṇi pāpāni surāpānasamāni ca|| 41.40 || dīnasarvasvaharaṇaṃ narastrīgajavājinām|| gobhūratnasuvarṇānāmauṣadhīnāṃ rasasya ca|| 41.41 || caṃdanāgarukarpūrakastūrīpaṭṭavāsasām|| hastanyāsāpaharaṇaṃ skamasteyasamaṃ smṛtam|| 41.42 || kanyānāṃ varayogyānāmadānaṃ sadṛśe vare|| putramitrakalatreṣu gamanaṃ bhaginīṣu ca|| 41.43 || kumārīsāhasaṃ ghoramaṃtyajastrīniṣevaṇam|| savarṇāyāśca gamanaṃ gurutalpasamaṃ smṛtam|| 41.44 || dvijāyārthaṃ pratiśrutya na prayacchati yaḥ punaḥ|| na ca casmārayate vipraṃ tulyaṃ tadupapapātakam|| 41.45 || abhimānotikopaśca dāṃbhikatvaṃ kṛtaghnatā|| atyaṃtaviṣayāsaktiḥ kārpaṇyaṃ śāṭhyamatsaram|| 41.46 || bhṛtyānāṃ ca parityāgaḥ sādhubaṃdhutapasvinām|| gavāṃ kṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ strīśūdrāṇāṃ ca tāḍanam|| 41.47 || śivāśramatarūṇāṃ ca puṣpārāmavināśanam|| ayājyānāṃ yājanaṃ cāpyayācyānāṃ ca yācanam|| 41.48 || yajñārāmataḍāgādidārāpatyasya vikrayaḥ|| tīrthayātropavāsānāṃ vratāyatanakarmaṇām|| 41.49 || strīdhanānyupajīvaṃti strībhiratyaṃtanirjitāḥ|| arakṣaṇaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam|| 41.50 || ṛṇānāmapradānaṃ ca mithyāghṛddhyupajīvanam|| niṃditānāṃ dhanādānaṃ sādvīkanyoktidūṣaṇam|| 41.51 || viṣamāraṇayaṃtrāṇāṃ proyago mūlakarmaṇām|| uccāṭanābhicārāśca rāgavidveṣaṇakriyā|| 41.52 || jihvākāmopabho gārthaṃ yasyāraṃbhaḥ svakarmasu|| mūlyenādhyāpayedyastu mūlyenādhīyate ca ye|| 41.53 || vrātyatā vratasaṃtyāgaḥ sarvāhāraniṣevaṇam|| asacchāstrābhigamanaṃ śuṣkatarkāva laṃbanam|| 41.54 || devāgnigurusādhūnāṃ niṃdā gobrāhmaṇasya ca|| pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā rājñāṃ maṃḍalināmapi|| 41.55 || utsannapatṛdevejyāḥ svakarmatyāginaśca ye|| duḥśīlā nāstikāḥ pāpā na sadā satyavādinaḥ|| 41.56 || parvakāle divā cāpsu viyonau paśuyoniṣu|| rajasvalāsvayonau ca maithunaṃ yaḥ samācaret|| 41.57 || strīputramitrasuhṛdāmāśācchedakarāśca ye|| janasyāpriyavaktāraḥ krūrāḥ samayabhedinaḥ|| 41.58 || bhettā taḍāgakūpānāṃ saṃkramāṇāṃrasasya ca|| ekapaṃktisthitānāṃ ca pākabhedaṃ karoti yaḥ|| 41.59 || ityetaiśca narāḥ pāpairupapātakinaḥ smṛtāḥ|| yuktāstadunakaiḥ pāpaiḥ pāpinastānnibodha me|| 41.60 || ye gobrāhmaṇakanyānāṃ svāmimitratapasvinām|| antaraṃ yāṃti kāryeṣu te smṛtāḥ pāpino narāḥ|| 41.61 || paraśriyābhitapyaṃte hīnāṃ savaṃti ye striyām|| paṃktyarthaṃ ye na kurvaṃti dānayajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ|| 41.62 || goṣṭhāgnijalarathyāsu tarucchāyānageṣu ca|| tyajaṃti ye purīṣādyamārāmāyataneṣu ca || 41.63 || gītavādyaratā nityā mattāḥ kilakilāparāḥ|| kūṭaveṣakriyācārāḥ kūṭasaṃvyavahāriṇaḥ|| 41.64 || kūṭaśāsanakartāraḥ kūṭayuddhakarāśca ye|| nirdayo'tīva bhṛtyeṣu paśūnāṃ damanaśca yaḥ|| 41.65 || mithyāprasādito vākyamākarṇayati yaḥ śanaiḥ|| capalaścāpimāyāvī śaṭho mithyāvinītakaḥ|| 41.66 || yo bhāryāputramitrāṇi bālavṛddhakṛśāturān|| bhṛtyānatithibaṃdhūṃśca tyaktvāśrāti bubhukṣitān|| 41.67 || yaḥ svayaṃ mṛṣṭamaśrāti viprāyānyatprayacchati|| vṛthāpākaḥ sa vijñeyo brahmavādivigarhitaḥ|| 41.68 || niyamānsvayamādāya ye tyajaṃtyajiteṃdriyāḥ|| ye tāḍayaṃti gāṃ nityaṃ vāhayaṃti muhurmuhuḥ|| 41.69 || durbalānnaiva puṣṇaṃti praṇaṣṭārthā dviṣaṃti ca|| pīḍayantyabhicāreṇa sakṣatānvāhayaṃti ca|| 41.70 || teṣā madattvā cāśraṃti cikitsaṃti na rogiṇaḥ|| ajāviko māhiṣikaḥ samudrī vṛṣalīpatiḥ|| 41.71 || hīnavarṇātmavṛttiśca vaidyo dharmadhvajī ca yaḥ|| yaśca śāstramatikramya svecchayaivāharetkaram|| 41.72 || sadā daṇḍaruciryaśca yo vā daṇḍarucirna hi|| utkocakairadhikṛtaistaskaraisca prapīḍyate|| 41.73 || yasya rājñaḥ prajā rāṣṭre pacyate narakeṣu saḥ|| acauraṃ cauravatpaśyeccauraṃ vā'caurarūpiṇam|| 41.74 || ālasyopahato rājā vyasanī narakaṃ vrajet|| evamādīni cānyāni pāpānyāhuḥ purāvidaḥ|| 41.75 || yadvātadvā paradravyamapi sarṣapamātrakam|| apahṛtya naraḥ pāpo nārakī nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 41.76 || evamādyairnaraḥ pāpairutkrāntaiḥ samanaṃtaram|| śarīraṃ yātanārthāya pūrvākāramavāpnuyāt|| 41.77 || tasmāttrividhamapyetannārakīyaṃ vivarjayet|| sadāśivaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ vrajetsacchraddhayā yutaḥ|| 41.78 || namaskāraḥ stutiḥ pūjā nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā|| saṃparkātkautukāllobhānna tasya viphalaṃ bhavet|| 41.79 || ||karaṃdhama uvāca|| saṃkṣepācchivapūjāyā vidhānaṃ vaktumarhasi|| kṛtena yena manujaḥ śivapūjāphalaṃ labhet|| 41.80 || ||mahākāla uvāca|| prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne śaṃkaraṃ sarvadā bhajet|| darśanātsparśanānmartyaḥ kṛtatṛtyo bhavetsphuṭam|| 41.81 || ādau snānaṃ prakurvita bhasmasnānamathāpi vā|| āpadgataḥ kaṇṭhasnānaṃ mantrasnānamathāpi vā|| 41.82 || āvikaṃ paridadhyācca tato vāsaḥ sitaṃ ca vā|| dhāturaktamatho navyaṃ malinaṃ saṃdhitaṃ na ca|| 41.83 || uttarīyaṃ ca saṃdadhyādvinā tanniṣphalārcanam|| bhasmatripuṇḍradhārī ca lalāṭe hṛti cāṃsayoḥ|| 41.84 || pūjayedyo mahādevaṃ prītaḥ paśyati taṃ muhuḥ|| sarvadoṣānbahiḥ kṣipya śivāyatanamāviśet|| 41.85 || praviśya ca praṇamyeśaṃ tato garbhagṛhaṃ viśet|| pāṇī prakṣālya taccitto nirmālyamavaropayet|| 41.86 || yena rudrāyate bhaktyā kurute mārjanakriyām|| tasmānmārjayate tvevaṃ sthāṇunaitatparasparam|| 41.87 || rudrabhaktyā ca saṃtiṣṭhenamālinyaṃ mārjayettataḥ|| bhaktirdevasya tiṣṭhenna mālinyaṃ mārjataḥ sadā|| 41.88 || gaḍukānpūrayetpaścānnirmalena jalena vai|| gaḍukāstu samāḥ sarve sarve ca śubhadarśanāḥ|| 41.89 || nirvraṇāḥ saumyarūpāśca sarve codakapūritāḥ|| vastrapūtajalaiḥ pūrṇāgandhadhūpaiśca vāsitāḥ|| 41.90 || kṣālitāḥ pūritā nītāḥ ṣaḍakṣarajapena ca|| gaḍukāṣcaśataṃ kuryādathavāpyaṣṭaviṃśatiḥ|| 41.91 || aṣṭādaśāpi caturastatonyūnaṃ na kārayet|| payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva kṣaudramikṣurasaṃ tathā|| 41.92 || evaṃ sarvaṃ ca taddravyaṃ vāmataḥ saṃnyasedbhavāt|| tato bahirviniṣkramya pūjayetpratihārakān|| 41.93 || sarveṣāṃ vācakā mantrāḥ kathyaṃte'taḥ paraṃ kramāt|| 41.94 || oṃgaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ|| oṃkṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ|| oṃgaṃ gurubhyo namaḥ|| iti ākāśe|| oṃkauṃ kuladevyai namaḥ|| oṃ naṃdine namaḥ|| oṃmahākālāya namaḥ|| oṃdhātre vidhātrai namaḥ|| tataḥ pravisya liṃgācca kiñciddakṣiṇataḥ śuciḥ|| udaṅmukhaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyāyetsamakāyāsanasthitaḥ|| 41.95 || darbhādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ madhyapadmārkamaṃḍalam|| somamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedvai vahnimaṃḍalam|| 41.96 || tanmadhye viśvarūpaṃ ca vāmādyaṣṭādiśaktikam|| paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ caṃdrabhūṣitam|| 41.97 || vāmāṃkagirijaṃ devaṃ dhyāyetsiddhaiḥ stutaṃ muhuḥ|| tataḥ pūrvaṃ pradadyācca pādyārghaṃ śaṃbhave nṛpa|| 41.98 || pānīyamakṣatā darbhā gaṃdhapūṣpaṃ sasarpiṣam|| kṣīraṃ dadhi madhu punarnavāṃgo'rghaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 41.99 || tataḥ śraddhārdracittasya snānaṃ liṃgasya cācaret|| gṛhītvā gaḍukaṃ pūrvaṃ malasnānaṃ samācaret|| 41.100 || arddhena snāpayetpūrvaṃ kuryācca malagharṣaṇam|| sarveṇa snāpayetpaścātpūjayetsnāpayettataḥ|| 41.101 || praṇamya ca tato bhaktyā snāpayenmūlamaṃtrataḥ|| oṃhūṃ viśvamūrtaye śivāya nama|| iti dvādaśākṣaro mūlamaṃtraḥ|| 41.102 || vārikṣaradadhikṣaudraghṛtenekṣurasena ca|| snāpayenmūlamantreṇa jaladhūpārcanātpṛthak|| 41.103 || gaḍukaiḥ snāpayetsarvaiḥ snātaṃ gandhairvirūkṣayet|| 41.104 || virūkṣitaṃ tataḥ snāpya śrīkhaṇḍena vilepayet|| pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairvidhinā yena tacchṛṇu|| 41.105 || āgneyapāde|| oṃdharmāya namaḥ|| nairṛtake|| oṃjñānāya namaḥ|| vāyavye|| oṃvairāgyāya namaḥ|| īśānapāde|| oṃaiśvaryāya namaḥ|| pūrvapāde|| oṃadharmāya namaḥ|| dakṣiṇe|| oṃajñānāya namaḥ|| paścime|| oṃavairāgyāya namaḥ|| uttare oṃanaiśvaryāya namaḥ|| oṃanantāya namaḥ|| oṃpadmāya namaḥ oṃarkamaṇḍalā namaḥ|| oṃsomamaṇḍalāya namaḥ|| oṃvahnimaṇḍalā namaḥ|| oṃvāmājyeṣṭhādipaṃcamantraśaktibhyo namaḥ|| oṃparamaprakṛtyai devyai namaḥ|| oṃīśānatatpuruṣāghoravāmadevasadyojātapañcavaktrāya rudrasādhyavasvādityaviśvedevādidevaviśvarūpāya aṇḍajasvedajodbhijjajarāyujarūpasthāvarajaṅgamamūrtaye parameśvarāya oṃhūṃ viśvamūrtaye śivāya namastriśūladhanuḥkhaḍgakapāladaṇḍakuṭhārebhyaḥ|| 41.106 || tato jalādhāramukhe caṇḍīśvarāya namaḥ|| evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivattato'rghaṃ saṃniveśayet|| 41.107 || pānīyamakṣatāḥ puṣpametairyuktaṃ phalottamaiḥ|| gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mahādeva pūjāsaṃpūrtihetave|| 41.108 || arghādanaṃtaraṃ śaktaḥ pūjayedvasupūjayā|| dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ kramātpaścānnivedayet|| 41.109 || ghaṇṭāṃ ca vādayettatra tato nīrājanaṃ caret|| bhrāmayeddevadevasya śaṃkhavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ|| 41.110 || nīrājanaṃ ca yaḥ paśye ddevadevasya śūlinaḥ|| sa mucyetpātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ kiṃ punaryaḥ kariṣyati|| 41.111 || nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca alīkamapi yaścaret|| tasya tuṣyedanaṃtaṃhi gītavādyaphalaṃ yataḥ|| 41.112 || stotraistataśca saṃstūya daṇḍavatpraṇamedbhuvi|| kṣamāpayecca deveśaṃ sukṛtaṃ kukṛtaṃ kṣama|| 41.113 || ya evaṃ yajate rudramasmim̐lliṃge viśeṣataḥ|| pitaraṃ pitāmahaṃ caiva tathaiva prapitāmaham|| 41.114 || sarvātpāpātsamuttārya rudraloke vasecciram|| evaṃ māheśvaro bhūtvā sadācāravratasthitaḥ|| 41.115 || paśupāśavimokṣārthaṃ pūjayettanmanā yadi|| ya evaṃ yajate rudraṃ tenaitattarpitaṃ jagat|| 41.116 || kiṃ tvetatsaphalaṃ rājannācārayo na laṃghayet|| ācārātphalate dharmo hyācārātsvargamaśnute|| 41.117 || ācārāllabhate hyāyurācāro haṃtyalakṣaṇam|| yajñadānatapāṃsīha puruṣasya na bhūtaye|| 41.118 || bhavanti yaḥ sadācāraṃ samullaṃghya pravartate|| tasya kiñcitsamuddeśaṃ vakṣye taṃ śrṛṇu pārthiva|| 41.119 || trivargasādhane yatnaḥ kartavyo gṛhamedhinā|| tatsaṃsiddhau gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca|| 41.120 || brāhme muhūrte budhyena dharmārthau cāpi cintayet|| samutthāya tathācamya daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam|| 41.121 || sandhyāmupāsīta budhaḥ saṃśāṃtaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ|| pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ sanakṣatrāṃ paścimāṃ sadivākarām|| 41.122 || upāsīta yathānyāyaṃ naināṃ jahyādanāpadi|| varjayedanṛtaṃ cāsatpralāpaṃ paruṣaṃ tathā|| 41.123 || asatsevāṃ hyasadvādaṃ hyasacchāstraṃ ca pārthiva|| ādarśadarśanaṃ daṃtadhāvanaṃ keśasādhanam|| 41.124 || devārcanaṃ ca pūrvāhṇe kāryāṇyāhurmaharṣayaḥ|| pālāśamāsanaṃ caiva pāduke daṃtadhāvanam|| varjayedāsanaṃ caiva padā nākarṣayedbudhaḥ|| 41.125 || jalamagniṃ ca ninayedyagapanna vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 41.126 || pādau prasārayennaiva gurudevāgnisaṃmukhau|| catuṣpathaṃ caityataruṃ devāgāraṃ tathā yatim|| 41.127 || vidyādhikaṃ guruṃ vṛddhaṃ kuryādetānpradakṣiṇān|| 41.128 || āhāranīhāravihārayogāḥ susaṃvṛtā dharmavidānukāryāḥ|| vāgbuddhivīryāṇi tapastathaiva vārtāyuṣī guptatame ca kārye|| 41.129 || ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ|| dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau hyevamāyurna riṣyate|| 41.130 || pratyagniṃ prati sūryaṃ ca prati gāṃ vratinaṃ prati|| prati somodakaṃ sandhyāṃ prajñā naśyati mehataḥ|| 41.131 || bhojane śayane sthāne utsarge malamūtrayoḥ|| rathyācaṃkramaṇe cārdrapañcakaścācametsadā|| 41.132 || na nadyāṃ mehanaṃ kuryānna śmaśāne nabhasmani|| na gomaye na kṛṣṭe ca naivālūne na śāḍvale|| 41.133 || uddhṛttābhistathādbhistu śaucaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| aṃtarjalāddevakulādvalmīkānmūṣakasthalāt|| 41.134 || apaviddhāpaśaucāśca varjayetpaṃca mṛttikāḥ|| gandhalepāpaharaṇaṃ śaucaṃ kuryāttathā budhaḥ|| 41.135 || nātmānaṃ tāḍayennaiva dadyādduḥ khebhya eva ca|| ubhābhyāmapi pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyennātmanaḥ śiraḥ|| 41.136 || rakṣeddārāṃstyajedīṣyāṃ tāsu niṣkāraṇaṃ budhaḥ|| sūryāstaṃ na vinākāścitkriyā naivācarettathā|| 41.137 || adroheṇaiva bhūtānāmalpadroheṇa vā punaḥ|| śivacittorjayodvittaṃ na cātikṛpaṇo bhavet|| 41.138 || nerṣyuḥ syānna kṛtaghnaḥ syānna paradrohakarmadhīḥ|| na pāṇipādacapalo na netracapalo'nṛjuḥ|| 41.139 || na ca vāgaṅgacapalo na cāśiṣṭasya gocaraḥ|| na śuṣkavādaṃ kurvīta śuṣkravairaṃ tathaiva ca|| 41.140 || upāyaiḥ sādhayedarthāndaṇḍastvagatikā gatiḥ|| bhinnāśanaṃ bhinnaśayyāṃ varjayedbhinnabhājanam|| 41.141 || aṃtareṇa na gacchena dvayorjvalanaliṃgayoḥ|| nāgnyorna viprayoścaiva na daṃpatyornṛpottama|| 41.142 || na sūryavyomayornaiva harasya vṛṣabhasya ca|| eteṣāmaṃtaraṃ kurvanyataḥ pāpamavāpnuyāt|| 41.143 || naikavastraśca bhuṃjīta nāgnau homamathācaret|| na cārcayeddvijānnaiva kuryāddevārcanaṃ budhaḥ|| 41.144 || khaṃḍanaṃ peṣaṇaṃ mārṣṭiṃ jalasaṃśodhanaṃ tathā|| raṃdhanaṃ bhojanaṃ svāpa utthānaṃ gamanaṃ kṣutam|| 41.145 || kāryāraṃbhaṃ samāptiṃ ca vacaḥ procya tathā priyam|| pibañjighranspṛśañchṛṇvanvivakṣurmaithunaṃ tathā|| 41.146 || śucitvaṃ ca japaṃ sthāṇuṃ yaḥ kuryādviṃśatiṃ tathā|| māheśvaraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śeṣonyo nāmadhārakaḥ|| 41.147 || sa vai rudramayo bhūtvā tataścāṃte śivaṃ vrajet|| parastriyaṃ nābhibhāṣettathā saṃbhāṣayedyadi|| 41.148 || mātaḥ svasaratho putri āryeti ca vadedbudhaḥ|| ucachiṣṭo nālabhetkiṃcinna ca sūryaṃ vilokayet|| 41.149 || nenduṃ na tārakāścaiva nādayennātmanaḥ śiraḥ|| svasrā dihitrā mātrā vā naikāṃtāsana mācaret|| 41.150 || durjayo hīṃdriyagrāmo muhyate paṃḍito'pi san|| gurumabhyāgataṃ gehe svayamutthāya yatnataḥ|| 41.151 || āsanaṃ kalpayettasya kuryātpādābhivaṃdanam|| nodakchirāḥ svapejjātu na ca pratyakchirā budhaḥ|| 41.152 || śirasyagastyamādhāya tathaiva ca puraṃdaram|| udakyādarśanaṃ sparśaṃ varjyaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā|| 41.153 || nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret|| kṛtvā vibhavato devamanuṣyarṣisamarcanām|| 41.154 || pitṝṇāṃ ca tataḥ śeṣaṃ bhoktuṃ māheśvaro'rhati|| vāgyataḥ śucirācāṃtaḥ prāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pi vā|| 41.155 || antarjānuśca taccitto bhuñjītānnamakutsayan|| nopaghātaṃ vinā doṣānna tasyodāharedbudhaḥ|| 41.156 || nagnasnānaṃ na kurvīta na śayīta vrajeta vā|| duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyātkruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet|| 41.157 || parivādaṃ na śrṛmuyādanyeṣāmapi jalpatām|| sadā cā karṇayeddhamāstyaktvā kṛtyaśatānyapi|| 41.158 || nityaṃ nityaṃ hi saṃmārṣṭi gehadarpaṇayoriva|| śuklāyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ naktabhojī sadā bhavet|| 41.159 || tisro rātrīrna śaktaścedevaṃ māheśvaro bhavet|| saṃyāvakṛśarāmāṃsaṃ nātmānamupasādhayet|| 41.160 || sāyaṃprātaśca bhoktavyaṃ kṛtvā hyatithi bhojanam|| svapnādhyayanabhojyāni saṃdhyayośca vivarjayet|| 41.161 || bhuṃjānaḥ saṃdhyayormohādasurāvasatho bhavet|| snāto na dhūnayetkeśānkṣute niṣṭhīvite'dhvani|| 41.162 || ālabheddakṣiṇaṃ karṇaṃ sarvabhūtāni kṣāmayet|| na cāpi nīlīvāsāḥ syānna viparyastavastradhṛk|| 41.163 || varjyaṃ ca malinaṃ vastraṃ daśābhiśca vivarjitam|| prakṣālya mukhahastau ca pādau cāpyupaviśya ca|| 41.164 || aṃtajānustrirācāmeddirmukhaṃ parimārjayet|| toyena sparśayetkhāni svamūrdhānaṃ tathaiva ca|| 41.165 || ācamya punarācamya kriyāḥ kurvīta sarvaśaḥ|| kṣute niṣṭhīvite caiva daṃtalagne tathaiva ca|| 41.166 || patitānāṃ ca saṃbhāṣe kuryādācamanikriyām|| adhyetavyā trayī nityaṃ bhavitavyaṃ vipaścitā|| 41.167 || dharmato dhanamāhārya yaṣṭavyaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ|| hīnebhyopi na yuṃjīta tvaṃkāraṃ karhicidbadhaḥ|| tvaṃkāro vā vadho vāpi gurūṇāmubhayaṃ samam|| 41.168 || satyaṃ vācyaṃ nityamaitreṇa bhāvyaṃ kāryaṃ tyājyaṃ nityamāyāsakāri|| loke'muṣminyaddinaṃ syāttathāsminnātmā yoge yejanīyo gabhīraiḥ|| 41.169 || tīrthasnānaiḥ sopavāsairvrataiśca pātre dānairhomajapyaiścayajñaiḥ|| bhavārcanairdevapūjāviśeṣairātmā nityaṃ śodhanīyo malāktaḥ|| 41.170 || yatrāpi kurvato nātmā jugupsāmeti pārthiva|| tatkartavyasamasaṃgena yannagopyaṃ mahājane|| 41.171 || iti te vai samuddeśaḥ kīrtitaḥ kiṃcideva ca|| śeṣaḥ smṛtipurāṇebhyastvayā śrotavya eva ca|| 41.172 || evamācarato dharmaṃ maheśasya gṛhe sataḥ|| dharmārthakāmasaṃprāptau paratreha ca śobhanam|| 41.173 || evaṃ nānāvidhāndharmānmahākālasya phālguna|| vadato dhvanirākāśe sumahānabhyajāyata|| 41.174 || yāvatpaśyaṃti ye tatra samājagmuḥ śrṛṇuṣva tān|| brahmā viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ rudro de vī rudragaṇāstathā|| 41.175 || iṃdrādayastathā devā vasiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ|| tuṃbarupravarāścāpi gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ|| 41.176 || tānmaheśamukhānsarvānmahākālo mahāmatiḥ|| arcayāmāsa bahudhā bhaktyudrekātipūritaḥ|| 41.177 || tato brahmādibhirdevairvare ratnamayāsane|| upaviṣṭo'bhiṣiktaśca mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| 41.178 || tato devyā samāliṃgya nītvotsaṃgaṃ svakaṃ mudā|| putratve kalpitaḥ pārtha mahākālo mahāmatiḥ|| 41.179 || uktañca yāvadbrahmāṇḍamidamāste śivavrata|| tāvattiṣṭha śivasthāne śivavacchivabhaktitaḥ|| 41.180 || devena ca varo dattastvalliṃgaṃ yo'rcayiṣyati|| jitendriyaḥ śucirbhūtvā ūrdhvaṃ mallokameṣyati|| 41.181 || darśanaṃ stavanaṃ pūjā praṇāmaśca tato japaḥ|| dānaṃ cātra kṛtaṃ liṃge mamātitṛptikāraṇam|| 41.182 || ityukte vismitā devāḥ sādhu sādhviti te jaguḥ|| brahmaviṣṇumukhāścaiva mahākālaṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ|| 41.183 || tataḥ suraiḥstūyamāno vaṃdyamānaśca cāraṇaiḥ|| nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca kītairgaṃdharvajaiḥ śubhaiḥ|| 41.184 || koṭikoṭigaṇaiścaiva stuvadbhiḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ|| 41.185 || mahākālo rudrabhavanaṃ gato bhavapurassaraḥ|| evametanmahāliṃgamutpannaṃ kurunaṃdana|| 41.186 || kūpaścāpi saraḥ puṇyaṃ mahākālasya siddhidam|| atra ye manujāḥ pārtha liṃgasyārādhane ratāḥ|| 41.187 || mahākālaḥ samāliṃgya tāñchivāya nivedayet|| etadatyadbhutaṃ liṃgaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam|| 41.188 || dṛṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ pūjitaṃ ca gatāste bhavasadma tat evametāni liṃgāni sapta jātāni phālguna|| 41.189 || ye śrṛṇvaṃti gṛṇaṃtyetattepi dhanyā narottamāḥ|| 41.190 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe śrīmahākālamāhātmye mahākālakaraṃdhamasaṃvāde śivapūjanavidhinityakartavyadharmanirūpaṇapūrvakamahākālaśivalokaprāptivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 41 || cha ||
<1.2.42>
||nārada uvāca|| tato mayā sthāpite ca sthāne kālāṃtareṇa ha|| ciṃtitaṃ hṛdaye bhūyo dvijānugrahakāmyayā|| 42.1 || vāsudevavihīnaṃ hi tīrthametanna rocate|| asūryaṃ hi jagadyadvatsa hi bhūṣaṇa bhūṣaṇam|| 42.2 || yatra naiva hariḥ svāmī tīrthe gehe'tha mānase|| śāstre vā tadasatsarvaṃ hāṃsaṃ tīrthaṃ na vāyasam|| 42.3 || tasmātprasādya varadaṃ tīrthe'sminpuruṣottamam|| āneṣye kalayā sākṣādviśvanugrahakāmyayā|| 42.4 || iti saṃciṃtya kauravya tato'haṃ cātra saṃsthitaḥ|| jñānayogena yogīṃdraṃ śataṃ varṣāṇyatoṣayam|| 42.5 || aṣṭākṣaraṃ japanmaṃtraṃ saṃnigṛhyeṃdriyāṇi ca|| vāsudevamayo bhūtvā sarvabhūtakṛpāparaḥ|| 42.6 || evaṃ mayārādhyamāno garuḍaṃ harirāsthitaḥ|| gaṇakoṭiparivṛtaḥ pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata|| 42.7 || tamahaṃ prāṃjalirbhūtvā dattvārghyaṃ vidhivaddhareḥ|| pratyavocaṃ pramamyātha prabaddhakarasaṃ puṭaḥ|| 42.8 || śvetadvīpe purā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā rūpaṃ tava prabho|| ajaṃ sanātanaṃ viṣṇo naranārāyaṇātmakam|| 42.9 || tadrūpasya kalāmekāṃ sthāpayātra janārdana|| yadi tuṣṭo'si me viṣṇo tadidaṃ kriyatāṃ tvayā|| 42.10 || evaṃ mayā prārthito'tha provāca garuḍadhvajaḥ|| evamastu brahmaputra yattvayābhīpsitaṃ hṛdi || 42.11 || tattathā bhavitā sarvamapyatrasthaṃ sadaiva hi|| evamuktvā gate viṣṇau niveśya svakalāṃ prabho|| 42.12 || mayā saṃsthāpito viṣṇurlokānugrahakāmyayā|| yasmātsvayaṃ śvetadvīpanivāsyatra hariḥ sthitaḥ|| 42.13 || vṛddho viśvasya viśvākhyo vāsudevastataḥ smṛtaḥ|| kārtike śuklapakṣe yā bhavatye kādaśī śubhā|| 42.14 || snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena toyaprasravaṇādiṣu|| yorcayedacyutaṃ bhaktyā paṃcopacārapūjayā|| 42.15 || upoṣya jāgaraṃ kuryādgītavādyaṃ hareḥ puraḥ|| kathāṃ vā vaiṣṇavīṃ kuryāddaṃbhakrodhavivarjitaḥ|| 42.16 || dānaṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā niyato hṛṣṭamānasaḥ|| anekabhavasaṃbhūtātkalmaṣādakhilādapi|| 42.17 || mucyate'sau na saṃdeho yadyapi brahmaghātakaḥ|| gāruḍena vimānena vaikuṃṭhaṃ padamāpnuyāt|| 42.18 || kulānāṃ tārayetpārtha śatamekottaraṃ naraḥ|| śraddhāyuktaṃ mudā yuktaṃ sotsāhaṃ saspṛhaṃ tathā|| 42.19 || ahaṃkāravihīnaṃ ca snānaṃ dhūpānupanam|| puṣpanaivedyasaṃyuktamarghadānasamanvitam|| 42.20 || yāmeyāme mahābhaktyā kṛtārārtikasaṃyutam|| cāmarāhlādasaṃyuktaṃ bherīnādapuraskṛtam|| 42.21 || purāṇaśrutisaṃpannaṃ bhaktinṛtyasamanvitam|| vinidraṃkṣṛttṛṣāsvādaspṛhāhīnaṃ ca bhārata|| 42.22 || tatpādasaurabhaghrāṇasaṃyutaṃ viṣṇuvallabham|| sagītaṃ sārcanakaraṃ tatkṣetragamanānvitam|| 42.23 || pāyurodhena saṃyuktaṃ brahmacaryasamanvitam|| stutipāṭhena saṃyuktaṃ pādodakavibhūṣitam|| 42.24 || satyānvitaṃ satyayogasaṃyutaṃ puṇyavārtayā|| paṃcaviṃśatibhiryuktaṃ guṇairyo jāgaraṃ naraḥ|| ekādaśyāṃ prakurvīta punarna jāyate bhuvi|| 42.25 || atra tīrthavare pūrvamaitareya iti dvijaḥ|| siddhiṃ prāpto mahābhāgo vāsudevaprasādataḥ|| 42.26 || ||arjuna uvāca|| aitareyaḥ kasya putro nivāsaḥ kvāsya vā mune|| kathaṃ siddhimāgāddhīmānvāsudevaprasādataḥ|| 42.27 || ||nārada uvāca|| asminneva mama sthāne hārītasyānvaye'bhavat|| 42.28 || māṃḍūkiriti viprāgryo vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ|| 42.29 || tasyāsī ditarā nāma bhāryā sādhvīguṇairyutā|| tasyāmutpadyata sutastvaitareya iti smṛtaḥ|| 42.30 || sa ca bālyātprabhṛtyeva prāgjanmanyanuśikṣitam|| jajāpamaṃtraṃ tvaniśaṃ dvādaśākṣarasaṃjñitam|| 42.31 || na śrṛṇoti na vaktyeva manasāpi ca kiṃcana|| evaṃprabhāvaḥ so'bhūcca bālye viprasutastadā|| 42.32 || tato mūko'yamityeva nānopāyaiḥ prabodhitaḥ|| pitrā yadā na kurute vyavahārāya mānasam|| 42.33 || tato niścitya manasā jaḍoyamiti bhārata|| anyāṃ vivāhayāmāsa dārānputrāṃstathādadhe|| 42.34 || piṃgānāma ca sā bhāryā tasyāḥ putrāśca jajñire|| catvāraḥ karmakuśalā vedavedāṃgavādinaḥ|| 42.35 || yajñeṣu śāṃtihomeṣu dvijaiḥ sarvatra pūjitāḥ|| aitareyopi nityaṃ ca trikālaṃ harikaṃdire|| 42.36 || jajāpa paramaṃ jāpyaṃ nānyatra kurute śramam|| tato mātā nirīkṣyaiva sapatnītanayāṃstathā|| 42.37 || dāryamāṇena manasā tanayaṃ vākyamabravīt|| kleśāyaiva ca jāto'si dhigme janma ca jīvitam|| 42.38 || nāryāstasyā nṛloke'tra varaivājananiḥ sphuṭam|| vimānitā yā bhartrāsyānna putraḥ syādguṇairyutaḥ|| 42.39 || piṃgeyaṃ kṛtapuṇyā vai yasyāḥ putrā mahāguṇāḥ|| vedavedāṃgatattvajñāḥ sarvatrābhyarcitā guṇaiḥ|| 42.40 || tadahaṃ putra durbhāgyā mahīsāgarasaṃgame|| nimajjīṣye varaṃ mṛtyurjīvite kiṃ phalaṃ mama|| tvamapyevaṃ mahāmaunī nanda bhakto hareściram|| 42.41 || ||nārada uvāca|| iti māturvacaḥ śrutvā prahasannaitareyakaḥ|| 42.42 || dhyātvā muhurtaṃ dharmajño mātaraṃ praṇato'bravīt|| mātarmithyābhibhūtāsi ajñāne jñānavatyasi|| 42.43 || aśocye śocasi śubhe śocye naivā'pi śocasi|| dehasyāsya kṛte mithyāsaṃsāre kiṃ vimuhyasi|| 42.44 || mūrkhācaritametaddhi manmāturucitaṃ na hi|| anyatsaṃsārasāraṃ ca sāramanyacca mohitāḥ|| 42.45 || prapaśyaṃti yathā rātrau khadyotaṃ dīpavatsthitam|| yadidaṃ manyase sāraṃ śrṛṇu tasyāpyasāratām|| 42.46 || evaṃvidhaṃ hi mānu'yamā garbhāditi kaṣṭadam asthipaṭṭatulāstambhe snāyubandhena yaṃtrite|| 42.47 || raktamāṃsamadālipte viṇmūtradravyabhājane|| keśaromatṛṇacchanne suvarṇatvaksudhūtake|| 42.48 || vadanaikamahādvāre ṣaḍgavākṣavitabhūṣite|| oṣṭhadvayakāṭe ca tathā daṃtārgalānvite|| 42.49 || nāḍīsvedapravāhe ca kālavaktrānalasthite|| evaṃvidhe gṛhe gehī jīvo nāmāsti śobhane|| 42.50 || guṇatrayamayī bhāryā prakṛtistasya tatra ca|| bodhāhaṃkārakāmāśca krodhalobhādayo'pi ca || 42.51 || apatyānyasya hā kaṣṭamevaṃ mūḍhaḥ pravartate|| tasya yoyo yathā mohastathā taṃ śrṛṇu tattvataḥ|| 42.52 || srotāṃsi yasya satataṃ prasravaṃti gireriva|| kaphamūtrādikānyasya kṛte dehasya muhyati|| 42.53 || sarvāśucinidhānasya śarīrasya na vidyate|| śucirekapradeśo'pi viṇmūtrasya dṛteriva|| 42.54 || spṛṣṭvā svadehasrotāṃsi mṛttoyaiḥ śodhyate karaḥ|| tathāpyaśucibhāṃḍasya na virajyati kiṃ naraḥ|| 42.55 || kāyaḥ sugandhatoyādyairyatnenāpi susaṃskṛtaḥ|| na jahāti svakaṃ bhāvaṃ śvapucchamiva nāmitam|| 42.56 || svadehāśucigaṃdhena na virajyati yo naraḥ|| virāge kāraṇaṃ tasya kimanyadu padiśyate|| 42.57 || gandhalepāpanodārthaṃ śaucaṃ dehasya kīrtitam|| dvayasyāpagamātpaścādbhāvaśuddhyā viśudhyati|| 42.58 || gaṃgātoyena sarveṇa mṛdbhāraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ|| ā mṛtyorācarañchaucaṃ bhāvaduṣṭo na śudhyati|| 42.59 || tīrthasnānaistapobhirvā duṣṭātmā naiva śudhyati|| sveditaḥ kṣālitastīrthe kiṃ śuddhimadhigacchati|| 42.60 || aṃtarbhāvapraduṣṭasya viśato'pi hutāśanam|| na svargo nāpapargaśca dehanirdahanaṃ param|| 42.61 || bhāvaśuddhiḥ paraṃ śaucaṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvakarmasu|| anyathāliṃgyate kāṃtā bhāvena duhitā'nyathā|| 42.62 || anyathaiva stanaṃ putraściṃtayatyanyathā patiḥ|| cittaṃ viśodhayettasmātkimanyairbāhyaśodhanaiḥ|| 42.63 || bhāvataḥ saṃviśuddhātmā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca viṃdati|| jñānāmalāṃbhasā puṃsaḥ sadvairāgyamṛdā punaḥ|| 42.64 || avidyārāgaviṇmūtralepagaṃdhaviśodhanam|| evametaccharīraṃ hi nisargādaśuci viduḥ|| 42.65 || tvaṅmātrasāraniḥsāraṃ kadalīsārasaṃnibham|| jñātvaivaṃ doṣavaddehaṃ yaḥ prājñaḥ śithilībhavet|| 42.66 || sa niṣkrāmati saṃsāre dṛḍhagrāhī sa tiṣṭhati|| evametanmahākaṣṭaṃ janma duḥkhaṃ prakīrtitam|| 42.67 || puṃsāmajñātadoṣeṇa nānākarmavaśena ca|| yathā girivarākrāṃtaḥ kaścidduḥkhena tiṣṭhati|| 42.68 || yathā jarāyuṇā dehī duḥkhaṃ tiṣṭhati veṣṭitaḥ|| patitaḥ sāgare yadvaddṛḥkhamāste samākulaḥ|| 42.69 || garbhodakena siktāṃgastathā''ste vyākulaḥ pumān|| lohakumbhe yathānyasta pacyate kaścidagninā|| 42.70 || garbhakumbhe tathā kṣiptaḥ pacyate jaṭharāgninā|| sūcībhiragnivarṇābhirvibhinnasya nirantaram|| 42.71 || yadduḥkhaṃ jāyate tasya tadgarbhe'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet|| ityetadgarbhaduḥkhaṃ hi prāṇināṃ parikīrtitam|| 42.72 || carasthirāṇāṃ sarveṣāmātmagarbhānurūpataḥ|| tatrasthasya ca sarveṣāṃ janmanāṃ smaraṇaṃ bhavet|| 42.73 || mṛtaścāhaṃ punarjāto jātaścāhaṃ punarmṛtaḥ|| nānāyonisahasrāṇi mayā dṛṣṭānvanekadhā|| 42.74 || adhunā jātamātro'haṃ prāptasaṃskāra eva ca|| tataḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yena garbho na saṃbhavet|| 42.75 || adhyeṣyāmi harerjñānaṃ saṃsāravinivartanam|| evaṃ saṃciṃtayannāste mokṣopāyaṃ vicintayan|| 42.76 || gabhātkoṭiguṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ jāyamānasya jāyate|| garbhavāse smṛtiryāsītsā jātasya praṇaśyati|| 42.77 || spṛṣṭamātrasya bāhyena vāyunā mūḍhatā bhavet|| saṃmūḍhasya smṛtibhraṃśaḥ śīghraṃ saṃjāyate punaḥ|| 42.78 || smṛtibhraṃśāttatastasya pūrvakarmavaśena ca|| ratiḥ saṃjāyate tūrṇaṃ jaṃtostatraiva janmani|| 42.79 || rakto mūḍhaśca lokoyamakārye saṃpravartate|| tatrātmānaṃ na jānāti na paraṃ na ca daivatam|| 42.80 || na śrṛṇoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi nekṣate|| same pathi samairgacchanskhalatīva padepade|| 42.81 || satyāṃ buddhau na jānāti bodhyamāno budhairapi|| saṃsāre kliśyate tena rāgamohavaśānugaḥ|| 42.82 || garbhasmṛterabhāvena śāstramuktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ|| taddṛḥkhakathanārthāya svargamokṣaprasādhakam|| 42.83 || ye śāstrajñāne satyasminsarvakarmārthasādhake|| na kurvaṃtyātmanaḥ śreyastadatra paramadbhutam|| 42.84 || avyaktendriyavṛttitvādbālye duḥkhaṃ mahatpunaḥ|| icchannapi na śaknoti vaktuṃ kartuṃ ca kiñcana|| 42.85 || daṃtotthāne mahadduḥkhaṃ maulena vyādhinā tathā|| bālarogaiśca vividhaiḥ pīḍā bālagrahairapi|| 42.86 || tṛḍbubhukṣāparītāṃgaḥ kvacittiṣṭhati rāraṭan|| viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇādyaṃ ca mohādbālaḥ samācaret|| 42.87 || kaumāre karṇavedhena mātāpitrorvitāḍanaiḥ|| akṣarādhyayanādyaiśca duḥkhaṃ syādguruśāsanāt|| 42.88 || pramatteṃdriyavṛttaiśca kāmarāgaprapīḍanāt|| rāgodvṛttasya satataṃ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ hi yauvane|| 42.89 || īrṣyayā sumahadduḥkhaṃ mohādraktasya jāyate|| mattasya kupitasyaiva rāgo doṣāya kevalam|| 42.90 || na rātrau viṃdate nidrā kāmāgniparikheditaḥ|| divāpi hi kutaḥ saukhyamarthopārjanaciṃtayā|| 42.91 || nārīṣu tvanubhūtāsu sarvadoṣāśrayāsu ca|| viṇmutrotsargasadṛśaṃ saukhyaṃ maithunajaṃ smṛtam|| 42.92 || sanmānamapamānena viyogeneṣṭasaṃgamaḥ|| yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ kva saukhyamanupadravam|| 42.93 || valīpalitakāyena śithilīkṛtavigrahaḥ|| sarvakriyāsvaśaktaśca jarayājarjjarīkṛtaḥ|| 42.94 || strīpuṃsoryauvanaṃ rūpaṃ yadanyonyāśrayaṃ purā|| tadevaṃ jarayā grastamubhayorapi na priyam|| 42.95 || jarābhibhūtaḥpuruṣaḥ patnīputrādibāṃdhavaiḥ|| aśaktatvāddurācārairbhṛtyaiśca paribhūyate|| 42.96 || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca nāturo yataḥ|| śaktaḥ sādhayituṃ tasmādyuvā dharmaṃ samācaret|| 42.97 || vātapittakaphādīnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ vyādhirucyate|| vātādīnāṃ samūhaśca deho'yaṃ parikīrtitaḥ|| 42.98 || tasmādvyādhimayaṃ jñeyaṃ śarīramidamātmanaḥ|| rogairnānāvidhairyāṃti dehe duḥkhānyanekaśaḥ|| 42.99 || tāni na svātmavedyāni kimanyatkathayāmyaham|| ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśatamasmindehe pratiṣṭhitam|| 42.100 || tatraikaḥ kālasaṃyuktaḥ śeṣāstvāgaṃtavaḥ smṛtāḥ|| ye tvihāgaṃtavaḥ proktāste praśāmyanti bheṣajaiḥ|| 42.101 || japahomapradānaiśca kālamṛtyurna śāmyati|| vividhā vyādhayaḥ śastāḥ sarpādyāḥ prāṇinastathā|| 42.102 || viṣāṇi cābhicārāśca mṛtyordvārāṇi dehinām|| pīḍitaṃ sarparogādyairapi dhanvaṃtariḥ svayam|| 42.103 || svasthīkartuṃ na śaknoti kālaprāptaṃ hi dehinam|| naiṣadhaṃ na tapo maṃtrā na mitrāṇi na bāṃdhavāḥ|| 42.104 || śaknuvaṃti paritrātuṃ naraṃ kālena pīḍitam|| rasāyanatapojapyairyogasiddhairmahātmabhiḥ|| 42.105 || kālamṛtyurapi prājñairnīyate nāpi saṃyutaiḥ|| nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ bhayam|| 42.106 || nāsti mṛtyusamasrāsaḥ sarveṣāmapi dehinām|| sadbhāryāputramitrāṇi rājyaiśvaryasukhāni ca|| 42.107 || ābaddhāni snehapāśairmṛtyuḥ sarvāṇi kṛṃtati|| kiṃ na paśyasi mātastvaṃ sahasrasyāpi madhyataḥ|| 42.108 || janāḥ śatāyuṣaḥ paṃcabhavaṃti na bhavanti vā|| aśītikā vipadyante kecitsaptatikā narāḥ|| 42.109 || paramāyuḥ sthitā ṣaṣṭistadapyasti na niṣṭhitam|| tasya yāvadbhavedāyurdehinaḥ pūrvakarma bhiḥ|| 42.110 || tasyārdhamāyuṣo rātrirharate mṛtyurūpiṇī|| bālabhāvena mohena vārdhake jarayā tathā|| 42.111 || varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiryāti dharmakāmārthavarjitaḥ|| āgantukairbhavaiḥ puṃsāṃ vyādhiśokairanekadhā|| 42.112 || hriyaterddhaṃ hi tatrāpi yaccheṣaṃ taddhi jīvitam|| jīvitāṃteca maraṇaṃ mahāghoramavāpnuyāt|| 42.113 || jāyate yonikoṭīṣu mṛtaḥ karmavaśātpunaḥ|| dehabhedena yaḥ puṃsāṃ viyogaḥ karmasaṃkhyayā|| 42.114 || maraṇaṃ tadvinirddiṣṭaṃ na nāśaḥ paramārthataḥ|| mahātamaḥpraviṣṭasya cchidyamāneṣu marmasu|| 42.115 || yadduḥkhaṃ maraṇaṃ jaṃtorna tasyehopamā kvacit|| hā tāta mātarhā kāṃte kraṃdatyevaṃ suduḥkhitaḥ|| 42.116 || maṇḍūka iva sarpeṇa gīryate mṛtyunā janaḥ|| bāṃdhavaiḥ saṃparityaktaḥ priyaiśca parivāritaḥ|| 42.117 || niḥśvasandīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca mukena pariśuṣyatā|| caturaṃteṣu khaṭvāyāḥ parivartanmuhurmuhuḥ|| 42.118 || saṃmūḍhaḥ kṣipatetyarthaṃ hastapādāvitastataḥ|| khaṭvāto vāṃchate bhūmiṃ bhūmeḥ khaṭvāṃ punarmahīm|| 42.119 || vivastro muktalajjaśca viṣṭhānulepitaḥ|| yācamānaśca salilaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ|| 42.120 || ciṃtayānaḥ svavittāni kasyaitāni mṛte mayi|| paṃcāvaṭānkhanamānaḥ kālapāśena karṣitaḥ|| 42.121 || mriyate paśyatāmeva gale ghurghurarāvakṛt|| jīvastṛṇajalūkeva dehāddehaṃ viśetkramāt|| 42.122 || saṃprāpyottaramaṃśena dehaṃ tyajati pūrvakam|| maraṇātprārthanā duḥkhamadhikaṃ hi vivekinaḥ|| 42.123 || kṣaṇikaṃ maraṇe duḥkhamanaṃtaṃ prārthanākṛtam|| jñātaṃ mayaitadadhunā mṛto bhavati yadguruḥ|| 42.124 || na paraḥ prārthayedbhūyastṛṣṇā lāghavakāraṇam|| ādau duḥkhaṃ tathā madhye hyantye duḥkhaṃ ca dāruṇam|| 42.125 || nisargātsarvabhūtānāmiti duḥkhaparaṃparā|| kṣudhā ca sarvarogāṇāṃ vyādhiḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 42.126 || sa cānnauṣadhilepena kṣaṇamātraṃ praśāmyati|| kṣuddhyādhervedanā tīvrā niḥśeṣabalakṛntanī|| 42.127 || tayābhibhūto mriyate yathānyairvyādhibhirnnaraḥ|| rājño'bhimānamātraṃ hi mamaiva vidyate gṛhe|| 42.128 || sarvamābharaṇaṃ bhāraṃ sarvamālepanaṃ mama|| sarvaṃ pralāpitaṃ gītaṃ nityamunmattaceṣṭitam|| 42.129 || ityevaṃ rājyasaṃbhogaiḥ kutaḥ saukhyaṃ vicārataḥ|| nṛpāṇāṃ vyagracittānāmanyonyavijigīṣayā|| 42.130 || prāyeṇa śrīmadālepānnahuṣādyā mahānṛpāḥ|| svargaṃ prāpyāpi patitāḥ kaḥ śriyo viṃdate sukham|| 42.131 || uparyupari devānāmanyonyātiśaye sthitam|| naraiḥ puṇyaphalaṃ svarge mūlacchedena bhujyate|| 42.132 || na cānyatkriyate karma so'tra doṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ|| chinnamūlataruryadvadavaśaḥ patate kṣitau|| 42.133 || puṇyamūlakṣaye tadvatpātayaṃti divaukasaḥ|| iti svargepi devānāṃ nāsti saukhyaṃ vicārataḥ|| 42.134 || tathā nārakiṇāṃ duḥkhaṃ prasiddhaṃ kiṃ ca varṇyate|| sthāvareṣvapiduḥkhāni dāvāgnihimaśoṣaṇam|| 42.135 || kuṭhāraiśṭhedanaṃ tīvraṃ valkalānāṃ ca takṣaṇam|| parṇaśakhāphalānāṃ ca pātanaṃ caṃḍavāyunā|| 42.136 || apamardaśca satataṃ gajairvanyaiśca dehibhiḥ|| tṛḍbubhukṣā ca sarpāṇāṃ krodho duḥkhaṃ ca dāruṇam|| 42.137 || duṣṭānāṃ ghātanaṃ loke pāśena ca nibandhanam|| evaṃ sarīsṛpāṇāṃ ca duḥkhaṃ mātarmuhurmuhuḥ|| 42.138 || akasmājjanmamaraṇaṃ kīṭādīnāṃ tathāvidham|| varṣāśītātapairduḥkhaṃ sukaṣṭaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām|| 42.139 || kṣuttṛṭkleśena mahatā saṃtrastāśca sadā mṛgāḥ|| paśunāganikāyānāṃ śrṛṇu duḥkhāni yāni ca|| 42.140 || kṣuttṛṭchītādidamanaṃ vadhabandhanatāḍanam|| nāsāpravedhanaṃ trāsaḥ pratodāṃkuśatāḍanam|| 42.141 || veṇukuntādinigaḍamudgarāṃ'kuśatāḍanam|| bhārodvahanasaṃkleśaṃ śikṣāyuddhādipīḍanam|| 42.142 || ātmayūthaviyogaśca vane ca nayanādikam|| durbhikṣaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca mūrkhatvaṃ ca daridratā|| 42.143 || adharottarabhāvaśca maraṇaṃ rāṣṭravibhramaḥ|| anyonyābhibhavādduḥkhamanyonyātiśayātpunaḥ|| 42.144 || anityatā prabhāvāṇāmucchrayāṇāṃ ca pātanam|| ityevamādibhirduḥkhairyasmādvyāptaṃ carācaram|| 42.145 || nirayādimanuṣyāṃtaṃ tasmātsarvaṃ tyajedbudhaḥ|| skandhātsakandhaṃ nayedbhāraṃ viśrāmaṃ manyatenyathā|| 42.146 || tadvatsarvamidaṃ loke duḥkhaṃ duḥkhena śāmyati|| evametajjagatsarvamanyonyātiśayocchritam|| 42.147 || duḥkhairākulitaṃ jñātvā nirvedaṃ paramāpnuyāt|| nirvedācca virāgaḥ syādvirāgājjñānasaṃbhavaḥ|| 42.148 || jñānena taṃ paraṃ jñātvā viṣṇuṃ muktimavāpnuyāt|| nāhametādṛśe loke rameyaṃ janani kvacit|| 42.149 || rājahaṃso yathā śuddhaḥ kākāmedhyapradarśakaḥ|| śrṛṇu mātaryatra saṃstho rameyaṃ nirupadravaḥ|| 42.150 || avidyāyanamatyugraṃ nānākarmātiśākhinam|| saṃkalpadaṃśamakaraṃ śokaharṣahimātapam|| 42.151 || mohāṃdhakāratimiraṃ lobhavyālasarīsṛpam|| viṣayānanyathādhvānaṃ kāmakrodhavimokṣakam|| 42.152 || tadatītya mahādurgaṃ praviṣṭo'smi mahadvanam|| na tatpraviśya śocaṃti na praduṣyaṃti tadvidaḥ|| 42.153 || na ca bibhyati keṣāṃcinnāsya bibhyati kecana|| 42.154 || tasminvane saptamahādrumāstu saptaiva nadyaśca phalāni sapta|| saptāśramāḥ sapta samādhayaśca dīkṣāśca saptaitadaraṇyarūpam|| 42.155 || paṃcavarṇāni divyāni caturvarṇāni kānicit|| tridvivarṇaikavarṇāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca|| 42.156 || sṛjaṃtaḥ pādapāstatra vyāpya tiṣṭhanti tadvanam|| 42.157 || sapta striyastatra vasaṃti satyastvavāṅmukhyo bhānumato bhavaṃti|| ūrdhvaṃ rasānādadate prajābhyaḥ sarvāśca tāstattvataḥ kopi vade|| 42.158 || saptaiva girayaścātra dhṛtaṃ yairbhuvanatrayam|| nadyaśca saritaḥ sapta brahmavārivahāḥ sadā|| 42.159 || tejaścābhayadānatvamadrohaḥ kauśalaṃ tathā|| acāpalyama thākrodhaḥ priyavādaśca saptamaḥ|| 42.160 || ityete girayo jñeyāstasminvidyāvane sthitāḥ|| dṛḍhaniścayastathā bhāsā samatā nigraho gumaḥ|| 42.161 || nirmamatvaṃ tapaścātra santoṣaḥ saptamo hradaḥ|| bhagavadguṇavijñānādbhaktiḥ syātprathamā nadī|| 42.162 || puṣpādipūjā dvitīyā tṛtīyā ca pradakṣiṇā|| caturthī stutivāgrūpā pañcamī īśvarārpaṇā|| 42.163 || ṣaṣṭhī brahmaikatā proktā saptamī siddhireva ca|| sapta nadyo'tra kathitā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā|| 42.164 || brahmā dharmo yamaścāgniriṃdro varuṇa eva ca|| 42.165 || dhanadaśca dhruvādīnāṃ saptakānarcayaṃtyamī|| nadīnāṃ saṃgamastatra vaikuṃṭhasamupahvare|| 42.166 || ātmatṛptā yato yāṃti śāṃtā dāṃtāḥ parātparam|| keciddrumāḥ striyaḥ kecitkecittattvavido'pare|| 42.167 || saritaḥ kecidāhuḥ sma saptaiva jñānavittamāḥ|| anapetavratakāmo'tra brahmacaryaṃ carāmi ca|| 42.168 || brahmaiva samidhastatra brahmāgnirbrahma saṃstaraḥ|| āpo brahma gurubrahma brahmacaryamidaṃ mama|| 42.169 || etadevedṛśaṃ sūkṣmaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vidurbudhāḥ|| guruṃ ca śrṛṇu me mātaryo me vidyāprado'bhavat|| 42.170 || ekaḥ śāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā hṛdyeva tiṣṭhanpuruṣaṃ praśāsti|| tenābhiyuktaḥ praṇavādivodakaṃ yatā niyuktosmi tathācarāmi|| 42.171 || eko gururnāsti tathā dvitīyo hṛdi sthitastamahaṃ nṛ bravīmi|| yaṃ cāvamānyaiva guruṃ mukundaṃ parābhūtā dānavāḥ sarva eva|| 42.172 || eko baṃdhurnāsti tato dvitīyo hṛdī sthitaṃ tamahamanubravīmi|| tenānuśiṣṭā bāṃdhavā baṃdhumaṃtaḥ saptarṣayaḥ sapta divi prabhāṃti|| 42.173 || brahmacaryaṃ ca saṃsevyaṃ gārhasthya śrṛṇu yādṛśam|| patnī prakṛtirūpā me taccitto nāsmi karhicit|| 42.174 || maccittā sā sadā mātarmama sarvārthasādhanī|| ghrāṇaṃ jihvā ca cakṣuśca tvakca śrotraṃ ca paṃcamam|| 42.175 || mano buddhiśca saptaite dīpyaṃte pāvakā mama|| gaṃdho rasaśca rūpaṃ ca śabdaḥ sparśaśca paṃcamam|| 42.176 || maṃtavyamatha boddhavyaṃ saptaitāḥ samidho mama|| hutaṃ nārāyaṇadhyānādbhuṃkte nārāyaṇaḥ svayam|| 42.177 || evaṃvidhena yajñena yajāmyasmi tamīśvaram|| akāmayānasya ca sarvakāmo bhavedadviṣāṇasya ca sarvadoṣaḥ|| 42.178 || na me svabhāveṣu bhavaṃti lepāstoyasya biṃdoriva puṣkareṣu|| nityasya me naiva bhavaṃtyanityā nirīkṣamāṇasya bahusyabhāvāt|| 42.179 || na sajjate karmasu bhogajālaṃ divīva sūryasya mayūkhajālam|| 42.180 || evaṃvidhena putreṇa mā mātarduḥkhinī bhava|| tatpadaṃ tvā ca neṣyāmi na yatkratuśatairapi|| 42.181 || iti putravacaḥ śrutvā vismitā itarābhavat|| ciṃtayāmāsa yadyevaṃ vidvānmama suto dṛḍham|| 42.182 || lokeṣu khyātimāyāti tato me syādyaśaḥ param|| ityādi ciṃtayaṃtyāṃ ca rajanyāṃ bhagavānhariḥ|| 42.183 || prahṛṣṭastasya tairvākyairvismitaḥ prādurāsa ca|| mūrteḥ svayaṃ viniṣkramya śaṃkhacakragadādharāḥ|| 42.184 || jagadudbhāsayanbhāsā sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ|| tato niṣpatya dharaṇīṃ hṛṣṭaromāśrudgadaḥ|| 42.185 || mūrdhni baddhāṃjaliṃ dhīmānaitareyo'tha tuṣṭuve|| 42.186 || namastubhyaṃ bhagavate vāsudevāya dhīmahi|| pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca|| 42.187 || namo vijñānamātrāya paramānaṃdamūrtaye|| ātmārāmāya śāṃtāya nivṛttadvaitadṛṣṭaye|| 42.188 || ātmānaṃdānuruddhāya samyaktayaktormaye namaḥ|| hṛṣīkeśāya mahate namaste'naṃtaśaktaye|| 42.189 || vacasyuparate prāpyo ya eko manasā saha|| anāmarūpacinmātraḥ so'vyānnaḥ sadasatparaḥ|| 42.190 || yasminnidaṃ yataścedaṃ tiṣṭhatyapaiti jāyate|| mṛnmayeṣviva mṛjjātistasmai te brahmaṇe namaḥ|| 42.191 || yaṃ na spṛśaṃti na vidurmanobuddhīṃdriyāsavaḥ|| aṃtarbahiśca vitataṃ vyomavatpraṇato'smyaham|| 42.192 || deheṃdriyaprāṇamanodhiyo'mī yadaṃśabddhāḥ pracaraṃti karmasu|| naivānyadālohamiva prataptaṃ sthāneṣu taddṛṣṭapadena ete|| 42.193 || caturbhiśca tribhirdvābhyāmekadhā praṇamāmi tam|| pūrvāparāparayuge śāstāraṃ paramīśvaram|| 42.194 || hitvā gatīrmokṣakāmā yaṃ bhajaṃti daśātmakam|| taṃ paraṃ satyamamalaṃ tvāṃ vayaṃ paryupāsmahe|| 42.195 || oṃnamo bhagavate mahāpuruṣāya mahānubhāvāya vibhūtipataye sakalasātvataparivṛḍhanikarakarakamalotpalakuḍmalopalālitacaraṇāraviṃdayugala paramaparameṣṭhinnamaste|| 42.196 || tavāgnirāsyaṃ vasudhāṃghriyugmaṃ nabhaḥ śiraścaṃdraravī ca netre|| samastalokā jaṭharaṃ bhujāśca diśaścatasro bhagavannamaste|| 42.197 || janmāni tāvaṃti na saṃti deva niṣpīḍya sarvāṇi ca sarvakālam|| bhūtāni yāvaṃti mayātra bhīme pītāni saṃsāramahāsamudre|| 42.198 || saṃpacchilānāṃ himavanmaheṃdrakailāsamervādiṣu naiva tādṛk|| dehānanekānanugṛhṇato me prāptāsti saṃpanmahatī tatheśa|| 42.199 || na saṃtite deva bhuvi pradeśā na yeṣu jāto'smi tathā vinaṣṭaḥ|| bhūtvā mayā yeṣu na jaṃtavaśca saṃbhakṣito vā na ca bhūtasaṃghaiḥ|| 42.200 || śokābhibhūtasya mamāśru deva yāvatpramāṇaṃ patitaṃ bhaveṣu|| tāvatpramāṇaṃ na jalaṃ payodā muṃcaṃti divyairapi varṣalakṣaiḥ|| 42.201 || manye dharitrīparamāṇusaṃkhyāmupaiti pitrorgaṇanā na mahyam|| mitrāvyamitrāṇyanujīvyabaṃdhūnsaṃkhyātumīśo'smina devadeva|| 42.202 || tvayyarpitaṃ nātha punaḥ punarme manaḥ samākṣipya sudurddharāri|| kāmo vaśaṃ kradhamukhaiḥ sahāyaiḥ karoti kiṃ tadbhagavankaromi|| 42.203 || so'haṃ bhṛśārtaḥ karuṇākarastvaṃ saṃsāragarte patitasya viṣṇo|| mahātmanāṃ saṃśrayamabhyupeto naivāvasīdatyapi durgato'pi|| 42.204 || parāyaṇaṃ rogavato hi vaidyo mahābdhimagnasya ca naurnarasya|| bālasya mātāpitarau sughorasaṃsārakhinnasya hare tvameva|| 42.205 || prasīda sarveśvara sarvabhūta sarvasya heto paramārthasāra|| māmuddharāsmāduruduḥkhasaṃghātsaṃsāragartātsvaparigraheṇa|| 42.206 || kṣṛttṛṭtridhātubhirimaṃ muhurardyamānaṃ śītoṣṇa vātasalilairitaretarācca|| kāmāgninācyuta ruṣā ca sudurbhareṇa saṃpaśyato mama urukrama sīdato hi|| 42.207 || bhavaṃtu bhadrāṇi samastadoṣāḥ prayāṃtu nāśaṃ jagato'khilasya|| mayādya bhaktyā parameśvare prabhau stute jagaddhātari vāsudeve|| 42.208 || ye bhūtale ye divi cāṃtarikṣe rasātale prāṇigaṇāśca kecit|| bhavaṃtu te siddhiyujo mayādya stute jagaddhātari vāsudeve|| 42.209 || ajñānino jñānavido bhavaṃtu praśāntibhājaḥ satatogracittāḥ|| mayā ca viśvaṃbharaṇe hyanaṃte stute jagaddhātari vāsudeve|| 42.210 || śrṛṇvaṃti ye me stuvatastathānye paśyaṃti ye māmidamīrayaṃtam|| devāsurādyā manujāstiraśco bhavaṃtu te'pyacyutayogabhājaḥ|| 42.211 || ye cāpi mūkā vikaleṃdriyatvātpaṭhaṃti no naiva vilokayaṃti|| paśvādayaḥ kīṭapipīlikādyā bhavaṃtu te'pyacyutayogabhājaḥ|| 42.212 || naśyaṃtu duḥkhāni jagatyapetu lobhādiko doṣagaṇaḥ prajābhyaḥ|| yathātmani bhrātari cātmaje vā tathā narasyāstu janepi bhāvaḥ|| 42.213 || saṃsāravaidyai'khiladoṣahānivicakṣaṇe nirvṛtihetubhūte|| saṃsārabaṃdhāḥ śithilībhavaṃtu hṛdi sthite sarvajanasya viṣṇau|| 42.214 || pāpaṃ praṇāśaṃ mama ca prayātu yanmānasaṃ yacca karomi vācā|| śarīramapyācaritaṃ ca yanme smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve|| 42.215 || yathā hi vā vāsudeveti prokte saṃkīrttane viṣṇubhaktasya vāpi|| smṛte harau vāpi prayāti pāpaṃ satyena me naśyatāṃ tena pāpam|| 42.216 || mūḍho'yamalpamatiralpaviceṣṭito'yaṃ kliṣṭaṃ mano'pi viṣayairmayi na prasaṃgi|| itthaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mayi praṇate'khileśa tvāṃ stotumaṃbujabhavo'pi hi deva neśaḥ|| 42.217|| sa tvaṃ prasīda bhagavankuru mayyanāthe viṣṇo kṛpāṃ paramakāruṇikaḥ kila tvam|| saṃsārasāgaranimagnamanaṃta dīnamuddhartumarhasi hare puruṣottamosi|| 42.218 || itthaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavānaitareyeṇa bhārata|| vāsudevo viśālātmā sānaṃdamidamāha tam|| 42.219 || vatsaitareya tuṣṭosmi bhaktyānena stavena te|| varaṃ vṛṇuṣva mattastvaṃ durlabhaṃ yadabhīpsitam|| 42.220 || ||aitareya uvāca|| eṣa eva varo nāthamama nityamabhīpsitaḥ|| majjato ghorasaṃsāre karṇadhāro hare bhava|| 42.221 || ||śrībhagavānuvāca|| mukta evāsi saṃsārādyasya te bhaktirīdṛśī|| grahairmahāgrahairbaddho naiva te dvitrayodaśī|| 42.222 || yaśca stotreṇa satataṃ guptakṣetrasamīhitam|| stoṣyate vāsudevaṃ māṃ sa pāpakṣayamāpsyati|| 42.223 || yasmādetena stotreṇa pāpaṃ nāśamavāpsyati|| aghanāśanamityeva tasmātkhyātimavāpsyati|| 42.224 || ekādaśyāmupoṣyaiva mamāgre yaḥ paṭhiṣyati|| stavamenaṃ sa pūtātmā mama lokamavāpsyati|| 42.225 || sarveṣāmeva kṣetrāṇāṃ guptakṣetraṃ priyaṃ yathā|| tathā sarvastavānāṃ ca stavoyaṃ supriyomama|| 42.226 || yāni coddiśya bhūtāni japyate'sau mahātmabhiḥ|| tāni śāṃtiṃ bhagaṃ prajñāṃ prāpsyaṃti kṛpayā mama|| 42.227 || tvaṃ ca vatsa śrautadharmānsamyagācara śraddhayā|| na tairbaṃdhaṃ mayi nyastairāpsyasyanabhisaṃdhitaiḥ|| 42.228 || yaja yajñairavāpyaiva dārānnandaya mātaram|| mayi dhyānena tīvreṇa māmavāpsyasyasaṃśayam|| 42.229 || buddhirmanotha bhūtāni buddhikarmendriyāṇi ca|| trayodaśagrahairye syustrayodaśa mahāgrahāḥ|| 42.230 || boddhavyamatha maṃtavyamahaṃtā śabda eva ca|| sparśo raso rūpagandhau vacanādānameva ca|| 42.231 || vihṛtyutsarga ānaṃdastrayodaśa mahāgrahāḥ|| etānmahāgrahanputra śuddhāñchuddhaiḥ svakairgrahaiḥ|| 42.232 || gṛhāṇa dhyānayogena mamaivaṃ mokṣamāpsyasi|| evaṃ tvaṃ karmabhirvīra naiṣkarmyaṃ samavāpsyasi|| 42.233 || śulbaṃrasena saṃviddhaṃ dakṣo hema yathāśnute|| varṇāśramācāravatā mayi saṃnyastakarmaṇā|| 42.234 || madanudhyānayuktena mokṣo nāstīha durlabhaḥ|| tasmādevaṃ vartamāno nanda vrataparāyaṇaḥ|| 42.235 || uddhṛtya saptapuruṣāllam̐yaṃ mayi gamiṣyasi|| sāṃprataṃ pratibhāsyaṃti vedaścāpaṭhitā api|| 42.236 || tatastvaṃ koṭitīrthe ca yajñe vai harimedhasaḥ|| yāhi tatra bhaviṣyaṃ te sarvaṃ māturabhīpsitam|| 42.237 || ityuktvā bhagavānviṣṇurmūrtimadhye viveśa ha|| vilokya māno nimiṣaṃ mātrā caiva sutena ca|| 42.238 || tato mūrti namaskṛtya vāsudevasya vismitaḥ|| aitareyaḥ svajananīṃ mudito vākyamabravīt|| 42.239 || purāhamabhavaṃ śūdro bhītaḥ saṃsāradoṣataḥ|| pariniṣṭhāgataṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ|| 42.240 || sa kṛpālurmama prāha mantraṃ vai dvādaśākṣaram|| sademaṃ japacetyuktvā tamahaṃ japtavānsadā|| 42.241 || tena jāpyaprabhāvena mamotpattistavodarāt|| jātasmṛtirviṣṇubhaktiḥ sthitiratra ca sarvadā|| 42.242 || idānīṃ ca prayāmyeṣa yajñaṃ taṃ harimedhasaḥ|| tvadrūpaṃ viṣṇuprītyarthaṃ praṇamya tvāṃ prasādaye|| 42.243 || tato mahīnagarakākhye koṭitīrthatalasthitam|| yajantaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ vipraiḥ koṭiśastamupāgamat|| 42.244 || gehāya mātaraṃ procya sa yajñe proktavāndvijaḥ|| namastasmai bhagavate viṣṇave'kuṇṭhamedhase|| 42.245 || yanmāyāmohitadhiyo bhramāmaḥ karmasāgare|| iti ślokaṃ mahārthaṃ te harimedhamukhā dvijāḥ|| 42.246 || ākarṇyāsanapūjādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsuraṃga tam|| tato vedārthanaipuṇyaistena te toṣitā dvijāḥ|| 42.247 || pradadurdakṣiṇāṃ sarvāṃ harimedhāḥ sutāmapi|| dravyaṃ kanyāṃ ca saṃgṛhya svagṛhaṃ samupāgamat|| 42.248 || vandayitvā svajananīṃ putrānutpādya cāmalān|| iṣṭvā yajñairaitareyo dvādaśīvratatatparaḥ|| 42.249 || vāsudevānudhyānena mokṣaṃ paścādupāgataḥ|| evaṃvidho vāsudevaḥ svayamatrāsti bhārata|| 42.250 || yoryayetpūjayetstauti sarvaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ viduḥ|| śivadharmeṣu yatproktaṃ phalaṃ pūrvaṃ mayā tava|| 42.251 || tādṛśaṃ labhate martyo vāsudevaprasādataḥ|| 42.252 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe śrīvṛddhavāsudevamāhātmyavarṇana aitareyabrāhmaṇacaritravarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 42 || cha ||
<1.2.43>
||śrīnārada uvāca|| tato'haṃ pārtha bhūyo'pi janānugrahakāmyayā|| pratyakṣadevaṃ mārtaṃḍamatrānetumiyeṣa ha|| 43.1 || sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ yasmāduḍupo bhagavānraviḥ|| ihāmutra ca kauṃteya viśvaddhārī ravirmataḥ|| 43.2 || ye smaraṃti raviṃ bhaktyā kīrtayaṃti ca ye narāḥ|| pūjayaṃti ca ye nityaṃ kṛtārthāste na saṃśayaḥ|| 43.3 || sūryabhaktiparā ye ca nityaṃ tadgatamānasāḥ|| ye smaraṃti sadā sūryaṃ na te duḥkhasya bhājinaḥ|| 43.4 || bhavanāni manojñāni vividhābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ|| dhanaṃ cādṛṣṭaparyaṃtaṃ sūryapūjāvidheḥ phalam|| 43.5 || durlabhā bhaktiḥ sūrye vā durlabhaṃ tasya cārcanam|| dānaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tasmai tato homaśca durlabhaḥ|| 43.6 || namaskārādisaṃyuktaṃ ravirityakṣaradvayam|| jihvāgre vartate yasya saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam|| 43.7 || ityahaṃ hṛdi saṃciṃtya māhātmyaṃ ravijaṃ mahat|| pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ pārtha raviṃ bhaktyā hyatoṣayam|| 43.8 || japena suviśuddhena cchandasāṃ vāyubhojanaḥ|| tataḥ khāddvitīyāṃ mūrtiṃ kṛtvā yogabalādvibhuḥ|| 43.9 || tejasā durdṛśo bhāsvānpratyakṣaḥ samajāyata|| 43.10 || tamahaṃ prāṃjalirbhūtvā namaskṛtya raviṃ prabhum|| sāmabhirvividhairdevaṃ paryatoṣayamīśvaram|| 43.11 || tuṣṭo māmāha varado devarṣe suciraṃ tvayā|| tapasārādhito'smīti varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam|| 43.12 || ityukto'haṃ lokanāthaṃ prāṃjaliḥ prāstuvaṃ vacaḥ|| yadi tuṣṭo bhavānmahyaṃ yadi deyo varo mama|| 43.13 || tataste kāmarūpe yā kalā nātha pravartate|| rājavardhanarājñā yā''rādhitā ca janaiḥ purā|| 43.14 || tayā ca kalayā bhāno sadātra sthātumarhasi|| tatastatheti devena prokte tuṣṭena bhārata|| 43.15 || asthāpayamahaṃ sūryaṃ bhaṭṭādityābhidhānakam|| bhaṭṭenasthāpitaṃ yasmānmayā tasmādravirjagau|| 43.16 || tataḥ saṃpūjya taṃ puṣpaiḥ kṛtāveśamahaṃ ravim|| bhaktyudrekāplutāṃgo'tha stutimetāmathācaram|| 43.17 || sarvavedarahasyaiśca nāmabhiśca śatāṣṭabhiḥ|| saptasaptiraciṃtyātmā mahākāruṇikottamaḥ|| 43.18 || saṃjīvano jayo jīvo jīvanātho jagatpatiḥ|| kālāśrayaḥ kālakartā mahāyogī mahāmatiḥ|| 43.19 || bhūtāṃtakaraṇo devaḥ kamalānandanandanaḥ|| sahasrapācca varado divyakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ|| 43.20 || dharmapriyocitātmā ca savitā vāyuvāhanaḥ|| ādityo'krodhanaḥ sūryo raśmimālī vibhāvasuḥ|| 43.21 || dinakṛddinahṛnmaunī suratho rathināṃvaraḥ|| rājñīpatiḥ svarṇaretāḥ pūṣā tvaṣṭā divākaraḥ|| 43.22 || ākāśatilako dhātā saṃvibhāgī manoharaḥ|| prajñaḥ prajāpatirdhanyo viṣṇuḥ śrīśo bhiṣagvaraḥ|| 43.23 || ālokakṛllokanātho lokapālanamaskṛtaḥ|| viditāśayaśca sunayo mahātmā bhaktavatsalaḥ|| 43.24 || kīrtikīrtikaro nityo rociṣṇuḥ kalmaṣāpahaḥ|| jitānando mahāvīryo haṃsaḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ|| 43.25 || kṛtakṛtyaḥ susaṃgaśca bahujño vacasāṃ patiḥ|| viśvapūjyo mṛtyuhāri ghṛṇī dharmasya kāraṇam|| 43.26 || praṇatārtiharo'roga āyuṣyamānsukhadaḥ sukhī|| maṅgalaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣo vratī vrataphalapradaḥ|| 43.27 || śuciḥ pūrṇo mokṣamārgadātā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ|| dhanvaṃtariḥ priyābhāṣī dhanurvedavidekarāṭa|| 43.28 || jagatpitā dhūmaketurvidhūto dhvāṃtahā guruḥ|| gopatiśca kṛtātithyaḥ śubhācāraḥ śucipriyaḥ|| 43.29 || sāmapriyo lokabandhurnaikarūpo yugādikṛt|| dharmaseturlokasākṣī kheṭataṛ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ|| 43.30 || mayaivaṃ saṃstuto bhānurnāmnāmaṣṭaśatena ca|| tuṣyatāṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokapriyo vibhuḥ|| 43.31 || ityevaṃ saṃstavātprīto bhāskaro māmavocata|| sadātra kalayā sthāsye devarṣe tvatpriyepsayā|| 43.32 || yo māmatra mahābhaktyā bhaṭṭādityaṃ prapūjayet|| sahasraśaḥ kā marūpe saṃpūjyāpnoti tatphalam|| 43.33 || māmuddiśya ca yo vipraḥ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu|| dāsyate'trākṣayaṃ tacca grahīṣye karajaṃ yathā|| 43.34 || raktotpalaiśca kahlāraiḥ kesaraiḥ karavīrakaiḥ|| śatatrayairmahāpdamai ravivāreṇa mānavaḥ|| 43.35 || saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā ye'rcayiṣyaṃti māmiha|| yānyānprārthayate kāmāṃstāṃtānprāpsyati niścitam|| 43.36 || darśanānmama bhaktyā ca nāśo vyādhidaridrayoḥ|| praṇāmātsvargamāpnoti śrutvā mokṣaṃ ca nityaśaḥ|| 43.37 || abhaktiṃ yaśca kartā me sa gacchenniściṃtaṃ kṣayam|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāma mamāgre yattvayeritam|| 43.38 || trikālamekakālaṃ vā paṭhataḥ śrṛṇuyatphalam|| kīrtimānsubhago vidvānsusukhī priyadarśanaḥ|| 43.39 || bhavedvarṣaśatāyuśca sarvarogavivarjitaḥ|| yastvidaṃ śrṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā prayataḥ śuciḥ|| 43.40 || akṣayaṃ svalpamapyannaṃ bhavettasyopasādhitam|| vijayī ca bhavennityaṃ tathā jātismaro bhavet|| 43.41 || tasmādetattvayā jāpyaṃ paraṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat|| tathā mamāgre kuṃḍaṃ ca kuru snānārthamuttamam|| 43.42 || kāmarūpakalā yatra tatra kuṃḍaṃ vane bhavet|| evaṃ dattvā varānbhānustatraivāṃ taradhīyata|| 43.43 || tato bhāskaravākyena siddheśasya ca savyataḥ|| vanamadhye mayā kuṃḍaṃ kṛtaṃ darbhaśalākayā|| 43.44 || kāmarūpabhavaṃ kuṃḍaṃ vṛkṣāste cāpi bhārata|| saṃlīnāstanmahāścaryaṃ mamājāyata cetasi|| 43.45 || māghamāsasya śuklāyāṃ saptamyāṃ strī naro'pi vā|| snānaṃ kuṃḍe śubhaṃ kṛtvā bhaṭṭādityaṃ prapaśyati|| 43.46 || tasyānaṃtaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ rathaṃ yaśca prapūjayet|| rathayātrāṃ ca kurute yasminyasminnasau pathi|| 43.47 || ye ca paśyaṃti lokāste dhanyāḥ sarve na saṃśayaḥ|| putradhānyadhanairyuktā nīrujastejasā'nvitāḥ|| 43.48 || bhaviṣyaṃti narāste ye kārayaṃti rathotsavam|| gaṃgādisarvatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ kīrtitaṃ budhaiḥ|| 43.49 || bhaṭṭādityasya kuṃḍe ca tatphalaṃ saptamīdine|| tatra kuṃḍe ca yaḥ snātvā sūryārghyaṃ prayacchati|| kapilāgośa tasyāsau dattasya phalamaśnute|| 43.50 || ||arjura uvāca|| vāsudevādayaḥ sarve vadaṃtyevaṃ mahāmune|| 43.51 || bhāskarārghaṃ vinā pātaḥ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ca niṣphalam|| tasyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhiṃ vidhividāṃ vara|| 43.52 || ||nārada uvāca|| yathā brahmādayo devā yacchaṃtyarghaṃ mahātmane|| bhāskarāya śrṛṇu tvaṃ taṃ vidhiṃ sarvāghanāśanam|| 43.53 || prathamaṃ tāvatpratyuṣe udite sūrye śucirbhūtvā gomayakṛtamaṃḍalasyopari raktacaṃdanena maṃḍalakaṃ kṛtvā tatastāmrapātre raktacaṃdanodakaśvetacaṃdanādidravyaiḥ prapūraṇaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye hemākṣatadūrvādadhisarpīṣi parikṣipya sthāpayet|| 43.54 || svaśarīramālabhet anena maṃtraṇa|| oṃkhakholkāya namaḥ|| saptavārānuccārya sthātavyam|| tena śuddhirupasaṃjāyate dehasyārcārhatā bhavati|| paścādāsanasthaṃ devaṃ savitāraṃ maṃḍalamadhye dvādaśātmakaṃ surādibhiḥ saṃpūjyamānaṃ dhyātvā pūrvoktamarghapātraṃ śirasi kṛtvā bhūmau jānunī nipātya sūryābhimukhastadgatamanābhūtvārghamaṃtramudāharet|| taducyate sūryavaktrādvinirgatamiti|| 43.55 || yasyoccāraṇaśabdena sthaṃ saṃsthāpya bhāskaraḥ|| pratigṛhṇāti caivārghyaṃ varamiṣṭaṃ ca yacchati|| 43.56 || oṃyasyāhuḥ sapta cchaṃdāṃsi rathe tiṣṭhaṃti vājinaḥ|| aruṇaḥ sārathiryasya rathavāho'grataḥ sthitaḥ|| 43.57 || jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśanī|| iḍā ca piṃgalā caiva vahaṃto'śvamukhāstathā|| 43.58 || ḍiṃḍiśca śeṣanāgaśca gaṇādhyakṣastathaiva ca|| skaṃdarevaṃtatārkṣyāśca tathā kalmāṣapakṣiṇau|| 43.59 || rājñī ca nikṣubhā devī lalitā caiva saṃjñikā|| tathā yajñabhujo devā ye cānye parikīrtitāḥ|| 43.60 || ebhiḥ parivṛto yo'sāvadharottaravāsibhiḥ|| tamahaṃ lokakartāramāhvayāmi tamopaham|| 43.61 || ammayo bhagavānbhānuramuṃ yajñaṃ pravartayan|| idamarghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca pragṛhāṇa namonamaḥ|| 43.62 || ||āvāhanam|| sahasrakiraṇa varada jīvanarūpa te namaḥ|| iti sāṃnidhyakaraṇam|| oṃvaṣaṭ ityuccārya sūryasya caraṇayugalaṃ paśyan bhuvi padmyāṃ pātrīṃ nirvāpayet pādyaṃ taducyate|| evaṃ pādyaṃ dattvā baddhāṃjaliḥ susvāgatamiti kuryāt|| svāgataṃ bhagavannehi mama prasādaṃ vidhāya āsyatām|| iha gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ ca prasādaṃ ca dhiyā kuru|| tiṣṭha tvaṃ tāvadatraiva yāvatpūjāṃ karomyaham|| 43.63 || evaṃ vijñāpanaṃ dadyādanena maṃtreṇa kamalāsanam|| tatkamalāsanaṃ kamalanaṃdana upāviśati|| āsana upaviṣṭasya śeṣāṃ pūjāṃ niyojayet anena vidhānena|| oṃsomamūrtikṣīrodapataye namaḥ|| iti kṣīrādisnapanam|| oṃbhāskarāya nīrava sine namaḥ|| ||iti jalasnānam|| tato vāsoyugaṃ śubhraṃ dadyāt anena maṃtreṇa|| idaṃ vāsoyugaṃ sūrya gṛhāṇa kṛpayā mama|| kaṭibhūṣaṇamekaṃ te dvitīyaṃ cāṃgaprāvaraṇam|| 43.64 || tato yajñopavītaṃ dadyāt anena maṃtreṇa|| sūtrataṃtumayaṃ śuddhaṃ pavitramidamuttamam|| yajñopavītaṃ deveśa pragṛhāṇa namo'stu te|| 43.65 || tato yathāśakti śvetamukuṭamudrikādibhūṣaṇāni dadyāt anena maṃtreṇa|| mukuṭo ratnanaddho'yaṃ mudrikāṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca|| alaṃkāraṃ gṛhaṇemaṃ mayā bhaktyā samarpitam|| 43.66 || evamalaṃkāraṃ nivedya paścātkeśarakuṃkumakarpūraraktacaṃdanamiśramanulepanaṃ dadyāt|| 43.67 || oṃtavātipriya vṛkṣāṇāṃ raso'yaṃ tigmadīdhite|| sa tavaivocitaḥ svāmingṛhāṇa kṛpayā mama|| 43.68 || tataścaṃpakajapākaravīrakarṇakakesarakokanadādibhiḥ pūjāṃ kuryāt|| 43.69 || oṃvanaspatiraso divyo gaṃdhāḍhyo gaṃdha uttamaḥ|| āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām|| 43.70 || ||śallakīdhūpamaṃtraḥ|| tataḥ pāyasādiniṣpannaṃ naivedyaṃ nivedayedanena maṃtreṇa|| naivedyamamṛtaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇavardhanam|| pūrṇapātre mayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇa prasīda me|| 43.71 || tataḥ śaucodakatāṃbūladīpārārtikaśītalikāpunaḥ pūjādi nivedya yathāśaktyā stutvā sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vā kṣamasveti procya visarjayet|| tato bhūyo namasya hemavastropavītālaṃkārān brāhmaṇāya nivedya nirmālyaṃ saṃhṛtyāṃbhasi nikṣipet|| 43.72 || ||ityarghyadānavidhiḥ|| ya evaṃ bhāskarāyārghyaṃ mūrtau maṃḍalake'pi vā|| nityaṃ nivedayetprātaḥ syādraverātmavatpriyaḥ|| 43.73 || anena vidhinā karṇo bhāskarārghyaṃ prayacchati|| tataḥ sūryasya pārthāsāvātmavadvallabho mataḥ|| 43.74 || aśaktaścennityamekamarghyaṃ dadyāddivākṛte|| tato'tra rathasaptamyāṃ kuṃḍe deyaḥ prayatnataḥ|| 43.75 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya sūryaloka mavāpnuyāt|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena dātavyo'rgho'tra bhārata|| 43.76 || evaṃvidhastvasau devo bhaṭṭādityo'tra tiṣṭhati|| bhūyānato'pi bahuśaḥ pāpahā dharmavardhanaḥ|| 43.77 || divyamaṣṭavidhaṃ cātra sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam|| pāpānāṃ copabhuktaṃ hi yathā pārtha halāhalam|| 43.78 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe sāgarasaṃgame bhaṭṭādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 43 || cha ||
<1.2.44>
||arjuna uvāca|| divyaprākāramicchāmi śrotuṃ cāhaṃ munīśvara|| kathaṃ kāryāṇi kānīha sphuṭaṃ yaiḥ puṇyapāpakam|| 44.1 || ||nārada uvāca|| śapaṣāḥ pośaghaṭakau viṣāgna taptamāṣakau|| phalaṃ ca taṃdulaṃ caiva divyānyaṣṭau vidurbudhāḥ|| 44.2 || asākṣikeṣu cārtheṣu mitho vivadamānayoḥ|| rājadrohābhiśāpeṣu sāhaseṣu tathaiva ca|| 44.3 || avidastattvataḥ satyaṃ śapathenābhilaṃghayet|| maharṣibhiśca devaiśca satyārthāḥ śapathāḥ kṛtāḥ|| 44.4 || javano nṛpatiḥ kṣīṇo mithyāśapathamācaret|| vasiṣṭhāgre varṣamadhye sānvayaḥ kila bhārata|| 44.5 || aṃdhaḥ śatrugṛhaṃ gacchedyo mithyāśapathāṃścaret|| rauravasya svayaṃ dvāramuddhāṭayati durmatiḥ|| 44.6 || manyaṃte vai pāpakṛto na kaścitapaśyatīti naḥ|| tāṃśca devāḥ prapaśyaṃti svasyaivāṃtarapauruṣāḥ|| 44.7 || ādityacaṃdrāvanilo'nalaśca dyaurbhūmirāpo hṛdayaṃ yamaśca|| ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca saṃdhye dharmo hi jānāti narasya vṛttam|| 44.8 || evaṃ tasmādabhijñāya satyarthaśapathāṃścaret|| vṛthā hi śapathānkurvanpretya ceha vinaśyati|| 44.9 || idaṃ satyaṃ vadāmīti bruvansākṣī bhavānyataḥ|| śubhāśubhaphalaṃ dehi śuciḥ pādau raveḥ svṛśet|| 44.10 || atha śāstrasya vipro'pi śastrasyāpi ca kṣatriyaḥ|| māṃ saṃspṛśaṃstathā vaiśyaḥ śudraḥ svagurumeva ca|| 44.11 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ pūjyaṃ spṛśetsādhāraṇaṃ tvidam|| kośasya rūpaṃ pūrvaṃ te vyākhyātaṃ pāṃḍunaṃdana|| 44.12 || vipravarjyaṃ tathā keśaṃ varṇināṃ dāpayennṛpaḥ|| yo yo yaddevatābhaktaḥ pāyayettasya taṃ naram|| 44.13 || samabhaktaṃ ca devānāmādityasyaiva pāyayet|| sarveṣāṃ cogradevānāṃ snāpayedāyudhāstrakam|| 44.14 || snānodakaṃ vā saṃkalpaṃ gṛhītvā pāyayennavam|| trisaptarātramadhye ca phalaṃ kośasya nirdiśet|| 44.15 || ataḥ paraṃ mahādivyavidhānaṃ śrṛṇu yadbhavet|| saṃśayacchedi sarveṣāṃ dhārṣṭyattaddivyameva ca|| 44.16 || saśiraskaṃpradātavyamiti brahmā purābravīt|| mahogrāṇāṃ ca dātavyamaśiraskamapi sphuṭam|| 44.17 || sādhūnāṃ varṇināṃ rājā na śiraskaṃ pradāpayet|| na pravātedhaṭaṃ deyaṃ noṣṇakāle hutāśanam|| 44.18 || varṇināṃ ca tathā kālaṃ taṃdulaṃ mukharogiṇām|| 44.19 || kuṣṭhapittārditānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca no viṣam|| taptamāṣakamarhaṃti sarve dharmyaṃ niratyayam|| 44.20 || na vyādhimarake deśe śapathānkośameva ca|| divyānyāsurakairmaṃtraiḥ staṃbhayaṃtīha kecana|| 44.21 || pratighātavidasteṣāṃ yojayeddharmavatsalān|| divyānāṃ stabhakāñjñātvā pāpānnityaṃ mahīpatiḥ|| 44.22 || vivāsayetsvakādrāṣṭrātte hi lokasya kaṃṭakāḥ|| teṣāmanveṣaṇe yatnaṃ rājā nityaṃ samācaret|| 44.23 || te hi pāpasamācārāstaskarebhyo'pi taskarāḥ|| prāgdṛṣṭadoṣānsvalpeṣu divyeṣu viniyojayet|| 44.24 || mahatsvapi na cārtheṣu dharmajñāndharmavatsalān|| na mithyāvacanaṃ yeṣāṃ janmaprabhṛti vidyate|| 44.25 || śraddadhyātpārthivasteṣāṃ vacanā deva bhārata|| jñātvā dharmiṣṭhatāṃ rājā puruṣasya vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 44.26 || krodhāllobhātkārayaṃśca svayameva praduṣyati|| tasmātpāpiṣu divyaṃ syāttatrādau procyate dhaṭe|| 44.27 || susamāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca digbhāge pūrvadakṣiṇe|| yajñiyasya tu vṛkṣasya sthāpyaṃ syānmuṃḍakadvayam|| 44.28 || staṃbhakasya pramāṇaṃ ca saptahastaṃ prakīrtitam|| dvau hastau nikhanetkāṣṭhaṃ dṛśyaṃ syāddhastapaṃcakam|| 44.29 || aṃtaraṃ tu tayoḥ kāryaṃ tathā hastacatuṣṭayam|| muṃḍakopari kāṣṭhaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| 44.30 || caturhastaṃ tulākāṣṭhamavraṇaṃ kārayetsthiram|| khadirārjunavṛkṣāṇāṃ śiṃśapāśālajaṃ tvatha|| 44.31 || tulākāṣṭhe tu kartavyaṃ tathā vai śikyakadvayam|| prāṅmukho niścalaḥ kāryaḥ śucau deśe dhaṭastathā|| 44.32 || pāṣāṇasyāpi jāyet staṃbheṣu ca dhaṭastathā|| vaṇiksuvarṇakāro vā kuśalaḥ kāṃsyakārakaḥ|| 44.33 || tulādhāradharaḥ kāryo ripau mitre ca yaḥ samaḥ|| śrāvayetprāḍvivāko'pi tulādhāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ|| 44.34 || brahmaghne ye smṛtā lokā ye ca strībālaghātake|| tulādhārasya te lokāstulāṃ dhārayato mṛṣā|| 44.35 || ekasmiṃstolayecchikye jñātaṃ sūpoṣitaṃ naram|| dvitīye mṛttikāṃ śubhrāṃ gaurāṃ tu tulayedbudhaḥ|| 44.36 || iṣṭikābhasmapāṣāṇakapālāsthīni varjayet|| tolayitvā tataḥ pūrvaṃ tasmāttamavatārayet|| 44.37 || mūrdhni patraṃ tato nyasya nyastapatraṃ niveśayet|| patre maṃtrastvayaṃ lekhyo yaḥ puroktaḥ śvayaṃbhuvā|| 44.38 || brahmaṇastvaṃ sutā devī tulānāmneti kathyate|| tukāro gaurave nityaṃ lakāro laghuni smṛtaḥ|| 44.39 || gurulāghavasaṃyogāttulā tena nigadyase|| saṃśayānmocayasvainamabhiśastaṃ naraṃ śubhe|| 44.40 || bhūya āropayettaṃ tu naraṃ tasminsapatrakam|| tulito yadi vardheta śuddho bhavati dharmataḥ|| 44.41 || hīyamāno na śuddhaḥ syāditi dharmavido viduḥ|| śikyacchede tulābhaṃge punarāropayennaram|| 44.42 || evaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ jñānaṃ yaccānyāyaṃ na lopayet|| etatsarvaṃ ravau vāre kāryaṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaram|| 44.43 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi viṣadivyaṃ śrṛṇuṣva me|| 44.44 || dviprakāraṃ ca tatproktaṃ ghaṭasarpaviṣaṃ tathā|| śṛṃgiṇo vatsanābhasya himaśailabhavasya vā|| 44.45 || yavāḥ sapta pradātavyā athavā ṣaḍghṛtaplutāḥ|| mūrdhni vinyastapatrasya patre caivaṃ niveśayet|| 44.46 || tvaṃ viṣa brahmaṇaḥ putra satyadharme vyavasthitaḥ|| trāyasvainaṃ naraṃ pāpātsatyenāsya bhavāmṛtam|| 44.47 || yena vegairvinā jīrṇaṃ chardimūrcchāvivarjitam|| taṃ tu śuddhaṃ vijānīyāditi dharmavido viduḥ|| 44.48 || kṣudhitaṃ kṣudhitaḥ sarpaṃ ghaṭasthaṃ procya pūrvavat|| saṃspṛśettālikāḥ sapta na daśecchudhyatīti saḥ|| 44.49 || agnidivyaṃ yathā prāha viraṃcistacchṛṇuṣva me|| saptamaṃḍalakānkuryāddevasyāgre ravestathā|| 44.50 || maṃḍalānmaṃḍalaṃ kāryaṃ pūrveṇeti viniścayaḥ|| ṣoḍaśāṃtulakaṃ kāryaṃ maṃḍalāttāvadaṃ taram|| 44.51 || ārdravāsasamāhūya tathā caivāpyupopitam|| kārayetsarvadivyāni devabrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau|| 44.52 || pratyakṣaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ rājño vādhikṛtasya vā|| brāhmaṇānāṃ śrutavatāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca|| 44.53 || paścime dinakāle hi prāṅmukhaḥ prāñjaliḥ śuciḥ|| caturasre maṃḍale'nye kṛtvā caiva samau karau|| 44.54 || lakṣayeyuḥ kṛtādīni hastayostasya hāriṇaḥ|| saptāśvatthasya patrāṇi bhadhnīyuḥ karayostataḥ|| 44.55 || navena kṛtasūtreṇa kārpāsena dṛḍhaṃ yathā|| tatastu susamaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭāṃgulamathāyasam|| 44.56 || piṃḍaṃ hutāśasaṃtaptaṃ paṃcāśatpalikaṃ dṛḍham|| ādau pūjāṃ raveḥ kṛtvā hutāśasyātha kārayet|| 44.57 || raktacaṃdanadhūpābhyāṃ raktapuṣpaistathaiva ca|| abhiśastasya patraṃ ca badhnīyāccaiva mūrdhani|| 44.58 || maṃtreṇānena saṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇābhihitena ca|| tvamagne vedāścatvārastvaṃ ca yajñeṣu hūyase|| 44.59 || pāpaṃ punāsi vai yasmāttasmātpāvaka ucyase|| tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tvaṃ mukhaṃ brahmavādinām|| 44.60 || jaṭharastho'si bhūtānāṃ tato vetsi śubhāśubham|| pāpeṣu darśayātmānamarciṣmānbhava pāvaka|| 44.61 || athavā śuddhabhāveṣu śīto bhavamahābala|| tato'bhiśastaḥ śanakairmaṃḍalāni parikramet|| 44.62 || parikramya śanairjahyāllohapiṃḍaṃ tataḥ kṣitau|| vipatrahastaṃ taṃ paścātkārayedvrīhimardanam|| 44.63 || nirvikārau karau dṛṣṭvā śuddho bhavati dharmataḥ|| bhayādvā pātayedyastu tadadho vā vibhāvyate|| 44.64 || punastvāhārayellohaṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ|| athātaḥ saṃpraaivakṣyāmi taptamāṣavidhiṃ śrṛṇu|| 44.65 || kārayedāyasaṃ pātraṃ tāmraṃ vā ṣoḍaśāṃgulam|| caturaṃgulakhātaṃ tu mṛnmayaṃ vāpi kārayet|| 44.66 || pūrayedghṛtatailābhyāṃ palairviśatibhistataḥ|| sutapte nikṣipettatra suvarṇasya tu māṣakam|| 44.67 || vahnyuktaṃ vinyasenmaṃtramabhiśastasya mūrdhani|| aṃguṣṭhāṃguliyogena taptamāṣaṃ samuddharet|| 44.68 || śuddhaṃ jñeyamasaṃdigdhaṃ visphoṭādivivarjitam|| phālaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śrṛṇu tvaṃ dhanaṃjaya|| 44.69 || āyasaṃ dvādaśapalaṃ ghaṭitaṃ phālamucyate|| aṣṭāṃgulamadīrghaṃ ca caturaṃgulavistṛtam|| 44.70 || vahnyuktaṃ vinyasenmaṃtramabhiśastasya mūrdhani|| triḥparāvartayejjihvā lihannasmātṣaḍaṃgulam|| 44.71 || gavāṃ kṣīraṃ pradātavyaṃ jihvāśodhanamuttamam|| jihvāparīkṣaṇaṃ kuryāddagdhā cenna tu vimocyate|| 44.72 || taṃ viśuddhaṃ vijānīyādviśuddhā cettu jāyate|| taṃdulasyātha vakṣyāmi vidhidharmaṃ sanātanam|| 44.73 || caurye tu taṃdulā deyā na cānyatra kathaṃcana|| taṃdulānudake siktvā rātrau tatraiva sthāpayet|| 44.74 || prabhāte kāriṇe deyā bhakṣaṇāya na saṃśayaḥ|| triḥkaॉtvaḥ prāṅmukhaścaiva patre niṣṭhīvayettataḥ|| 44.75 || pippalasyātha bhūrjasya na tvanyasya kathaṃcana|| tāṃstu vai kārayecchuddhāṃstaṃdulāñchālisaṃbhavān|| 44.76 || mṛnmaye bhājane kṛtvā savituḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ|| tandulānmaṃtrayecchuddhānmantreṇānena dharmataḥ|| 44.77 || dīyase dharmatattvajñairmānuṣāṇāṃ viśodhanam|| stutastandula satyena dharmatastrātumarhasi|| 44.78 || niṣṭhīvane kṛte teṣāṃ savituḥ purataḥ sthite|| śoṇitaṃ dṛśyate yasya tamaśuddhaṃ vinirdiśet|| 44.79 || evamaṣṭavidhaṃ divyaṃ pāpasaṃśayacchedanam|| bhaṭṭādityasya purato jāyate kurunaṃdana|| 44.80 || jaladivyaṃ tathā prāhurdviprakāraṃ purāvidaḥ|| jalahastaṃ smṛtaṃ caikaṃ majjanaṃ cāparaṃ viduḥ|| 44.81 || bāṇakṣepastathādānaṃ yāvadvīryavatā kṛtam|| tāvattaṃ majjayejjīvettathā tacchuddhimādiśet|| 44.82 || evaṃvidhamidaṃ sthānaṃ bhaṭṭādityasya bhārata|| mamaiva kṛpayā bhānorjātametanmahītale|| 44.83 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe bhaṭṭādityamāhātmye divyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 44 || cha ||
<1.2.45>
||nārada uvāca|| tathā bahūdakasthāne kathāmākarṇayādbhutām|| yasmādbahūdakaṃ kāmarūpe yadasti ca|| 45.1 || tadasti cātra saṃkrāṃtaṃ tasmātproktaṃ bahūdakam|| kapilenātra taptvā ca varṣāṇi subahūnyapi|| 45.2 || sthāpitaṃ śobhanaṃ liṃgaṃ kapilaśvarasaṃjñitam|| tacca ligaṃ sadā pārtha nandabhadra iti samṛtaḥ|| 45.3 || vāṇiksaṃpūjayāmāsa trikālaṃ ca kṛtādaraḥ|| sarvadharpraviśevajñaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ|| 45.4 || nājñātaṃ tasya kiṃcicca yaddharmeṣu prakīrtyate|| sarveṣāṃ ca suhṛnnityaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca hite rataḥ|| 45.5 || karmaṇā manasā vācā dharmamenamupāśritaḥ|| na bhūto na bhaviṣyaśca na sa dharmo'sti kiṃcana|| 45.6 || vidoṣo yo hi sarvatra niścityaivaṃ vyavasthitaḥ|| asya dharmasamudrasya saṃpravṛddhasya sarvataḥ|| 45.7 || nirmathya nandabhadreṇa āhṛtaṃ tanniśāmaya||
