vāṇijyaṃ manyate śreṣṭhaṃ jīvanāya tadā sthitaḥ|| 45.8 || paricchinnaiḥ kāṣṭhatṛṇaiḥ śaraṇaṃ tena kāritam|| madyavarjaṃ bhedavarjaṃ kūṭavarjaṃ samaṃ tathā|| 45.9 || sarvabhūteṣu vāṇijyamalpalābhena so'carat|| amāyayā parebhyo'sau gṛhītvaiva krayāṇakam|| 45.10 || amāyayaiva bhūtebhyo vikrīṇātyasya sadvratam|| kecidyajñaṃ praśaṃsaṃti nandabhadro na manyate|| 45.11 || doṣamenaṃ viniścatya śrṛmu taṃ pāṃḍunandana|| lubdho'nṛtī dāṃbhīkaśca svapraśaṃsāparāyaṇaḥ|| 45.12 || yajanyajñairjagaddhaṃ ti svaṃ cāṃdhatamasaṃ nayet|| agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyagādityamupatiṣṭhate|| 45.13 || ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvaṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ|| yadyadā yajamānasya ṛtvijo dravyameva ca|| 45.14 || cauraprāyasya kaluṣājjanma jāyejjanasya hi|| adakṣiṇe vṛthā yajñe kṛte cāpyavidhānataḥ|| 45.15 || paśavo lakuṭairhanyuryajamānaṃ mṛtaṃ hatāḥ|| tasmācchuddhairyavadravyairyajamānaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 45.16 || yajña evaṃ vicāryāsau yajñasāraṃ samāsthitaḥ|| śraddhayā devapūjā yā namaskāraḥ stutiḥ śubhā|| 45.17 || naivedyaṃ haviṣaścaiva yajño'yaṃ hi vikalmaṣaḥ|| sa eva yajñaḥ prokto vai yena tuṣyanti devatāḥ|| 45.18 || kecicchaṃsanti saṃnyāsaṃ nandabhadro na manyate|| yo hi saṃnyasya viṣayānmanasā gṛhyate punaḥ|| 45.19 || ubhayabhraṣṭa evāsau bhinnā bhūmirvinaśyati|| saṃnyāsasya tu yatsāraṃ tattenāvṛtamuttamam|| 45.20 || kasyacinnaiva karmāṇi śapate vā praśaṃsati|| nānāmārgasthitām̐llokāṃścandravallīyate kṣitau|| 45.21 || na dveṣṭi no kāmayate na viruddho'nurudhyate|| samāśmakāṃcano dhīrastulyaniṃdātmasaṃstutiḥ|| 45.22 || abhayaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo yathāṃdhabadhirākṛtiḥ|| na karmaṇāṃ phalākāṃkṣā śivasyārādhanaṃ hi tat|| 45.23 || kāraṇāddharmamanvicchanna lobhaṃ ca tataścaran|| 45.24 || vivicya naṃdabhadrastatsāraṃ mokṣeṣu jagṛhe|| kṛṣiṃ kecitpraśaṃsaṃti naṃdabhadro na manyate|| 45.25 || yasyāṃ chiṃdaṃti vṛṣāṇāṃ caiva nāsikām|| karṣayaṃti mahābhārānbadhnaṃti damayaṃti ca|| 45.26 || bahudaṃśamayāndeśānnayaṃti bahukardamān|| vāhasaṃpīḍitā dhuryāḥ sīdaṃtyavidhinā pare|| 45.27 || manyaṃte bhrūṇahatyāpi viśiṣṭā nāsya karmaṇaḥ|| aghnyā iti gavāṃ nāma śrutau tāḥ pīḍayetkatham|| 45.28 || bhūmiṃ bhūmiśayāṃścaiva haṃti kāṣṭhamayomukham|| paṃceṃdriyeṣu jīveṣu sarvaṃ vasati daivatam|| 45.29 || ādityaścaṃdramā vāyuḥ prabhūtyaiva ca tāṃstu yaḥ|| vikrīṇāti sumūḍhasya tasya kā nu vicāraṇā|| 45.30 || ajo'gnirvaruṇo meṣaḥ sūryaśca pṛthivī virāṭ|| dhenurvatsaśca somo vai vikrīyaitānna sidhyati|| 45.31 || evaṃvidhasahasraiśca yutā doṣaiḥ kṛṣiḥ sadā|| aṣṭagavaṃ syāddhi halaṃ triṃśadbhāgaṃ tyajetkṛṣeḥ|| 45.32 || dharme dadyātpaśūnvṛddhānpuṣyādeṣā kṛṣiḥ kutaḥ|| sārametatkṛṣestena naṃdabhadreṇa cādṛtam|| 45.33 || visādhitavyānyannāni svaśaktyā devapitṛṣu|| manuṣya dvijabhūteṣu niyujyāśnīta sarvadā|| 45.34 || kecicchaṃsaṃti caiśvaryaṃ naṃdabhadro na manyate|| mānuṣā mānuṣāneva dāsabhāvena bhuṃjate|| 45.35 || vadhabaṃdhanirodhena pīḍayaṃti divāniśam|| dehaṃ kimetaddhātuḥ svaṃ māturvā janakasya vā|| 45.36 || mātuḥ piturvā balinaḥ kreturagneḥ śuno'pi vā|| iti saṃciṃtya vyaharannamarā iva īśvarāḥ|| 45.37 || aiśvaryamadapāpiṣṭhā mahāmadyamadādayaḥ|| aiśvaryamadamatto hi nā patitvā hi mādyati|| 45.38 || ātmavatsarvabhṛtyeṣu śriyā naiva ca mādyati|| 45.39 || ātmapratyayavāndehī kveśvaraścedṛśo'sti hi|| aiśvaryasyāpi sāraṃ sa jagrāhaitanniśāmaya|| 45.40 || svaśaktyā sarva bhūteṣu yadasau na parāṅmukhaḥ|| tīrthāyeke praśaṃsaṃti naṃdabhadro na manyate|| 45.41 || śrameṇa saṃkarāttāpaśītavātakṣudhā tṛṣā|| krodhena dharmagehasya nāpi nāśamavāpnuyāt|| 45.42 || saukhyena vā dhanasyāpi śraddhayā svalpagorthavān|| samartho hi mahatpuṇyaṃ śakta āptuṃ kva vāsti saḥ|| 45.43 || sadā śucirdevayājī tīrthasāraṃ gṛhegṛha|| nāpaḥ punaṃti pāpāni na śailā na mahāśramāḥ|| 45.44 || ātmā punāti pāpāni yadi pāpānnivartate|| evameva samācāraṃ prādurbhūtaṃ tatastataḥ|| 45.45 || ekīkṛtya sadā dhīmānnaṃdabhadraḥ samāsthitaḥ|| tasyaivaṃ vartataḥ sādhoḥ spṛhayaṃtyapi devatāḥ|| 45.46 || vāsavapramukhāḥ sarve vismayaṃ ca paraṃ yayuḥ|| atraiva sthānake cāpi śūdro'bhūtprativeśmakaḥ|| 45.47 || sa naṃdabhadraṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ punaḥ punarasūyata|| nāstikaḥ sa durācāraḥ satyavrata iti śrutaḥ|| 45.48 || sa sadā naṃdabhadrasya vilokayati cāṃtaram|| chidraṃ cedasya paśyāmi tato dharmānnivartaye|| 45.49 || svabhāva eva krūrāṇāṃ nāstikānāṃ durātmanām|| ātmānaṃ pātayaṃtyeva pātayaṃtyaparaṃ ca yat|| 45.50 || tatastvevaṃ vartato'sya naṃdabhadrasya dhīmataḥ|| eko'bhūttayaḥ kaṣṭādvārdhike so'pyanaśyata|| 45.51 || tacca daivakṛtaṃ matvā na śuśoca mahāmatiḥ|| devo vā mānavo vāpi ko hi davādvimucyate|| 45.52 || tato'sya supriyā bhāryā sarvaiḥ sādhvīguṇairyutā|| gṛhadharmasya mūrtiryā sākṣādiva aruṃdhatī|| 45.53 || vināśamāgatā pārtha kanakānāma nāmataḥ|| tato yateṃdriyo'pyeṣa gṛhadharmavināśataḥ|| 45.54 || śuśoca hā kaṣṭamiti pāpohamiti cāsakṛt|| tattasya cāṃtaraṃ dṛṣṭvā'hṛṣyatyavrataścirāt|| 45.55 || upāvrajya ca hā kaṣṭaṃ bruvaṃstaṃ naṃdabhadrakam|| dadhikarṇa ivāsādya naṃdabhadramuvāca saḥ|| 45.56 || hā naṃdabhadra yadyevaṃ tavāpyevaṃvidhaṃ phalam|| etena manye manasi dharmopyeṣa vṛthaiva yat|| 45.57 || ityādi bahudhā procya tattadvākyaṃ tatastataḥ|| satyavratastataḥ prāha naṃdabhadraṃ kṛpānvitaḥ|| 45.58 || naṃdabhadra sadā tubhyaṃ vaktukāmosmi kiṃcana|| prastāvasyāpyabhāvācca noditaṃ ca mayā kvacit|| 45.59 || aprastāvaṃ bruvanvākyaṃ bṛhaspatirapidhruvam|| labhate buddhyavajñānamavamānaṃ ca hīnavat|| 45.60 || ||nandabhadra uvāca|| brūhibrūhi na me kiṃcitsādhu gopyaṃ priyaṃ param|| vacobhiḥ śuddhasattvānāṃ na mokṣo'pyupamīyate|| 45.61 || ||satyavrata uvāca|| navabhirnavabhiścaiva vimuktaṃ vāgvidūṣaṇaiḥ|| navabhirbuddhidoṣaiśca vākyaṃ vakṣyāmyadoṣavat|| 45.62 || saukṣmyaṃ saṃkhyākramaścāpi nirṇayaḥ saprayojanaḥ|| paṃcaitānyarthajātāni yatra tadvākyamucyate|| 45.63 || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ coddiśya cocyate|| prayojanamiti proktaṃ prathamaṃ vākyalakṣaṇam|| 45.64 || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu pratijñāya viśeṣataḥ|| idaṃ taditi vākyāṃte procyate sa vinirṇayaḥ|| 45.65 || idaṃ pūrvamidaṃ paścādvaktavyaṃ yatkrameṇa hi|| kramayogaṃ tamapyāhurvākyatattavido budhāḥ|| 45.66 || doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ pravibhāgataḥ|| ubhayārthamapi prekṣya sā saṃkhyetyupadhāryatām|| 45.67 || vākyajñeyeṣu bhinneṣu yatrābhedaḥ pradṛśyate|| tatrātiśayahetutvaṃ tatsaukṣmyamiti nirdiśet|| 45.68 || iti vākyaguṇānāṃ ca vāgdoṣāndvinava śrṛṇu|| apetārthamabhinnārthamapavṛttaṃ tathādhikam|| 45.69 || aślakṣṇaṃ cāpi saṃdigdhaṃ padāṃte guru cākṣaram|| parāṅmukhamukhaṃ yacca anṛtaṃ cāpyasaṃskṛtam|| 45.70 || viruddhaṃ yattrivargeṇa nyūnaṃ kaṣṭātiśabdakam|| vyutkramābhihṛtaṃ yac saśeṣaṃ cāpyahetukam|| 45.71 || niṣkāraṇaṃ ca vāgdoṣānbuddhijāñchṛṇu tvaṃ ca yān|| kāmātkrodhādbhayāccaiva lobhāddainyādanāryakāt|| 45.72 || hīnānukrośato mānānna ca vakṣyāmi kiṃcana|| vaktā śrotā ca vākyaṃ ca yadā tvavikalaṃ bhavet|| 45.73 || samameti vivakṣāyāṃ tadā so'rthaḥ prakāśate|| vaktavye tu yadā vaktā śrotāramavamanyate|| 45.74 || śrotā cāpyatha vaktāraṃ tadā vākyaṃ na rohati|| atha yaḥ svapriyaṃ brūyācchroturvotsṛjyayadṛtam|| 45.75 || viśaṃkā jāyate tasminvākyaṃ tadapi doṣavat|| tasmādyaḥ svapriyaṃ tyaktvā śrotuścāpyatha yatpriyam|| 45.76 || satyameva prabhāṣeta sa vaktā netaro bhuvi|| mithyāvādāñchāstrajālasaṃbhavānyadvihāya ca|| 45.77 || satyameva vrataṃ yasmāttasmātsatyavratastvaham|| satyaṃ te saṃpravakṣyāmi maṃtumarhasi tattathā|| 45.78 || yadāprabhṛti bhadra tvaṃ pāṣāṇasyārcane rataḥ|| tadāprabhṛti kiṃcicca na hi paśyāmi śobhanam|| 45.79 || ekaḥ so'pi suto naṣṭo bhāryā cāryā'pyanaśyata|| kūṭānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sādho phalamevaṃvidhaṃ bhavet|| 45.80 || kva devāḥ saṃti mithyaitaddṛśyaṃte cedbhavaṃtyapi|| sarvā ca kūṭaviprāṇāṃ dravyāyaiṣā vikalpanā|| 45.81 || pitṝnuddiśya yacchaṃti mama hāsaḥ prajāyate|| annasyopadravaṃ yacca mṛto hi kimaśiṣyata|| 45.82 || yattvidaṃ bahudhā mūḍhā varṇayaṃti dvijādhamāḥ|| viśvanirmāṇamakhilaṃ tathāpi śrṛṇu satyataḥ|| 45.83 || utpattiścāpi bhaṃgaśca viśvasyaitaddvayaṃ mṛṣā|| evameva hi sarvaṃ ca sadidaṃ vartate jagat|| 45.84 || svabhāvato viśvamidaṃ hi vartate svabhāvataḥ sūryamukhā bhramaṃtyamī|| svabhāvato vāyavo vāṃti nityaṃ svabhāvato varṣati cāṃbudo'yam|| 45.85 || svabhāvato rohati dhānyajātaṃ svabhāvato varṣaśītātapatvam|| svabhāvataḥ saṃsthitā medinī ca svabhāvataḥ saritaḥ saṃsravaṃti|| 45.86 || svabhāvataḥ parvatā bhāṃti nityaṃ svabhāvato vāridhireṣa saṃsthitaḥ|| svabhāvato garbhiṇī saṃprasūte svabhāvato'mī bahavaśca jīvāḥ|| 45.87 || yathā svabhāvena bhavaṃti vakrā ṛtusvabāvādbadarīṣu kaṇṭakāḥ|| tathā svabhāvena hi sarvametatprakāśate ko'pi kartā na dṛśyaḥ|| 45.88 || tadevaṃ saṃsthite loke mūḍho muhyati mattavat|| mānuṣyamapi yaddhūrtā vadaṃtyagryaṃ śrṛṇuṣvatat|| 45.89 || mānuṣyānna paraṃ kaṣṭaṃ vairiṇāṃ no bhaveddhi tat|| śokasthānasahasrāṇi manuṣyasya kṣaṇekṣaṇe|| 45.90 || mānuṣyaṃ hi smṛtākāraṃ sabhāgyo'smādvimucyate|| paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭāḥ kṛmayaśca yathāsukham|| 45.91 || abaddhā viharaṃtyete yonireṣāṃ sudurlabhā|| niściṃtāḥ sthāvarā hyete saukhyameṣāṃ mahadbhuvi|| 45.92 || bahunā kiṃ manuṣyebhyaḥ sarvo dhanyo'nyayonijaḥ|| svabhāvameva jānīhi puṇyāpuṇyādikalpanā|| 45.93 || yadeke sthāvarāḥ kīṭāḥ pataṃgā mānuṣādikāḥ|| tasmānmityā parityajya naṃdabhadra yathāsukham|| piba krīḍanakaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogānsatyamidaṃ bhuvi|| 45.94 || ||nārada uvāca|| ityetairamukhairvākyairayuktairasamaṃjasaiḥ|| 45.95 || satyavratasya nākampannaṃdabhadro mahāmanāḥ|| prahasanniva taṃ prāha svakṣobhyaḥ sāgaro yathā|| 45.96 || yadbhavānāha dharmiṣṭhāḥ sadā duḥkhasya bhāginaḥ|| tanmithyā duḥkhajālāni paśyāmaḥ pāpināmapi|| 45.97 || vadhabaṃdhaparikleśāḥ putradārādi paṃcatā|| pāpināmapi dṛśyaṃte tasmāddharmo gururmataḥ|| 45.98 || ayaṃ sādhuraho kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭamasya mahājanāḥ|| sādhorvadaṃtyetadapi pāpināṃ durlabhaṃ tvidam|| 45.99 || dārādidravyalobhāryaṃ viśataḥ pāpino gṛhe|| bhavānapi bibhetyasmāddveṣṭi kupyati tadvṛthā|| 45.100 || yathāsya jagato brūṣe nāsti heturmaheśvaraḥ|| tadbālabhāṣitaṃ tubhyaṃ kiṃ rājānaṃ vinā prajāḥ|| 45.101 || yacca bravīṣi pāṣāṇaṃ mithyā liṃgaṃ samarcasi|| tadbhavām̐lliṃgamāhātmyaṃ vetti nāṃdho yathā ravim|| 45.102 || brahmādāyaḥ surā sarve rājānaśca maharddhikāḥ|| mānavā munayaścaiva sarve liṃgaṃ yajaṃti ca|| 45.103 || svanāmakāni cihnāni teṣāṃ liṃgāni saṃti ca|| ete kiṃ tvabhavatmūrkhāstvaṃ tu satyavrataḥ sudhīḥ|| 45.104 || pratiṣṭhāpya purā brahmā puṣkare nīlalohitam|| prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ sasarjemāḥ prajāḥ prabhuḥ|| 45.105 || viṣṇunāpi nihatyājau rāvaṇaṃ payasāṃnidheḥ|| tīre rāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ cāsti kiṃ mudhā|| 45.106 || vṛtraṃ hatvā purā śakro maheṃdre sthāpya śaṃkaram|| liṃgaṃ vimuktapāpo'tha tridivedyāpi modate|| 45.107 || sthāpayitvā śivaṃ sūryo gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame|| nirāmayo'bhūtsomaśca prabhāse paścimodadhau|| 45.108 || kāśyāṃ yamaśca dhanadaḥ sahye garuḍakaśyapau|| naimiṣe vāyuvaruṇau sthāpya liṃgaṃ pramoditāḥ|| 45.109 || asminneva staṃbhatīrthe kumāreṇaṃ guho vibhuḥ|| liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa sarvapāpaharaṃ na kim|| 45.110 || evamanyaiḥ surairyāni pārthivairmunibhistathā|| saṃstāpitāni liṃgāni tanna saṃkhyātumutsahe|| 45.111 || pṛthivīvāsinaḥ sarve ye ca svarganivāsinaḥ|| pātālavāsinastṛptā jāyaṃte liṃgapūjayā|| 45.112 || yacca bravīṣi gīrvāṇā na saṃti santi cetkutaḥ|| kutrāpi naiva dṛśyaṃte tena me vismayo mahān|| 45.113 || raṃkavatkiṃ sma te devā yācaṃtāṃ tvāṃ kulatthavat|| yamicchisi mahāprājña sādhako hi gurustava|| 45.114 || svabāvānnaiva sarvārthāḥ saṃsiddhā yadi te mate|| bhojanādi kathaṃ sidhyedvada kartāramaṃtarā|| 45.115 || badarīmaṃtareṇāpi dṛśyaṃte kaṇṭakā na hi|| tasmātkasyāsti nirmāṇaṃ yasya yāvattathaiva tat|| 45.116 || yacca bravīṣi paśvādyāḥ sukhino dhanyakāstvamī|| tvadṛte nedamuktaṃ ca kenāpi śrutameva vā|| 45.117 || tāmasā vikalā ye ca kaṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ ca ślāghyatām|| sarveṃdriyayutāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kuto dhanyā na mānuṣāḥ|| 45.118 || satyaṃ tava vrataṃ manye narakāya tvayā''dṛtam|| atyanarthe na bhīḥ kāryā kāmoyaṃ bhavitācirāt|| 45.119 || ādāvāḍaṃbareṇaiva dhruvato'jñānameva me|| itthaṃ niḥsāratā vyaktamādāvāḍaṃbārāttu yat|| 45.120 || māyāvināṃ hi bruvatāṃ vākyaṃ cāṃḍabarāvṛtam|| kunāṇakamivoddīptaṃ parīkṣeyaṃ sadā satām|| 45.121 || ādau madhye tathā cāṃte yeṣāṃ vākyamadoṣavat|| kaṣadāhaiḥ svarṇamiva cchede'pi syācchubhaṃ śubham|| 45.122 || tvayānyathā pratijñātamuktaṃ caivānyathā punaḥ|| tvaddoṣo nāyamasmākaṃ tadvacaḥ śrṛṇumo hi ye|| 45.123 || nāstikānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ viṣasya ca guṇastvayam|| mohayaṃti paraṃ yacca doṣo naiṣaparasya tu|| 45 124 || āpo vastraṃ tilāstailaṃ gaṃdho vā sa yathā tathā|| puṣpāṇāmadhivāsena tathā saṃsargajā guṇāḥ|| 45.125 || mohajālasya yo yonirmūḍhairiha samāgamaḥ|| ahanyahani dharmasya yoniḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ|| 45.126 || tasmātprājñaiśca vṛddhaiśca śuddhabhāvaistapasvibhiḥ|| sadbhiśca saha saṃsargaḥ kāryaḥ śamaparāyaṇaiḥ|| 45.127 || na nīcairnāpyavidvadbhirnānātmajñairviśeṣataḥ|| yeṣāṃ trīṇyavadātāni yonirvidyā ca karma ca|| 45.128 || tāṃśca sevedviśeṣeṇa śāstraṃ yeṣāṃ hi vidyate|| asatāṃ darśanasparśasaṃjalpāsanabhojanaiḥ|| 45.129 || dharmācārātprahīyaṃte na ca sidhyaṃti mānavāḥ|| buddhiśca hīyate puṃsāṃ nīcaiḥ saha samāgamāt|| 45.130 || madhyaiśca madhyatāṃ yāti śreṣṭhatāṃ yāti cottamaiḥ|| iti dharmaṃ smarannāhaṃ saṃgamārthī punastava|| yannindasi dvijāneva yairapeyo'rṇavaḥ kṛtaḥ|| 45.131 || vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ smṛtayaḥ pramāṇaṃ dharmārthayuktaṃ vacanaṃ pramāṇam|| naitattrayaṃ yasya bhavetpramāṇaṃ kastasya kuryādvacanaṃ pramāṇam|| 45.132 || itirayitvā vacanaṃ mahātmā sa naṃdabhadraḥ sahasā tadaiva|| gṛhādviniḥsṛtya jagāma puṇyaṃ bahūdakaṃ bhaṭṭaravestu kuṃḍam|| 45.133 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe kapileśvaratīrthamāhātmye naṃdabhadravaṇigvṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 45 || cha ||
<1.2.46>
||nārada uvāca|| bahūdakasya kuṃḍasya tīrasthaṃ liṃgamuttamam|| kapileśvaramabhyarcya naṃdabhadrastataḥ sudhī|| 46.1 || praṇamya cāgratastasthau prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ|| saṃsāracaritaiḥ kiṃciddruḥkhī gāthāṃ vyagāyata|| 46.2 || sraṣṭāramasya jagataścetpaśyāmi sadāśivam|| nānāpṛcchābhiratha taṃ kuryāṃ nāthaṃ vilajjitam|| 46.3 || apūryamāṇaṃ tava kiṃ jagatsaṃsṛjanaṃ vinā|| nirīha bahudhā yatte sṛṣṭaṃ bhārgavavajjagat|| 46.4 || sacetanena śuddhena rāgādirahitena ca|| atha kasmādātmasadṛśaṃ na sṛṣṭaṃ nirmitaṃ jaḍam|| 46.5 || nirvaireṇa samenātha sukhaduḥkhabhavābhavaiḥ|| brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ kimeva kliśyate jagat|| 46.6 || kāṃścitsvargetha narake pātayaṃstvaṃ sadāśiva|| kiṃ phalaṃ samavāpnoṣi kimevaṃ kuruṣe vada|| 46.7 || iṣṭaiḥ putrādibhirnātha viyuktā mānavā hyamī|| kraṃdaṃti karuṇāsāra kiṃ ghṛṇāpi bhavenna te|| 46.8 || atīva nocitaṃ sarvametadīśvara sarvathā|| yatte bhaktāḥ samaṃ pāpairmajjaṃte duḥkhasāgare|| 46.9 || evaṃvidhena saṃsāracāritreṇa vimohitāḥ|| sthānāṃ taraṃ na yāsyāmi bhokṣye pāsyāmi nodakam|| 46.10 || maraṇāṃtameva yāsyāmi sthāsye saṃciṃtayannadaḥ|| sa evaṃ vimṛśanneva naṃdabhadraḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ|| 46.11 || tataścaturthe divase bahūkataṭe śubhe|| kaścidbālaḥ saptavarṣaḥ pīḍāpīḍita āyayau|| 46.12 || kṛśotīva galatkuṣṭhī pramuhyaṃśca padepeda|| naṃdabhadramuvācedaṃ kṛcchrātsaṃstabhya bālakaḥ|| 46.13 || aho surūpasarvāṃga kasmādduḥkhī bhavānapi|| tatosya kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ vyācaṣṭa naṃdabhadrakaḥ|| 46.14 || śrutvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bālo dīnamanā bravīt|| aho hā kaṣṭamatyugraṃ budhānāṃ yadabuddhitā|| 46.15 || saṃpūrṇodriyagātrā yanmartumicchaṃti vai vṛthā|| muhūrtāddhyatra khaṭvāṃgo mokṣamārgamupāgataḥ|| 46.16 || tadaho bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ satyāyuṣi tyajeddhi kaḥ|| ahameva dṛḍho manye pitṛbhyāṃ yo vivarjitaḥ|| 46.17 || aśaktaścalituṃ vāpi martumicchāmi nāpi ca|| sarve lābhāḥ sātimānā iti satyā bataśrutiḥ|| 46.18 || saṃtoṣo'pyucitastubhyaṃ dehaṃ yasya dṛḍhaṃ tvidam|| śarīraṃ nīrujaṃ cenme bhavedapi kathaṃcana|| 46.19 || kṣaṇekṣaṇe ca tatkuryāṃ bhujyate yadyugeyuge|| iṃdriyāṇi vaśe yasya śarīraṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ bhavet|| 46.20 || so'pyanyadicchate cecca ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ|| śokasthānasahasrāṇi harṣasthānaśatāni ca|| 46.21 || divase divase mūḍhamāvaśaṃti na paṃḍitam|| na hi jñānaviruddheṣu bahvabapāyeṣu karmasu|| 46.22 || mūlaghātiṣu sajjaṃte buddhimaṃto bhavadvidhāḥ|| aṣṭāṃgāṃ buddhimāhuryāṃ sarvāśreyovighātinīma|| 46.23 || śrutismṛtyaviruddhā sā buddhistvayyasti nirmalā|| atha kṛcchreṣu durgeṣu vyāpatsu svajanasya ca|| 46.24 || śārīramānasairduḥkhairna sīdaṃti bhavadvidhāḥ|| nāprāpyamabhivāṃchaṃti naṣṭaṃ necchaṃti śocitum|| 46.25 || āpatsu ca na muhyaṃti narāḥ paṃḍitabuddhayaḥ|| manodehasamutthābhyāṃ duḥkhābyāmarpitaṃ jagat|| 46.26 || tayorvyāsasamāsābhyāṃ śamopāyamimaṃ śrṛṇu|| vyādheraniṣṭasaṃsparśācchramādiṣṭavisarjanāt|| 46.27 || caturbhiḥ kāraṇairduḥkhaṃ śīriraṃ mānasaṃ ca yat|| mānasaṃ cāpyapriyasya saṃyogaḥ priyavarjanam|| 46.28 || dviprakāraṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ dvayoretadudāhṛtam|| mānasena hi duḥkhaina śarīramupatapyate|| 46.29 || ayaḥpiṃḍena taptena kuṃbhasaṃsthamivodakam|| tadāśu prati kārācca satataṃ ca vivarjanāt|| 46.30 || vyādherādheśca praśamaḥ kriyāyogadvayena tu|| mānasaṃ śamayettasmājjñānenāgnimivāṃbunā|| 46.31 || praśāṃte mānase hyasya śārīramupaśāmti|| manaso duḥkhamūlaṃ tu sneha ityupalabhyate|| 46.32 || snehācca sajjano nityaṃ janturduḥkhamupaiti ca|| snehamūlāni duḥkhāni snehajāni bhāyāni ca|| 46.33 || śokaharṣau tathāyāsaḥ sarvaṃ snehātpravartate|| 46.34 || snehātkaraṇarāgaśca prajajñe vaiṣayastathā|| aśreyaskāvubhāvatau pūrvastatra guruḥ smṛtaḥ|| 46.35 || tyāgī tasmānna duḥkhī syānnarvairo niravagrahaḥ|| atyāgī janmamaraṇe prāpnotīha punaḥpunaḥ|| 46.36 || tasmātsnehaṃ na lipsena mitrebhyo dhanasaṃcayāt|| svaśarīrasamutthaṃ ca jñānena vinirvatayet|| 46.37 || jñānānviteṣu siddheṣu śāstrūjñeṣu kṛtātmasu|| na teṣu sajjate snehaḥ padmapatreṣvivodakam|| 46.38 || rāgābhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ kāmena parikṛṣyate|| icchā saṃjāyate cāsya tatastṛṣṇā pravardhate|| 46.39 || tṛṣṇā hi sarvapāpiṣṭhā nityodvegakarī matā|| adharmabahulā caiva ghorarūpānubaṃdhinī|| 46.40 || yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryataḥ|| yāsau prāṇāṃtiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham|| 46.41 || anādyaṃtā tu sā tṛṣṇā hyaṃtardehagatā nṛṇām|| vināśayati saṃbhūtā lohaṃ lohamalo yathā|| 46.42 || yathaivaidhaḥ samutthena vahninā nāśamṛcchati|| tathā'kṛtātmā lobena svotpannena vinaśyati|| 46.43 || tasmāllobho na kartavyaḥ śarīre cātmabaṃdhuṣu|| prāpteṣu va na hṛṣyeta nāśo vāpi na śocayet|| 46.44 || ||naṃdabhadra uvāca|| aho bāla na bālastvaṃ mato me tvāṃ namāmyaham|| tvadvākyairatitṛpto'haṃ tvāṃ tu prakṣyāmi kiṃcana|| 46.45 || kāmakrodhāvahaṃkāramiṃdriyāṇi ca mānavāḥ|| niṃdaṃti tatra me nityaṃ vivakṣeyaṃ prajāyate|| 46.46 || ahameṣa mamedaṃ ca kāryamīdṛśakastvaham|| ityādi cātmavijñānamahaṃkāra iti smṛtaḥ|| 46.47 || parihāryaḥ ya cettaṃ ca vinonmattaḥ prakīryate|| kāmo'bhilāṣa ityuktaḥ saṃ cetpuṃsā vivarjyate|| 46.48 || kathaṃ svargo mumukṣā vā sādhyate dṛṣadā yathā|| krodho vā yadi saṃtyājyastataḥ śatrukṣayaḥ katham|| 46.49 || bāhyānāmāṃtarāṇāṃ vā vinā taṃ tṛṇavadviduḥ|| iṃdriyāṇi nigṛhyaiva duṣṭānīti nipīḍayet|| 46.50 || kathaṃ syāddharmaśravaṇaṃ kathaṃ vā jīvanaṃ bhavet|| etasminme mano viddhaṃkhidyate'jñānasaṃkaṭe|| 46.51 || tathā kasmādidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ jaḍaṃ viśvaṃ cidātmanā|| evaṃ yadbahudhā kleśaḥ pīḍyate hā kutastvidam|| 46.52 || ||bāla uvāca|| samyagetadyathā pṛṣṭaṃ yatra muhyaṃti jaṃtavaḥ|| śrṛṇvekāgramanā bhūtvā jñātaṃ dvaipāyanānmayā|| 46.53 || prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva anādī śrṛṇumaḥ purā|| sādharmyeṇāvatiṣṭhete sṛṣṭeḥ prāgajarāmarau|| 46.54 || tataḥ kālasvabāvābhyāṃ preritā prakṛtiḥ purā|| puṃsaḥ saṃyogamaicchatsā tadabhāvātprakupyata|| 46.55 || tatastamomayī sā ca līlayā devavīkṣitā|| rājasī samabhūddūṣṭā sāttvikī samajāyata|| 46.56 || evaṃ triguṇatāṃ yātā prakṛtirdevadarśanāt|| tāṃ samāsthāya paramastrimūrtiḥ samajāyata|| 46.57 || tasyāḥ proccāraṇārthaṃ ca pravṛttaḥ svāṃśatastataḥ|| asūyata mahattattvaṃ triguṇaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ|| 46.58 || ahaṃkāra stato jātaḥ sattvarājasatāmasaḥ|| tamo rajastvamāpadya rajaḥ sattvaguṇaṃ nayet|| 46.59 || śuddhasattve tato mokṣaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ|| tamaso rajasasta smātsaṃśuddhyarthaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ|| 46.60 || jīvātmasaṃjñānsvīyāṃśānvyabhajatparameśvaraḥ|| tāvaṃtaste ca kṣetrjñā dehā yāvaṃta eva hi|| 46.61 || niḥsaraṃti yathā lohāttaptalliṃgātsphuliṃgakāḥ|| tanmātrabhūtasargoyamahaṃkārāttu tāmasāt|| 46.62 || iṃdriyāṇāṃ sāttvikācca triguṇāni ca tānyapi|| etaiḥ saṃsiddhayaṃtreṇa saccidānandavīkṣaṇāt|| 46.63 || rajastamaśca śodhyaṃte sattvenaiva mumukṣubhiḥ|| tasmātkāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ ca iṃdriyāṇāṃ pravartanam|| 46.64 || ahaṃkāraṃ ca saṃsevya sāttvikīṃ siddhimaśnute|| rājasāstāmasāścaiva tyājyāḥ kāmādayastvamī|| 46.65 || sāttvikāḥ sarvadā sevyāḥ saṃsāravijigīṣubhiḥ|| guṇatrayasya vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepāllakṣaṇaṃ tava|| 46.66 || sāstrābhyāsastato jñānaṃ śaucamiṃdriyanigrahaḥ|| dharmakriyātmaciṃtā ca sāttvikaṃ guṇa lakṣaṇam|| 46.67 || anyāyena dhanādānaṃ taṃdrī nāstikyameva ca|| krauryaṃ ca yācakādyaṃ ca tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam|| 46.68 || tasmādbuddhimukaistvataiḥ sāttvikairdevatāṃ bhajet|| rājasairmānavatvaṃ ca tāmasaiḥ sthāṇuyonitā|| 46.69 || buddhyādyaireva muktiḥ syādetaireva ca yātanā|| 46.70 || amīṣāṃ cāpya bhāve vai na kiṃcidupapadyate|| kalādo hi kalādīnāṃ suvarṇaṃ śodhayedyathā|| 46.71 || tathā rajastamaścaiva saṃśodhye sāttvikairguṇaiḥ|| asmādeva guṇānāṃ ca samavāyādanādijāt|| 46.72 || sukhino duḥkhinaścaiva prāṇinaḥ śāstradarśinaḥ|| aṣṭāviṃśatilakṣaiśca guṇamekaikamīśvaraḥ|| 46.73 || vyabhajaccaturā śītilakṣāstā jīvayonayaḥ|| sakāśānmanasastadvadātmanaḥ prabhavaṃti hi|| 46.74 || īśvarāṃśāśca te sarve mohitāḥ prākṛtairguṇaiḥ|| kleśānāsādayaṃtyeva yathaivādhikṛtā vibhoḥ|| 46.75 || annānāṃ payasāṃ cāpi jīvānāṃ cātha śreyase|| mānuṣyamāhustattvajñāḥ śivabhāvena bhāvitam|| 46.76 || ||naṃdabhadra uvāca|| evametatkiṃ tu bhūyaḥ prakṣyāmyetanmahāmate|| īśvarāḥ sarvadātāraḥ pūjyaṃte yaiśca devatāḥ|| 46.77 || svabhaktāṃstānna duḥkhebhyaḥ kasmādrakṣaṃti mānavān|| viśeṣātkepi dṛśyaṃte duḥkhamagnāḥ surānratāḥ|| 46.78 || iti me muhyate buddhistvaṃ vā kiṃ bāla manyase|| 46.79 || ||bāla uvāca|| aśuciśca śuciścāpi devabhakto dvidhā smṛtaḥ|| karmaṇā manasā vācā tadrato bhakta ucyate|| 46.80 || aśucirdevatāścaiva yadā pujayate naraḥ|| tadā bhūtānyā viśaṃti sa ca muhyati tatkṣaṇāt|| 46.81 || vimūḍhaścāpṭayakāryāṇi tāni tāni niṣevate|| tato vinaśyati kṣipraṃ nāśuciḥ pūjayettataḥ|| śucirvābhyarcayedyaśca tasya cedaśubhaṃ bhavet|| 46.82 || tasya pūrvakṛtaṃ vyaktaṃ karmaṇāṃ koṭi mucyate|| maheśvaro brahmahatyābhayādyatra tatastataḥ|| 46.83 || sasnau tīrtheṣu kasmācca itaro mucyate katham|| ambarīṣasutāṃ hṛtvā parvatānnāradāttathā|| 46.84 || sītāpahāramāpede rāmo'nyo mucyate katham|| brahmāpi śirasaśchedaṃ kāmayitvā sutāmagāt|| 46.85 || iṃdracaṃdraraviviṣṇupramukhāḥ prāpnuyuḥ kṛtam|| tasmādavaśyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhojyameva naraiḥ sadā|| 46.86 || mucyate ko'pi svakṛtānnaiveti śrutinirṇayaḥ|| kiṃ tu devaprasādena labhyamekaṃ suravrataiḥ|| 46.87 || bahubhirjanmabhirbhojyaṃ bhujyetaikena janmanā|| tacca bhuktvāta tastvartho bhavediti viniścayaḥ|| 46.88 || ye tapyaṃte gataiḥ pāpaiḥ śucayo devatāvratāḥ|| iha te putrapautraiśca modaṃte'mutra ceha ca|| 46.89 || tasmāddevāḥ sadā pūjyāḥ śucibhiḥ śraddhayānvitaiḥ|| prakṛtiḥ śodhanīyā ca svavarṇoditakarmabhiḥ|| 46.90 || svanuṣṭhito'pi dharmaḥ syātkleśāyaiva vināśivam|| durācārasya devopi prāheti bhagavānharaḥ|| 46.91 || bhoktavyaṃ svakṛtaṃ tasmātpūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ|| svācāreṇa parityājyau rāgadveṣāvidaṃ param|| 46.92 || ||nandabhadra uvāca|| śuddhaprajña kimetacca pāpino'pi narā yadā|| modamānāḥ pradṛśyante dārairapi dhanairapi|| 46.93 || ||bāla uvāca|| vyaktaṃ taistamasā dattaṃ dānaṃ pūrveṣu janmasu|| rajasā pūjitaḥ śaṃbhustatprāptaṃ svakṛtaṃ ca taiḥ|| 46.94 || kiṃ tu yattamasā karma kṛtaṃ tasya prabhāvataḥ|| dharmāya na ratirbhūyāttatasteṣāṃ vidāṃvara|| 46.95 || bhuktvā puṇyaphalaṃ yāti narakaṃ saṃśayaḥ|| asmiṃśca saṃśaye proktaṃ mārkaṃḍeyena śrūyate|| 46.96 || ihaivaikasya nāmutra amutraikasya no iha|| iha cāmutra caikasya nāmutraikasya no iha|| 46.97 || pūrvopāttaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ bhuktirnaivārjayantyapi|| iha bhogaḥ sa vai prokto durbhagasyālpamedhasaḥ|| 46.98 || pūrvopāttaṃ yasya nāsti tapobhiścārjayatyapi|| paraloke tasya bhogo dhīmataḥ sa kriyātsphuṭam|| 46.99 || pūrvopāttaṃ yasya nāsti puṇyaṃ cehāpi nārjayet|| tataścohāmutra vāpi bho dhiktaṃ ca narādhamam|| 46.100 || iti jñātvā mahābhāgatyaktvā śalyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ|| bhaja rudraṃ varṇadharmaṃ pālayāsmātparaṃ na hi|| 46.101 || yohi naṣṭeṣvabhīṣṭeṣu prāpteṣvapi ca śocati|| tṛpyeta vā bhavedbandho niścitaṃ so'nyajanmanaḥ|| 46.102 || ||nandabhadra uvāca|| namastubhyamabālāya bālarūpāya dhīmate|| ko bhavāṃstattvato vettumicchāmi tvāṃ śucismitam|| 46.103 || bahavo'pi mayā vṛddhā dṛṣṭāścopāsitāḥ sadā|| teṣāmīdṛśakā buddhirna dṛṣṭā na śrutāmayā|| 46.104 || yena me janmasaṃdehā nāśitā līlayaiva ca|| tasmātsāmānyarūpastvaṃ niścitaṃ na mataṃ mama|| 46.105 || ||bāla uvāca|| mahadetatsamākhyeyamekāgraḥ śrṛṇu tattvataḥ|| itaḥ saptādhike cāpi saptame janmani tvaham|| 46.106 || vaidiśe nagare vipro nāmnā'saṃ dharmajālikaḥ|| vedavedāṃgatattvatraḥ smṛtiśāstrārthavidvaraḥ|| 46.107 || vyākhyātā dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ yathā sākṣādbṛhaspatiḥ|| kiṃ tvahaṃ vividhāndharmālloṃkānāṃ varṇaye bhṛśam|| 46.108 || svayaṃ cātidurācāraḥ pāpināmapi pāparāṭ|| maṃsāśī madyasevī ca paradārarataḥ sadā|| 46.109 || asatyabhāṣī dambhīca sadā dharmadhvajī khalaḥ|| lobhī durātmā kathako na kartā karhicitkvacit|| 46.110 || yasmājjālikavajjālaṃ lokebhyo'haṃ kṣipāmi ca|| tattvajñā māṃ tataḥ prāhurdharmajālika ityuta|| 46.111 || so'haṃ tairbahubhiścīrṇaiḥ pātakairaṃta āgate|| mṛto gato yamasthānaṃ pātitaḥ kūṭaśālmalīm|| 46.112 || yamadutaistataḥ kṛṣṭaḥ smāryamāmaḥ svaceṣṭitam|| khaḍgaiśca kṛtyamāno'haṃ jīvāmi pramiyāmi ca|| 46.113 || ātmānaṃ bahudhā niṃdañchāśvatīrnyavasaṃ samāḥ|| narake yā matirbhūyāddharmaṃ prati prapīḍataḥ|| 46.114 || sā cenmuhūrtamātraṃ syādapi dhanyastataḥ pumān|| namonamaḥ karmabhūmyai sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca vā|| 46.115 || yasyāṃ muhūrtamātreṇa yugairapi na naśyati|| tato vipaścijjanako mokṣayāmāsa nārakāt|| 46.116 || taiḥ sahāhaṃ pramuktaśca kathaṃcidavapīḍitaḥ|| sthāṇutvamanubhūyātha kleśānāsādya bhūriśaḥ|| 46.117 || kīṭohamabhavaṃ paścāttīre sārasvate śubhe|| tatra mārge sukhamiva saṃsuptohaṃ yadṛcchayā|| 46.118 || āgacchato rathasyāsya śabdamaśrauṣamunnatam|| taṃ meghaninadaṃ śrutvā bhītohaṃ sahasā javāt|| 46.119 || mārgamutsṛjya dūreṇa prapalāyanamācaram|| etasminnaṃtare vyāsastatra prāpto yadṛcchayā|| 46.120 || sa māmapaśyattrastaṃ ca kṛpayā saṃyuto muniḥ|| yanmayā sarvalokānāṃ nānādharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ|| 46.121 || viprajanmani tasyaiva prabhāvādvyāsasaṃgamaḥ|| tataḥ sarvarutajño māṃ prāhārcyaḥ kīṭabhāṣayā|| 46.122 || kimevaṃ naśyase kīṭa kasmānmṛtyorbibheṣi ca|| aho samucitā bhītirmanuṣyasya kutastava|| 46.123 || ityukto matimānpūrvapuṇyādvyāsaṃ tadocivān|| na me bhayaṃ jagadvaṃdya mṛtyorasmātkathaṃcana|| 46.124 || etadeva bhayaṃ mānya gaccheyamadhamāṃ gatim|| asyā api kuyoneśca saṃtyanyāḥ koṭiśo'dhamāḥ|| 46.125 || tāsu garbhādikakleśabhītastrasto'smi nānyathā|| 46.126 || ||vyāsa uvāca|| mā bhayaṃ kuru sarvābhyo yonibhyaśca cirādiva|| mokṣayiṣyāmi brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpayiṣyāmi niścitam|| 46.127 || ityuktohaṃ kāliyena taṃ praṇamya jagadgurum|| mārgamāgatya cakreṇa pīḍito mṛtyumāgamam|| 46.128 || tataḥ kākaśrṛgālādiyoniṣvasmi yadā'bhavam|| tadātadā samāgamya vyāso māṃ smārayacca tat|| 46.129 || tato bahuvidhā yonīḥ parikramyāsmi karṣitaḥ|| brāhmaṇasya ca gehesyāṃ yonau jāto'tiduḥkhitaḥ|| 46.130 || tato janmaprabhṛtyasmi pitṛbhyāṃ parivarjitaḥ|| galatkuṣṭhī mahāpīḍāmetāṃ yo'nubhavāmi ca|| 46.131 || tato māṃ paṃcame varṣe vyāsa āgatya japtavān|| karṇe sārasvataṃ maṃtraṃ tenāhaṃ saṃsmarāmi ca|| 46.132 || anadhītāni śāstrāṇi vedāndharmāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ|| uktaṃ vyāsena cedaṃ me gaccha kṣetraṃ guhasya ca|| tatra tvaṃ naṃdabhadraṃ ca āśvāsayamahāmatim|| 46.133 || tyatkvā bahūdake prāṇānasthikṣepaṃ mahījale|| kārāyya tvaṃ tato bhāvī maitreya iti sanmuniḥ|| 46.134 || gamiṣyasi tato mokṣamiti māṃ vyāsa uktavān|| āgataśca tataścātra vāhīkebhyo'yo'tikleśataḥ|| 46.135 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvamātmanaścaritaṃ mayā|| pāpamevaṃvidhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ naṃdabhadra sadā tyaja|| 46.136 || ||naṃdabhadra uvāca|| aho mahādbhutaṃ tubhyaṃ caritaṃ yena me hṛdi|| bhūyaḥ śataguṇaṃ jātaṃ dharmāyadṛḍhamānasam|| 46.137 || kiṃ tu tvayoktadharmasya kartukāmosmi niṣkṛtim|| dharmaṃ smara bhavāṃstasmātkiṃcidādiśa niścitam|| 46.138 || ||bāla uvāca|| atra tīrthe ca saptāhaṃ nirāhārastvahaṃ sthitaḥ|| sūryamaṃtrāñjamiṣyāmi tyakṣyāmi ca tatastvasūn|| 46.139 || tato barkarikātīrthe dagdhavyohaṃ tvayā taṭe|| asthīni sāgare cāpi mama kṣepyāṇi cātra hi|| 46.140 || yadi sāpahnavaṃ cittaṃ mayyatīva tavāsti cet|| tatastvāṃ gurukāryārthamādekṣyāmi śrṛṇuṣva tat|| 46.141 || asminbahūdake tīrthe yatra prāṇāṃstyajāmyaham|| tatra mannāmacihnaste saṃsthāpyo bhāskaro vibhuḥ|| 46.142 || ārogyaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca putradārādisaṃpadaḥ|| bhāskaro bhagavāṃstuṣṭo dadyādetacchrutervacaḥ|| 46.143 || savitā paramo devaḥ sarvasvaṃ vā dvijanmanām|| vedavedāṃgagītaśca tvamapyenaṃ sadā bhaja|| 46.144 || bahūdakamidaṃ kuṃḍaṃ saṃsevyaṃ ca sadā tvayā|| māhātmyamasya vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepādvyāsa sūcitam|| 46.145 || bahūdake kuṃḍavare snāti yo vidhivannaraḥ|| ārogyaṃ dhanadhānyādyaṃ tasya syātsarvajanmasu|| 46.146 || bahūdake ca yaḥ snātvā saptamyāṃ māghamāsake|| dadyātpiṃḍaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca te'kṣyāṃ tṛptimāpnuyuḥ|| 46.147 || bahūdakasya tīre yaḥ śuciryajati vai kratum|| śatakratuphalaṃ tasya nāsti kācidvicāraṇā|| 46.148 || atra yastyajati prāṇānbahūdakataṭe naraḥ|| modate sūryaloke'sau dharmiṇāṃ ca suto bhavet|| 46.149 || bahūdakasya tīre ca yaḥ kuryyājjapasādhanam|| sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ japo homaśca pūjanam|| 46.150 || bahūdakasya tīre ca dvijamekaṃ ca bhojayet|| yo miṣṭānnena tasya syādviprakoṭiśca bhojitā|| 46.151 || bahūdakasya tīre yā nārī gauriṇikāḥ śubhāḥ|| saṃbhojayati tasyāśca kuryātsusvāgataṃ hyumā|| 46.152 || bahūdakasya tīre ca yaḥ kuryādyogasādhanam|| ṣaṇmāsābhyantare siddhirbhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ|| 46.153 || bahūdakasya tīre ca pretānuddiśya dīyate|| yatkiṃcidakṣayaṃ teṣāmupatiṣṭhenna cānyathā|| 46.154 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam|| kṛtaṃ bahūdakataṭe sarvaṃ syātsumahātphalam|| 46.155 || tvayaitaddhṛdi saṃdhārya phalaṃ vyāsena sūcitam|| bahūdakasya kuṃḍasya naṃdabhadra mahāmate|| 46.156 || ityuktvā so'bhavanmaunī snātvā kuṃḍe tataḥ śuciḥ|| tīre prastaramāśritya svayaṃ maṃtrāñjāpa ha|| 46.157 || ||śrīnārada uvāca|| tataḥ sa saptarātrāṃte jahau bālo nijānasūn|| saṃskārito yathoktaṃ ca naṃdabhadreṇa brāhmaṇaiḥ|| 46.158 || yatra bālaḥ sa ca prāṇāñjahau japaparāyaṇaḥ|| bālādityamiti khyātaṃ tatrāsthāpayata prabhum|| 46.159 || bahūdake ca yaḥ snātvā bālādityaṃ prapūjayet|| tasya syādbhāskarastuṣṭo mokṣopāyaṃ ca viṃdati|| 46.160 || naṃdabhadro 'pyathānyasyāṃ bhāryāyāmaparānsutān|| utpādyātmasamandhīmāñchivasūryaparāyaṇaḥ|| 46.161 || rudradehaṃ yayau pārtha punarāvṛttidurlabham|| evametanmahākuṃḍaṃ bahūdakamiti smṛtam|| 46.162 || asya tīre svamaṃśaṃ ca vallīnāthaḥ pramekṣyati|| dattātreyasya yo yogī hyavatāro bhaviṣyati|| 46.163 || arcayitvā ca taṃ devaṃ yogasiddhi mavāpnuyāt|| paśūnāmṛddhimāpnoti gośaraṇyo hyasau prabhuḥ|| 46.164 || paścimāyāṃ budhasutastathā kṣetraṃ sa bhārata|| purūravādityamiti sthāpayāmāsa pārthivaḥ|| 46.165 || sarvakāmapradaścāsau bhaṭṭadityasamo rivaḥ|| bahūdakakṣetrasamaṃ tasya kṣetraṃ ca bhārata|| 46.166 || asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ japtavyaṃ karṇamūlake|| putrasya vāpi śiṣyasya na kathaṃcana nāstikaḥ|| 46.167 || śrṛṇotīdaṃ śraddhayā yastasya tuṣyeśca bhāskaraḥ|| dhārayanhṛdaye mokṣaṃmucyate bhavasāgarāt|| 46.168 || ici śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe bahūdakamāhātmya bālādityavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 46 || cha ||
<1.2.47>
|| nārada uvāca || || tato mayāsya tīrthasya rakṣaṇāya punarjaya || samārādhya yathā devyaḥ sthāpitāstacchṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ||1|| yathātmā sarvabhūteṣu vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ || tathaiva prakṛtirnityā vyāpakā parameśvarī || 2 || śakti prasādādāpnoti vīryaṃ sarvāśca saṃpadaḥ || īśvarī sarvabhūteṣu sā caivaṃ pārtha saṃsthitā || 3 || buddhihrīpuṣṭilajjeti tuṣṭiḥ śāṃtiḥ kṣamā spṛhā || śraddhā ca cetanā śaktirmaṃtrotsāhaprabhūdbhavā || 4 || iyameva ca baṃdhāya mokṣāyeyaṃ ca sarvadā || enāmārādhya caiśvaryamindrādyāḥ samavāpnuyuḥ || 5 || ye ca śaktiṃ na manyaṃte tiraskurvaṃti cādhamāḥ || yogīndrā api te vyaktaṃ bhraśyaṃte kāśijā yathā || 6 || vārāṇasyāṃ kila purā siddhayogīśvarāḥ punaḥ || avamanya ca te śaktiṃ punarbhraṃśamupāgatāḥ || 7 || tasmātsadā dehineyaṃ śaktiḥ pūjyaiva nityadā || tuṣṭā dadāti sā kāmānruṣṭā saṃharate kṣaṇāt || 8 || paramā prakṛtiḥ sā ca bahubhedairvyavasthitā || tāsāṃ madhye mahādevyo hyatra saṃsthāpitāḥ śṛṇu ||9|| catasrastu mahāśaktyaścaturdikṣu vyavasthitāḥ || siddhāṃbikā tu pūrvasyāṃ sthāpitā sā guhena ca || 1.2.47.10 || jagadādau mūlūprakṛterutpannā sā prakīrtyate || ārādhitā yataḥ siddhaistasmātsiddhāṃbikā ca sā ||11|| dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathā tārā saṃsthitā sthāpitā mayā || tāraṇārthāya devānāṃ yasmātkūrmaṃ samāśritā || 12 || yayāviṣṭaḥ samujjahre vedānkūrmo jagadguruḥ || anayāviṣṭadehaśca budho bauddhānhaniṣyati ||13|| koṭiśo vedamārgasya dhvaṃsakānpāpakarmiṇaḥ|| iyaṃ mayā samārādhya samānītā gireḥ sutā || 14 || koṭisaṃkhyābhiratyugradevībhiḥ saṃvṛtā ca sā || dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritya saṃsthitā mama gauravāt ||15|| paścimāyāṃ tathā devī saṃsthitā bhāskarā śubhā || yayāviṣṭāni bhāsaṃte bhāskarapramukhāni ca||16|| biṃbāni sarvatārāṇāṃ gacchantyāyāṃti ca drutam || saiṣā mahābalā śaktirbhāsvarā kurunandana ||17|| mayārādhya samānītā kaṭāhādatra saṃsthitā || koṭikoṭivṛtā nityaṃ trāyate paścimāṃ diśam || 18 || uttarasyāṃ tathā devī saṃsthitā yoganaṃdinī || paramaprakṛterdehātpūrvaṃ niḥsṛtayā yayā || 19 || dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭā nirmalayā yogamāpuścatuḥsanāḥ || yogīśvarī ca sā devī sanakādyaiḥ sutoṣitā || 1.2.47.20 || saiva cāṃḍakaṭāhānme samārādhyātra prāpitā || yoginībhiḥ parivṛtā saṃsthitā cottarāṃ diśam || 21 || evametā mahāśaktyaścatasraḥ saṃsthitāḥ sadā || pūjitāḥ kāmadā nityaṃ ruṣṭāḥ saṃharaṇakṣamāḥ || 22 || tataśca nava me durgāḥ samānītāḥ śṛṇudhva tāḥ || 23 || tripurānāma paramā devī sthāṇuryayā purā || āviṣṭastripuraṃ ninye bhasmatvaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ || 24 || tripureti tatastāṃ tu proktavānbhagavānharaḥ || tuṣṭāva ca svayaṃ tasmātpūjyā sā jagatāmapi || 25 || sā cārādhya samānītā mayāmareśvaraparvatāt || bhaktānāṃ kāmadā sāsti bhaṭṭādityasamīpataḥ || 26 || aparā cāpi kolaṃbā mahāśaktiḥ sanātanī || kolarūpī yayāviṣṭaḥ keśavaścojjahāra gām || 27 || tasmātsā viṣṇunā coktā kolaṃbeti stutārcitā || sā ca devī mayā pārtha bhaktiyogena toṣitā || 28 || vārāhagirisaṃsthā māṃ samānītā ca sābravīt || yatrāhaṃ nārada sadā tiṣṭhāmi kṛpayārthinām || || 29 || tatra kūpena saṃstheyaṃ rudrāṇīsaṃsthitena vai || taṃ hi kūpaṃ vinā mahyaṃ na ratirjāyate kvacit ||1.2.47.30|| tasmādbhavānkūpavaraṃ svayamatra khana dvija || evamukte pārtha devyā darbhamūlena me tadā || 31 || kūpo'khani yatra sākṣādrudrāṇī kūpa ābabhau || tato mayā tatra devāḥ snātvā japtvā ca tarpitāḥ||32|| pūjitā ca tato daivī kolaṃbā jagadīśvarī || parituṣṭā tadā devī praṇataṃ mā tato'bravīt || 33 || sadātra cāhaṃ sthāsyāmi prasādaṃ prāpitā tvayā || ye ca kūpetra saṃsnātvā māghāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||34|| pūjayiṣyaṃti māṃ martyāsteṣāṃ chetsyāmi duṣkṛtam || sarvatīrthamayī yaśca sarvartukavanesthitaḥ || 35 || meroḥ samīpe rudrāṇyāḥ kūpa eṣa sa eva ca ||36|| prayāgādapi gaṃgāyā gayāyāśca viśeṣataḥ || kūpesminnadhikaṃ snānaṃ mayā nārada kīrtitam || 37 || tadahaṃ tava vākyena saṃsthitātra tapodhana || guhenātha saraḥ puṇyaṃ pālayiṣyāmyataṃdritā || 38 || kumāreśaṃ pūjayitvā pūjayiṣyaṃti ye ca mām || devībhiḥ ṣaṣṭikoṭībhiryutā teṣāmabhīṣṭadā || 39 || || nārada uvāca || || ityukto'haṃ pārtha devyā tadānīṃ prīyamāṇayā || pratyabravaṃ pramuditaḥ kolaṃbāṃ viśvamātaram || 1.2.47.40 || atrāsya mātā tvaṃ devi guptakṣetrasyakāraṇam || tīrthayātrā vṛthā teṣāṃ nārccayaṃtīha tvāṃ ca ye || 41 || idaṃ ca yatsaraḥ puṇyaṃ tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati || īśvarī saraso'sya tvaṃ tīrthasyāsya tatheśvarī || 42 || evaṃ dīrghaṃ tapastaptvā sthāpitā mayakā śubhā || mahādurgā naraistasmātpūjyeyaṃ satataṃ budhaiḥ || 43 || tṛtīyā ca diśi tasyāṃ sthitā saṃsthāpitā mayā || guhena ca kapāleśyāḥ prabhāvosyāḥ pureritaḥ || 44 || dhanyāste ye prapaśyaṃti nityamenāṃ narottamāḥ || kapāleśvaramabhyarcya viśvaśaktiriyaṃ yataḥ || 45 || evametāstisro durgāḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi saṃsthitāḥ || paścimāyāṃ pravakṣyāmi tisro durgā mahottamā || 46 || suvarṇākṣī tu yā devī brahmāṃḍaparipālinī || sā mayātra samārādhya tīrthe devī niveśitā || || 47 || ye caināṃ praṇamiṣyaṃti pūjayiṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || trayastriṃśadbhiḥ koṭībhirdevībhiḥ pūjitā ca taiḥ || 48 || aparā ca mahādurgā carcitā ceti saṃsthitā | rasātalatalāttatra mayānītā subhaktitaḥ || 49 || iyamarcyā ca ciṃtyā ca vīratvaṃ samabhīpsubhiḥ || bahubhirdevadaiteyairdadau tebhyaśca vīratām || 1.2.47.50 || iyameva mahādurgā śūdrakaṃ vīrasattamam | caurairbaddhaṃ kalau cāgre mokṣayiṣyati vikramāt || 51 || tatastvetāṃ sa cārādhya vīreṃdratvamavāpsyati || nihaniṣyati cākramya kālasenamukhānripūn || 52 || tasmādiyaṃ samārādhyā vīryakāmairnaraiḥ sadā || carcitā yā mahādurgā paścimāyāṃ diśi sthitā || 53 || tathā trailokyavijayā tṛtīyasyāṃ diśi sthitā | yāmārādhya jayaṃ prāptastrilokyāṃ rohiṇīpatiḥ || somalokānmayānītā pūjitā jayadā sadā || 54 || evametāḥ paścimāyāmuttarasyāmataḥ śṛṇu || tisro devyaścottarasyāmekavīrāmukhāḥ sthitāḥ || 55 || ekavīreti yā devī sākṣātsā śivapūjitā || yayāviṣṭo jagatsarvaṃ saṃharatyeṣa bhūtarāṭ || 56 || vīryeṇādyekavīrāyāḥ kṛtvā lokāṃśca bhasmasāt || yugaikādaśapūrṇatve vilakṣo'bhūtsa bhasmani || 57 || evaṃvidhā tvekavīrā śaktireṣā sanātanī || pūjitārādhitā caiva sarvābhīpsitadā nṛṇām || || 58 || brahmalokātsamānītā mayārādhyātra bhārata || nāmakīrtanamapyasyā duṣṭānāṃ ghātanaṃ viduḥ || 59 || dvitīyā harasiddhyākhyā devī durgā mahābalā || śīkottarātsamārādhya mayānītātra pāṃḍava || 1.2.47.60 || yadā śīkottarasthena pārvatyā prārthitena ca || rudreṇa ḍākinīmaṃtraḥ prokto devyāḥ kṛpālunā || 61 || tadā maṃtraprabhāveṇa mohitā girijā satī || tamevākramya māṃsaṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca bhavaṃ papau || 62 || tato rudraśarīrāttu viniṣkrāṃtārtināśinī || harasiddhirmahādurgā mahāmaṃtraviśāradā || 63 || sā sahasrabhujā devī samākramyābhipīḍya ca || mokṣayāmāsa giriśamaśāpayata tāṃ tathā || 64 || tataḥ prabhṛti sā loke harasiddhiḥ prakīrtyate || devīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikoṭībhirāvṛtā pūjyate suraiḥ || 65 || etāmārādhya sugrīvapramukhā doṣanāśinīm||| abhūvantsumahāvīryā ḍākinīsaṃghanāśanāḥ || 66 || tasmādetāṃ pūjayettu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || ḍākinyādyā na sarpaṃti harasiddheranaṃtaram || 67 || tṛtīyeśānakoṇasthā caṃḍikā navamī sthitā || vāgīśo'pi labhetpāraṃ naiva yasyāḥ pravarṇane || 68 || yā purā pārvatīdehādviniḥsṛtya mahāsurau || caṃḍamuṃḍau nihatyaiva bhakṣayāmāsa krodhataḥ || 69 || akṣauhiṇīśataṃ tvekaṃ caṃḍamuṃḍau ca tāvubhau || nāpūryataikagrāso'syāḥ kiṃlakṣyā yātviyaṃ hi sā || 1.2.47.70 || iyamevāṃdhakānāṃ ca tṛṣitā śoṇitaṃ punaḥ || papau tato nijagrāha cāṃdhakaṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ || 71 || iyaṃ ca raktabījānāṃ kṛtvā pānaṃ ca raktajam || arpayāmāsa taṃ devyāścāmuṇḍāpītaśoṇitam || 72 || eṣā tṛpyati bhaktānāṃ praṇāmenāpi bhārata || arbudānāṃ ca koṭībhirdaityānāṃ pāpakarmiṇām || 73 || kuṇḍaṃ cāsyā mayā devyāḥ puṇyaṃ niṣpāditaṃ śubham || yatra vai sparśamātreṇa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 74 || harasiddhirdevasiddhirdharmasiddhiśca bhārata || vividhā prāpyate siddhistīrthe'smiṃścaṃḍikārataiḥ || 75 || yaśca pūjayate devīṃ svalpena bahunāpi vā || kātyāyanī koṭiśatairvṛtā tasya vibhūtidā || 76 || evametā mahādurgā navatīrthe'tra saṃsthitāḥ || catasraścāpi digdevyo nityamarcyāḥ śubhepsubhiḥ ||77|| āśvinasya ca māsasya navarātre viśeṣataḥ || upoṣya caikabhaktairvā devīstvetāḥ prapūjayet || 78 || balipūpakanaivedyaistarpaṇairdhūpagaṃdhibhiḥ || tasya rakṣāṃ caraṃtyetā rathyāsu trikacatvare || 79 || bhūtapretapiśācādyā nopakuryuḥ prapīḍanam || āpado vidravaṃtyāśu yoginyo naṃdayaṃti tam || 1.2.47.80 || putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt || rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt || 81 || āsāṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktiṃ naro nārī ca śraddhayā || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yāṃściṃtayati cetasi || 82 || kāmagavya imā devyaścintāmaṇinibhāstathā || kalpavallyo''tha bhaktānāṃ praticchando'tra nava hi || 83 || tathātra bhūtamātāsti harasiddhestu dakṣiṇe || tasyā māhātmyamatulaṃ saṃkṣepātprabravīmi te || 84 || pūrvaṃ kila guho vidvānpuṇye sārasvate taṭe|| bhūtapretapiśācānāmādhirājye'bhyaṣicyata || 85 || sa ca sarvāṇi bhūtāni maryādāyāmadhārayat || etadannaṃ pradāyaiva kṛpayā bhagavānguhaḥ || 86 || yadamaṃtrahutaṃ kiṃcidvedabāhyaṃ ca yatkṛtam || aśraddhayā ca krodhena tadvastṛptyai bhaviṣyati || 87 || tatastvanena bhogena tāni naṃdaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || tataḥ kenāpi kālena śraddhayā'śraddhayā kṛtam || 88 || puṇyaṃ tānyeva bhūtāni grasaṃtyākramya devatāḥ || tato devāḥ kṣudhārttāste guhāyaitannyavedayan || 89 || sa vai tadākarṇya kruddho guhaḥ kāla ivābhavat || tasya kruddhasya bhrūpadmamadhyātkācidvinirgatā || 1.2.47.90 || jvālāmālā sudurdarśā nārī dvādaśalocanā || sā ca praṇamya taṃ prāha tava śaktirahaṃ prabho || śīghramādiśa māṃ kṛtye kiṃ karomi tavepsitam|| 91 || || skanda uvāca || || etairbhūtagaṇaiḥ pāpairullaṃghya mama śāsanam || 92 || manuṣyadattaṃ sakalaṃ bhujyate svecchayādhamaiḥ || śīghrametāni tvaṃ tasmānmaryādāyāmupānaya || 93 || etāstvānuvrajiṣyaṃti devyaḥ koṭiśataṃ śubhe || tatastatheti sā coktā devībhiḥ saṃvṛtā tadā || 94 || mayūraṃ samupāsthāya guhaśaktiḥ samāgatā || sarojavanamāsādya bhūtasaṃghānapaśyata || 95 || jaghāna ca samāsādya devī nānāvidhāyudhaiḥ || tataḥ pretapiśācādyā hanyamānā mahāraṇe || 96 || prasādayaṃti tāṃ devīṃ nānāveṣaiḥ sudīnavat || kecidbrāhmaṇaveṣaiśca tāpasānāṃ tatho ktibhiḥ || 97 || nṛtyaṃti devi padmākṣi prasīdeti punaḥpunaḥ || tataḥ prasannā sā devī vriyatāṃ svecchayā''ha tān || 98 || tāṃ te procustrāhi nastvaṃ bhūtamātā bhaveśvari || maryādāṃ naiva tyakṣyāmo vayaṃ skandavinirmitām || 99 || ye caivaṃ tvāṃ toṣayanti teṣāṃ dehi varānsadā || 1.2.47.100 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || vaiśākhe darśadivase ye caivaṃ toṣayaṃti mām || ariṣṭābharaṇaiḥ puṣpairdadhibhaktaiśca pūjanaiḥ || teṣāṃ sarvopasargā vai yāsyaṃti vilayaṃ sphuṭam || 101 || evaṃ dattvā varaṃ devī mumude bhūtasaṃvṛtā || evaṃprabhāvā sā devī mayānītātra bhārata || 102 || ya enāṃ praṇamenmartyaḥ sarvāriṣṭairvimucyate || 103 || evaṃ prabhāvāḥ parikīrtitā mayā samāsatastīrthavare'tra devyaḥ || caturdaśaivārjuna pūjitā yāścaturdaśasthānavarairnṛmukhyaiḥ || 104 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe śrīdevyākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
<1.2.48>
|| nārada uvāca || || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi somanāthamahiṃ sphuṭam || śṛṇvanyāṃ kīrta yiṣyāmi pāpamokṣamavāpnuyāt || 1 || purā tretāyuge pārtha cauḍadeśasamudbhavau || ūrjayaṃtaśca prāleyo viprāvāstāṃ mahādyutī || 2 || tāvekadā purāṇārthe ślokamekamapaśyatām || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaśāstrajñāvāstāṃ kaṃṭakitatvacau || 3 || prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni pulastyāyāha padmabhūḥ | na yaistatrāplutaṃ caiva kiṃ taistīrthamupāsitam || 4 || iti ślokaṃ paṭhitvā tau punaḥpunarabhiṣṭutam || tarhyeva ca prabhāsāya niḥsṛtau snātumuttamau || 5 || tau vanāni nadīścaiva vyatikramya śanaiḥśanaiḥ || maharṣigaṇasaṃkīrṇāmuttīṇau narmadāṃ śivām || 6 || guptakṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgamam || tatra snātvā prabhāsāya tanmadhyena pratasthatuḥ || 7 || tato mārgasya śūnyatvāttṛṭkṣudhāpīḍitau bhṛśam || āstāṃ vicetanau viprau siddhaliṃgasamīpataḥ || 8 || siddhanāthaṃ namaskṛtya saṃprayātau sudhairyataḥ || kṣudhāvegena tīvreṇa tṛṣā madhyārkatāpitau || 9 || sahasā patitau bhūmau sthūṇapādau vimūrchitau || tato muhūrtātprāleya ūrjayaṃtamabhāṣata || 1.2.48.10 || kiṃcidviśvasya dhairyācca sakhe kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā || yathā yathā vivarṇāṃgo jāyate tīrthayātrayā || 11 || tathātathā bhaveddānairdīnaḥ someśvaro haraḥ || tathā''stāṃ luṃṭhamānau tāvevamukte śrute'pi ca || 12 || luṃṭhamāno jagāmaiva prāleyaḥ kiṃcidaṃtare || utthitaṃ sahasā liṃgaṃ bhūmiṃ bhittvā sudurdṛśam || 13 || khe vāṇī cābhavattatra puṣpavarṣapuraḥsarā || prāleya tava hetostu somanāthasamaṃ phalam || utthitaṃ sāgarataṭe liṃgaṃ tiṣṭhātra suvrata || 14 || || prāleya uvāca || || yadyevaṃ satyametacca tathāpyātmā prakalpitaḥ || 15 || prabhāsāya prayātavyaṃ yadā'' mṛtyormayā sphuṭam || tataścaivorjjayaṃto'pi mūrchābhāvālluṭhanpuraḥ || 16 || apaśyadutthitaṃ liṃgaṃ sa caivaṃ pratyapadyata || tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāpto bhavaścakre tayordṛḍhe || 17 || dṛṣṭyā tanū tato yātau prabhāsaṃ śivasadma ca || tāvetau somanāthau dvau siddheśvarasamīpataḥ || 18 || ūrjayaṃtaḥ pratīcyāṃ ca prāleyasyeśvaro'paraḥ || somakuḍāṃbhasi śanaiḥ snātvārṇavamahījale || 19 || somanāthadvayaṃ paśyejjanmapāpātpramucyate || brahmātra sthāpayitvā tu hāṭakeśvara saṃjñitam || 1.2.48.20 || mahīnagarake liṃgaṃ pātālātsumanoharam || tuṣṭāva devaṃ prayataḥ stutiṃ tāṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava || 21 || namaste bhagavanrudra bhāskarāmitatejase || namo bhavāya rudrāya rasāyāṃbumayāya te || 22 || śarvāya kṣitirūpāya sadā surabhiṇe namaḥ || īśāya vāyave tubhyaṃ saṃsparśāya namonamaḥ || 23 || paśūnāṃ pataye cāpi pāvakāyātitejase || bhīmāya vyomarūpāya śabdamātrāya te namaḥ || 24 || mahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo'stu te || ugrāya yajamānāya namaste karmayogine || 25 || ityevaṃ nāmabhirdivyaiḥ stava eṣa udīritaḥ || yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi pitāmahakṛtaṃ stavam || 26 || hāṭakeśvaraliṃgasya nityaṃ ca prayato naraḥ || aṣṭamūrteḥ sa sāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 27 || hāṭakeśvaraliṃgaṃ ca prayato yaḥ smaredapi || tasya syādvarado brahmā tenedaṃ sthāpitaṃ jaya || 28 || evaṃvidhāni tīrthāni mahīsāgarasaṃgame || bahūni saṃti puṇyāni saṃkṣepādvarṇitāni me || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe stambhatīrthamāhātmye somanāthavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
<1.2.49>
|| arjuna uvāca || || atyadbhutāni tīrthāni liṃgāni ca mahāmune || śrutvā tava mukhāṃbhojādbhṛśaṃ me hṛṣyate manaḥ || 1 || mahīnagarakasyāpi sthāpitasya tvayā mune || yāni tīrthāni mukhyāni tāni varṇaya me prabho || 2 || || nārada uvāca || || śrīmanmahīnagarake yāni tīrthāni phālguna || tāni vakṣyāmi yatrāste jayā dityo raviḥ prabhuḥ || 3 || jayādityasya yo nāma kīrtayediha mānavaḥ || sarvarogavinirmukto labhetso'pi hṛdīpsitam || 4 || yasya saṃdarśanādeva kalyāṇairapi pūryate || mucyate cāpyakalyāṇaiḥ śraddhāvānpārtha mānavaḥ || 5 || tasya devasya cotpattiṃ śṛṇu pārtha vadāmi te || śṛṇvanvā kīrtayanvāpi prasādaṃ bhāskarāllabhet || 6 || ahaṃ saṃsthāpya saṃsthānametatkālena kenacit || prayāto bhāskaraṃ lokaṃ darśanārthī yadṛcchayā || 7 || sa māṃ praṇatamāsīnamabhyarcyārgheṇa bhāskaraḥ || prahasanniva prāhedaṃ devo madhurayā girā || 8 || kuta āgamyate vipra kva ca vā pratigamyate || kva cāyaṃ nāradamune kālaste vihṛto'bhavat || 9 || || nārada uvāca || || evamukto bhāskareṇa taṃ tadā prābravaṃ vacaḥ || bhārate vihṛtaḥ khaṇḍe mahīnagarakādapi || darśanārthaṃ tava vibho samāyāto'smi bhāskara || 1.2.49.10 || || raviruvāca || || yattvayā sthāpitaṃ sthānaṃ tatra ye saṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || teṣāṃ guṇānmama brūhi kiṃguṇā nanu te dvijāḥ || 11 || || nārada uvāca || || evaṃ pṛṣṭo bhagavatā punarevābravaṃ vacaḥ || 12 || yadi tānbhoḥ praśaṃsāmi svīyānstautīti vācyatā || niṃdāmyanarhānkasmādvā kaṣṭamevobhayatra ca || 13 || athavā pāramāhātmye sati teṣāṃ mahātmanām || alpe kṛte varṇane syāddoṣa eva mahānmama || 14 || madarcitadvijeṃdrāṇāṃ yadi syācchravaṇepsutā || tataḥ svayaṃ vilokyāste gatvedaṃ me mataṃ rave || 15 || iti śrutvā mama vaco ravirāsītsuvismitaḥ || svayaṃ drakṣyāmi covāca punaḥpunaraharpatiḥ || 16 || so'tha vipratanuṃ kṛtvā māṃ visarjyaiva bhāskaraḥ || pratapandivi yogācca prayātorṇavarodhasi || 17 || jaṭāṃ triṣavaṇasnānapiṃgalāṃ dhārayannatha || vṛddhadvijo mahātejā dadṛśe brāhmaṇairmama || 18 || tato hārītapramukhāḥ praharṣotphullalocanāḥ || utthāya brahmaśālāyāste dvijā dvijamādravan ||19|| namaskṛtya dvijāgryaṃ te praharṣādidamabruvan ||1.2.49.20|| adya no divasaḥ puṇyaḥ sthānamadyottamaṃ tvidam || yattvayā viprapravara svayamāgamanaṃ kṛtam || 21 || dhanyasya hi gṛhasthasya kṛpayaiva dvijottamāḥ || ātithyaveṣeṇāyāṃti pāvanārthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| tattvaṃ gehāni cāsmākaṃ pādacaṃkramaṇena ca || darśanādbhojanātsthānādasmābhiḥ saha pāvaya ||23|| || atithiruvāca || || bhojanaṃ dvividhaṃ viprā prākṛtaṃ paramaṃ tathā || tadahaṃ samyagicchāmi dattaṃ paramabhojanam ||24 || ityetadatitheḥ śrutvā hārītaḥ putramabravīt || aṣṭavarṣaṃ tu kamaṭhaṃ vetsi putra dvijoditam ||25|| ||kamaṭha uvātra|| || tāta praṇamya tvāṃ vakṣye tādṛkparamabhojanam || dvijaṃ ca tarpayiṣyāmi dattvā paramabhojanam || ||26|| sutena kila jātena jāyate cānṛṇaḥ pitā|| satyaṃ kariṣye tadvākyaṃ saṃtarpyātithimuttamam||27|| bhojanaṃ dviprakāraṃ ca pravibhāgastayorayam || prākṛtaṃ procyate tvevamanyatparamabhojanam || 28 || tatra yatprākṛtaṃ nāma prakṛtipramukhasya tat|| caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ gaṇasyoktaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 29 || ṣaḍrasaṃ bhojanaṃ tacca paṃcabhedaṃ vadaṃti ca || yena bhuktena tṛptaṃ syātkṣetraṃ yaddehalakṣaṇam || 1.2.49.30 || yathāparaṃ paraṃnāma proktaṃ paramabhojanam || paramaḥ procyate cātmā tasya tadbhojanaṃ bhavet || 31 || tato nānāprakārasya dharmasya śravaṇaṃ hi yat || tadannaṃ procyate bhoktā kṣetrajñaḥ śravaṇau mukham || 32 || taddāsyāmi dvijāgryāya pṛccha vipra yadicchasi || śaktitastarpayiṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ viprasaṃsadi || 33 || || nārada uvāca || || kamaṭhasyaitadākarṇya so'tithirvacanaṃ mahat || manasaiva praśasyāmuṃ praśnamenamathākarot || 34 || kathaṃ saṃjāyate jaṃtuḥ kathaṃ cāpi pralīyate || bhasmatāmatha saṃprāpya kva cāyaṃ prati padyate || 35 || || kamaṭha uvāca || || gurave prāṅnamaskṛtya dharmāya tadanaṃtaram || chaṃdogītamamuṃ praśnaṃ śaktyā vakṣyāmi te dvija || 36 || janane trividhaṃ karma heturjaṃtorbhavetkila || puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ca miśraṃ ca sattvarājasatāmasam || 37 || tatra yaḥ sāttviko nāma sa svargaṃ pratipadyate || svargātkālaparibhraṣṭo dhanī dharmī sukhī bhavet|| 38 || tathā yastāmaso nāma narakaṃ pratipadyate || bhuktvā bahvīryātanāśca sthāvaratvaṃ prapadyate || 39 || mahatāṃ darśanasparśairupabhogasahāsanaiḥ || mahatā kālayogena saṃsaranmānavo bhavet || 1.2.49.40 || so'pi duḥkhadaridrādyairveṣṭito vikaleṃdriyaḥ || pratyakṣaḥ sarva lokānāṃ pāpasyaitaddhi lakṣaṇam|| 41 || atha yo miśrakarmā syāttiryaktvaṃ pratipadyate || mahatāmeva saṃsargātsaṃsaranmānavo bhavet || 42 || yasya puṇyaṃ pṛthutaraṃ pāpamalpaṃ hi jāyate || sa pūrvaṃ duḥkhito bhūtvā paścātsaukhyānvito bhavet || 43 || pāpaṃ pṛthutaraṃ yasya puṇyamalpataraṃ bhavet || pūrvaṃ sukhī tato duḥkhī miśrasyaitaddhi lakṣaṇam || 44 || tatra mānuṣasaṃbhūtiṃ śṛṇu yādṛgasau bhavet || puruṣasya striyāścaiva śukraśoṇitasaṃgame || 45 || sarvadoṣavinirmukto jīvaḥ saṃsarate sphuṭam|| guṇānvitamanobuddhiśubhāśubhasamanvitaḥ || 46 || jīvaḥ praviṣṭo garbhaṃ tu kalale pratitiṣṭhati || mūḍhaśca kalale tatra māsamātraṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 47 || dvitīyaṃ tu tathā māsaṃ ghanībhūtaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || tasyāvayavanirmāṇaṃ tṛtīye māsi jāyate || 48 || asthīni ca tathā māsi jāyaṃte ca caturthake || tvagjanma paṃcame māsi paṣṭhe romṇāṃ samudbhavaḥ || 49 || saptame ca tathā māsi prabodhaścāsya jāyate || māturāhārapītaṃ ca saptame māsyupāśnute || 1.2.49.50 || aṣṭame navame māsi bhṛśamudvijate tataḥ || jarāyuṇā veṣṭitāṃgo mukhe baddhakarāṃguliḥ ||51|| madhye klībastu vāme strī dakṣiṇe puruṣastathā || tiṣṭhatyudarabhāge ca pṛṣṭheragnimukhaḥ kila || 52|| yasyāṃ tiṣṭhatyasau yonau tāṃ ca vetti na saṃśayaḥ || sarvaṃ smarati vṛttāṃtaṃ bahūnāṃ janmanāmapi || 53 || aṃdhe tamasi kiṃ dṛśyo gaṃdhānmohaṃ dṛḍhaṃ labhet || śīte mātrā jale pīte śītamuṣṇaṃ tathoṣṇake || 54 || vyāyāme labhate mātuḥ kleśaṃ vyādheśca vedanām || alakṣyāḥ pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ jāyaṃte vyādhayaḥ parāḥ || 55 || saukumāryādrujaṃ tīvrāṃ janayaṃti ca tasya te || svalpamapyatha taṃ kālaṃ vetti varṣaśatopamam || 56 || saṃtapyate bhṛśaṃ garbhe karmabhiśca purātanaiḥ || manorathāṃśca kurute sukṛtārthaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 57|| janma cedahamāpsyāmi mānuṣye jīvitaṃ tathā || tatastatprakariṣyāmi yena mokṣo bhavetsphuṭam||58|| evaṃ tu ciṃtayānasya sīmaṃtonnayanādanu|| māsadvayaṃ tadvrajati pīḍatastriyugākṛti || 59 || tataḥ svakāle saṃpūrṇe sūtimārutacālitaḥ || bhavatyavāṅmukho jaṃtuḥ pīḍāmanubhavanparām || ||1.2.49.60|| adhomukhaḥ saṃkaṭena yonidvāreṇa niḥsaret|| pīḍayā pīḍamāno'pi carmotkartanatulyayā || 61 || karapatrasamasparśaṃ karasaṃsparśanādikam || asau jāto vijānāti māsamātraṃ vimohitaḥ || 62 || prākkarmavaśagasyāsya garbhajñānaṃ ca naśyati || tataḥ karoti karmāṇi śvetaraktāsitāni ca || 63 || asthipaṭṭatulāstaṃbhasnāyubaṃdhena yaṃtritam || raktamāṃsamṛdāliptaṃ viṇmūtradravyabhājanam || 64 || saptabhittisusaṃbaddhaṃ channaṃ roma tṛṇairapi || vadanaikamahādvāraṃ gavākṣāṣṭavibhūṣitam || 65 || oṣṭhadvayakapāṭaṃ ca daṃtārgalavimudritam || nāḍīsvedapravāhaṃ ca kaphapittapariplutam || || 66 || jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ kālavaktrānalasthitam || rāgadveṣādibhirdhvastaṃ ṣaṭkauśikasamudbhavam || 67 || evaṃ saṃjāyate puṃso dehagehamidaṃ dvija || yasminvasati kṣetrajño gṛhastho buddhigehinī || 68 || mokṣaṃ svargaṃ ca narakamāste saṃsādhayannapi || 69 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe kamaṭhasūryasaṃvāde jīvasya dehotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
<1.2.50>
|| atithiruvāca || || sādhvabālamate bāla kamaṭhaitattvayocyate || śarīralakṣaṇaṃ śrotuṃ punaricchāmi tadvada || 1 || || kamaṭha uvāca || || yathaitadveda brahmāṃḍaṃ śarīraṃ ca tathā śṛṇu || pādamūlaṃ ca pātālaṃ prapadaṃ ca rasātalam || 2 || talātalaṃ tathā gulphau jaṃghe cāsya mahātalam || jānunī sutalaṃ corū vitalaṃ cātalaṃ kaṭim || 3 || nābhiṃ mahītalaṃ prāhurbhuvarlokamathodaram || uraḥsthalaṃ ca svarlokaṃ mahargrīvā mukhaṃ janam || 4 || netre tapaḥ satyalokaṃ śīrṣadeśaṃ vadaṃti ca || tadyathā sapta dvīpāni pṛthivyāṃ saṃsthitāni ca || 5 || tathātra dhātavaḥ sapta nāmatastānnibodha me || tvagasṛṅmāṃsa medo'sthimajjāśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ || 6 || asthnāmatra śatāni syustrīṇi ṣaṣṭyadhikāni ca || triṃśacchatasahasrāṇi nāḍīnāṃ kathitāni ca || 7 || ṣaṭpaṃcāśatsahasrāṇi tathānyāni navaiva tu || tā vahaṃti rasaṃ dehe jalaṃ nadyo yathā bhuvi ||8|| sārdhābhistisṛbhiśchannaṃ samaṃtādromakoṭibhiḥ || śarīraṃ sthūlasūkṣmābhirdṛśyādṛśyā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ ||9|| ṣaḍaṃgāni pradhānāni kathyamānāni me śṛṇu || dvau bāhū sakthinī dve ca mūrdhā jaṭharameva ca || 1.2.50.10 || aṃtrāṇyatra tathā trīṇi sārdhavyāmatrayāṇi ca || trivyāmāni tathā strīṇāmāhurvedavido dvijāḥ || 11 || ūrdhvanālamadhovaktraṃ hṛdi padmaṃ prakīrtyate || hṛtpadmavāmataḥ plīho dakṣiṇe syāttathā yakṛt || 12 || majjāto medasaścaiva vasāyāśca tathā dvija || mūtrasya caiva pittasya śleṣmaṇaḥ śakṛtastathā || || 13 || raktasya caramasyātra gartā dvyaṃjalayaḥ smṛtāḥ || geyaḥ pravartamānāste dehaṃ saṃdhārayaṃtyuta || 14 || sīvanyaśca tathā sapta paṃca mūrdhānamāsthitāḥ || ekā meḍhraṃ gatā caikā tathā jihvāṃ gatā dvija || 15 || nāḍyaḥ sarvāḥ pravartaṃte nābhipadmāttathātra ca || yāsāṃ śreṣṭhā śiro yātā suṣumneḍā'tha piṃgalā || 16 || nāsikādvāramāsādya saṃsthite dehavardhane || vāyuragniścaṃdramāśca paṃcadhā paṃcadhātra ca || 17 || prāṇāpānasamānāśca udāno vyāna eva ca || paṃca bhedāḥ smṛtā vāyoḥ karmārṇyeṣāṃ vadaṃti ca || 18 || ucchvāsaścaiva niḥśvāso hyannapānapraveśanam || ākaṃṭhācchīrṣasaṃsthāsya prāṇakarma prakīrtitam || 19 || tyāgo viṇmūtraśukrāṇāṃ garbhavisravaṇaṃ tathā || apānakarma nirdiṣṭaṃ sthānamasya gudopari || 1.2.50.20 || samāno dhārayatyannaṃ vivecayati cāpyatha || rasayaṃścaiva carati sarvaśroṇiṣvavāritaḥ || 21 || vākpravṛttipradodgāre prayatne sarvakarmaṇām || ākaṃṭhasurasaṃsthānamudānasya prakīrtyate || 22 || vyāno hṛdi sthito nityaṃ tathā dehacaropi ca || dhātuvṛddhipradaḥ svedalālonmeṣanimeṣakṛt || 23 || pācako rajakaścaiva sādhakālocakau tathā || bhrājakaśca tathā dehe pañcadhā pāvakaḥ sthitaḥ || 24 || pācakastu pacatyannaṃ nityaṃ pakvāśaye sthita. ||| āmāśayastho'pi rasaṃ raṃjakaḥ kurute tvasṛk || 25 || sādhako hṛdisaṃsthaśca buddhyādyutsāhakārakaḥ || ālocakaśca dṛksaṃstho rūpadarśanaśakti kṛta || 26 || tvaksaṃstho bhrājako dehaṃ bhrājayennirmalīkṛtaḥ || kledako bodhakaścaiva tarpaṇaḥ śleṣmaṇastathā || 27 || ālaṃbakastathā dehe paṃcadhā soma ucyate || kledakaḥ kledayatyannaṃ nityaṃ pakvāśaye sthitaḥ ||28|| bodhako rasanāsthaśca rasānāmavabodhakaḥ || śiraḥsthaścakṣurādīnāṃ tarpaṇāttarpaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 29 || sarvasaṃdhigataścaiva śleṣmaṇaḥ śleṣmakṛttathā || uraḥsthaḥ sarvagātrāṇi sa vai hyālaṃbakaḥ sthitaḥ ||1.2.50.30|| evaṃ vāyvagnisomaiśca dehaḥ saṃdhāritastvasau || ākāśajāni srotāṃsi tathā koṣṭhaviviktatā || 31 || pārthivānīha jānīhi ghrāṇakeśanakhāni ca || asthīni dhairyaṃ gurutā tvaṅmāṃsa hṛdayaṃ gudam || 32 || nābhirmedo yakṛnmajjā aṃtramāmāśayaḥ śirā || snāyuḥ pakvāśayaścaiva prāhurvedavido dvijāḥ || 33 || netrayormaḍalaṃ śuklaṃ kaphādbhavati paitṛkam || kṛṣṇaṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ vātāttathā bhavati mātṛkam || 34 || pakṣmamaṇḍalamekaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ carmamaṇḍalam || śuklaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kathita caturthaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam || 35 || dṛṅmaṇḍalaṃ paṃcamaṃ tu netraṃ syātpaṃcamaṇḍalam || apare netrabhāge dve upāṃgo'pāṃga eva ca|| 36 || upāṃgo netraparyaṃto nāsā mūlamapāṃgakaḥ || vṛṣaṇau ca tathā proktau medosṛkkaphamāṃsakau || 37 || asṛṅmāṃsamayī jihvā sarveṣāmeva dehinām || hastayoroṣṭhayormeḍhre grīvāyāṃ ṣaṭ ca kūrcakāḥ || 38 || evamatra sthite jīvo dehe'sminsaptasaptake || paṃcaviṃśatiko vyāpya dehaṃ vāso'sya mūrdhani || 39 || tvagasṛgmāṃsamityāhustrikaṃ mātṛsamudbhavam || medomajjāsthikaṃ proktaṃ pitṛjaṃ ṣaṭca kauśikam || 1.2.50.40 || evaṃ bhūtamayaṃ dehaṃ paṃcabhūtasamudbhavaiḥ || annairyathā vṛddhimeti tadahaṃ varṇayāmi te ||41|| tadannaṃ piṇḍakavalairgrāsairbhuktaṃ ca dehibhiḥ || pūrvaṃ sthūlāśaye vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ prakurute dvidhā|| 42|| saṃpraviśyānnamadhye tu pṛthagannapṛthagjalam|| agnerūrdhvaṃ jalaṃ sthāpya tadannaṃ tajjalopari || 43 || jalasyādhaḥ svayaṃ prāṇaḥ sthitvāgniṃ dhamate śanaiḥ || vāyunā dhamyamānogniratyuṣṇaṃ kurute jalam|| 44 || tadannamuṣṇatoyena samaṃtātpacyate punaḥ || dvidhā bhavati tatpakvaṃ pṛthakkiṭṭaṃ pṛthagrasam || 45 || malairdvādaśabhiḥ kiṭṭaṃ bhinnaṃ dehādbahirvrajet || karṇākṣināsikājihvādatāḥ śiśnaṃ gudaṃ nakhāḥ || 46 || romakūpāṇi caiva syurdvādaśaite malāśrayāḥ|| hṛtpadmapratibaddhāśca sarvā nāḍyaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 47 || tāsāṃ mukheṣu taṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyānaḥ sthāpayate rasam || rasena tena tā nāḍīḥ samānaḥ pūrayetpunaḥ || 48 || tataḥ prayāṃti saṃpūrṇāstāśca dehaṃ samaṃtataḥ || tataḥ sa nāḍimadhyastho rañjakenoṣmaṇā rasaḥ || 49 || pacyate pacyamānastu rudhiratvaṃ bhajetpunaḥ || tatastvaglomakeśāśca māṃsaṃ snāyu śirāsthi ca || 1.2.50.50 || nakhā majjā khavaimalyaṃ śukravṛddhiḥ kramādbhavet || evaṃ dvādaśadhānnasya pariṇāmaḥ prakīrtyate || 51 || evametadviniṣpannaṃ śarīraṃ puṇyahetave || yathaiva syaṃdanaḥ śubhro bhārasaṃvāhanāya ca || 52 || tailābhyaṃgādibhiryatnairbahubhiḥ pālyate na cet || kiṃ kṛtyaṃ sādhyate tena yadi bhāraṃ vahenna hi || 53 || evametena dehena kiṃ kṛtyaṃ bhojanottamaiḥ || vardhitena na cetpuṇyaṃ kurute paśuvacca tat || 54 || bhavaṃti cātra ślokāḥ || yasminkāle ca deśe ca vayasā yādṛśena ca || kṛtaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma tattathā tena bhujyate || 55 || tasmātsadā śubhaṃ kāryamavicchinnasukhārthibhiḥ || vicchidyaṃte'nyathā bhogā grīṣme kusarito yathā || 56 || yasmātpāpena duḥkhāni tīvrāṇi subahūnyapi || tasmātpāpaṃ na kartavyamātmapīḍākaraṃ hi tat || 57 || evaṃ te varṇitaḥ sādho praśno'yaṃ śaktito mayā || yathā saṃjāyate prāṇī yathā śṛṇu pralīyate || 58 || āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe saṃprāpte maraṇe nṛṇām|| svakarmavaśago dehī kṛṣyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 59 || paṃcatanmātrasahitaḥ samanobuddhyahaṃkṛtiḥ || puṇyapāpamayaiḥ pāśairbaddho jīvastyaje dvapuḥ || 1.2.50.60 || śīrṣṇaśca saptabhiśchidrairnirgacchetpuṇyakarmaṇām || adhaśca pāpināṃ yāṃti yogināṃ brahmaraṃdhrataḥ || 61 || tatkṣaṇātso'tha gṛhṇāti śārīraṃ cātivāhikam || aṃguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ tu svaprāṇaireva nirmitam || 62 || tatastasminsthitaṃ jīvaṃ dehe yamabhaṭāstadā || baddhvā nayaṃti mārgeṇa yāmyenāti yathābalam|| 63 || taptāṃbarīṣatulyena ayoguḍanibhena ca || prataptasikatenāpi tāmrapātranibhena ca || 64 || ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ mahītalāt || kṛṣyamāṇo yamapurīṃ nīyate pāpakṛdbhaṭaiḥ||65|| kvacicchītaṃ mahādurgamandhakāraṃ kvacinmahat|| agnisaṃsparśavadanaiḥ kākakākolajaṃbukaiḥ |66|| makṣikādaṃśamaśakairbhakṣyate sarpavṛścikaiḥ || bhakṣyamāṇo'pi tairjaṃtuḥ kraṃdate mriyate na hi || 67 || kvacicca bhakṣyate ghorai rākṣasaiḥ kṛṣyate'syate || dahyamānotighoreṇa saikatena ca nīyate || 68 || muhūtairdaśabhiryāti taṃ mārgamatidustaram || taṃ kālaṃ sumahadvetti puruṣo varṣasaṃmitam || 69 || tāryate ca nadīṃ ghorāṃ pūyaśoṇitavāhinīm || nadīṃ vaitaraṇīṃ nāma keśaśaivalaśādvalām || 1.2.50.70 || tato yamasya purataḥ sthāpyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ || pāpī mahābhayaṃ paśyetkālāṃtakamukhairvṛtam || 71 || puṇyakarmā saumyarūpaṃ dharmarājaṃ tadā kila || manuṣyā eva gacchaṃti yamalokena cāpare || || 72 || maraṇānaṃtaraṃ teṣāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ yonipūraṇam || tathāhi pretā manujāḥ śrūyaṃte nānyajaṃtavaḥ || 73 || dhārmikaḥ pūjyate tatra pāpaḥ pāśagalo bhavet || dhārmikaśca yathā yāti taṃ mārgaṃ śṛṇu vacmi te || 74 || ārāmadrumadātāraḥ phalapuṣpavatā pathā || chāyayā ca sukhaṃ yāṃti tathā ye cchatradā narāḥ || || 75 || upānahapradā yānairvitṛṣāḥ pūrtadharmiṇaḥ || vimānairyānadā yāṃti tathā śayyāsanapradāḥ || 76 || bhakṣyabhojyaistathā tṛptā yāṃti bhojanadāyina || dīpapradāḥ prakāśena gopradāstāṃ nadīṃ sukham ||77|| śrīsūryaṃ śrīmahādevaṃ bhaktā ye puruṣottamam || janmaprabhṛti te yāṃti pūjyamānā yamānugaiḥ || 78 || mahīṃ gāṃ kāṃcanaṃ lohaṃ tilānkārpāsameva ca || lavaṇaṃ saptadhānyaṃ ca dattvā yāti sukhaṃ naraḥ ||79|| teṣāṃ tatra gatānāṃ ca pāpināṃ puṇyakarmiṇām || citraguptaḥ pretapāya nirūpayati vai tataḥ || 1.2.50.80 || pretaloke sa vasati tataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ || vatsareṇa ca tenāsya śarīramabhijāyate || 81 || sodakumbhamathānnādyaṃ bāṃdhavairyatpradīyate || dinedine sa tadbhuktvā tena vṛddhiṃ prayāti ca || 82 || pūrvadattamathānnādyaṃ prāpnoti svayameva ca || svayaṃ yena na dattaṃ ca tathā dātā na vidyate || 83 || na cāpyudakadātāsau kṣuttṛḍbhyāmatipīḍyate || bāṃdhavaistūdakaṃ dattaṃ nadībhūtvopatiṣṭhati || 84 || māsimāsi ca yacchrāddhaṃ ṣoḍaśaśrāddhapūrvakam || atra na kriyate yasya pretatvātsa na mucyate || 85 || mānuṣeṇa dinenaiva pretaloke dinaṃ smṛtam || tasmāddinedine deyaṃ pretāyānnaṃ ca vatsaram || 86 || taṃ ca smāśānikānāma gaṇā yāmyā bhayāvahāḥ || śītavātātapopetaṃ tatra rakṣaṃti pāpinam || 87 || yatheha bandhane kaścidrakṣyate viṣamairnaraiḥ || pretapiṃḍā na dīyaṃte ṣoḍaśaśrāddhapūrvakāḥ || 88 || yasya tasya na mokṣo'sti pretatvādvai yugairapi || tataḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe bāṃdhavaiḥ sukṛte naraḥ || 89 || pūrṇe saṃvatsare dehaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ pratipadyate || pāpātmā ghorarūpaṃ tu dhārmiko divyamuttamam || 1.2.50.90 || tataḥ sa narakaṃ yāti svargaṃ vā svena karmaṇā || rauravādyāśca narakāḥ pātālatalasaṃsthitāḥ ||91|| surādyāḥ satyaparyaṃtāḥ svarlokasyordhvamāśritāḥ || itihāsapurāṇeṣu vedasmṛtiṣu yacchutam || 92 || puṇyaṃ tena bhavetsvargo narakastadviparyayāt || tatrāpi kālavasati karmaṇāmanurūpataḥ ||93|| arvāksapiṃḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya varṣācca vā kṛtam || pretatvamapi tasyāpi proktaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ dhuvam || 94 || yairiṣṭaṃ ca tribhirmedhairarcitaṃ vā suratrayam || pretalokaṃ na te yāṃti tathā ye samare hatāḥ||95|| śuddhena puṇyena divaṃ ca śuddhāṃ pāpena śuddhena tathā tamoṃdham|| miśreṇa svargaṃ narakaṃ ca yāti dehastathaivāsya bhavecca tādṛk|| 96 || praśnatrayaṃ ceti tava praṇītamutpattimṛtyū paralokavāsaḥ || yathā gururme samudājahāra kiṃ bhūya icchatyuta tadvadāmi || 97 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍa kaumārikākhaṇḍe ādityakamaṭhasaṃvāde jīvasya pāralaukikagatyādivarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
<1.2.51>
|| atithiruvāca || || yadetatparalokasya svarūpaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ tvayā || āgamaṃ samupāśritya tattathaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 || kiṃtvatra nāstikāḥ pāpāḥ sandihyante'lpacetanāḥ || teṣāṃ niḥsaṃśayakṛte vada karmaphalaṃ hi yat ||2 || ihaiva kasya kasyaiva karmaṇaḥ pāpakasya ca || prabhāvātkīdṛśo jāyetkamaṭhaitadvadāsti cet || 3 || || kamaṭha uvāca || || sarvametatpravakṣyāmi sthiro bhūtvā śṛṇuṣva tat || yathā mama guruḥ prāha yanme cetasi saṃsthitam || 4 || brahmahā kṣayarogī syātsurāpaḥ śyāvadaṃtakaḥ || suvarṇacauraḥ kunakhī duścarmā gurutalpagaḥ || 5 || saṃsargī sarvarogī syātpaṃcapātakinastvamī || niṃdāmākarṇya sādhūnāṃ badhiraḥ saṃprajāyate || 6 || svayaṃ prakīrtayeccāpi mūkaḥ pāpo'bhijāyate || ājñālopī gurūṇāṃ ca apasmārī bhavennaraḥ || 7 || avajñākārakasteṣāṃ kṛmirevābhijāyate || upekṣataḥ pūjyakāryaṃ duṣprajñatvaṃ ca jāyate || 8 || cauryāya sādhudravyāṇāṃ dadyādyāvatpadāni ca || tāvadvarṣāṇi paṃgutvaṃ sa prāpnoti narādhamaḥ || 9 || dattvā harati tadbhūyo jāyate kṛkalāsakaḥ || kupitānaprasādyaiva pūjyānsyācchīrṣarogavān || 1.2.51.10 || rajasvalāmabhigacchaṃśca caṃḍālaḥ saṃprajāyate || vastrāpahārī citrī syātkṛṣṇakuṣṭhī tathāgnidaḥ || 11 || darduro rūpyahārī syātkūṭasākṣī mukhārujaḥ || paradārāṃśca kāmena draṣṭā syādakṣirogavān || 12 || pratijñāyāprayacchanyo hyalpāyurjāyate naraḥ || vipravṛttyapahārī syādajīrṇī sarvadā'dhamaḥ || 13 || naiṣṭhikānnāśanādbhūyo nivṛtto rogavānsadā || patnībahutve tvekasyāṃ retomokṣaḥ kṣayī bhavet||14|| svāminā dharmayukto yastvanyāyena samācaret|| svayaṃ vā bhakṣayeddravyaṃ sa mūḍhaḥ syājjalodarī||15|| durbalaṃ pīḍyamānaṃ yo balavānsamupekṣate|| aṃgahīnaḥ sa ca bhavedannahṛtkṣudhito bhavet||16|| vyavahāre pakṣapātī jihvārogī bhavennaraḥ|| dharmapravṛttiṃ sañcārya patnyādīṣṭaviyogakṛt || 17 || svayaṃ pākāgrabhojī yo galarogamavāpnuyāt || paṃcayajñānakṛtvaiva bhuñjāno grāmaśūkaraḥ || 18 || parvamaithuna kṛnmehī parityajya svagehinīm || veśyādirakto mūḍhātmā khalvāṭo jāyate naraḥ || 19 || parikṣīṇānmitrabandhūnsvāminaṃ dayitānugān || avamanya nivṛttātmā kliṣṭavṛttiḥ sadā bhavet || 1.2.51.20 || chadmanopacaredyastu pitarau svāminaṃ gurūn || prāptavyārthasyātikaṣṭātparibhraṃśorthajo bhavet || 21 || viśrabdhasyāpahārī tu duḥkhānāṃ bhājanaṃ bhavet || dhārmike kṣudrakārī yo naraḥ sa vāmano bhavet || 22 || durbalavṛṣavāhī yaḥ kaṭilūtī bhavetsa ca || 23 || jātyaṃdhaścāpi yo goghno niḥpaśurduḥkhakṛdgavām || nirdayo goṣu ghātādyaiḥ sadā sodhvasu kaṣṭagaḥ || 24 || nistejakaḥ sabhāyāṃ yo galagaṇḍī sa jāyate || sadā krodhī ca caṃḍālaḥ pūtivaktraśca sūcakaḥ || 25 || ajavikrayakṛdvyādhaḥ kuṇḍāśī bhṛtako bhavet || nāstikastila piṃḍī syādaśraddho gītajīvanaḥ || 26 || abhakṣyādo gaṇḍamālī strīkhādī cā''sutasya kṛt || anyāyato jñānagrāhī mūrkho bhavati mānavaḥ || 27 || śāstracauraḥ kekarākṣaḥ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ ca dveṣṭi yaḥ || kṛmivaktraḥ sa ca bhavedvibhraṣṭo narakātkudhīḥ || 28 || devadvijagavāṃ vṛttihārako vāṃtabhakṣakṛt || taḍāgārāmabhettā yo bhavedvikalapāṇikaḥ || 29 || vyavahāre cchalagrāhī bhṛtyagrasto bhavennaraḥ || sadā puruṣarogī syātparadārarato naraḥ || 1.2.51.30 || vāta rogī kuvaidyaḥ syādduścarmā gurutalpagaḥ || madhumehī kharīgāmī gotrastrīmaithuno'prasūḥ || 31 || svasāraṃ mātaraṃ putravadhūṃ gacchannabījavān || kṛtaghnaḥ sarva kāryāṇāṃ vaiphalyaṃ samupāśnute || 32 || ityeṣa lakṣaṇoddeśaḥ pāpināṃ parikīrtitaḥ || citragupto'pi muhyeta sakalasyānuvarṇane || 33 || ete naraka vibhraṣṭā bhuktvā yonīḥ sahasraśaḥ || evaṃvidhaiścihnitāśca jāyaṃte lakṣaṇairnarāḥ || 34 || ye hi dharmaṃ na manyaṃte tathā ye vyasanairjitāḥ || anumānena boddhavyaṃ yadete śeṣapāpinaḥ || 35 || yeṣāṃ tvaṃtagataṃ pāpaṃ svargādvā ye samāgatāḥ || sarvavyasananirmuktā dharmamekaṃ bhajanti te || 36 || bhavaṃti cātra ślokāḥ || dharmādanavamaṃ saukhyamadharmādduḥkhasambhavaḥ || tasmāddharmaṃ sukhārthāya kuryātpāpaṃ vivarjayet || 37 || lokadvaye'pi yatsaukhyaṃ taddharmātprocyate yataḥ || dharmamekamataḥ kuryātsarvakāryārthasiddhaye || 38 || muhūrtamapi jīveta naraḥ śuklena karmaṇā || na kalpamapi jīveta lokadvayavirodhinā || 39 || iti pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vipra yathāśaktyā mayeritam || asūktaṃ sūktamathavā kṣaṃtavyaṃ kiṃ vadāmi ca || 1.2.51.40 || || nārada uvāca || || kamaṭhasyaitadākarṇya aṣṭavarṣasya bhāṣitam || bhagavānbhāskaraḥ prīto babhūvātīva vismitaḥ || 41 || praśaśaṃsa ca tānviprānhārītapramukhāṃstadā || aho vasumatī dhanyā dvijairevaṃvidhottamaiḥ || 42 || atha prajāpatirdhanyo yanmaryādābhipālyate || amībhirbrāhmaṇavarairdhanyā vedāśca saṃprati || 43 || yeṣāṃ madhye bālabuddhiriyametādṛśī sphuṭā || hārītapramukhānāṃ hi kā vai buddhirbhaviṣyati|| 44 || asaṃśayaṃ trilokasthameṣāmaviditaṃ na hi || yathaitānnāradaḥ prāha bhūyastasmādamī bahu || 45 || iti praśasya tānviprānprahṛṣṭo raviravravīt || ahaṃ sūryo vipramukhyā yuṣmākaṃ darśanātkṛte || 46 || samāgataḥ sūryalokātprāptaṃ netraphalaṃ ca me || bhavadvidhairvipramukhyaiḥ saṃjalpanasahāsanāt||47|| aṃtyajā api pūyante kiṃ punarmādṛśā dvijāḥ || sarvathā nārado dhanyo yo'sau trailokyatattvavit|| 48 || yuṣmābhirbadhyate śreyo yasya vai dhūtakilviṣaiḥ || praṇamāmi ca vaḥ sarvānmanobuddhisamādhibhiḥ || tapo vidyā ca vṛttaṃ ca yato vārddhakyakāraṇam||49|| varaṃ matto vṛṇīdhvaṃ ca durlabhaṃ yaṃ hṛdīcchata|| yūyaṃ svayaṃ hi varadā matsaṃgo māstu niṣphalaḥ||1.2.51.50|| devatānāṃ hi saṃsargo niṣphalo nopajāyate || tasmānmatto varaṃ kiṃcidvṛṇudhvaṃ pradadāmi vaḥ ||51|| || śrīnārada uvāca|| || iti sūryavacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭāste dvijottamāḥ ||52|| saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā pādyārghyastutivaṃdanaiḥ || maṃḍalādīnmahājapyāngṛṇaṃtaḥ procire ravim||53|| jayāditya jaya svāmiñjaya bhāno jayāmala|| jaya vedapate śaśvattārayāsmānaharpate || 54 || viprāṇāṃ tvaṃ paro devo viprasargo'pi tvanmayaḥ || nitarāṃ pūtametannaḥ sthānaṃ deva tvayekṣitam || 55 || adya naḥ saphalā vedā adya naḥ saphalāḥ kriyāḥ || adya naḥ saphalaṃ gehaṃ tvayā saṃgamya gopate || 56 || varaṃ yadi pradātāsi tadenaṃ pravṛṇīmahe || āsmākīnamidaṃ sthānaṃ na hi tyājyaṃ kathaṃcana || 57 || || śrīsūrya uvāca || || yasmādbhavadbhiḥ pūrvaṃ hi jayādityeti coditam || jayāditya iti khyātastasmātsthāsye'tra sarvadā || 58 || yāvanmahī samudrāśca parvatā nagarāṇi ca || tāvatsthānamidaṃ viprā na hi tyakṣyāmi karhicit||59|| dāridryarogasaṃghātāndadravo maṃḍalāni ca || kuṣṭhādīnnāśayiṣyāmi bhajatāmatra saṃsthitaḥ || 1.2.51.60 || yo māmatra sthitaṃ cāpi pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ || sūryalokamivāgamya pūjāṃ tasya bhajāmyaham || 61 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || evamukte bhagavatā hārītādyā dvijottamāḥ || mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsurvedoditavidhānataḥ || 62 || tato dvijāḥ prāhurevaṃ kamaṭhaṃ tvatkṛte raviḥ || atra svāmī sthitastasmātprathamaṃ stuhi tvaṃ ravim|| 63 || ityukto brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ kamaṭho vāggmināṃ varaḥ | praṇipatya jayādityaṃ mahāstotramidaṃ jagau || 64 || na tvaṃ kṛtaḥ kevalasaṃśrutaśca yajuṣyevaṃ vyāharatyādideva || caturvidhā bhāratī dūradūraṃ dhṛṣṭaḥ staumi svārthakāmaḥ kṣamaitat || 65 || mārtaṃḍasūryāṃśuravistathendro bhānurbhagaścāryamā svarṇaretāḥ || 66 || divākaro mitraviṣṇuśca deva khyātastvaṃ vai dvādaśātmā namaste || lokatrayaṃ vai tava garbhagehaṃ jalādhāraḥ procyase khaṃ samagram || 67 || nakṣatramālā kusumābhimālā tasmai namo vyomaliṃgāya tubhyam || 68 || tvaṃ devadevastvamanāthanāthastvaṃ prāpyapālaḥ kṛpaṇe kṛpāluḥ || tvaṃ netranetraṃ janabuddhibuddhirākāśakāśo jaya jīvajīvaḥ || 69 || dāridryadāridrya nidhe nidhīnāmamaṃgalāmaṃgala śarmaśarma || rogaprarogaḥ prathitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ciraṃ jayāditya jayāprameya ||1.2.51.70|| vyādhigrastaṃ kuṣṭharogābhibhūtaṃ bhagna prāṇaṃ śīrṇadehaṃ visaṃjñam || mātā pitā bāṃdhavāḥ saṃtyajaṃti sarvaistyaktaṃ pāsi kosti tvadanyaḥ || 71 || tvaṃ me pitā tvaṃ jananī tvameva tvaṃ me gururbāndhavāśca tvameva || tvaṃ me dharmastvaṃ ca me mokṣamārgo dāsastubhyaṃ tyaja vā rakṣa deva ||72|| pāpo'smi mūḍho'smi mahograkarmā raudro'smi nācāranidhānamasmi || tathāpi tubhyaṃ praṇipatya pādayorjayaṃ bhaktānāmarpaya śrījayārka || 73 || || nārada uvāca || || evaṃ stuto jayādityaḥ kamaṭhena mahātmanā || snigdhagaṃbhīrayā vācā prāha taṃ prahasanniva || 74 || jayādityāṣṭakamidaṃ yattvayā parikīrtitam || anena stoṣyate yo māṃ bhuvi tasya na durlabham || 75 || ravivāre viśeṣeṇa māṃ samabhyarcya yaḥ paṭhet || tasya rogā na śiṣyaṃti dāridryaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 76 || tvayā ca toṣito vatsa tava dadmi varaṃtvamum || sarvajño bhuvi bhūtvā tvaṃ tato muktimavāpsyasi || 77 || tvatpitā smṛtikāraśca bhaviṣyati dvijārcitaḥ || sthānasyāsya na nāśaśca kadācitprabhaviṣyati || 78 || na caitatsthānakaṃ vatsa parityakṣyāmi karhicit || evamuktā sa bhagavānbrāhmaṇairarcitaḥ stutaḥ || 79 || anujñāpya dvijedrāṃstāṃstatraivāṃtardadhe prabhuḥ || evaṃ pārtha samutpanno jayādityo'tra bhūtale || 1.2.51.80 || āśvine māsi saṃprāpte ravivāre ca suvrata || āśvine bhānuvāreṇa yo jayādityamarcayet ||81|| koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati|| pūjanādraktamālyaiśca raktacaṃdanakuṃkumaiḥ||82|| lepanādgaṃdhadhūpādyai naivedyerghṛtapāyasaiḥ || brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || 83 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati || putradāradhanānyāyuḥ prāpya sāṃ sārikaṃ sukham || 84 || iṣṭakāmaiḥ samāyuktaḥ sūryaloke ciraṃ vaset || 85 || sarveṣu ravivāreṣu jayādityasya darśanam || kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ vāpi sarva rogopaśāṃtidam || 86 || anādinidhanaṃ devamavyaktaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim || ye bhaktāste ca līyaṃte saurasthāne nirāmaye || 87 || sūryoparāge saṃprāpte ravikūpe samāhitaḥ || snānaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha homaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ || 88 || dānaṃ caiva yathāśaktyā jayādityāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || tasya puṇyasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā jaya || 89 || kurukṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ prabhāse puṣkareṣu ca || vārāṇasyāṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge naimiṣe'pi vā || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo jayādityaprasādataḥ || 1.2.51.90 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe jayāditya māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
<1.2.52>
|| arjuna uvāca || || koṭitīrthaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kena vā nirmitaṃ mune || kasmādvā koṭitīrthānāṃ phalamatrocyate mune || 1 || || nārada uvāca || || yadā me sthāpitaṃ sthānaṃ prasādyātha mayā prabhuḥ || brahmalokātsamānītaḥ sākṣādbrahmā pitāmahaḥ || 2 || tato madhyāhnasamaye snānārthe bhagavānvidhiḥ || sasmāra koṭitīrthānāṃ smṛtānyatrāgatāni ca || 3 || svargāttridaśalakṣāṇi saptatiśca mahītalāt || pātālādviṃśalakṣāṇi smṛtānyabhyāgatāni ca || 4 || anena pravibhāgena liṃgānyapi kurūdvaha || āyātāni yathā pūjāṃ vidadhāti pitāmahaḥ || 5 || tato'bhiṣecanaṃ kṛtvā liṃgānyabhyarcya padmabhūḥ || madhyāhnakṛtyaṃ saṃsādhya mama premṇā varaṃ dadau || 6 || tato bhagavatā hyatra manasā nirmitaṃ saraḥ || bhagavānarcitastīrthairidamūce prajāpatiḥ || 7 || kiṃ kurma bhagavandhātarādeśaṃ dehi naḥ prabho || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā prāha prajāpatiḥ || 8 || etasminsarasi stheyaṃ tīrthaiḥ sarvairathātra ca || ekasmiṃśca tathā liṃge sarvaliṃgairmamārcanāt || 9 || koṭīnāmeva tīrthānāṃ liṃgānāṃ snānapūjayā || dānena ca phalaṃ tvatra yadi satyaṃ vaco mama || 1.2.52.10 || yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute cātra piṃḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || snātvā yo'bhyarcayeddevaṃ koṭīśvaramananyadhīḥ || koṭiliṃgārcanaphalaṃ vyaktaṃ tasyopajāyate || 12 || trailokye yāni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || teṣāṃ sa phalamāpnoti koṭitīrthāvagāhanāt || 13 || evaṃ dattvā varaṃ brahmā brahmalokaṃ yayau prabhuḥ || koṭitīrthaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti viśrutam ||14|| asya tīre purā pārtha brahmādyairdevasattamaiḥ || yajñānbahuvidhānkṛtvā tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ || 15 || vasiṣṭhādyairmunivaraistapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha || manaso'bhīpsitānkāmānprāpuranye tapodhanāḥ || 16 || atra tīrthe purā pārtha atriṇā vihitaṃ tapaḥ || koṭitīrthāddakṣiṇataḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 17 || atrīśvarābhisaṃjñaṃ tu mahāpāpaharaṃ param || sthāpayitvā ca talliṃgamagre cakre sarovaram || 18 || tatra snātvā ca yo martyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ || atrīśvaraṃ samabhyarcya rudraloke vasecciram ||19|| bharadvājena muninā koṭitīrthe sarovare || tapaścīrṇaṃ mahābāho yajñāśca vihitāḥ kila || 1.2.52.20 || bharadvājeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ sumanoharam || tatra kṛtvā saro ramyaṃ parāṃ mudamavāptavān || 21 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ || bharadvājeśvaraṃ pūjya śivaloke mahīyate || 22 || tataśca koṭitīrthe'smingautamo bhagavānṛṣiḥ || atapyata tapo ghoramahalyāsaṃgamāśayā || 23 || taṃ kāmaṃ prāptavāndhīmānparāṃ mudamupāgataḥ || ahalyayā samāyogametattīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 24 || asminkṣetre mahāliṃgaṃ gautameśvarasaṃjñitam || sthāpayāmāsa bhagavānahalyāsarasastaṭe || 25 || || arjuna uvāca || || ahalyayā kadā brahmankhānitaṃ vai mahatsaraḥ || tanmama brūhi sakalamahalyāsaraḥkāraṇam || 26 || || nārada uvāca || || ahalyā śāpamāpannā gautamātkila phālguna || purā ceṃdrasamāyoge paraṃ duḥkhamupāgatā || 27 || tato duḥkhārtaḥ sa muniḥ koṭitīrthe'karottapaḥ || tapasā tena vai pārthāhalyayā saha saṃgataḥ || 28 || tataḥ sādhvī paraṃ hṛṣṭā atra kṣetre sarovaram || cakāra sumahatpuṇyaṃ tīrthodaiḥ paripūritam || 29 || ahalyāsarasi snānaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ samācaret || gautameśaṃ ca saṃpūjya brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 1.2.52.30 || koṭitīrthe naraśreṣṭha aneke munayo'malāḥ || tapastaptvā sughoraṃ ca parāṃ siddhimapāgatāḥ || 31 || rājabhirbahubhiḥ pūrvaṃ tapo dānaṃ tathādhvarāḥ || asmiṃstīrthe suvihitāḥ parāṃ siddhimupāgatāḥ || 32 || asya tīre dvijaṃ caikaṃ mṛṣṭānnairyaśca tarpayet || tena śraddhāsahāyena koṭirbhavati tarpitā || 33 || asya tīre naraḥ pārtha ratnāni vividhāni ca || gobhūmitiladhānyāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 34 || śraddhayā parayā pārtha dvijebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati || śatakoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭitīrthaprabhāvataḥ || koṭitīrthe pratiśrutya dvijebhyo na prayacchati || 35 || narake pātayitvā ca kulamekottaraṃ śatam || ātmānaṃ pātayetpaścāddāruṇaṃ rauravaṃ mahat || 36 || māghamāse tu saṃprāpte prātaḥkāle tathā'male || yaḥ snāti makarāditye tasya puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 37 || sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam|| sarvadānavratairyacca koṭi tīrthe dinedine || 38 || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || kanyāgate savitari yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || 39 || pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti gayāśrāddhaśatairna tu || kārtike māsi saṃprāpte snānādi kurute yadi || 1.2.52.40 || tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā || iṣṭvātra yajñamekaṃ tu koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || 41 || kanyāṃ brāhmeṇa vidhinā dattvā koṭiguṇaṃ phalam || sarvadānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ koṭitīrthe bhavedyataḥ || 42 || koṭi tīrthe tyajetprāṇānhṛdi kṛtvā tu mādhavam || tasya pārtha ciraṃ svarge hyakṣayā śāśvatī gatiḥ || 43 || koṭitīrthe tīrthavare dehatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ || tasya pūjāṃ prakurvaṃti brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ || 44 || asya tīre dehadāho yasya kasya prajāyate || asthikṣepo yasya bhavenmahīsāgarasaṃgame || 45 || tatphalaṃ gadituṃ pārtha vāgīśo'pi na vai kṣamaḥ || etajjñātvā paraṃ pārtha koṭitīrthaṃ prasevate || 46 || dinedine phalaṃ tasya kāpilaṃ gosahasrakam || svarge martye ca pātāle tasmādetatsudurlabham || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
<1.2.53>
|| nārada uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi śālāmāhātmya muttamam || saṃsthāpite purā sthāne proktohaṃ dvijapuṃgavaiḥ || 1 || sthānasya rakṣaṇārthāya upāyaṃ kuru suvrata || tato mayā pratijñātaṃ kariṣye sthāna rakṣaṇam || 2 || ārādhitā mayā paścādbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || trayastvekāgracittena tatastuṣṭāḥ surottamāḥ || 3 || samāgamyātha māṃ procurnārada vriyatāṃ varaḥ || proktaṃ tānārcya ca mayā kriyatāṃ sthānarakṣaṇam || 4 || ayameva varo mahyaṃ deyo devaiḥ sutoṣitaiḥ || sthānalopo yathā na syādyathā kīrtirbhavenmama || 5 || evamastviti deveśaiḥ pratijñātaṃ tadā mune || svāṃśena prakaripyāma dvijānāṃ tava rakṣaṇam || 6 || evamuktvā kalā muktā devaistripuruṣaiḥ svayam || aṃtardhānaṃ tataḥ prāptāḥ sarve'pi surasattamāḥ || 7 || tato mayā dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ śālāgre sthānarakṣaṇam || sthāpitāśca pṛthagdevāstrayastribhuvaneśvarāḥ || 8 || pīḍyamānā yadā viprāḥ kenāpi ca bhavaṃti hi || pūrvāhne cāpi ṛgvedaṃ madhyāhne ca yajūṃ ṣyatha || 9 || yāme tṛtīye sāmāni tārasvaramadhītya ca || śāpaṃ yasya pradāsyaṃti śālāgre bhṛśaroṣitāḥ || 1.2.53.10 || saptāhādvarṣamadhyādvā trivarṣādbhasmatāṃ vrajet || pratijñātā sthānarakṣā yadi vo nāradāgrataḥ || 11 || satyena tena no vairī bhasmībhavatu ha kṣaṇāt || anena śāpa maṃtreṇa bhasmībhavati niścitam || 12 || śālāṃ tripuruṣāṃ tatra yaḥ paśyati dinedine || arcayettoṣayeccāsau svargaloke mahīyate || 13 || iti tripuruṣaśālāmāhātmyam || || nārada uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi madīyasaraso mahat || 14 || māhātmyamatulaṃ pārtha devānāmapi durlabham || mayā pūrvaṃ saraḥ khātaṃ darbhāṃkuraśalākayā || 15 || mṛttikā tāmrapātreṇa tyaktā bāhye tataḥ svayam || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāmāhṛtyodaka muttamam || 16 || tattatra sarasi kṣiptaṃ tena saṃpūritaṃ saraḥ || āśvine māsi saṃprāpte bhānuvāre naraḥ śuciḥ || 17 || śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra snātvā dānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 18 || nāradīyaṃ saro hyetadvikhyāta jagatītale || mahatā puṇyayogena devairapi hi labhyate || 19 || yadatra dīyate dānaṃ hūyate yacca pāvake || sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vidyājjapānaśanasādhanāt || 1.2.53.20 || nāradīye saraḥśreṣṭhe snātvā yo nāradeśva ram || pūjayecchraddhayā martyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 21 || atra tīrthe purā pārtha sarvanāgaistapaḥ kṛtam || kadrūśāpasya mokṣārthamātmano hitakā myayā || 22 || tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā etarttārthaprabhāvataḥ || tato nāgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sthāpayāmāsurūrjitam || 23 || nāradāduttare bhāge sarve nāgāḥ praharṣitāḥ || nāradīye saraḥśreṣṭhe yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddharam || 24 || nāgeśvaraṃ mahābhaktyā tasya puṇyamanantakam || teṣāṃ sarpabhayaṃ
