nāsti nāgānāṃ vacanaṃ yathā || 25 || iti nāradīyasaromāhātmyam || || nārada uvāca || || aparadvārakānāma devī cātrāsti pāṃḍava || 26 || sā ca brahmāṃḍadvāre vai sadaiva vihitālayā || caturviṃśatikoṭībhirdevībhiḥ parirakṣitā || 27 || tato dīrghaṃ tapastaptvā mayānītātra toṣitā || aparasmiṃstato dvāre sthā pitā parameśvarī || 28 || pūrvasminnagaradvāre sthāpitā dvāravāsinī || navamī caitramāsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe bhavettu yā || 29 || kuṇḍe snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā tāṃ ca devīṃ prapūjayet || balibākulanaivedyairgandhadhūpādipūjanaiḥ || 1.2.53.30 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti tatkṣaṇāt || yānyānprārthayate kāmāṃstāṃstānā pnoti mānavaḥ || 31 || vandhyā ca labhate putraṃ snānamātreṇa tatra vai || navamyāṃ caitramāsasya puṣpadhūpārghyapūjayā || 32 || vighnāni nāśayeddevī sarva siddhiṃ prayacchati || bhaktānāṃ tatkṣaṇādeva satyametanna saṃśayaḥ || 33 || uttaradvārakāṃ cāpi pūjyaivaṃ vidhivannaraḥ || etadeva phalaṃ sopi prāpnuyānmāna vottamaḥ || 34 || pūrvadvāre tu vai devī yā sthitā dvāravāsinī || tasyāḥ pūjanamātreṇa prāpnuyādvāṃchitaṃ phalam || 35 || āśvine māsi saṃprāpte nava rātre viśeṣataḥ || upoṣya navarātraṃ ca snātvā kuṇḍe samāhitaḥ || 36 || pūjayeddevatāṃ bhaktyā puṣpadhūpānnatarpaṇaiḥ || aputro labhate putrānnirdhano labhate dhanam || 37 || vandhyā prasūyate pārtha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvara khaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe koṭitīrthādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || |||5||
<1.2.54>
|| nārada uvāca || || mamāpi pārtha tatrāsti mūrtirbrāhmaṇakāmyayā || tatra nāhaṃ tyajāmyaṃga cchatradaṇḍavibhūṣitām || 1 || kārtikasya tu yā śuklā bhavatyekādaśī śubhā || tasyāṃ madarcanaṃ kṛtvā kalidoṣairvimucyate || 2 || || arjuna uvāca || || bālyātprabhṛti saṃdeho mamāyaṃ hṛdi vartate || pṛcchatastaṃ ca me vipra na krodhaṃ kartumarhasi || 3 || sadā tvaṃ mokṣadharmeṣu pariniṣṭhāṃ parāṃ gataḥ || sarvabhūtasamo dāṃto rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ || 4 || tyaktaniṃdāstutirmaunī mokṣasthaḥ parikīrtyase || tvaṃ ca nārada lokeṣu vāyuvaccapalo mune || 5 || saudāminīva vicarandṛśyase prājñasaṃmataḥ || sadā kalikaro loke nirdayaḥ sarvaprāṇiṣu || 6 || bahūnāṃ hi sahasrāṇi devagaṃdharvarakṣasām || rājñāṃ munīndradaityānāṃ kalernaṣṭāni te'bhavan || 7 || kasmāttadeṣā ceṣṭā te saṃdehaṃ me hara dvija || saṃdehānna sukhaṃ śete bāṇaviddho mṛgo yathā || 8 || || sūta uvāca || || śaunakedaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā phālgunānnārado muniḥ || prahasanniva bābhravyavadanaṃ sa niraikṣata || 9 || sa ca bābhravyanāmā vai hārītasyānvayodbhavaḥ || brāhmaṇo nāradamuneḥ samīpe vartate sadā || 1.2.54.10 || sa ca jñātvā mahābuddhirnāradasya manīṣitam || prahasanniva provāca phālgunaṃ snigdhayā girā || 11 || || bābhravya uvāca || || satyametadyathāttha tvaṃ nāradaṃ prati pāṃḍava || sarvo'pi cātra vṛttāṃte saṃśayaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 12 || tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yathā kṛṣṇānmayā śrutam || stokakālāṃtare pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ yādavanaṃdanaḥ || 13 || mahīsāgarayātrāyāṃ kṛṣṇastatrāyayau prabhuḥ || ugrasenena sahito vasudevena babhruṇā || 14 || rāmeṇa raukmiṇeyena yuyudhānādibhistadā || sa ca jñātvā jñātisamaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame || 15 || piṃḍadānādikaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ || guheśvarādiliṃgāni yatnataḥ pratipūjya ca || 16 || snānaṃ kṛtvā koṭitīrthe jayādityaṃ samarcya ca || pūjayannāradamuniṃ yuktaḥ kṛṣṇo mahāmanāḥ || 17 || ugrasenena rājñā vai pūrvajena jaṭāyunā || madādivipramukhyānāṃ bahūnāṃ copaśṛṇvatām || ugraseno mahārājaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ provāca saṃsadi || 18 || || ugrasena uvāca || || kṛṣṇa prakṣyāmi tvāmekaṃ saṃśayaṃ vada taṃ mama || 19 || yo'yaṃ nāma mahābuddhirnārado viśvavaṃditaḥ || kasmādeṣo'ticapalo vāyuvadbhramate jagat || kalipriyaśca kasmādvā kasmāttvayyatiprītimān || 1.2.54.20 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || satyaṃ rājaṃstvayā pṛṣṭametatsarvaṃ vadāmi te || dakṣeṇa tu purā śapto nārado munisattamaḥ || 21 || sṛṣṭimārgāṃstu tānvīkṣya nāradena vicālitān || nāvasthānaṃ ca lokeṣu bhramataste bhaviṣyati || 22 || paiśunya vaktā ca tathā dvitīyānāṃ pracālanāt || iti śāpadvayaṃ prāpya dvividhātmajacālanāt || 23 || nirākartuṃ samartho'pi munirmene tathaiva tat || etāvānsādhuvādo hi yataśca kṣamate svayam || 24 || vināśakālaṃ cāvekṣya kaliṃ vardhayate yataḥ || satyaṃ ca vakti tasmātsa na ca pāpena lipyate ||25|| bhramato'pi ca sarvatra nāsya yasmātpṛthaṅmanaḥ || dhyeyādbhavati naiva syādbhramadoṣastatosya ca || yacca prītirmayi tasya paramā tacchṛṇuṣva ca || 26 || ahaṃ hi sarvadā staumi nāradaṃ devadarśanam || maheṃdragaditenaiva stotreṇa śṛṇu tannṛpa || 27 || śrutacāritrayorjātā yasyāhaṃtā na vidyate || aguptaśruta cāritraṃ nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 28 || aratikrodhacāpalye bhayaṃ naitāni yasya ca || adīrghasūtraṃ dhīraṃ ca nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 29|| kāmādvā yadi vā lobhādvācaṃ yo nānyathā vadet || upāsyaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 1.2.54.30 || adhyātmagatitattvajñaṃ kṣāṃtaṃ śaktaṃ jiteṃdriyam || ṛjuṃ yathārtha vaktāraṃ nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ||31|| tejasā yaśasā buddhyā nayena vinayena ca || janmanā tapasā vṛddhaṃ nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ||32|| sukhaśīlaṃ sukhaṃ veṣaṃ subhojaṃ svācaraṃ śubham || sucakṣuṣaṃ suvākyaṃ ca nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 33 || kalyāṇaṃ kurute gāḍhaṃ pāpaṃ yasya na vidyate || na prīyate parānarthe yo 'sau taṃ naumi nāradam || 34 || vedasmṛtipurāṇoktadharme yo nityamāsthitaḥ || priyāpriyavimuktaṃ taṃ nāradaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 35 || aśanādiṣvaliptaṃ ca paṃḍitaṃ nālasaṃ dvijam || bahuśrutaṃ citrakathaṃ nāradaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 36 || nārthe krodhe ca kāme ca bhūtapūrvo'sya vibhramaḥ || yenaite nāśitā doṣā nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 37 || vītasaṃmohadoṣo yo dṛḍhabhaktiśca śreyasi || sunayaṃ satrapaṃ taṃ ca nāradaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 38 || asaktaḥ sarvasaṃgeṣu yaḥ saktātmeti lakṣyate || adīrghasaṃśaṃyo vāggmī nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || 39 || na tyajatyāgamaṃ kiṃcidyastapo nopajīvati || avaṃdhyakālo yasyātmā tamahaṃ naumi nāradam || 1.2.54.40 || kṛtaśramaṃ kṛtaprajñaṃ na ca tṛptaṃ samādhitaḥ || nityaṃ yatnātpramattaṃ ca nāradaṃ taṃ namāmyaham || || 41 || na hṛṣyatyarthalābhena yo'lābhe na vyathatyapi || sthirabuddhirasaktātmā tamahaṃ naumi nāradam || 42 || taṃ sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ dakṣaṃ śucimakātaram || kālajñaṃ ca nayajñaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yāmi nāradam ||43|| imaṃ stavaṃ nāradasya nityaṃ rājanpaṭhāmyaham || tena me paramā prītiṃ karoti munisattamaḥ || 44 || anyopi yaḥ śucirbhūtvā nityametāṃ stutiṃ japet || acirāttasya devarṣiḥ prasādaṃ kurute param || 45 || etānguṇānnāradasya tvamathākarṇya pārthiva || japa nityaṃ stavaṃ puṇyaṃ prītaste bhavitā muniḥ || 46 || || bābhravya uvāca || || iti kṛṣṇamukhācchrutvā nāradasya guṇānnṛpaḥ || babhūva paramaprī taścakre tacca tathā vacaḥ || 47 || tato nāradamānarca dattvā dānaṃ ca puṣkalam || nāradīyadvijāgryāṇāṃ nāradaḥ prīyatāmiti || 48 || yayau dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sabhrātṛjātibāṃdhavaḥ || tīrthayātrāmimāṃ kṛtvā vidhivatpuruṣottamaḥ || 49 || tathā tvamapi kauravya nāradasya guṇānimān || śrutvā śraddhāmayo bhūtvā śṛṇu kṛtyaṃ yadatra ca || 1.2.54.50 || kārtike śukladvādaśyāṃ prabodhinyāmasau muniḥ || viṣṇordhyānasamādheśca prabuddho jāyate sadā || 51 || tasmindine nāradena nirmite'traiva kūpake || snānaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ || 52 || tapo dānaṃ japaścātra kūpe bhavati cākṣayam || 53 || idaṃ viṣṇviti maṃtreṇa tato viṣṇuṃ prabodhayet || nāradaṃ ca muniṃ paścānmantreṇānena pāṃḍava || 54 || yoganidrā yathā tyaktā hariṇā munisattama || tathā lokopakārāya bhavānapi parityaja || 55 || iti maṃtreṇa cotthāpya nāradaṃ paripūjayet || kṛṣṇaproditayā stutyā chatradhotrārcanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||56|| śaktyā dvijānāṃ deyaṃ ca chatraṃ dhotraṃ kamaṃḍalum || praṇamya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā nāradaḥ prīyatāmiti || 57 || evaṃ kṛte prasādātsa muneḥ pāpena mucyate || jāyate na kalistasya na cāsaukhyaṃ bhavediha|| 58 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe nāradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
<1.2.55>
|| sūta uvāca || || iti bābhravyavacanamākarṇya kurunandanaḥ || prāṇamannāradaṃ bhaktyā vismitaḥ pulakānvitaḥ || 1 || praśasya ca ciraṃ kālaṃ punarnāradamabravīt || 2 || guptakṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇvānastvanmukhānmune || tṛptiṃ naivādhigacchāmi bhūyastadvaktumarhasi || 3 || || nārada uvāca || || mahāliṃgasya vakṣyāmi mahimānaṃ kurūdvaha || gautameśvara liṃgasya sāvadhānaḥ śṛṇuṣva tat || 4 || akṣapādo mahāyogī gautamākhyo'bhavanmuniḥ || godāvarīsamānetā ahalyāyāḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ || 5 || gupta kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ sa ca jñātvā mahottamam || yogasaṃsādhanaṃ kurvannatra tepe tapo mahat || 6 || yogasiddhiṃ tataḥ prāpya gautamena mahātmanā || atra saṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ gautameśvarasaṃjñayā || 7 || saṃsnāpyaitanmahāliṃgaṃ candanena vilipya ca || saṃpūjya puṣpairvividhairguggulaṃ dāhayetpuraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate || 8 || || arjuna uvāca || || yogasvarūpamicchāmi śrotuṃ nārada tattvataḥ || yogaṃ sarve praśaṃsaṃti yataḥ sarvottamottamam || || 9 || || nārada uvāca || || samāsāttava vakṣyāmi yogatattvaṃ kurūdvaha || śravaṇādapi nairmalyaṃ yasya syātsevanātkimu || 1.2.55.10 || cittavṛttinirodhākhyaṃ yogatattvaṃ prakīrtyate|| tadaṣṭāṃgaprakāreṇa sādhayaṃtīha yoginaḥ||11|| yamaśca niyamaścaiva prāṇāyāmastṛtīyakaḥ|| pratyāhāro dhāraṇā ca dhyeyaṃ dhyānaṃ ca saptamam || 12 || samādhiriti cāṣṭāṃgo yogaḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥ || pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāmaṣṭānāṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava || || 13 || anukramānnaro yeṣāṃ sādhanādyogamaśnute || ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau ||14|| ete paṃca yamāḥ proktāḥ śṛṇveṣāmapi lakṣaṇam || ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu yo hitāya pravartate || 15 || ahiṃsaiṣā samākhyātā vedasaṃvihitā ca yā || dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ cānumitaṃ svānubhūtaṃ yathārthataḥ || 16 || kathanaṃ satyamityuktaṃ parapīḍāvivarjitam || anādānaṃ parasvānāmāpadyapi kathaṃcana || 17 || manasā karmaṇā vācā tadasteyaṃ prakīrtitam || amaithunaṃ yatīnāṃ ca manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 18 || ṛtau svadāragamanaṃ gehināṃ brahmacaryatā || yatīnāṃ sarvasaṃnyāso manovākkāyakarmaṇā || 19 || gṛhasthānāṃ ca manasā smṛta eṣo'parigrahaḥ || ete yamāstava proktāḥ paṃcaiva niyamāñchṛṇu ||1.2.55.20|| śaucaṃ tuṣṭistapaścaiva japo bhaktirgurostathā || eteṣāmapi paṃcānāṃ pṛthaksaṃśṛṇu lakṣaṇam || 21 || bāhyamābhyataraṃ caiva dvividhaṃ śaucamucyate || bāhyaṃ tu mṛjjalaiḥ proktamāṃtaraṃ śuddhamānasam || 22 || nyāyenāgatayā vṛttyā bhikṣayā vārtayāpi ca || saṃtoṣo yasya satataṃ sā tuṣṭiriti cocyate || 23 || cāṃdrāyaṇādīni punastapāṃsi vihitāni ca || āhāralāghavaparaḥ kuryāttattapa ucyate || 24 || svādhyāyastu japaḥ proktaḥ praṇavābhyasanādikaḥ || śive jñāne gurau bhaktirgurubhaktiriti smṛtā || || 25 || evaṃ saṃsādhya niyamānsaṃyamāṃśca vicakṣaṇaḥ || prāṇāyāmāya saṃdadhyānnānyathā yogasādhakaḥ || 26 || yato'śuciśarīrasya vāyukopo mahānbhavet || vāyukopātkuṣṭhatā ca jaḍatvādīnupāśnute || 27 || tasmādvicakṣaṇaḥ śuddhaṃ kṛtvā dehaṃ yatetparam || prāṇāyāmasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava || 28 || prāṇāpānanirodhaśca prāṇāyāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || laghumadhyottarīyākhyaḥ sa ca dhīraistridhoditaḥ || 29 || laghurdvādaśamātrastu mātrā nimiṣa unmiṣaḥ || dviguṇo madhyamaścoktastriguṇaścottamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.2.55.30 || prathamena jayetsvedaṃ madhyamena tu vepathum || viṣādaṃ ca tṛtīyena jayeddoṣānanukramāt || 31 || padmākhyamāsanaṃ kṛtvā recakaṃ pūrakaṃ tathā || kuṃbhakaṃ ca sukhāsīnaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ tridhā'bhyaset || 32 || prāṇānāmupasaṃrodhātprāṇāyāma iti smṛtaḥ || yathā parvatadhātūnāṃ dhmātānāṃ dahyate malaḥ || 33 || tatheṃdriyavṛto doṣaḥ prāṇāyāmena dahyate || gośataṃ kāpilaṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet || 34 || prāṇāyāmena yogajñastasmātprāṇaṃ sadā yamet || prāṇāyāmena siddhyanti divyāḥ śāntyādayaḥ kramāt || || 35 || śāṃtiḥ praśāntirdīptiśca prasādaśca yathākramam || sa hajāgaṃtukāmānāṃ pāpānāṃ ca pravartatām ||36|| vāsanāśāṃtirityākhyaḥ prathamo jāyate guṇaḥ || lobhamohātmakāndoṣānnirākṛtyaiva kṛtsnaśaḥ || 37 || tapasāṃ ca yadā prāptiḥ sā śāṃtiriti cocyate || sarvendriyaprasādaśca buddhervai marutāmapi || 38 || prasāda iti sa proktaḥ prāpyamevaṃ catuṣṭayam || evaṃphalaṃ sadā yogī prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyaset || 39 || mṛdutvaṃ sevyamānāstu siṃhaśārdūlakuṃjarāḥ || yathā yānti tathā prāṇo vaśyo bhavati sādhitaḥ || 1.2.55.40 || prāṇāyāmastvayaṃ proktaḥ pratyāhāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇu || viṣayeṣu pravṛttasya cetaso vinivartanam || 41 || pratyāhāraṃ vinirdiṣṭatasya saṃyamanaṃ hi yat || pratyāhārastvayaṃ prokto dhāraṇālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || 42 || yathā toyārthinastoyaṃ patranālādibhiḥ śanaiḥ || āpibeyustathā vāyuṃ yogī nayati sādhitam || 43 || prāgnābhyāṃ hṛdaye vāyuratha tālau bhruvoṃ'tare || caturdale ṣaḍdaśe ca dvādaśe ṣoḍaśadvike || 44 || ākuṃcanenaiva mūrddhamunnīya pavanaṃ śanaiḥ || mūrdhani brahmaraṃdhre taṃ prāṇaṃ saṃdhārayetkṛtī || 45 || prāṇāyāmā daśa dvau ca dhāraṇaiṣā prakīrtyate || daśaitā dhāraṇāḥ sthāpya prāpnotyakṣarasāmyatām || 46 || dhāraṇāsthasya yaddhyeyaṃ tasya tvaṃ śṛṇu lakṣaṇam || dhyeyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ pārtha yasyāṃto nopalabhyate || 47 || kecicchivaṃ hariṃ kecitkecitsūryaṃ vidhiṃ pare || keciddevīṃ mahadbhūtāmuta dhyāyanti kecana || 48 || tatra yo yacca dhyāyeta sa ca tatra pralīyate || tasmātsadā śivaṃ devaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ haraṃ smaret || 49 || padmāsanasthaṃ taṃ gauraṃ bījapūrakaraṃ sthitam || daśahastaṃ suprasannavadanaṃ dhyānamāsthitam || 1.2.55.50 || dhyeyametattava proktaṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ samācaret || dhyānasya lakṣaṇaṃ caitannimeṣārdhamapi sphuṭam || 51 || na pṛthagjāyate dhyeyāddhāraṇāṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ || evametāṃ durārohāṃ bhūmimāsthāya yogavit || 52 || na kiṃcicciṃtayetpaścātsamādhiriti kīrtyate || samādherlakṣaṇaṃ samyagbruvato me niśāmaya || 53 || śabdasparśarasairhīnaṃ gaṃdharūpavivarjitam || paraṃ puruṣaṃ saṃprāptaḥ samādhisthaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 54 || tāṃ tu prāpya naro vighnairnābhibhūyeta karhicit || samādhisthaśca duḥkhena guruṇāpi na cālyate ||55|| śaṃkhādyāḥ śataśastasya vādyante yadi karṇayoḥ || bheryaśca yadi hanyaṃte śabdaṃ bāhyaṃ na viṃdati || 56 || kaśāprahārābhihato vahnidagdhatanustathā || śītāḍhyeva sthito ghore sparśaṃ bāhyaṃ na vindati || || 57 || rūpe gaṃdhe rase bāhye tādṛśasya tu kā kathā || dṛṣṭvā ya ātmanātmānaṃ samādhiṃ labhate punaḥ || 58 || tṛṣṇā vātha bubhukṣā vā bādhete taṃ na karhicit || 59 || na svarge na ca pātāle mānuṣye kva ca tatsukham || samādhiṃ niścalaṃ prāpya yatsukhaṃ viṃdate naraḥ || 1.2.55.60 || evamārūḍhayogasya tasyāpi kurunadana || paṃcopasargāḥ kaṭukāḥ pravartaṃte yathā śṛṇu || 61 || prātibhaḥ śrāvaṇo daivo bhramāvarto'tha bhīṣaṇaḥ || pratibhā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ prātibho'yaṃ ca sāttvikaḥ || 62 || tena yo madamādadyādyogī śīghraṃ ca cetasaḥ || yojanānāṃ sahasrebhyaḥ śravaṇaṃ śrāvaṇastu saḥ || 63 || dvitīyaḥ sātvikaścāyamasmānmatto vinaśyati | aṣṭau paśyati yonīśca devānāṃ daiva ityasau || 64 || ayaṃ ca sāttviko doṣo madādasmādvinaśyati || āvarta iva toyasya janāvarte yadākulaḥ || 65 || āvartākhyastvayaṃ doṣo rājasaḥ sa mahābhayaḥ || bhrāmyate yannirālambaṃ mano doṣaiśca yoginaḥ || 66 || samastādhāravibhraṃśādbhramākhyastāmaso guṇaḥ || etairnāśitayogāśca sakalā devayonayaḥ || 67 || upasargairmahāghorairāvartyaṃte punaḥ punaḥ || prāvṛtya kaṃbalaṃ śuklaṃ yogī tasmānmanomayam || 68 || ciṃtayetparamaṃ brahma kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ || āhārāḥ sāttvikāścaiva saṃsevyāḥ siddhimicchatā || 69 || rājasaistāmasaiścaiva yogī siddhayenna karhicit || śraddadhāneṣu dāṃteṣu śrotriyeṣu mahātmasu || 1.2.55.70 || svadharmādanapeteṣu bhikṣā yācyā ca yoginā || bhaikṣaṃ yavānnaṃ takraṃ vā payo yāvakameva vā || 71 || phalamūlaṃ vipakvaṃ vā kaṇapiṇyākasaktavaḥ || śrutā ityeta āhārā yogināṃ siddhikārakāḥ || 72 || mṛtyukālaṃ viditvā ca nimittairyogasādhakaḥ || yogaṃ yuñjīta kālasya vaṃcanārthaṃ samāhitaḥ || 73 || nimittāni ca vakṣyāmi mṛtyuṃ yo vetti yogavit || raktakṛṣṇāṃbaradharā gāyaṃtīha satī ca yam || 74 || dakṣiṇāśāṃ nayennārī svapne so'pi na jīvati || nagnaṃ kṣapaṇakaṃ svapne hasamānaṃ pradṛśya ca || 75 || enaṃ ca vīkṣya valgantaṃ taṃ vidyānmṛtyumāgatam || ṛkṣavānarayugyastho gāyanyo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || || 76 || yāti majjedadhau paṃke gomaye vā na jīvati || keśāṃgāraistathā bhasmabhujaṃgairnijalāṃ nadīm || 77 || eṣāmanyatamaiḥ pūrṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā svapne na jīvati || karālairvikaṭai rūkṣaiḥ puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ || 78 || pāṣāṇaistāḍitaḥ svapne sadyo mṛtyuṃ bhajennaraḥ || sūryodaye yasya śivā krośaṃtī yāti sammukham || 79 || viparītaṃ parītaṃ vā sa sadyo mṛtyumṛcchati || dīpādhigaṃdhaṃ no vetti vamatyagniṃ tathā niśi || 1.2.55.80 || nātmānaṃ paranetrasthaṃ vīkṣate na sa jīvati || śakrāyudhaṃ cārdharātre divā vā grahaṇaṃ tathā || 81 || dṛṣṭvā manyeta sa kṣīṇamātmajīvitamāptavān || nāsikā vakratāmeti karṇayornnamanonnatī || 82 || netraṃ ca vāmaṃ sravati yasya tasyāyurudgatam || āraktatāmeti mukhaṃ jihvā cāpyasitā yadā || 83 || tadā prājño vijānīyādāsannaṃ mṛtyumātmanaḥ || uṣṭrarāsabhayānena svapne yo yāti dakṣiṇām || 84 || diśaṃ karṇau pidhāyāpi nirghoṣaṃ śṛṇuyānna ca || na sa jīvettathā svapne pati tasya pidhīyate || 85 || dvāraṃ na cottiṣṭhati ca śubhrā dṛṣṭiśca lohitā || svapne'gniṃ praviśedyaśca na ca niṣkramate punaḥ || 86 || jalapraveśādapi vā tadaṃtaṃ tasya jīvitam || yaścābhihanyate duṣṭairbhūtai rātrāvatho divā || 87|| prakṛtairvikṛtairvāpi tasyāsannau yamāṃtakau || devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca pitrorjñānavidāṃ tathā || 88 || nindāmavajñāṃ kurute bhakto bhūtvā na jīvati || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā nimittāni viparītāni yogavit || 89 || dhāraṇāṃ samyagāsthāya samādhāvacalo bhavet || yadi necchati te mṛtyuṃ tato nāsau prapadyate || 1.2.55.90 || vimuktimathavā vāṃchedvisṛjedbrahmamūrdhani || saṃti dehe vimukte ca upasargāśca ye punaḥ || 91 || yoginaṃ samupāyāṃti śṛṇu tānapi pāṃḍava || aiśānye rākṣasapure yakṣo gandharva eva ca || 92 || aindre saumye prajāpatye brāhme cāṣṭasu siddhayaḥ || bhavaṃti cāṣṭau śṛṇu tāḥ pārthivī yā ca taijasī || 93 || vāyavī vyomātmikā caiva mānasāhambhavā matiḥ || pratyekamaṣṭadhā bhinnā dviguṇā dviguṇā kramāta|94|| pūrve cāṣṭau catuḥṣaṣṭirante śṛṇuṣva tadyathā || sthūlatā hrasvatā bālyaṃ vārdhakyaṃ yovanaṃ tathā ||95|| nānājāti svarūpaṃ ca caturbhirdehadhāraṇam || pārthivāṃśaṃ vinā nityamaṣṭau pārthivasiddhayaḥ || 96 || vijite pṛthivītattve yadaiśānye bhavanti ca || bhūmāviva jale vāso nāturo'rṇavamāpibet || 97 || sarvatra jalaprāptiśca api śuṣkaṃ dravaṃ phalam || tribhirdehasya dharaṇaṃ nadīrvā sthāpayetkare || 98 || avraṇatvaṃ śarīrasya kāṃtiścāthāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || aṣṭau pūrvā imāścāṣṭau rākṣasānāṃ pure smṛtāḥ || 99 || dehādagnivinirmāṇaṃ tattāpabhayavarjanam || śaktidatvaṃ ca lokānāṃ jalamadhyegnijvālanam || 1.2.55.100 || agnigrahaśca hastena smṛtimātreṇa pāvanam || bhasmībhūtasya nirmāṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ dehasya dhāraṇam ||101|| pūrvāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāpyaṣṭau tejaso yakṣasadmani || manogatitvaṃ bhūtānāmantarniveśanaṃ tathā||102|| parvatādimahābhāravahanaṃ līlayaiva ca || laghutvaṃ gauravatvaṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ vāyuvāraṇam||103|| aṃgulyagranipātena bhūmeḥ sarvatra kampanam || ekena dehaniṣpattirgāṃdharve vāṃti siddhayaḥ ||104|| caturviṃśatiḥ pūrvāścāpyaṣṭāvetāśca siddhayaḥ || gandharvaloke dvātriṃśadata ūrdhvaṃ niśāmaya || 105 || chāyāvihīnaniṣpattiriṃdriyāṇāmadarśanam || ākāśagamanaṃ nityamiṃdriyādiśamaḥ svayam || 106 || dūre ca śabdagrahaṇaṃ sarvaśabdāvagāhanam || tanmātraliṃgagrahaṇaṃ sarvaprāṇinidarśanam || 107 || aṣṭau vātātmikāścaindre dvātriṃśadapi pūrvakāḥ || yathākāmopalabdhiśca yathākāmavinirgamaḥ ||108|| sarvatrābhibhavaścaiva sarvaguhyanidarśanam || saṃsāradarśanaṃ cāpi mānasyo'ṣṭau ca siddhayaḥ || 109 || catvāriṃśacca pūrvāśca somaloke smṛtāstvimāḥ || chedanaṃ tāpanaṃ bandhaḥ saṃsāraparivartanam || 1.2.55.110 || sarvabhūta prasādatvaṃ mṛtyukālajayastathā || ahaṃkārodbhavaścāṣṭau prājāpatye ca pūrvikāḥ || 111 || ākāreṇa jagatsaṣṭistathānugraha eva ca || pralayasyādhikāraṃ ca lokacitrapravartanam || 112 || asādṛśyamidaṃ vyaktaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak || śubhetarasya kartṛtvamaṣṭau buddhibhavāstvamī || 113 || ṣaṭpaṃcāśattathā pūrvāścatuḥṣaṣṭirime guṇāḥ || brāhmaye pade pravartaṃte guhyametattaveritam || 114 || jīvato dehabhede vā siddhyaścaitāstu yoginām || saṃgo naiva vidhātavyo bhayātpatanasaṃbhavāt || 115 || etānguṇānnirākṛtya yuñjato yoginastadā || siddhayo'ṣṭau pravartaṃte yogasaṃsiddhikārakāḥ || 116 || aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca || prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tathāpare || 117 || yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ māheśvarapadasthitāḥ || sūkṣmātsūkṣmatvamaṇimā śīghratvāllaghimā smṛtā || 118 || mahimā śeṣapūjyatvātprāptirnāprāpyamasya yat|| prākāmyamasya vyāpitvādīśitvaṃ ceśvaro yataḥ||119|| vaśitvādvaśitā nāma saptamī siddhiruttamā || yatrecchā tatra ca sthānaṃ tatra kāmāvasāyitā || 1.2.55.120 || aiśvaraṃ padamāptasya bhavaṃtyetāśca siddhayaḥ || tato na jāyate naiva vardhate na vinaśyati ||121|| eṣa mukta iti prokto ya evaṃ muktimāpnuyāt || yathā jalaṃ jalenaikyaṃ nikṣiptamupagacchati||122|| tathaivaṃ sātmyamabhyeti yogināmātmā parātmanā || evaṃ jñātvā phalaṃ yogī sadā yogaṃ samabhyaset || 123 || atropamāṃ vyāharaṃti yogārthaṃ yogino' malāḥ || śaśāṃkaraśmisaṃyogādarkakāṃto hutāśanam || 124 || samutsṛjati naikaḥ sannupamā sāsti yoginaḥ || kapiṃjalākhunakulā vasaṃti svāmiva dgṛhe || 125 || dhvaste yāṃtyanyato duḥkhaṃ na teṣāṃ sopamā yateḥ || mṛddehakalpadeho'pi mukhāgreṇa kanīyasā || 126 || karoti mṛdbhāgacayamupadeśaḥ sa yoginaḥ || paśupakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ patrapuṣpaphalānvitam || 127 || vṛkṣaṃ vilupyamānaṃ ca labdhvā sidhyaṃti yoginaḥ || rurugātraviṣāṇāgramālakṣya tilakākṛtim || 128 || saha tena vivardheta yogī siddhimupāśnute || dravyaṃ pūrṇamupādāya pātramārohate bhuvaḥ || 129 || tuṃgamārgaṃ vilokyaivaṃ vijñātaṃ ki na yoginām || tadgehaṃ yatra vasati tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati || 1.2.55.130 || yena niṣpādyate cārthaḥ svayaṃ syādyogasiddhaye || tathā jñānamupāsīta yogī yatkāryasādhakam || 131 || jñānānāṃ bahutā yeyaṃ yogavighnakarī hi sā || idaṃ jñeyamidaṃ jñeyamiti yastṛṣitaścaret || 132 || api kalpasahasrāyurnaiva jñeyamavāpnuyāt|| tyaktasaṃgo jitakrodho labdhāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ ||133|| pidhāya buddhyā dvārāṇi mano dhyāne niveśayet || āhāraṃ sāttvikaṃ sevenna taṃ yena vicetanaḥ ||134|| syādayaṃ taṃ ca bhuṃjāno rauravasya priyātithiḥ || vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṃḍaśca te trayaḥ||135|| yasyaite niyatā daṃḍāḥ sa tridaṃḍī yatiḥ smṛtaḥ|| anurāgaṃ jano yāti parokṣe guṇakīrtanam ||136 || na bibhyati ca sattvāni siddherlakṣaṇamucyate || 137 || alaulyamārogyamaniṣṭhuratvaṃ gaṃdhaḥ śubho mūtrapurīṣayośca || kāṃtiḥ prasādaḥ svarasaumyatā ca yogapravṛtteḥ prathamaṃ hi cihnam || 138 || samāhito brahmaparo'pramādī śucistathaikāṃtaratirjitendriyaḥ || samāpnuyādyogamimaṃ mahāmanā vimuktimāpnoti tataśca yogataḥ || 139 || kulaṃ pavitraṃ jananī kṛtārthā vasundharā bhāgyavatī ca tena || avāhyamārge sukhasindhumagnaṃ lagnaṃ pare brahmaṇi yasya cetaḥ || 1.2.55.140 || viśuddhabuddhiḥ samaloṣṭakāṃcanaḥ samastabhūteṣu vasansamo hi yaḥ || sthānaṃ paraṃ śāśvatamavyayaṃ ca yatirhi gatvā na punaḥ prajāyate || 141 || idaṃ mayā yogarahasyamuktamevaṃvidhaṃ gautamaḥ prāpa yogam || tenaitacca sthāpitaṃ pārtha liṃgaṃ saṃdarśanādarcanātkalmaṣaghnam || 142 || yaścāśvine kṛṣṇacaturdaśīdine rātrau samabhyarcati liṃgametan || snātvā ahalyāsarasi pradhāne śraddhāya sarvaṃ pravidhāya bhaktitaḥ || 143 || mahopakāreṇa vimuktapāpaḥ sa yāti yatrāsti sa gautamo muniḥ || 144 || idaṃ mayā pārtha tava praṇītaṃ guptasya kṣetrasya samāsayogāt || māhātmyametatsakalaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ sa syādviśuddhaḥ kimu vacmi bhūyaḥ || 145 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā gautamākhyānamuttamam || putrapautrapriyaṃ prāpya sa yāti padamavyayam || 146 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe gautameśvaramāhātmyasavistarayogalakṣaṇavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
<1.2.56>
|| nārada uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmeśaṃ liṃgamuttamam || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet || 1 || ekadā tu purā pārtha sṛṣṭi kāmena brahmaṇā || tapaḥ sucaritaṃ ghoraṃ sārdhavarṣasahasrakam || 2 || tapasā tena santuṣṭaḥ pārvatīpatiśaṃkaraḥ || varamasmai tataḥ prādāllokakartre svavāṃchitam || 3 || tato hṛṣṭaḥ pramuditaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ pitāmahaḥ || jñātvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ svayaṃ liṃgaṃ cakāra ha ||4|| cakhāna ca saraḥ puṇyaṃ nāmnā brahmasaraḥ śubhama || mahīnagarakātpūrve mahāpātakanāśanam || 5 || asya tīre mahāliṃgaṃ sthāpayāmāsa vai vibhuḥ || tatra devaḥ svayaṃ sākṣādvidyate kila śaṃkaraḥ || || 6 || puṣkarādadhikaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmeśaṃnāma phālguna || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā piṇḍadānaṃ samācaret || 7 || dānaṃ caiva yathāśaktyā kārtikyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || devaṃ prapūjayedbhaktyā brahmeśaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 8 || pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || puṣkareṣu ca yatpuṇyaṃ kurukṣetre ravigrahe || 9 || gaṃgādipuṇyatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tīrthasyāsyāvagāhanāt || 1.2.56.10 || mokṣaliṃgasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pārtha mahādbhutam || mayā sthānahitārthaṃ ca samārādhya maheśvaram || 11 || sthāpitaṃ pravaraṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā mokṣeśvaraṃ haram || darbhāgreṇa tataḥ pārtha kūpaṃ khanitavānaham ||12|| prasādya lokakartāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || kamaṇḍalorbrahmaṇaśca samānītā sarasvatī || 13 || kūpe'sminmokṣanāthasya lokānāṃ pretamuktaye || kārtikasya tu māsasya śuklapakṣe caturdaśī || 14 || kūpe snātvā narastasyāṃ tilapiṇḍaṃ samācaret || pretānuddiśya niyataṃ mokṣatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 15 || kule na jāyate tasya pretaḥ pārtha na saṃśayaḥ || pretā mokṣaṃ pragacchanti tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 16 || jayādityakūpavare naraḥ snātvā prayatnataḥ || garbheśvaraṃ namaskṛtya na sa garbheṣu majjati ||17|| idaṃ mayā pārtha tava praṇītaṃ guptasya kṣetrasya samāsayogāt || māhātmyametatsakalaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ syādviśuddhaḥ kimu vacmi bhūyaḥ || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṃḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe brahmeśvaramokṣeśvara garbhaśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||56||
<1.2.57>
|| nārada uvāca || || tato viprā nāradaśca samārādhya maheśvaram || mahīnagarake puṇye sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram || 1 || lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kedāraṃ liṃgamuttamam || atrīśāduttare bhāge mahāpātakanāśanam || 2 || atrikuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || atrīśaṃ ca namaskṛtya kedāraṃ yaḥ prapaśyati ||3|| mātuḥ stanyaṃ punarnaiva sa pibenmuktibhāgbhavet || tato rudro nīlakaṃṭhaṃ nāradāya mahātmane ||4|| svayaṃ dattvā svayaṃ tasthau mahīnagarake śubhe || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā nīlakaṃṭhaṃ prapaśyati || 5 || jayādityaṃ namaskṛtya rudralokamavāpnuyāt || jayādityaṃ pūjayaṃti kūpe snātvā narottamāḥ || 6 || na teṣāṃ vaṃśanāśo'sti jayādityaprasādataḥ || idaṃ te kathitaṃ pārtha mahīnagarakasya ca || 7 || ākhyānaṃ sakalaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe nīlakaṃṭhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
<1.2.58>
|| arjuna uvāca || || guptakṣetramidaṃ kasmātkasmādguptaṃ ca nārada || yasya prabhāvaḥ sumahānnaiva kasyāpi saṃstutaḥ || 1 || || nārada uvāca || || purātanāmatra kathāṃ guptakṣetrasya kāraṇe || śṛṇu pāṃḍava śāpena guptamāsīdidaṃ yathā || 2 || purā nimitte kasmiṃścitsarvatīrthādhidaivatāḥ || praṇāmāya brahmasado brahmāṇaṃ sahitā yayuḥ || 3 || puṣkarasya prabhāsasya nimiṣasyārbudasya ca || kurukṣetrasya kṣetrasya dharmāraṇyasya devatāḥ || 4 || vastrāpathasya śvetasya phalgutīrthaṃ sya cāpi yāḥ || kedārasya tathānyeṣāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ koṭiśo'pi yāḥ || 5 || siṃdhusāgarayogasya mahīsāgarakasya ca || gaṃgāsāgarayogasya adhipāḥ sūkarasya ca || 6 || gaṃgārevāmukhīnāṃ tu nadīnāmadhidevatāḥ || śoṇahradapurogāṇāṃ hradānāṃ cādhidevatāḥ || 7 || te sarve saṃghaśo bhūtvā śraiṣṭhya jñānāya cātmanaḥ || samupājagmuramalā mahatīṃ brahmaṇaḥ sabhām || 8 || tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi samāyātāni vīkṣya saḥ || uttasthau sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ sabhāsadbhiḥ pitāmahaḥ || 9 || praṇamya sarvatīrthebhyaḥ prabaddhakarasaṃpuṭaḥ || tīrthāni bhagavānāha vismayotphullalocanaḥ || 1.2.58.10 || adya naḥ sadma sakalaṃ yuṣmābhiratipāvitam || vayaṃ ca pāvitā bhūyo yuṣmākaṃ darśanādapi || 11 || tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ śreyaḥ sparśanaṃ snānameva ca || kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ cāpi na syātpuṇyaṃ vinā param ||12|| mahāpāpānvitā raudrāstvapi ye syuḥ suniṣṭhurāḥ || te'pi tīrthaiḥ prapūyaṃte kiṃ punardharmasaṃsthitāḥ ||13|| evamuktvā pulastyaṃ sa putramabhyādideśa ha || śīghramarghaṃ tīrthahetoḥ samānaya yathārcaye || 14 || || pulastya uvāca || asaṃkhyānīha tīrthāni dṛśyaṃte padmasaṃbhava || yathā diśasi māṃ tāta arghamekamupānaye || 15 || dharmapravacane śloko yata eṣa pragīyate || 16 || bhaveyuryadyasaṃkhyātā arghayogyāḥ samarcane || tatasteṣāṃ variṣṭhāya dātavyo'rghaḥ kilaikataḥ || 17 || || brahmovāca || || sābhiprāyaṃ sādhu vatsa tvayā proktamidaṃ vacaḥ || evaṃ kuruṣvaikamarghamānaya tvaṃ suśīghrataḥ || 18 || || nārada uvāca || || tataḥ pulastyo vegena samāninye'rghamuttamam || taṃ ca brahmā kare gṛhya tīrthānyāheti bhāratīm || 19 || sarvairbhavadbhiḥ saṃhatya mukhyastvekaḥ prakīrtyatām || tasmai cārghaṃ prayacchāmi naivaṃ māmanayaḥ spṛśet || 1.2.58.20 || || tīrthānyūcuḥ || || na vayaṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vidmaḥ kathaṃcana parasparam || asmāddhetośca saṃprāptā jñātvā dehi tvameva tat || 21 || || brahmovāca || || nāhaṃ vedmi śreṣṭhatāṃ vaḥ kathaṃcana namo'stu vaḥ || sarve cāpāramāhātmyaṃ svayaṃ me vaktumarhatha || 22 || yatra gaṃgā gayā kāśī puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā || kurukṣetraṃ tathā revā mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 23 || prabhāsādyāni śataśo yatra nastatra kā matiḥ || 24 || || nārada uvāca || || evamukte padmabhuvā kopi novāca kiṃcana || cireṇedaṃ tataḥ prāha mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 25 || mamainamarghaṃ tvaṃ yaccha caturānana śīghrataḥ || yataḥ koṭikalāyāṃ vā mama ko'pi na pūryate || 26 || yataścendradyumnarājñā tāpyamānā vasuṃdharā || sarvatīrthadravībhūtā mahīnāmābhavannadī || 27 || sā ca sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃyuktāni mayā saha || sarvatīrthamayastasmādasmi khyāto jagattraye || 28 || guhena ca mahāliṃgaṃ kumāreśvaramīśvaram || saṃsthāpya tīrthamukhyatvaṃ mama dattaṃ mahātmanā || 29 || nāradenāpi mattīre sthānaṃ saṃsthāpya śobhanam || sarvebhyaḥ puṇyakṣetrebhyo dattaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ purā mama || 1.2.58.30 || evaṃ tribhirhetuvarairmamevārghaḥ pradīyatām || guṇaikadeśe'pi samaṃ mama tīrthaṃ na vai param || 31 || ityukte vacane pārtha tīrtharājena bhārata|| sarve nocuḥ kiṃcanāpi kiṃ brahmā vakṣyatīti yat || 32 || tato brahmasuto jyeṣṭhaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ || dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumuddhatya dharmo vacanamabravīt || 33 || aho kaṣṭamidaṃ kūktaṃ tīrtharājena mohataḥ || santo'pi na guṇā vācyāḥ svayaṃ sadbhiḥ svakā yataḥ || 34 || svīyānguṇānsvayaṃ yo hi sampatsu prakṣipanparān || bravīti rājasastveṣa hyahaṃkāro jugupsitaḥ || 35 || tasmādasmādahaṃkārātsatsvapyeṣu guṇeṣu ca || aprakhyātaṃ dhvastarūpamidaṃ tīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||36|| staṃbhatīrthamiti khyātaṃ stambho garvaḥ kṛto yataḥ || staṃbhasya hi phalaṃ sadyo brahmāpi prāpa kiṃ paraḥ || 37 || ityukte dharmadevena hāheti rava utthitaḥ || tataḥ śīghraṃ samāyāto yogīśo'haṃ ca pāṃḍava || 38 || guhastato vacaḥ prāha dharmadevasamāgame || ayuktametacchāpo'yaṃ datto yaddharma dhārṣṭyataḥ || 39 || bravītu ko'pi sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ teṣu vartatām || yadyaiśvaryaṃ nārhatesau mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 1.2.58.40 || tiṣṭhatvātmaguṇo yacca tīrtharājena varṇitaḥ || tatra ko viguṇo nāma mithyāvādī yato guṇaḥ || 41 || aho na yuktaṃ pālānāṃ yadi te'pyavimṛśya ca || evamarthānkariṣyaṃti kaṃ yāṃti śaraṇaṃ prajāḥ || 42 || evamukte guhenātha dharmo vacanamabravīt || satyametadyadarho'yaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgamaḥ || 43 || mukhyatvaṃ sarvatīrthānāmarghaṃ cāpi pitāmahāt || kiṃtu nātmaguṇā vācyāḥ satāmetatsadā vratam || parokṣepi svapraśaṃsā brahmāṇamapi cālayet || 44 || svapraśaṃsāṃ prakurvāṇaḥ parākṣepasamanvitām || kiṃ divaḥ pṛthivīṃ pūrvaṃ yayātirna papāta ha || yāni pūrvaṃ pramāṇāni kṛtānīśena dhīmatā ||45|| tāni sampālanīyāni tāni ko'ti kramedbudhaḥ || tava pitrā samādiśya yadarthaṃ sthāpitā vayam || 46 || pālayāmāsa etacca tvaṃ pālayitumarhasi || īśvarāḥ svapramāṇena bhavaṃto yadi kurvate || 47 || tadasmābhiridaṃ yuktaṃ śāsanaṃ diśyatāṃ param || evamuktvā svīyamudrāṃ moktukāmaṃ vṛṣaṃ tadā ||48|| ahaṃ prastāvamanvīkṣya vākyametadudairayam|| namo dharmāya mahate viśvadhātre mahātmane || 49|| brahmaviṣṇuśivairnityaṃ pūjitāyāghanāśine || yadi mudrāṃ bhavāndharma parityakṣyati karhicit || 1.2.58.50 || tadasmākaṃ kuto bhāvo mā viśvaṃ nāśaya prabho || yogīśvaraṃ guhaṃ cāpi saṃmānayitumarhasi || 51 || śivavanmānanīyo hi yataḥ sākṣācchivātmajaḥ || tvāṃ ca devo guhaḥ svāmī saṃmānayitumarhati||52|| yuvayoraikyabhāvena sukhaṃ jīvedidaṃ jagat || tvayā pradattaḥ śāpo'yaṃ mā pratyākhyātilakṣaṇaḥ||53|| anugrahaśca kriyatāṃ tīrtharājasya mānada||54|| evamuccaramāṇaṃ māṃ praśasyāhāpi padmabhūḥ|| sādhvetannāradenoktaṃ dharmaitadvacanaṃ kuru|| 55 || sammānaya guhaṃ cāpi guhaḥ svāmī yato hi naḥ|| evamukte brahmaṇā ca dharmo vacanamabravīt|| 56 || namo guhāya siddhāya kiṃkarāyasya te vayam|| madīyāṃ skanda vijñaptiṃ nāthaināmavadhāraya ||57|| staṃbhādetanmahātīrthamaprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || staṃbhatīrthamiti khyātaṃ suprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ||58 || stambhatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam || yaścātra snānadānāni prakariṣyati mānavaḥ || 59 || yathoktaṃ ca phalaṃ tasya sphuṭaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati || śanivāre hyamāvāsyā bhavettasyāḥ phalaṃ ca yat || 1.2.58.60 || mahīsāgarayātrāyāṃ bhavettaccāvadhāraya || prabhāsadaśayātrābhiḥ saptabhiḥ puṣkarasya ca || 61 || aṣṭābhiśca prayāgasya tatphalaṃ prabhaviṣyati || paṃcabhiḥ kurukṣetrasya nakulīśasya ca tribhiḥ || 62 || arbudasya ca yatṣaḍbhistatphalaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || vastrāpathasya tisṛbhirgaṃgāyāḥ paṃcabhiśca yat || 63 || kūpodaryāścaturbhiśca tatphalaṃ prabhaviṣyati || kāśyāḥ ṣaḍbhistathā yatsyādgodāvaryāśca paṃcabhiḥ || 64 || tatphalaṃ staṃbhatīrthe vai śanidarśe bhaviṣyati || evaṃ datte vare skaṃdastadā prītamanābhavat || 65 || brahmāpi staṃbhatīrthāya dadāvarghaṃ samāhitaḥ || dadau ca sarvatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhatvamamitadyutiḥ || 66 || tīrthāni ca guhaṃ nāthaṃ sammānya visasarja saḥ || evametatpurā vṛttaṃ guptakṣetrasya kāraṇam || 67 || bhūyaścāpi prasiddhyarthaṃ preṣitāpsaraso'tra me || vimokṣitā grāharūpāttvayā tāśca kurūdvaha || 68 || yato dharmasya sarvasya nānārūpaiḥ pravartataḥ || paritrāṇāya bhavataḥ kṛṣṇasya ca bhavo bhave ||69|| tadidaṃ varṇitaṃ tubhyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ mahat || śrutvaitadāditaḥ pūrvaṃ pumānpāpaiḥ pramucyate ||1.2.58.70|| || sūta uvāca || || śrutveti vijayo dhīmānpraśaśaṃsa suvismitaḥ || visṛṣṭo nāradādyaiśca dvārakāṃ prati jagmivān ||71|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe mahīsāgaramāhātmyavarṇane'rjunatīrthayātrāparisamāptivarṇanaṃnāmaṣṭapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
<1.2.59>
|| śaunaka uvāca || || atyadbhutamidaṃ sūta guptakṣetrasya pāvanam || mahanmāhātmyamatulaṃ kīrtitaṃ harṣavardhanam || 1 || punaryatsiddhaliṃgasya pūrvaṃ māhātmyakīrtane || ityuktaṃ yatprasādena siddhamātustu setsyati || 2 || vijayonāma puṇyātmā sāhāyyāccaṃḍilasya ca || ko nvasau caṃḍilonāma vijayonāma kastathā|| || 3 || kathaṃ ca prāptavānsiddhiṃ siddhamātuḥ prasādataḥ || etadācakṣva tattvena śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ ||4|| satāṃ caritraśravaṇe kautukaṃ kasya no bhavet || || || ugraśravā uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭamidaṃ viprā dūrāṃtaritamapyuta || 5 || śrutā dvaipāyanamukhātkathāṃ vakṣyāmi cātra vaḥ || purā drupadarājasya putrīmāsādya pāṃḍavāḥ || 6 || dhṛtarāṣṭramate paścādiṃdraprasthaṃ nyaveśayan || rakṣitā vāsudevena kadācittatra pāṃḍavāḥ ||7|| upaviṣṭāḥ sabhāmadhye kathāścakruḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || devarṣipitṛbhūtānāṃ rājñāṃ cāpi prakīrtane || 8 || kriyamāṇe'tha tatrāgādbhīmaputro ghaṭotkacaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraḥ paṃca vāsudevaśca vīryavān || 9 || utthāya sahasā pīṭhādāliliṃgurmudā yutāḥ || sa ca tānpraṇataḥ prahvo vavaṃde bhīmanaṃdanaḥ || 1.2.59.10 || sāśiṣaṃ ca tato rājñā svotsaṃga upaveśitaḥ || āghrāya snehato mūrdhni proktaśca janasaṃsadi || 11 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || kuta āgamyate putra kva cāyaṃ vihṛtastvayā || kālaḥ kvacitsukhaṃ rājyaṃ kuruṣe mātulaṃ tava || 12 || kaściddeveṣu vipreṣu goṣu sādhuṣu sarvadā || haiḍaṃbe nāpakuruṣe priyametaddhareśca naḥ || 13 || heḍaṃbasya vanaṃ sarvaṃ tasya ye sainyarākṣasāḥ || pālyamānāstvayā sādho vardhaṃte janakṣemakāḥ || 14 || kaccinnaṃdati te mātā bhṛśaṃ naḥ priyakāriṇī || kanyaiva yā purā bhīmaṃ tyaktvā mānaṃ patiṃ śritā || 15 || iti pṛṣṭo dharmarājñā smayanhaiḍaṃbirabravīt || hate tasmindurācāre mātule'smi niyojitaḥ || 16 || tadrājyaṃ śāsane sthāpya duṣṭānnighnaṃścarāmyaham || mātā kuśalinī devī tapo divyamupāśritā || 17 || māmuvāca sadā putra pitṝṇāṃ bhaktikṛdbhava || so'haṃ māturvacaḥ śrutvā merupādātsamāgataḥ || 18 || praṇāmāyaiva bhavatāṃ bhaktiprahveṇa cetasā || ātmānaṃ ca mahatyarthe kasmiṃścittu niyojitam || bhavadbhirahamicchāmi phalaṃ yasmādidaṃ mahat || 19 || yadājñāpālanaṃ putraḥ pitṝṇāṃ sarvadā caret || athorddhvalokānsa jayediha jāyeta kīrtimān || 1.2.59.20 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ rājā parirabhya punaḥpunaḥ || uvāca dharmarāṭ putramānaṃdāśruḥ sagadgadam || 21 || tvameva no bhaktikārī sahāyaścāpi vartase || 22 || etadarthaṃ ca haiḍaṃbe putrānicchaṃti sādhavaḥ || ihāmutra tārayaṃte tādṛśāścāpi putrakāḥ || 23 || avaśyaṃ yādṛśī mātā tādṛśastanayo bhavet || mātā ca te bhaktimatī dṛḍhaṃ nastvaṃ ca tādṛśaḥ || 24 || aho suduṣkaraṃ devī kurute me priyā vadhūḥ || yā bhartṛśriyamullaṃghya tapa eva samāśritā || 25 || nūnaṃ kāmena bhogairvā kṛtyaṃ vadhvā na me manāk || yā putrasukhamanvīkṣya paralokārthamāśritā || 26 || duṣkulīnāpi yā bhaktā sūte'patyaṃ ca bhaktimat || kulīnameva tanmanye mamedaṃ matamuttamam ||27|| evaṃ bahūni vākyāni tāni tāni vadannṛpaḥ || dharmarājaḥ samābhāṣya keśavaṃ vākyamabravīt || 28 || puṃḍarīkākṣa jānāsi yathā bhīmādabhūdayam || jātamātrastu yaścāsīdyauvanastho mahābalaḥ || 29 || aṣṭānāṃ devayonīnāṃ yato janma ca yauvanam || sadya eva bhavettasmātsadyo'syāsīcca yauvanam || || 1.2.59.30 || tadasyocitadārārthe sadā ciṃtāsti kṛṣṇa me || ucitaṃ bata haiḍaṃbeḥ kva kalatraṃ karomyaham || 31 || tadbhavānkṛṣṇasarvajña trilokīmapi vetsi ca || haiḍaṃberucitā dārānvaktumarhasi yādava || 32 || || sūta uvāca || || evamukto dharmarājñā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā janārdanaḥ || dharmarājamidaṃ vākyaṃ padāṃtaritamabravīt || 33 || asti rājanpravakṣyāmi dārānasyocitāṃ śubhām || sāṃprataṃ saṃsthitā ramye prāgjyotiṣapure vare || 34 || sā ca putrī muroḥ pārtha daityasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ || yo'sau narakadaityasya prāṇatulyaḥ sakhā'bhavat || 35 || sa ca me nihato ghoraḥ pāśadurgasamanvitaḥ || narakaśca durācārastvametadvetsi sarvaśaḥ || 36 || tato hate murau daitye mayā tasya sutāvrajat || yoddhuṃ māmativīryatvādghorā kāmakaṭaṃkaṭā || 37 || tāṃ tato'haṃ mahāyuddhe khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīm || ayodhayaṃ mahābāṇaiḥ suśārṅgadhanuṣaścyutaiḥ || 38 || khaḍgena ciccheda bāṇānmama sā ca muroḥ sutā || samāgamya ca khaḍgena garuḍaṃ mūrdhnyatāḍayat || 39 || sa ca mohasamāviṣṭo garuḍo'bhūdacetanaḥ || tatastasyā vadhārthāya mayā cakraṃ samudyatam || 1.2.59.40 || cakraṃ samudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā tasminraṇājire || kāmākhyā nāma māṃ devī puraḥ sthitvā vaco'bravīt || 41 || naināṃ haṃtuṃ bhavānarho rakṣaitāṃ puruṣottama || ajeyatvaṃ mayā hyasyā dattaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca kheṭakam || 42 || buddhirapratimā cāpi śaktiśca paramā raṇe || tatastvayā trirātre'pi na jitāsīnmuroḥ sutā || 43 || evamukte tadā devīṃ vacanaṃ cāhamabravam || ayameṣa nivṛtto'smi vārayaināṃ ca tvaṃ śubhe || 44 || tataścāliṃgya tāṃ bhaktāṃ kāmākhyā vākyamabravīt || bhadre raṇānnivartasva nāyaṃ haṃtuṃ kathaṃcana ||45|| śakyaḥ kenāpi samare mādhavo raṇadurjayaḥ || nābhūdasti bhaviṣyo vā ya enaṃ saṃyuge jayet ||46|| api vā tryaṃbakaḥ putri nainaṃ śaktaḥ kuto'nyakaḥ || tasmādenaṃ namaskṛtya bhāvinaṃ śvaśuraṃ śubhe || 47 || raṇādasmānnivartasva tavocitamidaṃ sphuṭam || asya bhrāturhi bhīmasya snuṣā tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi || 48 || tasmāttvaṃ śvaśuraṃ bhadre sammānaya janārdanam || na ca śokastvayā kāryaḥ pitaraṃ prati paṃḍite || 49 || jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruva janma mṛtasya ca || bahavaścā'sya vettāro vada kenāpi vāryate || 1.2.59.50 || ṛṣīṃśca devāṃśca mahāsurāṃśca traividyavidyānpuruṣānnṛpāṃśca || kānmṛtyureko na pateta kāle parāvarajño'tra na muhyate kvacit || 51 || ślāghya eva hi te mṛtyuḥ piturasmājjanārdṛnāt || sarvapātakanirmukto gato'sau dhāma vaiṣṇavam || 52 || evaṃ kāmākhyayā proktā sā ca kāmakaṭaṃkaṭā || tyaktvā krodhaṃ ca saṃvṛtya gātrāṇi praṇatā ca mām || 53 || tāmahaṃ sāśiṣaṃ cāpi prāvocaṃ bharatarṣabha || asminneva pure tiṣṭha bhagadattaprapūjitā || 54 || mayā devyā pṛthivyā ca bhagadattaḥ kṛto nṛpaḥ || sa te pūjāṃ bahuvidhāṃ kariṣyati svasuryathā || 55 || vasaṃtī cātra taṃ vīraṃ haiḍiṃbaṃ patimāpsyasi || evamāśvāsya tāṃ devīṃ maurvīṃ cāhaṃ vyasarjayam || 56 || sā sthitā ca pure tatra gato'haṃ śakrasadma ca || tato dvāravatīṃ prāpya tvayā saha samāgataḥ || 57 || evameṣocitā dārā haiḍaṃbervidyate śubhā || kāmākhye ca raṇe ghorā yā vidyudiva bhāsate || 58 || na ca rūpaṃ varṇitaṃ me śvaśurasyocitaṃ yataḥ || sādhorhi naitaducitaṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ pravarṇanam || 59 || punarekaśca samayaḥ kṛtastaṃ śṛṇu yastayā || yo māṃ niruttarāṃ praśne kṛtvaiva vijayetpumān || 1.2.59.60 || yo me pratibalaścāpi sa me bhartā bhaviṣyati || evaṃ ca samayaṃ śrutvā bahavo daityarākṣasāḥ || 61 || tasyā jayārthamagamaṃste'pi jitvā hatāstayā || yo ya enāṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ na sa bhūyo nyavartata || 62 || vahneriva prabhāṃ dīptāṃ pataṃgānāṃ samuccayaḥ || evametādṛśīṃ maurvīṃ jetumutsahate yadi || 63 || ghaṭotkaco mahāvīryo bhāryāsya niyataṃ bhavet || 64 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || alaṃ sarvaguṇaistasyā yasyāstveko guṇo mahān || kriyate kiṃ hi kṣīreṇa yadi tadviṣamiśritam || 65 || prāṇādhikaṃ bhaimaseniṃ kathaṃ kevalasāhasāt || kṣipeyaṃ tava vākyānāṃ śuddhānāṃ cātha kovidam || 66 || anyā api striyaḥ saṃti deśe deśe janārdana || bahvyastāsāṃ varāṃ kāṃcidyoṣitaṃ vaktumarhasi ||67|| || bhīma uvāca || || samyaguktaṃ keśavena vākyaṃ bahvarthamuttamam || rājñā punaḥ snehavaśādyaduktaṃ tanna bhāti me || 68 || kārye duḥsādhya eva syātkṣatriyasya parākramaḥ || karīṃdrasyeva yūtheṣu gajānāṃ na mṛgeṣu ca || 69 || ātmā prakhyātimāneyaḥ sarvathā vīrapuṃgavaiḥ || sā ca khyātiḥ kathaṃ jāyedduḥsādhyakaraṇādṛte || 1.2.59.70 || na hyātmavaśagaṃ pārtha haiḍaṃberasya rakṣaṇam || yena dattastvayaṃ dhātrā sa enaṃ pālayiṣyati || 71 || sarvathoccapadārohe yatnaḥ kāryo vijānatā || tanna sidhyati ceddaivānnāsau doṣo vijānataḥ || 72 || yathā devavratastveko jahre kāśisutāḥ purā || tathaika eva haiḍaṃbirmaurvīṃ prāpnotu mā ciram || 73 || || arjuna uvāca || || kevalaṃ pauruṣaparaṃ bhīmenoktamidaṃ vacaḥ || abalaṃ daivahetutvātprabalaṃ pratibhāti me || 74 || na mṛṣā hi vaco brūte kāmākhyā yā purā'bravīt || bhīmasenasutaḥ pāṇiṃ tava bhadre grahīṣyati || 75 || anena hetunā yātu śīghraṃ tatra ghaṭotkacaḥ || iti me rocate kṛṣṇa tava kiṃ brūhi rocate || 76 || || kṛṣṇa uvāca || || rocate me vacastubhyaṃ bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ || na hi tulyo bhaimasenerbuddhau vīrye ca kaścana || 77 || aṃtarātmā ca me vetti prāptāmeva muroḥ sutām || tacchīghraṃ yātu haiḍaṃbistvaṃ ca kiṃ putra manyase || 78 || || ghaṭotkaca uvāca || || na hi nyāyyāḥ svakā vaktuṃ pūjyānāmagrato guṇāḥ || pravṛttā eva bhāsaṃte sadguṇāśca raveḥ karāḥ || 79 || sarvathā tatkariṣyāmi pitaro yena me'malāḥ || lajjiṣyaṃti na saṃsatsu mayā putreṇa pāṃḍavāḥ||1.2.59.80|| evamuktvā mahābāhurutthāya praṇanāma tān || jayāśīrbhiśca pitṛbhirvarddhito gaṃtumaicchata ||81|| taṃ gatukāmamāhedamabhinaṃdya janārdanaḥ || kathākathanakāle māṃ smarethāstvaṃ jayāvaham ||82|| yathā buddhiṃ sudurbhedyāṃ vardhayāmi balaṃ ca te || ityuktvāliṃgya taṃ kṛṣṇo vyasasarjata sāśiṣam || 83 || tato hiḍaṃbātanayo mahaujāḥ sūryākṣakālākṣamahodarānugaḥ || viyatpathaṃ prāpya jagāma tatpuraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ nāma dinavyapāye || 84 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe barbarikopā khyāne ghaṭotkacasya prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati gamanavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
<1.2.60>
|| sūta uvāca || || so'tha prāgjyotiṣādbāhye mahopavanasaṃsthitam || sahasrabhūmikaṃ gehamapaśyata hiraṇmayam || 1 || veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṃgānāṃ niḥsvanaiḥ paripūritam || daśasāhasrasaṃkhyābhiśceṭībhiḥ paripūritam || 2 || āyādbhiḥ pratiyādbhiśca bhagadattasya kiṃkaraiḥ || kimicchantīti bhaginī pṛcchakairabhipūritam || 3 || tadāsādya sa haiḍaṃbirmeroḥ śikharavadgraham || dvāri sthitāṃ saṃdadarśa karṇaprāvaraṇāṃ sakhīm || 4 || tāmāha lalitaṃ vīro bhadre sā kva muroḥ sutā || kāmuko draṣṭumicchāmi dūradeśāgato'tithiḥ || 5 || || karṇaprāvaraṇovāca || || kiṃ tavāsti mahābāho tayā maurvyā prayojanam || koṭiśo nihatāḥ pūrvaṃ tayā kāmuka kāmukāḥ || 6 || tava rūpamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā ghaṭahāsaṃ sadotkacam || praṇamya pādayorvīra sthitā te vacanaṃkarī || 7 || tanmayā saha modasva bhuṃkṣva bhogāṃśca kāmuka || dāsyāmyanucarāṇāṃ te trayāṇāṃ ca priyātrayam || 8 || || ghaṭotkaca uvāca || || kalyāṇi kiṃvadaṃtī te pramuktā svocitā śubhe || punarnaitadvacastubhyaṃ viśate mama cetasi || 9 || vāmaḥ kāmo yato bhadre yasminnupanibaddhyate || sa cātra naiva badhnāti tadvayaṃ ki prakurmahe || 1.2.60.10 || adya te svāminī dṛṣṭā jitā vā krīḍate mayā || tayā vā vijito yāsye pūrveṣāṃ kāmināṃ gatim || 11 || karṇaprāvaraṇe tasmācchīghrameva nivedyatām || yathā darśanamātreṇa pūjayaṃtyatithiṃ khalu || 12 || iti bhaimervacaḥ śrutvā praskhalaṃtī niśācarī || prāsādaśikharasthāṃ tāṃ maurvīmevaṃ vacovadat || 13 || devi ko'pi yuvā śrīmāṃstrailokyeṣvamitaprabhaḥ || kāmātithistava dvāri vartate diśa tatparam || 14 || || kāmakaṭaṃkaṭovāca || || mucyatāṃ śīghramevāsau kimarthaṃ vā vilaṃbase || kadāciddevasaṃgatyā samayo me'bhipūryate || 15 || ityuktavacanācceṭī prāpyāvocadghaṭotkacam || vraja śīghraṃ kāmuka tvaṃ tasyā mṛtyośca sannidhau || 16 || ityuktaḥ sa prahasyaiva tatrotsṛjya svakānugān || praviveśa gṛhaṃ bhaimiḥ siṃho meruguhāmiva || 17 || sa paśyañchukasaṃghātānpārāvatagaṇāṃstathā || sārikāśca madonmattāśceṭīstāṃ cāpyapaśyata || 18 || rūpeṇa vayasaḥ caiva raterapi ratiṃkarīm || āṃdolakasukhāsīnāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām || 19 || tāṃ vidyutamivonnaddhāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaimiraciṃtayata || aho kṛṣṇena pitrā me nirdiṣṭeyaṃ mamocitā || 1.2.60.20 || nyāyyametatkṛte pūrvaṃ naṣṭā yatkāmināṃ gaṇāḥ || śarīrakṣayaparyāptaṃ kṣīyate yadi kāminām || 21 || kāminīnāṃ kṛte yeṣāṃ kṣīyate gaṇanātra kā || evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ kāmī ciṃtayannāha bhīmabhūḥ || 22 || niṣṭhure vajrahṛdaye prāpto'hamatithistava || ucitāṃ tatsatāṃ pūjāṃ kuru yā te hṛdi sthitā || 23 || iti haiḍaṃbivacanaṃ śrutvā kāmakaṭaṃkaṭā || vismitābhūttasya rūpātsvaṃ niniṃda ca bāliśam || 24 || dhigahaṃ yanmayā pūrvaṃ samayaḥ sa kṛto'bhavat || na kṛto'bhūdyadi purā abhaviṣyadasau patiḥ || 25 || iti saṃcintayantī sā bhaimiṃ vacanamabravīt || vṛthā tvamāgato bhadra jīvanyāhi punaḥ sukhī || 26 || atha kāmayase māṃ tvaṃ tatkathāṃ śīghramuccara || kathāmābhāṣya yadi māṃ sandehe pātayiṣyasi || tato'haṃ vaśagā jātā hato vā svapsyase mayā || 27 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktavacanāmetāṃ netropāṃtena vīkṣya saḥ||28|| smṛtvā carācaraguruṃ kṛṣṇamārabdhavānkathām || kasyāṃcidabhavatpatnyāṃ yuvā ko'pyajitedriyaḥ ||29|| tasya caikā sutā jajñe bhāryā tasya mṛtā'bhavat || tato bālakikāṃ putrīṃ rarakṣa ca pupoṣa ca || 1.2.60.30 || sā yadābhūdyauvanagā vyaṃjitāvayavā śubhā || prollasatkucamadhyāṃgī prollasanmukhapaṃkajā || 31 || tadāsya kāmalulitamālānaṃ prajahau manaḥ || provāca tāṃ ca tanayāṃ samāliṃgya durāśayaḥ || 32 || prātiveśmakaputrī tvaṃ mayānīyātra poṣitā || bhāryārthaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ tatkāryaṃ sādhaya priye || 33 || ityuktā sā ca mene ca tattathaiva vacastadā || patitvena ca bheje taṃ bhāryātvena sa tāṃ tathā || 34 || tatastasyāṃ sutā jajñe tasmānmadanarāsabhāt || vada sā tasya bhavati kiṃ dauhitrī sutā'thavā || enaṃ praśnaṃ mama brūhi śīghraṃ cecchaktirasti te || 35 || || sūta uvāca || || iti praśnaṃ sā ca śrutvā ciṃtayadbahudhā hṛdi || 36 || na ca paśyati nirddhāraṃ praśnasyāsya kathaṃcana || tataḥ praśnena vijitā svāṃ śaktiṃ samupādade || 37 || atāḍayadrukmarajjuṃ karābhyāṃ dolakasya ca || tato rakṣāṃsi niṣpetuḥ koṭiśo bhīṣaṇānyati || 38 || siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca mahiṣāścitrakā mṛgāḥ || samīkṣya tānasaṃkhyeyānkhādituṃ dhāvato ruṣā || 39 || avādayannakhau bhaimiḥ kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhajau hasan || tato viniḥsṛtāstatra dviguṇā rākṣasādayaḥ || 1.2.60.40 || tairmaurvīnirmitāḥ sarve kṣaṇādeva sma bhakṣitāḥ || vijitāyāṃ svaśaktau ca balaśaktimathādade || 41 || utthāya sahasā dolātkhaḍgamādātumaicchata || uttiṣṭhaṃtīṃ ca tāṃ bhaimiranusṛtya javādiva || 42 || keśeṣvādāya savyena pāṇinā'pātayadbhuvi || tataḥ kaṃṭhe savyapādaṃ dattvādāya ca kartikām ||43|| dakṣiṇena kareṇāsyāśchettumaicchata nāsikām|| visphuraṃtī tato maurvī maṃdamāha ghaṭotkacam ||44|| praśnena śaktyā ca balena nātha tridhā tvayāhaṃ vijitā namaste || tanmuṃca māṃ karmakarī tavāsmi samādiśa tvaṃ prakaromi tacca || 45 || || ghaṭotkaca uvāca || || yadyevaṃ tarhi muktāsi bhūyo darśaya yadbalam || evamuktvā mumocaināṃ muktā cāha praṇamya sā || 46 || jānāmi tvāṃ mahābāho vīraṃ śaktimatāṃ varam || sarvarākṣasabhartāraṃ trailokye'mitavikramam || 47 || guhyakādhipatistvaṃ hi kālanābha iti smṛtaḥ || ṣaṣṭikoṭipatirjāto yakṣarakṣākṛte bhuvi || 48 || iti māṃ prāha kāmākhyā sarvaṃ tatsaṃsmarāmyaham || idaṃ gehaṃ sānugaṃ me dattaṃ mayātmanā tava || 49 || samādiśa prāṇanātha kamādeśaṃ karomi te || || ghaṭotkaca uvāca || || pracchannastasya ghaṭate na vivāhaḥ kathaṃcana || 1.2.60.50 || morvi yasya hi vartaṃte pitarau bāṃdhavāstathā || tanmāṃ śīghraṃ vaha śubhe śakraprasthāya saṃprati || 51 || ayaṃ kulakramo'smākaṃ yadbhāryā patimudvahet || tatrānujñāṃ samāsādya pariṇeṣyāmi tvāmaham || 52 || bhagadattamatho nāthaṃ tato maurvī nyavedayat || samādāya bahudravyaṃ visasarjātha bhrātaram || 53 || tataḥ pṛṣṭhiṃ samāropya ghaṭotkacamaniṃditā || nānādravyaparīvārā śakraprasthaṃ samāvrajat || 54 || tato'sau vāsudevena pāṃḍavaiścābhinaṃditaḥ || śubhe lagne pāṇimasyā jagṛhe bhīmanaṃdanaḥ || 55 || kurūṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca proktottamavidhānataḥ || udvāhya tāṃ taddhanaiśca tarpayāmāsa pāṃḍavān || 56 || kuṃtī ca draupadī cobhe mumudāte nitāṃtataḥ || maṃgalānyasya cakrāte maurvyāśca dhana tarpite || 57 || tato vivāhe nirvṛtte pratipūjya ghaṭotkacam || bhāryayā sahitaṃ rājā svarājyāya samādiśat || 58 || maurvyā''jñāṃ śirasā gṛhya haiḍaṃbirbhāryayānvitaḥ || śubhaṃ hiḍambasya vane svarājyaṃ samupāvrajat ||59|| tato rākṣasayoṣābhirvīrakāṃsyaiḥ pravardhitaḥ|| mahotsavena mahatā svarājye pramumoda saḥ ||1.2.60.60|| tato vaneṣu citreṣu nimnagāpulineṣu ca || reme saha tayā bhaimirmaṃdodaryeva rāvaṇaḥ || 61 || evaṃ vikrīḍatastasya garbho jajñe mahādyuteḥ|| heḍaṃbai rākṣasavyāghrādbālasūryasamaprabhaḥ || 62 || sa jātamātro vavṛdhe kṣaṇādyauvanago'bhavat || nīlameghacayaprakhyo ghaṭāsyo dīrghalocanaḥ || 63 || ūrdhvakeśaścordhvaromā pitarau praṇato'bravīt || praṇamāmi yuvāṃ cobhau jātasya pitarau gurū || 64 || bhavatorhi priyaṃ kṛtvā anṛṇaḥ syāṃ sadā hyaham || bhavadbhyāṃ dattamicchāmi abhidhānaṃ yathātmanaḥ||65|| ataḥ paraṃ tu yacchreyaṃ kartavyaṃ pronnatipradam|| tato bhemistamāliṃgya putraṃ vacanamabravīt ||66|| barbarākārakeśatvādbarbarīkābhidho bhavān || bhaviṣyati mahābāho kulasyānandavardhanaḥ || 67 || śreyaśca te yatparamaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca tatkīrtyate bahudhā vipra mukhyaiḥ || prakṣyāvahe tadyaduvaṃśanāthaṃ gatvā purīṃ dvārakāṃ vāsudevam || 68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe barbarīkotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
<1.2.61>
|| sūta uvāca || || tato ghaṭotkaco muktvā tatra kāmakaṭaṃkaṭām|| putreṇānugato dhīmānviyatā dvārakāṃ yayau || 1 || āgacchantaṃ ca taṃdṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṃ rākṣasānugam || dvārakāvāsino yodhāścakruratyulbaṇaṃ ravam || 2 || grāme grāme susaṃnaddhā navalakṣamitā rathāḥ || rākṣasau dvau samāyātau pātyetāṃ viśikhairiti || 3 || tāngṛhītāyudhāndṛṣṭvā yaduvīrānghaṭotkacaḥ || pragṛhya vipulaṃ bāhuṃ jagau tārasvareṇa saḥ || 4 || rākṣasaṃ vitta māṃ vīrā bhīmaputraṃ ghaṭotkacam || supriyaṃ vāsudevasya praṇāmārthamupāgatam || 5 || nivedayata māṃ prāptaṃ yādavendrāya sātmajam || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā te kṛṣṇāya nyavedayan || 6 || āha devaḥ sabhāsthaśca śīghramatrāvrajatvasau || tataḥ praveśayāmāsurdvārakāṃ te ghaṭotkacam || 7 || saputraḥ so'pi ramyāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca || krīḍāśailāṃśca harmyāṇi saṃpaśyannāgataḥ sabhām ||8|| sa tatra ugrasenaṃ ca vasudevaṃ ca sātyakim || akrūrarāmapramukhānvavande kṛṣṇameva ca || 9 || taṃ pādayornipatitaṃ samāliṃgya sahātmajam || sāśiṣaṃ svasamīpasthamupaveśyedamabravīt || 1.2.61.10 || putra rākṣasaśārdūla kurūṇāṃ kulavardhana || kuśalaṃ sarvataḥ kaccitkimarthaste samāgamaḥ || || 11 || || ghaṭotkaca uvāca || || deva yuṣmatprasādena sarvataḥ kuśalaṃ mama || śrūyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ svāminyadarthamahamāgataḥ || 12 || devopadiṣṭa bhāryāyāṃ jāto'yaṃ tanayo mama || sa ca praśnaṃ vakṣyati tvāṃ śrūyatāmāgatastvataḥ || 13 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || vatsa maurveya brūhi tvaṃ sarvaṃ pṛccha yadicchasi || yathā ghaṭotkaco mahyaṃ supriyaśca tathā bhavān || 14 || || barbarīka uvāca || || praṇamya tvāmādidevaṃ manobuddhisamādhibhiḥ || prakṣyāmi kena śreyaḥ syājjaṃtorjātasya mādhava || 15 || kecicchreyo dharmamāhuraiśvaryaṃ tyāgabhojanam || keciddamaṃ tapo dravyaṃ bhogānmuktiṃ ca kecana || 16 || tadevaṃ śatasaṃkhyeṣu śreyassu puruṣottama || mama caivaṃ kulasyāsya śreyo yadbrūhi niścitam || 17 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || vatsa pṛthakpṛthakproktaṃ varṇānāṃ śreya uttamam || brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo mūlaṃ damo'dhyayanameva ca || 18 || dharmaprakaṭanaṃ cāpi śreya uktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || balaṃ sādhyaṃ pūrva meva kṣatriyāṇāṃ prakīrtitam || 19 || duṣṭānāṃ śāsanaṃ cāpi sādhūnāṃ paripālanam || pāśupālyaṃ ca vaiśyānāṃ kṛṣirvijñānameva ca || 1.2.61.20 || śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā tayā jīvanvaṇigbhavet || śilpairvā vividhairjīveddvijātihitamācaran || 21 || bhāryāratirbhṛtyapoṣṭā śuciḥ śraddhā parāyaṇaḥ || namaskāreṇa mantreṇa paṃcayajñānna hāpayet || 22 || tadbhavānkṣatriyakule jāto'si kuru tacchṛṇu || balaṃ sādhaya pūrvaṃ tvamatulaṃ tena śikṣaya || 23 || duṣṭānpālaya sādhūṃśca svargamevamavāpsyasi || balaṃ ca labhyate putra devīnāṃ suprasādataḥ || 24 || tadbhavānbalaprāptyarthaṃ devyārādhanamācara || 25 || || barbarīka uvāca || || kasminkṣetre ca kāṃ devīṃ kathamārādhayāmyaham || etatprasādapravaṇaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā nivedaya || 26 || || sūta uvāca || || iti pṛṣṭaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāha dāmodaro vibhuḥ || vatsa kṣetraṃ pravakṣyāmi yatra tapsyasi tattapaḥ || guptakṣetramiti khyātaṃ mahīsāgarasaṃgame || 27 || tatra tribhuvane yāśca saṃti devyaḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ || nāradena samānītāstāścaikyaṃ sumahātmanā || 28 || catasrastasya digdevyo nava durgāśca saṃti yāḥ || samārādhaya tā gatvā tāsāmaikyaṃ hi durlabham || 29 || nityaṃ pūjaya tāḥ putra puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ || stutibhiścopahāraiśca yathā tuṣyati tāstava || 1.2.61.30 || tuṣṭāsu devīṣu balaṃ dhanaṃ ca kīrtiśca putrāḥ subhagāśca dārāḥ || svargastathā muktipadaṃ ca satsukhaṃ na durlabhaṃ satyametattavoktam || 31 || || sūta uvāca || || evamuktvā barbarīkaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prāha ghaṭotkacam || ghaṭotkacārya putraste dṛḍhaṃ suhṛdayo hyasau || 32 || tasmātsuhṛdayetyevaṃ dattaṃ nāma mayā dvikam || evamuktvā samāliṃgya saṃtarjya vividhairdhanaiḥ || 33 || guptakṣetrāya bhagavānbarbarīkaṃ samādiśat || so'tha kṛṣṇaṃ namaskṛtya pitaraṃ yādavāṃśca tān || 34 || anujñāpya ca tānsarvānguptakṣetraṃ samāvrajat || ghaṭotkaco'pi kṛṣṇena visṛṣṭaḥ svavanaṃ yayau || 35 || smaranputraguṇānpatnyā svarājyaṃ samapālayat || tataḥ suhṛdayo dhīmāndagdhasthalyāṃ kṛtāśramaḥ || 36 || trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsa devīḥ karmasamādhibhiḥ || nityaṃ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca upahāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 37 || tasyārādhayato devyastutuṣurhāyanaistribhiḥ || tataḥ pratyakṣato bhūtvā balāttasya mahātmanaḥ || 38 || balaṃ yattriṣu lokeṣu kasyacinnāsti durlabham || ūcuśca kaṃcitkālaṃ tvaṃ vasātraiva mahādyute || 39 || saṃgatyā vijayasya tvaṃ bhūyaḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi || ityuktaḥ sarvadevībhiḥ sa tatraiva vyavasthitaḥ ||1.2.61.40 || ājagāmātha vijayo nāmnā māgadhabrāhmaṇaḥ || sa sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā pādākrāṃtāṃ dvijottamaḥ || 41 || kāśyāṃ vidyābalaṃ prāpya sādhanārthamupāyayau || guheśvaramukhānyeṣa saptaliṃgānyapūjayat || ||42|| ārādhayāmāsa ciraṃ devīrvidyāphalāptaye|| tatastuṣṭāstasya devyaḥ svapne procuridaṃ vacaḥ||43|| vidyāṃ sādhaya tvaṃ sādho siddhamātuḥ puroṃ'gaṇe || ayaṃ bhaktaḥ suhṛdayaḥ sāhāyyaṃ te kariṣyati || 44 || tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā vijayaḥ svapnamadhyataḥ || utthāya gatvā devyāstaṃ vavre bhīmātma jātmajam || 45 || so'pi devīvacaḥ śrutvā mene sāhāyyakāraṇam || tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmupoṣya vijayaḥ śuciḥ || 46 || snātvābhyarcyaiva liṃgāni devīścaivārcayatpṛthak || kṛtvā snānamupoṣyaiva barbarīkoṃ'tike'bhavat || 47 || prathamāyāṃ tato rātrau yayau siddhāṃbikāpuraḥ || maṃḍalaṃ tatra kṛtvā ca bhagākāraṃ karānnava || 48 || aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭakīlāṃśca nikhanyaiva sasūtrakān || kṛṣṇājinadharo bhūtvā barbarīkasamanvitaḥ || 49 || śikhāmābaddhya digbaṃdhaṃ kṛtvā rebhe tato vidhim || madhye vai maṃḍalasyāpi kuṃḍe śubhre trimekhalaṃ || 1.2.61.50 || samarpya ca tataḥ khaḍgaṃ khādiraṃ maṃtratejitam || saṃsthāpya kīlānabhito barbarīkamathābravīt || 51 || śucirvinidraḥ saṃtiṣṭha stavaṃ devyāḥ samudgiran || yāvatkarma karomyeṣa yathā vighnaṃ na jāyate || 52 || ityukte saṃsthite tatra barbarīke mahābale || vijayaḥ śoṣaṇaṃ dāhaṃ plāvanaṃ kṛtavānyamī || 53 || tataḥ sukhāsano bhūtvā guṃgurubhyo namaḥ iti || maṃtramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā gurubhyaḥ praṇamya ca || tato gaṇeśvaravidhānamārabdhavān || 54 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi maṃtraṃ gaṇapateḥ param || 55 || sarvakāryakaraṃ svalpaṃ mahārthaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 56 || oṃgāṃgīṃgūṃgaiṃgauṃgaḥ saptākṣaro'yaṃ mahāmaṃtraḥ || oṃgaṇapatimaṃtrasya gaṇako nāma ṛṣiḥ vighneśvaro devatā gaṃ bījam oṃśaktiḥ pūjārthe japārthe vā tilakārthe vā manasa īpsitārthe homārthe vā viniyoga iti || sādha kasya pūrvaṃ tilakakaraṇam || oṃgāṃgaṇapataye namaḥ || iti tilakasyopari akṣatāndadyāt anena mantreṇa || oṃ gāṃgaṇapataye namaḥ || iti tilakamaṃtraḥ || oṃgāṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ || anena maṃtreṇa gaṇeśāya puṣpāṃjalitrayaṃ dadyāt || mūlamaṃtreṇātra caṃdanagaṃdhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyapūgīphala tāṃbūlādikaṃ dadyāt || ata ūrdhvaṃ mūlamantreṇa japaṃ kuryāt || aṣṭottaraśataṃ sahasraṃ lakṣaṃ koṭiṃ ceti yathāśakti japtvā daśāṃśahomārthe gaṇeśāgnaye āvāhayāmīti agnimāvāhya || oṃ gāṃ gaṇapataye svāheti mantreṇa guggulaguṭikābhirhomaṃ vidadhyādviniyogaṃ ceti gāṇeśvaro tā(?)kalpaḥ || ya evaṃ sarva vighneṣu sādhayenmantramuttamam || sarvavighnāni naśyaṃti manobhīṣṭaṃ ca sidhyati || 57 || ḍākinyo yātudhānāśca pretādyāśca bhayaṃkarāḥ || śatrūṇāṃ jāyate nāśo vaśīkaraṇameva ca || 58 || imaṃ gāṇeśvaraṃ kalpaṃ vijānanvijayo'pi ca || tilakaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā japtvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 59 || daśāṃśaṃ guṭikā hutvā pūjya siddhivināyakam || siddheyakṣetrapālasya cakre pūjāṃ tato niśi || 1.2.61.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe mahāvidyāsādhane gāṇeśvarakalpavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||
<1.2.62>
|| śaunaka uvāca || || sūta śrutā purāsmābhirutpattirgaṇapasya ca || kṣetranāthaḥ kathaṃ jajñe vadaitacchṛṇvatāṃ hi naḥ || 1 || || sūta uvāca || || yadā dārukadaityena pīḍyamānā divaukasaḥ || śivaṃ devyā sahāsīnaṃ praṇipatyedamabruvan || 2 || deva daityena ghoreṇa durjayena surāsuraiḥ || pīḍitā dārukeṇa smaḥ svasthānāccāpi cyāvitāḥ || 3 || na viṣṇunā na caṃdreṇa na cānyenāpi kenacit || śakyo haṃtuṃ sa duṣṭātmā ardhanārīśvaraṃ vinā || 4 || tena saṃpīḍyamānānāmasmākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava || ityuktvā rurudurdevāstrāhitrāhīti cābruvan || 5 || tato'tikṛpayāviṣṭaharakaṃṭhasya kālimām || gṛhītvā pārvatī cakre nārīmekāṃ mahābhayām || 6 || ātmaśaktiṃ tatra muktvā provācedaṃ vacaḥ śubhā || yasmādatīva kālāsi nāmnā tvaṃ kālikā bhava || 7 || devāriṃ ca durātmānaṃ śīghraṃ nāśaya śobhane || evamuktā mahārāvā kālikā prāpya taṃ tadā || 8 || raveṇaiva mṛtaṃ cakre sānugaṃ sphuṭitahṛdam || tatovantī śmaśānasthā mahārāvānamuṃcata || 9 || yairāsanvikalā lokāstrayo'pi pramṛtā yathā || tato rudro bālarūpaṃ kṛtvā viśvakṛte vibhuḥ || 1.2.62.10 || rudaṃstasyāḥ samīpe cāpyāgataḥ pretasadmani || rudaṃtaṃ ca tato bālaṃ kṛtvotsaṃge kṛpānvitā || 11 || kālikā'pāyayatstanyaṃ mā rudeti prajalpatī || stanya vyājena bālo'pi papau krodhaṃ tadaṃgajam || 12 || yo'sau harakaṃṭhabhavaviṣādāsītsudurdharaḥ || pītakrodhasvabhāve ca saumyāsītkālikā tadā || 13 || bālo'pi bālarūpaṃ tattyaktumaicchatkṛtakrihayāḥ || 14 || tato devāḥ kālikāyāḥ śaṃkamānāḥ punarbhayam || ūcurmā bāla bālatvaṃ parityaja kṛpāṃ kuru || 15 || || bāla uvāca || || na bhetavyaṃ kālikāyāḥ saumyā devī yataḥ kṛtā || asti cedbhavatāṃ bhītiranyānsrakṣyāmi bālakān || catuḥṣaṣṭikṣetrapālānityuktvā so'sṛjanmukhāt || 16 || prāha tānbālarūpāṃśca bālarūpī maheśvaraḥ || svargeṣu paṃcaviśānāṃ pātāleṣu ca tāvatām || 17 || caturdaśānāṃ bhūrloke vāso vaḥ pālanaṃ tathā || ayameva śmaśānastho bhavitā śvā ca vāhanam || 18 || naivedyaṃ bhavatāṃ rājamāṣataṃdulamiśrakāḥ || anabhyarcya ca yo yuṣmānkiṃcitkṛtyaṃ vidhāsyati || 19 || tasya tanniṣphalaṃ bhāvi bhuktaṃ pretaiśca rākṣasaiḥ || ityuktvā bhagavānrudrastatraivāṃ taradhīyata || 1.2.62.20 || kṣetrapālāḥ sthitāścaiva yathāsthāne nirūpitāḥ || iti vaḥ kṣetrapālānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ proktā samāsataḥ || 21 || ārādhanaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena prītā bhavaṃti te || 22 || oṃkṣāṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ || iti navākṣaro mahāmaṃtraḥ ||23|| anenātra caṃdanādi dattvā rājamāṣataṇḍulamiśrakāśca catuḥṣaṣṭikṛtabhāgānvaṭakānnivedya tāvatyo dīpikāstāvanti patrāṇi pūgāni nivedya daṇḍavatpraṇamya mahāstutimetāṃ japet || 24 || oṃūrdhvakeśā virū pākṣā nityaṃ ye ghorarūpiṇaḥ || raktanetrāśca piṃgākṣāḥ kṣetrapālānnamāmi tān || 25 || ahvaro hyāpakumbhaśca iḍācārastathaiva yaḥ || iṃdramūrtiśca kolākṣa upapāda ṛtuṃsanaḥ || 26 || siddheyaścaiva valiko nīlapādekadaṃṣṭrikaḥ || irāpatiścāghahārī vighnahārī tathāṃtakaḥ || 27 || ūrdhvapādaḥ kambalaśca khaṃjanaḥ khara eva ca || gomukhaścaiva jaṃghālo gaṇanāthaśca vāraṇaḥ || 28 || jaṭālopyajaṭālaśca naumi svaḥkṣetrapālakān || ṛkāro haṭhakārī ca ṭaṃkapāṇiḥ khaṇistathā || 29 || ṭhaṃṭhaṃkaṇo jaṃbaraśca sphuliṃgāsyastaḍidruciḥ || daṃturo ghananādaśca nandakaśca tathā paraḥ || 1.2.62.30 || phetkārakārī paṃcāsyo barbarī bhīmarūpavān || bhagnapakṣaḥ kālamegho yuvāno bhāskarastathā || 31 || rauravaścāpi laṃboṣṭho vaṇijaḥ sujaṭālikaḥ || sugaṃdho huhukaścaiva naumi pātālarakṣakān || 32 || sarvaliṃgeṣu huṃkāraḥ smaśāneṣu bhayāvahaḥ || mahālakṣo vane ghore jvālākṣo vasatau sthitaḥ || 33 || ekavṛkṣaśca vṛkṣeṣu karālavadano niśi || ghaṇṭāravo guhāvāsī padmakhaṃjo jale sthitaḥ || 34 || catvareṣu durārohaḥ parvate kuravastathā || nirjhareṣu pravāhākhyo māṇibhadro nidhiṣvapi || 35 || rasakṣetre rasādhyakṣo yajñavāṭeṣu koṭanaḥ || caturdaśa bhuvaṃ vyāpya sthitāścaivaṃ namāmi tān || 36 || evaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭimitāñcharaṇaṃ yāmi kṣetrapān || prasīdaṃtu prasīdaṃtu tṛpyaṃtu mama pūjayā || 37 || sarvakāryeṣu yaścaivaṃ kṣetrapānarcayecchuciḥ || kṣetrapāstasya tuṣyaṃti yacchaṃti ca samīhitam || 38 || imaṃ kṣetrapakalpaṃ ca vijānanvijayastathā || yathoktavidhinābhyarcya siddheyaṃ tuṣṭuve ca tam || 39 || praṇamya ca tato devīmānarca vaṭayakṣiṇīm || purā yadā nāradena kalāpagrāmato dvijāḥ || 1.2.62.40 || samānītāstaiśca sākaṃ sunaṃdā nāma brāhmaṇī || vidhavābhyāgatā tatra tapastaptuṃ mahītaṭe || 41 || sā kṛcchrāṇi parākāṃśca atikṛcchrāṇi kurvatī || jyaiṣṭhe bhādrapade cakre sāvitryā dve trirātrike || 42 || māsopavāsaṃ ca tathā kārtike kulanaṃdinī || saptaliṃgāni saṃpūjya devīpūjāṃ sadā vyadhāt || 43 || darśe snānaṃ tathā cakre mahīsāgarasaṃgame || ityādibahubhistaistairnityaṃ niyamapālanaiḥ || 44 || dhūtapāpā yayau lokamumāyāḥ kṛtasvāgatā || aṃśena ca taṭe tasminsaṃbhūtā vaṭayakṣiṇī || 45 || tasyāstuṣṭo varaṃ prādātsiddhaliṃgasthito haraḥ || anabhyarcya ya enāṃ ca matpūjāṃ prakariṣyati || 46 || tasya tanniṣphalaṃ sarvamityuktaṃ pālyameva me || tasmātprapūjayennityaṃ vaṭasthāṃ vaṭayakṣiṇīm || puṣpairdhūpaistu naivedyairmaṃtreṇānena bhaktitaḥ || 47 || sunaṃde naṃdanīyāsi pūjāmetāṃ gṛhāṇa me || prasīd sarvakāleṣu mama tvaṃ vaṭayakṣiṇi || 48 || evaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ natvā kṣamāpya vaṭayakṣiṇīm || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti naro nārī ca sarvadā || 49 || vijayaścāpi māhātmyamidaṃ jānanmahāmatiḥ || ānarca vaṭavṛkṣasthāṃ bhaktito vaṭayakṣiṇīm || 1.2.62.50 || tataḥ siddhāṃbikāṃ stutvā japtavānaparājitām || mahāvidyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ tu sādhanena samanvitām || 51 || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvaduḥkhakṣayo bhavet || tāṃ vidyāṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ viprapuṃgavāḥ || 52 || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya namo'naṃtāya sahasraśīrṣāya kṣīrodārṇavaśāyine śeṣabhogaparyaṃkāya garuḍavāhanāya pītavāsase vāsudeva saṃkarṣaṇa pradyumnāniruddha hayaśiro varāha narasiṃha vāmana trivikrama rāma rāma varaprada namo'stu te namo' stute asuradaityadānavayakṣarākṣasa bhūtapretapiśācakuṃbhāṃḍa siddhayoginī ḍākinī yasyāḥ kākavaṃdhyā ca yā bhavet || dhārayeta imāṃ vidyāmebhirdoṣairna lipyate ||57 || raṇe rājakule dyūte nityaṃ tasya jayo bhavet || śastra dhārayate hyeṣāṃ samare kāṃḍadhāriṇī || 58 || sādhanena vināpi ca || tasyāpi sarvavighnāni naśyaṃti dvijapuṃgavāḥ || 62 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe barbarikopākhyāne <1.2.63>
|| sūta uvāca || || aśvatthalākṣāvahnau ca sarṣapānkesaraplutān || juhvato maṃtramukhyaiśca balātibalasaṃjñakaiḥ || 1 || yāme tu prathame yāte kācinnārī samāyayau || śoṇitāktaikavasanā mahoccordhvaśiroruhā || 2 || dāruṇākṣī śukladantī bhayasyāpi bhayaṃkarī || sā ruroda mahārāvaṃ prāpya tāṃ homabhūmikām || 3 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cukṣubhe sadyo vijayo bhītimāniva || barbarīkaśca nirbhītistasyāḥ saṃmukhamāyayau || 4 || tataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ samāśliṣya tasyā matimatāṃ varaḥ || ruroda dviguṇaṃ vīro meghavannādayanbahu || 5 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitā sā ca yāvanmuṃcati kartikām|| tāvanniṣpīḍite kaṃṭhe moktuṃ tasminna cāśakat||6|| pīḍyamāne ca balinā kaṃṭhe tasyā muhurmuhuḥ|| mumuoca vividhāñchabdānvajrāhata ivācalaḥ || 7 || kṣaṇaṃ rāvāṃstato muktvā trāhi muñceti vaktyaṇu || tataḥ kṛpālunā muktā pādayoḥ patitā'bravīt || 8 || śaraṇaṃ te prapannāsmi dāsī karmakarī tava || mahājihveti māṃ viddhi rākṣasīṃ kāmarūpiṇīm || 9 || kāśīśmaśānanilayāṃ devadānavadarpahām || dadāsi yadi me vīra durlabhāṃ prāṇadakṣiṇām || 1.2.63.10 || tatastapaścariṣyāmi sarvabhūtābhayapradā || asminnarthe svadevasya śapathā me tathātmanaḥ || 11 || yadyetadvyatyayaṃ kuryāṃ bhasmībhūyāṃ tataḥ kṣaṇam || evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ vīro nigṛhya śapathairdṛḍham || 12 || mumoca sāpi saṃhṛṣṭā kṛcchrānmuktā yayau vanam || so'pi vīraḥ khaṅgadhārī tatraivāvasthito'bhavat || 13 || tato madhyamarātrau ca garjitaṃ śrūyate mahat || andhakāraṃ ca saṃjajñe tamoṃ'dhanarakaprabham || 14 || dadṛśe ca tataḥ śailaḥ śataśṛṃgo'tivistaraḥ || nānāśilāḥ pramumuce nānāvṛkṣāṃśca socchrayān || 15 || nānānirjhara saṃghoṣaṃ vavṛṣe śoṇitaṃ vahu || taṃ tathā nagamālokya nirbhīto bhaiminaṃdanaḥ || 16 || parvato dviguṇo bhūtvā parvataṃ sahasāplutaḥ || tadābhijaghne saṃhṛtya parvataṃ svena bhūbhṛtā || 17 || tadā viśīrṇaḥ so'bhūcca parvato bhūmimaṃḍale || tato yojanadehātmā śataśīrṣaḥ śatodaraḥ || 18 || vaktrairmuṃcanmahājvālāṃ repalendro'bhyadhāvata || taṃ dhāvamānaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva barbarīko mahābalaḥ || 19 || vidhāya tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ nardantaṃ cāpyadhāvata || tato madhyamarātrau tī laghu citraṃ ca suṣṭhu ca || 1.2.63.20 || yuyudhāte bāṇajālairyathā prāvṛṣi toyadau || chinnacāpau ca khaṅgābhyāṃ chinnakhaḍgau ca muṣṭibhiḥ || || 21 || parvatāviva satpakṣau ciraṃ yuyudhatuḥ sthiram || tataḥ kakṣe samutpāṭya bhrāmayitvā muhūrtakam || 22 || bhūmau pradharṣayāmāsa prasṛtaṃ ca mumoca ha || cikṣepa cāgnikoṇe taṃ mahīsāgararodhasi || 23 || taddūre repalendrākhyaṃ grāmamadyāpi vartate || evaṃ sa repalonāma vṛtratulyaparākramaḥ || 24 || nāthaḥ śmaśānasyāvantyā vighnakṛnnihato'bhavat || taṃ nihatya punarvīro barbarīkaḥ sthito'bhavat || 25 || tatastṛtīyayāme ca pratīcyā diśa āyayau || parvatābhā mahānādā pādaiḥ kampayatīva bhūḥ || 26 || duhadruhākhyāśvatarī meghabhraṣṭā taḍidyathā || tāmāyāṃtīṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā sūryavaiśvānaraprabhām || 27 || upasṛtya javādbhaimī ruroha prahasanniva || vegāttataḥ pradravatīṃ tuṇḍe prāhatya muṣṭibhiḥ || 28 || sthāpayāmāsa tatraiva tasthau sā cātipīḍitā || tataḥ kruddhā mahārāvaṃ kṛtvāplutya duhadruhā || 29 || jagatyāmāśu cikṣepa barbarīkaṃ tathecchakam || tato naditvā cātīva pādaghātamamuṃcata || 1.2.63.30 || pādau ca vīraḥ saṃgṛhya cikṣepa bhuvi līlayā || tataḥ punaḥ samutthāya dhāvaṃtīṃ tāṃ nigṛhya saḥ || || 31 || muṣṭinā pātayitvaiva daṃtānkaṃṭhamapīḍayat || klinnaṃ vāsa ivāpīḍya prāṇānatyājayaddrutam || 32 || evaṃ sīkottarasthāne smaśānaikapado dbhavā || śākinīnāmadhīśā sā barbarīkeṇa sūditā || 33 || hatvā tāṃ cāpi cikṣepa pratīcyāmeva līlayā || duhadruhākhyamadyāpi tatra grāmaṃ sma vartate || 34 || tatastathaiva saṃtasthau barbarīko'bhirakṣaṇe || tataścaturthe yāme ca prāptaḥ kṣapaṇako'dbhutaḥ || 35 || muṃḍī nagno mayūrāṇāṃ picchadhārī mahāvrataḥ || provāca cedaṃ vacanaṃ hāhā kaṣṭamatīva bhoḥ || 36 || ahiṃsā paramo dharmastadagnirjvālyate kutaḥ || hūyamāne yato vahnau sūkṣmajīvavadho mahān || 37 || śrutvedaṃ vacanaṃ tasya barbarīko'bravītsmayan || vadane sarvadevānāṃ hūyamāne sma pāvake || 38 || anṛtaṃ bhāṣase pāpa śikṣāyogyo'si durmate || ityuktvā sahasotpatya kakṣāmadhye sthiro'sya ca || 39 || dantānmuṣṭiprahāraiśca samāhatyābhyapātayat || rudhirāvilavaktraṃ taṃ mumoca patitaṃ bhuvi || 1.2.63.40 || sa kṣaṇāccetanāṃ prāpya ghoradaityavapurdharaḥ || bhayādbhaimeḥ pradudrāva guhāvivaramāviśat || 41 || bahuprabheti nagarī ṣaṣṭiyojanamāyatā || tasyāṃ viveśa sahasā taṃ cānu barbarīkakaḥ || 42 || barbarīkaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā nādo'bhūcca palāśinām || dhāvadhvaṃ hanyatāmeṣa chidyatāṃ bhidyatāmiti || 43 || tacchrutvā daityavīrāṇāṃ koṭayo nava bhīṣaṇāḥ || nānāyudhadharā vīraṃ barbarīkamupādravan || 44 || dṛṣṭvā tānkoṭiśo daityānkruddho bhīmātmajātmajaḥ || nimīlya sahasā netre teṣāṃ madhyamadhāvata || 45 || pādaghātaistataḥ kāṃścidbhujāghātaistathāparān || hṛdayasyābhighātaiśca kṣaṇānninye yamakṣayam || 46 || yathā nalavanaṃ krruddhaḥ kuryādbhūmisamaṃ karī || navakoṭīstathā jaghne saha tena palāśinā || 47 || tato nāgāḥ samāgamya vāsukipramukhāstadā || tuṣṭuburvividhairvākyairūcuḥ suhṛdayaṃ ca te || 48 || nāgānāṃ paramaṃ kṛtyaṃ kṛtaṃ te bhaiminaṃdana || palāśīnāma daityoyaṃ nīto yatsānugo yamam || || 49 || anena hi vayaṃ vīra sānugena durātmanā || pīḍitā vividhopāyaiḥ pātālādapyadhaḥ kṛtāḥ || 1.2.63.50 || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ tasmānnāgebhyo'bhimataṃ param || varadāḥ sarva eva sma vayaṃ tubhyaṃ sutoṣitāḥ || 51 || || suhṛdaya uvāca || || yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ tadenaṃ pravṛṇomyaham || sarvavighnavinirmukto vijayaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt || 52 || tatastatheti taṃ procuḥ prahṛṣṭā vāyubhojanāḥ || sa ca tebhyaḥ purīṃ dattvā nivṛtto nāgapūjitaḥ || 53 || vivarasya ca madhyena samāgacchanmahāprabham || sarvaratnamayaṃ liṃgaṃ sthitaṃ kalpataroradhaḥ || 54 || arcyamānaṃ suvahnībhirnāgakanyābhiraikṣata || tato'sau vismayāviṣṭo nāgakanyā hyapṛcchata || 55 || kenedaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sūryavaiśvānaraprabham || liṃgādapi caturdikṣu mārgāśceme tu kīdṛśāḥ || 56 || iti vīravacaḥ śrutvā bṛhatkaṭipayodharā || savrīḍaṃ sasmitāpāṃganirmokṣamidamabravīt || 57 || sarvapannagarājena śeṣeṇa sumahātmanā || tapa staptvā mahāliṃgamidamatra pratiṣṭhitam || 58 || darśanātsparśanāddhyānādarcanātsarvasiddhidam || liṃgātpūrveṇa mārgoyaṃ yāti śrīparvataṃ bhuvi || 59 || elāpatreṇa vihito nāgānāṃ tatra prāptaye || dakṣiṇena ca mārgo'yaṃ yāti śūrpārakaṃ bhuvi ||1.2.63.60|| karkoṭakena nāgena kṛto'yaṃ tatra prāptaye || paścimena ca mārgo'yaṃ prabhāsaṃ yāti suprabham ||61|| airāvatena vihito nāgānāṃ gamanāya ca || uttareṇa ca mārgoyaṃ yena yātuṃ bhavānsthitaḥ||62|| guptakṣetre siddhaliṃgaṃ yāti śaktiguhā''kṛtaḥ || vihitastakṣakeṇāsau yātuṃ tatra mahātmanā ||63|| itīdaṃ varṇitaṃ vīra vijñaptiḥ śrūyatāṃ mama|| ko bhavānadhunaiveto daityapṛṣṭha gato'bhavat || adhunaiva tathaikākī samāyāto'tra no vada ||64|| vayaṃ ca sarvāste dāsyastvāṃ patiṃ pravṛṇīmahe || asmābhiḥ sahitaḥ krīḍa vividhāsvatra bhūmiṣu || 65 || || barbarīka uvāca || || ahaṃ kurukulotpannaḥ pāṃḍuputrasya pautrakaḥ || barbarīka iti khyātastaṃ daityaṃ haṃtumāgataḥ || 66 || sa ca daityo hataḥ pāpaḥ punaryāsye mahītalam || bhavatībhiśca me nāsti kṛtyaṃ bhobhoḥ kathaṃcana || 67 || brahmacārivrataṃ yasmādahaṃ satatamāsthitaḥ || ityuktvābhyarcya talliṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca daṇḍavat || 68 || ūrdhvamācakrame vīraḥ kātaraṃ tābhirīkṣitaḥ|| tato bahiḥ samāgatya saprakāśaṃ mukhaṃ tadā ||69|| praharṣeṇaiva pūrvasyā vijayaṃ dadṛśe diśaḥ || tasminkāle ca vijayaḥ karma sarvaṃ samāptavān || 1.2.63.70 || kāṃtyā sūryasamābhāsa ūrdhvamācakrame kṣaṇāt || tato viyadgataṃ devaiḥ puṣpavarṣamabhūnmahat || 71 || jagurgaṃdharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || vijayo barbarīkaṃ ca tato vacanamabravīt || 72 || tava prasādādvīreśa siddhiḥ prāptā mayātulā || ciraṃ jīva ciraṃ naṃda ciraṃ vasa ciraṃ jaya || 73 || ata eva hi sādhṛnāṃ saṃgamicchaṃti sādhavaḥ || auṣadhaṃ sarvadoṣāṇāṃ bhavetsatyaṃ gamo yataḥ || 74 || tvaṃ ca homasthitaṃ bhasma siṃdūrasadṛśaprabham || niḥśalyaṃ savivarakaṃ pūryamāṇaṃ gṛhāṇa ca || 75 || akṣayyametatsaṃgrāme prathamaṃ te pramuṃcataḥ || śatrūṇāṃ sthānakaṃ mṛtyordehaṃ dhvastaṃ kariṣyati || 76 || evaṃ sukhena vijayaḥ śatrūṇāṃ te bhaviṣyati || 77 || || barbarīka uvāca || || upakuryānnirākāṃkṣo yaḥ sa sādhuritīryate || sākāṃkṣamupakuryādyaḥ sādhutve tasya ko guṇaḥ || 78 || taddehi bhasma cānyasmai kenāpyartho na me'ṇvapi || prasādasumukhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vinā nānyadvṛṇomi te || 79 || || devā ūcuḥ || || kurūṇāṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca bhaviṣyati mahānraṇaḥ || tato bhūmisthitaṃ bhasma prāpsyaṃti yadi kauravāḥ || 1.2.63.80 || mahānanartho bhavitā pāṃḍavānāṃ tataḥ sphuṭam || tasmādgṛhāṇa tvaṃ bhasma sopi cakre tatho vacaḥ || 81 || devībhiḥ sahitā devāḥ saṃmānya vijayaṃ ca te || siddhaiśvaryaṃ dadustasmai siddhaseneti nāma ca || 82 || evaṃ sa vijayo vipraḥ siddhiṃ lebhe sudurlabhām || barbarīkaśca kṛtvaitaddevībhaktirato'vasat || 83 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe kāryasiddhivarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
<1.2.64>
evaṃ tatra sthite tīre devyārādhanatatpare || saptaliṃgārcanarate bhīmanandananandane || 1 || tataḥ kālena kenāpi pāṃḍavā dyūtanirjitāḥ || tatrājagmuśca kramatastīrthasnānakṛte bhuvam || 2 || prāgeva caṃḍikāṃ devīṃ kṣetrādīśānataḥ sthitām || āsedurmārgakhinnāste draupadīpaṃcamāstadā || 3 || tatraiva copaviṣṭo'bhūttadānīṃ caṃḍikāgaṇaḥ || barbarīkaśca tānvīrānsamāyātānapaśyata || 4 || paraṃ nāsau veda pāṇḍūnpāṇḍavāstaṃ ca no viduḥ || ājanma yasmānnaivābhūtpāṇḍūnāṃ cāsya saṃgamaḥ || 5 || tataḥ praviśya vai tasmindevīmāsādya pāṃḍavāḥ || piṃḍakādyaṃ tatra muktvā tṛṣā praikṣi jalaṃ tadā||6|| tato bhīmaḥ kuṇḍamadhyaṃ jalaṃ pātuṃ viveśa ha || praviśaṃtaṃ ca taṃ prāha yudhiṣṭhira idaṃ vacaḥ ||7|| uddhṛtya bhīma toyaṃ tvaṃ pādau prakṣālya bho bahiḥ || tataḥ pibā'nyathā doṣo mahāṃstvāmupapatsyate || 8 || etadrājño vaco bhīmastṛṣā vyākulalocanaḥ || aśrutvaiva viveśāsau kuṇḍamadhye jalecchayā || 9 || sa ca dṛṣṭvā jalaṃ pātuṃ tatraiva kṛtaniścayaḥ || mukhaṃ hastau ca caraṇau kṣālayāmāsa śuddhaye || 1.2.64.10 || yataḥ pītaṃ jalaṃ puṃsāmaprakṣālya ca yadbhavet || pretāḥ piśācāstadrūpaṃ saṃkramya prapibaṃti tat || 11 || evaṃ prakṣālayāne ca pādau tatra vṛkodare || uparisthastadā prāha satyaṃ suhṛdayo vacaḥ || 12 || durmate bhoḥ kimetattvaṃ kuruṣe pāpaniścayaḥ || devīkuṇḍe kṣālayasi mukhaṃ pādau karau ca yat || 13 || yato devī sadānena jalena snāpyate mayā || datra prakṣipaṃstoyaṃ malapāpānna bibhyasi || 14 || malāktatoyaṃ yannāma aspṛśyaṃ tannarairapi || kuto devaiśca tatpāpaṃ spṛśyate tattvato vada || 15 || śīghraṃ ca tvaṃ niḥsarāsmātkuṇḍādbhūtvā bahiḥ piba || yadyevaṃ pāpa mūḍho'si tīrtheṣu bhramase kutaḥ || 16 || || bhīma uvāca || || kimetadbhāṣase krūra paruṣaṃ rākṣasādhama || yatastoyāni jaṃtūnāmupabho gārthameva hi || 17 || tīrtheṣu kāryaṃ snānaṃ cetyuktaṃ munivarairapi || aṃgaprakṣālanaṃ snānamuktaṃ māṃ niṃdase kutaḥ || 18 || yadi na kriyate pānamaṃgaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || tatkimarthaṃ pūrtadharmāḥ kriyante dharmaśālibhiḥ || 19 || || suhṛdaya uvāca || || snātavyaṃ tīrthamukhyeṣu satyametanna saṃśayaḥ || careṣu kiṃ tu saṃviśya sthāvareṣu bahiḥ sthitaḥ || 1.2.64.20 || sthāvareṣvapi saṃviśya tanna snānaṃ vidhīyate || na yatra devasnānārthaṃ bhaktaiḥ saṃgṛhyate jalam ||21|| yacca hastaśatādūrdhvaṃ sarastatra vidhīyate || saṃveśe'pi kramaścāyaṃ pādau prakṣālya yadbahiḥ || 22 || tataḥ snānaṃ prakartavyamanyathā doṣa ucyate || kiṃ na śrutastvayā proktaḥ ślokaḥ padmabhuvā purā || 23 || malaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca śleṣma niṣṭhīnāśru ca || gaṃḍūṣāścaiva muñcati ye te brahmahaṇaiḥ samāḥ || 24 || tasmānniḥsara śīghraṃ tvaṃ yadyevamajitendriyaḥ || tatkimarthaṃ durācāra tīrtheṣvaṭasi bāliśa || 25 || yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam|| nirvikārāḥ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sa hi tīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 26 || || bhīma uvāca || || adharmo vāpi dharmo'stu nirgaṃtuṃ naiva śaknuyām || kṣudhā tṛṣā mayā nityaṃ vārituṃ naiva śakyate || 27 || || suhṛdaya uvāca || || jīvitārthe bhavānkasmātpāpaṃ prakurute vada || kiṃ na śrutastvayā ślokaḥ śibinā yaḥ samīritaḥ || 28 || muhūrtamapi jīveta naraḥ śuklena karmaṇā || na kalpamapi jīveta lokadvayavirodhinā || 29 || || bhīma uvāca || || kākāraveṇa te mahyaṃ karṇau badhiratāṃ gatau || pāsyāmyeva jalaṃ cātra kāmaṃ vilapa śuṣya vā || 1.2.64.30 || || suhṛdaya uvāca || || kṣatriyāṇāṃ kule jātastvahaṃ dharmābhirakṣiṇām || tasmātte pātakaṃ kartuṃ na dāsyāmi kathaṃcana || 31 || tadvarākātha śīghraṃ tvamasmātkuṃḍādviniḥsara ||32|| iṣṭakāśakalaiḥ śīghraṃ cūrṇayiṣye'nyathā śiraḥ || ityuktvā ceṣṭakāṃ gṛhya mumoca śirasaḥ prati || 33 || bhīmaśca vaṃcayitvā tāmutplutya bahirāvrajat || bhartsayaṃtau tataścobhāvanyonyaṃ bhīmavikramau || 34 || yuyudhāte pralaṃbābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ yuddhapāragau || vyūḍhoraskau dīrghabhujau niyuddhakuśalāvubhau || 35 || muṣṭibhiḥ pārṣṇighātaiśca jānubhiścābhijaghnatuḥ || tato muhūrtātkauravyaḥ paryahīyata pāṃḍavaḥ || 36 || hīyamānastato bhīma udyato'bhūtpunaḥ punaḥ || ahīyata tato'pyaṃga vavṛdhe barbarīkakaḥ || 37 || tato bhīmaṃ samutpāṭya barbarīko balādiva || niṣpipeṣa tataḥ kruddhastadadbhutamivābhavat || 38 || mūrchitaṃ caivamādāya visphurantaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || sāgarāya pracalitaḥ kṣeptuṃ tatra mahāṃbhasi || 39 || dadṛśuḥ pāṃḍavā naitaddevyā nayanayaṃtritāḥ || 1.2.64.40 || tathā gṛhīte kuruvīramukhye vīreṇa tenādbhutavikrameṇa || āścaryamāsīddivi devatānāṃ devībhirākāśatale nirīkṣya tam || 41 || sāgarasya tatastīre barbarīkaṃ gataṃ tadā || nirīkṣya bhagavānrudro viyatsthaḥ samabhāṣata || 42 || bhobho rākṣasaśārdūla barbarīka mahābala || muṃcainaṃ bharataśreṣṭhaṃ bhīmaṃ tava pitāmaham || 43 || ayaṃ hi tīrthayātrāyāṃ vicaranbhrātṛbhiryutaḥ || kṛṣṇayā cāpyadastīrthaṃ snātumevābhyupāyayau || 44 || sammānaṃ sarvathā tasmādarhaḥ kauravanaṃdanaḥ || apāpo vā sapāpo vā pūjya eva pitāmahaḥ || 45 || || sūta uvāca || || iti rudravacaḥ śrutvā sahasā taṃ vimucya saḥ || nyapatatpādayorhā dhikkaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ ca prāha saḥ || 46 || kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ ceti punaḥ punaravocata || śiraśca tāḍayansvīyaṃ ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ || 47 || taṃ tathā pariśocaṃtaṃ muhyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || bhīmasenaḥ samāliṃgya āghrāya ca vaco'bravīt || 48 || vayaṃ tvāṃ naiva jānīmastvaṃ cāsmāñjanmakālataḥ || atra vāsaśca te putra bhaimeḥ kṛṣṇācca saṃśrutaḥ || 49 || paraṃ no vismṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nānāduḥkhaiḥ pramuhyatām || duḥkhitānāṃ yataḥ sarvā smṛtirluptā bhavetsphuṭam || 1.2.64.50 || tadasmākamidaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvakālavidhānataḥ || mā śocastvaṃ ca tanaya na te doṣo'sti cāṇvapi || 51 || yataḥ sarvaḥ kṣatriyasya daṃḍyo vipathisaṃsthi taḥ || ātmāpidaṃḍyaḥ sādhūnāṃ pravṛttaḥ kupathādyadi || 52 || pitṛmātṛsuhṛdbhrātṛputrādīnāṃ kimucyate || atīva mama harṣo'yaṃ dhanyohaṃ pūrvajāśca me || || 53 || yasya tvīdṛśakaḥ pautro dharmajño dharmapālakaḥ || varārhastvaṃ praśaṃsārho bhavānyeṣāṃ satāṃ tathā || 54 || tasmācchokaṃ vihāyemaṃ svastho bhavi tumarhasi || 55 || barbarīka uvāca || || pāpaṃ māṃ tātatāta tvaṃ brahmaghnādapi kutsitam || apraśasyaṃ nārhasīha draṣṭuṃ spraṣṭumapi prabho || 56 || sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ procyate budhaiḥ || pitrorabhaktasya punarniṣkṛtirnaiva vidyate || 57 || tadyena dehena mayā tātatāto'bhipīḍitaḥ || tattvameva samutsrakṣye mahīsāgarasaṃgame || 58 || maivaṃ bhaveyamanyeṣu api janmasu pātakī || na māmasmādabhiprāyādarhaḥ ko'pi nivartitum || 59 || yatoṃ'śena vilupyeta prāyaścittānnivārakaḥ || evamuktvā samutplutya yayau caivārṇavaṃ balī || 1.2.64.60 || samudro'pi cakaṃpe ca kathamenaṃ nihanmyaham || tataḥ siddhāṃbikāyāśca devyastatra caturdaśa || 61 || samāliṃgya ca saṃsthāpya rudreṇa sahitā jaguḥ || ajñātavihite pāpe nāsti vīreṃdra kalmaṣam || 62 || śāstreṣūktamidaṃ vākyaṃ nānyathā kartumarhasi || amuṃ ca pṛṣṭhalagnaṃ tvaṃ paśya bhoḥ svaṃ pitāmaham || 63 || putraputreti bhāṣaṃtamanu tvā maraṇonmukham || adhunā cetsvakaṃ dehaṃ vīra tvaṃ parityakṣyasi || 64 || tatastyakṣyati bhīmo'pi pātakaṃ tanmahattava || evaṃ jñātvā dhāraya tvaṃ svaśarīraṃ mahāmate || 65 || atha cettyaktukāmastvaṃ tatrāpi vacanaṃ śṛṇu || svalpenaiva ca kālena kṛṣṇāddevakinaṃdanāt || 66 || dehapātastava proktastaṃ pratīkṣa yadīccha si || yato viṣṇukarādvatsa dehapāto viśiṣyate || 67 || tasmātpratīkṣa taṃ kālamasmākaṃ prārthitena ca || evamukto nivavṛte barbarīko'pi durmanāḥ || 68 || rudraṃ devīśca cāmuṃḍāṃ sopālaṃbhaṃ vaco'bravīt || tvameva devi jānāsi rakṣyate śārṅgadhanvinā || 69 || pāṃḍavā bhūmilābhārthe tatte kasmādupekṣitam || tvayā ca samupāgatya rakṣito'yaṃ vṛkodaraḥ || 1.2.64.70 || || devyuvāca || || ahaṃ ca rakṣayiṣyāmi svabhaktaṃ kṛṣṇamṛtyutaḥ || yasmācca caṃḍikākṛtye kṛto'nena mahāraṇaḥ || tasmāccaṃḍilanāmnāyaṃ viśvapūjyo bhaviṣyati || 71 || evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve devā devyastvadṛśyatām || bhīmo'pi taṃ samādāya pāṃḍubhyaḥ sarvamūcivān || 72 || vismitāḥ pāṃḍavāstaṃ ca pūjayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || yathoktavidhinā cakrustīrthasnānamataṃdritāḥ || 73 || bhīmopi yatra rudreṇa mokṣitastatra
