suprabham || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa bhīmeśvaramiti śrutam || 74 || jyeṣṭhamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || rātrau saṃpūjya bhīmeśaṃ janmapāpādvimucyate || 75 || yathaiva liṃgāni supūjitāni saptātra mukhyāni mahāphalāni || bhīmeśvaraṃ liṃgamidaṃ tathaiva samastapāpāpaharaṃ supūjyam || 76 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe bhīmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
<1.2.65>
|| sūta uvāca || || uṣitvā saptarātrāṇi tīrthesminbhrātṛbhiḥ saha || yudhiṣṭhiro mahātejā gamanāyopacakrame || 1 || prabhāte vimale snātvā devīrliṃgānyathārcya ca || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣetraṃ devīstotraṃ jajāpa saḥ || prayāṇakāleṣu sadā japyaṃ kṛṣṇena kīrtitam || 2 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || devi pūjye mahāśakte kṛṣṇasya bhagini priye || natvā tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 3 || saṃkarṣaṇābhayadāne kṛṣṇacchavisamaprabhe || ekānaṃśe mahādevi putravattrāhi māṃ śiva || 4 || tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagadavyaktarūpayā || iti matvā tvāṃ gato'smi śaraṇaṃ trāhi māṃ śubhe || 5 || kāryārambheṣu sarveṣu sānugena mayā tava || sva ātmā kalpito bhadre jñātvaitadanukaṃpyatāma || 6 || || sūta uvāca || || iti bruvāṇaṃ rājānaṃ śirobaddhājaliṃ tadā || vāyuputraḥ prahasyaiva sāsūyamidamabravīt || 7 || ye tvāṃ rājanvadaṃtyevaṃ sarvajño'yaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || vṛthaiva vacanaṃ teṣāṃ yatastvaṃ vetsi nāṇvapi || 8 || ko hi prajñāvatāṃ mukhyaḥ sarvaśāstravidāṃvaraḥ || strīṇāṃ śaraṇamāpadyedṛjurbuddhiryathā bhavān || 9 || yatastvameva vetsīdaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu kīrtyate || jaḍeyaṃ prakṛtirmūḍhā yayā saṃmohyate jagat || 1.2.65.10 || sacetanaṃ ca puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca vicetanām || prāhurbudhā narādhyakṣa puṃsaścaprakṛtiḥ priyā || 11 || tatsvayaṃ puruṣo bhūtvā yudhiṣṭhira vṛthāmate || prakṛtiṃ nauṣi natvā tāṃ hāso me'tīva jāyate || 12 || ārohayecchiro naiva kvaciddhitvā upānahau || yathā sa mūḍho bhavati devībhaktiratastathā || 13 || yadi te bandivatpārtha tiṣṭhedvāṇyanivāritā || tatkimarthaṃ mahādevaṃ na stauṣi tripurāntakam || 14 || alakṣyamiti vā matvā maheśānaṃ mahāmate || tataḥ kimartha dāśārhaṃ na stauṣi puruṣottamam || 15 || yasya prasādādasmābhiḥ prāptā drupadanaṃdinī || indraprasthe tathā rājyaṃ rājasūyastvayā kṛtaḥ || 16 || vijayena dhanurlabdhaṃ jarāsandho mayā hataḥ || pratyāhartuṃ tathecchāmaḥ kauravebhyaḥ svakāṃ śriyam || 17 || yasya prasādāttaṃ muktvā kṛṣṇaṃ hā stauṣi yajjayī || atha svayaṃ kauravāṇāmutpannaṃ kulasattame || 18 || jānannātmānamalpatvādbuddherna stauṣi yādavam || tatkimarthaṃ mahāvīryaṃ na stauṣyarjunamuttamam || 19 || yena viddhaṃ purā lakṣyaṃ yena karṇādayo jitāḥ || yena tatkhāṃḍavaṃ dagdhaṃ yajñe yena nṛpā jitāḥ || 1.2.65.20 || śrūyate yena vikramya maheśāno'pi nirjitaḥ || svarlokasaṃsthitasyāsya śaraṇaṃ yāhi stauṣi ca || 21 || athavā tena śakreṇa rājyaṃ me nārpitaṃ kutaḥ || iti matvā vṛthaiva tvaṃ na stauṣi bhrātaraṃ mama || 22 || tato māṃ vā kathaṃ vīraṃ na stauṣi tvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || yena tvaṃ rakṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ lākṣāgehāgnimadhyataḥ || 23 || vṛkṣeṇāhatya madreśo nadīṃ śuṣkāṃ prasāritaḥ || rājarājastathā yena jarāsaṃdho nipātitaḥ || 24 || pūrvā diṅnirjitā yena yena pūrvaṃ bako hataḥ || hiḍambaśca mahāvīraḥ kirmīraścādhunā vane ||25|| kālekāle ca rakṣāmi tvāmevāhaṃ sadānugaḥ || na tāṃ paśyāmi rakṣaṃtīṃ natvā yāṃ stauṣi bhārata||26|| atha kṣudhābalaṃ jñātvā māmaudarikasattamam|| krūraṃ sāhasikaṃ caiva na stauṣi kṣamiṇāṃ varaḥ||27|| tataḥ susaṃyato bhūtvā praṇavaṃ samudīrayan|| kathaṃ na yāsi mārge tvaṃ vṛthālāpo hi doṣabhāk||28|| pretāḥ piśācā rakṣāṃsi vṛthālāparataṃ naram || āviśaṃti tadāviṣṭo vaktābaddhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||29|| vṛthālāpī yadaśnāti yatkaroti śubhaṃ kvacit || pretāditṛptaye sarvamiti śāstraviniścayaḥ ||1.2.65.30|| nāyaṃ tasyāsti vai lokaḥ kuta eva paro bhavet || tasmādvijānatā yatnāttyājyameva vṛthā vacaḥ || 31 || evaṃ saṃsmārito'pi tvaṃ yadi bhūyaḥ pravartase || bhūtāviṣṭaścikitsyo no vividhairauṣadhairbhavān || 32 || || sūta uvāca || || iti pravarṇitāṃ śrutvā bhīmasenena bhāratīm || paṭīmiva pravitatāṃ vihasyāha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 33 || nūnaṃ tvamalpavijñāno vedādhītāstvayā vṛthā || mātaraṃ sarvabhūtānāmaṃbikāṃ yanna manyase || 34 || strīpakṣa iti matvā tāmavajānāsi bhoḥ katham || strī satī na praṇamyā kiṃ tvayā kuntī vṛkodara || 35 || yadi na syānmahāmāyā brahmaviṣṇuśivārcitā || tava dehodbhavaḥ pārtha kathaṃ syāttattvato vada || 36 || īśvaraḥ paramātmā tāṃ tyaktuṃ śaktaḥ kathaṃ na hi || punarbheje yato devīṃ tena manye mahorjitām || 37 || vāsudevo'pi nityaṃ tāṃ stauti śaktiṃ parātparām || ahaṃ yadi cikitsyaḥ syāṃ cikitsyaḥ so'pi kiṃ bhavān || 38 || naivaṃ bhūyaḥ pravaktavyaṃ maurkhyātprati maheśvarīm || bhūmau nipatya śaraṇaṃ yāhi cetsukhamicchasi || 39 || || bhīma uvāca || || sarvopāyairbodhayaṃti cāṭā hastagataṃ naram || idamevauṣadhaṃ tatra taiḥ sārdhaṃ jalpanaṃ na hi || 1.2.65.40 || muṇḍe muṇḍe matirbhinnā satyametannṛpa sphuṭam || svābhīṣṭaṃ kurute sarvaḥ kurmo'bhīṣṭaṃ vayaṃ tathā || 41 || nāgāyutasamaprāṇo vāyuputro vṛkodaraḥ || na striyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchedvāṅmātreṇa kathaṃcana || 42 || ityuktvā vacanaṃ bhīmo hyanuvavrāja taṃ nṛpam || rājāpi sānugo yāto na sādhviti muhurbruvan || 43 || tataḥ kṣaṇena vikalastvitaścetaśca praskhalat || uvāca vacanaṃ bhīmaḥ susaṃbhrāṃto nṛpaṃ prati || 44 || dharmarāja mahābuddhe paśya māṃ nṛpasattama || cakṣurbhyāṃ naiva paśyāmi vaikalyaṃ kimidaṃ mama || 45 || || rājovāca || bhīmabhīma dhruvaṃ devī kupitā te maheśvarī || tena naṣṭe cakṣuṣī te mahāsāhasavallabha || 46 || tatsāṃpratamabhipraihi śaraṇaṃ parameśvarīm || punaḥ prasannā te dadyātkadācinnayane punaḥ || 47 || || bhīma uvāca || || ahamapyaṃga jānāmi samo devyā na kaścana || prabhāvapratyayārthaṃ hi sadā nindāmi tāṃ punaḥ || 48 || tasmātprabhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ nipatya vasudhātale || manovāgbuddhibhirnatvā śaraṇaṃ staumi mātaram || 49 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || gatvaiva devyāḥ śaraṇaṃ bhīmastuṣṭāva mātaram || 1.2.65.50 || || bhīma uvāca || || sarvabhūtāṃbike devi brahmāṃḍaśatapūrake || bāliśaṃ bālakaṃ svīyaṃ trāhitrāhi namo'stu te || 51 || tvaṃ brāhmī brahmaṇaḥ śaktirvaiṣṇavī tvaṃ ca śāṃbhavī || trimūrtiḥ śaktirūpā tvaṃ rakṣarakṣa namo'stu te || 52 || tvamaindrī ca tvamāgneyī tvaṃ yāmyā tvaṃ ca nairṛtī || tvaṃ vāruṇī tvaṃ vāyavyā tvaṃ kauberī namo'stu te ||53 || aiśāni devi vārāhi nārasiṃhi jayaprade || kaumāri kulakalyāṇi kṛpeśvari namo'stu te || 54 || tvaṃ sūrye tvaṃ tathā some tvaṃ bhaume tvaṃ budhe gurau || tvaṃ śukre tvaṃ sthitā rāhau tvaṃ ketuṣu namo'stu te || 55 || vasasi dhruvacakre tvaṃ municakre ca te sthitiḥ || bhacakreṣu khacakreṣu bhūcakre ca namo'stu te || 56 || saptadvīpeṣu tvaṃ devi samudreṣu ca saptasu || saptasvapi ca pātāleṣvavasaṃsthe namo'stu te || 57 || tvaṃ devi cāvatāreṣu viṣṇoḥ sāhāyyakāriṇī || viṣṇunābhyarthyase tasmāttrāhi mātarnamo'stu te || 58 || caturbhuje caturvaktre phalade catvarapriye || carācarastute devi caraṇau praṇamāmi te || 59 || mahāghore kālarātri ghaṃṭāli vikaṭojvale || satataṃ saptamīpūjye netrade śaraṇaṃ bhava || 1.2.65.60 || meruvāsini piṃgākṣi netratrāṇaikakāriṇi || huṃhuṃkāradhvastadaitye śaraṇye śaraṇaṃ bhava || 61 || mahānāde mahāvīrye mahā mohavināśini || mahābandhāpahe devi dehi netratrayaṃ mama || 62 || sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalyā yadi tvaṃ satyatoṃbike || tato me maṃgalaṃ dehi netradānānnamostu te || 63 || yadi sarvakṛpālubhyaḥ satyatastvaṃ kṛpāvatī || tataḥ kṛpāṃ kuru mayi dehi netre namo'stu te || 64 || pāpoyamiti yaddevi prakupyasi vṛthaiva tat || tvaṃ māṃ mohayasi tvevaṃ na te tatkiṃ namo'stu te || 65 || svayamutpādya yo reṇuṃ veṣṭitastena kupyati || tathā kupyasi me mātaranāthasyāsya darśaya || 66 || iti stutā pāṃḍavena devī kṛṣṇacchavicchaviḥ || rāmā rāmābhivadanā pratyakṣā samajāyata || 67 || vidyutkoṭisamābhāsa mukuṭenātiśobhitā || sūryabiṃbaprabhābhyāṃ ca kuṇḍalābhyāṃ vibhūṣitā || 68 || pravāheneva hāreṇa suranadyā virājitā || kalpadrumaprasūnaiśca pūrṇāvataṃsamaṃḍitā| || 69 || dantendukāṃtividhvastabhaktamohamahābhayā || khaḍgacarmaśūlapātracaturbhujavirājitā || 1.2.65.70 || vāsasā taḍidābhena meghalekheva veṣṭitā || mālayā sumamālinyā bhrājitā sālimālayā || 71 || satāṃ śaraṇadābhyāṃ ca padbhyāṃ nūpurarājitā || jayeti puṣpavarṣaiśca śakrādyairabhipūjitā|| 72 || gaṇairdevībhirākīrṇā śatapadmairmahāmalaiḥ || tāṃ tādṛśīṃ vyomni dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ vyomavāhinīm || 73 || bhūmau nipatya rājeṃdro namonama iti sthitaḥ || bhīmopi mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā bālo'bhidhāvati || 74 || tathā sammukhamādhāvajjaya mātariti bruvan || darśanenaiva devyāśca śubhanetratrayastadā || 75 || praṇipatya namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ muhurjagau || prasīda devi padmākṣi punarmātaḥ prasīda me || 76 || punaḥ prasīda pāpasya kṣamāthīle prasīda me || 77 || evaṃ stutā bhagavatī svayamutthāya pārthivam || bhīmaṃ cotsaṃgamāropya kṛpayedaṃ vaco'bravīt || 78 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || yattvayābhihitaṃ stotraṃ tena tuṣṭā tavopari || ato netratrayaṃ dattaṃ dve bāhye cāṃtaraṃ param || 79 || nāhaṃ kopaṃ yatra tatra darśayāmi vṛkodara || tvaṃ tu pramāṇapuruṣastvattaḥ krodhamadarśayam || 1.2.65.80 || naitatpriyaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya bhrāturme krodhamācaram || bhavanto vāsudevasya yatra prāṇā bahiścarāḥ || 81 || tvaṃ ca nindasi māṃ nityaṃ tacca jāne vṛkodara || matprabhāvaparijñānahetave kīdṛśastviti || 83 || tadevaṃ naiva bhūyaste prakartavyaṃ kathaṃcana || akṣikṣepo hi pūjyānāmāvahatyadhikaṃ rujam || 84 || tadidānīṃ sarvamevaṃ kṣantavyaṃ ca parasparam || yacca bravīmi tvāṃ vīra tanniśāmaya bhārata || 85 || yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirāvirbhaveddhariḥ || tadātadāvatīryāhaṃ viṣṇorasya sahāyinī || 86 || idānīṃ ca harirjāto vasudevasuto bhuvi || ahaṃ ca gopanandasya ekānaṃśābhidhā sutā || 87 || tadyathā bhagavānkṛṣṇo mama bhrātābhipūjitaḥ || bhavanto'pi tathā mahyaṃ bhrātaraḥ pāṃḍavā sadā || 88 || ye bhīmabhaginītyevaṃ māṃ stoṣyaṃti narottamāḥ || ābādhā nāśayiṣyāmi teṣāṃ harṣasamanvitā || 89 || tvaṃ ca bhrāturjayaṃ vīra pradāsyasi mahāraṇe || bhujayoste vasiṣyāmi dhārtarāṣṭranipātane || 1.2.65.90 || kṛtvā rājyaṃ ca varṣāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśattadanantaram || mahāprasthānadharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ paricariṣyatha || 91 || asminneva tato deśe lohonāma mahāsuraḥ || bhavatāṃ nyastaśastrāṇāṃ vadhārthaṃ prakramiṣyati || 92 || tatastaṃ sarvabhūtānāmavadhyaṃ bhavatāṃ kṛte || andhaṃ kṛtvā pātayiṣye tato yūyaṃ prayāsyatha || 93 || nistīrya ca himaṃ sarvaṃ nimagnāḥ bālukārṇave || svargaṃ yāsyati rājaikaḥ saśarīro gamiṣyati || 94 || andho yatra kṛto loho lohāṇābhidhayā puram || bhaviṣyati ca tatraiva sthāsye'haṃ kalayā sadā ||95|| tataḥ kaliyuge prāpte kelo nāma bhaviṣyati || mama bhaktastasya nāmnā bhāvyā keleśvarītyaham || 96 || vailākaścāparo bhakto bhaviṣyati mamottamaḥ || tasyārādhanataḥ khyātiṃ prayāsyāmi kalau yuge || 97 || lohāṇāsaṃsthitāṃ caiva yercayiṣyaṃti māṃ janāḥ || śraddhayā sitasaptamyāṃ taiśca sarvatra pūjitā || 98 || aṃdhānāṃ ca pradāsyāmi bhāvīni nayanānyaham || tasmindine tarpitāhaṃ bhaktibhāvena pāṃḍava || 99 || pādāṃguṣṭhena ca bhavāṃstatra kuṃḍaṃ vidhāsyati || sarvatīrthasnāna tulyaṃ tatra snānaṃ ca taddine || 1.2.65.100 || matsyānāṃ netranetrasthatejastanmātramuttamam || uddhṛtya yojayiṣyāmi pratyakṣaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || 101 || evaṃ mama mahāsthānaṃ kalau khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || 102 || lohāṇākhyaṃ mahābāho nāma keleśvarīti ca || durgamākhyaṃ tato hatvā asminkṣetre ca bhārata||103||| durgā nāma bhaviṣyāmi mahīsāgarapūrvataḥ || dharmāraṇye vasiṣyāmi bhavatāṃ trāṇakāraṇāt || 104 || dharmāraṇye sthitāṃ caiva ye'rcayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || āśvine māsi caitre vā navamyāṃ śuklapakṣake || 105 || snātvā mahīsāgare ca teṣāṃ dāsyāmi vāṃchitam || vidhinā ye'rcayiṣyaṃti māṃ ca śraddhāsa manvitāḥ || 106 || putrapautrānpradāsyāmi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || praveśe ca kaleḥ kāle bhavatāṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ || vatsarājaḥ pāṃḍavānāṃ toṣayiṣyati yatnataḥ || 107 || yasya nāmnā tataḥ khyātā bhaviṣyāmi kalau yuge || vatseśvarīti vatsasya rājñaḥ sarvārthadāyinī ||108|| matprasādātsa rājā vai bhavanottāpakāriṇīm || aṭṭālayāṃnāma tadā rākṣasīṃ nihaniṣyati || 109 || tasyāścāpi vadhasthānamaṭṭālajamiti sthitam || bhaviṣyati puraṃ tatra māṃ ca saṃsthāpayiṣyati || 1.2.65.110 || aṭṭālayājagrāme māmarcayiṣyaṃti ye janāḥ || vatseśvarīṃ sitāṣṭamyāmāśvine taiḥ sadārcitā || 111 || vatseśvarīṃ ca ye devīṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || teṣāṃ sarvaphalāvāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 112 || itthamaṭṭālaye vāso lohāṇe ca bhaviṣyati || dharmāraṇye mahākṣetre mahīsāgarasaṃnidhau || 113 || mama lokahitārthāya lohasya ca niśamyatām || adhīkṛto mayā loho bahvīstaptāṃ tapaḥ samāḥ || || 114 || vṛtrāsura ivājeyo lokānutsādayiṣyati || taṃ ca viśvapatirdhīmānavatīrya budho hariḥ || 115 || yatra haṃtā tatra grāmaṃ lohāṭīti bhaviṣyati || gayonāma mahādaityo bhavatāṃ vighnakṛttadā ||116|| prasthāne lohavadbhāvī kariṣye taṃ napuṃsakam || gayatrāḍeti māṃ tatra pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || || 117 || grāmaṃ cāpi gayatrāḍaṃ tatra khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || gayatrāḍe gayatrāḍāṃ ye'rcayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || 118 || māghāṣṭamyāṃ na śiṣyaṃti tasya sarve'pyupadravāḥ || ye ca māṃ kopayiṣyaṃti pāṃḍavārādhitāṃ sadā || 119 || teṣāṃ puṃstvaṃ hariṣyāmi mahāraudrādhitiṣṭhati || parivāraśca me cātra ṣaṇḍhaḥ sarvo bhaviṣyati || 1.2.65.120 || tasminkaliyuge ghore raudre rudre'tinirghṛṇe || evaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tanmahyaṃ sthānamatra bhaviṣyati || 121 || bhavatsu ca svargateṣu gayo'pi sumahattapaḥ || taptvā prāpya punaḥ puṃstvaṃ lokānsaṃpīḍayiṣyati || 122 || gayātīrthaṃ gataṃ taṃ ca gayādhvaṃsanakāmyayā || budha eva jagatsvāmī tatra taṃ sūdayiṣyati || 123 || itthaṃ śrīmānpītavāsā avatīrya budhaḥ prabhuḥ || bahūni kṛtvā karmāṇi svasthānaṃ pratipatsyate || 124 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ pāṃḍavā mayā || bhavatāṃ cittanirvṛtyai śrūyatāṃ bhūya eva ca || 125 || idaṃ tīrthavaraṃ mahyaṃ saṃsevyaṃ sarvadā priyam || kṛtaṃ yadatrāgamanaṃ tena prītiḥ parā mama || 126 || bhīmasya cāpi pautreṇa dṛḍhaṃ saṃtoṣitā'smi ca || devyaḥ sarvāśca madrūpaṃ naitajjñeyama to'nyathā || 127 || vrajadhvaṃ cāpi tīrthāni yāni vo na kṛtāni ca || ābādhāsvasmi sarvāsu smaraṇīyā svaseva ca || 128 || āpṛcche cāpi vaḥ sarvānyūyaṃ kṛṣṇasamā mama || 129 || || sūta uvāca || || iti devyā vacaḥ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanāḥ || punaḥpunaḥ praṇamyaināṃ nāpaśyandīpavadgatām || 1.2.65.130 || tataste barbarīkaṃ ca saṃsthāpyātraiva niṣṭhitam || āgaccha yoge coktvedaṃ cakrustīrthāni mukhyaśaḥ || 131 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṇḍe barbarīkopākhyāne keleśvarī vatseśvarīdurgādevīgayatrāḍāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||
<1.2.66>
|| sūta uvāca || || tatastrayodaśe varṣe vyatīte samaye tadā || upaplave saṃgateṣu sarvarājasu pāṃḍavāḥ || 1 || yoddhumāgatya saṃtasthuḥ kurukṣetraṃ mahārathāḥ || kauravāścāpi saṃtasdhurduryodhanapurogamāḥ ||2|| tato bhīṣmeṇa proktāṃ ca naraiḥ śrutvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || rathātirathasaṃkhyāṃ tu rājñāṃ madhye vaco'bravīt ||3|| bhīṣmeṇa vihitā kṛṣṇa rathātirathavarṇanā || tato duryodhano'pṛcchadidaṃ svīyānmahārathān||4|| sasainyānpāṃḍavānetānhanyātkālena kena kaḥ || māsena tu pratijñātaṃ bhīṣmeṇa ca kṛpeṇa ca ||5|| pakṣaṃ droṇena cāhnāṃ ca daśabhirdrauṇinā raṇe || ṣaḍbhiḥ karṇena ca tathā sadā mamabhayaṃkṛtā || 6 || tadahaṃ svāṃśca pṛcchāmi kena kālena haṃti kaḥ || etacchrutvā vaco rājñaḥ phālguno vākyamabravīt || 7 || ayuktametadbhīṣmādyaiḥ pratijñātaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || tato jaye ca vijaye niścayo hi mṛṣaiva tat || 8 || tavāpi ye saṃti nṛpāḥ sannaddhā raṇasaṃsthitāḥ || paśyaitānpuruṣavyāghrānkālakalpāndurāsadān || 9 || drupadaṃ ca virāṭaṃ ca dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca kaikayam || sahadevaṃ sātyakiṃ ca cekitānaṃ ca durjayam|| 1.2.66.10 || dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ saputraṃ ca mahāvīryaṃ ghaṭotkacam || bhīmādīṃśca maheṣvāsānkeśavaṃ cāparājitam || 11 || manyehamekastveteṣāṃ hanyātkauravavāhinīm || sannaddhāḥ pratidṛśyaṃte bhīṣmādyā bahavo rathāḥ || 12 || tebhyo bhayaṃ na kāryaṃ te phalgavo'mī mṛgā iva || 13 || asmākaṃ dhanuṣāṃ ghoṣairidānīmeva bhārata || kauravā vidraviṣyaṃti siṃhatrastā mṛgā iva || 14 || vṛddhādbhīṣmāddvijādvṛddhāddroṇādapi kṛpādapi|| bāliśātkiṃ bhayaṃ drauṇeḥ sūtaputrācca durmateḥ || 15 || athavā cittanirvṛtyai jñātumicchasi bhārata || śatrūṇāṃ pratyanīkeṣu saṃdhāvacchṛṇu me vacaḥ ||16|| eko'hameva saṃgrāme sarve tiṣṭhaṃtu te rathāḥ || ekāhnā kṣapaye sarvānkauravānsainyasaṃyutān || 17 || ityarjunavacaḥ śrutvā smayandāmodaro'bravīt || evametadyathā prāha phālguno'yaṃ mṛṣā na tat || 18 || tataśca śaṃkhānbherīśca śataśaścaiva puṣkarān || nivārya rājamadhyastho barbarīko vaco'bravīt || || 19 || yena taptaṃ guptakṣetre yena devyaḥ sutoṣitāḥ || yasyātulaṃ bāhubalaṃ tena coktaṃ niśamyatām || 1.2.66.20 || yadbravīmi vacaḥ satyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ tannarādhipāḥ || ātmano vīryasadṛśaṃ kevalaṃ na tu darpataḥ || 21 || yadāryeṇa pratijñātamarjunena mahātmanā || na marṣayāmi tadvākyaṃ kālakṣepo mahānayam || 22 || sarve bhavaṃtastiṣṭhaṃtu sārjunāḥ sahakeśavāḥ || eko muhūrtādbhīṣmādīnsarvānneṣye yamakṣayam || 23 || mayi tiṣṭhati kenāpi śastragrāhyaṃ na kṣatriyaiḥ || svadharmaśapatho vo'stu mṛte grāhyaṃ tato mayi || 24 || paśyadhvaṃ me balaṃ bāhvordevyārādhanasaṃbhavam || māhātmyaṃ guptakṣetrasya tathā bhaktiṃ ca pāṃḍuṣu || 25 || paśyadhvaṃ me dhanurghoraṃ tūṇīrāvakṣayau tathā || khaḍgaṃ ca devyā yaddattaṃ tato vacmi vacastvidam || 26 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṣatriyā vismayaṃ yayuḥ || arjunaśca kaṭākṣepe lajjitaḥ kṛṣṇamaikṣata || 27 || tamāha lalitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ phālgunaṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ || ātmaupayikamevedaṃ bhaimi putro'bhyabhāṣata || 28 || navakoṭiyuto'nena palāśī nihataḥ purā || kṣaṇādeva ca pātāle śrūyate mahadadbhutam || 29 || punaḥ prakṣyāmade tvenaṃ kvenopāyena kauravān|| muhūrtāddhaṃsi brūhīti pṛcchayatāṃ cāha taṃ jayaḥ || 1.2.66.30 || tataḥ smaranyādaveṃdro bhaimiputramabhāṣata || 31 || bhīpmadroṇakṛpadrauṇikarṇaduryodhanādibhiḥ || guptāṃ tryaṃbakadurjeyāṃ senāṃ haṃsi kathaṃ kṣaṇāt || 32 || ayaṃ mahānvismayaste vacaso bhaiminaṃdana || saṃbhūtaḥ sarvarājñāṃ ca phālgunasya ca dhīmataḥ || 33 || tadbrūhi kenopāyena muhūrtāddhaṃsi kauravān || upāyavīryaṃ te jñātvā maṃsyāmo vayamapyuta || 34 || || sūta uvāca || || ityukto vāsudevena sarvabhūteśvareṇa ca || siṃhavakṣāḥ parvatābho nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 35 || ghaṭāsyo ghaṭahāsaśca ūrdhvakeśo'tidīpti mān || vidyudakṣo vāyujavo yaścecchennāśayejjagat || 36 || devīdattātulabalo barbarīko'bhyabhāṣata || yadi vo mānasaṃ vīrā upāyasya pradarśane || 37 || tadahaṃ darśayāmyeṣa paśyadhvaṃ sahakeśavāḥ || ityuktvā dhanurāropya saṃdadhe viśikhaṃ tvaran || niḥśalyaṃ cāpi saṃpūrṇaṃ siṃdūrābheṇa bhasmanā ||38|| ākarṇamākṛpya ca taṃ mumoca mukhādathodbhūtamabhūcca bhasma || 39 || senādvaye tacca papāta śīghraṃ yasyaiva yatrāsti ca mṛtyumarma || sarvaromasu bhīṣmasya kaṃṭhe rādheyadroṇayoḥ || 1.2.66.40 || ūrau duryodhanasyāpi śalyasyāpi ca vakṣasi || kaṃṭhe ca śakunerdīptaṃ bhagadattasya cāpatat || 41 || kṛṣṇasya pādatala lake kaṃṭhe drupadamatsyayoḥ || śikhaṃḍinastathā kaṭyāṃ kaṃṭhe senāpatestathā || 42 || papāta raktaṃ tadbhasma yatra yeṣāṃ ca marma ca || kevalaṃ caiva pāṃḍūnāṃ kṛpadroṇyośca nāspṛśata || 43 || iti kṛtvā tato bhūyo barbarīko'bhyabhāṣata || dṛṣṭaṃ bhavadbhirevaṃ yanmayā marma nirīkṣitam || 44 || adhunā pātayiṣyāmi marmasveṣāṃ śitāñcharān || devīdattānamoghākhyānyairmariṣyaṃtyamī kṣaṇāt || 45 || śapathā vaḥ svadharmasya śastraṃ grāhyaṃ na vaḥ kvacit || muhūrtātpātayiṣyāmi śatrūnetāñchitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 46 || tato vismitacittānāṃ yudhiṣṭhirapurogiṇām || āsīnninādaḥ sumahānsādhusādhviti śaṃsa tām || 47 || vāsudevaśca saṃkruddhaścakreṇa niśitena ca || evaṃ bruvata evāsya śiraśchittvā nyapātayat || 48 || tataḥ kṣaṇātsarvamāsīdāvigraṃ rājamaṃ ḍalam || vyalokayankeśavaṃ te vismitāścābhavanbhṛśam || 49 || kimetaditi prāhuśca barbarīkaḥ kuto hataḥ|| pāṃḍavāścāpi mumucuraśrūṇi sahapārthivāḥ || 1.2.66.50 || hāhā putreti ca gṛṇanpraskhalaṃśca padepade || ghaṭotkaco'pataddīnaḥ putropari vimūrchitaḥ || 51 || etasminnaṃtare devyaścaturdaśa samāyayuḥ || 52 || siddhāṃbikā kroḍamātā kapālī tārā suvarṇā ca trilokajetrī || bhāṇeśvarī carcikā caikavīrā yogeśvarī caṃḍikā traipurā ca ||53|| bhūtāṃbikā harasiddhistathāmūḥ saṃprāpya tasthurnṛpavismayaṃkarāḥ || śrīcaṃḍikā''śvāsya tatau ghaṭotkacaṃ provāca vākyaṃ mahatā svareṇa || 54 || śṛṇudhvaṃ pārthivāḥ sarve kṛṣṇena viditātmanā || hetunā yena nihato barbarīko mahābalaḥ || 55 || merumūrdhni purā pṛthvī samavetāndivaukasaḥ || bhārākrāṃtā jagādaitānbhāro'pa hriyatāṃ hi me || 56 || tato brahmā prāha viṣṇuṃ bhagavaṃstvamidaṃ śṛṇu || devāstvānugamiṣyaṃti bhāraṃ hara bhuvaḥ prabho || 57 || tatastatheti tanmene vacanaṃ viṣṇuravyayaḥ || etasminnaṃtare bāhumuddhṛtyoccairabhāṣata || 58 || sūryavarceti yakṣeṃdraścaturāśītikoṭipaḥ || kimarthaṃ mānuṣe loke bhavadbhirjanma kāryate || 59 || mayi tiṣṭhati doṣāṇāmanekānāṃ mahāspade || sarve bhavaṃto modaṃtu svargeṣu saha viṣṇunā || 1.2.66.60 || ahameko'vatīryaitānhaniṣyāmi bhuvo bharān || svadharmaśapathā vo vai saṃti cejjanma prāpsyatha || 61 || ityuktavacane brahmā kruddhastaṃ samabhāṣata || durmate sarvadevānāmaviṣahyaṃ mahābharam ||62|| svasādhyaṃ brūṣe mohāttvaṃ śāpayogyo'si bāliśa || deśakālocitaṃ svīyaṃ parasya ca balaṃ hṛdā || 63 || avicāryaiva prabhuṣu vakti so'rhati daṃḍanam || tasmādbhūbhāraharaṇe yuddhasyopakrame sati || 64 || śarīranāśaṃ kṛṣṇāttvamavāpsyasi na saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ śapto brahmaṇā'sau viṣṇumetadayācata || 65 || yadyevaṃ bhavitā nāśastadekaṃ deva prārthaye || janmaprabhṛti me dehi matiṃ sarvārthasādhanīm || 66 || tatastatheti taṃ prāha keśavo devasaṃsadi || śiraste pūjayiṣyaṃti devyāḥ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi || 67 || ityuktvā cāvatīrṇo'sau saha devairharistadā || harirnāma sa kṛṣṇo'sau bhavaṃtaste tathā surāḥ || 68 || sūryavarcāḥ sa cāyaṃ hi nihato bhaimiputrakaḥ || prākchāpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtvā hatonena mahātmanā || tasmāddoṣo na kṛṣṇe'smindraṣṭavyaḥ sarvabhū mipaiḥ ||69|| || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || yaduktaṃ bhūmipā devyā tattathaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 1.2.66.70 || yadyenamadhunā naiva hanyāṃ brahmavaco'nyathā || tato bhavediti smṛtvā mayāsau vinipātitaḥ || 71 || guptakṣetre mayaivā'sau niyukto devyanusmṛtau || pūrvaṃ dattaṃ varaṃ svīyaṃ smaratā devasaṃsadi ||72 || ityukte caṃḍikā devī tadā bhaktaśirastvidam || abhyukṣya sudhayā śīghramajaraṃ cāmaraṃ vyadhāt || 73 || yathā rāhuśirastadvattacchiraḥ praṇanāma tān || uvāca ca didṛkṣāmi yuddhaṃ tadanumanyatām || 74 || tataḥ kṛṣṇo vacaḥ prāha meghagaṃbhīravākprabhuḥ || yāvanmahī sanakṣatrā yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 75 || tāvattvaṃ sarvalokānāṃ vatsa pūjyo bhaviṣyasi || devīlokeṣu sarveṣu devīvadvicariṣyasi ||76|| svabhaktānāṃ ca lokeṣu devīnāṃ dāsyase sthitim || bālānāṃ ye bhaviṣyaṃti vātapittakaphodbhavāḥ || piṭakāstāḥ sukhenaiva śāmayiṣyasi pūjanāt || 77 || idaṃ ca śṛṃgamāruhya paśya yuddhaṃ yathā bhavet || 78 || dhāvaṃtaḥ kauravāstvasmānvayaṃ yāmastvamūniti || ityukte vāsudevena devyo'thāṃbaramāviśan || 79 || barbarīkaśiraścaiva giriśṛṃgamavāpya tat || dehasya bhūmisaṃskārāścābhavacchiraso nahi || tato yuddhaṃ mahadabhūtkurupāṃḍavasenayoḥ ||1.2.66.80|| aṣṭādaśāhena hatā ye ca droṇavṛṣādayaḥ || duryodhane hate krūre aṣṭādaśadinātyaye || 81 || yudhiṣṭhiro jñātimadhye goviṃdaṃ samabhāṣata || puruṣottama saṃgrāmamamuṃ saṃtāritā vayam || 82 || tvayaiva nāthena hare namaste puruṣottama || śrutvā tasyāpi sāsūyamidaṃ bhīmo vaco'bravīt || 83 || yena dhvastā dhārtarāṣṭrāstaṃ nirākṛtya māṃ nṛpa || puruṣottamaṃ kṛṣṇamiti bravīṣi kimu mūḍhavat || 84 || dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ phālgunaṃ ca sātyakiṃ māṃ ca pāṃḍava || nirākṛtya bravīṣyeva sūtaṃ dhiktvā yudhiṣṭhira || 85 || || arjuna uvāca || || maivaṃ maivaṃ brūhi bhīma na tvaṃ vetsi janārdanam || na mayā na tvayā pārtha nānyenāpyarayo hatāḥ || 86 || ahaṃ hi sarvadāgrasthaṃ naraṃ paśyāmi saṃyuge || nighnaṃtaṃ śātravāṃstatra na jāne ko'pyasāviti || 87 || || bhīma uvāca || || vibhrāṃto'si dhruvaṃ pārtha nātra haṃtā naro'paraḥ || atha cedasti tvatpautramuccasthaṃ vacmi haṃta kaḥ || 88 || upasṛtya tato bhīmo barbarīkamapṛcchata || brūhyete kena nihatā dhārtarāṣṭrā hi śatravaḥ || 89 || || barbarīka uvāca || || eko mayā pumāndṛṣṭo yudhyamānaḥ paraiḥ saha || savyataḥ paṃcavaktraḥ sa dakṣiṇe caikavaktrataḥ || 1.2.66.90 || savyato daśahastaśca dhṛtaśūlādyudāyudhaḥ || dakṣiṇe ca caturhasto dhṛtacakrādyudāyudhaḥ || 91 || savyataśca jaṭādhārī dakṣiṇe mukuṭoccayaḥ || savyato bhasmadhārī ca dakṣiṇe dhṛtacaṃdanaḥ || 92 || savyataścaṃdradhārī ca dakṣiṇe kaustubhadyutiḥ || mamāpi taddarśanato mahadbhayamajāyata || 93 || īdṛśo me naro dṛṣṭo na cānyo yo jaghāna tān || ityukte puṣpavarṣaṃ tu khādāsītsumahāprabham || 94 || sasvanurdevavādyāni sādhusādhviti vai jaguḥ || vismitāḥ pāṃḍavāścāsanpraṇemuḥ puruṣottamam || 95 || vilakṣaścābhavadbhīmo niśvāsāṃścāpyamuṃcata || taṃ tataḥ keśavaḥ svāmī samādāya kare dṛḍhe || 96 || kuruśārdūla ehīti procya sasmāra kāśyapim || āruhya garuḍaṃ paścātsmṛtamātramupasthitam || 97 || bhīmena sahito vyomni prayāto dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || tato'rṇavamatītyaiva suvelaṃ ca mahāgirim || 98 || laṃkāsamīpe dṛṣṭvaiva saraḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdvacaḥ || kuruśārdūla paśyedaṃ saro dvādaśayojanam || 99 || yadi śūro'si tacchīghramānayāsyatalānmṛdam || ityukto garuḍācchīghraṃ nyapatattajjale balī || 1.2.66.100 || yojanaṃ vāyujavādgacchannadho nāṃtamapaśyata || tato bhīmo viniḥsṛtya bhagnavīryo'bhyabhāṣata || 101 || agādhametatsumahatsaraḥ kaiścinmahābalaiḥ || ahaṃ khāditumārabdhaḥ kathaṃciccāpi nirgataḥ ||102||| evamukto hasankṛṣṇa uccikṣepa mahatsaraḥ || svenāṃguṣṭhena tejasvī tadardhārdhamajāyata ||103|| tadṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ prāha kimidaṃ kṛṣṇa brūhi me || 104 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca|| kumbhakarṇa iti khyātaḥ pūrvamāsīnniśācaraḥ || rāmabāṇahatasyābhūcchiraśchinnaṃ sudurmateḥ || 105 || śirasastasya tālukyakhaṃḍametadvṛkodara || yojanadvādaśāyāmaṃ mṛdu kṣiptaṃ vicūrṇitam || 106 || vidhṛtastvaṃ ca yaiste tu sarogeyābhidhāḥ surāḥ || trikūṭasya śilā bhiśca cūrṇitā ye ca koṭiśaḥ || 107 || ete hi viśvaripavo nihatāḥ syurupāyataḥ || gacchāmaḥ pāṃḍavānbhīma drauṇirhi tvarate dṛḍham || 108 || tato bhīmaḥ praṇamyāha manovākkāyavṛddhibhiḥ || kṛtamājanmataḥ sava kukṛtaṃ kṣama keśava || 109 || puruṣottama bhavānnātha bāliśasya prasīda me || tataḥ kṣāṃtamiti procya bhīmena sahito hariḥ || 1.2.66.110 || raṇājiraṃ bhūya etya barbarīkaṃ vaco'bravīt || carannevaṃ suhṛdaya sarvalokeṣu nityaśaḥ || 111 || pūjitaḥ sarvalokaistvaṃ yacchaṃsteṣāṃ varānvṛtān || guptakṣetraṃ ca na tyājyaṃ sarvakṣetrottamottamam || 112 || dehisthalyāṃ tathā vāsī kṣamasva duṣkṛtaṃ ca yat || ityuktastānnamatkṛtya bhaimiḥ svairaṃ yayau mudā || 113 || vāsudevo'pi kāryāṇi sarvāṇyūrdhvamakārayat || iti vo varṇitotpattirbarbarīkasya vāḍavāḥ || stavaṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi yena tuṣyati yakṣarāṭ || 114 || jayajaya caturaśītikoṭiparivāra sūryavarcābhidhāna yakṣarāja jaya bhūbhāraharaṇapravṛtta laghuśāpaprāptanairṛtiyonisaṃbhava jaya kāmakaṭaṃkaṭākukṣirājahaṃsa jaya ghaṭotkacānaṃdavardhana barbarīkābhidhāna jaya kṛṣṇopadiṣṭaśrīguptakṣetrade vīsamārādhanaprāptātulavīrya jaya vijayasiddhidāyaka jaya piṃgalārepalendraduhadruhānavakoṭīśvara palāśanadāvānala jaya bhūpātālāṃtarāle nāgakanyāpari hāraka jaya bhīmamānamardana jaya sakalakauravasenāvadhamuhūrtapravṛtta jaya śrīkṛṣṇavaralabdhasarvavarapradānasāmarthya jayajaya kalikālavaṃditanamonamaste pā hipāhīti || 115 || anena yaḥ suhṛdayaṃ śrāvaṇe'bhyarcya darśake || vaiśākhe ca trayodaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe dvijottamāḥ || śatadīpaiḥ pūrikābhiḥ saṃstavettasya tuṣyati || 116 || tato viprā nāradaśca samārādhya maheśvaram || mahīnagarake puṇye sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram || 117 || lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kedāraṃ liṅgamuttamam || atrīśāduttare bhāge mahāpāpapraṇāśanam || 118 || atra kuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || atrīśaṃ ca namaskṛtya kedāraṃ ca prapaśyati || 119 || mātuḥ stanyaṃ punarnaiva sa pibenmuktibhāgbhavet || tato rudro nīlakaṇṭho nāradāya mahātmane || 1.2.66.120 || varaṃ dattvā svayaṃ tasthau mahīnagarake śubhe || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā nīlakaṇṭhaṃ prapaśyati || 121 || jayādityaṃ namaskṛtya rudralokamavāpnuyāt || jayādityaṃ pūjayaṃti kūpe snātvā narottamāḥ || 122 || na teṣāṃ vaṃśanāśo'sti jayādityaprasādataḥ || teṣāṃ kule na rogaḥ syānna dāridryaṃ na lāñchanam || 123 || putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamāyutāḥ || bhuktvā bhogāniha bahūnsūryaloke vasanti te || 124 || iti proktaṃ mayā viprā guptakṣetraṃ samāsataḥ || saptakrośapramāṇaṃ ca kṣetrasyāsya purā dvijāḥ || svayaṃbhuvā proktamidaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam || 125 || iti vo varṇitaḥ puṇyo mahīsāgarasambhavaḥ || śṛṇvansaṃkīrtayaṃścaiva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 126 || ya idaṃ śrāvayedvidvānmahāmāhātmyamuttamam || sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 127 || guptakṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ sakalaṃ śrāvayedyadi || sarvaiśvaryamavāpnoti brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 128 || koṭitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mahīnagarakasya ca || śṛṇoti śrāvayedyastu brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 129 || koṭitīrthe naraḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || dānaṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā śṛṇudhvaṃ tatphalaṃ hi me || 1.2.66.130 || svargapātālamartyeṣu yāni tīrthāni santi vai || teṣu dāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ || 131 || aśvamedhādibhiryajñairiṣṭaiścaivāptadakṣiṇaiḥ || sarvavratatapobhiśca kṛtairyatpuṇyamāpyate || 132 || tatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate viprāḥ koṭitīrthe na saṃśayaḥ || 133 || idaṃ pavitraṃ khalu puṇyadaṃ sadā yaśaskaraṃ pāpaharaṃ parātparam || śṛṇoti bhaktyā puruṣaḥ sa puṇyabhāgasukṣaye rudrasalokatāṃ vrajet|| 134 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ niyataṃ supuṇyaṃ svarmokṣadaṃ pāpaharaṃ narāṇām || śṛṇoti nityaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ pumānbhittvā raviṃ viṣṇu padaṃ prayāti || 135 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kaumārikākhaṃḍe guptakṣetramāhātmyapari samāptivarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||63|| || ata ūrdhvaṃ kāpilasthānopākhyānaṃ bhaviṣyati ||(?)|| iti śrīskandapurāṇīyaprathamamāheśvarakhaṇḍāntargato dvitīyaḥ kaumārikākhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ ||
<1.3.1.1>
|| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ|| || atha śrīmadaruṇācalamāhātmyapūrvārdhaḥ prārabhyate|| || lalāṭe traipuṃḍrī niṭilakṛtakastūritilakaḥ sphuranmālādhāraḥ sphuritakaṭikaupīnavasanaḥ || dadhāno dustāraṃ śirasi phaṇirājaṃ śaśikalāṃ pradīpaḥ sarveṣāmaruṇagiriyogīvijayate ||1|| || vyāsa uvāca || || athāhurmunayaḥ sūtaṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ || aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ tvattaḥ śuśrūṣavo vayam || 2 || tanmāhātmyaṃ vadetyuktaḥ sūtaḥ provāca tānmunīn || || śrīsūta uvāca || || etadarthaṃ caturvaktraṃ papraccha sanakaḥ purā || 3 || śṛṇutāvahitā yūyaṃ tadvo vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || yadākarṇayatāṃ bhaktyā narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam || 4 || satyaloke sthitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kamalāsanam || sanakaḥ paripapraccha praṇataḥ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ || 5 || || sanaka uvāca || || bhuvanādhāra deveśa vedavedya caturmukha || āsīdaśeṣavijñānaṃ prasādādbhavato mama || 6 || bhavadbhaktivibhūtyā me śodhite cittadarpaṇe || biṃbate sakalaṃ jñānaṃ sakṛdevopadeśataḥ || 7 || sārārthaṃ vedavedānāṃ śivajñānamanākulam || labdhavānahamatyaṃtaṃ kaṭākṣaiste jagadguroḥ || 8 || liṃgāni bhuvi śaivāni divyāni ca kṛpānidhe || mānuṣāṇi ca saiddhāni bhautāni suranāyaka || 9 || nāmasmaraṇamātreṇa yatpātakavināśanam || śivasārūpyadaṃ nityaṃ mahyaṃ vada dayānidhe || 11 || anādijagadādhāraṃ yattejaḥ śaivamavyayam || yacca dṛṣṭvā kṛtārthaḥ syāttanmahyamupadiśyatām || 12 || iti bhaktimatastasya kautūhalasamanvitam || vākyamākarṇya bhagavānprasasāda taponidhiḥ || || 13 || dadhyau ca suciraṃ śaṃbhuṃ paṃkajāsanasaṃsthitaḥ || aṃtaraṃgasukhāṃbhodhimagnacetāścaturmukhaḥ || 14 || dṛṣṭvā yadā purā dṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥstaṃbhamayaṃ śivam || uttīrṇasakalādhāraṃ na kiṃcitpratyabudhyata || 15 || punarājñāṃ śivāllabdhāmanupālayituṃ prabhuḥ || nirvarttya hṛdayaṃ yogātsasmāra sutamānatam || 16 || śivadarśanasaṃjātapulakāṃkitavigrahaḥ || ānaṃdavāṣpavannetraḥ sagadgadamabhāṣata || 17 || || brahmovāca || || ataḥ saṃsmāritaḥ putra bhavatā'haṃ purātanam || śivayogamanudhyāyannasmārṣaṃ tava cādarāt ||18|| śivabhaktiḥ parā jātā tapobhirbahubhistava || tayā madīyaṃ hṛdayaṃ vyāvarttitamiva kṣaṇāt || 19 || pāvayaṃti jagatsarvaṃ caritaiste nirākule || yeṣāṃ sadāśive bhaktirvarddhate sārvakālikī || 1.3.1.1.20 || saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ sahāvāsaḥ krīḍā caiva vimiśraṇam || darśanaṃ śivabhaktānāṃ smaraṇaṃ cāghanāśanam|| 21 || śrūyatāmadbhutaṃ śaivamāvirbhūtaṃ yathā purā || avyājakaruṇāpūrṇamaruṇādryabhidhaṃ mahaḥ || 22 || ahaṃ nārāyaṇaścobhau jātau viśvādhikodayāt || bahu syāmiti saṃkalpaṃ vitanvānātsadāśivāt || 23 || svabhāvena samudbhūtau vivadaṃtau parasparam || na ca śrāṃtau niyudhyaṃtau sāhaṃkārau kadācana ||24|| parasparaṃ raṇotsāhamāvayoratibhīṣaṇam || ālokya karuṇāmūrtiraciṃtayadatheśvaraḥ || 25 || kimarthamanayoryuddhaṃ jāyate lokanāśanam || mayā sṛṣṭamahaṃ pāteti vivādamadhitasthuṣoḥ || 26 || samaye'sminsvayaṃ lakṣyo mugdhayoranayorbhṛśam || yadi yuddhaṃ na rotsyāmi tadā syādbhuvanakṣayaḥ || 27 || vedeṣu mama māhātmyaṃ viśvādhikatayā śrutam || na jānāte imau mugdhau krodhato galitasmṛtī || 28 || sarvopi jaṃturātmānamadhikaṃ manyate bhṛśam || amatānyasamādhikyastvadhaḥ patati durmatiḥ || 29 || yadyahaṃ kvāpi bhuvane dāsyāmi mitimātmanaḥ || tadā tadrūpavijñānātsa ātmā sopi māmiyāt || 1.3.1.1.30 || iti niścitya manasā svayameva sadāśivaḥ || āvayoryudhyatormadhye vahnistaṃbhaḥ samudyataḥ || 31 || atītya sakalām̐llokānsarvato'gniriva jvalan || 32 || anādyaṃtatayā cātha dṛgārtau saṃvyatiṣṭhatām || tejaḥstaṃbhaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ tamālokya śithilāśayau || 33 || āvayoḥ purato jātā vāṇī cāpyaśarīriṇī || kimarthaṃ bālakau yuddhaṃ kalpyate mūḍhamānasau || 34 || yuvayorbalavaiṣamyaṃ śiva eva vivekṣyate || tejaḥstabhamayaṃ rūpamidaṃ śaṃbhorvyavasthitam || 35 || ādyaṃtayoryadi yuvāmīkṣiṣāthāṃ balādhikau || iti tāṃ giramākarṇya niyuddhādviratau tadā || 36 || ahaṃ viṣṇuśca gatimānvicetuṃ tadvyavasthitau || agnistaṃbhamayaṃ rūpaṃ śaṃbhorādyaṃtavarjitam || 37 || ālokituṃ vyavasitāvāvāmādyaṃtabhāgataḥ || biṃbitaṃ vyomagaṃ caṃdraṃ yathā bālau jighṛkṣataḥ ||38|| tathaivāvāṃ samudyuktau paricchettuṃ ca tanmahaḥ|| atha viṣṇurmahotsāhātkroḍo'bhūtsumahāvapuḥ || 39 || tanmūlavicayā'yācca bhūmigarbhaṃ vyadārayat || ahaṃ ca haṃsatāṃ prāpto mahāvegaṃ samutpatan || 1.3.1.1.40 || didṛkṣustacchirobhāgaṃ viyadūrdhvamagāhiṣam || adhodhodārayankṣoṇimaśeṣāmapi mādhavaḥ || 41 || āvirbhūtamivādhastādagnistaṃbhamavaikṣata || anekakoṭivarṣāṇi vicinvannapi tejasaḥ || 42 || apaśyannādimakṣayyamārtarūpaḥ sa vihvalaḥ || viśīrṇadaṃṣṭrabalayo vigalatsaṃdhibaṃdhanaḥ || 43 || śramāturastṛṣākrāṃto no yātumaśakaddhariḥ || vārāhaṃ rūpamatulaṃ saṃdhārayitumakṣamaḥ || 44 || vihaṃtumapi viśrāṃto viṣasāda ramāpatiḥ || aciṃtayadameyātmā pariśrāṃtaśarīravān || 45 || galitaśrīḥ kriyāśrāṃtaḥ śaraṇyaṃ śivamāśrayan || dhiṅmamedaṃ mahanmaugdhyamahaṃkārasamudbhavam 48||| yenāhamātmano nāthamātmānaṃ nāvabuddhavān || ayaṃ hi sarvavedānāṃ devānāṃ jagatāmapi || 47 || mūlabhūtaḥ śivaḥ sākṣānmūlamasya kathaṃ bhavet || asmādeva samudbhūto'smyahamādyaṃtavarjitāt || 48 || yanmayānveṣṭumārabdhaṃ śivaṃ paśuvapurdhṛtā || avyājakaruṇābandhoḥ pituḥ śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ || 49 | punarevedṛśī labdhā matirme svātmabodhinā || svayameva mahādevaḥ śaṃbhuryaṃ pātumicchati || 1.3.1.1.50 || tasya sadyo bhavejjñānamanahaṃkāramātmajam || na śaknomi punaḥ kartuṃ pūjāmasya jagadguroḥ || 51 || nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram || iti dadhyau śivaṃ viṣṇuḥ stutyāmarpitacetanaḥ ||| || 52 || satprasādādbhūtapateḥ punarevoddhutaḥ kṣitau || ahaṃ ca gagane'bhrāmyamanekānapi vatsarān || 53 || āghūrṇamānanayanaḥ ślathapakṣaḥ śramaṃ gataḥ ||| uparyupari cāpaśyaṃ jvalanaṃ purataḥ sthitam || 54 || tejaḥstambhaṃ sthūlaliṃgābhaṃ śaivaṃ tejaḥ surārcitam || āhuḥ sma kecidālokya siddhāstejoṃśasaṃbhavāḥ || 55 || nityāṃ śaṃbhoḥ parāṃ koṭiṃ didṛkṣuṃ māṃ kṛtodyamam || aho'yaṃ satyamugdhatvamadyāpi ca cikīrṣati || 56 || āsannadehapāto'pi nāhaṃkāro'sya vai gataḥ || viśīryamāṇapakṣo'yaṃ śrāṃtvā vibhrāṃtalocanaḥ || 57 || apāratejasi vyartho vimoho'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || evaṃ vyākulacitto'yaṃ kroḍarūpī janārdanaḥ || 58 || vyāvarttitaḥ śivenaiva nirvyājakaruṇājuṣā || īdṛśāṃ brahmamukhyānāṃ surāṇāṃ koṭisaṃbhavaḥ || 59 || yattejaḥparamāṇubhyastasya pāraṃ didṛkṣate || svātmano yo gato dhyātvā samaye bhagavāñchivaḥ || 1.3.1.1.60 || yadi buddhiṃ dadātyasmai tasya naśyedahaṃkriyā || ityevaṃ vadatāṃ teṣāṃ siddhānāṃ sadayaṃ vacaḥ || 61 || ākarṇya śīrṇāhaṃkāro hyahamātmanyaciṃtayam || na vedarāśivijñānāttapastīrthaniṣevaṇāt || 62 || saṃjāyate śivajñānamasyaivānugrahādṛte || śīrṇe'pi pakṣayugale sīdatyaṃge hyacaṃcale || 63 || punarutsahate cetaḥ svāhaṃkārasya saṃgrahe || dhiṅmāmahaṃ kriyākrāṃtamanātmabalavedinam || 64 || śivārpitamanaskebhyaḥ siddhebhyaḥ satataṃ namaḥ || yeṣāṃ saṃsargalabdhena tapasā śodhitāśayaḥ || 65 || śivamenaṃ vijānāmi svātmahetuṃ puraḥsthitam || yatprasādopalabdhena vibhavena samanvitāḥ || 66 || devāḥ sarve bhaviṣyaṃti satataṃ śamitārayaḥ || yasya vedā na jānaṃti paramārthaṃ mahāgamaiḥ || 67 || tameva śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃbhuṃ viśvavilakṣaṇam || avādiṣamathābhāṣyaṃ viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam || 68 || labdhadehaḥ śivaṃ bhaktyā saṃśritaścandraśekharam || aho kimidamāścaryamāgataṃ śauryaśālinām || 69 || śaṃbhunā yatsamudbhūtamahaṃkāramupāśritau || āvāṃ parasparaṃ yuddhamākarṇya vipulaṃ mahat || 1.3.1.1.70 || sa eva śaṃkaraḥ sarvamahaṃkāramathāvayoḥ || apāharadameyātmā svamāhātmyaprakāśanāt || 71 || imamīśvaramānataṃ surairanalastambhamayaṃ sadāśivam || abhipūjayituṃ pravartate sa bhavedvai bhavasāgarasya nauḥ || 72 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe brahmasanakasaṃvāde liṃgaprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||
<1.3.1.2>
|| brahmovāca || || athāhamuccaranvedānaśeṣairvadanaiḥ śivam || astauṣaṃ bhaktisaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā mānasamarcanam || 1 || namaḥ śivāya mahate sarvalokaikahetave || yena prakāśyate sarvaṃ dhriyate satataṃ namaḥ || 2 || viśvavyāptamidaṃ tejaḥ prakāśayati saṃtatam || nekṣaṃte tvaddayāhīnā jātyaṃdhā bhāskaraṃ yathā || 3 || bhūliṃgamamalaṃ hyetaddṛśyamadhyātmacakṣuṣā || aṃtassthaṃ vā bahissthaṃ vā tvadbhaktairanubhūyate || 4 || aparicchedyamākāramaṃtarātmani yoginaḥ || tadetattava deveśa jvalitaṃ darpaṇo yathā || 5 || athavā śāṃkarī śaktiḥ satyā'ṇorapyaṇīyasī || matto nānyataraḥ kaścidyanmayyapi vilīyate || 6 || aṇuste karuṇāpātraṃ mahattvaṃ dhruvamaśnute || nādhiko'sti parastvatto na matto'pi tadāśrayāt || 7 || tvayyarpitaṃ manastvato na viyogamapekṣate || vācaḥ kathaṃ pravṛttiḥ syāttava vaibhavakīrttane || 6 || svayamīśa mahādeva prasīda bhuvanādhika || ādiśa prayataṃ bhaktamapekṣitaniyuktiṣu || 9 || idaṃ vijñāpya vinayānnamaskṛtvā punaḥpunaḥ || prāṃjalirdevadeveśaṃ nyaṣīdaṃ savidhe vibho ||1.3.1.2.10|| atha viṣṇurnavāṃbhodagaṃbhīradhvanirabhyadhāt || vācaḥ kṛtārthanbhūyaḥ śuklāḥ śaṃkarakīrttanaiḥ || 11 || jaya tribhuvanādhīśa jaya gaṃgādhara prabho || jaya nātha virūpākṣa jaya caṃdrārddhaśekhara || 12 || avyājamamitaṃ śaṃbho kāruṇyaṃ tava varddhate || yena nirdhūtamakhilaṃ bhakteṣu jñānamāhitam || 13 || pālanaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpaṇaṃ bhūtisaṃcayaiḥ || purāṇaṃ ca saputrāṇāṃ pitureva pravardhanam || || 14 || śatānāmapi mūrtīnāmekāmapi navaiḥ stavaiḥ || stotuṃ na śaknumeśāna samavāyastu ki punaḥ || 15 || tvameva tvāmalaṃ vettuṃ yadi vā tvatprasādataḥ || bhramaraḥ kīṭamākṛṣya svātmānaṃ kiṃ na cānayet || 16 || devāstvadaṃśasaṃbhūtiprabhavo na bhavanti kim || apyāyasyāgnikīlasya dāhe śaktirna kiṃ bhavet || 17 || deśakālakriyāyogādyathāgnerbhedasambhavaḥ || tathā viṣayabhedena tvameko'pi vibhidyase || 18 || anugrahaparo deva mūrtiṃ darśaya śaṃkara || āvayorakhilādhāra nayanānaṃdadāyinīm || 19 || evaṃ praṇamatordevaḥ śraddhābhaktisamanvitam || prasasāda paraṃ śaṃbhuḥ stuvatorāvayordvayoḥ || 1.3.1.2.20 || tejaḥstaṃbhātpunastasmāddevaścandrārddhaśekharaḥ || āvirbabhūva puruṣaḥ kapilaḥ kālakandharaḥ || 21 || paraśuṃ bālahariṇaṃ karairabhayaviśramau || dadhānaḥ puruṣo'vādītputrāvāvāmiti prabhuḥ|| 22 || parituṣṭo'smi yuvayorbhaktyā yuktātmanormayi|| bhavataṃ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭirakṣādhipau yuvām || 23 || yuvayoriṣṭasiddhyarthamāvirbhūto'smyahaṃ yataḥ || varaṃ vṛṇutamanyaṃ ca varado'hamupāgataḥ || 24 || iti devasya vacanātsaprītau ca kṛtāṃjalī || vijñāpayāmāsivatau svaṃ svamarthaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 25 || ahaṃ mantraiḥ śiśuprāyajagattrayavidhāyakaḥ || saṃstuvanvaidikairmaṃtrairīśānamaparājitam || || 26 || namasyehamidaṃ rūpaṃ śaśvadvaradamīśvaram || tejomayaṃ mahādevaṃ yogidhyeyaṃ niraṃjanam || 27 || āpūryamāṇaṃ bhavatā tejasā gaganāṃtaram || paripṛcchyaḥ surāvāsaḥ kṣaṇāddeva bhaviṣyati || 28 || siddhacāraṇagandharvā devāśca paramarṣayaḥ || nāvasandivi saṃcāraṃ labheraṃstejasā tava || 29 || pṛthvī ca sakalā caiva tapyamānā tavaujasā || carācarasamutpattikṣamā naiva bhavipyati || 1.3.1.2.30 || upasaṃhṛtya tejaḥ svamaruṇācalasaṃjñayā || bhava sthāvaraliṃgaṃ tvaṃ lokānugrahakāraṇāt || 31 || jyotirmayamidaṃ rūpamaruṇācalasaṃjñitam || ye namanti narā bhaktyā te bhavantyamarādhikāḥ || 32 || sevaṃtāṃ sakalā lokāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || gaṇāśca vividhā bhūmau mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāsthitāḥ || 33 || divyārāma samudbhūtakalpakādyāḥ suradrumāḥ || sevinastvāṃ prarohaṃtu bharitā vividhaiḥ phalaiḥ || 34 || divyauṣadhigaṇāssarve siṃhādyā mṛgajātayaḥ || praśāṃtāḥ parivarttaṃtā pāpakalmaṣanāśanam || 35 || ayanadvayabhinnena gamanenāpi saṃyutaḥ || na laṃghayiṣyati raviḥ śṛṃgaṃ liṃgatanostava || 36 || divya duṃdubhiśaṃkhānāṃ ghoṣaiḥ puṣpaughavṛṣṭibhiḥ || sevito bhava deva tvamapsaronṛtyagītibhiḥ || 37 || amaratvaṃ ca siddhatvaṃ gsasiddhīśca nirvṛtim || labhaṃtāṃ mānuṣā nityaṃ tvatsaṃnidhimupāgatāḥ || 38 || īśatvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ kālavaṃcanam || tvāmāśritya narāssarve labhaṃtāmaruṇācala || 39 || sarvāvayavadānena sarvavyādhivināśanāt || sarvābhīṣṭapradānena dṛśyo bhava mahītale ||1.3.1.2.40|| tatheti varadaṃ devamaruṇādripatiṃ śivam|| praṇamya kamalānāthaḥ prārthayannidamabravīt || 41 || prasīda karuṇāpūrṇa śoṇaśaileśvara prabho || maheśa sarvalokānāṃ hitāya prakaṭodaya || 42 || yadāhaṃ tvāmupāśritya jagadrakṣaṇadakṣiṇaḥ || śrīpatitvamanuprāptastadā bhaktā bhavaṃtu te || 43 || nālpapuṇyairupāsyeta tvadrūpaṃ mahadadbhutam || mayā ca brahmaṇā caivamadṛṣṭapadaśekharaḥ || 44 || pradakṣiṇānamaskārairnṛtyagītaiśca pūjanaiḥ || tvāmarcayaṃti ye martyāḥ kṛtārthāste gatāṃhasaḥ || 45 || upavāsairvrataiḥ satrairupahāraistathārcanaiḥ || tvāmarcayaṃti manujāḥ sārvabhaumā bhavaṃtu te || 46 || ārāmaṃ maṃḍapaṃ cāpi kūpaṃ vidhiviśodhanam || kurvatāmaruṇādrīśa saṃnidhāne punarbhava || 47 || aṃgapradakṣiṇaṃ kurvannaṣṭaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ || aśeṣapātakaiḥ sadyo vimukto nirmalāśayaḥ || 48 || āvāmapyavimuṃcaṃtau sadā tvatpādapaṃkajam || dhyātavyaṃ manujaiḥ sarvaistava saṃnidhimāgataiḥ || 49 || tathāstviti varaṃ dattvā viṣṇave caṃdraśekharaḥ || bharuṇācalarūpeṇa prāptaḥ sthāvaraliṃgatām || 1.3.1.2.50 || taijasaṃ liṃgametaddhi sarvalokaikakāraṇam || aruṇādririti khyātaṃ dṛśyate vasudhātale || 51 || yugāṃtasamaye kṣubdhaiścaturbhirapi sāgaraiḥ || api nirmagnalokāṃtairaspṛṣṭāṃtikabhūtalam || 52 || gajapramāṇaiḥ pṛṣataiḥ pūrayaṃto jagattrayam || puṣkarādyā mahāmeghā viśrāṃtā yasya sānuni || 53 || pravṛtte bhūtasaṃhāre prakṛtau pratisaṃcare || bhaviṣyatsarvabījāni niṣeduryatra niścayam || 54 || mayā cāhūyamānebhyaḥ pralayānaṃtaraṃ punaḥ || yatpādaseviviprebhyo vedādhyayanasaṃgrahaḥ || 55 || sarvāsāmapi vidyānāṃ kalānāṃ śāstrasaṃpadām || āgamānāṃ ca vedānāṃ yatra satyavyavasthitiḥ || 56 || yadguhāgahvarāṃtassthā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || jaṭinaḥ saṃprakāśaṃte koṭisūryāgnitejasaḥ || 57 || paṃcabrahmamayairmaṃtraiḥ paṃcākṣaravapurdharaiḥ || akārapīṭhikārūḍho nādātmā yaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 58 || aṣṭabhiśca sadā liṃgairaṣṭadikpālapūjitaḥ || aṣṭamūrttitayā yo'yamaṣṭasiddhipradāyakaḥ || 59 || yatra siddhāstathā lokānsvānsvānmuktvā sureśvarāḥ|| apekṣaṃte sthitā muktiṃ vihāya kanakācalam ||1.3.1.2.60|| evaṃ vasuṃdharāpuṇyaparipākasamuccayaḥ || aruṇādririti khyāto bhaktabhaktivarapradaḥ ||61|| kailāsānmeruśikharādāgatairdevasaṃcayaiḥ || pūjyate śoṇaśailātmā śaṃbhuḥ sarvavarapradaḥ ||62|| iti kamalajavaktrapadmajāṃ taṃ muditamanāḥ sanako niśamya bhaktyā || viracitavinayaḥ praṇamya putraḥ pitaramapṛcchadaśeṣavedasāram || 63 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe brahmaviṣṇustutipūrvakaṃ śaṃkarasya sthāvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || cha ||
<1.3.1.3>
|| sanaka uvāca || || bhagavannaruṇādrīśa māhātmyamidamadbhutam || śrutaṃ śivaprasādena dayayā te jagadguroḥ || 1 || āścaryametanmāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || ārādhayanpunaḥ ke vā varadaṃ śoṇaparvatam || 2 || anādiraṃtarahitaḥ śivaḥ śoṇacalākṛtiḥ || yuvayostapasā deva varadānāya saṃsthitaḥ || ||3|| sakṛtsaṃkīrtite nāmni śoṇādririti muktide || sannidhiḥ sarvakāmānāṃ jāyate cāghanāśanam ||4|| śivaśabdāmṛtāsvādaḥ śivārcanakathākramaḥ|| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ || 5 || uvāca karuṇāmūrtiraruṇādrīśamānaman || || brahmovāca || || śrūyatāṃ vatsa pārvatyāścaritaṃ yatpurātanam || 6 || aruṇādrīśamāśritya yathā sā nirvṛtābhavat || āsasāda mahādevaḥ kadācitpārvatīpatiḥ || 7 || ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ ratnatoraṇasaṃyutam || ratnapuṣpaphalopeta kalpadrumamanoharam || 8 || parārdhya dṛṣadāstīrṇaṃ baddhamuktāvitānakam || vimuktapuṣpaprakaradivyadhūporusaurabham || 9 || pralaṃbamālikājālaninadadbhṛṃgasaṃkulam || divyatūryaghanārāvapranṛtyadguhavāhanam || 1.3.1.3.10 || pārvatīsiṃhasaṃcāraparitrastamahāgajam || apsarobhiḥ pranarttābhirgāyaṃtībhiśca kevalam || 11 || āsevitapuroraṃgaṃ dikpālakaniṣevitam || ṛgyajuḥsāmajairmaṃtraiḥ stuvadbhirmunipuṃgavaiḥ || 12 || brahmarṣibhistathā devaiḥ siddhai rājarṣibhivṛtam || gaṇaiśca vividhākārairbhasmālaṃkṛtavigrahaiḥ || 13 || rudrākṣadhārasubhagairāpūrṇaṃ śivatatparaiḥ || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāditauryatrikajanisvanaiḥ |||14 || ghaṃṭāṭaṃkārasubhagairvedadhvanivimiśritaiḥ || manoharaṃ mahādivyamāsanaṃ pārvatīsakhaḥ || 15 || alaṃcakāra bhagavanbhaktānugrahakāmyayā || āsthāya vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sarvatejomayaṃ śivam || 16 || aṃbikāsahitaḥ śrīmānvijahāra dayānidhiḥ || saṃgītena kathābhedairdyūtakrīḍāvikalpanaiḥ || 17 || gaṇānāṃ vikaṭairnṛtyai ramayāmāsa pārvatīm || visṛjya sakalāndevānṛṣīṃścāpi sabhāsadaḥ || 18 || varānpradāya vividhānbhaktalokāya vāñchitān || āgameṣu vicitreṣu sarvartukusumeṣu ca || 19 || vijahāromayā sārddhaṃ ratnaprāsādapaṃktiṣu || vāpikāsu manojñāsu ratnasopānapaṃktiṣu || 1.3.1.3.20 || keliparvataśṛṃgeṣu hemaraṃbhāvanāṃtare || gaṃgātaraṃgaśītena phullapaṃkajagaṃdhinā || 21 || vātena maṃdagatinā vihāravihataśramaḥ || svakāmataḥ svayaṃ devaḥ preyasīmabhyanandayat || 22 || ratirūpāṃ śivāṃ devīṃ sarvasaubhāgyasundarīm || kadācidrahasi prītā nijājñāvaśavarttinam || 23 || ramaṇaṃ jānatī mugdhā paścādabhyetya sādaram || karābhyāṃ kamalābhābhyāṃ triṇetrāṇi jagadguroḥ || 24 || pidadhe līlayā śaṃbhoḥ kimetaditi kautukāt || candrādityāgnirūpeṇa pihiteṣvakṣiṣu kramāt || 25 || andhakāro'bhavattatra cirakālaṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ || nimiṣārddhena devasya jagmurvatsarakoṭayaḥ || 26 || devīlīlāsamutthena tamasābhūjjagatkṣayaḥ || tamasā pūritaṃ viśvamapāreṇa samantataḥ ||27|| śūnyaṃ jyotiḥ pracāreṇa vināśaṃ pratyapadyata || na vyajṛṃbhata vibudhā na ca vedāścakāśire ||28|| nāpi jīvāḥ samabhavannavyaktaṃ kevalaṃ sthitam || jagatāmapi sarveṣāmakāle vīkṣya saṃkṣayam ||29|| tapasā labdhasphūrtīnāṃ vicāraḥ samapadyata || kimetattamaso janma bhuvanakṣayakāraṇam || 1.3.1.3.30 || bhagavānapi sarvātmā na nūnaṃ kālamākṣipat || devī vinodarūpeṇa pidhatte purajiddṛśaḥ || 31 || tenedamakhilaṃ jātaṃ nistejo bhuvanatrayam || akālatamasā vyāpte sakale bhuvanatraye || 32 || kā gatirlabdharājyānāṃ tapaso devajanmanām || na yajñāḥ saṃpravartaṃte na pūjyante surā bhuvi || 33 || iti niścitya manasā vīkṣya te jñānacakṣuṣā || nityāste sūrayo bhaktyā śaṃbhumāgamya tuṣṭuvuḥ || 34 || namaḥ sarvajagatkartre śivāya paramātmane || māyayā śaktirūpeṇa pṛthagbhāvamupeyuṣe || 35 || avinābhāvinī śaktirādyaikā śivarūpiṇī || līlayā jagadutpattirakṣāsaṃhṛtikāriṇī || 36 || ardhāṃgī sā tava deva śivaśaktyātmakaṃ vapuḥ || eka eva mahādevo na pare tvadvinā vibho || 37 || līlayā tava lokoyamakāle pralayaṃ gataḥ || karuṇā tava nirvyājā varddhatāṃ lokavarddhanī || 38 || bhavato nimiṣārddhena tejasāmupasaṃhṛteḥ || gatānyanekavarṣāṇi jagatāṃ nāśahetave || 39 || tataḥ prasīda karuṇāmūrtte kāla sadāśiva || virama praṇayārabdhādamuṣmāllokasaṃkṣayāt || 1.3.1.3.40 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhaktānāṃ siddhiśālinām || visṛjākṣoṇi gaurīti karuṇāmūrttirabravīt || 41 || visasarja ca sā devī pidhānaṃ haracakṣuṣām || somasūryāgnirūpāṇāṃ prakāśamabhavajjagat || 42 || kiyānkālo gataśceti pṛṣṭaiḥ siddhaiśca vai nataiḥ || uktaṃ tvannimiṣārddhena jagmurvatsarakoṭayaḥ || 43 || atha devaḥ kṛpāmūrttirālokya vihasanpriyām || abravītparamodāraḥ paraṃ dharmārthasaṃgraham || 44 || avicārya kṛtaṃ mugdhe bhuvanakṣayakāraṇāt || ayuktamiha paśyāmi jaganmātustavaiva hi || 45 || ahamapyakhilām̐llokānsaṃhariṣyāmi saṃkṣaye || prāpte kāle tvayā maugdhyādakāle pralayaṃ gatāḥ || 46 || keyaṃ vā tvādṛśī kuryādīdṛśaṃ sadvigarhitam || karma narmaṇyapi sadā kṛpāmūrtirna bādhate || 47 || iti śambhorvacaḥ śrutvā dharmalopabhayākulā || kiṃ kariṣyāmi tacchāṃtyā ityapṛcchatsma taṃ priyā || 48 || atha devaḥ prasannātmā vyājahāra dayānidhiḥ || devyāstenānutāpena bhaktyā ca toṣitaḥ śivaḥ || 49 || manmūrtestava keyaṃ vā prāyaścittirihocyate || athāpi dharmamārgoyaṃ tvayaiva paripālyate || 1.3.1.3.50 || śrutismṛtikriyākalpā vidyāśca vibudhādayaḥ || tvadrūpametadakhilaṃ mahadarthosmi tanmayaḥ || 51 || mānyayābhinnayā devyā bhāvyaṃ lokasisṛkṣayā || || 52 || tasmāllokānurūpaṃ te prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate || ṣaḍvidho gadito dharmaḥ śrutismṛtivicārataḥ || 53 || svāminā nānupālyeta yadi tyājyo'nujīvibhiḥ || na tvāṃ vihāya śaknomi kṣaṇamapyāsituṃ kvacit || 54 || ahameva tapaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmyātmani sthitaḥ || pṛdhvī ca sakalā bhūyāttapasā saphalā tava || 55 || tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśāttvattapodarśanādapi || nirasyaṃti svasānnidhyādduṣṭajātamupadravam || 56 || karmabhūmestvamādhikyahetave puṇyamācara || tvattapaścaraṇaṃ loke vīkṣya sarvopi saṃtatam || 57 || dharme dṛḍhatarā buddhiṃ nibadhnīyānna saṃśayaḥ || kṛtārthayiṣyati mahīṃ dayā te dharmapālanaiḥ || 58 || tvamevaitatsakalaṃ proktā vedairdevi sanātanaiḥ || asti kāṃcīpurī khyātā sarvabhūtisamanvitā || 59 || yā divaṃ devasaṃpūrṇā pratyakṣayati bhūtale || yatra kṛtaṃ tapaḥ kiṃcidanaṃtaphalamucyate || 1.3.1.3.60 || devāśca munayaḥ sarve vāsaṃ vāṃchaṃti saṃtatam || tatra kaṃpeti vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī || ||61|| yatra sthitānāṃ martyānāṃ kampante pāpakoṭayaḥ || tatra cūtadrumaścaiko rājate nityapallavaḥ ||62|| saṃpūrṇaśītalacchāyaḥ prasūnaphalapallavaiḥ || tatra japtaṃ hutaṃ dattamanantaphaladaṃ bhavet || 63 || gaṇāśca vividhākārā ḍākinyo yoginīgaṇāḥ || paritastvāṃ niṣevaṃtāṃ viṣṇumukhyāstathā parāḥ ||64|| ahaṃ ca niṣkalo bhūtvā tava mānasapaṃkaje || sannidhāsyāmi mā bhūstvaṃ devi madvirahākulā || 65 || ityuktā devadevena devī kaṃpāṃtikaṃ yayau || tapaḥ kartuṃ sakhīyuktā vismayākrāntalocanā ||66 || kaṃpāṃ ca vimalāṃ sindhuṃ munisamaghaniṣevitām || ālokya komaladalamekāmraṃ dṛṣṭivāraṇam || 67 || phalapuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ kokilālāpasaṃkulam || prasasāda punardevaṃ sasmāra ca maheśvaram || 68 || kāmāgniparivītāṃgī tapaḥkṣāmeva sā'bhavat || abhyabhāṣata sā gaurī vijayāṃ pārśvavarttinīm || 69 || kāmaśokaparītāṃgī purārivirahākulā || 1.3.1.3.70 || imamaghaharamāgatāniśaṃ svayamapi pūjayituṃ tapobhirīśam || ayamabhinavapallavaprasūnaḥ smarayati māṃ smarabandhurekacūtaḥ || 71 || kathamiva virahaḥ śivasya sahyaḥ kṣubhitadhiyātra bhṛśaṃ manobhavena || tadapi ca taruṇeṃducūḍapādasmaraṇamahauṣadhamekameva dṛṣṭam || 72 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārddhe pārvatyāḥ śivanetramīlanena tamasā kṣubdhalokapāpabhayena kāṃcyāṃ kaṃpāsthitaikāmratale tapaścaryārthamāgamanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<1.3.1.4>
|| brahmovāca || || athābhyadhatta vijayā praṇamya jagadambikām || sāṃtvayantī stutiśatairupāyaiḥ śivadarśanaiḥ || 1 || devi tvamavinābhūtā sadā devena śaṃbhunā || prāṇeśvarī tvamekāsi śaktistasya parātmanaḥ || 2 || tathā māyāṃ tvamātmīyāṃ saṃdarśayitumīhase || pṛthagbhāvamiveśānaḥ prakāśayati na svayam || 3 || ādeśaṃ pratigṛhyaiva samupetāsi pārvati || alaṃghanīyā sevājñā śāṃbhavī sarvadā tvayā ||4 || vidhātavyaṃ tapaḥ prāptaṃ sthānesmicchivakalpite || nivṛttya nikhilānkāmācchaṃmumāśritayā tvayā || 5 || anyathāpi jagadrakṣā tvadadhīnā jaganmayi || dharmasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ bhūyaḥ śivena sahitaṃ tava || 6 || niṣkalaṃ śivamatyaṃtaṃ dhyāyaṃtyātmanyavasthitam || viyogaduḥkhaṃ kañcittvaṃ na smariṣyasi pārvati || 7 || bhaktānāṃ tava mukhyānāṃ tavaivācārasaṃgrahaḥ || upadeśitayā loke prathatāṃ dharmavatsale || 8 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā gaurī susthiramānasā || tapaḥ karttuṃ samārebhe kaṃpā nadyāstaṭe śubhe || 9 || vimucya vividhā bhūṣā rudrākṣagaṇabhūṣitā || visṛjya divyaṃ vasanaṃ paryadhādvalkale śubhe || 1.3.1.4.10 || alakaiḥ sahasā śilpamanayacca kapardṛtām || aliṃpata tanūṃ sarvāṃ bhasmanā muktakuṃkumā || 11 || mṛgeṣu kṛtasaṃtoṣā śiloṃchīkṛtavṛttiṣu || jajāpa niyamopetā śivapaṃcākṣaraṃ param || 12 || kṛtvā triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ kampā payasi nirmale || kṛtvā ca saikataṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaram || 13 || vṛkṣapraropaṇairdānairaśeṣātithipūjanaiḥ || śrāṃtiṃ haraṃtī jīvānāṃ devī dharmamapālayat || 14 || grīṣme paṃcāgnimadhyasthā varṣāsu sthaṃḍileśayā || hemante jalamadhyasthā śiśire cākarottapaḥ || 15 || puṇyātmanāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ darśanārthamupeyuṣām || vismayaṃ janayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa sādaram || 16 || kadācitsvayamuccitya vanāṃtātpallavānvitam || puṣpotkaraṃ viśeṣeṇa śodhituṃ samupāviśat || 17 || kṛtvā ca saikataṃ liṃgaṃ kaṃpārodhasi pāvane || saṃpūjayitumārebhe nyāsāvāhanapūrvakam || 18 || sūryamabhyarcya vidhivadraktaiḥ puṣpaiśca caṃdanaiḥ || paṃcāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ kramādānarca śaṃkaram || 19 || dhūpairdīpaśca naivedyairbhaktibhāvasamanvitaiḥ || aparokṣitamīśānamāluloke purohitam || 1.3.1.4.20 || atha devaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātsaṃśodhayitumaṃbikām || kaṃpānadyāḥ pravāheṇa mahatā paryaveṣṭayat || 21 || ativṛddhaṃ pravāhaṃ taṃ kampāyāḥ samupasthitam || ālokya niyamāsīnāmāhuḥ sakhyastadāṃbikām ||22|| uttiṣṭha devi bahulaḥ pravāho'yaṃ vijṛṃbhate || diśāṃ mukhāni saṃpūrya tarasā plāvayiṣyati || 23 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyāyaṃtī mīlitekṣaṇā || unmīlya vegamatulaṃ nadyāstaṃ samavaikṣata || 24 || aciṃtayacca sā devī pūjāvighnasamākulā || kiṃ karomi na śaknomi hātumārabdhamarcanam || 25 || śreyaḥ prāptumavighnena prāyaḥ puṇyātmanāṃ bhuvi || ghaṭate dharmasaṃyogo manorathaphalapradaḥ || 26 || saikataṃ liṃgamatulapravāhāllayameṣyati || liṃganāśe vimoktavyaḥ sadbhaktaiḥ prāṇasaṃgrahaḥ || 27 || pravāho'yaṃ samāyāti śivamāyāvinirmitaḥ || viśodhayitumātmānaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ nije pade || 28 || āliṃgya sudṛḍhaṃ dorbhyāmetalliṃgamanākulam || ahaṃ vatsyāmi yātāśu sakhyo yūyaṃ vidūrataḥ || 29 || ityuktā saikataṃ ligaṃ gāḍhamāliṃgya sāṃbikā || na mumoca pravāhena veṣṭyamānāpi vegataḥ || 1.3.1.4.30 || stanacūcukanirmagnamudrādarśitalāṃchanam || mahāliṃgaṃ svasaṃyuktaṃ praṇanāma tadādarāt || 31 || nimīlitekṣaṇā dhyānaniṣṭhaikahṛdayā sthitā || pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgī sā smaraṃtī sadāśivam || 32 || kaṃpasvedaparitrāṇalajjāpraṇayakelidāt || kṣaṇamapyacalā liṃgānna viyogamapekṣate || 33 || atha tāmabravītkāpi daivī vāgaśarīriṇī || vimuṃca bālike liṃgaṃ pravāho'yaṃ gato mahān ||34|| tvayārcitamidaṃ liṃgaṃ saikataṃ sthiravaibhavam || bhaviṣyati mahābhāge varadaṃ surapūjitam || 35 || tapaścaryāṃ tavālokya racitaṃ dharmapālanam || liṃgaṃ caitannamaskṛtya kṛtārthāḥ saṃtu mānavāḥ || 36 || ahaṃ hi taijasaṃ rūpamāsthāya vasudhātale || vasāmi cātra siddhyarthamaruṇācalasaṃjñayā || 37 || ruṇaddhi sarvalokebhyaḥ paruṣaṃ pāpasaṃcayam || ruṇo na vidyate yasmindṛṣṭe tenāruṇācalaḥ || 38 || ṛṣayaḥ siddhagaṃdharvā mahātmānaśca yoginaḥ || muktvā kailāsaśikharaṃ meruṃ cainamupāsate || 39 || madaṃśa jātayoḥ pūrvaṃ yudhyatorbrahmakṛṣṇayoḥ || ahaṃ mohamapākarttuṃ tejorūpo vyavasthitaḥ || 1.3.1.4.40 || brahmaṇā haṃsarūpeṇa viṣṇunā kroḍarūpiṇā || adṛṣṭaśekharapadaḥ praṇato bhaktiyogataḥ || 41 || tataḥ prasannaḥ pratyakṣastasyāṃ varamabhīpsitam || prādāṃ jagattrayasyāsya saṃrakṣāyāṃ tu kauśalam || 42 || prārthitaśca punastābhyāmaruṇācalasaṃjñayā || anaiṣi taijasaṃ rūpamahaṃ sthāvaraliṃgatām || 43 || gatvā pṛccha mahābhāgaṃ madbhaktiṃ gautamaṃ munim || aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā tatra tapaścara || 44 || tatra te darśayiṣyāmi taijasaṃ rūpamātmanaḥ || sarvapāpanivṛttyarthaṃ sarvalokahitāya ca || 45 || iti vācaṃ samākarṇya niṣkalātkathitāṃ śivāt || tatheti sahasā devī gaṃtuṃ samupacakrame || 46 || atha devānṛṣīnsarvānpaścātsevārthamāgatān || avādīdaṃbikālokya snehapūrṇena cakṣuṣā || 47 || tiṣṭhatātraiva vai devā munayaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ || niyamāṃścādhitiṣṭhaṃtaḥ kaṃpārodhasi pāvane || 48 || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasaubhāgyavarddhanam || pūjyatāṃ saikataṃ liṃgaṃ kucakaṃkaṇalāṃchanam || 49 || ahaṃ ca niṣkalaṃ rūpamāsthāyaitaddivāniśam || ārādhayāmi maṃtreṇa śoṇeśvaraṃ varapradam || 1.3.1.4.50 || mattapaścaraṇālloke maddharmaparipālanāt || malliṃgadarśanāccaiva sidhyaṃtviṣṭavibhūtayaḥ || || 51 || sarvakāmapradānena kāmākṣīmiti kāmataḥ || māṃ praṇamyātra madbhaktā labhaṃtāṃ vāṃchitaṃ varam || 52 || ahaṃ hi devadevasya śaṃbhoravyāhato janaḥ || ādeśaṃ pālayiṣyāmi gatvāruṇamahīdharam || 53 || tatra gatvā tapastīvraṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhuṃ prasādya ca || māṃ tu labdhavarāṃ yūyaṃ paścādrakṣyatha saṃgatāḥ || 54 || iti sarvānvisṛjyāśu sadbhaktānpādasevinaḥ || aruṇādriṃ gatā bālā tapase śaṃkarājñayā || 55 || nityābhisevitā'kāri sakhībhirabhiyogataḥ || āsasādāruṇādrīśaṃ divyaduṃdubhināditam || 56 || aṃtastejomayaṃ śāṃtamaruṇācalanāyakam || apsaronṛtyagītaiśca pūjitaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ || 57 || praṇamya sthāvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kautūhalasamanvitā || siddhānāṃ yogināṃ sārthamṛṣīṇāṃ cānvavaikṣata || 58 || atrirbhṛgurbharadvājaḥ kaśyapaścāṃgirāstathā || kutsaśca gautamaścānye siddhavidyādharāmarāḥ || 59 || tapaḥ kurvaṃti satatamapekṣitavarāptaye || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaścānyāḥ paritaḥ paryupāsate || 1.3.1.4.60 || divyaliṃgamidaṃ pūjyamaruṇādririti smṛtam || vaṃdasveti suraiḥ proktā praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ || 61 || abhyarthitā punaḥ sarvairātithyārthe maharṣibhiḥ || śivājñayā gautamo me draṣṭavya iti sāvadat || 62 || ayamatrarṣibhirbhaktairnirdiṣṭaṃ tamathābhyagāt || sa muniḥ śivabhaktānāṃ prathamastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 63 || vanāṃtaraṃ gateḥ prātaḥ samitkuśaphalāhṛteḥ || atithīnāśramaṃ prāptānarcatheti dṛḍhavratān || 64 || śiṣyānādiśya dharmātmā gataśca vipināṃtaram || atha sā gautamaṃ draṣṭumāgatā parṇaśālikām ||65|| kva gato munirityuktairita āyāsyati kṣaṇāt || śiṣyairabhyarthitetyuktvā phalamūlaissugaṃdhibhiḥ || 66 || abhyutthānenāsanena pādyenārgheṇa sūnṛtaiḥ || vacanaiḥ phalamṛlena sārcitā śiṣyasaṃpadā || 67 || kṣaṇaṃ kṣamasvasūnustāmanye jagmustadantikam || devyāṃ praviṣṭamātrāyāṃ maharṣerāśramo mahān || 68 || abhavatkalpabahulo maṇiprāsādasaṃkulaḥ || vanāṃtarādupāvṛttya samitkuśaphalāharaḥ || 69 || apaśyatsvāśramaṃ dūre vimānaśataśobhitam || kimetaditi sāścaryaṃ ciṃtayanmunipuṃgavaḥ || 1.3.1.4.70 || gauryāḥ samāgamaṃ sarvamapaśyajjñānacakṣuṣā || śīghraṃ nivartamāno'sau draṣṭuṃ tāṃ lokamātaram || 71 || śiṣyaiḥ śīghracarairvṛttamāveditamathāśṛṇot || 72 || atha maharṣirupāgatakautuko nijatapaḥphalameva tadāgamam || śivadayākalitaṃ paricintayannabhajadāśramamāśritavatsalaḥ || 73 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe pārvatyāḥ kaṃpāyā aruṇācale gautamāśramāgamanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4 || ||
<1.3.1.5>
|| brahmovāca || || araṇyādgautamaṃ śāṃtamuṭajadvāra āgatam || pratyādhātuṃ pravavṛte śivabhaktirjaganmayī ||1|| āluloke samāyātaṃ gautamaṃ śiṣyasevitam || laṃbamānaśiraḥśmaśrusampūrṇamukhamaṇḍalam ||2|| jaṭābhiratitāmrābhistīrthasnānaviśuddhibhiḥ || nyastarudrākṣamaṇibhirjvālābhiriva pāvakam |||| 3 || bhasmatripuṇḍrakopetaviśālaniṭilojvalam || śuklayajñopavītena pūrṇaṃ rudrākṣadāmabhiḥ || 4 || dadhānaṃ valkale rakte tapaḥ kṛśitavigraham || japaṃtaṃ vaidikānmaṃtrānrudraprītikarānbahūn || 5 || śambhunāvasitodāttasārūpyamiva bhāṣitam || tejonidhiṃ dayāpūrṇaṃ pratyakṣamiva bhāskaram || 6 || ālokya taṃ mahātmānaṃ vṛddhaṃ śaṃbhupadāśrayam || kṛtāṃjalipuṭā gaurī praṇantumupacakrame || 7 || kṛtāṃjaliṃ munirvīkṣya samastajagadambikām || kimetaditi sāścaryaṃ vārayanpraṇanāma saḥ || 8 || svāgataṃ gauri subhage lokamātardayānidhe || vyājena bhaktasaṃrakṣāṃ kartumatrāgatāsyaho || 9 || aho mānye mānyamarthaṃ vijñāyaiva purā vayam || pṛthagbhāvamivālaṃbya śiṣyādibhiḥ samāgatāḥ || 1.3.1.5.10 || yaddevi te na cetkiṃcinmāyāvilasitannijam || tataḥ prapaṃcasaṃsiddhiḥ kathameva bhaviṣyati || 11 || tiṣṭhatvaśeṣaṃ me vaktuṃ māyāvilasitaṃ tava || na śakyate yannirṇetuṃ tvadīyaiśca kadācana || || 12 || āsyatāṃ pāvane śuddhaṃ āsane kuśanirmite || gṛhyatāṃ pādyamarghaṃ ca dattaṃ ca vidhivanmayā || 13 || iti śiṣyaiḥ samānīte darbhāṃke paramāsane|| āsīnāmaṃbikāṃ vṛddho munirānarca bhaktimān ||14|| nivedya sakalāṃ pūjāṃ bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ || gauryā samabhyanujñātaḥ svayamapyāsane sthitaḥ||15|| uvāca daśanajyotsnāparidhautadiśāmukhaḥ || pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgaḥ sānaṃdāśru sagadgadam || 16 || aho devasya māhātmyaṃ śambhoramitatejasaḥ || sadbhakta rakṣaṇāya tvāmādiśadbhaktavatsalaḥ || 17 || asiddhamanyallabdhavyaṃ kiṃ vānyattava vidyate || ambaitadbhaktimāhātmyaṃ saṃdarśayitumīśvaraḥ || 18 || kailāsaśailavṛttāṃtaḥ kaṃpātaṭatapaḥsthitaḥ || aruṇādrisamādeśaḥ sarvaṃ jñātamidaṃ mayā || 19 || āgatāsi mahābhāge bhaktāśramamimaṃ svayam || snehena karuṇāmūrte karttavyamupadiśyatām || 1.3.1.5.20 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā maharṣeḥ sarvavedinaḥ || aṃbikā prāha kutukātstuvantī taṃ mahāmunim || 21 || mahāvaibhavametatte devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ || madhye tapasvināṃ tvaṃ tu draṣṭavya iti cādiśat || 22 || āgamānāṃ śivoktānāṃ vedānāmapi pāragaḥ || tapasā śaṃbhubhaktānāṃ tvameva śivasaṃmataḥ || 23 || aruṇācala nāmnāhaṃ tiṣṭhāmītyabravīcchivaḥ ||| asyācalasya māhātmyaṃ śrotavyaṃ ca bhavanmukhāt || 24 || prāptāsmyahaṃ tapaḥ kartumaruṇācalasannidhau || bhavatāṃ darśanādeva svayamīśaḥ prasīdati || 25 || śivabhaktena saṃbhāṣā śivasaṃkīrttanaśravaḥ || śivaliṃgārcanaṃ loke vapurgrahaphalodayaḥ || 26 || tasmānmamaitanmāhātmyaṃ śrotavyaṃ bhavato mukhāt || suvyaktamupadeśena jñānato'si pitā mama || 27 || iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā gautamastapasāṃ nidhiḥ || ācakhyau giriśaṃ dhyāyannaruṇācalavaibhavam || 28 || ajñātamiva yatkiṃcitpṛcchyate ca punastvayā || avaimi sarvavidyānāṃ māyā śaivī tvameva sā || 29 || athavā bhaktavaktreṇa śivavaibhavasaṃśravaḥ || śikṣaṇaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ teṣāṃ tava tuṣṭeśca kāraṇam || 1.3.1.5.30 || paṭhitānāṃ ca vedānāṃ yadāvṛttaphalāvaham || vadatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ loke śivasaṃkīrttanaṃ tathā || 31 || saphalānyadya sarvāṇi tapāṃsi caritāni me || yadahaṃ śaṃbhunādiṣṭaṃ māhātmyaṃ kīrttaye śrutam || 32 || śivāśivaprasādena māhātmyamidamadbhutam || 33 || aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ duritakṣayakāraṇam || śrūyatāmanavadyāṃgi purāvṛttamidaṃ mahat || 34 || aruṇādrimayaṃ liṃgamāvirbhūtaṃ yathā purā || na śakyate punarvaktumaśeṣaṃ vaktrakoṭibhiḥ || 35 || aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ brahmaṇāmapi koṭibhiḥ|| brahmaṇā viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ somabhāskaravahnibhiḥ || 36 || indrādibhiśca dikpālaiḥ pūjitaścāṣṭasiddhaye || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharva yakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ || 37 || khagaiśca munibhirdivyaiḥ siddhayogibhirarcitaḥ || tattatpāpanivṛttyarthaṃ tattadīpsitasiddhaye || 38 || ārādhito'yaṃ bhagavānaruṇādripatiḥ śivaḥ || dṛṣṭo harati pāpāni sevito vāṃchitapradaḥ || 39 || kīrtitopi janairdūraiḥ śoṇādririti muktidaḥ || tejaḥstaṃbhamayaṃ rūpamaruṇādririti śrutam || 1.3.1.5.40 || dhyāyanto yoginaścitte śivasāyujyamāpnuyuḥ || dattaṃ hutaṃ ca yatkiṃcijjaptaṃ cānyattapaḥ kṛtam || 41 || akṣayyaṃ bhavati prāptamaruṇācalasaṃnidhau || purā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivatejoṃśasaṃbhavau ||42|| sāhaṃkārau yuyudhatuḥ parasparajigīṣayā || tathā tayorgarvaśāṃtyai yogidhyeyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 43|| agnitejomayaṃ rūpamādimadhyāṃtavarjitam || saṃprāpya tasthau tanmadhye diśo daśa vibhāsayan || 44 || tejaḥstaṃbhasya tasyātha draṣṭumādyaṃtabhāgayoḥ || haṃsakroḍatanū kṛtvā jagmaturdyāṃ rasātalam || 45 || tau viṣaṇṇamukhau dṛṣṭvā bhagavānkaruṇānidhiḥ || āvirbabhūva ca tayorvaraṃ prādādabhīpsitam ||46|| tatprārthitaśca deveśo yātaḥ sthāvaraliṃgatām || aruṇādririti khyātaḥ praśāṃtaḥ saṃprakāśate ||47|| divyadundubhinirghoṣairapsarogītanarttanaiḥ|| pūjyate taijasaṃ liṃgaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiśataiḥ sadā || 48 || brahmaṇāmapyatītānāṃ purā ṣaṇṇavateḥ prabhuḥ || viṣṇunābhisamudbhūto brahmā lokānsasarja hi || 49 || sa kadācittapovighnaṃ kartukāmena yoginām || iṃdreṇa prārthito brahmā sasarja lalitāṃ striyam || 1.3.1.5.50 || lāvaṇyaguṇasaṃpūrṇāmālokya kamalekṣaṇām || mumoha kaṃdarpaśaraiḥ sa viddhahṛdayo vidhiḥ || 51 || spraṣṭukāmaṃ tamālokya brahmāṇaṃ kamalāsanam || natvā pradakṣiṇavyājādgaṃtumaicchadvarāpsarāḥ || 52 || asyāṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ bhaktyā kurvāṇāyāṃ prajāpateḥ || catasṛbhyo'pi digbhyo'sya mukhānyudabhavankṣaṇāt || 53 || sā bālā pakṣiṇī bhūtvā gaganaṃ samagāhata || punaśca khagarūpeṇa samāyāṃtaṃ samīkṣya sā || 54 || śaraṇaṃ yācamānā sā śoṇādrimimamāśrayat || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā ca tvamadṛṣṭapadaśekharaḥ || 55 || rakṣa māmaruṇādrīśa śaraṇya śaraṇāgatām || iti tasyāṃ bhayārttāyāṃ krośaṃtyāmaruṇācalāt || 56 || udabhūtsthāvarālliṃgādvyādhaḥ kaściddhanurddharaḥ || saṃdhāya sāyakaṃ cāpe sameghagaganadyutiḥ || 57 || niṣāde purato dṛṣṭe mohastasya nanāśa hi || tataḥ prasannahṛdayotinamraḥ kamalodbhavaḥ|| 58 || namaścakre śaraṇyāya śoṇādripataye tadā || sarvapāpakṣayakṛte namastubhyaṃ pinākine || 59 || aruṇācalarūpāya bhakvavaśyāya śaṃbhave || ajānatāṃ svabhaktānāmakarmavinivarttane || 1.3.1.5.60 || tvadanyaḥ kaḥ prabhuḥ kartumaśakyaṃ cāpi dehinām || upasaṃhara me dehaṃ tejasā pāpaniścayam || 61 || anyaṃ vā sṛja viśvātmanbrahmāṇaṃ lokasṛṣṭaye || atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śivo dīnasya vedhasaḥ || 62 || uvāca karuṇāmūrtirbhūtvā caṃdrārddhaśekharaḥ || dattaḥ kālastava mayā puraiva na nivartyate || 63 || kaṃ vā rāgādayo doṣā na bādheranprabhusthitam || tasmāddūrasthito'pyetadaruṇācalasaṃjñitam||64|| bhajasva taijasaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvadoṣanivṛttaye || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ vā ca yadbhavet ||65|| vinaśyati kṣaṇātsarvamaruṇācaladarśanāt || pradakṣiṇā namaskāraiḥ smaraṇairarcanaiḥ stavaiḥ ||66|| aruṇādrirayaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ || kailāse meruśṛṃge vā svasthāneṣu kalādriṣu ||67|| saṃdṛśyaḥ kaścidevāhamaruṇādrirayaṃ svayam || yacchṛṃgadarśanānnṝṇāṃ cakṣurlābhena kevalam || 68 || bhavetsarvāghanāśaśca lābhaśca jñānacakṣuṣaḥ || madaṃśasaṃbhavo brahmā svanāmnā brahmapuṣkare || 69 || atra snātaḥ purā brahmanmoho'gājjagatīpateḥ || snātvā tvaṃ brahmatīrthe māṃ samabhyarcya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 1.3.1.5.70 || maunī pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā viśvātmanbhava vijvaraḥ ||71|| iti vacanamudīrya viśvanāthaṃ sthitamaruṇācalarūpato maheśam || atha sarasi nimajya padmajanmā duritaharaṃ samapūjayatkrameṇa||72|| imamaruṇagirīśameṣa vedhā yamaniyamādiviśuddhacittayogaḥ || sphuṭataramabhipūjya sopacāraṃ gatadurito'tha jagāma cādhipatyam ||73|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe brahmapuṣkaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5|| ||
<1.3.1.6>
|| gautama uvāca || || purā nārāyaṇaḥ kalpe śayānaḥ salilārṇave || śeṣaparyaṃkaśayane kadācinnaiva budhyata || 1 || tamasā pūritaṃ viśvamapajñātamalakṣaṇam || vīkṣya kalpāvasāne'pi viṣedurnityasūrayaḥ||2|| aho kaṣṭamidaṃ rūpaṃ tamasā viśvamohanam || yena kalpāvasānepi viṣṇurnādyāpi budhyate ||3|| jyotiṣaḥ puruṣaṃ pūrṇamapaśyaṃtaṃ surā api || kathaṃ vā tamasaḥ śāṃtiṃ labheranparibhāvinaḥ ||4|| iti niścitya manasā devadevamumāpatim || ciṃtayāmāsurātmasthaṃ tejorāśiṃ niraṃjanam || 5 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃstejorāśirmaheśvaraḥ || viśvāvanāya vijñaptaḥ praṇatairnityasūribhiḥ || 6 || tatastejomayācchaṃbhoḥ sphuliṃgāṃśusamudbhavāḥ || udastaṃbhaṃta devānāṃ trayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ ||7|| bodhitaḥ sakalairdevaiḥ samutthāya ramāpatiḥ|| prabhātaṃ vīkṣya sakalaṃ manasyevamacintayat || 8 || mayā tamasi udrekādakāle śayanaṃ kṛtam || prabodhāya paraṃ jyotiḥ svayaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sadāśivaḥ || 9 || jagadutpattikṛtyāni svayaṃ kartuṃ vyavasyati || kiṃ mayātra punaḥ kāryaṃ brahmaṇā vā svayaṃbhuvā||| 1.3.1.6.10|| dhiṅmāṃ sthitamanātmajñaṃ nidrayā hṛtacetasam || athavā sarvakartāraṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkaram || 1 1|| sarvadoṣapraśamanaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || pavitramalpapuṇyānāṃ durlabhaṃ śaṃbhudarśanam ||12|| ciṃtayannevamātmasthaṃ jyotirliṃgaṃ sadāśivam || praṇanāma harirbhaktyā devamaṣṭāṃgato muhuḥ||13|| viśvasraṣṭāramīśānaṃ tuṣṭāva duritacchidam || atha tejomayaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam || 14|| anugṛhya kaṭākṣaistaṃ samuttiṣṭhetyabhāṣata || utthāya karuṇāpūrṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ caṃdrārddhaśekharam ||15|| namastribhuvaneśāya trimūrtiguṇadhāriṇe || tridevavapuṣe tubhyaṃ tridṛśe tripuradruhe || 16 || tvameva jagatāmīśo nijāṃśairdevatāmayaiḥ || kāryakāraṇarūpeṇa karoṣi svecchayā kriyāḥ || 17 || māṃ niyujya jagadguptau parimohya ca māyayā || na doṣamuta saṃkalpaṃ vihātumapi necchasi || 18 || kiṃ karomi jaganmūrttau nyastabhāro'smyahaṃ tvayi || na doṣamīhase nūnamakālaśayanena mām || 19 || hara śambho harerārtimanutāpaṃ samīkṣya saḥ || ādideśa haraḥ śrīmānprāyaścittaṃ hareridam || 1.3.1.6.20 || aruṇācalarūpeṇa tiṣṭhāmi vasudhātale || tasya darśanamātreṇa bhavitā te tamaḥ kṣayaḥ || 21 || pūrvasmai viṣṇave tatra varo datto mayā purā|| tadaiva taijasaṃ liṃgamaruṇācala saṃjñitam || tejomayamidaṃ rūpaṃ praśāṃtaṃ lokarakṣaṇāt|| yadagnimayamavyaktamapāraguṇavaibhavam|| 23|| nadīnāṃ nirjharāṇāṃ ca meghamuktāṃbhasāmapi || aṃtarjyotirmayatvena layastatraiva dṛśyate || 24 || aṃdhānāṃ dṛṣṭilābhena paṃgūnāṃ pādasaṃcaraiḥ || aputrāṇāṃ ca putrāptyā mūkānāṃ vākpravṛttibhiḥ || 25 || sarvasiddhipradānena sarvavyādhivimocanaiḥ || sarvapāpapraśamanairyatsarvavaradaṃ sthitam || 26 || ityuktāṃtardadhe śambhurhariścaivāruṇācalam || āgatya tapa āsthāya śoṇācalamupāsta ca || 27 || tamadriṃ parito dṛṣṭvā surānkānanasaṃśrayān || ṛṣīṇāmāśramānpuṇyānsthāpayāmāsa vai hariḥ || vedānsāṃgopaniṣadānsamaṃtānmūrtidhāriṇaḥ || 28 || sasarja divyarūpāṇāṃ śatamapsarasāṃ kulam || nṛtyairgītaiśca vāditraissevadhvamiti cādiśat || 29 || snātvā brahmasarasyasminviṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārāmumaruṇādriṃ samarcitam || 1.3.1.6.30 || apāpaḥ sarvalokānāmādhipatyaṃ ca labdhavān || ramayā sahito nityamabhirūpasurūpayā || 31 || bhāskarastejasāṃ rāśirasurairapi pīḍitaḥ || brahmopadeśādānarca bhaktyāruṇagirīśvaram || 32 || nimajjya vimale tīrthe pāvane brahmanirmite || pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārainamaruṇārdri svayaṃprabhum || 33 || aśeṣadaityavijayaṃ labdhvā merupradakṣiṇam || lebhe ca paramaṃ tejaḥ paratejaḥpraṇāśanam || 34 || dakṣaśāpānalākrāṃtassomaḥ śivavacobalāt || aruṇācalamabhyarcya labdharūpo'bhavatpunaḥ || 35 || agnirbrahmarṣiśāpena yakṣmarogaprapīḍitaḥ || apūto'pi pavitro'bhūdaruṇācalasevayā || 36 || śakro vṛtraṃ balaṃ pākaṃ namuciṃ jṛṃbhamuddhṛtam || śivalabdhavarāndaityānpurā hatvā jagatpatīn || 37 || pātakaiśca parikṣīṇastathā lokāṃtamāśritaḥ || śambhuṃ prasādya tapasā śivena paricoditaḥ|| 38 || aruṇādriṃ samabhyarcya vipāpo'bhūtsurādhipaḥ || iṣṭvā ca hayamedhena prīṇayāmāsa śaṃkaram || 39 || labdhvā cendrapadaṃ śakraḥ śatamapsarasāṃkulam || sevārthamādiśanchrīmāndivyaduṃdabhisevayā || 1.3.1.6.40 || puṣpameghānsamādiśya divyābhiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ || samarcayati śoṇādriṃ divi nityaṃ ca vaṃdate || 41 || śeṣo'pi śoṇaśaileśaṃ samabhyarcya śivājñayā || abhajatkāmarūpatvaṃ mahīmaṇḍaladhārakaḥ || 42 || anye nāgāśca gandharvāḥ siddhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || dikpālāśca tamabhyarcya lebhire'pekṣitānvarān || 43 || devairaśeṣairdaityādīñjetukāmaiḥ samudyataiḥ || prārthitaḥ sarvato'bhīṣṭavarado'ruṇabhūdharaḥ || 44 || tvaṣṭrā viracitākāra ādityastejasā tapan || grahanāthastu śoṇādriṃ vilaṃghayitumudyataḥ || 45 || rathavāhāḥ punastasya śaktihīnāḥ śramaṃ gatāḥ || so'pi śriyā vihīnaśca jātaḥ goṇādritejasā || 46 || nāśaknocca divaṃ gantuṃ sarvagatyāṃśumālinaḥ || sa tu brahmopadeśena samārādhyāruṇācalam || 47 || prītyā tasmādvibhorlebhe mārgaṃ vyomno hayāñchubhān || tataḥ prabhṛti tigmāṃśuḥ sa hi śoṇākhyaparvatam || 48 || na laṃghayati kiṃ tvasya pradakṣiṇaparikramaiḥ || dakṣayāgaparidhvastā hīnāṃgāstridaśāḥ purā || 49 || aruṇācalamārādhya navānyaṃgāni lebhire || pūṣā dantaṃ śikhī hastaṃ bhago netraṃ tvakhaṃḍitam || 1.3.1.6.50 || ghrāṇaṃ vāṇī ca lebhe sā śoṇācalaniṣevaṇāt || bhārgavaḥ kṣīṇanetrassa viṣṇuhastakuśāgrataḥ || 51 || balidattāvanīdānajaladhārānirodhataḥ || sa tu śoṇācalaṃ gatvā tapaḥ kṛtvātiduṣkaram || 52 || lebhe netraṃ ca pūtātmā bhāskarākhye girau sthitaḥ || aruṇācalanāthasya sevayā sūryasārathiḥ || 53 || pratardanākhyo nṛpatirgrahītuṃ devakanyakām || aruṇādripatergānaṃ kurvaṃtīṃ sādaro'bhavat || 54 || kṣaṇātkapimukho jāto maṃtribhiścodito nṛpaḥ || pratyarpya tāṃ punaścānyāḥ prādādaruṇabhūbhṛte || 55 || tataścārumukhojātaḥ prasādādaruṇeśituḥ || sāyujyamasmai sakalaṃ dattavānbhaktibhāvataḥ ||56|| aruṇācalanāthasyasaṃnidhau jñānadurbalaḥ || gaṃdharvaḥ puṣpakākhyastu bhaktihīno hyagātpurā || 57 || tato vyāghramukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṃdharvaparicārakāḥ || kimetaditi sāścaryaṃ paprachuste parasparam || 58 || atha nārada nirdiṣṭamavajñāphalamātmanaḥ || buddhvāruṇādriṃ saṃpūjya punaśca sumukho'bhavat || 59 || śivabhūmiriyaṃ khyātā parito yojanadvayam || muktistatra pramītānāṃ kadāpi vilayo na hi || 1.3.1.6.60 || saptarṣayaḥ purā bhūmau śāpadoṣasamanvitāḥ || siṣevireruṇādriṃ vai nātho jñātvā viniścayam || 61 || śāpamokṣaṃ dadau śrīmānsaptarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām || saptarṣibhiḥ kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || 62 || śoṇācalasya nikaṭe dṛśyate pāvanaṃ śubham || paṃgurmuniḥ śoṇaśailātpādau labdhuṃ samāgataḥ || 63 || aṃtarhitaprārthitārtho dāruhastapuṭe vahan || jānucaṃkramaṇavyagraḥ śoṇanadyāstaṭaṃ gataḥ || 64 || dāruhastapuṭe tīrthe nicikṣepa pipāsataḥ || jānucaṃkramaṇe tasmindhūrtastoyaṃ pipāsati || 65 || atha śoṇācalaṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ vā dāruhastakaḥ || kimetaditi taṃ pṛcchannādhāvatkalitatparaḥ || 66 || labdhapādaśca sahasā jagāma ca nijālayam || nādrākṣītpuruṣaṃ tatra dāruhastau purogamau || 67 || svayaṃ gṛhītvā cālokya vavaṃde'ruṇaparvatam || nanaṃda labdhacaraṇo labdharūpo mahāmuniḥ || 68 || vismayotphullanayanaiḥ śivabhaktairmahātmabhiḥ || pūjito labdhapādaḥ sañjagāma ca yathāgatam || 69 || vālī śakrasutaḥ śrīmāñchraṃgādudayabhūbhṛtaḥ || astācalasya śikharaṃ pratigantuṃ samudyataḥ || 1.3.1.6.70 || āluloke'ruṇagiriṃ madhye devanamaskṛtam || ūrdhvaṃ gaṃtuṃ samudyuktaḥ kṣīṇavīryo'patadbhuvi || 71 || pitrā śakreṇa saṃgamya coditaḥ śoṇaparvatam || liṃgaṃ taijasamabhyarcya labdhavīryo'bhavatpunaḥ || 72 || nalaḥ pūrvaṃ samabhyarcya svasṛṣṭā mānavapriyāḥ || pālayāmāsa dharmātmā nītisārasamanvitaḥ || 73 || ilaḥ praviśya sahasā gaurīvanamakhaṃḍitam || strībhāvaṃ samanuprāptaḥ papraccha svaṃ purodhasam || 74 || vaśiṣṭhena samādiṣṭaḥ śoṇādriṃ samapūjayat || tapasārādhya deveśaṃ punaḥ puṃstvamupāgataḥ || 75 || somopadeśādbhaktyātha sasmārāruṇaparvatam || īśānugrahato lebhe śāpamokṣaṃ tapodhikaḥ || 76 || lebhe ca paramaṃ sthānamaprāpyamamarairapi || bharato mṛgaśāvasya smaraṇādāyuṣo'tyaye || 77 || na muktiṃ prāpa yogena mṛgajanmani saṃgataḥ || patnīvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāptavānamitaṃ hariḥ || 78 || punarbhṛgūpadeśena śoṇādrimimamarcayan || avatāreṣu sarveṣu sarvaduḥkhānyapākarot || 79 || sarasvatī ca sāvitrī śrīrbhūmiḥ saritastathā || abhyarcya śoṇaśaileśamāpado niratāriṣuḥ || 1.3.1.6.80 || bhāskaraḥ pūrvadigbhāge viśvāmitrastu dakṣiṇe || paścime varuṇo bhāge triśūlaṃ cottarāśrayam || 81 || yojanadvayaparyaṃte sīmāḥ śaileṣu saṃsthitāḥ || catasro devatāstvetāḥ sevaṃte śoṇaparvatam|| 82 || sthitāḥ sīmāvasāneṣu śoṇādrīśamavasthitam || namaṃti devāścatvāraḥ śivaṃ śoṇācalākṛtim || 83 || asyottarasmiñchikhare dṛśyate vaṭabhūruhaḥ || siddhaveṣaḥ sadaivāste yasya mūle maheśvaraḥ || 84 || yasya cchāyātimahatī sarvadā maṇḍalākṛtiḥ || lakṣyate vismayopetaiḥ sarvadā devamānavaiḥ || 85 || aṣṭabhiḥ parito liṃgairaṣṭadikpālapūjitaiḥ || aṣṭāsu saṃsthitairdikṣu śobhate hyupasevitaḥ || 86 || nṛpāṇāṃ śambhubhaktānāṃ śaṃkarājñānupālinām || atraiva mahadāsthānamādidevena nirmitam || 87 || bakulaśca mahāṃstatra sadārthitaphalapradaḥ || āgamārthavidā mūle vāmadevena sevyate || 88 || agastyaśca vaśiṣṭhaśca saṃpūjyāruṇabhūdharam || saṃsthāpya liṃge vimale tepāte tādṛśaṃ tapaḥ ||89|| hiraṇyagarbhatanayaḥ purā śoṇanadaḥ pumān|| atra tīvraṃ tapastaptvā gaṃgābhimukhago'bhavata || 1.3.1.6.90 || atra śoṇanadī puṇyā pravahatyamalodakā || veṇā ca puṇyataṭinī paritaḥ sevate'calam || 91 || vāyavyāśca diśo bhāge vāyutīrthaṃ ca śobhate || tatra snātvā marutpūrvaṃ jagatprāṇatvamāptavān || 92 || uttare'sya girestīrthaṃ suvarṇakamalojjvalam || divyasaugaṃdhikākīrṇaṃ haṃsabhṛṃgamanoharam || 93 || kauberaṃ tīrthameśānyāmaiśānyaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 94 || tasyaiva paścime bhāge viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || snātvā viṣṇutvamabhajatkamalālālitākṛtiḥ || 95 || navagrahāḥ purā tatra snātvā grahapadaṃ gatāḥ || navagrahaprasādaśca jāyate tatra majjatām || 96 || durgā vināyaka skando kṣetrapālaḥ sarasvatī || rakṣaṃti paritastīrthaṃ grāhayametadanantaram || 97 || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva godāvarī sarasvatī || narmadāsindhukāveryaḥ śoṇaḥ śorṇanadī ca sā || 98 || etā gūḍhā niṣevaṃte pūrvādyāśāsu saṃtatam || naśyaṃtyaḥ sakalaṃ pāpamātmakṣetrasamudbhavam|| 99 || anyāśca sarito divyāḥ pārthivyaśca śubhodakāḥ || udajṛṃbhaṃta sahasā śoṇādrīśaprasādataḥ || 1.3.1.6.100 || āgastyaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge tīrthaṃ mahadudāhṛtam || sarvabhāṣārthasaṃsiddhirjāyate tatra majjatām || 101 || atrāgastyaḥ samāgatya snātvā munigaṇāvṛtaḥ || abhyarcayati śoṇādriṃ māsi bhādrapade sadā || 102 || vāśiṣṭhamuttare bhāge tīrthaṃ divyaṃ śubhodayam || sarvavedārthasaṃsiddhirjāyate tatra majjanāt || 103 || atra meroḥ samāgatya vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || karotyāśvayuje māsi śoṇādrīśaniṣevaṇam || 104 || gaṃgānāma mahattīrthaṃ pūrvottaradiśi sthitam || tatra snānādbhavennṛṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 105 || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ kārttike māsi saṃgatāḥ || atrāruṇādrināthasya sevāṃ kurvaṃti sādaram || 106 || brāhmyaṃ nāma mahātīrthamaruṇādrīśasannidhau || tasyopasaṃgamātsadyo brahmahatyādi naśyati || 107 || mārge māsi samāgatya brahmalokātpitāmahaḥ || snātvā tatpratyahaṃ devamarcayatyaruṇācalam |||| 108 || pauṣe māsi samāgatya snātvā tīrthe nijaiḥ suraiḥ || mahendraḥ śoṇaśaileśamabhyarcayati śaṃkaram || 109 || śaivaṃnāma mahātīrthaṃ saṃnidhau tatra vartate || rudro brahmakapālena saha tatra nyamajjata || 1.3.1.6.110 || atra śambhurgaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ māghe māsi prasīdati || prāyaścittāni sarvāṇi nṝṇāṃ saphalayanbhuvi || 111 || āgneyamagnidigbhāge tīrthaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam || agniratra purā snātvā svāhayā saṃgataḥ sukhī || 112 || anaṃgopi smaraḥ snātvā phālgune māsi saṃgataḥ || abhyarcya śoṇaśaileśamabhūtsarvasukhādhipaḥ || 113 || diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamadbhutam || brahmarṣayaḥ sadā tatra vasaṃti kṛtakautukāḥ || 114 || caitre māsi samāgatya viṣṇustatra ramāpatiḥ || snātvābhyarcyāruṇādrīśamabhavallokanāyakaḥ || 115 || sauraṃnāma mahātīrthaṃ kauberadiśi jṛṃbhitam || sarvarogopaśāṃtiśca jāyate tatra majjanāt || || 116 || vaiśākhe māsi dinakṛtsnātvātreśaṃ niṣevate || vālakhilyaiḥ samaṃ śrīmānvedaiśca saha saṃgataḥ || 117 || āśvinaṃ pāvanaṃ tīrthamīśabrahmottare sthitam || āplutau bhipajau dasrau pūtāvatra nimajjanāt || 118 || atrāśvinau samāgatya snātvābhyarcya ca śaṃkaram || dakṣiṇe śoṇa śailasya nikaṭe varttate śubham || 119 || kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva tīrthaṃ pāṃḍavasaṃjñitam || purā hi pāṃḍavāstatra majanātkṣitināyakāḥ || 1.3.1.6.120 || atra dhātrī samāgatya sarvauṣadhiphalānvitā || jyeṣṭhe māsi samaṃ devairārcayaccāruṇācalam || 121 || āṣāḍhe māsi saṃtyaktā viśvedevā mahābalāḥ || abhyarcya śoṇaśaileśamāgacchanmakharādhyatām || 122 || vaiśvadevaṃ mahātīrthaṃ somasūryottarāśrayam || viśvādhipatyamatulaṃ labhyate tatra majjanāt || || 123 || parito lakṣyate tīrthaṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi śobhane || atra lakṣmīḥ purā snātvā lebhe puruṣamuttamam || 124 || uttarasyāṃ diśi purā puṇyā skaṃdanadī sthitā || atra snātvā purā skaṃdaḥ saṃprāpto vipulaṃ balam || 125 || paścimasyāṃ diśi khyātā parā kuṃbhanadī śubhā || agastyaḥ kuṃbhakaḥ kuṃbhastatra nityaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 126 || gaṃgā ca mūlabhāgasthā yamunā gagane sthitā || somodbhavā śirobhāge sevaṃte śoṇaparvatam || 127|| bahūnyapi ca tīrthāni saṃbhūtāni samaṃtataḥ || teṣāṃ bhedānpurā vettuṃ mārkaṇḍeyastu nāśakat || 128 || tapobhirbahubhissoyaṃ śoṇādrīśamatoṣayat || prārthayāmāsa ca varaṃ prītāttasmānmunīśvaraḥ || 129 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || bhagavannaruṇādrīśa tīrthabhedāḥ sahasraśaḥ || prakhyātāśca prakāśaṃte durbodhāstvalpacetasām || 1.3.1.6.130 || kathamekatra sāṃnidhyaṃ labheranbhuvi mānavāḥ || aparyāptaśca bhavati pṛthageṣāṃ niṣevaṇe ||131|| aṃtarnigūḍhatejāstvaṃ gatvā yassakalaiḥ suraiḥ || āraṇyase kuru tathā śoṇādrisparśabhīrubhiḥ || 132 || ahaṃ ca śaṃbhumabhyarcya tapasāruṇaparvatam || sarvalokopakārārthaṃ sūkṣma liṃgamapūjayam || 133 || viśvakarmakṛtaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ vividhotsavam || saṃkalpya sakalānbhogānnityānajanayatpunaḥ || 134 || dharmaśāstrāṇi vividhānyavāpurmunipuṃgavāḥ || śivakāryāṇi sarvāṇi cakrubhaktisamanvitāḥ || 135 || mayā ca śaṃbhumabhyarcya kṛtāgnyāhutisaṃbhavāḥ || sapta kanyā varārohāḥ pūjārthaṃ viniyojitāḥ || 136 || hataśatrugaṇaibhūpairlabdharājyaiḥ purā nṛpaiḥ || pratyekaṃ vividhairbhogaiḥ śoṇaśailādhiporcitaḥ || 137 || idamanubhavavaibhavaṃ vicitraṃ duritaharaṃ śivaliṃgamadrirūpam || amalamanabhigamyanāmadheyaṃ varamaruṇādrināyakaṃ bhajasva || 138 || avanatajanarakṣaṇocitasya smaraṇanirākṛtaviśvakalmaṣasya || bhajanamamitapuṇyarāśiyogādaruṇagireḥ kṛtinaḥ paraṃ labhasva || 139 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe'ruṇācalasthavividhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || cha ||
<1.3.1.7>
