|| pārvatyuvāca || || kathamagnimayaṃ liṃgamabhigamyamabhūdbhuvi || prāṇināmapi sarveṣāmupaśāṃtiṃ kathaṃ gataḥ || 1 || tīrthānāmudbhavaḥ puṇyātkathaṃ cāruṇaparvatāt || upasaṃhṛtasarvāṃgaḥ kathaṃ vā vada me'calaḥ ||2|| || gautama uvāca|| || kṛte tvagnimayaḥ śailastretāyāṃ maṇiparvataḥ || dvāparaṃ hāṭakagiriḥ kalau marakatācalaḥ || 3 || bahuyojanaparyaṃtaṃ kṛte vahnimaye sthite || bahiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakruḥ praśāmyati maharṣayaḥ ||4|| śanaiḥ śāṃtoruṇādrīśaḥ śrīmānabhyarthitaḥ suraiḥ || lokaguptyarthamatyarthamupaśāṃto'ruṇācalaḥ ||5|| atha gaurī muniṃ prāha kathaṃ śāṃto'ruṇācalaḥ || kathaṃ vā prārthayāmāsurdeveśaṃ tridaśā imam||6|| iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā gautamastvabhyabhāṣata || praśasya bhaktimatulāṃ tasyāstattvārthavedinīm ||7 || || gautama uvāca || || agnirūpaṃ purā śailamāsādayitumakṣamāḥ || purā surāḥ stutiṃ cakrurabhyarcya kratusaṃbhavaiḥ || 8 || bhagavannaruṇādrīśa sarvalokahitāvaha || agnirūpo'pi saṃśāṃtaḥ prakāśasya mahītale || 9 || asau yastāmro aruṇa uta babhruḥ sumaṃgalaḥ || iti tvāṃ sakalā vedāḥ stuvaṃti śivavigraham || 1.3.1.7.10 || namastāmrāyāruṇāya śivāya paramātmane || vedavedya svarūpāya somāya sukharūpiṇe || 11 || tvadrūpamakhilaṃ deva jagadetaccarācaram || nidhānamiva te rūpaṃ devānāmidamīkṣyate ||12|| varṣatāṃ ca payodānāṃ nirjharāṇāṃ ca bhūyasām || salilopāyasaṃhāro yuktaste yugasaṃkṣaye ||13|| agnerāpaḥ samudbhūtāstvatto hi paramātmanaḥ || viśvasṛṣṭiṃ vitanvati vicitraguṇa vaibhavāt || 14 || śīto bhava mahādeva śoṇācala kṛpānidhe || sarveṣāmapi jīvānāmabhigamyo bhava prabho || 15 || iti stutaḥ suraiḥ sarverānatairbhaktavatsalaḥ || sadyaḥ śītalatāṃ gacchannabhimyo'bhavatprabhuḥ || 16 || prāvarttata punarnadyo nirjharāśca bahūdakāḥ || varṣatāmapi meghānāṃ na jagrāha jalaṃ bahu || || 17 || tathāpi taruṇārkodyatkālāgniśatakoṭibhiḥ || samānadīptirabhajajjīvānāmabhigamyatām ||18|| visṛjya viśvasalilaṃ nadīśca rasavikṣaraiḥ || saṃpūryaḥ sakalairdevaḥ sarvadā saṃprakāśate || 19 || tīrthāni tāni tānyāsanparitaḥ prārthanāvaśāt || dikpālānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca maharṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām |||| 1.3.1.7.20 || || brahmovāca || || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā gaurī kutukasaṃyutā || tīrthānāmudbhavaṃ sarva śrotuṃ samupacakrame || 21 || || pārvatyuvāca || || kāni tīrthāni jātāni śoṇādrerlokaguptaye || bhagavanbrūhi sakalaṃ tīrthānāmudbhavaṃ mama || 22 | iti tasyā vacaḥ śṛṇvangirīśātsaṃśrutaṃ purā || tīrthānāmudbhavaṃ sarvaṃ vyākhyātumupacakrame || 23 || || gautama uvāca || || aindraṃ nāma mahātīrthamiṃdrabhāge samutthitam || tatra snātvā purā śakro brahmahatyāṃ vyapohayat || 24 || brahmatīrthaṃ punardivyaṃ vahniḥkoṇe samutthitam || parastrīsaṃgamātpāpaṃ vahniḥ snātvātra cātyajat || 25 || yāmyaṃ nāma mahātīrthaṃ yamabhāge vijṛṃbhate || atra snātvā yamo'tyākṣīdbhayaṃ brahmāstrasaṃbhavam || 26 || nairṛtaṃ tu mahātīrthaṃ nairṛtyāṃ diśi śobhate || bhūtavetālavijayaṃ tatra snātvarṣayo gatāḥ || 27 || paścime vāruṇaṃ tīrthaṃ digbhāge ca prakāśate || śalyakośaṃ purā lebhe snātvātra varuṇo nijam || 28 || vāyave vāyavīyaṃ ca tīrthamatra prakāśate || tatra snātvā yayau vāyurjagatprāṇatvavaibhavam || 29 || uttare cātra digbhāge somatīrthamiti smṛtam || tatra snātvā purā somo yakṣmarogādamuṃcata || 1.3.1.7.30 || aiśāne cātra digbhāge viṣṇutīrthamiti smṛtam || tatra snātvā purā viṣṇuḥ śriyā ca saha saṃgataḥ || 31 || mārkaṇḍeyaḥ purā devi prārthayāmāsa śaṃkaram || sadāśiva mahādeva devadeva jagatpate || 32 || bahūnāmiha tīrthānāmekatra syātsamāgamaḥ || kenopāyena bhagavankṛpayā vada śaṃkara || 33 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devadeva umāpatiḥ || upāyaṃ darśayāmāsa munaye prītamānasaḥ|| 34 || || maheśvara uvāca || || sadopahāravelāyāṃ sarvatīrthasamuccayaḥ || sannidhiṃ mama saṃprāptaḥ sevate gūḍharūpataḥ || 35 || nānyadanveṣaṇīyaṃ te tīrthamatra mahāmune || mamopahāravelāyāṃ dṛśyate tīrthasaṃcayaḥ || 36 || tasmādbhaktiyutairnityaṃ sarvatīrthasamāgamaḥ || munibhiśca suraiḥ sarvairnaivedyāṃte vilokyatām || 37 || iti devi purā devo mārkaḍeyāya śaṃkaraḥ || upādiśadameyātmā tīrthasaṃdarśanakramam || 38 || || gautama uvāca || || sarvāṇyapi ca puṇyāni tīrthāni śivasannidhau || sadopahāravelāyāṃ dṛśyāni kila mānavaiḥ || 39 || vrataṃ tīrthaṃ tapo vedā yajñāśca niyamādayaḥ || yogāśca śoṇaśaileśadarśanāddṛṣṭasaṃcarāḥ || 1.3.1.7.40 || niśamya vākyaṃ munipuṃgavasya praseduṣī parvatarājaputrī || avocadatyadbhutametadatra tvayopadiṣṭaṃ bhuvi tīrthajālam || 41 || ahaṃ kṛtārthā tapatāṃ variṣṭha tvatsaṃgamātsaṃprati tīrthajālam || prāptā namaste'stu tapoviśeṣa śivopi me'trādiśadeva kartum || 42 || kathaṃ girīśaḥ punaratra devaḥ sphuranmahāvahnivapurdharo'pi || praśāṃtarūpaḥ parameśvaro'yamabhyarcanīyo bhuvi martyavargaiḥ || 43 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe 'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe'ruṇācalasthavividhatīrthavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha ||
<1.3.1.8>
|| gautama uvāca || || śṛṇu devi purāvṛttaṃ kailāse merudhanvinā || ādiṣṭastīrthayātrārthamahaṃ liṃgāni vīkṣitum || 1 || rudrakṣetre ca kedāre tathā badarikāśrame || kāśyāṃ puṇyeṣu deśeṣu tathā śrīparvate śive || 2 || kāṃcīmukhyāsu puṇyāsu purīṣvapyagamaṃ tadā || ṛṣibhirvibudhaiḥ sārthairgaṇairyogibhiruttamaiḥ || 3 || sthāpitāni ca liṃgāni svayaṃbhūni ca dṛṣṭavān || tatratatra mahābhāge tīrthāni śivasannidhau || 4 || sevamānaḥ saśiṣyo'haṃ paryaṭanpṛthivīmimām || evaṃ tīrthāni sarvāṇi gāhamāno vratānvitaḥ || 5 || tapāṃsi yajñakarmāṇi kurvanbhūmiṃ samācaran|| śivasmaraṇasaṃyuktaḥ śivaliṃgāni sannaman || 6 || sarvāṇi bhuvi puṇyāni deśametamupāśrayam || atra devaṃ mahādevamavikeśaṃ triyaṃbakam || 7 || aruṇādriritikhyātaṃ parvataṃ liṃgamaikṣiṣi || atra siddhā mahātmāno munayaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ || 8 || kaṃdamūlaphalāhārā dṛṣṭāḥ śoṇādri sevakāḥ || astauṣamādimaṃ liṃgamaruṇādrimayaṃ mahat ||9|| ādyena brahmaṇā pūrvamarcitaṃ divyacakṣuṣā || asau yastāmro aruṇa uta babhruḥ sumaṃgalaḥ || || 1.3.1.8.10 || iti vedā stuvaṃti tvāmaruṇādrīśa saṃtatam|| namastāmrāya cāruṇāya śivāya paramātmane || 11 || sarvavedasvarūpāya nityāyāmṛtamūrttaye || kālāya karuṇārdrāya dṛṣṭipeyāmṛtābdhaye ||12|| bhaktavātsalyapūrṇāya puṇyāya purabhedine || darśanaṃ tava deveśa sarvadharmaphalapradam ||13|| bhuvi labdhavatā bhūyo nānyatkāryaṃ tapaḥ kvacit || bhavatā karmabhūreṣā vartatedya nirodhitā || 14 || prārthayate svayaṃ vāsāndevāścātra tvadāśraye || kālasaṃgrahasaṃjātaṃ phalaṃ labdhaṃ mayādhunā || 15 || anyatkṛtaṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ tvaddarśanaphalaṃ mama || īdṛśaṃ tava deveśa rūpamatyadbhutodayam || 16 || ekamadrimayaṃ liṃgaṃ na kvaciddṛṣṭavānbhuvi || sūryeṃdvagnisusaṃyukta koṇatrayamanoharam || 17 || trimūrtirūpa deveśa dṛśyate te vapurmahat || śaktitrayasvarūpeṇa kālatrayavidhānakam || 18 || trivedātmaṃ trikoṇāṃgaṃ liṃgaṃ te dṛṣṭamadbhutam || trailokyarakṣaṇārthāya vitataṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ || 19 || dṛśyate vasudhābhāge śoṇādririti viśrutaḥ || ajānatāṃ ca martyānāṃ samālokanamātrataḥ || 1.3.1.8.20 || vitaratyakhilānbhogānvyājakaruṇānidhiḥ || arcayā rahitaṃ liṃgamanyaṃ śūnyamudāhṛtam || 21 || idaṃ tu pūjitaṃ devaiḥ sadā sarvavarapradam || prasīda karuṇāpūrṇa śoṇācala maheśvara || 22 || trāyasva bhavabhītaṃ māṃ prapannaṃ bhaktavatsala || draṣṭavyaṃ draṣṭametatte rūpamatyadbhutaṃ mahat || 23 || kṛtārthaya kṛpāsiṃdho śaraṇya śaraṇāgatam || iti saṃstūyamāno me devaḥ śoṇācaleśvaraḥ || 24 || adarśayatparaṃ rūpaṃ divyamehītyuvāca mām || prīto'smi bhavataḥ stotrairbhaktyā ca parayā bhṛśam || 25 || atraiva bhavato vāso nityamastu mamāṃtike || saṃpūjaya ca māṃ nityaṃ bhuvi bhogaiḥ sanātanaiḥ || 26 || tapasā tapa sarveṣāṃ mahattvamiha darśaya || pūrvaṃ kailāsaśikhare vasaṃtaṃ tvāṃ taponvitam || 27 || ādiśaṃ pṛthivībhāgaṃ śoṇādrau pūjayeti mām || saptarṣipūjitā pūjā divi me saṃprakāśate || 28 || tathā nityārcanāyukta prakāśaya dharātale || sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ hitāya tvaṃ tapo'dhikaḥ || 29 || bhuvi māṃ pūjayārcābhirāgamoktābhirādarāt || divyā mama mahāpūjā dṛśyā hi divi daivataiḥ || 1.3.1.8.30 || prakāśanīyā bhavatā pārthivī vasudhātale || māhātmyaṃ pūrvamevoktaṃ yathāhamaruṇācalaḥ || 31 || sthito vasuṃdharābhāge mayā prītaṃ tu te bhṛśam || ye vā saṃpūjayaṃti sma pūrvaṃ māṃ sukṛtādhikāḥ || 32 || tebhyastvamadhiko bhūmau prakāśasva śivārcanam || ityādiṣṭo hi deveśaṃ praṇamya bhavabhaktimān || 33 || anvapṛcchaṃ dayāpūrṇamaruṇādrīśamānaman || anāsādyamidaṃ rūpamagnirūpaṃ maheśvaram || 34 || kathamadyārcayāmyenaṃ martyalokocitārcanaiḥ || ādeśamimamanvarthaṃ kathaṃ vā kalpayāmyaham || 35 || upāyamādiśa śrīmannabhigamyo yathā bhavān || iti vijñāpito devaḥ śrīmāñchoṇācaleśvaraḥ || 36 || anvagrahīdaśeṣātmā praṇataṃ māṃ dayānidhiḥ || ahaṃ tu sūkṣmaliṃgāni prakāśiṣye mahītale |||| 37 || āgamoktakriyābhedaiḥ pūjāṃ me pratipādaya || paṃcāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ liṃgaṃ me sūkṣmamadbhutam || 38 || aruṇādrīśvarābhikhyaṃ saṃpūjaya tapobalaiḥ || ityādiśya mahādevaḥ svayaṃbhu vimalaṃ mahat || 39 || rūpaṃ me darśayāmāsa sūkṣmaliṃgātmanā śivaḥ || ālokya vimalaṃ liṃgaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tatsvayamucchritam|| 1.3.1.8.40 || aśeṣā''varaṇopetaṃ kṛtārthahṛdayo'bhavam || punarvyajñāpayaṃ devaṃ śambhumāśritavatsalam || 41 || āgamoktaprakārāṇāmanirīkṣyatvamāgatam || kathaṃ tu tava rūpāṇāṃ nāmabhedānviyojitān || 42 || jānīyāṃ karuṇāmūrte svayamīśvara matprabho || pūjakāstava ke vā syurmaṃdiraṃ vātra kīdṛśam || 43 || kathaṃ stotraṃ kathaṃ pūjā ke vātra paricārakāḥ || sthānarakṣā kathaṃ vā syātke vātmaparirakṣakāḥ || 44 || kathaṃ vā mānuṣī pūjā nityā saṃvardhate tava || āgatā bahavo devāḥ śraddheyaṃ manujaiḥ katham || 45 || prasīda parameśāna svayamājñāpayākhilam || evaṃ vijñāpito devaḥ śoṇādrīśaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 46 || ājñāpayattadā devo viśvakarmāṇamāgatam || sṛja tvaṃ nagaraṃ divyamaruṇākhyaṃ guṇādhikam || 47 || maṃdiraṃ mama divyaṃ ca mahāmaṇigaṇojjvalam || tauryatrikaṃ saparyāṃgaṃ tanme sarvaṃ prakalpaya || 48 || ābabhāṣe śivaḥ śrīmānnāmabhedārcanakramam || vrataṃ ca karuṇāmūrttiraruṇādrīśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 49 || śṛṇu tanme ca ye sṛṣṭā pūjārthaṃ paricārakāḥ || śṛṇu gautama sarvaṃ me mānuṣaṃ pūjanakramam || 1.3.1.8.50 || ya eṣa sarvalokānāṃ kṣemāya prathate bhuvi || idaṃ tejomayaṃ liṃgamatulaṃ dṛśyate mahat ||51|| aruṇādrīśvarābhikhyaṃ pūjyatāṃ satataṃ tvayā || śaktirmamottare bhāge pūjyā nityodayā mudā || || 52 || dadhatī sthānamāhātmyamapītakucanāmikā || aruṇācalarājoyamavibhāgaḥ priyānvitaḥ || 53 || utsavārtho mahādevaḥ pūjyo bhogasutāvṛtaḥ || bodhado bhaktalokasya dattābhayakaraḥ śivaḥ || 54 || sāraṃgaṃ paraśuṃ vibhratprasannavadanaḥ sadā || umāskandeśvaraḥ śambhurdivyaratnavibhūṣaṇaḥ || || 55 || ābhayā bhāsayam̐llokānavikuṇṭhaśriyānvitaḥ || śakterutsavabhadre ca saṃpūjyā suṃdareśvarī || 56 || sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktā śṛṅgārarasavarddhanī || bālo gaṇapatiḥ pūjyaḥ purastādbhūtinandanaḥ || 57 || madaṃtikamalaṃkurvanbhakṣyairbhojyairbahūdayaiḥ || matpārśvamavimuṃcaṃtī śoṇarekhāṃcitekṣaṇā || 58 || utsavārthā parā śaktiraṃtikasthaiva pūjyatām || mukharāṃghripatiḥ śrīmānnṛtyaṃstāṃḍavapaṇḍitaḥ || 59 || utsavārthaṃ samabhyarcyaścakṣuragre'mṛteśvaraḥ || śaktiścānyā mahābhāgā saṃpūjyā bhūvināyakā || 1.3.1.8.60 || dvāre nandī mahākālaḥ purastātsūryasaṃnibhaḥ || bhaktānāṃ mama sarveṣāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi kalpyatām || 61 || dakṣiṇe mātaraḥ pūjyā vighnaśāstṛsamanvitāḥ || saṃpūjyo nairṛte koṇe vighnanāśo vināyakāḥ || 62 || skandaḥ śaktidharaścaivaiśānakoṇe samarcyatām || liṃgāni ca manojñāni pūjanīyānyanantaram || 63 || maṃdiraṃ mama saṃpūjya dakṣiṇāmūrti dakṣiṇam || paścime viṣṇurūpāṃkamagnirūpānvitaṃ tathā || 64 || uttare brahmarūpāṃkaṃ pūrve sāraṃgabhūyutam || sarvadevaguṇopetaṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam |||| 65 || apītakucanāthāyāḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitam || maṃdiraṃ guru saṃpūjya dikpālakavadhūvṛtam || 66 || maṃdirasyāvanārthāya devīrvaibhavanāyakāḥ || || 67 || kṣetrapālaṃ tu saṃpūjya sarvāvaraṇasaṃyutam || putrasya trāṇamāyātā pūjyāruṇagirīśvarī || 68 || kālī bahuvidhāścānyā devatā vidhipālakāḥ || utsavā vividhāḥ kalpyāḥ pratimāsamahodayāḥ || 69 || sṛjasva kanyakā divyāḥ śivadevārhaṇe ratāḥ || nṛttagītakalābhijñā rūpasaubhāgyasaṃyutāḥ || || 1.3.1.8.70 || cāruvibhramasaṃyuktāḥ kāmadā nityapāvanāḥ || śiṣyānādiśa vedajñānsadācārasamujjvalān || 71 || 226a divyopacārasaṃsiddhyai subhagāñchuddhacetasaḥ || dīkṣitānvimalāñchuddhāñchaivāgamaviśāradān || 72 || śaivācāraprasiddhyarthamādiśābhyarcane mama || mārddalāñchāṃkhikānvaiṇāṃstālikānveṇuvādakān || 73 || śaulbikānsṛja sadvidyāṃścaturvidyāviśāradān || kṣatriyānvividhānvaiśyāñchūdrāṃśca śivasaṃmatān || 74 || catvāraśca maṭhāḥ kalpyāścaturdiktīrthavāsinām || munīnāṃ śivabhaktānāṃ nirāśānāṃ nivāsataḥ || 75|| teṣu sthitā munīṃdrā me rakṣaṃtu śivapūjanam || bhikṣamāṇāḥ punaḥ śaivā bhaktāḥ pāśupatā api || 76 || pālayaṃtu sadānye ca yuktāḥ kāpālikā api || sarveṣāṃ jāyamānānāṃ jātānāṃ saṃbhaviṣyatām || 77 || avyāhatājñamārakṣyamidaṃ sthānaṃ mahībhṛtām || bakulaśca mahānatra dṛśyate divyabhūruhaḥ || 78 || atra bhaktā vitanvantu śivakāryaviniścayam || atra me dīyate dravyamaprekṣitaparāptaye || 79 || yattadakṣayyaphaladamārakṣyaṃ śivasevakaiḥ || bhaktairvijñāpitaṃ cārthaṃ śroṣyāmi purataḥ sthitaiḥ || 1.3.1.8.80 || sarvaṃ saṃpādayiṣyāmi teṣāṃ cittānukūlakam || aparādhasahasrāṇi kṣaṃsye māṃ svarcatāmaham || 81 || āgamoktā ca pūjeyaṃ mānuṣī nirmitā yataḥ || grahīṣye tāmahaṃ sarvāmarcāṃ sarvāgamoditām || 82 || saṃkalpitaṃ bhavetkarma prītikṛnmama sevakaiḥ || āgamārthānaśeṣāṃstvamālokya samayocitān || 83 || vidhāyābhyarcanābhedām̐llokarakṣākṛte mune || kartavyā mahatī pūjā paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sādaram || 84 || satrāṇi vividhānyatra kartavyāni sahasraśaḥ || vividhāni ca dānāni śaktyā caivāsya sannidhau || 85 || avyucchinnapradīpasya dātāro mama sannidhau || tejomayamidaṃ rūpaṃ mama yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ|| || 86 || jalajaṃ tarujaṃ puṣpaṃ kakṣajaṃ ca latodbhavam || dadate ye ca bhaktyā me te bhaviṣyaṃti bhūbhṛtaḥ || 87 || teṣāṃ purogataḥ sākṣādahaṃ jeṣyāmi vidviṣaḥ || yasya yasya tu deśasya yo yo rājā tapodhikaḥ || 88 || tattatsamarddhitaṃ ramyaṃ saṃbhavaṃ dadate'tra me || matsaṃnidhimupāgatya durātmāno'pi bhūmipāḥ || 89 || śivabhaktā bhṛśaṃ pūrṇā bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 1.3.1.8.90 || iti śaṃbhumukhotthitaṃ vacaḥ samupaśrutya vidhūtakalmaṣaḥ || ahamānatavānvyajijñapaṃ kutukācchoṇagirīśvaraṃ śivam || 91 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe'ruṇeśvarārādhanāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||cha||
<1.3.1.9>
|| gautama uvāca || || bhagavannaruṇādrīśa nāmadheyāni te bhṛśam || viśeṣācchrotumicchāmi sthāne'sminsurapūjite || 1 || || maheśvara uvāca || || nāmāni śṛṇu me brahmanmukhyāni dvijasattama || durlabhānyalpapuṇyānāṃ kāmadāni sadā bhuvi || 2 || śoṇādrīśo'ruṇādrīśo devādhīśo janapriyaḥ || prapannarakṣako dhīraḥ śivasevakavardhakaḥ || 3 || akṣipeyāmṛteśānaḥ strīpuṃbhāvapradāyakaḥ || bhaktavijñaptisaṃdhātā dīnabaṃdivimocakaḥ || 4 || mukharāṃghripatiḥ śrīmānmṛḍo mṛgamadeśvaraḥ || bhaktaprekṣaṇakṛtsākṣī bhaktadoṣanivarttakaḥ || 5 || jñānasaṃbaṃdhanāthaśca śrīhalāhalasuṃdakaḥ || āhavaiśvaryadātā ca smartṛsarvāghanāśanaḥ || 6 || vyatyastanṛtyaddhṛjadhṛksakāṃtirnaṭaneśvaraḥ || sāmapriyaḥ kalidhvaṃsī vedamūrtirniraṃjanaḥ || 7 || jagannātho mahādevastrinetrastripurāṃtakaḥ || bhaktāparādhasoḍhā ca yogīśo bhoganāyakaḥ || 8 || bālamūrttiḥ kṣamārūpī dharmarakṣo vṛṣadhvajaḥ || haro girīśvaro bhargaścaṃdrarekhāvataṃsakaḥ || 9 || smarāṃtakoṃ'dhakaripuḥ siddharājo digaṃbaraḥ || āgamapriya īśāno bhasmarudrākṣalāṃchanaḥ || 1.3.1.9.10 || śrīpatiḥ śaṃkaraḥ sraṣṭā sarvavidyeśvaro'naghaḥ || gaṃgādharaḥ kratudhvaṃso vimalo nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ || 11 || aruṇo bahurūpaśca virūpākṣo'kṣarākṛtiḥ || anādiraṃtarahitaḥ śivakāmaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ || 12 || saccidānaṃdarūpaśca sarvātmā jīvadhārakaḥ || strīsaṃgavāmasubhago vidhirvihitasuṃdaraḥ || 13 || jñānaprado muktidaśca bhaktavāṃchitadāyakaḥ || āścaryavaibhavaḥ kāmī niravadyo nidhipradaḥ || 14 || śūlī paśupatiḥ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhurgiriśo mṛḍaḥ || etāni mama mukhyāni nāmānyatra mahāmune || 15 || anyāni divyanāmāni purāṇoktāni saṃsmara || pradakṣiṇena māṃ nityaṃ viśeṣāttvaṃ samarcaya || 16 || pradakṣiṇapriyo yasmādahaṃ śoṇācalākṛtiḥ || ityājñapto mahādevamarcayannaruṇācalam || avimuṃcannihāvāsaṃ kṛtavānahamadrije || 17 || || gauryuvāca || || bhagavansarvadharmajña gautamāryya munīśvara || pradakṣiṇasya māhātmyaṃ brūhi me śoṇabhūbhṛtaḥ || 18 || kasminkāle kathaṃ kāryaṃ kairvā pūrvaṃ pradakṣiṇam || kṛtaṃ śoṇādrināthasya prāptamiṣṭaṃ paraṃ padam || 19 || || brahmovāca || || iti pṛṣṭo muniḥ prāha gautamaḥ śailakanyakām || śrūyatāṃ devi māhātmyamādiśanme maheśvaraḥ || 1.3.1.9.20 || || mahādeva uvāca || || ahaṃ hi śoṇaśailātmā prakāśo vasudhātale || 21 || parito māṃ surāḥ sarve vartaṃte munibhiḥ saha || 22 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāṃtarakṛtāni ca || tāni tāni vinaśyaṃti pradakṣiṇapade pade || 23 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyāyutāni ca || siddhyaṃti sarvatīrthāni pradakṣiṇapade pade || 24 || api prahīṇasya samastalakṣaṇaiḥ kriyāvihīnasya nikṛṣṭajanmanaḥ || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śaśāṃkaśekharaṃ prayāsyataḥ kasya na siddhiragrataḥ || 25 || samasta tīrthābhigameṣu puṇyaṃ samastayajñāgamadharmajātam || avāpyate śoṇamahīdharasya pradakṣiṇāprakramaṇena satyam || 26 || padenaikena bhūlokaṃ dvitīyenāṃtarikṣakam || tṛtīyena divaṃ martyo jayatyasya pradakṣiṇe || 27 || ekena mānasaṃ pāpaṃ dvitīyena tu vācikam || kāyikaṃ tu tṛtīyena padena kṣīyate nṛṇām || 28 || pātakāni ca sarvāṇi padenaikena mārjayet || dvitīyena tapaḥ sarvaṃ prāpnotyasya pradakṣiṇāt ||29|| parṇaśālā maharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ || surāṇāṃ ca tathā''vāsā vidyaṃtetra sahasraśaḥ || 1.3.1.9.30 || atra siddhaḥ punarnityaṃ vasāmyagre surārcitaḥ|| mamāṃtare guhā divyā dhyātavyā bhogasaṃyutā || 31 || agnistaṃbhamayaṃ rūpamaruṇādiriti śrutam || dhyāyam̐lliṃgaṃ mama bṛhatmandaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam || 32 || aṣṭamūrtimayaṃ liṃgamidaṃ yaistaijasaṃ bhṛśam || dhyātvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvanpātakāni vinirdahet ||33|| na punaḥ saṃbhavastasya yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām || śoṇācalākṛternityaṃ nityatvaṃ dhruvamaśnute ||34|| asya pādarajaḥsparśātpūyate sakalā mahī || padamekaṃ tu dhatte yaḥ śoṇādrīśapradakṣiṇe || 35 || namaskurvanpratidiśaṃ dhyāyanstauti kṛtāṃjaliḥ || asaṃsṛṣṭakaraḥ kaiścinmaṃdaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇam ||36|| āsannaprasavā nārī yathā gacchedanākulam || tathā pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādaśṛṇvaṃśca padadhvanim ||37|| snāto viśuddhaveṣaḥ sanbhasmarudrākṣabhūṣitaḥ || śivasmaraṇasaṃsṛṣṭo maṃdaṃ dadyātpadaṃ budhaḥ ||38|| manūnāṃ caratāmagre devānāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ || adṛśyānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ nānyeṣāṃ vāyurūpiṇām ||39|| saṃghaṭṭamatisaṃmardaṃ mārgarodhaṃ viciṃtayan || anukūlena bhaktaḥ sañchanairdadyātpadaṃ budhaḥ ||1.3.1.9.40|| athavā śivanāmāni saṃkīrtya varagītibhiḥ|| śivanṛtyaṃ ca racayanbhaktaiḥ sārddhaṃ parikramet ||41|| māhātmyaṃ mama vā śṛṇvannananyamatirādarāt || śanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādānandarasanirbharaḥ || 42 || dānaiśca vividhaiḥ puṇyairupakāraistathārthinām || yathāmati dayāpūrṇa āstikaḥ parito vrajet ||43|| kṛte tvagnimayaṃ liṃgaṃ tretāyāṃ maṇiparvatam || dvāpare ciṃtayeddhaimaṃ kalau marakatācalam || 44 || athavā sphāṭikaṃ rūpamaruṇaṃ tu svayaṃprabham || dhyāyanvimuktaḥ sakalaiḥ pāpaiḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 45 || avāṅmanasagamyatvādaprameyatayā svayam || agnitvācca paraṃ liṃgamanāsādyācalābhidham || 46 || dhyātvā pradakṣiṇaṃ karturabhigamyo'hamaṃjasā || tasya pādarajo nṛṇāmajarāmarakāraṇām || 47 || rūpamekaṃ tu dhatte yaḥ śoṇādrīśapradakṣiṇe || vāhanāni suraughāṇāṃ prārthayaṃte parasparam || 48 || kurvatāṃ caraṇaṃ voḍhumaruṇādripradakṣiṇām || chāyāpradānaṃ kurvaṃti kalpakādyāḥ suradrumāḥ || 49 || kurvatāṃ bhuvi marttyānāmaruṇādripradakṣiṇām || devagandharvakādyānāṃ sahasreṇa samāvṛtāḥ || 1.3.1.9.50 || sevaṃte te gaṇākīrṇā vimānaśatakoṭayaḥ || mama pradakṣiṇaṃ bhūmau kurvatāṃ pādapāṃsubhiḥ|| 51 || pāvitā mahatī vīthī dṛṣṭā śivapadapradā || aṃgapradakṣiṇaṃ kurvankṣaṇātsvargyatanurbhavet || 52 || prāpto vajraśarīratvaṃ na dhṛṣyeta mahītale || vyomayānotsukā devāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || 53 || adṛśyāḥ saṃcaraṃtyatra paśyaṃte mama saṃnidhim || vinayaṃ mama bhaktiṃ ca pradakṣiṇaparikrame || 54 || dṛṣṭvā harṣasamāyuktā marttyebhyo dadate varam || atra devāstrayastriṃśatpurā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 55 || pratyahaṃ mārgamāsīnāḥ pratyekaṃ koṭitāṃ gatāḥ || ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve purā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 56 || saṃpūrṇajagatībhāge sarve grahapatāṃ gatāḥ || yaḥ karoti naro bhūmau sūryavāre pradakṣiṇām || 57 || sa sūryamaḍalaṃ bhittvā muktaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || somavāre naraḥ kurvannaruṇādripradakṣiṇām || 58 || ajarāmaratāṃ prāpto nāsaumyo bhavati kṣitau || bhaumavāre naraḥ kurvannaruṇādripradakṣiṇām || 59 || ānṛṇyamakhilaṃ prāpya sārvabhaumo bhaveddhruvam || budhavāre naraḥ kurvañchoṇādrīśapradakṣiṇām || 1.3.1.9.60 || sarvajñatāmanuprāptaḥ sa vācāṃ patitāmiyāt || guruvāre naraḥ kurvansarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || 61 || pradakṣiṇena śoṇādreḥ sa tu lokagururbhavet || bhṛguvāre naraḥ kurvannaruṇādripradakṣiṇām || 62 || saṃprāpya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || mandavāre naraḥ kṛtvā śoṇādrīśapradakṣiṇām || 63 || vimukto grahapīḍābhiḥ sa viśvavijayī bhavet || nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi purā taddaivataiḥ saha || 64 || mama pradakṣiṇāṃ kartuḥ puṇyāni sahasā vrajet || tithayaḥ karaṇānīha yogāśca mama saṃmatāḥ || 65 || abhīṣṭaphaladā jātāḥ kurvatāṃ matpradakṣiṇām || muhūrtā vividhā horāḥ saumyāśca satatodayāḥ || 66 || matpradakṣiṇakartṛṇāṃ jāyaṃte satataṃ śubhāḥ|| pracchinatti prakāro'ghaṃ dakāro vāṃchitapradaḥ ||67|| kṣikārātkṣīyate karma ṇakāro muktidāyakaḥ|| durbalāḥ kārśyasaṃyuktā ādhivyādhivijṛṃbhitāḥ || 68 || mama pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyaṃte sarvaduṣkṛtaiḥ || mama pradakṣiṇaṃ karturbhaktyā pādena saṃtatam ||69|| kṣaṇena sādhvāṃ paśyāmi trailokyasya pradakṣiṇām || lokeśāśca digīśāśca ye cānye kāraṇeśvarāḥ||1.3.1.9.70|| mama pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā sthirā rājye purā'bhavan || ahaṃ ca gaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadevarṣisaṃyutaḥ ||71|| uttarāyaṇasaṃyoge karomi svapradakṣiṇām || madrūpaṃ taijasaṃ liṃgamaruṇādririti śrutam ||72|| trailokyasya hitārthāya kariṣyāmi pradakṣiṇām || āgatā ca parāṃte ca gaurī tapa ihādbhutam || 73 || kartuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā māmeṣyatyanaghā punaḥ || kārtike māsi nakṣatre kṛttikākhye mahātapāḥ || 74 || mama pradakṣiṇāṃ gaurī pradoṣe racayiṣyati || narāṇāmalpapuṇyānāṃ durlabhaṃ tatpradakṣiṇam || 75 || jyotirligasya dṛṣṭasya devī prārthanayā tathā || mayā sametā devī sā prāptā'pītakucābhidhā || 76 || āśvāsyati surānsarvānuttarāyaṇasaṃgame || devagandharvayakṣāṇāṃ siddhānāmapi rakṣasām || 77 || sarveṣāṃ devayonīnāṃ bhavitā tatra saṃgamaḥ || ye tadā māṃ samāgatya pūjayaṃti tapodhikāḥ || 78 || sarvajanmakṛtāghaugha prāyaścittaṃ vrajaṃti te || durllabhaṃ taddinaṃ puṃsāmuttarāyaṇasaṃgame || 79 || tadā madrūpamabhyarcya kṛtārthāḥ santu mānavāḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ tu me divyaṃ kurvaṃti ca mahībhujaḥ || 1.3.1.9.80 || teṣāṃ purogataḥ sākṣādahaṃ jeṣyāmi vidviṣaḥ || rājā yasya tu deśasya yo yo rājā tapodhikaḥ || 81 || sa kārayedvipramukhyaiḥ śrotriyairme pradakṣiṇām || maṃḍalaṃ maṃḍalārddhaṃ vā saṃkalpavidhipūrvakam || 62 || tasya tasya sthiraṃ rājyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ ca parāhatim || kariṣyāmi mune nityamahameva puraḥsthitaḥ || 83 || na vāhanena kurvīta mama jātu pradakṣiṇām || dharmalubdhamanā jānañchivācārapariplutim || 84 || dharmaketuḥ purā rājā yamalokādupāgataḥ || mama pradakṣiṇāṃ karttuṃ turageṇābhyarocayat || 85 || kṣaṇena turago jāto gaṇanāthaḥ surārcitaḥ || pratipede padaṃ śaivaṃ vimucya dharaṇīpatim || 86 || vīkṣya taṃ vāhanaṃ bhūyo gaṇanāthavapurddharam || pādapradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ ca gaṇapo'bhavat || 87 || tadāprabhṛti śakrādyāḥ surā viṣṇusamanvitāḥ || pādābhyāmeva kurvaṃti mama sarve pradakṣiṇām || 88 || svargānnipātitaḥ ko'pi siddhaḥ kāle tapaḥkṣayāt || pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punarlabdhapado'bhavat || 89 || skhalitaṃ pādajaṃ raktaṃ mama kartuḥ pradakṣiṇam || mārjyate tasya devendra maulimaṃdārakesaraiḥ || 1.3.1.9.90 || pradakṣiṇamahāvīthī śilāśakalaghaṭṭitam || padaṃ saṃdhāryate puṃsāṃ śrīpayodharakuṃkumaiḥ || 91 || maṇiparvataśṛṃgeṣu kalpadrumavanāṃtare || saṃcaraṃti sadā martyā mama kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam || 92 || || gauryuvāca || || upacārapravṛttānāṃ phalaṃ me śaṃsa suvrata || yairvai janaḥ kṛtārthaḥ syādyathāśakti kṛtādaraḥ || 93 || || muniruvāca || || upacāraphalaṃ devi śṛṇu vakṣyāmyahaṃ tava || yanmahyaṃ kṛpayā pūrvamuktavānparameśvaraḥ || 94 || lūtī taṃtukajālāni saṃsṛjya kvacideva me || jātismaro mahīdhre'sminsoṃ'śukairmāṃ vyaveṣṭayat || 95 || gajaḥ kaścitṛṣākrāṃto vimucya ca madhu kvacit || vanapallavamutkīrya mukto'bhūdgaṇanāyakaḥ || 96 || kṛmayo viluṭhanto me pārśve duritavarjitāḥ || siddhaveṣāḥ punaḥ sarve mama lokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 97 || avyucchinnapradīpārciḥ kṣaṇamapyādadhāti yaḥ || svayaṃprakāśaḥ sa bhavanmama sārūpyamaśnute || 98 || hārītaḥ kopi saṃprāptaḥ śākhānīḍo mamāṃtike || khadyoto dīpavannaktaṃ tāvanmuktiṃ samāgataḥ || 99 || gāvaḥ prasravaṇaiḥ siktā vatsasmaraṇasaṃbhavaiḥ || matpārśve muktimāpustā mama lokaṃ samāśrayan || 1.3.1.9.100 || kākaḥ pakṣajavātena baligrahaṇalolupaḥ || mārjayanmatpurobhāgaṃ muktiṃ prāpadyata kṣaṇāt || 101 || mūṣako madguhābhāgaṃ maṇisaṃghavikarṣaṇaiḥ || prakāśayanvitimiraṃ mama rūpamapadyata || 102 || chāyāvṛkṣatvamāsthātuṃ munayastridaśā api || prārthayaṃtyeva matpārśve na punaḥsaṃbhavecchayā||103|| gopuraṃ śikharaṃ śālāṃ maṇḍapaṃ vāpikāmapi || kurvatāṃ matpurobhāge sidhyaṃtīṣṭārthasaṃpadaḥ || 104 || sadā marttyairanāsādyamagniliṃgamidaṃ mama || anāsādyācaleśākhyaṃ pūjyatāṃ vasudhātale ||105|| vīkṣaṇasparśanadhyānaiḥ svabhūtaṃ nikhilaṃ jagat || poṣayaṃtī parā śaktiḥ pūjyā'pītakucābhidhā ||106|| sarvalokaikajananī saṃprāptā nityayauvanam|| yauvanaprārthibhiḥ sevyā sadā'pītakucābhidhā || 107|| kṣaṇāttasya purobhāge vasatāṃ prāṇināmiha || paratra vātra duṣprāpyamiṣṭavastu na vidyate ||108|| aprameyaguṇādhāramapekṣitavarapradam || aśeṣabhoganilayaṃ śoṇādrīśaṃ samarcaya ||109|| labdhakāmā punaḥ śambhumāśrayiṣyasi suvrate || tapaścaraṇamapyetattava lokahitāvaham || 1.3.1.9.110 || na kevalaṃ tava tapaḥ svavāṃchitaphalapradam || tapasyatāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca kṣemāyaiva bhaviṣyati||111|| kāraṇāṃtaramāśaṃkya tapaḥ kurvaṃti devatāḥ || rahasyaṃ devatānāṃ tu phalenaivānumīyate || 112 || vayaṃ ca sahasaṃvāsāstava vratanirīkṣaṇāt || kṛtārthāḥ syāma deveśi tapasā naḥ kṛtārthatā || 113 || iti tasya munervākyamarthagarbhaṃ niśamya sā || gaurī kautukasaṃyuktā praśaśaṃsa mahāmunim || 114 || tapaḥ kimanyatkartavyaṃ labdhaṃ tava tu darśanam || aruṇādrirayaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaṃ māhātmyamasya ca || 115 || aho bhūmestu vaicitryaṃ yato dṛṣṭā divo'dhikā || yatraiva taijasaṃ liṃgaṃ devatānāṃ varapradaḥ || 116 || śivaḥ prasādasiddho me darśitaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ || atraiva śivamārādhya vaśīkuryāṃ jagadgurum || 117 || avinābhūtamaikyaṃ me devena bhavatātsadā || tvayā kṛtena sāhyena bhaveyaṃ śivanāyikā || 118 || iti gautamasaṃnidhau tadānīṃ kṛtasaṃvittapa ādareṇa kartum || abhajadrucirāṃ ca parṇaśālāṃ muninā cānumatā tatheti bhaktyā || 119 || sukumāratanuḥ saroruhākṣī ghanatuṃgastanakalpitottarīyā || jaṭilā harinīlaratnakāṃtirgirijā rājati dehavattapaḥśrīḥ || 1.3.1.9.120 || niyamairbahubhistapoviśeṣaiḥ kratuṣu prāptavicitrayogabaṃdhaiḥ || nigamāgamadṛṣṭadharmamārgaṃ sakalaṃ sā tu kṛtārthatāmanaiṣīt || 121 || tapasā vividhenatapyamānā na kadācitparikhedamāpa tanvī || hariratnamayī ca kāpi vallī nitarāṃ dīptimatī babhūva bālā || 122 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe'ruṇeśvarapradakṣiṇāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<1.3.1.10>
|| brahmovāca || || atha devā mahīṃ hitvā mahiṣāsurapīḍitāḥ || natvā gaurīṃ tapasyaṃtīṃ jagmuḥ śaraṇamākulāḥ || 1 || atha tānabhayaṃ dehi devīti bhayavihvalān || amarānvīkṣya sā devī kiṃ kāryamiti cābhyadhāt || 2 || tato vijñāpayāmāsurdaityeṃdrādbhayamātmanām || devyai baddhāṃjalipuṭā devā iṃdrapurogamāḥ || 3 || || devā ūcuḥ || || apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaḥ sukhaṃ krīḍati naṃdane || airāvatamukhānsarvāndiṅnāgānnijamaṃdire || 4 || āvasayanvinodārthamaṃganābhiḥ sahāgatān || uccaiḥśravaḥpurogānāmupabhogaṃ karotyasau || 5 || maṃdurāsvasya ramyāsu dṛśyaṃte lakṣakoṭayaḥ || hutāśavāhanaṃ meṣaṃ putrārohārthamīpsati || 6 || yāmyaṃ mahiṣamānīya śakaṭe so'bhyavāhayat || siddhīrākṛṣya sakalā gṛhakarmaṇi cādiśat || 7 || apsaraḥsaṃghamakhilamātmasevārthamānayat || anyatkimapi yadvastu ratnabhūtaṃ jagattraye || 8 || anāhṛtaṃ punarhartuṃ na viśrāmyati kopavān || vayaṃ ca sevakā bhūtvā nityaṃ bhītisamanvitāḥ || 9 || pūjayaṃtaśca tasyājñāṃ nānyāṃ vīkṣāmahe gatim || śaraṇāgatasaṃtrāṇaṃ tapaḥphalamudāhṛtam || 1.3.1.10.10 || durjayo'yaṃ varo daityaḥ sarveṣāṃ balināmapi || surāṇāmapi daityānāṃ śivāllabdhavarodayaḥ || 11 || asya śṛṃgāhataḥ siṃdhurvyāvarjitamiti bruvan || ratnopahāradānena nityaṃ tatprītimicchati || 12 || parvatāṃśca samutkṣipya śṛṃgāgreṇa mahoddhataḥ || krīḍati kṣoditāśeṣadhātudhūlivilepanaiḥ || 13 || na śakyamatulaṃ tasya balamanyadurāsadam || svayameva vijānīhi hatvā te nijatejasā || 14 || śaṃbhuśaktiḥ parā seyaṃ strīrūpeṇātra dṛśyate || tvayaivāyaṃ nihaṃtavyaḥ śivāllabdhavaro hyayam || 15 || na jānīmo vayaṃ devi kiṃcicchaṃbhuviceṣṭitam || kevalaṃ pālanīyāḥ sma jaganmātrā sadā tvayā || 16 || iti teṣāṃ bhayārtānāmākarṇya vacanaṃ śubham || vyājahāra prasannātmā devī dattvābhayaṃ tadā || 17 || śaraṇāgatasaṃtrāṇaṃ tapasi sthitayā mayā|| karttavyamamarāḥ kālātkṣīṇaḥ śatrurbhaviṣyati ||18|| upāyena samākṛṣya haniṣyāmi mahāsuram || nirāgasastu hananamadya me na hi yujyate ||19|| dharmage dharmabhettāraḥ śalabhatvaṃ vrajaṃti hi || devāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇamya girikanyakām ||1.3.1.10.20|| jagmuryathāgataṃ sarve nirbhayā hṛṣṭacetasaḥ ||21|| gateṣu teṣu deveṣu gaurī kamalalocanā || babhūva mohinī śaktiḥ kāṃtiyuktā tatodarī ||22 || sā devī dikṣu śaileṣu caturṣvaruṇabhūbhṛtaḥ || rakṣārthaṃ sthāpitavatī caturo baṭukānvarān || 23 || yadā kailāsaśikharādāgatā śailakanyakā || anvagacchansevamānāścatasro mātarastadā || 24 || dundubhiḥ satyavatyākhyā tathā cānavamī parā || sundarīti catasrastāmanvayuḥ paricārikāḥ || 25 || vimuñcatātithiṃ śrāṃtaṃ kṣutpipāsā samanvitam || aruṇādrimimaṃ draṣṭuṃ nānyamityabravīcca tān || 26 || sīmāśalasthitānvīrāṃstānādiśya balādhikān || tapaścacārādrikanyā gautamāśramasannidhau || 27 || tasyāṃ tapatyāṃ tanvaṃgyāṃ na tāpaḥ kaścidapyabhūt || vavarṣa kāle jaladaḥ saphalāścābhavandrumāḥ || 28 || virodhīni ca sattvāni mumucuḥ pūrvamatsaram || āśramaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ śaraṇyo'bhūdbhayāpahaḥ || 29 || yojanadvayaparyaṃtaṃ sīmāśaileṣu saṃsthitaiḥ || catubhirvaṭakaiḥ śūrai rakṣitaścāruṇācalaḥ || 1.3.1.10.30 || nodabhūtkaścana trāso na ca dṛṣṭo bhayodayaḥ || na vyādhipīḍanaṃ cāsīttatra nārivijṛṃbhaṇam || 31 || kṛtārthā munayaḥ sarve praśaṃsaṃto nagātmajām || śivalokapadaṃ kecitpratyaśaṃsaṃstathāśramam || 32 || sā ca gaurī tapo ghoraṃ kurvatī ca divāniśam || na tṛptimāyayau bālā śivasaṃtoṣakārakam || 33 || mahiṣaśca mahāvīryo mṛgayāṃ kartumudyataḥ || cacāra kānanaṃ sarvaṃ vidūre śoṇabhūbhṛtaḥ || 34 || daityasainyasamāyukto mṛgayūthānyanekaśaḥ || vaneṣu nighnastarasā vicacārāśu bhakṣayan || 35 || dhanvibhirbalibhirvīrairmṛgāḥ kecidanudrutāḥ || bhayārttāḥ paridhāvaṃtaḥ prāviśaṃstaṃ tathāśramam || 36 || anuvrajanto ditijā mṛgāṃstānhaṃtumudyatāḥ || vāritā baṭukairvīrairmā yātātreti satvaraiḥ || 37 || kimatreti tadā pṛṣṭā baṭukā duṣṭadānavaiḥ || tapasyati varārohā kanyātretyāhuraṃjasā || 38 || na kenacitpraveṣṭavyaṃ balinā munisevitam || tapaḥsthānamidaṃ devyāḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakam || 39 || iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā balino duṣṭadānavāḥ || tatheti vinivṛttyāśu karttavyaṃ samaciṃtayan || 1.3.1.10.40 || māyayā pakṣirūpāste praviśyāśramamādarāt || ārāmavṛkṣaśākhāsu niṣeduḥ khādihekṣitum || 41 || sā punarllasitāraṇye sarvartukusumānvite || tapasyantī tadā dṛṣṭā māyā daityasya sainikaiḥ || 42 || rūpalāvaṇyate tasyā niścayaṃ tapasi sthitam || vīkṣya te vismayopetā gatvā tasmai nyavedayan ||43|| sa smarārto vṛddharūpaḥ praviveśāśramaṃ tadā || pūjito'syāḥ sakhībhiśca gataśrāṃtiriva sthitaḥ || 44 || vṛddho'pṛcchatkimarthaṃ tu tapo'syā iti tāstathā || bālā kāṃtaprasādārthaṃ ciramatra tapasyati || 45 || paraṃ sa balavānkāṃto na kadāpi prasīdati || kāryaṃ vivāhasamaye manorathaṃ yathocitam || 46 || apūrvaprabhuṇā tena navopakaraṇaṃ mahat || sadyojātakulālena sadyaḥ sṛṣṭairvipācitaiḥ || 47 || bhājanarapi sādyaskairnyastaḥ pakvaiśca śālibhiḥ || tādṛśaiḥ sādhanaiḥ sarvaistādṛśairdravyasaṃcayaiḥ || 48 || apūrvadṛṣṭavibhavaiḥ kāryaṃ syādupakāraṇam || siddhe tathopakaraṇe'syāḥ sadyo'stu svayaṃvaraḥ || 49 || iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā vihasanmahiṣo'bhyadhāt || tapaḥphalamahaṃ prāptaḥ satyamasyā iti sthitam || madīyā sakalāṃ bhūtiṃ śṛṇu bāle tapasvini || 1.3.1.10.50 || mahiṣo'haṃ mahāvīro daityendraḥ suravaṃditaḥ || jagattrayamidaṃ sarvaṃ mayaiva parigṛhyate || 51 || ananyavīrasadbhāvo mayyeva bhujaśuṣmaṇā || kāmarūposmyahaṃ bāle sarvabhogapradāyakaḥ || 52 || bhaja māṃ tava bharttāraṃ prāṇināṃ tapasaḥ phalam || sarvaṃ saṃpādayiṣyāmi kalpavṛkṣaiḥ samāhṛtaiḥ || 53 || sṛjāmi tapasā cāhaṃ viśvakarmāṇamāditaḥ || kāmadhenusahasrāṇi sṛjāmi tapasā kṣaṇāt || 54 || navabhirnidhibhiḥ prāptaiḥ pārśvasthairnityadā mama || apekṣitārthasaṃsiddhiḥ sahasaivopapādyate || 55 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā smṛtadevābhavatkramāt || visṛjya maunaṃ śanakairvihasaṃtī tamabravīt || 56 || ahaṃ balavato bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi tapaściram || karomi yadyasi balī balaṃ darśaya me nijam ||57|| viraca strīsvabhāvaṃ svaṃ śrutvā tadvākyamutthitam || hate koyamiti krodhānnanarda mahiṣāsuraḥ ||58 || jighṛkṣataṃ samāyāṃtaṃ vīkṣya taṃ mahiṣāsuram || abhūddurāsadā durgā kanyā sā jvalanākṛtiḥ || 59 || mahāmāyāṃ samālokya jvalaṃtī purataḥ sthitām || svayaṃ sa mahiṣākāro vavṛdhe merusannibhaḥ ||1.3.1.10.60 || kulabhūdharaśṛṃgāṇi śṛṃgābhyāṃ muhurākṣipan || ājuhāva nijāṃ senāmāpūritadigaṃtarām || 61 || atha brahmamukhā devāḥ praṇamya vividhāyudhaiḥ || pūjayāmāsurātmīyairdurgāṃ kālāgnirūpiṇīm || 62 || paṃcahetīrhariḥ prādāddaśa cāpi sadāśivaḥ || brahmā catasraśca tadā tasyai māyātirohitāḥ || 63 || dikpālāśca surāścānye parvatāśca payodhayaḥ || svīyairābharaṇaiḥ śastrairadhṛṣyāstāmapūjayan || 64 || māyā sā bahubhirhastairjvaladāyudhasaṃcayaiḥ || ābaddhakavacā tūrṇaṃ durgābhūtsiṃhavāhanā || 65 || āpūritadiśābhogā tejastatsoḍhumakṣamaḥ || durgāyā ghoramālokya mahiṣastu palāyitaḥ || 66 || atha tejo nijaṃ ghoraṃ prajvalatsoḍhumakṣamam || palāyamānamālokya mahiṣaṃ sā vyaciṃtayat || 67 || upāyena nihaṃtavyo duṣṭo'yaṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ || madapūrvaṃ nivṛtyaṃte mṛgā mṛgayubhirvane || 68 || dūtoktibhiḥ samākṛṣya mṛdvībhirmarmavṛttibhiḥ || kopamasya samudbhāvya kariṣyebhimukhaṃ kṣaṇāt || 69 || adharmavṛttiyuktānāṃ dharmavākyapariśravāt || kopaḥ samudbhavetsadyaḥ svajīvakṣayakāraṇam || 1.3.1.10.70 || athavā dharmabuddhissanyadi śāṃto bhaviṣyati || tadā hitopadeśena dharmalopo na saṃbhavet || 71 || tapasyadbhiḥ sadā kāryaḥ kopatyāgaḥ phalānvitaḥ || dharmahānirna soḍhavyā tatkopo hi tapaḥ param || 72 || iti saṃciṃtya sā gaurī nāmnā suraguruṃ munim || saṃkalpya vānaramukhaṃ prāhiṇodasuraṃ prati || 73 || gaccha tvaṃ māyayā yukto maharṣe vānarānana || mahiṣaṃ bodhayitvā ca vacanaṃ śīghramāvraja || 74 || maiva tvamaruṇādrīśamupapīḍaya durmate || atra durmanasāṃ vīryamadṛśyaṃ bhavati kṣaṇāt || 75 || na kalerupatāpo'tra nāsurairapi pīḍanam || na sāhasaṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivabhaktimatāmapi || 76 || pūrvajanmakṛtaiḥ puṇyairlabdhavīryamahodayaḥ || mā tvaṃ śoṇācaleśāgnau śalabhatvaṃ bhajāsura || 77 || śivena dattā vibhavāstava pūrvatapobalāt || dahyeranyatra tarasā dāvavahnau yathā drumāḥ || 78 || atra dharmātmanāṃ vāsaḥ śivabhaktimatāṃ sadā || parapīḍāprasaktānāṃ bhavedrogaśatāvṛtaḥ || 79 || aiśvaryyamatulaṃ prāpto balamanyaddurāsadam || kimarthaṃ svalpabuddhiḥ sansvadoṣairnāśameṣyasi || 1.3.1.10.80 || mayā kanyā punardṛṣṭā viśeṣādabalā matā || aṃtargatoruṇādrīśa etasmātsā viśiṣyate || 81 || athavā yuktibhedaistvaṃ śāstrairvā śivasaṃmataiḥ || anigrāhyamanovṛttirātmasainyaṃ samānaya || 82 || yena lokānsamastāṃstvaṃ bādhase balagarvitaḥ || tatsainyaṃ tava vṛddhaṃ ca kṣaṇāddhakṣyāmi tejasā ||83|| ānīya sakalaṃ sainyamagre sthāpaya sāyudham || sadyastvātmabalaiḥ sṛṣṭeḥ saṃhariṣyāmi tatkṣaṇāt ||84|| macchastra parikṛttasya sasainyasya tavāyuṣaḥ || muktiratraiva bhavitā ko jānāti śivehitam || 85 || vāryamāṇo'pi pūrveṇa karmaṇā prerito janaḥ || avaśaḥ karma kurute bhuṃkte ca sadṛśaṃ phalam || 86 || tvayāpi karuṇāvākyaṃ vaktavyaṃ kila bhūribhiḥ || akāryavinivṛttyarthaṃ nityadharmānupālane || 87 || iti gauryā samādiṣṭā vācaṃ kapimukho muniḥ || dūtaḥ sansarvamācaṣṭa mahiṣasyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 88 || so'pi sarvaṃ samākarṇya krodhavegasamākulaḥ || taṃ bhakṣayitumārebhe sopi māyābalādyayau ||89|| atha sainyaṃ nijaṃ sarvaṃ samāhūya durāśayaḥ || sannaddhaṃ sāyudhaṃ yoddhumādiśallokabhīṣaṇam ||1.3.1.10.90|| yugāṃtasamayodvelacaturarṇavasaṃnibham || sainyānāṃ sainyamatulaṃ śoṇādriṃ paryaveṣṭayat || 91 || atha gaurī samālokya daityānāṃ sainyamadbhutam|| sasarja taijasāñśūrānghorānbhūtagaṇānbahūn ||92|| ekapādākṣicaraṇā laṃbakarṇapayodharāḥ || pāṇipādaśiraḥkukṣivaktrāḥ kecidvinirgatāḥ || 93 || ahaṃ grasāmi sakalamaparyāptamidaṃ mama || ahameva haniṣyāmi daityasainyamaśeṣataḥ ||94|| kiṃ tvayātra punaḥ kāryaṃ vīkṣya tvaṃ tiṣṭha kevalam || ahamevātra yotsyāmītyabhāṣaṃta parasparam|| ||95|| teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ śaṃkhaṃ gaṇānāṃ yoginīgaṇaiḥ || adhamatsā bhagavatī haṃtuṃ taddaityamaṃḍalam ||96|| ālokya tāṃ tathārūpāmāpataṃstasya sainikāḥ || darśayaṃtaḥ svavīryāṇi svāminogre dhṛtāyudhāḥ || 97 || vavṛṣuḥ śastravarṣāṇi daityāḥ pratidigantaram || bāṇaiḥ kārmukanirmuktaistāni sā tu nyavārayat || || 98 || rathānāṃ vāraṇeṃdrāṇāṃ hayānāṃ lakṣakoṭibhiḥ || yuyudhurbhūtavetālā devyā sṛṣṭāstu durjayāḥ || 99 || mātaro vividhākārā ḍākinyo yoginīgaṇāḥ || sṛṣṭāśca tejasā bhūyaḥ piśācāḥ pretarākṣasāḥ || 1.3.1.10.100 || devyā sṛṣṭena sainyena durjayena mahāsurāḥ || bhakṣitāścūrṇitā bhinnā dāritā nihatāḥ kṣaṇāt || 101 || devī ca sāyudhā dṛṣṭā jvalaṃtī nihatāsuraiḥ || nṛtyadbhūtagaṇairbhuktai raktairmāṃsaiśca toṣitaiḥ || 102 || yadā kailāsaśikharātprāptā karttuṃ tapo bhuvam || tadā samāgatāḥ kāścinmātṛkā dehaguptaye || 103 || duṃdubhiḥ satyavatyākhyā tathā cāntavatī parā || suṃdarīti catasrastā anvayuḥ paricārikāḥ || 104 || devyā sṛṣṭā ca cāmuṃḍā daṃṣṭrāvalayabhīpaṇā || daityakṛttivasā māṃsaraktatṛptā cacāra sā || 105 || asuraṃ kaṃcidākramya naṭanaṃ sā cakāra ha || 106 || atha tāṃ samavekṣya durmado hi jvalayāmāsa ca kopavahninā saḥ || atitīvravivṛttabhīṣmanetraśrutiśṛṃgāgravibhinnameghajālaḥ || || 107 || jvaladagniśikhābhadīrghajihvāparilīḍhonnataśailaśṛṃgabhāgaḥ || avaniṃ dalayankhurābhighātairasakṛtpāṃsubhirāsvanandigaṃtān ||108|| atigharghara dīrghaghoranādasphuṭadaṃḍabhramamohitāmaro yaḥ || dhṛtavāladhidaṃḍatāḍyamānapratiśīrṇāmitaśastravarṣasaṃghaḥ ||109|| mṛtaye vyagamadbalitrayāḍhyāṃ mṛgarājasthitibhāsurāṃ bhavānīm||1.3.1.10.110|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe devyāstapaścaryāyāṃ mahiṣāsureṇa saha yuddhavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||cha||
<1.3.1.11>
|| brahmovāca || || sa tu siṃhasthitāṃ gaurīṃ jvalaṃtī vividhāyudhām || śailavarṣeṇa mahatā kupitaḥ samapūrayat || 1 || śaravarṣeṇa mahatā tannivārya vidūrataḥ || bibheda niśitaiḥ śastrairaśeṣaṃ tasya vigraham || 2 || bhidyamāno'pi daityeṃdraḥ śailasārapradurdharaḥ || viṣādaṃ nāgamatkiṃcidvavṛdhe yuddhadurmadaḥ || 3 || bhidyamānaḥ sa khaḍgena cakrairasibhirṛṣṭibhiḥ || śūlena cāyudhaiścānyairaṃtardhānamagāhata |||| 4 || tataḥ siṃhākṛtirbhīmaḥ pracaṃḍaninadānanaḥ || tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ śitanakhaḥ paribabhrāma kesarī || 5 || devīsiṃhaścapeṭena tāḍayāmāsa pāṇinā || daityasiṃhasya ca nakhaistasya vakṣo vyadārayat || 6 || atha vyāghratayā prāptaḥ sphuṭavyāttānano mahān || taṃ haṃtuṃ ca balāddevī vegena karamakṣipat || 7 || dīrghābhirnnīlarekhābhiḥ pūrṇaḥ piṃgalavigrahaḥ || yānāvalibhirākīrṇaḥ svarṇādririva saṃcaran || 8 || mṛgairiva paritrātuṃ mucyamāno'grato balī || jvalaṃtamiva roṣāgniṃ jihvāhetibhirāvahan||9|| āgacchaṃtaṃ rayāddevī bhallena śaśivarcasā || prativivyādha taṃ vyāghraṃ puratrayamiveśvaraḥ ||1.3.1.11.10|| sa bāṇastanmukhe magnastadraktena samukṣitaḥ || jagāhe gaganaṃ bhittvā dehamasya vinirgataḥ || 11 || sa daityo vāraṇo bhūtvā devīmāśvabhyupāgamat || balibhiḥ paśubhirbhinnaistasyāḥ prītimivāvahan || 12 || taṃ gajeṃdraṃ samāyāṃtaṃ madaklinnamahītalam || devīsiṃhastadā dṛṣṭvā nanarda ca jaghāna ca || 13 || atha khaḍgadharo vīraścarmapāṇiḥ samudgataḥ || vaktraṃ dadhāno babhrāma daṃṣṭrābhrukuṭibhīṣaṇam || 14 || devī ca vilasatkhaḍgacakracakralasatkarā || yuyodha tena vīreṇa bhagnaśīrṣābhyapadyata || 15 || bhūyaḥ sa māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāyāsuramāyayā || devyā yoddhuṃ pravavṛte yathāpūrvamanākulam || 16 || atha devaimunīṃdraiśca codito gautamo muniḥ || prabodhayitumārebhe stutibhirjagadaṃbikām || 17 || tvayi sarvasya jagataḥ prāṇaśaktiḥ parā matā || ojaḥśaktirjñānaśaktirbalaśaktiśca gamyate || 18|| kimetadadya mohāya yuddhamārabhyate tvayā || upasaṃhriyatāmeṣa daityo bhuvanaguptaye || 19 || bhinnānāmasya dehānāmupasaṃharaṇāttava || valayaścopadiśyante nigamoktā varapradāḥ ||1.3.1.11.20|| anyathā tṛṇakalpasya śatrorasya nibarhaṇe || kālāgnivarcaso devi kimarthaṃ saṃbhramastviyān || 21 || svaśaktimavasaṃstabhya samākarṣayatāṃ ripoḥ || prāṇaśaktiṃ triśūlena guṇatrayavapurdhṛtā || 22 || iti sma bodhitātena purā bhagavatī tadā || mahiṣāsuramākramya triśūlenābhyadhārayat|| 23 || anekagirisaṃkāśaṃ devyā vigrahamātmanaḥ|| aśaktastaṃ dhārayituṃ sasāda mahiṣāsuraḥ ||24|| niṣpiṣṭo viluṭhankrośannākrāṃtaśca parisphuran || nirgaṃtumudgataśirā na śaśākāsurādhipaḥ ||25|| triśūlamukhabhinnāṃgaraktadhārāsamuddhataḥ || samudra iva saṃjātaḥ saṃdhyāruṇakalevaraḥ || || 26 || atha khaḍgena tīkṣṇena kartayitvā ca tacchiraḥ || nanartta tasya śirasi tiṣṭhantī mahiṣārdinī || 27 || durgāṃ siddhāśca gandharvāḥ praśaśaṃsurmaharṣayaḥ || puṣpavṛṣṭiśca mahatī devairmuktā samaṃtataḥ || praṇataḥ prāṃjalirdevīṃ tuṣṭāva vibudhādhipaḥ || 28 || || indra uvāca || || namaste jagatāṃ mātre bhūtānāṃ bījasaṃvide || 29 || bhaktiḥ śraddhā ca bhajatāṃ śaktiścāsi tvamaṃbike || kāraṇaṃ paramā kīrtiḥ śātirdāṃtiḥ kalā kṣamā || 1.3.1.11.30 || ekaiva viśvarūpā tvaṃ nāmabhedernigadyase || teṣuteṣu padeṣvasmāṃstapo'nuguṇasiddhiṣu || 31 || niyujya śatruṃ nirbhidya śivā jñeyā prakāśase || hatoyaṃ mahiṣo duṣṭo vinikṛttaśca śāṃbhavi || 32 || chinnametasya tu śiraḥ sajīvamiva lakṣyate || raktanetraṃ tīkṣṇaśṛgaṃ jvalajjihvaṃ calaṃ śiraḥ || 33 || ākramya tava tiṣṭhantyā rūpameva sadāstu naḥ || cakraśṛṃgadhanurbāṇakhaṅgacarmavarābhayaiḥ || 34 || śūlaghaṇṭāṃkuśakaśākapālakuliśādibhiḥ || aśeṣadevatāmūrtiraśeṣaideṃvatāyudhaiḥ || 35 || āpūritā tvamevāṃba sarvaśatrūnnihaṃsi naḥ || āyudhānāṃ sahasrāṇi tanmayāste vibhūtayaḥ || 36 || tvajjitārātayaḥ sarve vividhāyudhavāhanāḥ || rathanāgahayairyuktāḥ sasainyā api bhūbhṛtaḥ || 37 || kṣaṇena dagdhavīryāḥ syustvatprasādavivarjitāḥ || apado'pyalpavīryo'pi tvatpādāṃbujasevakaḥ || 38 || trilokanāthatāṃ prāptaḥ prathate kīrtimaṇḍitaḥ || tadrūpamidamatyugraṃ dhyāyatāmarcatāṃ sadā || 39 || na śatrubhyo bhayaṃ kiṃcidbhavedvijayaśālinām || īdṛśaṃ sarvalokeṣu rūpaṃ te devavaṃditam || 1.3.1.11.40 || pūjyatāmiṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ devairbhṛtyaiśca sarvadā || mātaraśca tvayā sṛṣṭāḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ || 41 || sagaṇāḥ pratipūjyaṃtāṃ sarvasthāneṣu sarvadā || ayaṃ ca nihato daityastvatpādakṛtalāṃchanaḥ || 42 || tava bhaktaiḥ sadā pūjyastvatpramādāttvadagrataḥ || itthaṃ surendrapraṇutā sarvarṣisurasevitā || 43 || tatheti varadā devī sasarja ca divaṃ prati || svayamapyātmanastatra tadrūpaṃ vividhāyudham |||| 44 || saṃsthāpya mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ sthānarakṣaṇamātanot || saṃgṛhya vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sakhījanasamāvṛtā || 45 || mahiṣasya śiro'paśyadvikṛtaṃ khaṅgadhārayā || kathayantī punastasya citraṃ lokavibhūṣaṇam || 46 || sakhībhiḥ saha sā bālā kaṇṭhaṃ tasya vyalokayat || apaśyacca tadā ligaṃ karttuṃ tasya ca pūjanam || 47 || ādatta sahasā gaurī ligaṃ tasya gale sthitam || ālokayacca suciraṃ raktadhārāpariplutam || 48 || āsajjata punarliṃgamasyāḥ pāṇitalaṃ gatam || vimocayitumudyuktā nāśaknollagnamaṃjasā || 49 || aciṃtayacca sā devī kimetaditi vismayāt || viṣādena ca saṃyuktā maharṣīṇāṃ puraḥ sthitā || 1.3.1.11.50 || āhataḥ śivabhakto'yamiti śokaṃ samāviśat || agarhata bhṛśaṃ mauḍhyamātmanaḥ strīsvabhāvajam || 51 || avicāra samārabdhaṃ śivabhaktanibarhaṇam || upatāpaparītāṃgī gautamaṃ munisattamam || 52 || upagamyābravīdbālā sāhasaṃ kṛtamātmanā || bhagavansarvadharmajña gautamārya munīśvara || 53 || mānyayā dharmarūpeṇa ko'pyadharmaḥ prakalpitaḥ || devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kartumabhayaṃ dātumudyatā || 54 || ajñānānmahiṣaṃ daityaṃ śivabhaktimamardayam || rajasākrāntabuddhīnāṃ na bhaveddharmasaṃgrahaḥ || 55 || guruprasādasulabhaḥ sphuradvighnaśatākulaḥ || sudurdharṣā nirācāradurdamāḥ śivasaṃśrayāḥ || 56 || viśeṣato liṃgadharāḥ śivastānbahu manyate || purā puratrayāvāsā daiteyā liṃgadhārakā || 57 || ajitāḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ muktaliṃgā niṣūditāḥ || asya kaṃṭhasthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mama pāṇiṃ na muṃcati || 58 || kathaṃ pāpaṃ nirasyāmi śivabhaktavadhāśritam || asya kaṃṭhasthitaṃ liṃgaṃ dhārayaṃtī taponvitā || 59 || tīrthayātrāṃ kariṣyāmi yāvacchaṃbhuḥ prasīdati || punaḥ kailāsamukhyeṣu śaṃbhusthāneṣu bhūriṣu || 1.3.1.11.60 || tīrtheṣu racitasnānā lapsye pāpaviśodhanam || iti tasyāḥ pariśrāṃtiṃ durdharmapariśaṃkayā || 61 || ākarṇya śivadharmajño bhayārttāṃ tāmavocata || mā bhaiṣīrgirije mohācchivabhakto hatastviti || 62 || dharmasūkṣmārthavettārau durlabhā girikanyake || sadā śivasya vadanaiḥ sadyojātādi saṃśritaiḥ || 63 || āgamāḥ paṃcabhiḥ proktā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ || nirṇayāḥ śivabhaktānāṃ śivamārgasya śobhanāḥ || || 64 || teṣuteṣu munīṃdraiśca natvaiva pratipadyate || kālo mukhaṃ ca kaṃkālaṃ śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā || 65 || mahāvrataṃ paṃca caitāḥ śivamārgapravṛttayaḥ || bhedāśca bahavasteṣāmanyonyasya śive ratāḥ || 66 || sādhya eko hi balavānsarvaistairaniśaṃ śivaḥ || sarva eva sadā pūjyāḥ svadharmapariniṣṭhitaiḥ || 67 || amatsaraiḥ śive bhaktaiḥ śivājñāparipālakaiḥ || vedaiśca bahubhiryajñairbhaktyā ca parayā śivaḥ || 68 || ārādhyate mahādevaḥ sarvadā sarvadāyakaḥ || jīvahiṃsā na karttavyā viśeṣaṇa tapasvibhiḥ || 69 || śivadharmasya bhettāro nihaṃtavyāstathāṃjasā || na veṣajuṣi vīkṣeta na ligaṃ naiva saṃbhavam || 1.3.1.11.70 || śivadharmasya bhettāraṃ hanyādevāvicārayan || bahubhiḥ sphūrtayā buddhyā dharmavidbhirnirūpite || 71 || śivadharmasya vilaye sadyaḥ śaktiḥ pravartate || asya karma punardiṣṭaṃ liṃgamaiśvaryacarcitam || 72 || na jetuṃ śakyate devi tenāsau sarvadaivataiḥ || yadayaṃ nihato devi tvayā śaṃkaramānyayā|| 73 || ākrāṃtaḥ śāpadoṣeṇa maharṣīṇāṃ śivāśrayāt || atha te kupitāstasya vaiṣamyādavamānataḥ || 74 || śepurmahiṣavadduṣṭo mahiṣo'yaṃ bhavatviti || tatastadvacanātsadyo mahiṣo'bhūtkṣaṇāttathā || 75 || praṇamya toṣayāmāsa yayāce śāpamocanam || dattvā prakāmarūpatvaṃ dadurasmai prasāditāḥ || 76 || mahiṣatvepi saṃhāraṃ svayaṃ devyā śivājñayā || viṣādo na ca karttavyo aṃgadarśanatastvayā || 77 || siddhānāṃ śivarūpāṇāmavajñā kaṃ na bādhate || mahiṣatve samutpanne doṣeṇa samupasthite || 78 || siddhaprasādāllabdho'yaṃ śāpanāśastvayā kṛtaḥ || sarve lokāśca saṃtrātā duṣṭoyaṃ parirakṣitaḥ || 79 || śāpadoṣasamutpanne mahiṣatve vimocite || tvayā ca giriśaprītyai tapaḥ kurvāṇayādrije || 1.3.1.11.80 || draṣṭavyaṃ taijasaṃ liṃgamaruṇācalasaṃjñitam || pūrvajanmani bhakto'yamaruṇādripateḥ sphuṭam || 81 || mahiṣatve madākrāṃtaḥ paraṃ liṃgena saṃgataḥ || bhaktyā liṃgadharaṃ haṃtuṃ kaḥ samartho jagattraye || 82 || dṛṣṭāḥ puratraye pūrvaṃ rudreṇa pūjitāstrayaḥ || tvatkhaḍgaparikṛttena kaṃṭhenāsya varānane ||83|| dīkṣādirahitaṃ liṃgaṃ dattaṃ haṃtīti coditam || kṛtaṃ hi mahiṣeṇāpi bhaktito liṃgadhāraṇam || 84 || kadācitkṣapaṇoktānāṃ vibhāṣātpratyayaṃ gataḥ|| pūrvajanmatapoyogātsmaraṇo liṃgadhāraṇāt ||85|| tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśādayaṃ mukto na saṃśayaḥ|| maduktaniṣkṛtīnāṃ tu pātakānāṃ ca nāśanam ||86|| darśanaṃ śailavaryasya prāyaścittaṃ paraṃ matam || saṃsthāpya vividhāñchaivāñchivasiddhāṃtavedinaḥ ||87|| āvāhya sarvatīrthāni sarvadoṣanivṛttaye|| saraḥ kimapi saṃpādya snātvā tatra varānane||88|| aghamarṣaṇasaṃyuktā saliṃgā snānamācara || trisaṃdhyaṃ caiva māsāṃte devayāgamahotsave || 89 || ārādhayopacāraistvamaruṇādrimayaṃ śivam || 1.3.1.11.90 || evaṃ tasya munerniśamya vacanaṃ śaivārthasaṃbhāvitaṃ prītā devanamaskṛtā girisutā devī jagadrakṣikā || śaivaṃ dharmamimaṃ vidhātumucitaṃ śoṇācalasyāgratastīrthāgāhanabuddhimāśu vidadhe kartuṃ tvaghakṣālanam || 91 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe mahiṣāsuravadhottaraṃ devīpāṇau mahiṣāsuraśiraḥsaṃlagratāvṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<1.3.1.12>
|| brahmovāca || || iti saṃbhāṣamāṇe tu maharṣau muni sevite || vijahau girijā śaṃkāṃ śivabhaktavadhāśritām || 1 || athāṃtarikṣādudabhūdvāṇī karṇamanoharā || mā gamaḥ śailakanye tvaṃ pāpanipkṛtikāraṇāt || 2 || gaṃgā ca yamunā siṃdhurgodāpi ca sarasvatī || narmadā sā ca kāverī śoṇaḥ śoṇanadī ca sā || 3 || atraiva nava tīrthāni saṃbhavaṃtu śilātale || tvatkhaḍgadārite devi kuru tatrāghamarṣaṇam || 4 || asminnāśviyuje māsi jyeṣṭhānakṣatra āgate || nimajya khaḍgatīrthe tvaṃ saliṃgā māsamāvasa || 5 || nivartya sāvanaṃ māsamatra dikpālasaṃmitam || tataḥ pāṇisthitaṃ liṃgaṃ labdhvā pāpaviśodhanam || 6 || pratiṣṭhāpaya tīrthāgre lokānugrahakāraṇāt || uttīrya tīrthavarye'sminsnātvā liṃge'rcite śive || 7 || tāpatrayopaśāṃtiśca trailokyasya na saṃśayaḥ || sarvapāpaharaṃ liṃgaṃ sthāvaraṃ tīrthasannidhau || 8 || sthāpaya sthirayā bhaktyā sadālokahitāya ca || nakṣatre vaiśvadaivatye devakyāḥ saṃgamācara || 9 || mahotsavasamāyuktaṃ yāvaddaśadināvadhi || kṛtvā cāvabhṛthaṃ puṇyanakṣatre vahnidaivate || 1.3.1.12.10 || sāyamabhyarcya vidhivacchoṇācalavapurmama || tataste darśayiṣyāmi taijasaṃ rūpamātmanaḥ || 11 || etatkṛtaṃ te lokānāṃ rakṣāyai saṃbhaviṣyati || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maharṣivacanaṃ ca sā || 12 || ubhayaṃ kartumārebhe tapasā śailakanyakā || khaṅgena dārayāmāsa śilātalamanākulā || 13 || udajṛṃbhata tīrthānāṃ navakaṃ tatra tatkṣaṇāt || tasya kaṇṭhasthitaṃ ligaṃ dhyāyantī parvatātmajā || 14 || tīrthe mamajja tasminsā munīnāmabhyanujñayā || tīrthānāṃ navakaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ sphaṭikaprabham || 15 || aṃtarvasatitaḥ kāṃtyā mecakīkṛtamaṃjasā || vasaṃtyāṃ śailakanyāyāṃ tīrthe triṃśaddinaṃ tvatha || 16 || śambhorvirahasaṃtaptaṃ manaścaṃcalatāṃ yayau || tatra śriyā sarojāni cakṣuṣotpalakānanam || 17 || maṃdasmitena kumudaṃ sasarja salilasya sā || devyāstenodavāsena lokāstu nirupadravāḥ || 18 || kṛtārthāssahasā jātāstattatkālaphalānvitāḥ || māsāṃte sā samuttīrya kṛtvā devyutsavaṃ tathā || 19 || kārtike māsi nakṣatre kṛttikākhye niśodaye || pūjayitvā tapaḥsiddhairupacārairbahūdayaiḥ || 1.3.1.12.20 || aruṇādrimayaṃ liṃgaṃ tuṣṭāva jagadaṃbikā || namaste viśvarūpāya śoṇācalavapurbhṛte || 21 || tejomayādriliṃgāya sarvapātatakanāśine || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā ca tvaṃ duṣparicchedyavaibhavaḥ || 22 || agnirūpo'pi sañchāṃto lokānugrahaklṛptaye || śaktyā ca tattvasaṃghātakaraḥ kālānalākṛtiḥ || 23 || adriśreṣṭhāruṇādrīśa rūpalāvaṇyavāridhe || vicitrarūpametatte vedavedyasurārcitam || 24 || tejasāṃ deva sarveṣāṃ bījabhūtaṃ nigadyase || divyaṃ hi paramaṃ tejastava deva maheśvara || 25 || yatpurā brahmaṇā dṛṣṭaṃ viṣṇunā ca vicinvatā || adya pūtāsmi deveśa tava saṃdarśanādaham |||| 26 || tejo darśaya me divyaṃ sarvadoṣaharaṃ param || prārthayaṃtyāṃ tadā devyāmaruṇādrimayaḥ śivaḥ || 27 || āvirbabhūva tejobhirāpūrya bhuvanāṃtaram || koṭisūryodayaprakhyaṃ tulyaṃ pūrṇeṃdukoṭibhiḥ || 28 || kālāgnikoṭisaṃkāśaṃ tejaḥ paramadṛśyata || praṇamya parayā bhaktyā munibhiḥ sārdhamaṃbikā |||| 29 || vismayākrāṃtahṛdayā nanaṃda nalinekṣaṇā || atha tejonidhestasmādaruṇādriḥ samutthitaḥ || 1.3.1.12.30 || hiraṇmayo'bravīdvācaṃ puruṣaḥ kalakandharaḥ || prasanno'smi tapobhiste sthāneṣu mama kalpitaiḥ || 31 || tejomayamidaṃ rūpamīkṣitaṃ ca tvayādhunā || kāraṇairbahubhirlokānrakṣethāstvaṃ jaganmayi || 32 || tapāṃsi kuruṣe bhūmau kimanyatprārthitaṃ tava || mallocanatviṣā tedya tamorāśiḥ samutthitaḥ || 33 || aśeṣo hi praśāṃto'bhūttejaso'sya nirīkṣaṇāt || ayaṃ tu mahiṣo duṣṭo madbhaktiṃ liṃgapūjakaḥ || 34 || jagrāha sahasā hyetattasya liṃgaṃ gale sthitam || anena bhakṣitaṃ tacca nāstikasyopadeśataḥ || 35 || akaronmayyaviśvāsaṃ liṃgarūpe gale sthite || krameṇa sopi saṃprāpto munijanma manoharam || 36 || māmevābhyarcayandhyāyangaṇanāthatvamāvasan || pūrvajanmani bhakto'yaṃ mahiṣopi tvayā hataḥ || 37 || ciraṃ malliṃgadhṛgyasmātsiddhirasyāpi devyataḥ || śivaliṃgeṣvaviśvāsaḥ śivabhaktāvamānanam || 38 || na karttavyaṃ sadā bhaktaistasmādvai muktikāṃkṣibhiḥ || dīkṣayā rahitaṃ ligaṃ yena saṃdhāryate balāt || || 39 || na tādṛśaṃ phalaṃ datte vajravattaṃ nihaṃti ca || na doṣastatra kiṃcitte śoṇācalanirīkṣaṇāt || 1.3.1.12.40 || saphalā nayanāvāptiḥ sarvadoṣavināśanāt || tvatputrastanyadānena dhātryopakṛtamātmaje || 41 || tvāmapītakucāṃ cakre vatsalāṃ bhaktarakṣiṇīm || nakṣatre kṛttikākhye'tra tava sannidhilobhataḥ|| 42 || prāyaścittābhidhānena bhavāpītakucābhidhā || pūjāśeṣaṃ samādhāya bhaktānugrahahetave || 43 || bhaja māṃ karuṇāmūrtirapītakucanāyikā || iti devasya vacanamākarṇyātyaṃtaśītalam || 44 || praṇamya prārthitavatī provāca ca tamaṃbikā || devadeva prasādena tvayānugrahaśālinā || 45 || etatte darśitaṃ tejo dṛṣṭaṃ devaiśca mānavaiḥ || pratyakṣaṃ kṛttikāmāsi madvratāṃtamahotsave || 46 || nakṣatre kṛttikākhye'smiṃstejaste dṛśyatāṃ param || tadvīkṣitamidaṃ tejaḥ paramaṃ prativatsaram || 47 || dṛṣṭvā samastairduritairmucyatāṃ sarvajaṃtavaḥ || tatheti devadevena proce'thāṃtardadhe girau || 48 || pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārainaṃ sakhībhiḥ sā tatoṃ'bikā || ghanaśyāmalayā kāṃtyā parito jṛṃbhamāṇayā || 49 || aruṇādrimayaṃ liṃgaṃ cakre marakataprabham || maṃdaṃ carantī jātābhiḥ prabhābhiḥ pādapadmayoḥ || 1.3.1.12.50 || tastāra parito bhūmiṃ padmapatraiḥ sapallavaiḥ || praphullakanakāṃbhojanīlotpaladalotkaraiḥ || 51 || arcayantīva śoṇādrimabhito dṛṣṭikāṃtibhiḥ || indrādilokapālānāmaṃganābhirniṣevitā || 52 || prasāditā mātṛgaṇairgaṃdhadānavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || chatracāmarabhṛṃgāratālavṛntaphalācikāḥ || 53 || vahantībhiḥ surastrībhirvṛtā munivadhūyutā || pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārainamaruṇādriṃ svayaṃprabham |||| 54 || kāṃkṣantī śivasāyujyaṃ vivāhāgnimivādrijā || tasyāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā kurvāṇāyāṃ padepade || 55 || preṣitā śaṃbhunā devāḥ parivavruḥ sureśvarāḥ || sarasvatīsamaṃ dhātrā viṣṇunā ca samaṃ ramā || 56 || sarvadikpālakāṃtābhiḥ sametā śailabālikā || nirundhatīva devendraṃ salilairvaradānataḥ || 57 || adrināthasvarūpasya śītatvamiva kurvatī || tapasyayā'vinābhāvāddevasyeva kṛtasmṛtiḥ || 58 || duṣkarasyodavāsasya bodhayantīva sādhutām || ṛṣīṇāṃ devamānānāmupadeṣṭumiva kramāt || 59 || krīḍāmiva purābhyastāṃ tapasāpi ca saṃgatā || ātmānaṃ virahottaptāmātmasthaṃ tādṛśa śivam || 1.3.1.12.60 || saṃciṃtya cobhayoḥ kartuṃ śītalatvaṃ jale sthitā || tīrthānāmiva sarveṣāmudbhūtānāṃ śilātale || 61 || ādhikyamatha lokasya vaktukāmā svayaṃ sthitā || duritaghnaṃ ca paṃcāgnimarthāvāsaṃ suduṣkaram || 62 || adhigamya tapastasya śāṃtiṃ kartumiva sthitā || mahiṣāsurakaṃṭhottharaktadhārāpariplutam || 63 || kṣālayaṃtīva liṃgaṃ tadamalaistīrthavāribhiḥ || aruṇākhyaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || 64 || apītakucanātheśaśoṇādrīśvaratuṣṭaye || śṛṃgeṣu yasya saudheṣu vasantyo vārayoṣitaḥ || 65 || adhaḥkṛtābhrataḍito jigīṣaṃtīva cāmarīḥ || yattuṃgasaudhaśṛṃgāgre gāyaṃtīrvārayoṣitaḥ || 66 || siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvavidyādharavirājitam || aṣṭāpadarathākrāṃtamaṣṭavīthivirājitam || 67 || aṣṭāpadapathākāramaṣṭadikpālapūjitam || aṣṭasiddhiyutaiḥ siddhairaṣṭamūrtipadāśrayaiḥ || 68 || aṣṭāṃgabhaktiyuktaistairyuktamaṣṭāṃgabuddhibhiḥ || cāturvarṇyaguṇopetamupavarṇaṃ pariṣkṛtam || 69 || lasatsuvarṇaduvarṇaśālāmālāsamāsthitam || śaṃkhaduṃdubhinissāṇamṛdaṃgamurajādibhiḥ || 1.3.1.12.70 || vīṇāveṇumukhaistālaiḥ sālāpairuparaṃjitam || brahmaghoṣaninādena maharṣīṇāṃ śivātmanām || 71 || sevitavyaṃ dine divyasamadarśavṛṣadhvajam || navaratnaprabhājālairnavagrahasamodayaiḥ ||72|| niśādivasayorevaṃ darśayanniva sarvadā || viṣṇuḥ sthitaśca taṃ prītyā siṣeve purato vibhum || 73 || śakraḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ samāyayau || papāta divyagaṃdhāḍhyā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 74 || vyomagaṃgājalotsaṃgaśītalo marudāvavau || atīva saurabhāmodavāsitākhiladiṅmukhaḥ || 75 || kanakāṃkitaśṛṃgāgraparidhūtavanāvaliḥ || darpasaṃbhramasaṃnaddho nanāda vṛṣabho muhuḥ || 76 || vasaṃtapramukhāḥ sarve saharṣamṛtavaḥ puraḥ || asevaṃta priyakaraiḥ puṣpaiḥ svayamathocitaiḥ || 77 || gaṇaiśca vividhākārāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ || surāśca kutukopetāḥ samāgacchandidṛkṣavaḥ || 78 || kuṃkumakṣodasaṃmiśrakarpūrarajasānvitaḥ || caryāmuṣṭimahāsāraḥ samakīryata sarvataḥ || 79 || atha mṛdaṃgakamardalajhallarīpaṭahaduṃdubhitālasamanvitaiḥ || jalajakīcakakāhalanisvanaiḥ surakṛtairbhuvana samapūrayan || 1.3.1.12.80 || suravadhūjananṛttaniraṃtarollulitatuṃbarugāyanagītibhiḥ || abhivṛto munidevagaṇānvito vṛṣagataḥ samadarśi vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 81 || sarasametya śivaḥ karuṇānidhirnatamukhīmapi tāmapalajjayā || lalitamaṃkamanaṃgaripuḥ śivāṃ dhṛtimahānadhiropya jaharṣa saḥ || 82 || lalitayā nijayā priyayānvitaḥ suramunīṃdrasamājasamāvṛtaḥ || lalitamapsarasāṃ muhurādarānnaṭanamaikṣata gītisamanvitam || 83 || atha śivaḥ surarājasamarpitāñchubhapaṭīramukhānilasaurabhān || himagiriprahitāṃśca samagrahīnmṛgamadaiḥ saha gaṃdhasamuccayān || 84 || samanulepitahārasumaṃḍitāvabhigatau sitatāṃ samalaṃkṛtau || svayamapītakucākucakuḍmalāvaraṇaraṃbhaṇacañcalasatkarau || 85 || kaṭhinatuṃgaghanastanakorakasthagitamaṃgalagaṃdhamanoharām || girisutāmadhigamya śivaḥ svayaṃ virahatāpamaśeṣamapākarot || 86 || atha vinodaśatairupalakṣitāṃ nijaviyogajatāpa kṛśānvitām || aruṇaśailapatiḥ svayamadrijāṃ varamabhīpsitamarthaya cetyaśāt || 87 || sakutukaṃ praṇipatya nagātmajā puraripuṃ bhuvanatrayaguptaye || imamayācata śoṇagirīśvaraṃ varamudāramanugrahasaṃmudam || 88 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māhaśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe devyāḥ śivasamāgamavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<1.3.1.13>
|| brahmovāca || || atha gaurī purārātiṃ praṇamya jagadaṃbikā || ayācattādṛśā śaṃbhumavinābhāvamātmanaḥ || 1 || idaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa lokānugrahakāraṇāt || kṛpayā parayā pūrṇā gaurī saṃvādasuṃdarī || 2|| na tyājyametatte rūpamatra dṛṣṭimanoharam || ahaṃ tvayā na ca tyājyā sāparādhāpi sarvadā || manoharamidaṃ rūpametatte lokamaṃgalam || 3 || ālokyatāṃ sadā sarvairdivyagandhasamanvitam || bhujaṃgagaralabrahmakapālaśivabhasmabhiḥ || 4 || bhīṣaṇairalamīśāna jaya veṣaparigrahaiḥ || sukumāro bhaverdivyamālyagaṃdhāṃbarādibhiḥ |||| 5 || bhūṣito ratnabhūṣābhirviharasva maheśvara || āgatā nityamīśāna devagandharvakanyakāḥ || 6 || sevaṃtāmatra deveśaṃ nṛtyavāditragītibhiḥ || gaṇāśca mānuṣā bhūtvā sevaṃtāṃ tvāmaharniśam || 7 || tvatprasādādayaṃ deva sugaṃdhiḥ puṣṭivarddhanaḥ || āvayoḥ saṃgamo dṛṣṭo bhūyātsarvārthadāyakaḥ || 8 || gṛhītamatra deveśa sarvamaṃtrātmakaṃ vapuḥ || caritaṃ tava kaiṃkaryamastu bhaktiḥ sadā tava || 9 || jñānājñānakṛtaṃ nityamaparādhasahasrakam || kṣamyatāṃ tava bhaktānāmananyaśaraṇekṣaṇāt || 1.3.1.13.10 || iti devyā vacaḥ śrutvā śambhuḥ śoṇācaleśvaraḥ || tameva varadaḥ prādādvaraṃ sarvamabhīpsitam || 11 || ābhāṣya gaurīṃ kutukādraṃtukāmaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ || dhāraya tvaṃ mṛgamadaṃ manojñamidamūcivān || 12 || || mahādeva uvāca || || pulakākhyo mahāndaityo mṛgarūpī tapodhikam || kṛtvā prāpa varaṃ mattaḥ saugandhyaṃ paramādbhutam || 13 || labdhvā varaṃ svagandhenāmohayatsurayoṣitaḥ || tathaivādharmasaṃprāpto babādhe sakalaṃ jagat || 14 || devairabhyarthitaḥ sohamāhūyāsuranāyakam || vimuṃca lokarakṣārthamāsuraṃ dehamityaśām || 15 || || pulaka uvāca || || tyakṣyāmi devadeveśa dehametaṃ tvadājñayā || praṇamya bhaktimanasā māmapyarcedamūcivān || 16 || madaṃgasaṃbhavaṃ divyaṃ saurabhaṃ viśvamohanam || dhāryatāṃ deva deveśa sadā sādaracetasā || 17 || pulakasvedajāto hi sadā prakhyāyatāṃ tava || ayaṃ mṛgamado loke śṛṅgārarasavarddhanaḥ || 18 || tvatpriyaḥ kāṃtisaubhāgyarūpalāvaṇyadāyakaḥ || visṛjāmi nijaṃ dehaṃ devadeva jagatpate || 19 || sadā bahumato devyā divyasaurabhalubdhayā || madaṃśasaṃbhavā ye syurmattapolabdhasaurabhāḥ || 1.3.1.13.20 || līyaṃtāṃ tava deveśa mūrtāvālepanacchalāt || tatheti mayyuktavati sa daityaḥ pulakābhidhaḥ || 21 || visasarja nijaṃ dehaṃ mayisanyastajīvitaḥ || tatastadaṃgasaṃbhūtaṃ madaṃ bahulasaurabham || 22 || adhārayamahaṃ premṇā śataśṛṃgāravarddhanam || tapasā devadeveśi taptaṃ tava vapuḥ kṛśam || 23 || madaṃgaṃ ca viyogātta idaṃ nirvāpayādhunā || iti praśasya bahudhā pulakasnehamadbhutam || 24 || āliliṃpa mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ premamaṃdirām || apṛcchacca hasandevaḥ pārvatīṃ lalanākṛtim || 25 || kimetaditi hastotthaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagadaṃbikā || abravīdaruṇādrīśamānamya jagadaṃbikā || || 26 || āgatiṃ tasya puṣpasya sadā svakaravartinaḥ || 27 || || devyuvāca || || ahaṃ kailāsaśikharāddevadeva tvadājñayā || tapaḥ kartumanuprāptā kāṃcīṃ kanakatoraṇām || 28 || avāpya mānasodbhūtaṃ kahlāramidamuttamam || ārādhayaṃ mahādevamamlānagurusaurabham || 29 || yadakṣayamaviśrāṃtamarcanāyojitaṃ mayā || avicchinnamahādīptiḥ kāmadhenughṛtāplutaḥ || 1.3.1.13.30 || avekṣaṇīyo bhūpālairanupālyaśca sarvadā || dharmalakṣaṇamādheyaṃ lokarakṣārthamādarāt || 31 || sarvābhīpsitasiddhyarthaṃ matprītikaraṇāya ca || mayā saṃsthāpitā dharmā dvātriṃśallokaguptaye || 32 || rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena tatsaṃnidhimupāgataiḥ || sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvabhogakṛtotsavam || ālokyatāmidaṃ rūpaṃ kanyāyāṃ mama kāṃtimat || 33 || || brahmovāca || || iti devyā vacaḥ śrutvā śambhuḥ śoṇācaleśvaraḥ || 34 || tatheti varadaḥ prādādvaraṃ sarvamabhīpsitam || eṣa śoṇācalaḥ śrīmāndṛśyate lokapūjitaḥ || || 35 || sarvadā varadāgauryā sarvabhogaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ || ya etacchāṃbhavaṃ rūpamaruṇādritayā sthitam || 36 || saṃpaśyaṃti namasyaṃti kṛtārthāḥ sarva eva te || aruṇācalamāhātmyametacchraṇvaṃti ye bhuvi || 37 || bhavaṃti satataṃ teṣāṃ samagrāḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥ || śrīmattvaṃ vākpatitvaṃ ca rūpamavyāhataṃ balam || 38 || labhaṃte pāpanāśaṃ ca māhātmyasyāsya dhāraṇāt || sarvatīrthābhiṣavaṇaṃ sarvayajñakriyāphalam || 39 || sadāśivaprasādaṃ ca datte śoṇādridarśanam || 1.3.1.13.40 || iti kailāsaśikharātprāptā devī śivājñayā || śāpamokṣagatavatī śoṇācalanirīkṣaṇāt || 41 || sthāneṣvanyeṣu devasya vidyamāneṣu ca kṣitau || divi cātyaṃtapuṇyeṣu śaṃbhuratra prasedivān || 42 || ayaṃ sadāśivaḥ sākṣādaruṇācalarūpataḥ || dṛśyate paramaṃ tejaḥ sargasthityaṃtakāraṇam|| 43 || etattu taijasaṃ ligaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || dṛśyate karmabhūreṣā tena dharmādhikā matā || 44 || aruṇācalanāthasya tejasā dhūtakalmaṣāḥ || bhaktimaṃto narā loke sukhamāpsyaṃti sarvataḥ || 45 || pradakṣiṇairnamaskāraistapobhirniyamairapi || ye'rcayaṃtyaruṇādrīśaṃ teṣāṃ śaṃbhurvaśaṃgataḥ || 46 || na tathā tapasā yogairdānaiḥ prīṇāti śaṃkaraḥ || yathā sakṛdapi prāptādaruṇācaladarśanāt || 47 || svayaṃbhuvaḥ sadā vedāḥ setihāsā divi sthitāḥ || parito girirūpāste stuvaṃtyaruṇaparvatam || 48 || etasya vaibhavaṃ sarvaṃ na mayā na ca śārṅgiṇā || vacasā śakyate vaktuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi || 49 || devāśca harimukhyāste kalpakādyāḥ suradrumāḥ || pracchannarūpāḥ sevaṃte sarvadaivāruṇācalam || 1.3.1.13.50 || na tasya kalidoṣaḥ syānnādhivyādhivijṛṃbhaṇā || yatra saṃpūjyate liṃgamaruṇācalasaṃjñitam || 51 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ tava śaṃbhupadāśrayam || caritaṃ hyaruṇasyāsya kalpapuṇyadurāsadam || 52 || || sūta uvāca || || iti vidhimukhaniḥsṛtāmudārāmaruṇagirīśakathāsudhāpagāṃ hi || śrutipuṭayugalātpibanmanojñāṃ sanakamunistapasāṃ phalaṃ sa lebhe || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye pūrvārdhe śivenāruṇācalasya sarvaśraiṣṭhyavarapradānavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 |||cha|| aruṇācalamāhātmyasya pūrvārddhaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || ityaruṇācalamāhātmyapūrvārdhaṃ samāptam || (3.1) ||
<1.3.2.1>
|| śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || athāruṇācalamāhātmyottarārdham || vyāsa uvāca || vasaṃto naimiṣāraṇye munayaḥ sūtamabruvan || || munaya ūcuḥ || || sthānānāmuttamaṃ śaivaṃ yatsthalaṃ tadvadasva naḥ || 1 || sūta uvāca || || yūyaṃ śṛṇuta yatpūrvaṃ naṃdīśvaramukhācchrutam|| mārkaṇḍeyena tadvakṣye munayaḥ śṛṇutādarāt||2|| ||mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || naṃdīśvara tvayā prokto mahimā mādhyameśvaraḥ|| mayāpyavadhṛtaḥ sarvo bhaktiśraddhārdracetasā ||3|| tathāpi vada me bhūyo devadeva dayānidhe|| ahaṃ yatparipṛcchāmi bhavaṃtaṃ vihitādaraḥ ||4|| tvayāpyaviditaṃ kiṃcinnāstyatra bhuvanatraye || sarvāgamapurāṇeṣu bāhyeṣvābhyaṃtareṣu ca ||5|| svargāpavargayoḥ puṃsāṃ bhūmireva viśiṣyate || sarvakarmāṇi nirmātuṃ tattatphalaparāyaṇaiḥ ||6|| phalaṃ ca trividhaṃ puṃsāṃ tvayaiva kathitaṃ purā || bhūmau sukhaṃ svargabhogaḥ kaivalyamiti bhedataḥ || 7 || puṇyakṣayeṇa kṣīyeta prāyaḥ prāthamikaṃ dvayam|| kṣīyate na tṛtīyaṃ tu karmaṇāmeva nāśrayāt || 8 || tatsiddhistu tvayā proktā viśuddhajñānagocarā || sarveṣāṃ durlabhaṃ śuddhajñānaṃ dehabhṛtāṃ punaḥ ||9|| tajjñānaṃ kutra vā kṣetre śāstrādipaṭhanaṃ vinā || śivapūjanamātreṇa siddhyetsarvaśarīriṇām || 1.3.2.1.10 || jñānayogakriyācaryāsvaśeṣāṇāṃ śarīriṇām || api śaivāgamoktāsu na buddhiḥ saṃpravarttate || 11 || yasya sthānasya māhātmyādalpairapi śarīriṇaḥ || lapsyate niyamaiḥ śuddhajñānaṃ tanmama kathyatām || 12 || bhasmarudrākṣavahanādīśvarasmaraṇātsakṛt || yatra mugdhairapi śreyo labhyaṃ tatsthānamucyatām || 13 || abuddhipūrvakeṇāpi yatra vāsena dehinām || avighnaṃ setsyate śreyaḥ sthānaṃ tanme'nugṛhyatām || 14 || jātānāṃ varṇasāṃkaryye tairaścī yonimīyuṣām || sthāvarāṇāmapi śreyo yatra tatkṣetramucyatām ||15|| itīrayitvā sa mṛkaṃḍunaṃdanaḥ samaṃ munīṃdrairaparairmahātmabhiḥ|| papāta tasyāṃghrisaroruhadvaye śilādasūnorakhilāgamābdheḥ || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe sthānamāhātmyaprastāvavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
<1.3.2.2>
naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || sthānaṃ tvayā mune pṛṣṭamasti māheśvarāgraṇi|| carācarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmapi śarmaṇe || 1 || prakalpitaṃ hi devena tattatkarmānuguṇyataḥ || śarīrabhājāṃ jananaṃ tāsutāsvapi yoniṣu || 2 || tvayā śuśruṣitaṃ teṣāṃ hitāya mahate hyalam || anyathā saṃsṛterhāniḥ kalpakoṭiśatairnahi || 3 || svalpairhi karmabhirjñānairapi prāptā punaḥpunaḥ || ghaṭīyaṃtranayājjanmamaraṇe naiva śāmyataḥ || 4 || kathaṃ nu virato dehī garbhamokasamāgamāt || viśrāṃtaye prakalpeta viśuddhajñānato vinā || 5 || pradeśāḥ kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ prasaṃgavaśato mayā || ṛṣibhedādikaṃ teṣu nivāsaḥ kṛttivāsasaḥ || 6 || kecittīreṣu gaṃgāyāḥ kecitsārasvate taṭe || kāliṃdītīrayoranye katicicchoṇarodhasi ||7|| apare narmadātīre pare godāvarītaṭe || katicidgomatītīreṣvanye haimavatītaṭe ||8|| samudrapārśveṣvitaraṃ dvīpeṣvanye sarasvatām || mukheṣu kecitsiṃdhūnāṃ saṃbhedeṣvapi kecana ||9|| kṛṣṇaveṇītaṭe kecittuṃgabhadrāṃtike pare || upaveṇyāṃ katipaye pare śaktyāpagāṃtike || 1.3.2.2.10 || kāverītīra itare kecidvegavatītaṭe || anye tu tāmraparṇyāśca katicinmuralātaṭe || 11 || kecidairāvatītīre tvitare yātukāṃkṣike || 12 || kanyātaṭeṣu katicitkaticitkumārītīre pare ca tamasāvaruṇāṃtikenye || maṃdākinīsavidhayoritare pare'pi śiprātaṭe parisareṣu pare sarayvāḥ || 13 || vipāśābhyāśa itare śatadrutitaṭe pare || carmaṇvatyupakaṃṭhe'nye kecidbhīmarathītaṭe || 14 || kecidbiṃdusarobhyarṇe pare paṃpāsarastaṭe || abhyarṇakepi bhairavyāḥ katicitkauśikītaṭe|| 15 || apare mālinītīre pare gaṃdhavatītaṭe || katicinmānasopāṃte kecidacchodarodhasi || 16 || iṃdradyumnasarasyanya eke tu maṇikarṇike || pare tu varadātīre tāpyāṃ katicanāpare || pātālagaṃgāsavidhe śarāvatyaṃtike pare || 17 || lohityākūlayoḥ kecitkaticitkālamātaṭe || vitastopāṃtike tvanye caṃdrabhāgāṃtike pare || 18 || suralopāṃtike kecitpayoṣṇītīrayoḥ pare || kecinmadhumatītīre kecanānu pinākinīm || 19 || uktaṃ vārāṇasīkṣetraṃ krośapaṃcakapāvanam || devastatrāvimuktākhyo viśālākṣyā samarcitaḥ || 1.3.2.2.20 || kapālamocanaṃ yatra yatrāste kālabhairavaḥ || mṛtānāṃ yatra rudratvaṃ kāśīṃ viddhi hi tāṃ mune || 21 || gayāprayāgāvapi te kathitau sarvasiddhidau || yatra piṃḍapradānena tuṣyaṃti pitaraḥ kila || 22 || ākarṇitaṃ ca kedāraṃ yasminmahiṣarūpadhṛk || devopi ca hato devyā sarvaśreyaskaro nṛṇām || 23 || sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ kṣetraṃ badarikāśramam || yatrāste tryaṃbako devyā naranārāyaṇārcitaḥ || 24 || śrutaṃ hi naimiṣaṃ kṣetraṃ tvayā yatra maheśvaraḥ || devadevābhidhaḥ puṇyo devī sāraṃgadhāriṇī || 25 || amareśamiti sthānaṃ proktaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || oṃkāranāmā tatreśaścaṃḍikākhyā maheśvarī || 26 || puṣkarākhyaṃ mahāsthānaṃ śrutaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā || yatra devo rujogaṃdhiḥ puruhūtā maheśvarī || 27 || āṣāḍhīnāma te sthānaṃ pāvanaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || āṣāḍheśo harastatra ratīśā parameśvarī || 28 || daṃḍimuṃḍī samākhyaṃ ca sthānaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā || yatra muṃḍī mahādevo daṃḍikā parameśvarī ||29|| lākulaṃnāma te sthānaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || lākulīśo haro yasminnanaṃgā sarvamaṃgalā || 1.3.2.2.30 || bhārabhūtiriti sthānaṃ bhavato'bhihitaṃ mayā || yatra bhārābhidhaḥ śaṃbhurbhūtyākhyā bhūdharātmajā || 31 || arālakeśvaraṃ nāma sthānaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā || yatra sūkṣmābhidhaḥ śūlī sūkṣmākhyā śailanaṃdinī || 32 || gayānāma mahākṣetraṃ tava prastāvitaṃ mayā || maṃgalākhyā śivā yatra śaṃkaraḥ prapitāmahaḥ || 33 || kurukṣetramiti sthānaṃ bhavate viniveditam || yatra sthāṇupriyā devī devaḥ sthāṇusamāhvayaḥ || 34 || uktaṃ kanakhalaṃnāma mayā te sthānamuttamam || ugro yatra purārātirugrā girivarātmajā || 35 || tālakākhyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ mārkaṃḍeya mayoditam || devī svāyaṃbhuvī yatra svayaṃbhūḥ parameśvaraḥ || 36 || aṭṭahāsamiti proktaṃ mahāsthānaṃ mayā tava || yatrārkaḥ pūjayitveśamāsītpūrṇamanorathaḥ || || 37 || kṛttivāsābhidhaṃ kṣetramuktaṃ te vedavittama || yaḥ kailāsādapi ślāghyo nivāsaḥ kṛttivāsasaḥ || 38 || bhramarāṃbikayā devyā maheśo mallikārjunaḥ || śrīśaile sṛṣṭisiddhayarthaṃ pūjitaḥ parameṣṭhinā || 39 || suvarṇamukharītīre kālahastīti śaṃkaraḥ || vyāsenārādhito bhṛṃgamukharālakayāṃbayā || 1.3.2.2.40 || kāṃcyāmekāmramūlasthaḥ kāmākṣyā kāmaśāsanaḥ || tapasyaṃtyābhisaṃśliṣṭo valayenāṃkito'bhavat || 41 || asti vyāghrapuraṃnāma tillikānanamadhyagam || yatra nṛtyaṃtamīśānaṃ paryupāste pataṃjaliḥ || 42 || śvetāraṇyamiti sthānamuktaṃ tava mayā purā || bhagnamairāvato daṃtaṃ bheje yatra śivārcanāt || 43 || setubaṃdhamiti sthānamavocaṃ tatra rāghavaḥ || rāmanāthākhyayā devamaṃhoghnaṃ pratyatiṣṭhipat || 44 || gatapratyāhvaya sthānaṃ vidyate vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || yatra jaṃbūtarormūle jagadrakṣārthamāśritaḥ || 45 || maṇimuktānadīmanvakkṣetre vṛddhācalāhvaye || nityaṃ sannihito deva ityākarṇita eva te || 46 || śrīmanmadhyārjunaṃnāma śrutaṃ sthānamanuttamam || yasminvaraprado nityaṃ gaurīsahacaro haraḥ || 47 || āsthitaṃ somanāthena somatīrthaṃ tvayā śrutam || yatra tyaktavatāṃ dehaṃ na bhūyo bhavabaṃdhanam ||48|| ākarṇitaṃ hi bhavatā kṣetraṃ siddhavaṭāhvayam || yatra siddhāḥ samarcaṃti jyotirliṃgamanuttamam || 49 || aśrāvi khalu te kṣetraṃ kamalālayasaṃjñakam || valmīkeśārcanāllebhe yatra śrīrjīvitā hareḥ || 1.3.2.2.50 || śrutavānasi kaṃkādriṃ yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || idānīmapyupāsāte mokṣāya brahmakeśavau ||51|| śrīmaddroṇapuraṃ vetsi yasminkaliyugakṣaye || naukāmārūḍhavānabdhau kṣubhite pārvatīpatiḥ || 52 || śrutaṃ brahmapuraṃnāma kṣetraṃ yatreṃdrajitpurā || āryapuṣkariṇītīre sthāpayāmāsa dhūrjaṭim || 53 || śrīkoṭikākhyaṃ jñānābhikṣetraṃ yatreṃduśekharaḥ || samārādhayatāṃ puṃsāṃ pāpakoṭīrvyapohati || 54 || ākarṇitaṃ ca gokarṇaṃ śivaṃ yatsaṃnidhānataḥ || ārirādhayiṣuḥ svargaṃ jāmadagnyo na kāṃkṣati || 55 || tripurāṃtakamuktaṃ te kṣetraṃ yatra triyaṃbakaḥ || nirākaroti nirayādbhayaṃ dṛṣṭavatāṃ nṛṇām || 56 || uktaṃ kālāṃjanaṃ kṣetraṃ yadvāsī kālakaṃdharaḥ || nirvāpayati bhaktānāṃ ghorasaṃsārasaṃjvaram || 57 || priyālavaṇamākhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ yatrāṃbikāpatiḥ || payorthine payaḥsiṃdhuṃ vitatāropamanyave || 58 || kṣetraṃ prabhāsamuktaṃ te yatra khaṃḍeṃduśekharaḥ || pūjitaḥ śaurisīribhyāṃ dattavānakṣayaṃ phalam || 59 || vedāraṇyaṃ vijānīṣe yasminpramathanāyakaḥ|| abhyarthito'bhūnmokṣārthaṃ dakṣeṇa prākkṛtāgasā || 1.3.2.2.60 || hemakūṭaṃ tvamaśrauṣīḥ sthānaṃ viṣamacakṣuṣaḥ || puṃsāṃ tapasyatāṃ yatra punarjananato na bhīḥ || 61 || kṣetraṃ veṇuvanaṃnāma vidyate pāpanāśanam || yatra vaṃśalatāgarbhājjāto muktāmaṇiḥ śivā || 62 || jālaṃdharamiti sthānamaṃdhakārestvayā śrutam || lebhe gaṇapatāṃ tatra tapasyābhirjalaṃdharaḥ || 63 || jvālāmukhamiti sthānamajñāsīḥ kathitaṃ mayā || yatra jvālāmukhī devī kālarudramapūjayat || 64 || asti bhadravaṭonāma kṣetramuktaṃ śrutaṃ tvayā || tryaṃbakaṃ yatra heraṃbaḥ saṃpade paryapūjayat || 65 || nyagrodhāraṇyamuktaṃ te yatrogro nirmame kila || uccaṃḍatāṃḍavaṃ kālyā sākaṃ saṃgharṣameyivān || 66 || gaṃdhamādanasaṃjñaṃ tatkṣetramākarṇitaṃ tvayā || āṃjaneyena racitaṃ yatra mṛtyuṃjayārcanam || 67 || goparvatamiti sthānaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prakhyāpitaṃ mayā || yatra pāṇininā lebhe vaiyākaraṇikāgryatā || 68 || vīrakoṣṭhamiti kṣetrasthānaṃ nanvavadhāritam || yatra pracetasā lebhe tapasā kavimukhyatā || 69 || mahātīrthamiti proktaṃ jānīṣe yatra śaṃbhunā || adhyāpitāssuparvāṇaḥ sarve'pi druhiṇādayaḥ || 1.3.2.2.70 || mayūrapuramuktaṃ te kṣetraṃ māheśvaraṃ mayā || lebhe yatra vratasthena hrādinī vajrapāṇinā || 71 || śrīsuṃdaramiti kṣetramuktaṃ vegavatī taṭe || kalāvapi yuge yasmindevadevena dīpyate || 72 || kuṃbhakoṇamiti sthānaṃ śaṃbhorvetsi hi yatra sā || gaṃgāpi māghe sānnidhyaṃ kurute svāghaśāṃtaye || 73 || anugodāvarītīraṃ tryaṃbakaṃnāma te śrutam || śaktiṃ yatra guho lebhe tārakāsuraghātinīm || 74 || śrīpāṭalaṃ vyāghrapuramākhyātaṃ vedavittama || triśaṃkunā jātiśuddhyai yatra gaṃgādharorcitaḥ || 75 || kṣetraṃ kadaṃbapuryyākhyaṃ bhavatā cāvadhāritam || tvatkṛte yatra śūlena kṛtāṃtaṃ śambhurakṣiṇot || || 76 || avināśākhyamuktaṃ te kṣetraṃ yatra vṛṣadhvajaḥ || sānnidhyaṃ paḍikaṇṭhāya vitatāra prasedivān || 77 || raktaikānanamākhyātaṃ mayā kṣetraṃ tavānagha || mitrāvaruṇayoryatra rudro'jani varapradaḥ || 78 || śrīhāṭakeśvaraṃ kṣetraṃ pātālasthaṃ tvayā śrutam || yatra vairocanirdevaṃ svapadaprāptayercati || 79 || vetsi śaṃbhoḥ priyāvāsaṃ kailāsaṃ nityasevakaḥ || yatra yakṣeśvarastryakṣamayarcayati bhaktitaḥ || 1.3.2.2.80 || sthānāni khaṃḍaparaśorityuktāni mayā purā || tvayāpyavadhṛtānyeva kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 81 || ityūcivāneṣa śilādanaṃdano munermṛkaṇḍostanayaṃ munīśvaram || bhaktyā namaṃtaṃ padayoḥ kareṇa pasparśa maulau karuṇārasārdraḥ || 82 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe mahīmaṇḍalasthavividhaśivakṣetravarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<1.3.2.3>
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || bhagavanvaṃcanenālaṃ tvadekapravaṇe mayi || kiṃ mādṛśo'sti te śiṣyastvatkṛpaivātra sākṣiṇī || 1 || sthāneṣu prāktvadukteṣu phalāni ca pṛthakpṛthak || yatra sarvaphalaprāptiḥ sthānaṃ tadvada me vibho || 2 || carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ jānatāmapyajānatām || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa muktistadvada deśika || 3 || paśyaitena mayaikena bhagavānnānurādhyase || sarvairapyetadarthaṃ hi munibhiḥ parivāryase || 4 || pulahena pulastyena vaśiṣṭhena marīcinā || agastyena dadhīcena nakruṇā bhṛguṇātriṇā || 5 || jābālinā jaimininā dhaumyena jamadagninā || upayājena yājena bharatenārvarīvatā || 6 || pippalādena kaṇṭhena kumudenopamanyunā || kumudākṣeṇa kutsena vatsena varataṃtunā || 7 || vibhāṃḍakena vyāsena kaṇvarīṣeṇa kaṃḍunā || māṃḍavyena mataṃgena kukṣiṇā māṃḍakarṇinā || 8 || caṃḍakauśikaśāṃḍilyaśākaṭāyanakauśikaiḥ || śātātapamadhucchandogargasaubhariromaśaiḥ || 9 || āpastaṃbapṛthustaṃbabhārgavodaṃkaparvataiḥ || bhāradvājena dālbhyena dāṃtena śvetaketunā || 1.3.2.3.10 || kauṃḍinyapuṇḍarīkābhyāṃ raibhyeṇa tṛṇabindunā || vālmīkinā nāradena vahninā dṛḍhamanyunā || 11 || bodhāyanasubodhābhyāṃ hārītena mṛkaṇḍunā || durvāsasātitīkṣṇena jālapādena śaktinā || 12 || kāṃkvāryeṇa nadantena devadattena nyaṃkunā || suśrutā cāgniveśyena gālavena marutvatā || 13 || lokākṣiṇā viśravasā saiṃdhavena sumaṃtunā || śiśupāyanamaudgalyapathyacāvanamāturaiḥ || 14 || ṛṣyaśṛṅgaikapātkrauṃcadṛḍhagomukhadevalaiḥ || aṃgirovāmadevaurvapataṃjalikapiṃjalaiḥ || 15 || sanatkumārasanakasanaṃdanasanātanaiḥ || hiraṇyanābhasatyākhyavātāśanasuhotṛbhiḥ || 16 || maitreyapuṣpajitsatyatapaḥśālīṣyaśaiśiraiḥ || nidāghotathyasaṃvarttaśaulkāyaniparāśaraiḥ || 17 || vaiśaṃpāyanakauśalyaśāradvatakapidhvajaiḥ || kuśasvārcikakaivalyayājñavalkyāśvalāyanaiḥ || 18 || kṛṣṇātapottamānaṃtakaruṇāmalakapriyaiḥ || carakeṇa pavitreṇa kapilena kaṇāśinā || 19 || naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ ca divyaiścānyairmaharṣibhiḥ || matpraśnottaraśuśrūṣātatparaiḥ pratyavekṣyase || 1.3.2.3.20 || māheśvarāgragaṇyastvaṃ samastāgamapāragaḥ || vyāptaśca sarvalokeṣu yasmāttadanusādhi naḥ || 21 || tvanmukhādeva bhagavanvayamete suśikṣitāḥ || pūrvameva tvayā deva kiṃ vānyadupapadyate || 22 || divyāgamapurāṇāni draṣṭavyaḥ parameśvaraḥ || kātyāyanī vā skando vā bhagavānvātha vā bhavān || 23 || tvayi yadyasti no bhaktirdayā cāsmāsu te yadi || rahasyamidamudghāṭya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || 24 || itthaṃ mṛkaṇḍutanayena sa naṃdikeśo vijñāpitaḥ savinayaṃ smayamānavaktram || taṃ prāha connatataraṃ śivabhaktimastu prāgbhaktitoṣitaśivāptaśarīrasiddhim || 25 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe'ruṇācalākhyarahasyasthānapraśnavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || || cha ||
<1.3.2.4>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || mune manaḥparīkṣārthaṃ tathā tvaṃ bhāṣito mayā || tava cennābhidhāsyāmi kasya vānyasya kathyate || 1 || tvādṛganyosti kiṃ loke śivadharmaparāyaṇaḥ || yena svalpāyuṣāpyevaṃ nityenābhāvi bhaktitaḥ || 2 || kasyānyasya kṛte devaḥ svasyaivājñākaraṃ yamam || kruddho niyaṃtrayāmāsa caraṇāṃguṣṭhapīḍitam || 3 || tvameva śāṃkarāndharmānsarvānviddhi rahasyataḥ || yogre'si kālavadbhrāṃtaḥ paripakvosi cetasā || 4 || tvayaivānyena kenāhamevaṃ śuśrūṣitaściram || tvayīva kasminnanyasminmamāpi prītirīdṛśī || 5 || upadekṣyāmi te kṣetraṃ guptaṃ taddharmaśāsanaiḥ || bhaktyāvadhāraṇīyaṃ yadbhaktikaivalyakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 6 || ādarādanuyuṃjānaṃ śiṣyaṃ yo deśikaḥ svayam || upadeśena saṃtuṣṭaṃ na karoti sa kiṃ guruḥ || 7 || samāhitamanā bhūtvā viśvāsaṃ kuru śāśvatam || mayopadiśyamāne'sminrahasye pārameśvare || 8 || smara smarāṃtakaṃ devaṃ vaṃdasvādhyāya śāṃkarīm || upāṃśūccārayoṃkāraṃ śreyaste mahadāgatam || 9 || asti dakṣiṇadigbhāge drāviḍeṣu tapodhana || aruṇākhyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ taruṇeṃduśikhāmaṇeḥ || 1.3.2.4.10 || yojanatrayavistīṇamupāsyaṃ śivayogibhiḥ || tadbhūmerhṛdayaṃ viddhi śivasya hṛdayaṃgamam || 11 || tatra devaḥ svayaṃ śambhuḥ parvatākāratāṃ gataḥ || aruṇācalasaṃjñāvānasti lokahitāvahaḥ || 12 || āvāsaḥ sarvasiddhānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ suparvaṇām || vidyādharāṇāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ gaṃdharvāpsarasāmapi || 13 || sumerorapi kailāsādapyasau mandarādapi || mānanīyo maharṣīṇāṃ yaḥ svayaṃ parameśvaraḥ || 14 || spṛhayaṃti yadīyebhyo jaṃtubhyopi divaukasaḥ || ayatnalabhyamuktibhyo divāvāsapravaṃcitāḥ || 15 || na kalpavṛkṣāḥ sadṛśā yatratyānāṃ mahīruhām || patrapuṣpaphalairnityaṃ yercayaṃti girau haram || 16 || hiṃsaikarucayo vyādhā api rūpānusārataḥ || anaṃtā yatra devasya prādakṣiṇyaphalāspadam|| 17 || yaduddeśacarā meghāḥ śikharāṇyabhibaṃdhakāḥ || gaṃgāvato himavato'pyadhikaṃ svaṃ vijānate || 16 || kalārāvāḥ khagā yatra kvaṇaṃte kīcakā api || yakṣakiṃnaragandharvailabhyate durlabhaṃ padam || 19 || smaranto yatra khadyotāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe niśāgame || ārārtikapradātṝṇāṃ devasyāśnuvate padam ||1.3.2.4.20|| niṣpratyūhakṛtāśleṣā nityaṃ yattaṭinīruhāḥ || saubhīgyagarvato devīmaparṇāmavamanvate ||21|| yasyottuṃgasya śṛṃgāgrasaṃgamā api tārakāḥ || ātmano labdhasāmānyāścandreṇa bahu manvate || 22 || mṛgāḥ sarvepi satataṃ caraṃto yatra sānuṣu || pāṇipraṇayinaṃ śambhoreṇamapyavajānate || 23 || yasya pādāṃtikacaraiḥ prāyeṇa śabarairapi || nikumbhakumbhasādṛśyamayatnādupalabhyate || 24 || kiṃ bahūktyābhyasūyaṃte dvaimāturakumārayoḥ || yadaṃgarūḍhāstaravastiryaṃcaḥ śabarā api || 25 || siṃhavyāghradvipā yasminkāle tyaktakalevarāḥ || vāsapradatvānmānyaṃte dhruvaṃ śoṇādriśambhunā || 26 || asya bhāskaranāmādriḥ pūrvasyāṃ diśi dṛśyate || yatra sthitaḥ sadā vajrī sevate śoṇaparvatam ||27|| pratīcyāṃ diśi daṃḍādririti kaścinmahīdharaḥ || prācetasastadagagaḥ sevate'ruṇaparvatam || 28 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ ca śoṇādreradrirastyamarācalaḥ || kālaḥ śoṇādrisevārthamadhyāste tadadhityakām ||29|| uttare'sminharidbhāge siddhādhyāsitakandaraḥ || virājate triśūlādriḥ śrīdena paripālitaḥ || 1.3.2.4.30 || tatparyaṃtaprabhūtānāmanyeṣāmapi bhūbhṛtām || taṭakeṣvapare caiva dikpālāḥ paryupāsate || 31 || dhāritā yena satataṃ sarvepi dharaṇīruhāḥ || ārādhanādapyadhikamadhigacchaṃti vaibhavam || 32 || yasmingirīśe saṃdṛṣṭe menātuhinabhūbhṛtoḥ || samānasaṃbaṃdhatayā pramodo varddhatetarām || 33 || tarupallavalakṣeṇa lakṣyamāṇajaṭādharaḥ || sthāvaroyaṃ svayaṃ śambhuriheśa iva jaṃgamaḥ || 34 || jyotiṣmattoyaśṛṃgasya dvipārśvasthendubhāskaraḥ || vyanakti svasya lokebhyastejastritayanetratām || 35 || varṣāsu śikharādhastādabhinīlabalāhakaḥ || virājate yaḥ kaṇṭhena kālakūṭamivodvahan || 36 || sahasrapādaḥ sāhasraśīrṣo yaḥ parvateśvaraḥ || ukto na kevalaṃ śrutyā sākṣādapyupalakṣyate || 37 || śirolīnāmarasaritsrotāḥ prāgiti nādbhutam || girīśo'dyāpi yaḥ śṛṃgalīnānekasaridgaṇaḥ || 38 || āsāditāpakaṭakaḥ śāradairyaḥ payodharaiḥ || viḍaṃbayati gośreṣṭhamārūḍhavṛṣapuṃgavam || 39 || yatra śṛṅgāgrasaṃlagrasaṃlagnanīlalohitaḥ || sthāṇutvaṃ sthāvaratvena gahanatvena bhīmatām || 1.3.2.4.40 || sudurgamatvādugratvamapi dhatte na nāmataḥ || kṣudrāḥ sarīsṛpā yatra kaṭakeṣu kṛtāspadāḥ || 41 || takṣakānaṃtasarpādyaiḥ spardhante bhujageśvaraiḥ || aṣṭābhiryo'bhitaḥ koṇairāvibhūrto vibhūtibhiḥ || 42 || suspaṣṭaṃ viśinaṣṭīva svakīyāmaṣṭamūrtitām || yerṇyāśaktitaraṃgiṇyo iḍāpiṃgalayoḥ svayam || 43 || śivasya śṛṅgato madhye suṣumnā kamalāpagā ||
