jyotiḥstaṃbhasvarūpasya mūlāgre yasya vīkṣatum || 44 || kolahaṃsākṛtī nālaṃ brahmaviṣṇū babhūvatuḥ || tābhyāṃ ca prārthitaḥ śambhustasminsāṃnidhyavānabhūt || 45 || aruṇācalanāthākhyaṃ prapannaḥ pramadaiḥ samam || gautamastatra yogīṃdraḥ sahasraṃ parivatsarān || 46 || taptvā tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi sākṣāccakre sadāśivam || prāleyaśailakanyāpi tatra kṛtvā tapaḥ purā || 47 || alabdha vāmadehārddhaṃ manmathāreḥ praseduṣaḥ || gauryā pratiṣṭhitaṃ tatra pravālādrīśvarābhidham || 48 || liṃgaṃ bhogapradaṃ puṃsāṃ kaivalyāya prakalpate || tatra gaurīnideśena durgā mahiṣamardinī || 49 || sākṣādbhūya satāṃ datte mantrasiddhimavighnataḥ || khaḍgatīrthamiti khyātaṃ tatra gauryāśrame navam || 1.3.2.4.50 || sakṛnnimajjanānnṝṇāṃ paṃcapātakanāśanam || durgayā cārcitaṃ liṃgaṃ pāpanāśananāmakam || 51 || sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tatra vajrāṃgado rājā vittasāro vyatikramāt || 52 || punastadbhaktimāhātmyācchivasāyujyamāptavān || tasya pradakṣiṇenaiva kāṃtiśālikalādharau || 53 || vidyādhareśvarau muktau durvāsaḥśāpabandhanāt || nāsti śoṇādritaḥ kṣetraṃ nāsti paṃcākṣarānmanuḥ || 54 || nāsti māheśvarāddharmo nāsti devo maheśvarāt || nāsti jñānaṃ śivajñānānnāsti śrīrudrataḥ śrutiḥ ||55 || nāsti śaivāgraṇīrviṣṇornāsti rakṣā vibhūtitaḥ || nāsti bhakteḥ sadācāro nāsti rakṣākarādguruḥ || 56 || nāsti rudrākṣato bhūṣā nāsti śāstraṃ śivāgamāt || nāsti bilvadalātpatraṃ nāsti puṣpaṃ suvarṇakāt||57|| nāsti vairāgyataḥ saukhyaṃ nāsti mukteḥ paraṃ padam || nāruṇādreḥ samo merurna kailāso na maṃdaraḥ || 58 || te nivāsā girivyāptāḥ so'yaṃ tu giriśaḥ svayam || 59 || iti vadati śilādanaṃdane muditamanāḥ sa mṛkaṇḍunaṃdanaḥ || punarapi bahuśaḥ praṇamya taṃ cakitamanā bhavato vyajijñapat || || 1.3.2.4.60 || kiṃ kiṃ nṛṇāṃ karma bhavāya jāyate kathaṃ nu tattannarakāya śrūyate || teṣāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca kathaṃ pratikriyā kathaṃ nu tattanmama kathyatāmiti || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya utarārdhe'ruṇācalasthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.5>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || śuddhasattvaguṇopeto loke'smindurlabhaḥ pumān || rajastamoguṇopetā bhavaṃti sulabhā narāḥ || 1 || sāttvikaḥ puṇyaśīlatvānniḥśreyasamavāpnuyāt || vaicitryātkarmaṇāmeṣāmanubhogāya vedhasā || 2 || vaicitryāṇyeva sṛṣṭāni narakāṇyatra tatra ca || mahārauravabhāgbhūtvā kharaḥ śvā śūkaro'pi vā || 3 || caṃḍālo vā bhavetpretya puruṣo brahmahatyayā || ciraṃ rauravasaṃruddhaḥ kṛmikīṭapataṃgatām |||| 4 || prāpnuyātkarmakartṛtvaṃ surāpānena ca dvijaḥ || brahmasvaharaṇādbrahmarākṣasatvamavāpnuyāt || 5 || yadyattu corayettattacchūnyaṃ syādanyajanmani || asipatravane pīḍāmavāpya suciraṃ punaḥ || 6 || napuṃsakatvaṃ saṃgacchetpuruṣo gurutalpagaḥ || taptaiḥ kālāyasairdaṃḍaiḥ pīḍito yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 7 || narake kālasūtrākhye nivasetparadāragaḥ || agnido nivasedghore sughore garadāyakaḥ || 8 || mahāghore ca piśuno'vīcyāṃ dharmaviniṃdakaḥ || vasetkarāle mitradhrugbhīme hiṃsaikatatparaḥ || 9 || saṃhāre channapāpiṣṭho mṛṣāvādī bhayānake || asighore vasedvāpi kūpakṣetranarādihṛt || 1.3.2.5.10 || vajre paradroharato māṃsāśī tarale dvija || tīkṣṇe mātṛpitṛdrohī tāpane japadūṣakaḥ || 11 || aśvaghnopi nirucchvāse vasedgoghnaśca dāruṇe || bhrūṇahā nivaseccaṃḍe strīhatyākṛtkukūlake || 12 || devasvahārī dahane ghoraghore parasvahṛt || kṛtāṃtadūtā narake sarvāneva hi pāpinaḥ || 13 || badhnaṃti pāśairnighnaṃti daṃḍairvidhyaṃti śaṃkubhiḥ || tīkṣṇāyaścaṃcavaḥ kaṃkāḥ krūradaṃṣṭrā mahoragāḥ || 14 || kāleyakāśca vyāghrāśca hiṃsrāścānye daśaṃtyamūn || śakalīkurvate śastrairdahaṃtidehameva ca || 15 || khanaṃti gahane śvabhre kaśābhistāḍayaṃti ca || tailadroṇyāṃ vipacyaṃte tudyaṃte sūkṣmasūcibhiḥ || 16 || bāhyante durvahānbhārānyamadūtairhi pāpinaḥ || brahmahā kṣayarogī syatsurāpaḥ śyāvadaṃtakaḥ || 17 || svarṇāpahārī kunakhī duścarmā gurutalpagaḥ || apasmārī gurudrohī caṃḍālo vedadūṣakaḥ || 18 || kūṭasākṣī cākṣirogī maṃdāgniścāgrabhojanaḥ || vidyāpahārī mūkaḥ syādaṃdhaḥ pustakacorakaḥ || 19 || paradārarataḥ paṃgu badhiraḥ paraniṃdakaḥ || viḍvarāho nirācāro jihvārogī ca taskaraḥ || 1.3.2.5.20 || abhyāgatātithityāgī kapolakaṃṭako bhavet || parvasu strīrato mehī pūtyāsyo'bhakṣyabhakṣakaḥ || 21 || maryādābhedako dāsastaṭākārāmahṛtkharaḥ || pratiśrutāpradātā syādalpāyuḥ śvā vikatthanaḥ || 22 || viṣṇudrohī ca saraṭhaḥ śivadrohī ca mūṣakaḥ || evaṃ pāpaphalaṃ jñātvā prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || 23 || taccāsminnaruṇakṣetre kartavyaḥ samyagāstikaiḥ || 24 || iti niśamya sa duṣkṛtakāriṇāṃ bahuvidhāṃ narakeṣu nṛṇāṃ vyathām || caraṇayoḥ patitaśca tadā punaḥpunarayācata tacchamanakriyām|| 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe karmavipākavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamodhyāyaḥ || 5 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.6>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || vistarātkathayāmyadya prāyaścittaṃ mahāṃhasām || sarveṣāmavadhatsva tvamavalaṃbyāstikīṃ dhiyam || 1 || brahmahā prāpya śoṇādriṃ nimagnaḥ khaḍgatīrthake || japanpaṃcākṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ bhasmarudrākṣadhārakaḥ || 2 || kṛtopavāsaḥ saṃpūjya prayataḥ parameśvaram || brāhmaṇānbhojayedvarṣaṃ bhikṣāśī niyateṃdriyaḥ || 3 || viśeṣapūjāśuśrūṣāṃ kuryāddevasya bhaktitaḥ || brahmahatyā vinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate || 4 || surāpo'pyaruṇakṣetre varṣamekaṃ vasanprati || prāgvatkṛtasamācāraḥ saṃpūjyaivaṃ maheśvaram || 5 || kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevaṃ śatarudrīyamuccaran || surāpānodbhavenāśu pāpena parimucyate || 6 || suvarṇasteyakṛcchoṇakṣetre bilvadalairharam || abhyarcya bhojayedviprānpāpānmucyeta duṣkarāt || 7 || gurudāraratirgatvā kṛttikāsvaruṇācalam || yathāpūrvaṃ vratī bhūtvā sahasreṇa pradīpakaiḥ || 8 || māsatrayaṃ samārādhya śrīśoṇācalaśaṃkaram || pradadyādbhūṣitāṃ kanyāṃ brāhmaṇāya sudhīmate || 9 || ṣaḍakṣaraṃ japennityaṃ tena mucyeta pāpmanā || śivaloke ca nivasedāsaṃsāraṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 1.3.2.6.10 || paradārāpaharttā ca kṣetresminniyateṃdriyaḥ || māsamekaṃ navaiḥ puṣpairabhyarcyāruṇaśaṃkaram || 11 || māheśvarāya vitareddhanaṃ śaktyānuguṇyataḥ || tatkṣaṇena vinirmuktastasmātpāpādbhaviṣyati || 12 || garado'pyaruṇakṣetre vratī bhūtvā yathāpurā || kṣīropahāraṃ devāya dattvā doṣeṇa mucyate || || 13 || piśuno'pyaruṇakṣetre vratī vedarato naraḥ || adhyāpayeddvijānmukhyāṃstato niṣkalmaṣo bhavet || 14 || agnido'pyaruṇakṣetre trīnmāsānpūrvavadvratī || dadyācchaivāya nirmāyya gṛhaṃ tatpāpaśāṃtaye || 15 || dharmaniṃdākaraḥ śoṇakṣetre varṣaṃ vratī vasan || satrādikaṃ prakurvīta yathāśaktyaghaśāṃtaye || 16 || pitṛdrohyaruṇakṣetre tiṣṭhanmāsamataṃdritaḥ || girīśāya dvijebhyopi pradadyādgāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 17 || grahoparāgakāleṣu bhojayitvā dvijānbahūn|| vimuṃcedvṛṣabhaṃ nīlaṃ vimucyeta tatoṃ'hasaḥ || 18 || strīghnaścāpi śiśughno'pi śoṇakṣetramupeyivān || vyatīpāte tilāndadyāddvijabhyo duritacchide || 19 || pracchannapāpakṛcchoṇakṣetre'sminniyateṃdriyaḥ || guptadānāni kurvīta bhavedvai gatakalmaṣaḥ || 1.3.2.6.20 || mṛṣābhāṣyaruṇakṣetre ṣaṇmāsānnivasanvratī || śoṇācaleśvarastotrapāṭhena syādakalmaṣaḥ || 21 || kūpādibhedakṛcchoṇakṣetramāsādya bhaktitaḥ || taṭākānkhānayettatra dhruvaṃ nirvṛjino bhavet || 22 || kṣetrāpahārī devāya kṣetraṃ dadyānmahāphalam || ārāmakaṃṭakopyasmai dadyādudyānamuttamam || 23 || gṛhāpahārī kurvīta devasyāyatanaṃ navam || aṃhasā tena nirmuktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 24 || paradrohī vasañchoṇakṣetre māheśvarāndhanaiḥ || prīṇayitvā parām̐llokānniḥsaṃśayamavāpnuyāt || 25 || paśvādimāṃsabhukchoṇakṣetre pakṣatrayaṃ vratī || prīṇayedaruṇeśānaṃ sopahārairmanoharaiḥ || 26 || triḥśoṇācalanātheti ninadannanagho bhavet|| nivasannaruṇakṣetre pūjayedaruṇeśvaram ||27|| aruṇeśvaramaṃtraṃ ca japenmokṣecchurādarāt|| yadyasyābhihitaṃ tena padbhyāmeva pradakṣiṇām||28|| kurvatāruṇaśailasya tatprāpyaṃ śubhamaṃjasā || śruteṣu skhaliteṣvatyāhite duḥsvapnadarśane || 29 || prītyutkarṣe'pi ca budhairuccāryo'ruṇaśaṃkaraḥ || api varṇāśramabhraṣṭaḥ śivadroharato'pi vā || 1.3.2.6.30 || trīṇyahānyaruṇakṣetre vasanmucyeta pātakaiḥ || pārthivaḥ śivaloko'yaṃ mūrttametattrayīśiraḥ ||31 || eṣa dakṣiṇakailāso yosāvaruṇaparvataḥ || anyeṣu siddhakṣetreṣu tapobhiḥ siddhayo nṛṇām || 32 || asminsmaraṇamātreṇa tāratamyaṃ viciṃtyatām || yadgaṃgāyāṃ prayāge yatkāśyāṃ vai puṣkareṣu yat || 33 || karma setau ca yatpuṃsāṃ śoṇakṣetre tato'dhikam || agniṣṭomaṃ vājapeyaṃ vairājaṃ sarvatomukham || || 34 || rājasūyāśvamedhau ca kuryācchoṇācale budhaḥ || ekāhaṃ vāruṇakṣetre naro yatsyādupoṣitaḥ || 35 || tasya cāṃdrāyaṇaśataṃ bhavetsāṃtapanāyutam || ṣoḍaśāpi mahādānānyaruṇakṣetrasaṃnidhau || 36 || anuṣṭhitāni kalpoktaṃ kurvaṃti dviguṇaṃ phalam || 37 || iti naṃdikeśvaramukhena śuśruvānmuninaṃdanotha nirayapratikriyām|| abhinaṃdya taṃ vada dinartuvatsarapramukhārhaṇakramamiti vyajijñapat || 38 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe pāpāpanodakaprāyaścittavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.7>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || raktotpalairarkavāre yaḥ śoṇādrīśamarcayet || avaśyaṃ tasya sidhyaṃti sārvabhaumamaharddhayaḥ || 1 || saumyavāre'ruṇādrīśaṃ kastūrīkaravīrakaiḥ || yaḥ pūjayati tasya syātsatyaloke sukhāsikā || 2 || guruvāre sitāṃbhojaiḥ śoṇeśaṃ varivasyataḥ || janaloke ciraṃ vāsaḥ siddhaiḥ saha bhaviṣyati || 3 || caṃpakairmallikābhiśca śukravāre samarcayet || tapolokaṃ prapadyeta brahmarṣibhirabhiṣṭutaḥ || 4 || saurivāre ca jātībhissamārādhyāruṇeśvaram || na jātu yamalokānāṃ pāpīyānapi kalpate || 5 || prathamāyāṃ tithau devasyopahāraṃ samarpayet || yaḥ pāyasena sa bhaveddhanadhānyasamṛddhimān|| 6 || dvitīyasyāṃ tithau bhaktyā yo dadhyannaṃ nivedayet || sa bhavedbhāgyavāñchreṣṭhaḥ somapāśca bhaveddhruvam || 7 || tṛtīyāyāṃ ca yo'pūpaiḥ śoṇeśaṃ paritarpayet || tasyā vyāhatamārogyamāśarīraṃ bhaviṣyati || 8 || caturthyāmaruṇeśāya pūrṇakumbhotkarādikam || nivedayati yastasya bhavetpūrṇamanorathaḥ || 9 || mudgaudanaṃ ca paṃcamyāmupahāraṃ prakalpayeta || śoṇeśvarāya bhaktyā yaḥ sa syādakṣayyavaibhavaḥ || 1.3.2.7.10 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ guḍaudanaṃ dadyādaruṇācalaśambhave || bhaktyā yastasya santāno na kadācitprahīyate || 11 || tilaudanaṃ yassaptamyāṃ śoṇeśāya samarpayet || sa dīno'pyadhamarṇatvamayatnena vyapohati || 12 || aṣṭamyāṃ rājaśālyannaṃ yo dadyācchoṇaśambhave || tasya sevāṃ vināpi syādrājaloko vaśīkṛtaḥ || 13 || godhūmānnaṃ navamyāṃ ca śoṇādrīśāya yo'rpayet || rājayakṣmādayastasya na bhaviṣyaṃti jātu ca || 14 || daśamyāṃ śoṇanāthāya yaḥ karaṃbhaṃ nivedayet || sa bhavetsarvalokānāṃ sadaiva prītibhājanam || 15 || pṛthukairupahārānya ekādaśyāṃ prakalpayet || aruṇācalanāthasya sa bhavedakutobhayaḥ || 16 || dvādaśyāṃ śoṇanāthāya sūpaudananivedanam || yaḥ karoti bhavettasya nirvighāto manorathaḥ || 17 || yaḥ saktūnaruṇeśāya trayodaśyāṃ samarpayet || tasyā vyākulacittvamaśrāṃtamapi jāyate || 18 || arpayecchoṇanāthāya phalāni vividhāni yaḥ || caturdaśyāṃ sa mūḍho'pi siddhasārasvato bhavet || 19 || yaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ śoṇādrināthāya vinivedayet || panasasya phalaṃ tasya cakṣūrogo na jāyate || 1.3.2.7.20 || kuhvāṃ ca saṃgame bhaktyā kaṃdamūlādi yo'rpayet || śoṇācaleśvarāyāsya tuṣyaṃti pitaraḥ kila || 21 || aśvinyāmaruṇeśāya dadyādvāsāṃsi bhaktimān || bharaṇyāmaruṇeśāya dadyādābharaṇānyapi || 22 || kṛttikāsu pradīpāṃśca rohiṇyāṃ raupyamarpayet || mṛgaśīrṣe malayajamārdrāyāṃ haricaṃdanam || 23 || punarvasau mṛgamadaṃ puṣye karpūramarpayet || kāśmīrodbhavamāśleṣe maghāyāṃ tuhinodakam || 24 || tāṃbūlaṃ pūrvaphālgunyāṃ dhūpamuttaraphālgune || kālāgurūṃśca hastarkṣe citrāyāṃ yakṣakardamam || 25 || svātyāṃ suvāsinīvṛṃdaṃ viśākhāyāṃ prakīrṇakam || maitre muktātapatraṃ ca jyeṣṭhāyāṃ dhainukānyapi || 26 || mūle muktāsarānpūrvāṣāḍhe mukuṭamarpayet || ratnāni cottarāṣāḍhe śravaṇe bhadrapīṭhikām || 27 || aṣṭāpadaṃ dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ vāsaḥ śatabhiṣajyapi || pūrvābhādrapade bhogānuttarāyāṃ turaṃgamān || 28 || revatyāṃ ca rathaṃ haimaṃ pradadyācchoṇaśaṃbhave || dadyātkṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ tata evārpayennaraḥ || 29 || pūjyo rāśiṣu meṣādiṣvaruṇetho viśeṣataḥ || siṃduvāraiḥ kurabakaiḥ kakubhaiḥ pāṭalaiḥ kramāt || 1.3.2.7.30 || kuṭajairnīpakusumairjīvaṃtīmallikādibhiḥ || saroruhairdamanakairnadyāvartasaroruhaiḥ || 31 || paṃcāmṛtena snapayannubhayoruparāgayoḥ || paṃcākṣareṇa kurvīta śoṇanāthasya bhaktitaḥ || 32 || snapanaṃ pañcagavyena dvayorayanayorapi || ṣaḍakṣareṇa kurvīta gavyena snapanakriyām || 33 || praṇavenaiva kurvīta kṣīreṇa snapanakriyām || aruṇācalanāthasya bhaktyā viṣuvayordvayoḥ |||| 34 || prāhṇe syādrudratulasī madhyāhne kṛtamālakam || aparāhṇe mallikā ca śoṇādrīśasya śasyate ||35|| addhodaye ca snapayetsahasrakalaśodakaiḥ || śatarudrīyamuccārya śrīśoṇācalaśaṃbhave || 36 || śivarātrau viśeṣeṇa triśikhairbilvapatrakaiḥ || kamalaiḥ karṇikāraiśca jāgarūko yateṃdriyaḥ || 37 || gītavāditranṛtyaiśca divyāgamavidhānataḥ || pūjayedapavargārthaṃ śoṇaśaile maheśvaram || 38 || māsi pauṣe ca devasya kuryādāgneyamutsavam || navānnairupadaṃśādyairvyāhṛtīruccaranbudhaḥ || 39 || vaiśākhe ca viśākhāyāṃ śivataṃtrānusārataḥ|| śoṇācaleśvarasyāsya kuryāddamanakotsavam || 1.3.2.7.40 || prābodhika mārgaśīrṣe prātarnirmāya sāmabhiḥ || mahāpūjāṃ prakurvīta śoṇaśailasya bhaktimān || 41 || śanipradoṣeṣvārdrāsu vyatīpāteṣu parvasu || somārkavārayoścārcecchoṇādrīśaṃ yathāgamama || 42 || dīkṣopanayanodvāhaputrajanmādikeṣvapi || viśeṣapūjāṃ kurvīta śoṇanāthasya bhaktimān || 43 || api svajanmanakṣatre saṃpatsvāpatsu bhītiṣu || praveśanirgamanayoścārcanīyo'ruṇeśvaraḥ || 44 | vraticakrāgame pādabaṃdhane navavaibhave || aruṇeśārcanaṃ kuryādabhiyāneṣu ca dviṣām|| 45|| smaredatidavīyāṃścetpaśyetparyaṃtago yadi || sthitaścedaruṇakṣetre trikālaṃ pūjayecchivam || 46 || kimanyadvada vatseti uddhṛtya bhujamucyate || aruṇakṣetrato nānyadalaṃ svargāpavargayoḥ || 47 || smaraṇena manaḥśrotre śravaṇāddarśanādṛśauḥ || jihvāṃ ca kīrttanācchoṇakṣetraṃ sadyaḥ punātyalam|| 48 || aruṇesminmahākṣetre dehibhirlabdhajanmabhiḥ || jīvadbhirlabhyate bhogo mokṣaśconmuktajīvitaiḥ | 49 || anyatra muktadehānāmapyatra śrāddhakarmaṇā || api pāpātmanāṃ puṃsāmapavargo bhaviṣyati || 1.3.2.7.50 || ayodhyāṃ mathurāṃ māyāṃ kāśīṃ kāṃcīmavaṃtikām || dvārakāṃ cāruṇakṣetramatiśete na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || ityuktavaṃtaṃ ca śilādaputraṃ mṛkaṇḍusūnuḥ punarapyuvāca || māhātmyametanmahanīyakīrte bhūyopi pṛcchāmi vadasva mahyam || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe kāmyakarmavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7 || ||
<1.3.2.8>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || aruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ vistarātparipṛcchatā || mārkaṃḍeya tvayā manye mayi nyasto mahānbharaḥ || 1 || sthāne kutūhalākṣiptaṃ manastava mahāmate || yaḥ śoṇādrīśacaritaṃ na vetti sa naraḥ paśuḥ || 2 || kathaṃ vā śakyate vaktuṃ jānānarapi kārtsnyataḥ || śoṇācalajuṣaḥ śaṃbhormāhātmyaṃ mahitodayam ||3|| kathaṃ vā śrutamapyetadāścaryarasabhāvitaiḥ || aśeṣamavadhāryeta prajñāvatpravarairapi ||4|| idānīṃ smara citraṃ tu caritraṃ smaravairiṇaḥ || parāmṛtānubhūtyeva satyaṃ nṛtyati me manaḥ || 5 || adbhutaṃ śivacāritramāskaṃditamanoharam || mama varṇayituṃ kārtsnyānnaiva śaknoti śemuṣī || 6 || tathāpyeṣa pravakṣye'hamaṃśāṃśena yathāmati || puṇyaṃ śoṇādrināthasya māhātmyaṃ śrūyatāṃ mune || 7 || purādidevakalpādau nirvikalpo maheśvaraḥ || svecchayā sakalaṃ viśvaṃ punarapyudabhāvayat || 8 || udbhāvitaṃ ca tadviśvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ pātuṃ ca sarvadā || anvicchannādidevo'sau brahmaviṣṇū vinirmame || 9 || asṛjaddakṣiṇāṃgena tryaṃbakaḥ parameṣṭhinam || viṣṭaraśravasaṃ devo vāmāṃgena ca sṛṣṭavān || 1.3.2.8.10 | brahmāṇaṃ rajasā viṣṇuṃ sattvena samayūyujat || niyuktau devadevena tau viraṃcyacyutāvubhau || 11 || īśāte sarvajagatāṃ sṛṣṭirakṣāvidhānayoḥ || manasaiva marīcyādīnsasarja brāhmaṇāndaśa || 12 || dakṣaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhātsṛṣṭyai prāvartayadvidhiḥ || mukhena brāhmaṇāndorbhyāṃ kṣatriyānūruto viśaḥ || 13 || śūdrāṃśca padbhyāṃ niramātsvayaṃ ca kamalāsanaḥ || marīcitanayājjajñuḥ kaśyapādasurāssurāḥ || 14 || marutaḥ phaṇino gṛdhrā gaṃdharvāsaraso'pi ca || manuśca yasya saṃtāno mānavo'yaṃ pravarttate || 15 || nānājñātitvamāpādya nānākarmapravartakāḥ || atreśca samabhūdārṣaṃ kṣātraṃ ca dvividhaṃ kulam || 16 || pulastyapulahābhyāṃ ca jajñire yakṣarākṣasāḥ || utathyagīṣpatimukhā jajñireṃ'giriso muneḥ || 17 || bhṛgoragniḥ samudabhūccyavanādyāstatharṣayaḥ || vasiṣṭhapramukhebhyaśca saṃbabhūburmaharṣayaḥ || yatputrapautrairbhuvanamidamāpūryate'khilam || 18 || evaṃ brahmā''tmajaiḥ svīyairidamāpūrayajjagat || kālena vaibhavenāpi visasmāra maheśvaram || 19 || acyuto'pi bhṛgoḥ putrīmudvāhya kamalālayām || matsyādirūpo jagati bhavannāsmaradīśvaram || 1.3.2.8.20 || sṛṣṭisthitibhyāṃ druhiṇābjanābhau svādhīnatāṃ nūnamupāgatābhyām || atīva garvaṃ dadhaturna kasya mado'dhikāreṇa bhavennarasya || 21 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṃḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe sṛṣṭivaṇarnaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || cha ||
<1.3.2.9>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || ahameva prabhuriti prarūḍhādhikagarvayoḥ || viraṃcyapyutayorāsīdvivādo mohasaṃbhavaḥ || 1 || rajovikārābhyadhiko bāhye nīla ivotthitaḥ || viśvasṛṣṭikaro viṣṇuṃ viraṃcyo'brūta garvataḥ || 2 || || brahmovāca || || kathaṃ tvamadhikaścāsi viṣṇo janayiturmama || pitāmahasya lokānāṃ kimevamatimohitaḥ || 3 || tvatta evoditau daityau nihatya madhukaiṭabhau || daityāririti mugdha tvaṃ garvaṃ vahasi keśava || 4 || tvāmeva sṛjato nityaṃ bahudhā mama vedhasaḥ || adyāpyāyāsajāṃ pīḍāṃ na parityajataḥ karau || 5 || mama śramāṃbhasodbhūte mahāṃbhodhau nimajjataḥ || naiyagrodhaṃ na cotpannaṃ kutaste'stvavalaṃbanam|| 6 || madupajñe mahāṃbhodhau sravate ko'pi pannagaḥ || tadāśrayastvamūrdhvaṃ te padmaṃ taccāsanaṃ mama || 7 || kutastamomaye brūhi tvayi sattvaguṇodayaḥ|| sa vetsi kiṃ tvaṃ prakṛtiṃ nidrājaḍimanirbharaḥ || 8 || jalāśaye prasvapatā daityabhītyā janārdana || kathaṃ tvayā rakṣitāsau madadhīnā jagattrayī || || 9 || caturbhyo mama vaktrebhyo vedāḥ samudayaṃ gatāḥ || caitanyarūpiṇī śaktiḥ kalatraṃ me sarasvatī || 1.3.2.9.10 || mayā hi sṛjyate viśvamidaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam || rakṣyate ca tadindrādyairmāmakaiḥputrapautrakaiḥ||11|| tataḥ kathaya vaikuṃṭha manniyojyeṣu kaścana || jagatāmīśvarānmattaḥ kathaṃ nāmātiricyase ||12|| || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || itthaṃ saroṣasaṃraṃbhe vidhau pauruṣabhāṣiṇi || nārāyaṇo'pi sāsūyaṃ smitvaivaṃ samabhāṣata || 13 || || || viṣṇuruvāca || || viraṃce muṃca saṃraṃbhaṃ vṛthā khalu vikatthase || nābhīsarojasaṃjāto mama tvamavadhāraya || 14 || yoganidrāṃ mayonmucya purā ha madhukaiṭabhau || na cedyanmathitau tābhyāṃ tathaiva syāḥ praṇāśitaḥ || 15 || somakapramukhāndaityānhaṃtumātmecchayā mama || dhṛtamatsyādirūpasya ko vānyaḥ sṛṣṭikāraṇam || 16 || na kiṃcidapi paśyaṃti rajasārūḍhadṛṣṭayaḥ || rajomayena bhavatā kiṃ nirūpayituṃ kṣamam || 17 || avinābhāvinī śaktirnanu me padmavāsinī || yasyāḥ kaṭākṣamātreṇa jagavitayamedhate || 18 || bhūtānyamūni kālo'yamātmanopyahameva hi || mayā virahitaṃ ki vā triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 19 || pra ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālā manavo'pyaham || bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayīmenāṃ madadhīnāṃ viciṃtaya || 1.3.2.9.20 || mamaiva viniyogena sṛṣṭiśaktiḥ svayaṃ sthitā || tanme trailokyanāthasyaki tvaṃjyeṣṭhaḥ samo'thavā || 21 || || || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || evaṃ mohāṃdhamanasoranyonyaṃ pratigarjatoḥ || yayāvanalpasamayaḥsavartasadṛśastayo. || 22 || udayāstamayau syātāṃ na tadā caṃdrasūryayoḥ || nakṣatrāṇi ca tārāśca grahāśca kṣīṇatāṃ yayuḥ || 23 || nāvavurmaruto vā na jajvalurjātavedasaḥ || nāṃtarikṣaṃ na ca kṣoṇī na diśo'pi cakāśire || 24 || samudrāścukṣubhussarve parvatāśca cakaṃpire || auṣadhyaḥ śoṣamāseduravaseduśca jaṃtavaḥ || 25 || pakṣamāsartuvarṣādikālasya niyamo gataḥ || ahorātravyavasthāpi praṇāśa samupāyayau || 26 || indrādayo lokapālā marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ || sarvepyakāle saṃprāptaṃ kalpāṃtaṃ menire tadā || 27 || evaṃ jāte mahākṣobhe bhūtākrandapracoditaḥ || bhūtanātho jagajjātamavidyāyāmabudhyata || 28 || vyaciṃtayacca viśvātmā viśvasaṃrakṣaṇodyataḥ || avāhyayā dṛśā'paśyadanayomohakāraṇam || 29 || svāminaṃ sakalaiśvaryadātāraṃ māṃ madoddhatau || vismṛtya svaṃ svamevaitāvamaṃsetāṃ jagatprabhū || 1.3.2.9.30 || aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ vadimau druhiṇācyutau || jānānāvapi māṃ samyagabhūtāmevamuddhatau || 31 || ajñānatimirodbhūti dūṣitāśayalocanaḥ || janaḥ prāptaṃ stutamapi prāyo vastu na paśyati || 32 || kṛtāparādhāvapyetau nimagnau mohasāgare || mayā nopekṣaṇīyau hi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 33 || iti niścitya manasā māyā vaivaśyametayoḥ || devo dayāmahāṃbhodhirvyapohayitumaihata || 34 || aho'nukampā taruṇeṃdumauleḥ svabhāvasiddhā bhuvanatraye'smin || asau pramohāṃbudhimadhyatobhūdāvirnirastāvapi dhātṛviṣṇū || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe śivaviṣṇuvivādavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.10>
|| || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ājñāpaya vibho mahyaṃ yathā śaṃbhuḥ sanātanaḥ || anujagrāha mohāṃdho vaikuṇṭhaparameṣṭhinau || 1 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || śṛṇuṣva sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi vistareṇa yathātatham || yadeva devo vidadhe dayayā bhaktavatsalaḥ || 2 || athodasthāttayormadhye tathā vivadamānayoḥ || jyotiḥstaṃbhatvamabhyetya rodoraṃdhranirodhakaḥ || 3 || mahatā jṛṃbhamāṇena tasya brahmāṃḍabhedinaḥ || antarikṣamatiśyāmaṃ samutkṣiptamivābhavata || 4 || viṣvagvivarṇatā tasya jyotirliṃgasya tejasā || diśo virejire sadyo dūravistāritā iva || 5 || tīvraistasya mahājvālaiḥ śoṣitā iva sāgarāḥ || vimuktavīcisaṃkṣobhāḥ svāmeva prakṛtiṃ yayuḥ || 6 || vyadyotaṃta divi prāgvadvahāstārāgaṇaiḥ saha || tejaḥstaṃbhātsamudbhinnāḥ sphuliṃgā iva kecana ||7|| tejasā tasya śoṇena gairikeṇeva raṃjitāḥ || bhaumaraviśriyaṃ sarve'pyavahannavanībhṛtaḥ ||8|| samudrāstatpraticchāyānirbharāśliṣṭa yādasaḥ || padmarāgaśilākhaṇḍe ghaṭitā iva rejire || 9 || pravālagucchaiḥ pratyagrairlaṃbitā iva pādapāḥ || nadyaśca nirbharotphullakahlārā iva rejire|| 1.3.2.10.10 || mahī kuṃkumalipteva diśaḥ siṃdūritā iva || sarvāruṇamiva vyoma samagatpratyadṛśyata || 11 || brahmāṃḍakarparamabhūttanmahaḥ pūritāṃtaram || śoṇiteneva saṃpūrṇaṃ kapālaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ || 12 || evaṃ pravarddhamānena tejaḥstambhena tena ca || aruṇākāratāṃ bheje viśvaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam || 13 || tejoliṃgaṃ tadāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktamithaḥ krudhau || aciṃtayetāmekaikaṃ caturmukhacaturbhujau || 102 || kimeṣa vasudhāṃ bhittvā śeṣādīnāṃ phaṇābhṛtām || phaṇāmāṇikyamahasāṃ rāśirunmukhatāṃ gataḥ || 15 || kiṃ vā kalpāṃtasulabhaprādurbhāvāḥ prabhākarāḥ || dvādaśāpi nabhobhūmyormadhye yugapadutthitāḥ || 16 || āhosvinmegha saṃgharṣādvitatā vyomamadhyataḥ|| anyonyaṃ militāḥ kṣiprā nipataṃtyavanītale || 17 || pratighnanneṣa tejobhirakṣṇoḥ śaktimanukṣaṇam || svanirviśeṣitāśeṣabhūtajālaḥ pravarddhate || 18 || eṣa uddīpyamāno'pi saṃtāpāya na kalpate || nedīyāṃsyapi bhūtāni na nirdahati vahnivat || 19 || etasya kāṃtisaṃkrāṃtyā jagadeva na kevalam || madīyamapi śoṇatvamanuprāptamaho vapuḥ || 1.3.2.10.20 || kasmādeṣa samutpannaḥ kiṃ mūlaḥ kimupādhikaḥ || kutastyaḥ kimupādānaḥ kayā bhaktyā prakāśate || 21 || kiyānavadhiretasya viṣvaktiryagadhordhvataḥ || avagāḍhaśca pātālaṃ kiyanmātramasāviti || 22 || tadetadakhilaṃ jñātuṃ manaḥ paryutsukaṃ muhuḥ || icchatyutpatituṃ vyoma praveṣṭuṃ ca rasātalam || 23 || iti ciṃtābharākrāṃtau tejaḥstaṃbhāvalokanāt || ubhāvapyavakulitau vaikuṇṭhaparameṣṭhinau || 24 || abhāṣata ca goviṃdaḥ sutarāmeva garvitam || hiraṇyagarbhamālokya smayamānamukhāṃbujaḥ || 25 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || ayamevāvayorbrahmannanyonyotkarṣakāṃkṣiṇoḥ || satyameva parīkṣāyai nikaṣaḥ samupasthitaḥ || 26 ||| amuṣya tejasāṃ rāśeraparicchedyasaṃpadaḥ || ādyaṃtau jñātumekena na śakyaṃ dhruvamāvayoḥ || 27 || yaḥ paśyenmūlamagraṃ vā tejasosya svayaṃbhuvaḥ || sa eva nāvabhyadhiko jagatāṃ nāthako'pi saḥ || 28 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || ityubhāvapi viniścitāśayau mūlamagramapi tasya vīkṣitum || tejasotimahato babhūvatuḥ spardhayā viracitodyamau mithaḥ || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe brahmaviṣṇvormadhye tejomayaliṃgaprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<1.3.2.11>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || atha haṃsākṛtiṃ vyomapadavīlaṃghanakṣamām || bheje viraṃcistasyāgraṃ drakṣyāmīti kṛtodyamaḥ || 1 || jagrāha viṣṇurvārāhaṃ vigrahaṃ dṛḍhavigrahaḥ || viśvaṃbharāvinirbheda krīḍāsulabhavaibhavam || 2 || mūlaṃ tasya parijñāya pratyāvartitumutsukaḥ || kṛtrimastabdharomaiṣa daṃṣṭrābhyāmabhinanmahīm||3|| vidārayansa potreṇa bhūtadhātrīmavāṅmukhaḥ || mahāvarāho dadṛśe tejastaṃbhaṃ namanniva || krīḍākroḍakaṭhoreṇa kaṃṭhaghoṣeṇa pūrayan || pātālaṃ bahulotsāhaḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame ||5 || viveśa yatrayatrāsau tatratatra tathāsthitam || avaikṣiṣṭānalastaṃbhaṃ tameva kuhanākiṭiḥ ||6|| vidāritānmahīraṃdhātpratyadṛśyaṃta bhoginaḥ || prarohā iva śeṣādyāstejaḥstaṃbhasya kecana ||7|| pratyadṛśyata hemādrermūla kanda iva sthitaḥ || ādhāratāṃ gato dṛṣṭo hyacyutenādikacchapaḥ || 8 || ārādvasundharāgulphe dhuraṃdharatayā sthitāḥ || diksiṃdhurāśca dṛśyaṃte madamaṃtharabaṃdhurāḥ || 9 || madhudviṣā ca sa mahānmaṃḍūko'pi vilokitaḥ || akhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ bhūmeryasya pṛṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitam || 1.3.2.11.10 || ādhāraśaktimapi tāmabhyapaśyadadhokṣajaḥ || yadanugrahataḥ śeṣakūrmādyā api dhūrvahāḥ || 11 || atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiṣa sutalaṃ nitalaṃ tathā || talātalaṃ ca pratalaṃ mahātalamiti kramāt |||| 12 || dadarśa sapta pātālānapi vārijalocanaḥ || tatratyānvividhākārānsarvānapi savismayaḥ || 13 || atyagādbhogavatyākhyāṃ purīṃ vairocanīmapi || jagāhenyāṃśca daityānāmāvāsānatigahvarān || 14 || idaṃ dṛṣṭamidaṃ dṛṣṭamityupārūḍhakautukaḥ || mūlaṃ mugdhāśayastasya vicinoti sma mādhavaḥ || 15 || adhastādapi gāḍhena payodhestena potriṇā || tathaiva tejaḥstaṃbhaḥ sa nirvikāramavaikṣyata||16|| dalitā kevalaṃ pṛṣvī pāthorāśirvilolitaḥ|| naivālokyata tanmūlaṃ kolarūpena viṣṇunā || 17 || itthaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi bhrāṃtyā saṃbhrāṃtamānasaḥ || nālaṃ babhūva tanmūlaṃ līlākroḍo vilokitum || || 18 || avarugṇakhuraḥ kṣuṇṇadaṃṣṭro vidhvastavigrahaḥ || bhagnapotraḥ sa bhūdāro jagāhe bahalaṃ śramam || 19 || śrāṃtyā niśvasatastasya tādṛgdarpo viśṛṃkhalaḥ || nanāśa tatkṣaṇātsākaṃ tanmūlāvekṣaṇecchayā || 1.3.2.11.20 || anirvyūḍhapratijño'pi pratyāvartitumutsakaḥ || na cakṣame sarojākṣaścalituṃ ca padātpadam || 21 || śramāṃdhacakṣuṣastasya pātālāṃtaravarttinaḥ || tatteja eva paṃthānaṃ punarapyudabhāvayat || 22 || kathaṃkathaṃciduttīrṇo 'pyakūpārādapārataḥ || svedāṃbhaḥsāgarasrāve magno'bhūcchadmaśūkaraḥ || 23 || rajjveva tejaḥstaṃbhasya prabhayā sānubaddhayā || labdhvācalaṃ vanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ nyavarttiṣṭa janārdanaḥ || 24 || nāvaikṣi yanmayā mūlamamuṣya mahasāṃ nidheḥ || tataḥ sraṣṭrāpi no dṛṣṭaḥ śirobhāgaḥ kathaṃcana || 25 || amuṣya mahasāṃ rāśeḥ prāgabhūdyatra saṃbhavaḥ || tato nivṛttya yāsyāmi śaraṇaṃ śivamīśvaram ||26|| sa hi viśvādhiko devaściraṃ mohāṃdhacakṣuṣā || yadvismṛto mayā tasmāddurvipāko'janīdṛśaḥ || 27 || evaṃ vinirdhārya vimuktadarpo nivṛttavānāśu saroruhākṣaḥ || tameva deśaṃ prababhūva yatra staṃbhaḥ sa tejomayatāṃ dadhānaḥ || 28 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe viṣṇunā liṃgādhobhāgaśodhanavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ |||| 11 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.12>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || tatastejomayaṃ staṃbhamanusṛtya pitāmahaḥ || utpapātonmukho vegānnirālaṃbe nabhastale ||1|| drutamutpatatastasya pakṣāvegena vāritāḥ || vyaśīryata samudvartāḥ praṇunnā iva vāyubhiḥ||2|| sa vegādutpatandūraṃ nākṣṇorviṣayatāmagāt || kevalaṃ dīrghadīrghaiva rekhā vyomni vyabhāvyata||3|| māyāmarālo dadṛśe tejaḥstaṃbhasyapārśvataḥ|| saṃdhyāpayodharābhyarṇacārīva rajanīkaraḥ||4|| prāgatyagādutpatatāṃ tato'dhvānaṃ payomucām|| vimānapadavīṃ paścāttārāvartaṃ tataḥ param ||5|| tejasāṃ yāni dhāmāni hyatyuccānyūrdhvacāriṇām || aticakrāma vegena tānyasau kuhanākhagaḥ || || 6 || maruto manaso vāpi javaḥ sūkṣmatarākṛteḥ || so'bhūdadhaḥkṛtastena haṃsena gamanādinā || 7 || yathāyathā cotpapāta sudūraṃ śramitacchadaḥ || tathātathā ca dadṛśe tejaḥstaṃbhaḥ samunnataḥ || 8 || atītya marutāṃ skaṃdhānsapta saṃprāptavismayaḥ || bibhedāṃḍakaṭāhaṃ ca jvalaṃtaṃ tamudaikṣata || 9 || kathaṃ vā'dṛṣṭamūlasya sthātavyaṃ purato hareḥ || avimocayataḥ śaurerasamāsamaśīrṣatām || 1.3.2.12.10 || anirvyūḍhapratijñasya dīrghaiḥ kiṃ vā mamāsubhiḥ || tadatraupayikaṃ kiṃ syātkāryaṃ kā mā gatirmama ||11|| atisaṃdhitsato viṣṇuṃ kassahāyo bhaviṣyati || ārjavaṃ naiva nirjetuṃ prativādinamakṣamaḥ || 12 || chadmanā vā tiraskuryānmānā hi mahatāṃ dhanam || iti saṃcitayatyeva viriṃcau vyākulātmani || 13 || ākāśe dadṛśe nātidūre kimapi nirmalam || aiṃdavī kimiyaṃ rekhā tasyāḥ kathamihāgamaḥ || 14 || yadvā mṛṇālaṃ tatsiṃdhau viyatyasyāṃ kutastu saḥ || iti tasminsasaṃdehe nedīyastaṃ tadāgatam || 15 || abodhi ketakībarhamiti rājīvajanmanā || tatparyuṣitamapyudyatsaurabhaṃ vastuśaktitaḥ || 16 || hiraṇyagarbho vimalamagṛhṇātketakacchadam || gṛhītamātraṃ tenaitatsacaitanyaṃ kilābravīt || 17 || || ketaka uvāca || || bho gṛhṇāsi kimarthaṃ tvaṃ muṃca māṃ viśramodyatam || varṣāṇāṃ śatasāhasramutpatyaivaṃ vihāyasā || 16 || || naṃdīśa uvāca || || tathā samedhamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā śramamakhidyata || aciṃtayatpadmasūtiratyaṃtaṃ vihatāśayaḥ || 19 || anirvyūḍhapratijñāvānnīcatāmapi saṃśritaḥ || ākrāṃtarodovivaraḥ kva rāśistejasāmasau || 1.3.2.12.20 || ahametatparīkṣāyāṃ kva paricchinna pauruṣaḥ || bhajyete iva me pakṣau dṛśā cāṃdhāyate iva || pradhvaṃsaṃta ivāṃgāni patāmīvāhamapyadhaḥ || 21 || kiṃ vānyadbahunoktena saha niśvāsavāyubhiḥ || mama prāṇāśca niyataṃ nirgacchaṃtīva sāṃpratam || 22 || ahaṃkāramadagraṃthirayaṃ truṭatu cittataḥ || mukuṃdena saha spardhā sā ca śīghṃ praṇaśyatu || 23 || yadeṣa rodaḥkuharapariṇāhādhikodyamaḥ || aunnatyamayate'dyāpi tejastaṃbho yathā purā || 24 || tadasya tejasāṃ rāśernāhaṃ nārāyaṇo'thavā || kāraṇaṃ dūrataścānye maheṃdrapramukhāḥ surāḥ || 25 || ito notpatituṃ śaktirasti me tannivarttaye || iti niścitya manasā vidhātā jātavismayaḥ || 26 || pratyabhāṣata taṃ kastvaṃ kuto vā prāptavāniti || sa ca pratyabravīdenaṃ vedhasaṃ ketakacchadaḥ || 27 || ketakacchada evāsaṃ sacaitanyaḥ śivājñayā || tejastaṃbhātmanaḥ śaṃbhorasya mūrdhni ciraṃ sthitaḥ || 28 || bhūloka icchayā vastuṃ tataḥ saṃprāptavānaham ||29|| itthaṃ śrutvā ketakībarhavācaṃ labdhvāśvāsaṃ taṃ kilāṃbhojabhūtiḥ || brūhi tvaṃ me tatkiyatyaṃtare vā tejaḥstaṃbhasyāgramityāvabhāṣe || 1.3.2.12.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe brahmaṇā liṃgoparibhāgaśodhanavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12||
<1.3.2.13>
||naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || ketakībarhamapyenaṃ vihasya punarabravīt || || ketakyuvāca || || api mūḍha na kiṃcittvaṃ vetsi kastvaṃ kuto na tat || 1 || īdṛśyaḥ parito lagnā yasminbrahmāṃḍakoṭayaḥ || tasya pramāṇametāvaditi ko vedituṃ kṣamaḥ ||2|| caturyugāyutairyātaṃ tato nipatato mama|| idānīmapi nāproti tanmadhyaṃ kila bhūtalam ||3|| iti bruvāṇamenaṃ ca namaskṛtya sarojabhūḥ|| hitvā nijamahaṃkāramabhāṣata kṛtāṃjaliḥ||4|| brahmovāca|| mahātmansatyamevāsmi mūḍho'haṃ ketakacchada|| brahmaṇā hi mayā sparddhā viṣṇunā saha nirmitā|| 5|| dvābhyāmapīdamāvābhyāṃ vismṛtaṃ śivavaibhavam|| yannau mahānabhūdgarvassargasaṃtrāṇamātrataḥ|| 6|| hrepaṇī saṃkathā tāvadāstāmadyāpyahaṃ yataḥ || sparddhayā na vimukto'smi baddhayā garuḍadhvaje || 7 || sakhyaṃ sāptapadīnaṃ hi kathyate tadbhavānmayi || 8 || asaṃstutadhiyaṃ hitvā kartumarhasyanugraham || ahaṃ viṣṇuśca mohāṃdhau tejaḥstaṃbhasya vīkṣaṇāt || 9 || haṃsakolākṛtī dadhvo mithaḥ sāmyaṃ vyapohitum || mūlaṃ didṛkṣuḥ sa daśāṃ kīdṛśīṃ yātavāniti || 1.3.2.13.10 || na jāne mama cāsyāgraṃ didṛkṣorīdṛkṣī daśā || gatamuḍḍīyamānasya me sahasreṇa hāyaneḥ || || 11 || jātaśramo'smi nitarāṃ viyujya iva cāsubhiḥ || diṣṭyādya bhadra labdhastvaṃ mayā''laṃbovasīdatām|| 12 || tanme kuruṣva mitrasya saphalāṃ yācanāmimām || sakhāhaṃ sahasaṃjalpādasmi dāsonuṣaṃjanāt || 13 || tattvayā karaṇīyaivaṃ prārthanaiṣā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || yadi paśyati mūlaṃ sa jito'hamamunā tadā || 14 || yadvā na paśyati tadāpyasmi sāmyamupeyivān || idaṃ dvayamapi prāyo mamātihrepaṇaṃ sakhe || 15 || tvayaiva parihāryatvamidānīṃ samupāgatam || anṛtāmabhibhāṣa tvamucitāṃ ca suhṛtkṛte || 16 || giramekāmimāmagre cakrapāṇerudīraya || eṣa haṃsākṛtirbrahmā tejaḥstaṃbhasvarūpiṇaḥ || 17 || atyuccaṃ dṛṣṭavānagramatra sākṣye sthito'smyaham || tenāpi tejaḥstambhatvameyuṣā candramaulinā || 18 || saṃbhāvitoyaṃ sutarāṃ pitreva hi pitāmahaḥ || ato'yamevābhyadhiko bhavato viṣṭaraśravāḥ || 19 || ityuktvā mama sāhāyyaṃ sumahatkriyatāṃ tvayā || 1.3.2.13.20 || ||
<1.3.2.14>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhūyaḥ prārthito'yaṃ vidhātrā dākṣiṇyārdraḥ ketakībarhakopi || tejaḥstaṃbhābhyarṇabhāje tathaiva prāhāśeṣaṃ viṣṇave brahmavākyam || 21 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe brahmaṇā'satyasākṣyārthaṃ ketakacchadaprāthanāvarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || || cha || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || so'pi brahmāṇamudvīkṣya tāvatā dviguṇaṃ smayan || nāgraṃ dṛṣṭamaneneti niścikāya vivekavān || 1 || anugrahītuṃ māṃ mugdhaṃ haṃtuṃ cāsya vidhermadam|| devadevaḥ sa evālaṃ bhūtabhartetyamanyata || 2 || mūlasaṃdarśanāśaktyā tejaḥstaṃmbhasya me madaḥ || vyapeta eva manye'dya yadbhaktistryaṃbake'jani || 3 || stūyate vītagarvatvātsa idānīṃ maheśvaraḥ || yasya dakṣiṇavāmābhyāmaṃgābhyāṃ nau samudbhavau || 4 || adyāpyavītagarvatvāllabdhvāsau kūṭasākṣiṇam || hiraṇyagarbho māmevamatisaṃdhātumicchati || || 5 || tadadya sakalasyāpi duḥkhasyāpanaye kṣamaḥ || sa eva śaraṇatvena prāptavyaḥ śaṃkaro mayā || 6 || tathā kṛtāparādhasya kṛtaghnasya gurudruhaḥ || tamṛte rakṣitā ko'nyastameva staumi śaṃkaram || 7 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || jaya pṛdhvīmayākāra jaya cāpomayākṛte || jaya prabhākarākāra jayāmṛtakarākṛte || 8 || jaya vaiśvānarākāra jaya gandhavahākṛte || jaya hotṛmayākāra jayākāśamayākṛte || 9 || rakṣa māṃ triguṇātīta rakṣa māṃ kālavigraha || rakṣa māmakṣayaiśvarya rakṣa māṃ karuṇākara || 1.3.2.14.10 || sraṣṭā tvaṃ sarvajagatāṃ rakṣitā sarvadehinām || hartā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāṃ vinaivāsti ko'paraḥ || 11 || aṇūnāmapyaṇīyāṃstvaṃ mahāṃstvaṃ mahatāmapi || antarbahistvamevaitajjagadākramya vartase || 12 || nigamāstava niśvāsā viśvaṃ te śilpavaibhavam || sa tvaṃ tvadīya evāsi jñānamātmā tava prabho || 13 || amarā dānavā daityāḥ siddhā vidyādharā narāḥ || prāṇinaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ śailāḥ śikhino'pi tvameva hi || 14 || svargastvamapavargastvaṃ tvamoṃkārastvamadhvaraḥ || tvaṃ yogastvaṃ parā saṃvitkiṃ tvaṃ na bhavasīśvara || 15 || tvamādirmadhyamaṃtaśca tasthuṣāṃ jagmuṣāmapi || kālasvarūpatāṃ prāpya kalayasyakhilaṃ jagat || 16 || pareśaḥ parataḥ śāstā sarvānugrāhakaḥ śivaḥ || sa eṣa me kathaṃkāraṃ sākṣādbhavati dhūrjaṭiḥ || 17 || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaraṇaṃ prāpto niḥśreyasamavāpnuyāt || atha vā staumi taddhāma jātamātraṃ yathāmiti || 18 || tacchrutvaiṣa kṛpāṃ kuryādavaśyaṃ sarvataḥ śrutiḥ || iti niścitya vaikuṃṭhaḥ stotuṃ samupacakrame || 19 || tameva taijasaṃ staṃbhaṃ praṇamya parameśvaram || ādimadhyāṃtarahitaṃ matvā taṃ jagadīśvaram || haṭhāttena viraṃcena vāryamāṇopi sasmitam || 1.3.2.14.20 || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || jaya deva mahādeva vāmadeva vṛṣadhvaja || kālāṃtaka kratudhvaṃsinnīlakaṃṭheṃduśekhara || 21 || jaya śaṃbho śiveśāna śarva tryaṃbaka dhūrjaṭe || smaravairinpurārāte sthāṇo bhava maheśvara || 22 || jayeśa khaṃḍaparaśo śūlinpaśupate hara || sarvajña bharga bhūteśa kapālinnīlalohita || 23 || jaya rudra makhārāte pinākinpramathādhipa || gaṃgādhara vyomakeśa girīśa parameśvara || 24 || jaya bhīma mṛgavyādha kṛttivāsaḥ kṛpānidhe || kṛśānuretaḥ kailāse nityameva hi vartase || 25 || tvadājñayā marudrāti phaṇī vahati bhūbharam || dīpyataḥ sūryaśaśinau brahmāṃḍaṃ plavateṃ'budhau || 26 || jyotīṃṣi saṃcaraṃte khe sarvaṃ tvacchāsanātprabho || ahaṃ brahmā ca jagatāṃ sargasaṃtrāṇayoralam || 27 || vidhāya kalpase puṣṭyai sūte sasyāni medinī || nākrāmaṃtyavyayaḥ sīmāṃ yacca tvanmahireva saḥ || 28 || aṇimādimahāsiddhiniḥsādhāraṇavaibhavaḥ || kathaṃ tvāmamarairanyairupekṣe samabhiṣṭutam || 29 || viśuktve vismarāmastvāṃ smarāmaḥ saṃkaṭepi ca || na roṣo jātu bhakteṣu prasādaḥ sarvadaiva te || 1.3.2.14.30 || yadā vidhitserbhaktiṃ tvaṃ yadā ca prāvṛṇoṣi tām || mohabodhau tadā puṃsāṃ kalpete baṃdhamokṣayoḥ || 31 || iti stutassāṃjalibaddhapāṇinā patiḥ paśūnāmatha cakrapāṇinā || kṛtāpahāse ca sarojasaṃbhave madoddhate prādurabhūddayānidhiḥ || 32|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe śaṃkaraprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.15>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || tejaḥstaṃbhaṃ vinirbhidya saṃdhyābhramiva caṃdramāḥ || kailāsakūṭadhavalaṃ vṛṣendramadhitasthivān || 1 || jaṭājūṭavatā bālacaṃdracūḍena maulinā || kapālamālikāṃ vaidhīṃ srajaṃ cāragvadhī dadhat || 2 || nāgakuṃḍalibhiḥ phālaphalakodbhāsilocanaiḥ || paṃcabhirvadanairdīptaiḥ kṣveḍakalmāṣakaṃdharaiḥ || 3 || śūlaṃ kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ sāraṃgaṃ paraśuṃ dhanuḥ || khaṭvāṃgamamalaṃ khaḍgaṃ dorbhirnāgaṃ ca dhārayan || 4 || śvasitoddhūlitākāro gajacarmottarīyavān || sarvālaṃkārasaṃpannaḥ sarvadevairabhiṣṭutaḥ || 5 || paridhānīkṛtavyāghracarmā tābhyāmadarśi saḥ || rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ānaṃdaṃ nanartta nalinekṣaṇaḥ || 6 || na kiṃcidapi jānāno mumoha ca sarojabhūḥ || 7 || dṛśābhinaṃdya mādhavaṃ prasannayā maheśvaraḥ || athodatiṣṭhipacca taṃ sahuṃkriyaścaturmukham || 8 || jagāda cādhikāritāmadādyuvāṃ samuddhatau || na lajjitavyamatra vāmayaṃ kramo'dhikāriṇām || 9 || parīkṣya vaibhavaṃ mama prabodhavānabhūddhariḥ || ayaṃ na jātupadmabhūśchalanmano durātmavān|| 1.3.2.15.10 || aśāsi paṃcavaktratā yadopahāsito hyaham || punaḥsvaputrikāratirmayaiṣa śikṣito'bhavat || 11 || tṛtīya eṣa maṃturapyaho kathaṃ nu sahyate || tadasya tu pratiṣṭhayā kvacinna bhūyatāṃ vidheḥ || 12 || ayaṃ ca ketakacchado yadāpa kūṭasākṣitām || ataḥ paraṃ na jātu tanmamaitu mūrdhni saṃsthitim || 13 || śaptvaivametau giriśaḥ prītyā viṣṇumabhāṣata || || 14 || || śrīmaheśvara uvāca || || vatsa mā bhaiḥ prasanno'smi bhavate bhaktiśāline || nanu tvamaṃgānme jātassāttviko'si viśeṣataḥ || māheśvarāgragaṇyo'si jagatyāṃ hi yathā purā || 15 || na tavātaḥ paraṃ jātu bhaktihānirbhavenmayi || pratikṣaṇaṃ varddhamānā kalpate ca vimuktaye || || 16 || ityanugrahakṛtaṃ trilocanaṃ bhaktibhāji nirahaṃkriye harau || bhītimānavanataḥ svayaṃ vidhiḥ stotumārabhata klṛptavaṃdanaḥ || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmye uttarārdhe brahmakṛtaśivastutyudyamavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.16>
|| brahmovāca || || devadeva tavaiśvaryaṃ kena śakyeta veditum || vinā bhāyaikyasulabhaṃ bhavadīyamanugraham || 1 || akartṛkāṇi vākyāni aiśvaryaṃ te niratyayam || na stotuṃ śakyate kiṃ tu namaskurvaṃti dūrataḥ || 2 || ko viṣṇuḥ ko'hamete vā dikpālā vāsavādayaḥ || tvameva deva karttāsi jagatsṛjanarakṣayoḥ || 3 || patistvaṃ pārvatīnātha paśavo vayamapyamī || baddhaṃ pāśena moktuṃ vā tvamevāsmānpragalbhase || 4 || ṣaḍviṃśattattvarūpastvamabhitaścābhivarttase || kovidaḥ ko vinirṇetuṃ tava yāthātmyamīśvaraḥ ||5|| kirātaḥ kila devastvaṃ sārameyaiḥ kilāgamaiḥ || ṣaḍvargahiṃsrānsaṃhartuṃ karoṣyākheṭakautukam ||6|| deva dakṣādhvare pūrvaṃ varibhadrastvadājñayā || kāṃkāṃ śikṣāmakārṣīnna iti kāpi viḍambanā || 7 || tava kālāgnirūpasya sarvabrahmāṃḍadāhinaḥ || poṣaṇātpuṣpacāpasya prāyo jihveti śemuṣī || 8 || kṛtāparādhaḥ śūlena tvayā dīrṇo jalaṃdharaḥ || antakoṃdhakadaityaśca prativīraśca ko'sti te ||9|| adhārayiṣyatkaṇṭhena kālakūṭaṃ na cedbhavān || kathaṃ ca dhārayiṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve'pi jīvitam || 1.3.2.16.10 || devadāruvane pūrvaṃ munīnkevalakarmaṭhān || prakṣobhya dhūrtaveṣastvaṃ dayayānvagrahīstathā || 11 || aṃghriṇākrāṃtavānno cedatyugrāṃ tvamapasmṛtim || tayākrāṃtamidaṃ kṛtsnamaṃdhakārāyate jagat || 12 || ardhanārīśvaraṃ rūpaṃ tvayā cenna prakāśitam || prabhavāmi kathaṃ sraṣṭuṃ jagadetaccarācaram || 13 || bhavatā staṃbhitaḥ śambho saṃraṃbhājjaṃbhajidbhujaḥ|| kiyaṃtaṃ haṃta kālaṃ te jayastaṃbha iva sthitaḥ||14|| bhikṣoḥ kapālamāpūrya rudhireṇātmano hariḥ|| śūlenotkṣipya mumuhe hyetattvamavadhāraya|| 15|| na cedaśikṣayaḥ sarvaśastrāstrāṇyanukaṃpayā || nirvāpayetkathaṃ vairaṃ kruddhopi jamadagnibhūḥ || 16 || nṛhariṃ śarabhākāraḥ samahārṣīnna cedbhavān || sa eva saṃharedviśvaṃ hiraṇyakaśiporapi || 17 || tvamācakṛkṣaḥ kalpābdhau kaivartto matsyakacchapau || hariṃ baddhvāhirāṭsūtrairnṛsiṃhamatha sūkaram || 18 || ekone padmasāhasre svanetreṇa kṛtārcanam || śūlinsudarśanaṃ dattvā daityadviṣamatūtupaḥ || 19 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || stutyaivamasya viṣṇośca prārthanena prasedivān || dhūrjaṭiḥ sṛṣṭikartṛtvaṃ punarasyābhyamanyata || 1.3.2.16.20 || samam̐jyāsu dvijānāṃ ca pūjanaṃ cānuśiṣṭavān || ubhāvapyabravīdetau vātsalyāccadraśekharaḥ|| 21 || || śrīśiva uvāca || || vatsau yuvāṃ na jñātvaivaṃ bhūyo bhavatamuddhatau || guruṃ smarato māmeva jāgrataṃ sṛṣṭirakṣayoḥ || 22 || iha pradeśe yuvayoryanmayānugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ || puṇyakṣetramidaṃ puṃsāṃ tato mokṣāya kalpatām || 23 || yojanatrayamātre'sminkṣetre nivasatāṃ nṛṇām || dīkṣādikaṃ vināpyastu matsāyujyaṃ mamājñayā || 24 || yadvā tiraścāmapyatra sthāvarāṇāṃ ca dehinām || abuddhipūrvikā buddhirapavargasya jāyatām || 25 || nṛṇāṃ ca darśanāddūre kaivalyaṃ smaraṇena vā || astu vedāṃtavijñānaṃ na sādhyaṃ niṣprayāsataḥ || 26 || śubhāya taijasī mūrtiḥ sthāvarā mama śāśvatī || aruṇādririti khyātā nityamevātra varttatām || 27 || yugātyayepi nainaṃ tu majjayeyurmahābdhayaḥ || na cālayeyurmaruto na daheyuśca vahnayaḥ || 28 || jyotirmayamidaṃ liṃgaṃ jyotiḥṣvapi na jātucit|| kramaṃtā nirgamāgatyā khecarāṇi samaṃtataḥ|| 29|| yasyānugrahamicchāmi jaṃtotasyātra saṃbhavaḥ|| dehāṃte kalpatāṃ muktyai vinaupaniṣadīrgiraḥ|| 1.3.2.16.30|| eṣa dūrātpraṇāmena nikarṣācca pradakṣiṇāt|| api pāpātmanāṃ puṃsāmastu niśreyasapradaḥ || 31 || atraiva niyataṃ vāsāḥ saṃbhavaṃti mahātmanām || tasmātsthalamidaṃ hitvā na gaṃtavyaṃ kadācana || 32 || śoṇācalamanādṛtya kvacitsthitvāpi muktaye || tasmādyuvāṃ vidhiharī vasataṃ cātra nityaśaḥ || 33 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || ityuktavaṃtaṃ kāmāriṃ praṇamya vidhimādhavau || tau vyajñāpayatāṃ devaṃ dūrībhavadahaṃkriyau || 34 || || vidhimādhavāvūcatuḥ || || evametajjagadādhāra jagadādhāratāṃ gataḥ || āstāṃ girirasau kiṃ tu tejo hyasya sudussaham || 35 || atoyamuttamo rudra tejaḥ sāmānyaśailavat || tiṣṭhatvabhedyamahimā niśreyasamahākhaniḥ || 36 || vivṛṇoti nijaṃ jyotirviśvasyāsya samṛddhaye || pratyabdaṃ kārttike māsi kṛttikāsu dinātyaye || 37 || śarmadopi nṛṇāṃ deva śoṇādristava śāsanāt || mahattvādarcituṃ śakyo na syādbhaktasya kasyacit||38|| etasyopatyakāyāṃ tadadyārabhyāsmadarthanāt|| devena sannidhātavyamavanyāṃ liṃgarūpiṇā||39|| taccāruṇagirīśānamāvāmārādhayāvahe|| abhiṣekānulepādyairupacārairyathāvidhi ||1.3.2.16.40|| saṃtyatra keśarāścūtā nāgapuṃnāgakesarāḥ|| āragvadhāḥ kurabakā mālūrāḥ pāṭalā api || 41 || atraiva sannidhātavyaṃ devadeva dayānidhe || yatastvadbhaktidārḍhyaṃ nau bhavatāttvadupāsanāt||42|| nānyathā cittaśuddhirnnau deve'pyevaṃ praseduṣi || anādyavidyāvṛtaye yo bhaviṣyati nityaśaḥ || 43 || śoṇādreḥ pūrvadigbhāge sa eṣa bhṛśamunnataḥ || sa evālaṃ nivāsāya devasya hṛdayaṃgamaḥ ||||44|| sāṃgavedā dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇāni śivāgamāḥ || kṛtvā ca sakalāḥ proktā bhavataiva bhavāvayoḥ ||45|| niśreyasāya bhaktānāṃ tvayaiva gururūpiṇā|| aṣṭāviṃśatirākhyātā āgamāḥ śaivasaṃjñitāḥ || 46 || teṣu kasya prakāreṇa kurvāṇau tvadupāsanām || kadāpyajñānajāmārtiṃ nādhigacchāva śaṃkara || 47 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || iti tau dhātṛgoviṃdau pādapadmāvalaṃbinau || jagāda karuṇāmūrttirjagatībhṛtsutāpatiḥ || 48 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || yuktamuktamidaṃ bhadrau mayāpyevaṃ manīṣitam || kāmikoktena mārgeṇa māmarcayitumarhathaḥ || 49 || mohato vismṛtā manye bhavadbhyāṃ śaivasaṃhitā || adhunā matprasādena punarudbhāsatāṃ hṛdi || 1.3.2.16.50 || || nandīśa uvāca || || ityuktvā śrīśavāgīśau giriśo'ntaradhādatha || tadā prādurabhūttatra liṃgaṃ kimapi maṃgalam || 51 || taccāvalokya sāścaryyau mukundakamalāsanau || muhuḥ praṇamya sānaṃdaṃ prārcya tuṣṭuvatuściram || 52 || tāvakārayatāṃ śoṇagirināthasya cālayam || nānāśilpādbhutaṃ viśvakarmaṇā pracayena ca || 53 || khānayāmāsatustatra saraḥ kimapi pāvanam || abhiṣekāya devasya sarvatīrthamayaṃ navam || 54 || aruṇākhyaṃ puraṃ cārātkalpayāmāsatuściram || siddhyai notkaṃṭhate labdhvā kailāsāyāpi dhūrjaṭiḥ ||55|| tasyāṃ brahmarṣayo devā gaṃdharvā divyayoṣitaḥ || siddhavidyādharā yakṣāḥ pauratvaṃ samupāyayuḥ || 56 || tīrthāni dhārya kūpatvaṃ gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || naṃdanādīni ca vanānyabhavanniṣkuṭatvataḥ ||57|| goloko gogoṣṭhatayā naigamatvaṃ kilāgamāḥ || śailāśca gopurāditvaṃ smṛtayo vidhitāṃ yayuḥ ||58|| bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca vetālāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ || prapannā mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ tasyāṃ kila pṛthagjanāḥ || 59 || devopi dhūrjaṭistasyāṃ kautukī siddharūpadhṛk || yogitvaṃ samupāsthāya mātrākaupīnamuṇḍadhṛk ||1.3.2.16.60|| na kenacidavijñātaḥ sadā sarvatra dīpyati || tau ca keśavalokeśau jaṭilau bhasmaguṇṭhitau ||61|| dāṃtau śoṇādrināthaṃ tamarcayāmāsatuściram || tatratyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmānuguṇyataḥ || 62 || dīkṣādikāni cakrāte svayamācāryatāṃ gatau || krameṇa hṛtanirmālyau sarvāgamarahovidau || 63 || prātaḥ snātvā samāhṛtya puṣpapatrādikaṃ phalam || maṃtraṃ cāruṇanāthasya tata eva rahaḥ śrutam || 64 || jaṃjalpākau jajapatuḥ sarvamaṃtrādhikaṃ sadā || dhūpapradīpanaivedyairgītavāditranartanaiḥ || 65 || pradakṣiṇānamaskārairmudrābaṃdhairnavairnavaiḥ || āsanena ca mūrttyā ca mūlena ca yathāvidhi || 66 || paṃcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgādyairarcayāmāsatuḥ śivam || evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi ṣoḍaśāruṇaśaṃkaram || 67 || vedhoviṣṇū samārādhya śivajñānamavāpatuḥ || 68 || itīdamaśrāvi mayā rahasyaṃ pituḥ śilādasya mukhātpurā yat || niveditaṃ cādya tadeva tubhyaṃ kimanyadākarṇayituṃ manīṣā || 69 || || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe brahmaviṣṇukṛtāruṇācaleśa maṃdiravarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.17>
|| sūta uvāca || || iti śrutvāsya vacanaṃ mārkaṃḍeyo'bhyabhāṣata || || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || śrutameva mayā deva śrotavyaṃ bhavato mukhāt || 1 || tathāpi kautukenāhamākrāṃto munayo'pyamī || gauryā kathaṃ tapastaptaṃ mahādevyātra kathyatām || 2 || || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || kathayāmi tadapyetadyathā'dhigatamātmanā || śṛṇu tvamavadhānena mārkaṃḍeya mahāmate || 3 || nanu jānāsi tatpūrvaṃ yathā dākṣāyaṇī śivaḥ || upayeme satīṃ nāma satīnāmadhidevatām || 4 || yathā ca sā krudhā bharturdruhi dakṣaprajāpatau || yogādahāsīdātmīyaṃ vapurityapi te śrutam || 5 || tadā harājñānighnena vīrabhadreṇa yatkṛtam || adhvaradhvaṃsanaṃ dakṣasyāpi te viditaṃ mahat || 6 || aśrauṣīstasya dakṣasya gaṇaiḥ śīrṣāsakhaṃḍanam || brahmācyuteṃdramukhyānāṃ devānāmapi śikṣaṇam || 7 || daṃtaghātaṃ raveḥ pāṇipāṭanaṃ jātavedasaḥ || aditiprabhṛtīnāṃ ca divyastrīṇāṃ parābhavam|| || 8 || sā ca devī punarjanma lebhe himavato gṛhe || umeti pārvatītyākhyāṃ dvitīyāṃ vibhratī punaḥ || 9 || devaḥ sthāṇuvane tāṃ ca paricaryāparaṃ rahaḥ || arurocayiṣuḥ kāmamadhākṣītkālavahninā || 1.3.2.17.10 || jiteṃdriyaṃ ca taṃ devaṃ kvāpi yātaṃ gaṇaiḥ saha || tapobhistoṣayāmāsa gaurī śikharavāsinī || 11 || upayamyātha tāṃ devo vṛttāṃtaiścittakhaṃḍibhiḥ || ramayāmāsa caikāṃte modasveti vilāsinīm || 12 || vaidhavyakhinnayā ratyā prārthitā śailanaṃdinī || kāmapīṭhe tapasyaṃtī kāmaṃ pratyudadīpayat || 13 || punaśca menayā mātrā pitrā ca himabhūbhṛtā || ānītā bhavanaṃ bhartrā sākaṃ ciramaraṃsta sā || 14 || tadā śuṃbhaniśuṃbhākhyau lebhāte vedhaso varam || devadānavamartyeṣu māstu nau puruṣānmṛtiḥ || 15 || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jātatrāsaiḥ suparvabhiḥ || abhyarthito'vadaddevo rahaścakradharādibhiḥ || 16 || mābhaiṣṭa bhadra kālena tathā pratividhīyate || yathā niṣūditau syātāṃ tādṛśau dānavāviti || 17 || dattābhayānmukuṃdādīnvisṛjyāṃdhakasūdanaḥ || aṃtaḥpuragato reme devyā saha yathā purā || 18 || kadācinmarmalakṣyeṇa prītyā kālīti niṃditā || tasya prītyai kālikā ca tvacamevājahānnijām || 19 || yatrotkṣiptavatī carma svecchayā parameśvarī || mahākāśīprapātākhyaṃ tadabhūtkṣetramuttamam || 1.3.2.17.20 || sā ca tvakkauśikī nāmnā kālī viṃdhyādrivāsinī || tapasyaṃtī vṛṣasyaṃtau to jaghāna mahāsurau || 21 || devī ca gaurī śikhare tasminneva manohare || tapobhirlabdhagaurītvādbharttāraṃ samatoṣayat || 22 || krameṇa daurhṛdavatī bhūtvā prāsūta pārvatī || gajānanaṃ ca heraṃbaṃ senānyaṃ ca ṣaḍānanam || 23 || tau cāgamavidaḥ prāhurnārāyaṇacaturmukhau || pūrvāparādhaśuddhyarthaṃ devīgarbhasamudbhavau || 24 || vardhamānau ca tau bālau pitrorālokamānayoḥ || magnayoriva varṣābdhau premagraṃthirabhūddṛḍhā || 25 || jātu vīṇāninādena kadāciccitralekhanaiḥ || vijahratuśśivau svairamekadā maṃḍanairmithaḥ || 26 || jātu vidyāgamālāpaiḥ kadāciccitravastubhiḥ || ekadā lokavṛttāṃtairdaṃpatibhyāṃ vinoditam || 27 || puṣpāvacayanairjātu kadācidvārikhelanaiḥ || adīvyatāṃ ca rāgārdrau dolākelibhirekadā || 28 || mainākenārcitau jātu menayā jātu pūjitau || jātvarhitau himavatā daṃpatī tau vinoditau ||29|| jātu dyūtavinodena gatigoṣṭhyā kadācana || ekadā dānalīlābhiḥ śivau cikrīḍatuściram || 1.3.2.17.30 || dyūtanirjitamācchidya patyurutsaṃgatāṃ gatam || valayīkṛtameṇāṃkaṃ tāṭaṃkīkṛtavatyumā || 31 || iti tau pitarau carācarāṇāṃ nivasaṃtau kanakācalādikeṣu || rucireṣu padeṣu kāmabhogānatihṛdyānsuciraṃ kilānvabhūtām || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe śivapārvatīvihāravarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.18>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || gārhasthyaṃ bibhratī bharturekāmratalavāsinaḥ || pakvānnapānaissā tatra paryyatarpayata prajāḥ || 1 || jātu saṃdhyānusaṃdhānamukulīkṛtalocanam || baddhāṃjalipuṭaṃ devamadrākṣīdadrinaṃdinī || 2 || dhyāyate nūnamadhunā kāpi saubhāgyaśālinī || kriyate yanmayi prema tanmanye vacanaṃ mahat || 3 || kathaṃ vijñāyate puṃsāṃ kuṭilā mānasī sthitiḥ || mithyopacārāddakṣeṇa vaṃcitāsmyamunā bhṛśam || 4 || mayi dākṣiṇyamevāsya manye manasi cedrahaḥ || janaḥ saubhāgyavānyasmādbhavati snehabhājanam || 5 || adyaprabhṛti te dāsastapobhiḥ krīta ityapi || mugdheṃduśekhareṇāsmi vipralabdhā smarāriṇā || 6 || asamānānurāgeṣu nārīṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām || saubhāgyagarvo lokeṣu parihāsāya kevalam || 7 || iti praṇayaroṣeṇa devyāḥ kaluṣacetasaḥ || havyavāhātapālīḍhamivānanamalakṣyata || 8 || vāṣpavāriplave tasyā ātāmre ca vilocane || nīlotpale jalāpūrṇe iva bhūmnā virejatuḥ || 9 || yattasyādhīnatilakaṃ bhruvoryugamabhajyata || dvedhākṛtamivādarśi manmathasya śarāsanam|| 1.3.2.18.10 || aṃtarmanyubhareṇāsyāḥ kaṃpate smādharacchadaḥ || muhuḥ pravālasthāyīva raktāśokasya pallavaḥ ||11|| atīva rajyamāne tatpārvatyā gaṃḍamaṃḍalam || śāṇāvagharṣamāṇikyadarpaṇapratimaṃ babhau || 12 || aṃtarvepadhutau tasyāścakaṃpāte payodharau || padmakośāvivāṃtaḥstha caṃcarīkapracālitau || 13 || aciṃtayacca saṃbhūya saubhāgyābhāvato nanu || mamāyamanyastrīciṃtāṃ kurute caṃdrabhūṣaṇaḥ || 14 || tadaiṣā kvāpi yāsyāmi kimatrāstyekayā mama || tapasyate ca saubhāgyamarjanīyaṃ mayādhunā || 15 || nimīlitākṣiṇyevāsya gaṃtavyaṃ nibhṛtaṃ mayā || na cenmāṃ vārayatyeṣa kaṃṭhādupari bhāṣitaiḥ || 16 || vatsau tu vardhayatyeva gaṃgeyamativatsalā || devastu na smaratyeva māmanyastrīparāyaṇaḥ || 17 || iti niścitya devasya pārśvādāśu nivṛttya sā || anirdiśya diśaṃ kāṃcidyātuṃ vyagrā pracakrame || 18 || calāvatī mālyavatī mālinī vijayā jayā || vāritā api saṃraṃbhātsvāminīmanvayuḥ svayam || 19 || tatra sāpi girīnpuṇyānvanāni nagarāṇi ca || sarāṃsi saritaścaiṣā vicacāra samaṃtataḥ || 1.3.2.18.20 || bhramaṃtī sahyapādeṣu drāviḍākhye sunīvṛti || tīrtvā śaktyāpagāṃ devī vijayāṃ samabhāṣata || 21 || dṛśyo'yaṃ nātidūreṇa purastātsakalāruṇaḥ || śṛṃgaissaṃlakṣyate'ṣṭābhirnūnaṃ māhātmyavāngiriḥ || 22 || upatyakāsu caitasya dṛśyaṃte tāpasāśramāḥ || atīva pāvanāḥ śāṃtāḥ puṇyāraṇyamanoharāḥ || 23 || gatvā nirūpayāmastānimānpuṇyāśramānvayam || prasīdatitarāṃ ceta eṣāṃ saṃdarśanena me || 24 || evamāhrādayatyāli krameṇa girinaṃdinī || tasyādrerjagmuṣī pārśvamapaśyatkaṃcidāśramam || 25 || lūtāstaṃtūnnayaṃtyatra kumbhīrāḥ śaivalānyapi || śiśūnpuṣṇaṃti nīvāraiḥ sapharānbhūrimāyavaḥ || 26 || haraṃtyavakarānvālaiścamarāḥ sphītaromabhiḥ || samīkurvaṃti codbhūtairviṣāṇairyatra sairibhāḥ || 27 || vānarāḥ phalapuṣpāṇi madhupatrāṇi bhallukāḥ || kroḍāḥ snānīyamṛtsnāṃ ca yatrarṣibhyo nayaṃtyaho || 28 || kākolūkaiḥ śukaśyenairmṛgavyāghrairharidvipaiḥ || kalāpisarpairyatrāsumārjāraiḥ sauhṛdaṃ śritam || 29 || hūyamānapurāḍāśadravyasaurabhyahāriṇī || yatra drumāṃtarālebhyo dhūmyā niryāti pāvanī || 1.3.2.18.30 || paṭhaṃti śatarudrīyaṃ yatra vāyasavairiṇaḥ || gṛṇaṃti kākāḥ stotrāṇi sāma gāyaṃti sārikāḥ || 31 || śākaśāliṣu śārdūlāścaraṃti ca tathaiva gāḥ || siṃcaṃti puṣkarāṃbhobhiḥ kuṃbhinī yatra pādapān || || 32 || kvacicca śobhane deśe puṇye puṇyamanohare || dadarśa sā tapasyantaṃ yaṃ kaṃciddṛṣisattamam || 33 || adhastātsaptaparṇasya citravyāghratvagāsane || baddhavīrāsanaṃ samyakpāvane kuśaviṣṭare || 34 || śāliśūkāruṇābhābhirjaṭābhirbhasmapāṃḍuram || acaṃcalābhirvidyudbhiriva śāradavāridam || 35 || nāsāgraniścaladṛśaṃ samaprasphuritādharam || āvarttayantaṃ rudrākṣamālikāmagrapāṇinā || 36 || pratyagranirṇejanato hyaṃtyaśyānadaśāṃcale || vasānaṃ valkalayuge saṃdhyābhre bhūbhṛtāṃ yathā || 37 || ṣaḍvargahiṃsrabaṃdhāya sthāpitāṃ vāgurāmiva || upavītatrayīmārādurogartasya bibhratam || kṛtocitopacārā sā tamaprākṣīttapodhanam || 38 || || pārvatyuvāca || || kastvaṃ ko'yaṃ girivaro yatra tvaṃ kuruṣe tapaḥ || 39 || sa cāhāruṇaśailo'yaṃ puṇyakṣetreṣu pūjitaḥ|| gautamo'haṃ munirmuktyai tapasārādhaye śivam || 1.3.2.18.40 || ityuktvā vijayādīnāṃ mukhenaināmumāṃ vidan || praṇamya bhaktyā bahuśo nītavānuṭajaṃ nijam || 41 || kandamūlaphalādyaiśca kṛtātithyāmimāṃ muniḥ || jaganmaṃgalamūlāya tapase cānvamanyata || 42 || jyotiḥstambhasya saṃbhūtimārabhyānukrameṇa saḥ || jagāda cāsyai śoṇādrermahimānamaśeṣataḥ || 43 || śoṇādreḥ pūrvadigbhāge sthalīśvaramiti sthalam || yatra saṃnihitaḥ śaṃbhurjyotirliṃgātmatāṃ gataḥ || 44 || vaikuṇṭhaparameṣṭhyādi gīrvāṇa nibiḍīkṛte || na tatra me tapaḥ kartumavyākṣepeṇa śakyate || 45 || ayaṃ śoṇagireḥ pādaḥ pravālācalanāmavān|| puṇyāraṇyoparuddhatvādrahasyatvaṃ vigāhate || 46 || tata evāhamatraiva pratiṣṭhāpya trilocanam || ārādhaye yathāśakti tapobhiḥ kalpitātmabhiḥ || 47 || mamāśramasamīpe'sminpuṇyakṣetramidaṃ mahat || kriyatāmāśramo devyā karttavyaṃ hi tapaściram || 48 || munerevamanujñānātkṛtāśramaparigrahā || udayuṃkta tapaḥ karttuṃ sumahatparvatātmajā || 49 || āśramaṃ rakṣituṃ satyavatīṃ kānanavāsinīm || śubhagāṃ dhuṃdhumāriṃ ca prāgādyāśāsvatiṣṭhipat || 1.3.2.18.50 || tapovanasya sarvasya rakṣārthaṃ sā samādiśat || durgāmanargalasphūrtimājñānirvāhaṇakṣamām || || 51 || anaṃtaraṃ sā dhammillaṃ maṃdāraprasavocitam || jaṭābharatvaṃ tapase gamayāmāsa pārvatī || 52 || haṃsacihnadaśaṃ hitvā dukūlaṃ mihakālaghu || paruṣaṃ sukumārāṃgī paridhattesma valkalam || 53 || api prasūnāvacayanissahāṃgulipallavā || alāvīdatitīkṣṇāgrāṇyavikāraṃ kuśāni sā || 54 || vajrasūcinirbharāṃgairavacchinnāni kaṃṭakaiḥ || śirīṣamṛdvī śāṃḍilyapallavānyuccikāya yā || 55 || pāvanyāṃ kamalānadyāṃ prātarvihitamajjanā || arcayāmāsa raktābjairyathāvidhi vibhākaram || 56 || darbhākṣatatilonmiśrairgaurī śrīnadivāribhiḥ || devī nirvartayāmāsa devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam || 57 || vālukāmaṃḍale sūryamāvāhyābhyarcya paṃkajaiḥ || kṛtapradakṣiṇā gaurī praṇanāma sahasraśaḥ || 58 || svayameva pratiṣṭhāpya liṃgaṃ kimapi śaṃkaram || āgamoktena vidhinā pūjayāmāsa pārvatī || 59 || āsanena ca mūrtyā ca mūlenāṃgaiśca sā ravim || daṃḍipiṃgalamukhyāṃśca śaktīrdīptādikā api || 1.3.2.18.60 || tattaddikṣu ca somādīngrahāndhenvādimudrayā || tejaścaṃḍe cārcayitvā nirmālyaṃ ca nyavedayat || 61 || argheṇātīva śuddhena saṃprokṣya ca samaṃtataḥ || dvāravāstu samabhyarcya nyāsānapi cakāra sā || 62 || bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyānvagaṃtaryāgaṃ cakāra sā || hṛdi padmāsane cārcya jñānadharmādikānkramāt || || 63 || śaktīrdaleṣu vāmādīrdalāgre sūryavedhasau || kesarāgre somaviṣṇū karṇikāgre'gnidhūrjaṭī || 64 || tadūrdhve śakticakraṃ ca vinyastabrahmapaṃcakā || aṃgairdattvā ca pādyādīnupacaryābhiṣicya sā || 65 || prādāccaṃdanapuṣpādi dhūpadīpapradāyinī || bhūyopi paṃcabrahmāṇi ṣaḍaṃgānyapyapūjayat || 66 || tattaddikṣu ca śakrādīnvajrādīṃśca vidhānataḥ || kṛtvā sarvopacārāṃśca vitatārāṣṭapuṣpikām || 67 || paṃcavaktrāṇi cābhyarcya kṛtacaṃḍeśvarārcanā || pradakṣiṇā praṇāmādyairnityaṃ śivamapūjayat || 68 || śivāgamoktavidhinā dravyaiḥ saubhāgyadāyibhiḥ || sā juhāva ca pūjāṃte praṇīte jātavedasi || 69 || parikalpitopacārā ca kaṃdamūlaphalādikaiḥ || svayaṃ kṛtopacāreyamatithīnabhyapūjayat || 1.3.2.18.70 || aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tiṣṭhaṃtī grīṣye paṃcāgnimadhyataḥ || hrade ca śiśire caṃdrapīyūṣāpyāyitā'bhavat || 71 || varṣarātrīṣu dhārābhiḥ saha vāridharā punaḥ || saudāminīva dadṛśe tamasi stimitā kṛtiḥ || 72 || pāṇipādena padmāni mukhena ca kalānidhim || pradarśayatyanāyāsānninye sā haimanīrniśāḥ || 73 || nīvārabījadānena sā mṛgānapyapoṣayat || ajñātahiṃsābhibhavānāśramopāṃtavartinaḥ || 74 || kṛtālavālasalilaiḥ suvālākalaśāhṛtaiḥ || vātsalyādvarddhayāmāsa pūrṇānāśramapādapān|| 75 || pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtavatī śoṇaśailaṃ girīṃdrajā || sā manorathasaṃsiddhyai nityaṃ saha sakhījanaiḥ || 76 || paṃcākṣarī jajāpaiṣā śivastotrāṇyudairayat|| dadhyau ca devaṃ manasā śoṇaparvatarūpiṇam || 77 || anudinamaruṇācaleśvaraṃ sā praṇatavatī vihitapradakṣiṇādyaiḥ || śivanigamavidhānavedinī sā vyaracayadadrisutā ciraṃ tapasyām || 78 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe pārvatīkṛtāruṇācaleśvaraparicaraṇavarṇanaṃnāmā'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.19>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || tāvatkutaścidākarṇya tatrasthāṃ mahiṣāsuraḥ || avajñātasurārātirvidhvaṃsitapuraṃdaraḥ || 1 || sarvalokajayī siddhavidyādharabhayāvahaḥ || durnigraho varādāsīcchastrāstrairakhilairapi || 2 || tīkṣṇānāmapi śāpānāmapyagocaratāṃ gataḥ || darpadbhirdānavaidaityaiḥ kauṇapaiśca niṣevitaḥ || 3 || dūṣako munipatnīnāṃ dharmamārgopaghātakaḥ || balātpulomno namucervṛtrādapi balādhikaḥ || 4 || hiraṇyakaśiporvaśyo hiraṇyākṣa ivāparaḥ || tāṃ vilobhayituṃ kāṃcitprāhiṇotkila dūtikām|| 5 || tataḥ sā tāpasīveṣadhāriṇī girijāṃ prati || sakhīsamakṣa evedamuvācānucitaṃ vacaḥ || 6 || arāru bhīṣaṇe bhīro nivasasyatra kiṃ vane || vihartumucitā ramyeṣvavarodhanaveśmasu || 7 || kimarthaṃ vādya cittaṃ te yauvane bhoganiḥspṛham || niveśitaṃ tapasi ca daivatairapi duṣkare || 8 || haṃsatūlamayīṃ śayyāṃ muktāmayavitānikām || hitvā kimiti mṛdvaṃgi supyate paruṣāśmasu || 9 || tapojaḍo mṛḍo diṣṭyā prāgevāsti tvayojjhitaḥ || tavānurūpo naivānyo vidyate diviṣatsu ca || 1.3.2.19.10 || kiṃ tu trailokyanātho'sti mahiṣo dānaveśvaraḥ || yadi drakṣyasi taṃ subhra tyakṣyasyeva kṣaṇāttapaḥ || 11 || kiṃ nihnavena nanveṣa śrutvā sarvaṃ cirātprabhuḥ || sa prāhiṇodupānetuṃ dūtikāṃ māṃ smarāturaḥ || 12 || ityatyaṃtaviruddhaṃ tāṃ bruvāṇāmasamaṃjasam || devyāścittasthitiṃ jñātvā vijayā nirakāsayat || 13 || sā cātiroṣeṇa kṛtapratijñā daityarūpikā || gatvā viditavṛttāṃtamakaronmahiṣāsuram || 14 || so'pi tatsarvamākarṇya ruṣātīvāruṇekṣaṇaḥ || devīṃ jighṛkṣurabhyāgādvṛto daiteyakoṭibhiḥ || || 15 || syandanairdviradairaśvaiḥ pattibhiśca samaṃtataḥ || bhuvamācchādayāmāsa dhvajaiśca gaganāṃtaram || 16 || kṣvelitairvādyaghoṣaiśca nabhaḥ sphuṭadivābhavat || pādāghātaiśca daityānāṃ vidadre vasudhātalam || 17 || karālo durddharastasya vicaṣṇurvikarālakaḥ || bāṣkalo durmukhaścaṃḍaḥ pracaṃḍaścāmarāsuraḥ || 18 || mahāhanurmahāmaulirugrāsyo vikaṭekṣaṇaḥ || jvālāsyo dahanaśceme senānyopi pratasthire || 19 || kolāhalamimaṃ śrutvā devī niyamavighnataḥ || śaṃkitā daityasaṃhṛtyai durgāmādiśati sma sā || 1.3.2.19.20 || sāruṇādrirahodroṇyāmadhirūḍhā mṛgādhipam || dīptāyudhadharairdorbhiḥ kālikeva mahīṃ gatā || 21 || ghanāghanaravodagraṃ siṃhanādamacīkarat || sphuraddaṃtacchadopāṃtaṃ valgadaṃgulipallavā || 22 || svāṃgebhyo yoginīcakraṃ mātaro'pyasṛjanruṣā || devyāḥ priyāya daiteyasaṃhārārhāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 23 || kāścittatrāruṇacchāyā daṃḍinyo haṃsavāhanāḥ || mukhaiścaturbhirājagmuḥ kopaprasphuritādharaiḥ || || 24 || niryayuḥ kāścana kruddhā jvalattriśikhapāṇayaḥ || nisvanadbhūṣaṇāḥ paṃsallalāṭā vṛṣavāhanāḥ || 25 || nirjagmuraparāḥ senāsahitāḥ śikhivāhanaiḥ || śaktidaṃḍābhayakarāḥ śataśaḥ ṣaḍbhirānanaiḥ || 26 || niścakramuḥ parāstārkṣyamadhiruhyādhikakrudhā || śaṃkhacakradharāḥ sūryacaṃdramobhyāṃ divo yathā || || 27 || pratiṣṭhaṃte tathā vyāghravāhāḥ kuvalayatviṣaḥ || potraiḥ sadghargharārāvairbibhratyo musalaṃ halam || 28 || roṣāruṇasahasrākṣyo valakṣadvipavāhanāḥ || pratasthire śātakoṭiśatakoṭidharāḥ parāḥ || 29 || aśvārūḍhā samāpeturekāḥ saudāminīnibhāḥ || khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇyaḥ kopena kapilānanāḥ || || 1.3.2.19.30 || tāśca koṭicatuḥṣaṣṭimasurānāśramādbahiḥ || arundhanprasabhaṃ dhvāṃtarāśīniva ravestviṣaḥ || 31 || tataśca yoginīcakradānavānīkayormithaḥ || prāvarttata raṇaṃ ghoraṃ muṣṭāmuṣṭi kacākaci || 32 || sāyakairyoginīmuktairdalitā daityamaulayaḥ || ācchādayanmahīpṛṣṭhaṃ sthalajānīva sarvataḥ || 33 || prasasrū raktasarito lagatkaiśikaśaivalāḥ || luṭhadvipāṭhapāṭhīnāḥ smarairdevīmukhāṃbujaiḥ || 34 || vetaṇḍatuṇḍānyāruhya saudhāniva piśācikāḥ || pracaṇḍa tāṃḍavāḥ pītaraktamadyāścakāśire || 35 || kapālairdaityavīrāṇāmaghāsurasṛgāsavān || krīḍaḍḍamarukākārairḍāmarairyoginīgaṇāḥ || 36 || parijahrustathāṃtrāṇi kaṃkaughāḥ pāśaśaṃkayā || kṣudhitā api māṃsāni saśalyānyajahuḥ śivāḥ || 37 || siddhavidyādharonmuktamaṃdāraprasavāsavaiḥ || iyāya śāṃtiṃ bhūreṇuḥ saṃgrāme kṣobhasambhavaḥ || 38 || virejuryoginīmuktairdehalagnairdviṣāṃ hayāḥ || amarṣātiśayotkṣiptaiḥ śalyaiḥ śalyamṛgā iva || 39 || daṃḍaiḥ kecitpare śūlairniśitaiḥ ke'pi śaktibhiḥ || cakrairanye halaireke katicicchatakoṭibhiḥ || 1.3.2.19.40 || yoginīnāṃ pare khaḍgairdalitā dānaveśvarāḥ || niḥśeṣatāmupājagmurvinā senādhipānnijān|| 41 || brāhmī svayamupāgamya vihitāyodhanāvadhīt || karālaṃ vikarālena daṇḍena jvalitā cirāt || 42 || māheśvarī triśūlena suciraṃ kṛtasaṃgarā || cakarta durddharasyāśu mūrddhānamatiroṣaṇā || 43 || śaktyā lulāva kaumārī cikṣurāsuramastakam || cakreṇa cālunānmauliṃ vikarālasya vaiṣṇavī || 44 || bāṣkalasyāśu vārāhī musalenālunācchiraḥ || durmukhaṃ cāśu vajreṇa vyadhādaiṃdrī gatāyuṣam || 45 || khyātaṃ yasyāśca nāmedaṃ tayoreva nidūṣanāt || cāmuṇḍā caṇḍamuṇḍau ca maṇḍalāgreṇa cicchide || 46 || pracaṇḍacāmarau vīrau mahāmauliṃ mahāhanum || ugrāsyavikaṭākṣau ca jvālāsyadahanāvapi || 47 || anujagmuḥ krudhā yāntaṃ yuddhāya mahiṣāsuram || kālanemiprabhṛtayo vipracittimivāsurāḥ || 48 || śirastravaṃto rathinaḥ suniṣaṃgā dhanurdharāḥ || udbhūtakaṭakāḥ prāpuryuddhabhūmiṃ caladdhvajāḥ || 49 || samaṃtātpūritadiśaḥ siṃhanādairbhayaṃkaraiḥ || pṛṣatkavarṣiṇo mātṛmaṃḍalānyabhidudruvuḥ || 1.3.2.19.50 || tāśca tairbalibhiḥ kṛtvā saṃgrāmaṃ nissahatvataḥ || durgāṃ prapedire devīṃ śaraṇaṃ siṃhavāhanām || 51 || uktvā māyālulāyasya durjayatvaṃ durātmanaḥ || devī tāṃ tuṣṭuvurdurgāmevaṃ saptāpi mātaraḥ || 52 || yoganidreti rūpeṇa viṣṇornayanapadmayoḥ || tvayā nilīyate devi madhukāryeva līlayā || 53 || amūmuhastaṃ na tathā mātaśca madhukaiṭabhau || kathaṃ jaghāna tau viṣṇustayorevābhyanujñayā || 54 || tvaṃ kauśikī na cejjātā mṛtyuḥ śuṃbhaniśaṃbhayoḥ || kathaṃ tu lokapālānāmaiśvaryaṃ devi eṣyati || 55 || viṃdhyavāsini viṃdhyena kimavaṃdhyaṃ kṛtaṃ tapaḥ || yatra maitrī kirātībhirapi labhyā tvayā samam || 56 || kāpiśāyanamāpītaṃ dhanadopāyanīkṛtam || tvayāṃba nītaṃ daityānāṃ rasairniyatamānavaiḥ || 57 || brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭiśaktistvaṃ sthitiśaktirmadhudviṣaḥ || aṃba saṃhāraśaktiśca rudrasyāpi pragalbhase || 58 || yaśodānaṃdajātā tvamekānaṃśeti nāmataḥ || kaṃsādyasurasaṃhāre hareḥ sāhyaṃ kariṣyasi || 59 || tvaṃ vidyā tvaṃ mahāmāyā tvaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ sarasvatī || tvaṃ devī pārvatīśāpi durge kiṃ vā na jāyase || 1.3.2.19.60 || || nandikeśvara uvāca || || stotreṇānena mātṛbhyo durgā dattābhayā svayam || mahiṣāsurayuddhāya saṃtuṣṭā niryayau tadā || 61 || pracaṃḍamaṃḍalāgreṇa bhiṃḍipālena cāmaram || mahāmauliṃ kṣurikayā karpareṇa mahāhanum || 62 || ugravaktraṃ kuṭhāreṇa śaktyā vikaṭacakṣuṣam || jvālāmukhaṃ mudgareṇa dahanaṃ musalena ca || 63 || nihatya mahiṣasyāgre saroṣaṃ yudhyatī svayam || siṃhanādaṃ mahāghoraṃ cakreṇa muditāśayā || 64 || athātyamarṣito durgāṃ viśikhairmahiṣāsuraḥ || vivyādha phālaphalake stanayorgaḍayorapi || 65 || tato durgātha saṃraṃbhātprajahārāsureśvaram || bāhvorvakṣasi vaktre ca kṣurapraiḥ prajvalatphalaiḥ ||66|| tato daityastribhirdurgāṃ jaghāna viśikhairmukhe || paṃcabhiḥ paṃcabhirbāhvordvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ca netrayoḥ || 67 || ekena sārathiṃ rathyānaṣṭabhiḥ kārmukaṃ tribhiḥ|| caturbhiśca dhvajaṃ tasya durgā ciccheda sāyakaiḥ || 68 || padātiratha daityeṃdraḥ śataghnīṃ jvaladākṛtim || kāladaṃḍapratīkāśāṃ durgāṃ prati vimuktavān || 69|| hāhākurvastu deveṣu vidrāṇe mātṛmaṃḍale || tāmāpataṃtīmādāya durgā jagrāha līlayā ||1.3.2.19.70 || kṛpāṇamaṃkuśaṃ pāśaṃ bhuśuṃḍīṃ karavālikām || śaṃkuṃ śaktiṃ gadāṃ cakraṃ tomaraṃ phalakaṃ sṛṇim || 71 || paraśvadhaṃ bhiṃḍipālaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ laguḍaṃ ca saḥ || durgāṃ prati vicikṣepa kṣayāṃbhoda ivāśanim || 72 || āpataṃtyeva śastrāṇi kṣiptānyādāya vairiṇām|| babhaṃja pāṇibhiḥ svairaṃ kariṇīvekṣukāṃḍakam||73|| durgopavāhyaḥ siṃho'pi lāṃgūlāgreṇa mudritam || daṃṣṭrayā dārayāmāsa praharannakhapaṃkajaiḥ || 74 || kṣaṇaṃ siṃhaḥ kṣaṇaṃ kroḍaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vyāghraḥ kṣaṇaṃ gajaḥ || kṣaṇaṃ ca mahiṣo bhūtvā daityo durgāmayodhayat || 75 || mahiṣo'tha viṣāṇābhyāṃ tīkṣṇābhyāmatyamarṣitaḥ || tāḍayāmāsa siṃhaṃ ca devīmapi muhurmuhuḥ || 76 || kṣaṇaṃ gaganamadhyasthaḥ kṣaṇaṃ prāpto mahītale || kṣaṇaṃ dikṣu bhramanprāptaḥ kṣaṇaṃ cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||77|| prārthitā mātṛcakreṇa durgā mahiṣadānavam || amoghena triśūlena dārayāmāsa sasmitā || 78 || muktaghargharanirghoṣo yāvatpatati dānavaḥ || tāvadasya haṭhenāṃghriṃ skaṃdhapīṭhe nyaveśayat || 79 || kaṃṭhapīḍanato yātajīvitasyāmaradruhaḥ || chinnamūrddhānamādāya pāṇinātha nanartta sā || 1.3.2.19.80 || iti durgayā samiti kāsarāsure dalite samastabhuvanaikakaṃṭake || nanṛtuḥ surāḥ prajahṛṣurmaharṣayo vavṛṣuśca divyakumumāni vāridāḥ || 81 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmyauttarārdhe devyāstapaścaryāyāṃ durgākṛtamahiṣāsuravadhavarṇananāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || cha ||
<1.3.2.20>
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || aho mahiṣadaityasya durācāratvamīdṛśam || aho duritahāriṇyā durgāyāśca parākramaḥ || 1 || evaṃ tayā bhadrakālyā nihate mahiṣāsure || kiṃ cakāra girīṃdrasya naṃdinī tapasi sthitā|| 2 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || anaṃtaraṃ sā hastena dadhatī daityamastakam || nanāma gaurīmanyena pāṇinā khaṅgadhāriṇā || 3 || atha harṣeṇa nṛtyaṃtīṃ tāmālokya dayārdrayā || dṛṣṭyā devī jagādaināṃ daṃtāṃśudyotitāṃbarā || 4 || tvayātiduṣkaraṃ karma nirmitaṃ viṃdhyavāsini || jātaṃ tava prabhāvena niṣpratyūhaṃ ca me tapaḥ || 5 || athaitanmāhiṣaṃ śīrṣamapavitra bhayaṃkaram || jagatpavitracāritre tyaktumarhasi hastataḥ || 6 || iti gauryoditā durgā jugupsākulamānasā || mūrdhnastasya nipātāya vyadhunodbahuśaḥ karam || 7 || tīrthamutpādyatāṃ devi navaṃ pāpavināśanam || tasminnimajjanāddurge prāyaścittaṃ bhaviṣyati || 8 || itīritā gautamena durgā duritaśaṃkinī || pāṭayāmāsa khaṅgena śilāpaṭṭaṃ paṭīyasā || 9 || pātālāvadhi nirbhinnātpāṣāṇatalatastataḥ || udajṛṃbhattaraṃgāṃbhaḥ saccittamiva nirmalam || 1.3.2.20.10 || mamajja sāpi gaṃbhīre tasminnaṃbhasi pāvane || namaḥ śoṇādrināthāyetyuktvā maṃtramanuttamam || 11 || tāvanmahiṣakaṃṭhasthaṃ liṃgaṃ tadgalitaṃ tale || taṭe pratiṣṭhitaṃ jātaṃ pāpanāśanasaṃjñayā || 12 || unmamajja tato durgā tīrthāṃbhodhūtakalmaṣā || nipapātātha tatpāṇermahiṣāsuramastakam || 13 || kṛtapradakṣiṇā natvā pāpanāśanamīśvaram || purastādasti sā gauryā gautamenābhinaṃditā||14|| evaṃ pratyakṣaniratapāpāṃ tāṃ vīkṣya pārvatī|| jagāda dīrghatapasaṃ jagatīdharanaṃdinī||15|| mahiṣāsurasaṃhāreṃ'jasā svanumatiḥ kṛtā || viṃdhyavāsinīyamaho duṣṭamāhiṣavigraham || 16 || gṛhītvā bhakṣayāmāsa tasya liṃgamidaṃ śivam || prāyaścittaṃ tato brūhi mamāpi munisattama ||17 || || gautama uvāca || || devi sarvajagatsargasthitisaṃhārakāriṇi || tvaddhyānameva jagatāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || || 18 || athāpi laukikaṃ vṛttamavalaṃbya tvayeritam || svakṛtāpi hi maryādā na mahadbhirvilaṃghyate || 19 || antaḥkaraṇakāluṣyakṣālinī kācana kriyā || kathyate'dya mayā mātaravadhānaṃ vidhīyatām || 1.3.2.20.20 || aruṇādrirayaṃ sākṣādanalādristirohitaḥ || jvalatijyotiṣā svena kṛttikāpūrṇimā niśi || 21 || tatsaparyātapaścaryā kāryā kātyāyani tvayā || tajjyotirdarśanātsarvamabhīṣṭaṃ tava sidhyati || 22 || ityuktā gautamenāṃbā tadāprabhṛti dāruṇā || iyaṃ ca śivabhaktā hi śivapūjāratā tadā || 23 || tapaścacāra paṃcānāmagnīnāṃ madhyamāśritā || caturṇāṃ śikhināṃ madhye sthitā sūryaniviṣṭadṛk || 24 || reje haimī śalākeva dyotamānā girīṃdrajā || athākṛṣṭevapārvatyāḥ premapāśairnirāyataiḥ || 25 || sā kārttikī paurṇamāsī samāpede śubhā tithiḥ || tatastasya dinasyāṃte śṛṃge śoṇamahībhṛtaḥ || 26 || adarśi kimapi jyotiranupādhikavaibhavam || tadarthopagatairbrahmamadhubhidvāsavādibhiḥ || 27 || upāsyamānamabhito devairdivyarṣisaṃgataiḥ || tadaniṃdhanamasnehamadaśāvartisaṃbhavam || 28 || mahāpradīpamālokya vismayaṃ prāpa pārvatī || kṛtapradakṣiṇā sātha praṇamaṃtī padepade || aruṇādrīśvaraṃ nāthaṃ tuṣṭā tuṣṭāva śailajā || 29 || namaste merucāpāya kailāsācalavāsine || nīhāraśailajāmātre śoṇakṣmādhararūpiṇe || 1.3.2.20.30 || varuṇādisurārcyāya taruṇādityavarcase || aruṇācalanāthāya karuṇāmūrttaye namaḥ || || 31 || jaya jahnusutācandra lekhālaṃkṛtaśekhara || sauṃdaryamohitāśeṣamunipatnījanāśaya || 32 || jaya śailasutāsaṃgasaṃbhṛtānaṃgavaibhava || māyā nārāyaṇābhogakrīḍāmreḍanapaṃḍita || 33 || jaya saṃdhyāsamopetasaṃbhṛtānaṃdatāṃḍava || jaya gīrvāṇagaṃdharvasiddhavidyādharārcita || 34 || jaya heraṃbajanaka jaya ṣaṇmukhavatsala || jaya haimavatīprārthya jaya pārthivadurlabha || 35 || iti stutvā muhustasmiñjyotiṣi nyastalocanām || dṛṣṭvā devīṃ dayāvyājādvililye vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 36 || layitvā nijamāsthāya rūpamutkaṭasundaram || āsthāya vṛṣabhaṃ divyamamūṃ dṛṣṭvā śivāṃ śubhām || 37 || mānātirekādapahāya sarvamaiśvaryamevaṃ tapasi pravṛttām || mugdhāṃ punaḥ sāṃtvayituṃ girīśaḥ pracakrame parvatarājaputrīm || 38 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe pārvatīkṛtāruṇācaleśvarastutivarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||cha|| ||
<1.3.2.21>
|| naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || tadā brahmā sarasvatyā mahāviṣṇuśca padmayā || śakraḥ pulomasutayā pare dikpālakā api || 1 || gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghā vasavo'pi surā api || trayastriṃśatkoṭigaṇāḥ pare muni gaṇā api || 2 || ekādaśamahārudrā ādityā dvādaśāpi ca || bhairavāśca piśācāśca vetālāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ || 3 || yakṣarakṣoragā bhūtā ye cānye śivakiṃkarāḥ || saṃtoṣabhājaḥ sarve'pi vikaṭākāraveṣṭitāḥ || 4 || parivārya maheśānaṃ samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || tadvīrāśaṃsanaṃ dṛṣṭvā yoginīdānavaiḥ kṛtam || 5 || atīva vismayaṃ bhejuḥ sarve kalpāṃtabhīṣaṇam || kṛtasāṃnidhyamālokya devamānaṃdayaṃtyumā || 6 || cirarātraprarūḍhāṃ ca tadviyogavyathāṃ jahau || romāṃcitā svinnamukhī vepamānā ghanastanī || 7 || pādāṃgulīṣu nayane viniveśayati sma sā || vṛṣabhādavaruhyātha gṛhītvaināṃ kare śivaḥ || smitaśarīrakaṃṭhaśrīpraṇayenaivamabravīt || 8 || || śiva uvāca || || vyākulīkriyate devi kimevaṃ kāraṇaṃ vinā || 9 || sarvairārādhanīyeti mayāpi ghaṭitoṃjaliḥ || kiṃ na vetsyāvayoraikyaṃ jyotsnācaṃdramasoriva || 1.3.2.21.10 || anādisiddhaṃ deveśi tavedaṃ maugdhyamīdṛśam || kvedaṃ śirīṣamṛdvaṃgi śarīraṃ te girīndraje || 11 || tapaḥ samādhayaśceti kva karkaśajanocitāḥ | nārāyaṇohaṃ lakṣmīstvaṃ brahmāsmi tvaṃ sarasvatī || 12 || vāruṇī tvaṃ phaṇīṃdrohaṃ rohiṇī tvamahaṃ śaśī || svāhā tvaṃ havyavāho'haṃ sūryo'haṃ tvaṃ suvarcalā ||13|| jāhnavī tvaṃ samudro'haṃ merurasmi tvamurvarā || pulomajā tvaṃ śakrohaṃ tvaṃ ratiścittabhūraham || 14 || buddhistvaṃ rājarājohaṃ tvaṃ śamā'haṃ samīraṇa || pāthodhipo'haṃ vīcistvaṃ prakṛtistvaṃ pumānaham || 15 || vidyā tvaṃ veditavyo'haṃ vāktvamarthopi pārvatī || īśvaro'haṃ madaṃśāsi tvayaivājñāsvarūpayā || 16|| sṛṣṭi sthityupasaṃhāravidhānānugraheśvare || na bhedo'tastvayā kāryaḥ pṛthagjanavadāvayoḥ || 17 || citprakāśātmanordevi svecchādhṛtaśarīrayā || vyākulīkuruṣe śaśvadvṛthaiverṣyāyase hi mām || 18 || dṛṣṭāpratikriyā tasya kriyate yādhunā mayā|| ityuktveśo niṣaṇṇastāṃ pārśvadeśe nyaveśayat || 19 || gaurīṃ svakīya evāṃge gūhamānāmiva hriyā || aṃgadvayaṃ tayoraikyamagātpremṇā ca līnayoḥ || 1.3.2.21.20 || arthadvayamivāhnāya saṃnikarṣopalaṃbhataḥ || ardhe karpūradhavalamardhe siṃdhūrapāṭalam || 21 || tadvicitramabhūdaṃgaṃ śivayorekatāṃ gatam || ardhe kuṃtaladāmārdhahāramadhye tu kuṃcikā ||22 || aṃgādardheṃducūḍasya vapurardhendukūlitam || ekanūpuratāṭaṃkaparihāryamanoharam || 23 || ekapiṃgalasadhrīco gātramekastanaṃ babhau || devyai dattvā ca dhāmārthaṃ vāmadevo jagāda tām || 24 || avakāśo ruṣo devi mā bhūrataḥ paraṃ tava || stanyārthinaṃ guhaṃ hitvā yātāsi tapase yataḥ || 25 || tadapītastanīnāmnā nivasātra mamāṃtike || tvāmapītastanīṃ devīṃ śoṇādrīśaṃ ca māmapi || 26 || janāḥ sarve samārādhya ramaṃtāṃ bhogamokṣayoḥ || iyaṃ tvadaṃśajā devī durgā mahiṣasūdinī || 27 || atraiva sannidhattāṃ tu maṃtrasiddhipradā nṛṇām || khaḍgatīrthamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sakṛdeva nimajjanāt || 28 || sarvarogaharaṃ puṃsāmastu sarvāghanāśanam|| pravālagirināthaśca devo'yaṃ pāpanāśanaḥ||29|| bhaktiśraddhāvatāṃ nṝṇāṃ bhūyāstāṃ bhūtaye bhṛśam|| ayaṃ ca gautamo devi tvadanugrahabhājanam|| ||1.3.2.21.30|| taponurūpaṃ bhajatāṃ lokeṣvācaṃdratārakam || imāśca mātaraḥ sapta saptalokaikamātaraḥ ||31|| adyaprabhṛti kurvaṃtu sānnidhyaṃ jagatāṃ śriyai || śāstāro bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālakā baṭukā api || 32 || aruṇakṣetra evātra nityaṃ kurvaṃtu saṃnidhim || atrāhamaruṇakṣetre nivasāmyaruṇāhvayaḥ || 33 || tvayāpyaruṇayā devyā sthātavyaṃ karuṇārdrayā || īpsināmaruṇādevau sānnidhyaṃ kuruto yataḥ || 34 || tadasminnaruṇakṣetre sulabhāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ|| 35 || idaṃ kṛtaṃ parvatarājaputryā prasādanaṃ śoṇagirīśvarasya || śṛṇoti yaḥ sa dviṣato vidhūya svargāpavargau sulabhāvupeyāt || 36 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe śivakṛtapārvatīpraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || || cha || ||
<1.3.2.22>
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || svāminnityaśivānanda bhagavannaṃdikeśvara || āhlādito'smi śoṇeśamāhātmyasudhayā tvayā || 1 || kathaṃ vajrāṃgadaḥ pāṃḍyarājaḥ śoṇavyatikramam || cakre kathaṃ tadbhaktyaiva prāptavānsaṃpadaṃ punaḥ || 2 || kathaṃ vidyādharādhīśau kāṃtiśālikalādharau || durvāsaḥśāpanirviddhāvavitau śoṇaśaṃbhunā || 3 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || dīrghāyuṣyatvasāphalyaṃ labdhavāṃstvaṃ mṛkaṇḍuja || yadiyaṃ stheyasī bhaktirbhavato bhūtanāyake || 4 || vakṣye vajrāṃgadodaṃtaṃ vṛttaṃ vidyābhṛtorapi || yato'bhūnmahito loke śoṇādrīśvaravaibhavaḥ || 5 || āsīdvajrāṃgadonāma purā pāṃḍyeṣu pārthivaḥ || āste yasya bhujastambhe vasudhā sālabhaṃjikā || 6 || dhārmiko nyāyavijjñātā gaṃbhīro dakṣiṇam kṣamaḥ || śāṃto vinayavāndhīmānekadāravrataḥ kṛtī || 7 || śivapūjārcanarataḥ śrīmāñchīlavatāṃ varaḥ || pṛthvīmāsetukedārācchaśāsa jitaśātravaḥ || 8 || kadācinmṛgayāvyājātsa caransuturaṃgamaḥ || aruṇācalaparyaṃtaṃ kāṃtāraṃ samagāhata || 9 || sa tatra bahalāmodaṃ kaṃcitkastūrikāmṛgam || dṛṣṭvā tamanvakturagaṃ prāvartayata kautukāt || 1.3.2.22.10 | sa mṛgo'nudrutastena abhitaḥ śoṇaparvatam || prādakṣiṇyātparīyāya papāta ca manojavaḥ || 11 || tataḥ sa bhagnasāropi rājā jātaśramaścaran || papāta vāhādvicchāyaḥ kṣīṇapuṇya iva dyutaḥ || 12 || ajñātakāraṇenaivaṃ mātaṃgeneva pīḍitaḥ || nājñāsītkṣaṇamātmānaṃ rājā grahagṛhītavat || 13 || aciṃtayacca koyaṃ me nirhetuḥ sattvaviplavaḥ || kva gataḥ sa hyakasmānme upavāhyasturaṃgamaḥ || 14 || iti ciṃtākule tasmiṃstajjñānepyapaṭīyasi || taḍittaṭajaṭāleva sahasā dyauradṛśyata || 15 || nirīkṣamāṇa evāsminhitvā tiryakkalevaram || tūrṇaṃ turaṃgasāraṃgau khecaratvamupāgatau || 16 || kirīṭinau kuṇḍalinau hārakeyūradhāriṇau || kṣaumāṃtarīyottarīyau sragviṇau ca virejatuḥ || 17 || avocatāṃ ca nṛpatimāścaryākṛṣṭamānasam || haraṃtāviva dantāṃśujālaistvasyārttijaṃ tamaḥ || 18 || rājannalaṃ viṣādena śoṇādrīśaprabhāvataḥ || etāṃ jānīhi saṃjātāṃ navāṃ nau cedṛśī daśām|| 19 || tadovāca tayoḥ kiṃcidāśvastaiva pārthivaḥ || kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣiṣṭa tāvubhau vinayānvitaḥ ||1.3.2.22.20|| kau yuvāṃ nirmito yābhyāmabhiṣaṃgo mamedṛśaḥ || bhadrau bhaṇatamārttānāṃ trāṇaṃ hi mahatāṃ guṇaḥ || 21 || iti tena kṛte praśne tamuvāca kalādharaḥ || rājānaṃ janitāścaryaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ kāṃtiśālinā || 22 || avehi rājannāvāṃ hi purāvidyādhareśvarau || parasparātisauhārdau vasaṃtamadanāviva || 23 || ekadā tu suvarṇādreḥ pārśve durvāsaso muneḥ || tapovanamagacchāva manaso'pi durāsadam ||24|| krośeddhāṃ tapasastasya śivārādhanasādhanīm || puṣpojjvalāmapaśyāva puṇyāmārāmavāṭikām ||25|| vinītāvapyasaṃjātau tattvocitasudhīgaṇau || prāviśāva tadudyānaṃ prasūnāvacayotsukau || 26 || sthalasya tasya sauhārdātkāṃtiśālyatigarvitaḥ || saṃcacāra muhuḥ pādanyāsairāghaṭṭayanmahīm || 27 || ahaṃ tu tatra puṣpāṇāṃ gaṃdhātiśayamohitaḥ || vikasvareṣu puṣpeṣu nyastahasto durāśayaḥ || 28 || tataḥ śāṃḍilyamūlastho vyāghracarmāsane sthitaḥ || durvāsāstapasāṃ rāśirjvalanniva hutāśanaḥ ||29 || amarṣotkarṣanīraṃdhraspaṃdamānādharacchadaḥ || karāla bhṛkuṭībaṃdhasārālitaviśālabhūḥ || 1.3.2.22.30 || saroṣo'bhūttejasāḍhyo gharmadaṃturavigrahaḥ || dahanniva dṛśā paśyannabhartsayata nau muniḥ || 31 || āḥ pāpau pracyutācārau kau yuvāmatigarvitau || jvalataḥ kopavahnerme śalabhatvamupāgatau || 32 || tapovanamidaṃ matkaṃ pāvanaṃ bhūtabhāvanam || pādairna spṛśataḥ kvāpi sūryācaṃdramasāvapi ||33|| puravairisaparyāyāḥ paryāyakamidaṃ vanam || na spaṃdate'tra vātopi na lipyaṃte'tra ṣaṭapadāḥ || 34 || tadetatpādasaṃcārairdūṣayanneṣa pātakī|| hayo bhavatu bhūloke paravāhyatvapīḍitaḥ || 35 || aparopyayamatyugre patatvacalakaṃdare prasūnagaṃdhalobhādyo gaṃdhasāraṃgatāṃ gataḥ ||36|| iti tenograroṣeṇa śāpavajre nipātite || tatkṣaṇādvigaladgarvāvāvāṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ gatau || 37 || abhidhāya ca taṃ devamāhitāṃghriparigrahaiḥ || amogha eṣa tvacchāpastadasyāṃto nivedyatām || 38 || athātidīnamanasāvāvāmālokya pārthiva || sānugraho'bhūnmunirāṭ kāruṇyādatiśītalaḥ || 39 || abhāṣata ca maivaṃ bho bhavatoḥ kvāpi durdhiyoḥ || śāpasya bhavitā śāṃtiraruṇādreḥ pradakṣiṇāt || 1.3.2.22.40 || purā khalu purārātiradhyatiṣṭhacchubhāṃ sabhām || paryupāsyata dikpālairiṃdropeṃdrayamādibhiḥ || 41 || tadā ca devadevāya naṃdanāraṇyadevatā || upāyanīkṛtavatī phalaṃ kimapi pāṭalam || 42 || bālyātkutūhalākrāntau gajānanaṣaḍānanau || pitaraṃ tadayācetāṃ lobhanīyataraṃ phalam || 43 || atha tāvavadaddevastanayau phalatarṣitau || gopayitvā phalaṃ pāṇisaṃpuṭena kumārakau || 44 || imāṃ samastāṃ pṛthivīṃ lokālokena veṣṭitām || yo vāṃ pradakṣiṇīkartumīṣṭe tasmai dadāmyaham || 45 || ityukte pārvatīśena smayamānamukheṃdunā || skaṃdaḥ pradakṣiṇīkartuṃ medinīmupacakrame || 46 || laṃbodarastu devasya śoṇaśailākṛteḥ pituḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā purastādeva tatkṣaṇāt || 47 || taddṛṣṭvā tasya cāturyaṃ heraṃbāya triyaṃvakaḥ || phalaṃ vitīrṇavānasmai praṇayāghrātamastakaḥ || 48 || adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ phalānāmadhināyakaḥ || bhavetyasmai varaṃ dattvā hyekadaṃtāya śaṃkaraḥ || 49 || babhāṣe ca sabhāstārānsarvānapi surāsurān || prasaraddaśanajyotsnākarburīkṛtamaṃdiraḥ ||1.3.2.22.50 || sthāvaroyaṃ mamākāraḥ śoṇādriryo'sya bhaktitaḥ || pradakṣiṇāṃ vitanute sa me sārūpyabhāgbhavet || 51 || gireḥ pradakṣiṇenāsya yasya dhattaḥ pade rujam || sa samrāṭsakalotkṛṣṭaṃ labhate śāśvataṃ padam || 52 || iti śāsanataḥ śaṃbhoḥ śoṇaśailapradakṣiṇam || vidhāya sarvagīrvāṇā lebhire svaṃ svamīpsitam || 53 || yuvāmapi madodbhūtamālinyau śikṣitau mayā || pradakṣiṇena śoṇādreḥ śāpāṃto vāṃ bhaviṣyati || 54 || tiraścorapi vāṃ sidhyedaruṇādreḥ pradakṣiṇā || vajrāṃgadasya pāṃḍyasya nṛpateranubaṃdhataḥ || 55 || ityamarṣaṇamaharṣimahābdheḥ śāpahālahala śoṣitagātrau || pātitau bahulapātakabhārātkṣipramaśvamṛgajātiṣu jātau || 56 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe 'ruṇācalapradakṣiṇāmāhātmye vajrāṃgada vṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || || || || cha ||
<1.3.2.23>
