|| kalādhara uvāca || || kāṃbojeṣu hayo bhūtvā kāṃtiśālī suhṛnmama || ayāsīdaupavāhyatvaṃ bhavato rājapuṃgava || 1 || ahaṃ ca gaṃdhamṛgatāṃ gataḥ svāṃgaprasūtinā || sugaṃdhinā madenāsya saṃcāraṃ cācaraṃ gireḥ || 2 || dharmātmanmṛgayāvyājādāgatena tvayādhunā || āvāṃ śoṇādrināthasya prāpitau hi pradakṣiṇām || 3 || vāhārohaṇadoṣeṇa tavāsīdīdṛśī daśā || pādapracārapuṇyena prāptaṃ nau prāktanaṃ padam|| 4 || rājeṃdra tava saṃbaṃdhādasmāttiryaktvabaṃdhanāt || muktāvāvāṃ svakaṃ dhāma prāptau svastyastu te sadā|| 5 || ityudīrya nijaṃ dhāma yiyāsaṃtaṃ kalādharam || kāṃtiśālinaṃ ca rājā jagāda racitāṃjaliḥ || 6 || evaṃ yuvāṃ śoṇaśailaśaṃkarasya prabhāvataḥ || śāpārṇavaṃ samuttīrṇau kathaṃ me punarucchrayaḥ ||7|| bhrāmyatīva mama svāṃtamādhāya tadavekṣaṇam || niryāṃtīva mama prāṇāstatra daivaṃ balottaram || 8|| || kalādharakāṃtiśālināvūcatuḥ || || avadhāraya nistāraṃ kathayāva tavāsyadam || samāhitena manasā nirdhūtanikhilādhinā || 9 || jagatsargasthitidhvaṃsavidhānānugraheśvare || aruṇādrīśvare cittaṃ nidhehi karuṇānidhau ||1.3.2.23.10|| pratyakṣitaṃ tvayedānīmasya devasya vaibhavam || tiraścorāvayoretadīdṛśatvaṃ vitanvataḥ || 11 || kuru pradakṣiṇāṃ pādacārī mṛgamadādṛtaiḥ || kalhāraiḥ pūjayeśānaṃ devaṃ mṛgamadapriyam || 12 || yāvatī tava saṃpattistāvatīmakhilāṃ vibho || prākāragopurāgāranavīkārāya kalpaya || 13 || acirādeva siddhiste bhaviṣyati garīyasī || manumāṃdhātṛnābhāgabhagīrathavadādhikā || 14 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || itthaṃ niśamya ca tayornijameva dhāma vidyābhṛtoḥ sapadi saṃśrutayornarendraḥ || niḥsaṃśayena manasā niratastadānīṃ bhaktiṃ babaṃdha bhagavatyaruṇādrināthe ||15|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe kalādharakāṃtiśālivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||23|| ||
<1.3.2.24>
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || bhagavanbhavamāhātmyaratnākarasudhākaram || naṃdīśa citraṃ cāritraṃ śrutaṃ vidyābhṛtordvayoḥ || 1 || kadā vajrāṃgadaḥ siddhaḥ kathaṃ devamapūjayat || kathaṃ cānvagrahītprahvaṃ devastamaruṇeśvaraḥ || 2 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || nivarttanecchāṃ hitvātha nṛpo nijapuraṃ prati || tasyaiva pādaparyaṃte svasya vāsamarocayat || 3 || athāsya mahatī senā vāhamārgānusāriṇī || prāptā śatāṃgamātaṃgaturaṃgabhaṭasaṃkulā || 4 || samadṛśyata bhūpālastādṛśo dhairyasāgaraḥ || purodhomaṃtrisāmaṃtasenāpatisuhṛttamaiḥ || 5 || tatastāmāgatāṃ senāmavanīpatirādṛtaḥ || aruṇādreśca sīmāyā bahireva nyaveśayat || 6 || svakīyamakhilaṃ kośaṃ deśānapi mahāphalān || śoṇādrināthapūjāyai kalpayāmāsa bhaktimān || 7 || gautamasyāśramābhyāśe svayaṃ kṛtatapovanaḥ || purodhoktaḥ sasacivaḥ śivārcanarato'bhavat || 8 || ratnāṃgadākhyaṃ tanayaṃ sthāpayitvā nije pade || tatpreṣitairaparyāptaiḥ śoṇeśaṃ paryatarpayat || 9 || paritaḥ śoṇaśailasya paripūrṇajalāśayān || agrahārānbahuphalānbrāhmaṇebhyo'tisṛṣṭavān || 1.3.2.24.10 || tejasāruṇanāthasya jvalanastaṃbharūpiṇaḥ || dhanvaprāye'pi deśe'smindīrghikāḥ śataśo vyadhāt || 11 || sauṃdaryaśālinīrātmaparivāravarāṃganāḥ || sevārthaṃ śoṇanāthasya dattavāndīrghadarśanaḥ || 12 || athāgatenāgastyena lopāmudrāsakhena saḥ || abhyanaṃdyata śoṇādrināthapūjāparāyaṇaḥ || 13 || pratyahaṃ navatīrthākhye sarasi snānamācaran || pāpanāśapravāleśau prayataḥ paryapūjayat || 14 || mahiṣāsurasaṃhārakāriṇī mānaveśvaraḥ || nityamārādhayāmāsa durgāṃ durggārtihāriṇīm || || 15 || pratikṣaṇaṃ brahmaviṣṇupūjyasya liṃgarūpiṇaḥ || ādidevasya vividhāḥ saparyāḥ paryakalpayat || 16 || pratyuṣasyutthitaḥ snātaḥ pādābhyāmeva pārthivaḥ || japanpaṃcākṣarīmaṃtramakārṣīttriḥ pradakṣiṇām || 17 || paurṇamāsyāṃ sa kārttikyāṃ pārvatīvallabhapriyam || mahādīpotsavaṃ cakre mahitaṃ bhuvanatraye || 18 || sugaṃdhasārakahlārakarpūrajalapūritaḥ || sahasraiḥ svarṇakuṃbhānāmabhyaṣiṃcattriyaṃtrakam || 19 || pratimāsadhvajārohapūrvaṃ tīrthotsavādikam || trailokyābhyarhitaṃ cakre rathārohaṃ mahotsavam|| 1.3.2.24.20|| aṃgaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ cāsya vidadhe viśadāśayaḥ|| yojanatritayāyāmavyāpinaḥ śoṇabhūbhṛtaḥ||21|| aruṇācalanātheti karuṇāmṛtasāgaraḥ|| aruṇāṃvāsanātheti tuṣṭāva ca muhurmuhuḥ||22|| saṃlipya vividhairdravyairnityaṃ paṃcāmṛtādibhiḥ|| ācarca yadgaṃdhasārapaṃkaiḥ karpūrapāṃḍuraiḥ || 23 || apūjayata kalhāraiḥ sravanmṛgamadadravaiḥ || prā tarārabhya śoṇādrināyakaṃ gaṇarūpiṇam || 24 || iti varṣatrayaṃ tasya vaśino varivasyayā || aruṇādrīśvarastuṣṭaḥ pratyakṣatvamagāhata ||25|| nīhārācalasaṃkāśamārūḍho vṛṣapuṃgavam|| anvagāsīnayā devyā kṛtagāḍhopagūhanaḥ|| 26|| brahmarṣibhirvasiṣṭhādyairnāradādyairmaharṣibhiḥ|| gaṇairnikuṃbhakuṃbhādyaiḥ kriyamāṇajayastutiḥ || 27|| karuṇāsiṃdhukallolaiḥ kamalāvāsaveśmabhiḥ || kaṭākṣapātairjagatāṃ kāluṣyamiva vārayan || 28 || dṛṣṭvā ca devadevaṃ tamaṣṭāṃgaṃ nyasya bhūtale || praṇanāma paraṃ hṛṣṭo vajrāṃgadamahīpatiḥ || 29 || vyajñāpayacca bhūpālo maulīkṛtaśatāṃjaliḥ || kṣālayanniva daṃtāṃśujālaistatpādapaṃkaje || 1.3.2.24.30 || || || vajrāṃgada uvāca || || deveśa yadahaṃ mohādbahupātakasaṃcayam || acāriṣaṃ sa eko'yaṃ kṣamyatāṃ me vyatikramaḥ || 31 || itivādinamatyaṃtaṃ dīnameva dayānidhiḥ || jagāda jagatīnātho devaḥ śoṇācaleśvaraḥ || 32 || || śrīmaheśvara uvāca || || mā bhaiṣīrvatsa bhadraṃ te saṃtyaṣṭau mama mūrttayaḥ || tāḥ sarvāḥ sarvajaṃtūnāmatyarthaṃ parikalpitāḥ || 33 || purā puraṃdarastvaṃ hi kailāsaśikhare sthitam || garvito māmavāmaṃsthāḥ staṃbhitaśca tadā mayā || 34 || kṣaṇaṃ galitagarvastvaṃ staṃbhanā vrīḍitastadā || ayāciṣṭhāḥ śivajñānamakhilaiśvaryakāraṇam || 35 || ādiṣṭastvaṃ mayā vajrinnavatīryāvaniṃ bhavān|| rājā vajrāṃgado bhūtvā lapsyase matkṛpāmiti|| 36|| jātaṃ tataḥ prabhāveṇa kṣetrametanmadāspadam|| śikṣitotīva mugdhastvaṃ bhaktosi ca paraṃ mayi || 37 || adhunātisaparyābhistvatkṛtābhiraharniśam || parituṣṭosmyahaṃ rājannatastvāṃ bodhayāmyaham || 38 || khaṃ vāyuranalo vāri bhūḥ sūrya śaśinau pumān || iti manmūrttibhirviśvaṃ bhāsate sacarācaram || 39 || kālo hi kālayāmyarthānsattvānadhvana eva ca || tattvātītaḥ śivaścāhaṃ na mattostīha kiṃcana || 1.3.2.24.40 || aparyaṃtacidānaṃdasiṃdhorme kecidūrmayaḥ || vedhomukundarudreṃdramukhānāhuruditvarāḥ || 41 || vāṇīlakṣmīkṣamāśraddhāprajñāsvāhāsvadhādayaḥ || asaṃkhyeyamahāśaktermama visṛṣṭiśaktayaḥ || 42 || iyaṃ mama mahāśaktirgaurī māyā jagatprasūḥ || anayācchādyate viśvaṃ śaśvadvistāryate'pi ca || 43 || śaktyānayānvitaḥ sargarakṣāsaṃhṛtivibhramaḥ || vicitrametatpaśyāmi jagaccitraṃ nijecchayā ||44|| apavāhitamohastvaṃ mahimā me vicāraya || ātmānamavibhinnaṃ me taraṃgamiva vāridheḥ || 45 || tato madrūpaśālinyā ādhipatyaṃ kṣitergataḥ || matprasādena rājeṃdra bhuṃkṣva bhogānyathāsukham || 46 || punaḥ puraṃdaratvena bhuktadivyasukhaściram|| madekarūpatāṃ rājanniścayāttvamavāpsyasi || 47 || || naṃdikeśvara uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtarhite deve rājā vajrāṃgadaḥ kṛtī || śoṇeśaṃ pūjayanneva sarvānbhogānavāptavān ||48|| itthaṃ te kathitaṃ sādho śivabhaktavijṛṃbhaṇam || pradakṣiṇāphalaṃ caiva śoṇaśailasya śāśvatam || 49 || kiṃ vācāṃ vistareṇātra śoṇaśailapradakṣiṇā || mahatāmaśvamedhānāṃ śatādapi viśiṣyate || 1.3.2.24.50 || viṣuvāyanasaṃkrāti vyatīpātādiparvasu || pradakṣiṇācchoṇagirerasaṃkhyeyaṃ phalaṃ labhet || 51 || na kṣetramaruṇādasti nāsti devo'ruṇeśvarāt || nāpi pradakṣiṇādanyadvipadyate'bhyadhikaṃ tapaḥ || 52 || iti kathayati naṃdikeśvaresminpulakitasarvavapurmṛkaṇḍuputraḥ || muhuradhigataharṣavāṣpavṛṣṭirmahati nimagna ivābhavatsudhābdhau || 53 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe'ruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhe vajrāṃgadasadgativarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || cha || || ityaruṇācalamāhātmya uttarārdhaḥ samāptaḥ || (3.2) || ityaruṇācalamāhātmyaṃ saṃpūrṇam || (3) ||
